department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 高齡同伴動物照護者之工作－非工作衝突經驗研究
title_en: A Study on Work–Nonwork Conflict Experiences among Caregivers of Aging Companion Animals
keywords: 人力資源管理、工作－非工作衝突、非典型照護責任、高齡同伴動物、描述現象學
abstract_zh: 本研究以人力資源管理視角出發，探討高齡同伴動物照護者在照護歷程中所經驗之工作－非工作衝突。隨著少子化、高齡化與家庭型態多元化，照護責任已不再侷限於傳統親屬關係；同伴動物逐漸成為現代人生活中的重要家庭成員與情感支持來源。然而，當同伴動物步入高齡時，照護者往往需投入大量時間、情緒、體力與經濟資源，並在工作責任、生活品質與照護責任之間產生持續張力。　　本研究採描述現象學取徑，透過立意取樣邀請八位具高齡犬隻主要照護經驗之職場工作者參與半結構式深度訪談，並依 Colaizzi 分析程序進行資料分析。研究結果歸納出三項主題：一為「工作責任中的照護牽掛與角色拉扯」；二為「日常生活中的照護負荷與身心消耗」；三為「多重責任交會中的持續取捨與意義調整」。研究指出，高齡同伴動物照護具有情感責任深重與制度承認不足並存之特徵，建議未來工作－非工作衝突研究可納入跨物種照護經驗；實務上，組織可於彈性工時、員工福利及悲傷支持等面向提升包容性。
abstract_en: From the perspective of human resource management, this study explores the work–nonwork conflict experienced by caregivers of aging companion animals throughout the caregiving process. With declining birthrates, population aging, and the diversification of family structures, caregiving responsibilities are no longer confined to traditional kinship relations. Companion animals have gradually become important family members and sources of emotional support in modern life. However, when companion animals enter old age, caregivers often need to invest substantial time, emotional energy, physical effort, and financial resources, thereby experiencing persistent tensions among work responsibilities, quality of life, and caregiving responsibilities.　　Adopting a descriptive phenomenological approach, this study used purposive sampling to recruit eight working adults with primary caregiving experience for aging dogs. Data were collected through semi-structured in-depth interviews and analyzed following Colaizzi’s method. The findings were organized into three themes: “care-related concern and role tension within work responsibilities,” “caregiving burden and physical and psychological exhaustion in daily life,” and “continuous negotiation and meaning adjustment amid intersecting responsibilities.” The study indicates that aging companion animal care is characterized by both profound emotional responsibility and insufficient institutional recognition. Accordingly, future research on work–nonwork conflict may incorporate cross-species caregiving experiences as an analytical dimension. In practice, organizations may enhance inclusiveness toward nontraditional caregiving responsibilities through flexible working arrangements, employee benefits, and grief-support measures.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 技術型高中產學攜手僑生專班學生知覺教師支持對其實習之影響-以自我效能為中介
title_en: The Impact of Perceived Teacher Support on Internship Outcomes among Students in Industry–Academia Collaboration Programs at Technical High Schools: The Mediating Role of Self-Efficacy
keywords: 技術型高中、教師支持、產學攜手僑生專班、實習表現、自我效能
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在探討技術型高中產學攜手合作僑生專班學生知覺教師支持對其實習表現之影響，並以自我效能作為中介變項，分析知覺教師支持、自我效能與實習表現三者之間的關係。研究背景係基於我國少子女化趨勢、產業人力需求增加，以及政府推動新南向政策與產學攜手合作僑生專班，使來臺就讀技術型高中之僑生人數逐年增加。僑生除須適應新的語言與文化環境外，亦須兼顧校內課程學習及校外實習，於學習、生活及職場適應歷程中容易面臨語言溝通、文化差異、人際互動及工作適應等挑戰。因此，教師所提供之情感支持、學術支持、資訊支持及評價支持，不僅有助於提升學生之學習信心與自我效能，亦可能進一步影響其實習表現，值得深入探討。    本研究採量化研究方法，以問卷調查法蒐集資料，研究對象為新北市某技術型高中114學年度在學之產學攜手合作僑生專班且具有校外實習經驗之學生。研究工具包括「知覺教師支持量表」、「自我效能量表」及「實習表現量表」，共回收有效問卷1,047份（總體有效回收率為90.73%）。所得資料以SPSS 23統計軟體進行分析，採用描述性統計、皮爾森積差相關分析、多元迴歸分析及PROCESS Macro Model 4 Bootstrap中介效果檢定，以驗證各研究假設及變項間之影響關係。    研究結果顯示，產學攜手合作僑生專班學生之知覺教師支持、自我效能及實習表現整體皆達高程度水準。其中，知覺教師支持以學術性支持得分最高，自我效能以學習效能最高，實習表現則以職場倫理表現最佳，顯示教師在專業學習協助與學生職場態度養成方面具有重要影響。此外，相關分析結果顯示，知覺教師支持、自我效能及實習表現三者之間皆呈顯著正相關，其中自我效能與實習表現之相關程度最高（r = .723，p < .01），其次為知覺教師支持與自我效能（r = .589，p < .01）及知覺教師支持與實習表現（r = .543，p < .01）。    迴歸分析結果顯示，知覺教師支持能顯著正向預測自我效能及實習表現；中介效果分析進一步證實，自我效能在知覺教師支持與實習表現之間具有顯著部分中介效果，顯示教師支持除可直接提升學生之實習表現外，亦可透過增強學生之自我效能，進一步提升其實習成效與職場適應能力。   本研究結論如下：一、產學攜手合作僑生專班學生之知覺教師支持、自我效能及實習表現皆達高程度水準。二、知覺教師支持與自我效能呈顯著中度正相關。三、知覺教師支持與實習表現呈顯著中度正相關。四、自我效能與實習表現呈顯著高度正相關，且為三組變項中相關程度最高者。五、自我效能在知覺教師支持與實習表現之間具有顯著部分中介效果。    綜合而言，本研究驗證知覺教師支持、自我效能與實習表現之間的影響機制，顯示教師支持不僅直接影響學生之實習表現，更可透過提升學生自我效能發揮間接效果。本研究除補充技術型高中產學攜手合作僑生專班相關實證研究外，亦可作為教育行政機關、學校行政單位、教師及建教合作機構規劃僑生輔導、實習制度、教師增能、多元文化教育及職涯發展政策之重要參考，以提升僑生學習適應、跨文化適應能力及實習成效，進而培育符合產業需求之技術人才。
abstract_en: This study aimed to investigate the influence of perceived teacher support on the internship performance of students enrolled in the Industry-Academia Collaboration International Student Program at a vocational high school, with self-efficacy serving as a mediating variable. Specifically, the study examined the relationships among perceived teacher support, self-efficacy, and internship performance. The study was conducted against the backdrop of Taiwan's declining birth rate, increasing industrial demand for skilled labor, and the implementation of the New Southbound Policy and the Industry-Academia Collaboration International Student Program, which have led to a growing number of international students enrolling in vocational high schools. In addition to adapting to a new linguistic and cultural environment, international students are required to balance academic learning with off-campus internships and often encounter challenges related to language communication, cultural adaptation, interpersonal interaction, and workplace adjustment. Therefore, teachers' emotional, academic, informational, and appraisal support may not only enhance students' learning confidence and self-efficacy but also improve their internship performance, making this topic worthy of further investigation.A quantitative research design was adopted, and data were collected through a questionnaire survey. The participants consisted of students enrolled in the Industry-Academia Collaboration International Student Program with off-campus internship experience at a vocational high school in New Taipei City during the 2025 academic year. The research instruments included the Perceived Teacher Support Scale, Self-Efficacy Scale, and Internship Performance Scale. A total of 1,047 valid questionnaires were collected, yielding an effective response rate of 90.73%. The collected data were analyzed using SPSS Version 23. Statistical analyses included descriptive statistics, Pearson's product-moment correlation analysis, multiple regression analysis, and mediation analysis using PROCESS Macro Model 4 with the Bootstrap method to test the proposed hypotheses and examine the relationships among the variables.The findings indicated that the students demonstrated high levels of perceived teacher support, self-efficacy, and internship performance. Among the dimensions of perceived teacher support, academic support received the highest mean score. Within self-efficacy, learning efficacy ranked the highest, while workplace ethics received the highest score among the dimensions of internship performance, highlighting the important role of teachers in promoting students' professional learning and workplace attitudes. Furthermore, significant positive correlations were found among perceived teacher support, self-efficacy, and internship performance. The strongest correlation was observed between self-efficacy and internship performance (r = .723, p < .01), followed by perceived teacher support and self-efficacy (r = .589, p < .01), and perceived teacher support and internship performance (r = .543, p < .01).The regression analysis further revealed that perceived teacher support significantly and positively predicted both self-efficacy and internship performance. Mediation analysis confirmed that self-efficacy partially mediated the relationship between perceived teacher support and internship performance. These findings suggest that teacher support not only directly enhances students' internship performance but also indirectly improves internship outcomes by strengthening students' self-efficacy and workplace adaptability.The major findings of this study are summarized as follows:Students enrolled in the Industry-Academia Collaboration International Student Program demonstrated high levels of perceived teacher support, self-efficacy, and internship performance.Perceived teacher support was significantly and moderately positively correlated with self-efficacy.Perceived teacher support was significantly and moderately positively correlated with internship performance.Self-efficacy was significantly and highly positively correlated with internship performance, representing the strongest relationship among the three variables.Self-efficacy had a significant partial mediating effect on the relationship between perceived teacher support and internship performance.In conclusion, this study verified the relationships and underlying mechanism among perceived teacher support, self-efficacy, and internship performance. The findings indicate that teacher support not only directly enhances students' internship performance but also indirectly influences it by improving students' self-efficacy. The results contribute to the limited empirical research on students enrolled in the Industry-Academia Collaboration International Student Program at vocational high schools. They also provide valuable references for educational authorities, school administrators, teachers, and industry partners in developing student counseling services, internship systems, teacher professional development, multicultural education, and career guidance policies. Ultimately, these efforts may enhance international students' learning adjustment, cross-cultural adaptation, and internship performance, thereby cultivating skilled technical professionals who meet industry workforce needs.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 以活躍老化架構探討團體運動與體感遊戲介入對高齡者認知功能、孤獨感與 功能性體適能之研究
title_en: An Active Aging Framework for Examining the Effects of Group Exercise and Exergaming Interventions on Cognitive Function, Loneliness, and Functional Fitness among Older Adults
keywords: 活躍老化、高齡者、團體運動、體感遊戲、認知功能、孤獨感、功能性體適能
abstract_zh: 本研究基於活躍老化架構，旨在探討並比較「團體運動」與「體感遊戲」介入模式，對日照中心高齡者認知功能、孤獨感及功能性體適能之影響。研究採實驗設計，招募22位日照中心高齡者（69-79歲），隨機分派至團體運動組（8人）、體感遊戲組（7人）與自由活動組（7人）。實驗組接受為期12週、每週2次、每次80分鐘之介入訓練，並以量化測驗搭配質性訪談進行整合分析。研究結果顯示：在認知功能方面，團體運動組之空間定向感與注意力、體感遊戲組之空間定向感均呈顯著組內改善，惟組間差異未達顯著。在孤獨感方面，團體運動組顯著降低孤獨感；體感遊戲組量化雖無顯著差異，但質性回饋具備趣味性與互動性，有助促進社交參與。在功能性體適能方面，團體運動組於多項體適能指標皆具顯著組內改善，且在「4公尺走路」之改善幅度顯著優於自由活動組；體感遊戲組亦具改善趨勢，惟組間差異不顯著。綜上所述，兩種介入模式對高齡者身心健康皆具正向效益。團體運動在體適能與社交心理之成效較為全面，體感遊戲則在特定認知定向感與活動趣味性上具備優勢。建議未來可融合兩者特性，規劃兼具身體鍛鍊與科技趣味之多元化活躍老化促進方案。
abstract_en: Based on the active aging framework, this study aimed to explore and compare the effects of group exercise and exergame intervention modes on cognitive function, loneliness, and functional fitness among older adults in a daycare center. Employing a experimental design, 22 older adults aged 69 to 79 recruited from a daycare center were randomly assigned into three groups: a group exercise group (n=8), an exergame group (n=7), and a control group with free activities (n=7). Participants in the intervention groups received 80-minute training sessions twice weekly for 12 weeks, followed by an integrated analysis combining quantitative measurements and qualitative interviews.The results demonstrated that in terms of cognitive function, the group exercise group showed significant intra-group improvements in spatial orientation and attention, while the exergame group exhibited significant intra-group improvement in spatial orientation, though no significant differences were found between groups. Regarding loneliness, the group exercise group experienced a significant reduction, whereas the exergame group showed no statistically significant quantitative difference, yet qualitative feedback revealed that exergames offered fun and interactivity that helped promote social participation. For functional fitness, the group exercise group demonstrated significant intra-group improvements across multiple indicators, with its improvement in the 4-meter walk test being significantly superior to that of the control group. The exergame group also showed a positive trend of improvement, although inter-group differences were not statistically significant.In conclusion, both intervention modes yielded positive health benefits for the physical and mental well-being of older adults. Group exercise demonstrated more comprehensive outcomes in physical fitness and psychosocial well-being, whereas exergames showed distinct advantages in specific cognitive spatial orientation and activity enjoyment. Future initiatives are recommended to combine the features of both modalities to design diversified active aging promotion programs that integrate physical exercise with technology-enhanced engagement.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 探討組織氛圍、目標導向、知識分享行為與知識藏匿行為的關係
title_en: Examining the Relations among Organizational Climate, Goal Orientations, Knowledge Sharing Behavior, and Knowledge Hoarding Behavior
keywords: 組織氛圍、目標導向、知識分享行為、知識藏匿行為、員工行為模型
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在探討組織氛圍如何透過目標導向影響員工知識分享行為與知識藏匿行為，並檢驗目標導向之中介效果。研究以員工行為模型為整體理論架構，將組織氛圍視為組織層次之外在情境因素，目標導向視為個體層次之內在心理因素，以探討組織情境如何透過個體心理因素影響員工知識分享行為與知識藏匿行為。本研究以臺灣企業正式辦公室員工為研究對象，採問卷調查法，透過立意抽樣搭配滾雪球抽樣方式蒐集資料，共取得350份有效樣本，並以描述性統計、Spearman等級相關分析、驗證性因素分析及路徑分析進行資料分析。研究結果顯示，合作型組織氛圍有助於提升精熟趨近目標導向與表現趨近目標導向，進而促進知識分享行為；競爭型組織氛圍則同時促進知識分享行為與提高知識藏匿行為；個人主義型組織氛圍則強化表現迴避目標導向，進而提高知識藏匿行為。此外，目標導向在組織氛圍與知識分享行為、知識藏匿行為之間具有顯著中介效果，而薪資對知識分享行為與知識藏匿行為之直接影響較有限。整體而言，組織氛圍會透過影響員工之目標導向，進一步影響其知識分享行為與知識藏匿行為。本研究結果可作為企業營造適切組織氛圍、引導員工正向目標導向，以及促進知識分享行為、降低知識藏匿行為之管理參考。
abstract_en: This study examined how organizational climate influences employees’ knowledge sharing behavior and knowledge hoarding behavior through goal orientations and investigated the mediating role of goal orientations. Drawing on a model of employee behavior, this study examined how the organizational context influences employees' knowledge-sharing and knowledge-hoarding behaviors through psychological factors. Data were collected from 350 full-time office employees in Taiwanese enterprises using purposive and snowball sampling. Descriptive statistics, Spearman’s rank correlation analysis, confirmatory factor analysis (CFA), and path analysis were performed. The results indicated that a cooperative organizational climate promoted mastery-approach and performance-approach goal orientations, thereby enhancing knowledge sharing behavior. A competitive organizational climate increased both knowledge sharing behavior and knowledge hoarding behavior, whereas an individualistic organizational climate strengthened performance-avoidance goal orientations, thereby increasing knowledge hoarding behavior. Goal orientations significantly mediated the relationships between organizational climate and both knowledge sharing behavior and knowledge hoarding behavior, whereas salary had limited direct effects. These findings provide practical implications for fostering an appropriate organizational climate, promoting positive goal orientations, encouraging knowledge sharing behavior, and reducing knowledge hoarding behavior.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 五年制專科學校化妝品相關科系學生參與校外實習行為意向之分析：以計畫行為理論為基礎
title_en: An Analysis of Students’ Behavioral Intention to Participate in Off-Campus Internships in Cosmetics-Related Programs at Five-Year Junior Colleges: A Theory of Planned Behavior Approach
keywords: 計畫行為理論、校外實習、角色認同、行為意向、五年制專科學校
abstract_zh: 關鍵詞：計畫行為理論、校外實習、角色認同、行為意向、五年制專科學校    本研究以計畫行為理論（Theory of Planned Behavior, TPB）為基礎，納入角色認同作為擴展變項，以探討臺灣五年制專科學校化妝品相關科系學生參與校外實習之行為意向。有鑑於國內技職教育長期面臨學用落差，校外實習被視為連結理論與實務、提升專業能力及就業競爭力的重要途徑。因此本研究除檢驗態度與知覺行為控制對實習意向之直接影響外，亦檢驗主觀規範是否透過角色認同之內化歷程，間接影響學生參與校外實習行為意向。本研究採量化研究取向，以自編問卷作為研究工具，並經專家效度審查、預試分析與題項修訂後進行正式施測。本研究依教育部統計處資料建立全國五年制專科化妝品相關科系學校清冊，並依北、中、南區域逐一接洽符合條件之學校。經學校同意配合後，由研究助理至合作學校，邀請該校三、四年級且年滿 18 歲、符合研究條件並願意參與之學生填答問卷，共取得 422 份有效問卷。研究資料以結構方程模型（Structural Equation Modeling, SEM）進行分析，以檢驗本研究所提出之學生校外實習行為意向模式、研究假說及角色認同之中介效果。研究結果顯示，本研究模式具良好整體配適度（χ² = 495.927，df = 213，χ²/df = 2.328，GFI =.907，AGFI =.880，CFI =.977，TLI = .973，RMSEA = .056，SRMR =.023），並可解釋行為意向85.8%之變異量，以及角色認同63.7%之變異量。態度（β =.247，p < .001）、知覺行為控制（β = .194，p=.003 ）與角色認同（β = .453，p < .001）皆顯著正向影響行為意向，其中以角色認同影響最大。主觀規範對角色認同具有顯著正向影響（β =.798，p < .001）；主觀規範對行為意向之直接效果未達顯著（β = .097，p = .084），但可透過角色認同間接影響行為意向（間接效果 = .361，95% CI = [.213, .532]），結果支持角色認同具有完全中介型態。綜合而言，五專化妝品相關科系學生參與校外實習之行為意向，主要受態度、知覺行為控制與角色認同影響，其中以角色認同為最關鍵因素；主觀規範則需透過角色認同之內化歷程，方能進一步提升學生參與校外實習之意願。建議學校強化學生對實習價值之認知，降低學生知覺到的實習障礙，並透過職涯探索、實習前的準備、業界示範與專業角色養成措施，培養學生對化妝品相關專業人員的角色認同，提升其參與校外實習之行為意向。
abstract_en: Keywords: Theory of Planned Behavior, off-campus internship, role identity, behavioral intention, five-year junior collegeThis study was grounded in the Theory of Planned Behavior (TPB) and incorporated role identity as an extended variable to investigate the behavioral intention of students in cosmetics-related programs at five-year junior colleges in Taiwan to participate in off-campus internships. Given the long-standing gap between school learning and workplace application in Taiwan’s technical and vocational education, off-campus internships are regarded as an important pathway for bridging theory and practice, enhancing professional competence, and strengthening employment competitiveness. Therefore, in addition to examining the direct effects of attitude and perceived behavioral control on internship intention, this study also examined whether subjective norm indirectly influences students’ behavioral intention to participate in off-campus internships through the internalization process of role identity.A quantitative research approach was adopted, and a researcher-developed questionnaire was used as the research instrument. The questionnaire was formally administered after expert review for content validity, pilot testing, and item revision. Based on data from the Department of Statistics of the Ministry of Education, this study compiled a roster of five-year junior colleges in Taiwan offering cosmetics-related programs. Eligible schools were contacted by region, including northern, central, and southern Taiwan. After obtaining institutional consent, research assistants visited the cooperating schools and invited third- and fourth-year students who were aged 18 or older, met the research criteria, and were willing to participate to complete the questionnaire. A total of 422 valid questionnaires were obtained. Structural equation modeling (SEM) was employed to analyze the data and to examine the proposed model of students’ behavioral intention to participate in off-campus internships, the research hypotheses, and the mediating effect of role identity.The results showed that the proposed model demonstrated good overall fit: χ² = 495.927, df = 213, χ²/df = 2.328, GFI = .907, AGFI = .880, CFI = .977, TLI = .973, RMSEA = .056, and SRMR = .023. The model explained 85.8% of the variance in behavioral intention and 63.7% of the variance in role identity. Attitude (β = .247, p < .001), perceived behavioral control (β = .194, p = .003), and role identity (β = .453, p < .001) all had significant positive effects on behavioral intention, with role identity exerting the strongest effect. Subjective norm had a significant positive effect on role identity (β = .798, p < .001). The direct effect of subjective norm on behavioral intention was not significant (β = .097, p = .084); however, subjective norm indirectly affected behavioral intention through role identity (indirect effect = .361, 95% CI = [.213, .532]), thereby supporting the full mediating effect of role identity.In conclusion, the behavioral intention of students in cosmetics-related programs at five-year junior colleges to participate in off-campus internships was mainly influenced by attitude, perceived behavioral control, and role identity. Among these factors, role identity was the most critical. Subjective norm enhanced students’ intention to participate in off-campus internships through the internalization process of role identity. It is recommended that schools strengthen students’ recognition of the value of internships, reduce their perceived barriers to internship participation, and cultivate students’ role identity as future cosmetics-related professionals through career exploration, pre-internship preparation, industry demonstrations, and professional role development. These efforts may further enhance students’ behavioral intention to participate in off-campus internships.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 檢索增強生成式AI聊天機器人對技術型高中學生化工裝置課程學習成效、自我導向學習與科技接受度之研究
title_en: A Study on the Effects of Retrieval-Augmented Generative AI Chatbots on Vocational High School Students’ Learning Effectiveness, Self-Directed Learning, and Technology Acceptance in a Chemical Engineering Equipment Course
keywords: 檢索增強生成、AI輔助教學、化工裝置、自我導向學習、科技接受度
abstract_zh: 技術型高中《化工裝置》課程為化工群科之核心科目，旨在培養學生對單元操作與流程系統的整合性理解。然而，該領域涉及複雜的符號編碼、多重單位轉換與抽象原理，往往造成學生極高的學習負擔。隨著生成式 AI 展現出作為個別化鷹架的巨大潛力，如何在降低錯誤回覆與資料風險的前提下，將生成式 AI 導入強調工安與嚴謹性的工程教育現場，成為當前重要課題。有鑑於此，本研究發展一套檢索增強生成式AI聊天機器人輔助教學模式，用以比較「檢索增強生成式AI聊天機器人輔助之討論式教學」與「未導入AI 工具之傳統討論式教學」對學生學習成效及自我導向學習能力之影響。本研究採準實驗研究法之「不等組前後測設計」，以桃園市某技術型高中化工科三年級兩班學生（共 62 人）為研究對象，進行為期四週、每週 3 節、每節 50 分鐘，每週共 150 分鐘之教學實驗。實驗組（31 人）實施 AI 聊天機器人輔助教學，強調行動微學習與即時對話引導；對照組（31 人）則採傳統討論式教學。研究工具包含化工裝置學習成就測驗、自我導向學習量表，並針對實驗組實施科技接受度問卷（改編自 Unified Theory of Acceptance and Use of Technology 2, UTAUT2 模型）。所得數據採共變數分析（ANCOVA），在控制前測能力基準後，檢驗不同教學模式對各項依變項的淨影響效果。研究結果顯示：一、在控制前測干擾後，實驗組在《化工裝置》之學科學習成效優於對照組，且達大效果量標準，顯示 AI 聊天機器人輔助教學與較佳學習表現有關。二、在自我導向學習能力方面，實驗組在多數自我導向學習構面上，實驗組後測表現較佳；其中「計畫與執行」因前測與組別交互作用達顯著，另依 Johnson-Neyman 法檢視其條件式差異。三、科技接受度現況分析顯示，實驗組學生在各構面之平均得分偏高，對系統呈現正向接受傾向。本研究提供生成式 AI 輔助教學應用於技術型高中化工裝置課程之初步實證參考，並為未來導入 AI 輔助教學實務提供具體之設計與應用參考。
abstract_en: The Chemical Engineering Equipment course is a core subject in vocational senior high school chemical engineering programs. Due to its complex engineering concepts, symbolic representations, and unit conversions, students often encounter substantial learning difficulties. To provide accurate and reliable learning support, this study developed a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)-based AI chatbot and investigated its effectiveness in vocational chemical engineering education.A quasi-experimental nonequivalent pretest-posttest design was employed. The participants were 62 twelfth-grade students from two chemical engineering classes at a vocational senior high school in Taoyuan, Taiwan. The experimental group (n = 31) received AI chatbot-assisted instruction, whereas the control group (n = 31) received traditional discussion-based instruction. The intervention lasted four weeks. Research instruments included a Chemical Engineering Equipment Achievement Test, the Self-Directed Learning Instrument (SDLI), and a Technology Acceptance questionnaire based on the Unified Theory of Acceptance and Use of Technology 2 (UTAUT2). Data were analyzed using analysis of covariance (ANCOVA).The results showed that the experimental group achieved significantly better learning outcomes than the control group after controlling for pretest performance, with a large effect size. The experimental group also demonstrated higher self-directed learning performance in most dimensions. A significant interaction effect was found in the Planning and Implementation dimension, and the Johnson–Neyman technique was applied for further analysis. In addition, students reported high levels of technology acceptance toward the AI chatbot.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 擴增實境應用於技術型高中智能障礙學生清潔技能學習成效之研究
title_en: Effects of Applying Augmented Reality on Cleaning Skill Learning for Vocational High School Students with Intellectual Disabilities
keywords: 擴增實境、智能障礙學生、技術型高中、清潔技能、職業技能學習
abstract_zh: 隨著特殊教育與數位科技的發展，擴增實境（Augmented Reality, AR）逐漸應用於教學現場，以支援具有多元學習需求之學生。然而，現有研究多聚焦於普通教育或學前、國小教育階段，針對技術型高中集中式特教班智能障礙學生職業技能學習之實證研究仍相對有限。鑑於清潔技能為智能障礙學生未來職場適應與支持性就業之重要基礎，本研究旨在探討擴增實境應用於技術型高中智能障礙學生清潔技能學習之成效，並比較其與傳統示範教學法對學生學習表現之差異。本研究採準實驗研究法，以不等組前後測設計進行研究。研究對象為技術型高中服務群科集中式特教班學生共二十七名，依自然班級分為實驗組十四名與對照組十三名。實驗組接受融入擴增實境之清潔技能教學，對照組則接受傳統示範教學法。研究工具包含清潔技能正確率評量表、清潔技能完成率評量表及清潔技能記憶與理解測驗，並以描述性統計、Wilcoxon 符號等級檢定、Mann–Whitney U 檢定及效應量進行分析。研究結果顯示，實驗組學生在清潔技能正確率、完成率及記憶與理解測驗之前後測表現皆達顯著差異，且效果量均達大型效果。對照組學生在清潔技能正確率與完成率之前後測表現亦達顯著差異，但記憶與理解測驗未達顯著差異。組間比較結果顯示，實驗組在三項學習成效指標之進步幅度皆高於對照組，惟組間差異皆未達統計顯著。綜合而言，擴增實境教學對技術型高中智能障礙學生清潔技能學習具有正向影響，並可作為職業技能教學之輔助策略。惟本研究尚無法直接推論擴增實境教學顯著優於傳統示範教學。未來研究可擴大樣本、延長介入時間，並納入延宕測驗、類化測驗及社會效度資料，以進一步驗證其長期效益與實務價值。
abstract_en: This study investigated the effects of applying augmented reality (AR) to cleaning skill learning for vocational senior high school students with intellectual disabilities, and compared AR-based instruction with traditional demonstration instruction. A quasi-experimental research method with a nonequivalent pretest-posttest design was employed. Participants included 27 students from self-contained special education classes in a service cluster, including an experimental group (n = 14) receiving AR-based instruction through the MAKAR platform and a control group (n = 13) receiving traditional demonstration instruction.Learning outcomes were evaluated using three indicators: cleaning skill accuracy, completion rate, and memory and comprehension. Data were analyzed using descriptive statistics, Wilcoxon signed-rank tests, Mann–Whitney U tests, and effect sizes. The results showed that the experimental group achieved significant pretest-to-posttest improvements across all three indicators with large effect sizes. The control group showed significant improvements in accuracy and completion rate, but not in memory and comprehension. Although the experimental group showed greater descriptive progress across all three indicators, the between-group differences did not reach statistical significance.In conclusion, AR-based instruction showed positive effects and application potential for supporting cleaning skill learning. However, this study can’t directly conclude that AR-based instruction was significantly superior to traditional demonstration instruction. Future research could expand the sample size, extend the intervention period, and include delayed retention tests, generalization tests, and social validity data.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 高中集中式特教班教師數位熟練度與 AIPACK 之關係
title_en: The Relationship between Digital Proficiency and AIPACK among Special Education Teachers in Self-Contained Special Education Classes at Senior High Schools
keywords: 高中集中式特教班、人工智慧學科教學知識 (AIPACK)、數位熟練度、AI 教育倫理、調查研究法
abstract_zh: 隨著人工智慧技術快速發展及教育數位轉型的推動，教師運用 AI 進行教材調整、課程設計與適性教學，已成為教育現場的重要課題。本研究旨在了解高中集中式特教班教師數位熟練度與人工智慧學科教學知識（AIPACK）之現況，分析不同背景變項之差異，並探討兩者之相關及預測情形。本研究採問卷調查法，以全臺高中集中式特教班教師為研究對象，透過分層抽樣取得120份有效問卷。研究工具包括數位熟練度量表與 AIPACK 量表，所得資料以描述性統計、獨立樣本 t 檢定、單因子變異數分析、Pearson 積差相關及迴歸分析進行處理。研究結果顯示：一、教師整體數位熟練度屬中上程度，其中以「與科技共同成長」得分最高；AIPACK 各構面亦達中等以上程度，以「倫理」得分最高，「AIPACK」得分相對較低。二、女性教師在「與科技共同成長」、「圖像式依賴溝通」及「倫理」構面之得分顯著高於男性教師；教學年資10年（含）以下教師在「與科技共同成長」、「圖像式依賴溝通」、「即時回饋偏好」、整體數位熟練度、「AIK」及「倫理」構面之得分顯著高於教學年資超過10年者；不同任教地區教師則均未達顯著差異。三、整體數位熟練度與 AIPACK 五個構面均呈顯著正相關，其中與「AIPK」之相關最高。四、整體數位熟練度對 AIPACK 五個構面均具有顯著正向預測力，其中對「AIPK」之解釋力最高；「多工處理的自在感」與「圖像式依賴溝通」可預測 AIK 與 AIPK，「即時回饋偏好」可預測 AICK、AIPACK 與倫理，而「圖像式依賴溝通」亦可預測 AIPACK。研究結果可作為未來規劃特殊教育教師數位科技及 AI 教學專業發展課程之參考。
abstract_en: With the rapid development of artificial intelligence (AI) and the advancement of digital transformation in education, teachers’ use of AI for instructional material adaptation, curriculum design, and adaptive teaching has become an important issue in educational practice. This study aimed to examine the current levels of digital proficiency and Artificial Intelligence Pedagogical Content Knowledge (AIPACK) among teachers in senior high school self-contained special education classes, analyze differences across background variables, and investigate the correlations and predictive relationships between digital proficiency and AIPACK.A questionnaire survey was conducted with teachers in senior high school self-contained special education classes across Taiwan. Through stratified sampling, 120 valid questionnaires were collected. The research instruments included a digital proficiency scale and an AIPACK scale. Data were analyzed using descriptive statistics, independent-samples t-tests, one-way analysis of variance, Pearson product-moment correlation, and regression analysis.The findings were as follows. First, teachers demonstrated an above-moderate level of overall digital proficiency, with “growing up with technology” receiving the highest score. All AIPACK dimensions also reached above-moderate levels, with “Ethics” receiving the highest score and “AIPACK” receiving a relatively lower score. Second, female teachers scored significantly higher than male teachers in “growing up with technology,” “reliance on graphics for communication,” and “Ethics.” Teachers with 10 or fewer years of teaching experience scored significantly higher than those with more than 10 years of experience in “growing up with technology,” “reliance on graphics for communication,” “preference for immediate feedback,” overall digital proficiency, “AIK,” and “Ethics.” No significant differences were found across teaching regions. Third, overall digital proficiency was significantly and positively correlated with all five AIPACK dimensions, with the strongest correlation found for “AIPK.” Fourth, overall digital proficiency significantly and positively predicted all five AIPACK dimensions, with the greatest explanatory power for “AIPK.” “Comfort with multitasking” and “reliance on graphics for communication” predicted both AIK and AIPK. “Preference for immediate feedback” predicted AICK, AIPACK, and Ethics, while “reliance on graphics for communication” also predicted AIPACK. These findings may serve as a reference for planning professional development programs related to digital technology and AI-assisted instruction for special education teachers.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 大學科學研究與產業技術創新？ 1980-2019 年臺灣生物醫學領域的 縱貫性研究
title_en: The Impact of University Scientific Research on Industrial Technological Innovation: A Longitudinal Analysis of Taiwan's Biomedical Sector (1980-2019)
keywords: 深度學習、自然語言處理、空間知識外溢、空間杜賓模型、地理資訊系統
abstract_zh: 本研究探討臺灣 1980 至 2019 年間生物醫學學術研究與產業創新之空間關聯，並分析學術研究對產業創新之本地影響與知識外溢效果。研究運用自然語言處理與深度學習建構學術資料，結合專利資料建立長期區域資料庫；並透過空間探索性資料分析（ESDA）檢驗空間集群與地理關聯，進一步採用空間杜賓模型（SDM），在控制區域與時間固定效果下，估計全期（1980–2019）及分期（1980–2000、2001–2019）模型，以檢視空間影響機制之時間差異。研究結果顯示，學術研究與產業創新皆呈現結構性空間集群，但形成時序不同。專利活動自早期即具有穩定之空間依賴結構，且於後期增強；學術研究則於 2000 年後逐漸形成空間集聚。SDM 結果顯示，學術研究對本地產業創新具有穩定正向影響，且其外溢效果具時間差異。1980–2000 年期間，學術研究之影響主要透過本地產業創新再經空間連動間接擴散；2001–2019 年期間，則轉為直接且顯著之跨區域外溢，顯示知識外溢由間接擴散轉為直接傳播機制。整體而言，本研究揭示學術研究與產業創新之空間互動具有時間異質性，並為區域創新政策提供實證依據。
abstract_en: This study examines the spatial relationship between academic research and industrial innovation in Taiwan’s biomedical sector from 1980 to 2019, with a particular focus on local effects and knowledge spillovers. The study first constructs a longitudinal dataset by integrating bibliometric data derived from natural language processing and deep learning techniques with patent data at the regional level. It then employs Exploratory Spatial Data Analysis (ESDA) to identify spatial clustering patterns and geographic co-location between academic research and industrial innovation. Furthermore, a Spatial Durbin Model (SDM) is applied with both full-period (1980–2019) and sub-period analyses (1980–2000 and 2001–2019), controlling for regional and time fixed effects to examine temporal variations in spatial interaction mechanisms.The results show that both academic research and industrial innovation exhibit significant spatial clustering, but with distinct temporal dynamics. Patent activities demonstrate stable spatial dependence from an early stage, which intensifies over time, whereas the spatial concentration of academic research emerges more prominently after 2000. The SDM results indicate that academic research consistently exerts a positive local impact on industrial innovation, while its spillover effects vary over time. During 1980–2000, spillovers occur mainly through indirect transmission via spatial dependence in industrial innovation. In contrast, during 2001–2019, spillover effects become direct and significant, suggesting a transition from indirect diffusion to more explicit cross-regional knowledge transmission.Overall, this study highlights the temporal heterogeneity and structural transformation of spatial interactions between academic research and industrial innovation, providing empirical implications for regional innovation policy.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 雙語政策下臺灣現職教師參與國際專業訓練對其教學實踐之影響
title_en: The Impact of International Professional Training on the Teaching Practice of In-Service Teachers in Taiwan Under the Bilingual Policy
keywords: 雙語政策、雙語師資培訓、教學自我效能感、TKT國際認證、混合研究法
abstract_zh: 本研究探討雙語政策下現職教師的培訓成效與實務挑戰，旨在評估國際培訓對提升教師專業知能的效益，辨識政策配套與教學實踐的落差，作為精進師培與資源配置之參考。本研究採用混合研究法，研究對象包含參與國際培訓與公辦研習之現職教師，透過前後測量化數據、問卷調查及深度訪談，全面評估在提升專業知能、教學信心及政策支持之成效，剖析培訓成果轉化為教學實踐之歷程。本研究發現，國際培訓顯著提升教師專業識能，對學科及非都會區教師具補償性正義效益，尤以課室管理模組之成效顯著，有效化解焦慮並建立安全感。然而，雙軌培訓雖皆提升教學信心，但國際組之行政孤立感，揭露高動能教師與僵化配套的結構矛盾。最後，本研究提出結論，資源配置由採購導向轉為賦能，消弭政策抗拒，並確立多元複合型雙軌架構，為破除語言焦慮及落實政策之最佳解方。據此，本研究提出三項建議：主管機關端應持續政策推動雙語專業人力資本專款，建立偏鄉雙語教師激勵機制，實施差異化資源配置，以滾動式經費規劃永續經營；學校及師培端應接軌國際培訓，發展融合式本土課程以深化教學實踐；現職教師端則可同步語言及教學的增能，著重課堂語言溝通功能，籌組雙語專業學習社群，以共備建構專業認同。
abstract_en: This study investigates the training effectiveness and practical challenges faced by in-service teachers under the bilingual education policy, aiming to evaluate the benefits of international training programs on enhancing teachers' professional literacy and to identify the disconnect between policy support and classroom practice, thereby serving as a reference for refining teacher education and resource allocation. Utilizing a mixed-methods research design, this study examines in-service teachers participating in international training and public workshops. Through quantitative pre- and post-test data, surveys, and in-depth interviews, it comprehensively evaluates effectiveness across professional literacy, teaching confidence, and policy support, while analyzing the trajectory of translating training outcomes into pedagogical practice. The findings reveal that international training significantly enhances teachers' professional literacy and yields substantial compensatory justice benefits for non-English subject teachers and those in non-metropolitan areas; particularly, the classroom management module demonstrates pronounced efficacy, effectively mitigating anxiety and establishing psychological safety. However, while both training tracks bolster teaching confidence, the pronounced administrative isolation experienced by the international group exposes a structural contradiction between high-agency teachers and rigid institutional support. Consequently, this study concludes that shifting resource allocation from procurement-driven to empowerment-oriented approaches can eliminate policy resistance. Furthermore, establishing a multifaceted dual-track framework serves as the definitive solution to dismantle language anxiety and ensure policy implementation. Based on these insights, three recommendations are proposed: For educational authorities, institutional financial support through professional human capital funds should be sustained, alongside implementing differential resource allocation and localized incentive mechanisms to ensure sustainable development via rolling budget planning. For schools and teacher education institutions, international training should be integrated to develop blended localized curricula, thereby deepening pedagogical practice. For in-service teachers, simultaneous language and pedagogical empowerment should be pursued, focusing on the communicative functions of classroom language while organizing bilingual professional learning communities to construct professional identity through collaborative lesson preparation.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 新北市技術型高中服務群科學生網路交友風險感知與避險行為之研究
title_en: A Study of Online Dating Risk Perception and Avoidance Behaviors among Service Cluster Students in Vocational High Schools in New Taipei City
keywords: 服務群科學生、網路交友、風險感知、避險行為
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在探討新北市技術型高中服務群科學生之網路交友風險感知與避險行為程度以及之間的一致性，並分析不同背景變項之新北市技術型高中服務群科學生在網路交友風險感知與避險行為程度及之間一致性的差異情形。本研究採用問卷調查法，研究工具為「新北市技術型高中服務群科學生之網路交友風險感知與避險行為」問卷，以2025學年度新北市技術型高中服務群科學生為研究對象，採普查方式，共發出問卷419份，回收有效問卷222份，有效回收率達53%。統計方法採描述性統計、獨立樣本t檢定、單因子變異數分析（one-way ANOVA）、相依樣本t檢定進行資料分析。本研究之結論如下：。一、新北市技術型高中服務群科學生網路交友風險感知程度整體及各構面皆為中上程度。二、新北市技術型高中服務群科學生網路交友風險感知程度會因網路交友安全學習經驗及網路交友經驗而不同。三、新北市技術型高中服務群科學生網路交友避險行為程度整體及各構面皆為中上程度。四、新北市技術型高中服務群科學生網路交友避險行為程度因年級、上網時間長度及網路交友安全學習經驗而有差異。五、新北市技術型高中服務群科學生網路交友風險感知與避險行為程度整體呈一致性，但在個資與隱私外洩、心理與社交風險、性暴力構面皆呈知行不一致。六、不同網路交友安全學習經驗及網路交友經驗者，其網路交友風險感知與避險行為程度不一致，其餘背景變項則無顯著差異。
abstract_en: This study aimed to investigate the levels of online dating risk perception and avoidance behaviors among service department students at vocational high schools in New Taipei City, as well as the consistency between the two. It further analyzed differences in risk perception, avoidance behaviors, and their consistency based on various background variables. This study employed a questionnaire survey method, using the "Online Dating Risk Perception and Avoidance Behaviors among Vocational High School Service Department Students in New Taipei City" as the research instrument. The target population consisted of service department students at vocational high schools in New Taipei City during the 2025 academic year. A census approach was adopted, with 419 questionnaires distributed and 222 valid questionnaires collected, yielding an effective response rate of 53%. Statistical methods included descriptive statistics, independent samples t-tests, one-way ANOVA, and paired samples t-tests. The conclusions of this study are as follows:1.  The overall level and all dimensions of online dating risk perception among vocational high school service department students in New Taipei City were above average.2.  The level of online dating risk perception among these students varied depending on whether they had received safety education regarding online dating and whether they had online dating experience.3.  The overall level and all dimensions of online dating avoidance behaviors among these students were above average.4.  The level of online dating avoidance behaviors among these students differed based on grade level, daily internet usage time, and experience with online dating safety education.5.  Overall, the online dating risk perception and avoidance behaviors of vocational high school service department students in New Taipei City were consistent；however, inconsistency between perception and behavior was found in the dimensions of personal information and privacy leakage, psychological and social risks, and sexual violence.6.  Students with different experiences in online dating safety education and online dating experience showed inconsistency between their levels of online dating risk perception and avoidance behaviors, while no significant differences were found for the remaining background variables.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 公部門人員組織正義對離職傾向之影響 —以工作動機為中介變項
title_en: The Impact of Organizational Justice on Turnover Intention among Public Sector Employees:Testing Work Motivation as Mediators
keywords: 組織正義、工作動機、脈絡化期望價值理論、離職傾向
abstract_zh: 隨著公部門業務日益繁重及工作壓力增加，組織正義已成為影響公部門人員工作動機與離職傾向的重要因素。相較於私部門多以辭職作為職涯轉換方式，公部門人員亦可能透過組織內部調職或跨機關轉任進行職務調整。因此，本研究以 Werner 與 DeSimone (2011) 之員工行為模型及脈絡化期望價值理論 (situated expectancy-value theory, SEVT) 為基礎，建構「組織正義－工作動機－離職傾向」研究架構，並將離職傾向區分為組織內部調職、跨組織轉任及離開公職三類，探討工作動機之中介效果。研究採問卷調查法，共蒐集371份公部門現職人員有效樣本，運用 Spearman 相關分析、多元迴歸分析及 PROCESS 搭配拔靴法 (bootstrapping) 進行驗證，並將薪資納入控制變項。研究結果指出，分配正義可提升工作價值並降低工作成本；人際正義與資訊正義可降低工作成本；程序正義未達顯著水準。在離職傾向方面，工作成本對組織內部調職、跨組織轉任及離開公職皆具有顯著影響；工作價值僅對離開公職具有顯著負向影響；工作期望則未達顯著效果。中介分析結果為工作期望未具中介效果，工作價值僅具部分中介效果，工作成本則為組織正義影響離職傾向較重要且較穩定之中介因素。綜上，工作成本為解釋公部門人員離職傾向之關鍵因素。
abstract_en: With the increasing workload and pressure in the public sector, organizational justice has become a crucial factor influencing public employees' work motivation and turnover intentions. Unlike the private sector, where resignation is the primary means of career transition, public sector personnel can also adjust their positions through internal transfers or inter-agency transfers. Based on Werner and DeSimone’s (2011) employee behavior model and the situated expectancy-value theory (SEVT), this study constructs an "organizational justice–work motivation–turnover intention" research framework. To explore the mediating effects of work motivation, turnover intentions are categorized into three types: internal transfer, inter-organizational transfer, and leaving the public sector.Data were collected through a questionnaire survey, yielding 371 valid samples of current public sector employees. Spearman correlation, multiple regression, and the PROCESS macro with bootstrapping were utilized for empirical verification, with salary included as a control variable. The results indicate that distributive justice enhances task value and reduces perceived cost, while interpersonal and informational justice significantly reduce perceived cost; however, procedural justice did not reach statistical significance. Regarding turnover intentions, perceived cost indicates a significant impact on internal transfer, inter-organizational transfer, and leaving the public sector. In contrast, task value only has a significant negative effect on leaving the public sector, whereas expectancy shows no significant effect. Mediation analysis reveals that expectancy plays no mediating role, and task value exerts only a partial mediating effect. Notably, perceived cost is the most critical and stable mediating mechanism through which organizational justice influences turnover intentions. Overall, perceived cost represents the key factor in explaining the turnover intentions of public sector personnel.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 數位情緒日記融入社會技巧課程對國中學習障礙學生自我覺察影響之行動研究
title_en: An Action Research on the Effects of Integrating Social Skills Instruction with a Digital Emotion Diary on the Self-Awareness of Junior High School Students with Learning Disabilities
keywords: 數位情緒日記、學習障礙、社會情緒學習、自我覺察、行動研究
abstract_zh: 本研究發展並實施數位情緒日記融入社會技巧課程，探討其對國中學習障礙學生自我覺察能力之影響，並分析研究者的教學省思與自我成長。研究者發現，學習障礙學生除學業困難外，常伴隨情緒詞彙不足、情緒覺察與表達能力較弱等問題，影響其學校適應與人際互動。因此，本研究運用數位情緒日記為媒介，結合社會技巧課程，以提升學生的自我覺察能力。本研究採行動研究法，以北部某國中資源班三名七年級學習障礙學生為對象，進行八週教學介入。課程以「MangaChat」漫話日記平台為工具，參考RULER、MindUP及PATHS等社會情緒學習課程理念，並結合適合學障生的教學策略，引導其進行情緒辨識、標記、表達與反思。研究採質量並用，量化資料以「情緒覺察量表」進行前後測分析；質性資料則包含教學觀察記錄、省思札記、訪談、數位日記內容及學習單，並透過三角檢驗法進行分析。研究結果如下：一、  數位情緒日記融入社會技巧課程之實施，應考量學障生的特性，透過彈性調整進度、提供具體生活情境範例、反覆練習及個別化支持，以提升其學習參與及教學成效。二、  本課程對研究對象的自我覺察能力有正向改變。在區辨情緒與身體覺察方面，學生能更精確地辨識情緒並逐漸察覺自身生理反應，惟其發展程度受語文能力影響；在情緒表達與分析方面，個案在語文鷹架輔助下有個別化的成長，能更完整地描述情緒經驗並建立事件、情緒與行為之連結。然而，其自我覺察能力的發展仍受到家庭關係、人際互動經驗及環境支持等因素影響而有差異化的表現。三、  研究者透過持續的觀察、反思與修正，逐步發展更符合學習障礙學生需求之教學策略，並體認到善用數位工具、建立支持性師生關係及促進家校合作的重要性。最後，研究者根據研究結果提出教學實務及未來研究建議，作為未來推動學習障礙學生社會情緒學習課程與相關研究之參考。
abstract_en: This study developed and implemented a social skills curriculum integrated with a digital emotion diary, explored its effects on the self-awareness competency of junior high school students with learning disabilities, and analyzed the researcher's pedagogical reflections and self-growth. The researcher observed that students with learning disabilities, in addition to academic challenges, frequently face deficits in emotional vocabulary alongside weaker abilities in emotional awareness and expression, which consequently hinder their school adaptation and interpersonal interactions. Therefore, this study utilized a digital emotion diary as a vehicle, combining it with a social skills curriculum to enhance students' self-awareness competency.Adopting an action research approach, this study focused on three seventh-grade students with learning disabilities from a resource room at a junior high school in northern Taiwan, conducting an eight-week instructional intervention. The curriculum utilized the "MangaChat" digital diary platform as a primary tool, drawing upon core concepts from social-emotional learning programs such as RULER, MindUP, and PATHS. It incorporated instructional strategies tailored to the characteristics of students with learning disabilities, guiding them through emotional identification, labeling, expression, and reflection. A mixed-methods approach was employed for data collection and analysis. Quantitative data were analyzed using pre- and post-tests of the "Emotional Awareness Scale." Qualitative data—including instructional observation records, teacher's reflective journals, interview transcripts, digital emotion diary entries, and classroom worksheets—were systematically analyzed through triangulation. The research findings are as follows:1.Curriculum Implementation and Adaptation: The implementation of integrating a digital emotion diary into a social skills curriculum must consider the characteristics of students with learning disabilities. It is essential to flexibly adjust instructional paces, provide concrete real-life examples, arrange repetitive practice, and offer individualized support to optimize student engagement and teaching efficacy.2.Positive Changes in Self-Awareness Competency: This curriculum led to positive changes in the participants' self-awareness competency. Regarding emotional differentiation and bodily awareness, students demonstrated more precise identification of emotions and a developing capacity to perceive their own physiological responses, though the extent of this development was influenced by their language abilities. In terms of emotional expression and analysis, the participants exhibited individualized growth with the assistance of linguistic scaffolds, enabling them to more comprehensively describe their emotional experiences and construct clear connections among situations, emotions, and behaviors. However, the development of their self-awareness competency remained influenced by external factors such as family relationships, interpersonal experiences, and environmental support, resulting in differentiated behavioral outcomes.3.Teacher Reflection and Professional Growth: Through continuous observation, reflection, and modification, the researcher progressively developed instructional strategies that better aligned with the needs of students with learning disabilities, while also recognizing the critical importance of leveraging digital tools, establishing supportive teacher-student relationships, and facilitating home-school cooperation.Finally, based on the research results, practical pedagogical recommendations and suggestions for future studies are proposed to serve as a reference for advancing social-emotional learning curricula and related research for students with learning disabilities.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 家長教養行為、家長情緒教化與孩童情緒覺察關係之探究
title_en: The Relationships Among Parenting Behavior, Parental Emotion Socialization, and Children's Emotional Awareness
keywords: 教養行為、家長情緒教化、孩童情緒覺察
abstract_zh: 隨著108課綱實施，社會情緒學習（Social Emotional Learning, SEL）已成為教育現場重要議題。情緒覺察能力不僅是SEL「自我覺察」的基礎，亦為情緒理解與調節的前提，其發展深受家長教養行為與情緒互動模式影響。根據認知發展理論，國小階段正值孩童去中心化思維成熟之際，能理解情緒因果關係與複雜狀態，為情緒覺察發展的關鍵期。然而，在升學壓力與數位科技交織的背景下，情緒發展的重要性相對被忽視，家長教養行為與情緒互動遂成為支持孩童心理健康的核心因素。現有研究雖著重探討家庭因素對孩童整體情緒能力的影響，然而對「情緒覺察」此特定構面的探討仍付之闕如，亦缺乏針對不同家庭因素影響力之系統性比較與驗證。本研究採問卷調查法，以臺中地區國小四至六年級孩童及其家長為例，運用最小平方法結構方程模型，探討家長教養行為、家長情緒教化與孩童情緒覺察之關聯性，並檢驗背景變項之影響。研究結果顯示，孩童年齡在「區辨情緒」構面具顯著差異，年長孩童表現較佳；30歲以下之較年輕家長傾向展現較高之忽視冷漠型教養行為；家長教育程度及家庭結構對各變項之影響均未達顯著。而家長情緒教化對孩童情緒覺察能力之預測效果整體優於教養行為類型；忽視冷漠型對「區辨情緒」、寬鬆溺愛型對「沒有隱藏情緒」均具顯著負向影響；回饋策略對「關注他人情緒」與「分析情緒」具正向影響；放大策略對「身體覺察」具正向影響，但對「沒有隱藏情緒」具負向影響；推翻策略對「關注他人情緒」具負向影響。根據解釋變異量百分比，家長於孩童表達生氣情緒當下所採取之具體情緒教化策略，比整體教養行為類型對孩童情緒覺察具有更直接且顯著的預測作用，突顯微觀親子情緒互動品質在孩童情緒教育中的核心地位。
abstract_en: With the implementation of the 108 Curriculum Guidelines, Social Emotional Learning (SEL) has become a crucial issue in the educational field. Emotion awareness is not only the foundation of "self-awareness" in SEL, but also the prerequisite for emotion understanding and regulation. Its development is profoundly influenced by parenting behaviors and emotional interaction patterns. According to cognitive development theory, the elementary school stage is a critical period for the development of emotion awareness; as children's decentration matures, they become capable of understanding emotional causality and complex emotional states.However, amidst the intertwining contexts of academic pressure and digital technology, the importance of emotional development has been relatively neglected. Consequently, parenting behaviors and emotional interactions have become core factors in supporting children's mental health. Although existing research has primarily focused on the impact of family factors on children's overall emotional competence, exploration of the specific construct of "emotion awareness" remains scarce, as does a systematic comparison and empirical validation of the influential power of different family factors.Using a questionnaire survey method, this study sampled 4th to 6th-grade elementary school children and their parents in the Taichung area. Partial Least Squares Structural Equation Modeling (PLS-SEM) was employed to explore the relationships among parenting behaviors, parental emotion socialization, and children's emotion awareness, as well as to examine the effects of background variables. The results indicated significant age differences within the "differentiating emotions" construct, with older children performing better. Younger parents (under the age of 30) tended to exhibit higher levels of neglectful parenting behavior. Parents' educational level and family structure showed no significant effects on any of the variables. Furthermore, the overall predictive effect of parental emotion socialization on children's emotion awareness was superior to that of general parenting styles. Specifically, neglectful parenting had a significant negative impact on "differentiating emotions," while permissive parenting negatively impacted "not hiding emotions." Regarding emotion socialization, feedback strategies positively influenced "attending to others' emotions" and "analyzing emotions"; magnification strategies positively affected "bodily awareness" but negatively affected "not hiding emotions"; and overriding strategies had a negative impact on "attending to others' emotions." Based on the percentage of variance explained, the specific emotion socialization strategies parents adopt in the moment their children express anger possess a more direct and significant predictive effect on children's emotion awareness than overall parenting styles. This highlights the central role of micro-level parent-child emotional interaction quality in children's emotional education.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 生成式AI語音對話功能改進日語課程口說教學之行動研究
title_en: An Action Research of Generative AI Speech Dialogue Function to Improve the Teaching of Spoken Japanese in Japanese Courses
keywords: 生成式AI、日語口說能力、學習成效、日語口說焦慮
abstract_zh: 近年來生成式AI以其即時反饋及互動的對話能力，能夠模擬真實交流情境。本研究主旨在運用生成式AI，提供學生一個輕鬆的日語口說學習環境，預期能降低學生口說焦慮和提升日語口說能力學習成效。本研究採用行動研究，研究對象為臺北市某補習班的日語中級學生。研究工具採用Open AI的ChatGPT。研究期間為八週，期間內進行多次實踐活動，以評估學生的日語口說焦慮、日語口說學習成效和對使用ChatGPT學習日語的評價。本研究之研究結果分述如後：一、ChatGPT值得提供給學生練習日語口說，但其用詞及功能方面不足之處仍需教師共同進行把關。二、學生運用ChatGPT進行日語口說學習可降低日語口說焦慮。三、學生運用ChatGPT進行日語口說學習可提升日語口說能力之學習成效。四、學生對運用ChatGPT進行日語口說學習持正向態度，但仍有學生希望能進行更多貼近現實生活的對話練習。
abstract_en: This study utilizes ChatGPT developed by OpenAI to provide students with a relaxed environment for learning Japanese speaking. ChatGPT, with its instant feedback and interactive conversational abilities, can simulate real-life communication scenarios.　　The study was conducted using an action research method with Japanese intermediate students in a tutorial class in Taipei City. During the eight-week study period, a number of hands-on activities were conducted to evaluate the students' Japanese speaking anxiety, Japanese speaking learning effectiveness, and their evaluation of using ChatGPT to learn Japanese. The results of this study are summarized as follows:1.ChatGPT is valuable for practicing Japanese speaking with students, but its vocabulary and functionality still require supervision by teachers.2.Using ChatGPT for Japanese speaking practice can reduce students' oral anxiety of Japanese.3.Students who use generative AI for Japanese speaking practice can improve their oral proficiency of Japanese.4.Most students hold a positive attitude towards using generative AI for learning Japanese speaking, although some express a desire for more real-life conversational practice.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 人才培育與產業需求的空間重疊與落差──臺灣高等技職理工教育與製造業之研究
title_en: Talent Cultivation and Industrial Demand in Spatial Perspective: Higher Technological and Vocational Education and Manufacturing in Taiwan
keywords: 技職教育、產學連結、空間錯配、學期總實習時數、產業地理
abstract_zh: 臺灣技職教育體系之空間佈局多形成於早期區域發展階段，然而隨著產業結構由傳統製造業逐步轉向高科技與園區化發展，產業地理區位已發生顯著變遷。當教育機構具備相對固定的空間特性，而產業活動呈現高度流動性時，兩者在空間上的重疊或落差，將可能影響以「做中學」為核心的技職實習制度運作成效。本研究旨在探討人才培育與產業需求在空間上的重疊與落差，具體提出三項研究目的：（一）描繪臺灣高等技職理工類科與製造業聚落之空間分布現況；（二）檢驗產業地理鄰近性對技職學生「學期總實習時數」之影響；（三）比較不同技術屬性類科在空間依賴程度上的異質性。研究範圍聚焦於與臺灣核心製造業關聯最深之四大理工類科（機械、電機、電子、資訊工程），整合教育部校系層級之實習統計資料與經濟部工廠登記資料，計算各校系半徑 15 公里內之真實工廠數量，並採用雙對數迴歸模型（log-log regression）進行實證分析 。研究結果顯示，樣本在不同技術類科之間呈現出差異化的空間反應特徵 。其中，機電相關類科（機械、電機）呈現較明顯的「空間嵌入」特性，其學期總實習時數與周邊產業聚落規模之關聯達統計顯著；相對地，資訊電子相關類科（電子、資訊工程）之估計結果未達顯著，顯示其實習安排具備較高的空間彈性，兩者呈現截然不同的「雙軌空間邏輯（dual spatial logic）」。整體而言，本研究指出地理區位在部分技術領域的實習制度運作中具有較高的重要性，並建議未來技職教育政策與科系規劃可依不同類科之空間依賴程度，採取差異化的空間配置與配套補償策略。
abstract_en: The spatial configuration of Taiwan’s vocational education system was shaped in earlier stages of regional development, while industrial activities have increasingly concentrated in high-tech and science-park-based clusters. This structural divergence may create spatial overlap or mismatch, potentially influencing the operation of "learning-by-doing" internship systems in vocational education. This study aims to explore the spatial overlap and mismatch between talent cultivation and industrial demand by addressing three main research objectives: (1) mapping the spatial distribution of Taiwan’s higher vocational STEM disciplines and manufacturing clusters; (2) examining the impact of industrial geographic proximity on students' total semester internship hours; and (3) comparing the heterogeneity of spatial dependence across different technological disciplines. Focusing on the four core STEM disciplines most closely associated with Taiwan's manufacturing sector (Mechanical, Electrical, Electronic, and Computer Science), this study integrates department-level internship statistics from the Ministry of Education and factory registry data from the Ministry of Economic Affairs. A log-log regression model is employed to estimate the elasticity of total semester internship hours with respect to the actual factory density within a 15-kilometer radius of each department.  The results indicate discipline-specific differences in spatial responses. For Mechanical and Electrical related disciplines, total semester internship hours are positively and significantly associated with surrounding factory density, suggesting stronger "spatial embeddedness". In contrast, for Information and Electronic related disciplines, the relationship is not statistically significant, implying greater spatial flexibility in internship arrangements. These contrasting patterns highlight a "dual spatial logic" in vocational education. Overall, the findings demonstrate that geographic proximity plays a crucial and differentiated role in the operation of internship systems across specific technological fields. The study suggests that future vocational education policies and department planning should adopt tailored spatial strategies and compensatory measures based on the varying spatial dependence of different disciplines

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 影片播放速度對技術型高中學生學習成就與認知負荷之影響
title_en: The Effects of Video Playback Speed on Learning Achievement and Cognitive Load among Vocational High School Students
keywords: 影片播放速度、學習成就、認知負荷
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在探討影片播放速度對技術型高中學生學習成就與認知負荷的影響與相關性。隨著數位教材在教育情境中日益普及，學生透過調整影片播放速度以優化學習效率的行為越趨常見。為契合技職教育體系強調實作與素養導向學習的現況與需求，本研究選定北部某技術型高中在學學生作為研究對象，並以AI主題講座影片作為實驗教材，藉由控制不同的影片播放速度，深入分析其對學生的學習成效所帶來的影響。本研究採實驗設計，將學生觀看的不同影片播放速度設為自變項。依變項則包含學習成就與認知負荷，分別透過「影片學習成就測驗」評估學生對影片內容的理解與記憶成效，以及「認知負荷量表」進行客觀測量。實驗程序依序包含學習成就前測、學生分組依不同速度觀看影片，以及隨後立即施測的後測與認知負荷測量。資料分析方面，主要採用描述性統計、同質性檢定，並以單因子變異數分析（ANOVA）及單因子多變量變異數分析（MANOVA）比較不同影片播放速度組別間在學習成就與認知負荷上的顯著差異。研究結果顯示：1.學習成就方面：兩組學生在接受教學後均有顯著進步，但在排除先備知識影響後，1.5倍速與1.0倍速組間並無顯著差異。這顯示在1.5倍速的範圍內，縮短觀看時間並不會損及學生的知識吸收成效 。2.認知負荷方面：影片播放速度對學生的整體認知負荷具有極顯著影響（p < .001），且效果量極高。實驗組（1.5X）在內在負荷、外在負荷及增生負荷的得分均顯著高於控制組（1.0X）。3.綜合討論：研究發現1.5倍速學習呈現「高效率、高負荷、等成效」的特性。實驗組學生雖面臨較高的資訊處理壓力和呈現干擾，但透過顯著提升的增生認知負荷，成功抵銷速度加快帶來的負面影響，維持與原速相當的學習品質。
abstract_en: This study aims to investigate the impact and correlation of video playback speed on the learning achievement and cognitive load of vocational high school students. As digital materials become increasingly prevalent in educational settings, students frequently adjust playback speeds to optimize learning efficiency. To align with the current needs of the vocational education system, which emphasizes practical and competency-based learning, this study selected students from a vocational high school in northern Taiwan as participants. Using an AI-themed lecture video as experimental material, the study analyzed the effects of different controlled playback speeds on students' learning outcomes.An experimental design was adopted, with video playback speed serving as the independent variable. The dependent variables included learning achievement, assessed via a self-developed AI learning achievement test, and cognitive load, measured through a cognitive load scale. The experimental procedure consisted of a pre-test for learning achievement, group viewing of the video at assigned speeds, and immediate administration of a post-test and cognitive load measurement. Data analysis utilized descriptive statistics, homogeneity tests, and specific statistical methods, including One-way ANCOVA and One-way MANOVA, to compare significant differences between groups.The research findings indicate the following:Learning Achievement: Both groups showed significant improvement after instruction. However, after controlling for prior knowledge, no significant difference was found between the 1.5X and 1.0X groups. This suggests that within a 1.5X speed range, shortening viewing time does not impair students' knowledge acquisition.Cognitive Load: Video playback speed had a highly significant impact on the overall cognitive load of students (p < .001), with a high effect size. The experimental group (1.5X) scored significantly higher than the control group (1.0X) in intrinsic, extraneous, and germane cognitive load.Discussion: The study found that 1.5X speed learning is characterized by "high efficiency, high load, and equal performance". Although students in the experimental group faced higher information processing pressure and presentation interference, they successfully offset the negative impact of increased speed through significantly enhanced germane cognitive load, thereby maintaining learning quality comparable to that of the original speed.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 人工智慧輔助概念圖教學對國中生自然科概念理解、提示詞最佳化與AI評分一致性之實證分析
title_en: An Empirical Analysis of AI-Assisted Concept Map Teaching on Junior High School Students' Understanding of Natural Science Concepts, Prompt Optimization, and AI Scoring Consistency
keywords: 概念圖、自然科概念理解、評分一致性、提示詞最佳化
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在探討不同方式的人工智慧 (AI) 輔助概念圖教學設計，對國中八年級學生自然科概念理解的影響，並系統性分析AI與人工評分之一致性，同時建立一套可複製的提示詞最佳化方法。研究採用準實驗不等組後測設計，將七個班級的學生 (N=202) 分為四組： (1) 傳統教學AI評分組 (AI評組) (n=56) ：學生繪製概念圖後，由AI進行評分與回饋，再繪製個人概念圖； (2) 學生評鑑AI概念圖組 (評AI組) (n=58) ：學生先評鑑由AI生成的示範概念圖，由AI進行評分與回饋，再繪製個人概念圖； (3) 協作學習AI評分組 (協作AI評組) (n=57) ：學生先產出個人概念圖，再進行小組協作繪製，最終由AI計算個人貢獻值並提供回饋，再繪製個人概念圖； (4) 人工評分對照組 (n=31) ：完全由人工評分教師進行教學與評分，且由人工評分教師進行回饋，再繪製個人概念圖。研究工具包含AI平台Claude、NotebookLM以及後測之「自然科概念知識測驗」。資料分析方法採用單因子共變數分析 (One-way ANCOVA) 在排除上學期三次自然科段考平均後檢驗各組在自然科概念理解上的差異，並運用組內相關係數 (ICC) 與Cohen's Kappa係數探討AI與人工評分的一致性。本研究結果如下: (1) 最終提示詞架構歷經五個版本的迭代最佳化，從初期的基礎內容識別，逐步導入Novak評分規準與個人貢獻追蹤技術，最終演進為兼具客觀量化評分與個人化適性回饋的穩定架構； (2) 在控制上學期三次自然科段考平均分數影響後，四組教學設計對學生的概念理解成效存在顯著差異，其效果排序為：協作AI評組>人工評分對照組>評AI組>AI評組。「協作AI評組」顯著優於其他所有組別，證明結合社會建構與AI鷹架的方式最具成效； (3) AI與人工評分教師的總體評分呈現中等程度正相關，在能力等級區辨上展現良好一致性。其中，「協作AI評組」的AI評分與人工評分一致性最高。本研究結論呈現協作學習並搭配AI回饋的教學設計，對學生自然科概念的理解具有最顯著的幫助；傳統人工教學成效次之；若僅以AI評分或讓學生評鑑AI繪製的概念圖，其成效相對較差。
abstract_en: This study aims to investigate the impact of different AI-assisted concept map instructional designs on eighth grade students' understanding of science concepts, systematically analyze the consistency between AI and human teacher scoring, and establish a replicable prompt optimization method. A quasi-experimental post-test design with unequal groups was employed. Students from seven classes (N=202) were divided into four groups: (1) Traditional Instruction with AI Scoring Group (AI Scoring Group) (n=56): Students drew concept maps, received AI scoring and feedback, then drew personal concept maps; (2) Student Evaluation of AI Concept Maps Group (AI Evaluation Group) (n=58): Students first evaluated AI-generated demonstration concept maps, received AI scoring and feedback, then created personal concept maps; (3) Collaborative Learning AI Scoring Group (Collaborative AI Scoring Group) (n=57): Students first produced individual concept maps, then collaborated in groups to create a shared map. Finally, AI calculated individual contribution scores and provided feedback before students drew their personal concept maps; (4) Human Scoring Control Group (n=31): Instruction and scoring were entirely conducted by human teachers, who also provided feedback before students created individual concept maps. Research tools included AI platforms Claude and NotebookLM, along with a post-test "Science Concept Knowledge Assessment. " Data analysis employed one-way ANCOVA to examine differences in science concept understanding across groups after controlling for average science test scores. Intraclass correlation coefficients (ICC) and Cohen's Kappa were used to assess agreement between AI and human teacher scoring.The findings of this study are as follows: (1) This research indicates that the prompt architecture underwent five iterations of optimization. Starting from basic content recognition in its initial phase, it progressively incorporated Novak scoring criteria and individual contribution tracking technology, ultimately evolving into a stable framework that combines objective quantitative scoring with personalized adaptive feedback. (2) After controlling for the influence of average science test scores, significant differences emerged in conceptual understanding outcomes across the four instructional design groups. Effectiveness ranked as follows: Collaborative AI Grading Group > Human Grading Group > Grading AI Group > AI Grading Group. The "Collaborative AI Grading Group" significantly outperformed all other groups, demonstrating that the model integrating social construction and AI scaffolding is most effective; (3) Overall scores from AI and human teachers showed a moderate positive correlation, exhibiting good consistency in ability level differentiation. Among these, the "Collaborative AI Grading Group" achieved the highest consistency between AI scores and human teacher scores.This study concludes that instructional designs combining collaborative learning with AI feedback provide the most significant enhancement to students' understanding of science concepts. Traditional manual instruction yields the next best results. However, approaches relying solely on AI scoring or having students evaluate AI-generated concept maps demonstrate comparatively weaker effectiveness.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 新北市教保服務人員社會資本、工作鑲嵌與留任意願關係之研究
title_en: The Relationships among Social Capital, Job Embeddedness, and Intention to Stay of the Preschool Educators in New Taipei City
keywords: 教保服務人員、社會資本、工作鑲嵌、留任意願
abstract_zh: 鑑於學前教育人員高流動率現象對教學穩定與幼兒發展造成潛在影響，瞭解影響其留任之關鍵因素實屬重要。過往研究多聚焦於薪資、壓力等外在條件，對於社會資本與心理層面的工作鑲嵌之探討仍屬不足，且缺乏針對教保服務人員之實證研究。因此本研究以新北市公私立幼兒園之教保服務人員為研究對象，探討社會資本、工作鑲嵌與留任意願之間的關係，以及工作鑲嵌在社會資本與留任意願之間的中介效果。採用問卷調查法，總計發放400份問卷，回收有效問卷共337份，有效回收率84.3%。問卷調查結果透過SPSS 24.0版統計軟體進行描述性統計、t 檢定、單因子變異數分析、皮爾森積差相關分析及階層迴歸分析，研究結果發現新北市教保服務人員的社會資本感受正向，且有中高程度的工作鑲嵌與留任意願；資深教保服務人員的工作鑲嵌顯著高於資淺者；已婚者的工作連結程度高於未婚者；研究所學歷則高於高職與大學學歷者；資深者的留任意願高於資淺者；社會資本、工作鑲嵌均與留任意願有顯著正向關係，社會資本與工作鑲嵌亦有顯著正向關係，同時工作鑲嵌在社會資本與留任意願間有完全中介效果。本研究提出以下建議：一、教育主管機關應加強幼兒園的願景塑造，並提出教保服務人員留任誘因；二、幼兒園應營造支持型文化，並提供教保服務人員參與決策過程；三、教保服務人員應加強人際互動網絡，並強化專業成長與專業認同。
abstract_en: Given the potential impact of high turnover rates among preschool educators on teaching stability and child development, it is crucial to understand the key factors influencing their intention to stay. While previous studies have primarily focused on external factors such as salary and work-related stress, limited research has examined the roles of social capital and the psychological dimension of job embeddedness. Moreover, empirical research specifically targeting preschool educators remains scarce. Therefore, this study investigates the relationships among social capital, job embeddedness, and intention to stay among preschool educators in public and private kindergartens in New Taipei City. Additionally, the study explores the mediating role of job embeddedness between social capital and intention to stay.This research employed a questionnaire survey method. A total of 400  questionnaires were distributed, with 337 valid responses collected, yielding an effective response rate of 84.3%. Data were analyzed using SPSS version 24.0 software through descriptive statistics, independent sample t-tests, one-way ANOVA, Pearson’s correlation analysis, and hierarchical regression analysis.The results revealed that preschool educators in New Taipei City perceived their social capital positively and demonstrated moderately high levels of job embeddedness and intention to stay. Senior preschool educators showed significantly higher levels of job embeddedness than less experienced educators. In addition, married educators exhibited a higher degree of job links than unmarried educators, and those with graduate-level education reported higher levels of job links than those with vocational high school or university degrees. Senior educators also demonstrated a higher intention to stay than their less experienced counterparts. Social capital and job embeddedness were both positively correlated with intention to stay. Social capital also had a positive relationship with job embeddedness. Furthermore, job embeddedness was found to have a full mediating effect between social capital and intention to stay.This study proposes the following recommendations. First, educational authorities should strengthen vision building in kindergartens and provide retention incentives for preschool educators. Second, kindergartens should cultivate a supportive organizational culture and offer preschool educators opportunities to participate in decision-making processes. Third, preschool educators should enhance their interpersonal interaction networks and further strengthen their professional development and professional identity.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 高等教育擴張是否能消除教育機會的不平等?
title_en: Does Higher Education Expansion Eliminate Inequality in Educational Opportunities?
keywords: 高等教育擴張、社會階層化、代際流動
abstract_zh: 本研究關注臺灣高等教育自「四一○教改」以來快速擴張下，教育機會是否更公平，特別是家庭背景與地理脈絡對完成大學以上教育程度的影響是否減弱。研究以中央研究院「臺灣社會變遷基本調查」（TSCS）2005、2010 與 2020 年綜合問卷為次級資料，選取1969–1978 年（擴張前）與 1979–1988 年（擴張後）兩個入學世代，樣本數分別為 918 與 886 人。主要自變項為性別、家庭文化資本（母親專科以上、父親大學以上）、家庭社經資本（父親為管理／專業人員）、地理因素（十五歲前居住都市與北中南東區），以是否完成大學以上為因變項，採二元邏輯斯迴歸並報告勝算比及顯著性。結果顯示，兩世代性別效果皆不顯著，女性已不再是取得大學學歷的主要弱勢。母親專科以上與父親大學以上在擴張前後皆為穩定且顯著的正向預測因子（例如擴張後母親專科以上OR=4.47，p<0.001；父親大學以上 OR=3.10，p=0.001），顯示家庭文化資本的代際優勢並未因高教擴張而減弱。父親職業為管理／專業人員在擴張前具顯著正向效果（OR=1.84，p=0.009），擴張後則不再顯著，顯示職業階層的不平等有弱化趨勢。地理方面，十五歲前居住都市在兩期皆不顯著；以北部為基準，東部地區在擴張前呈顯著劣勢（OR=0.21，p=0.021），擴張後則不再顯著，顯示區域差距有收斂現象。綜合而論，高教擴張確實改善地理與職業階層的不平等，但家庭文化資本對教育達成的影響仍高度穩定。本文建議，高教政策除持續平衡區域資源與支持弱勢地區院校外，更需從義務教育階段起強化弱勢家庭的文化與學習支持，以避免代際不平等在更高學歷門檻上持續再製。
abstract_en: This study assesses whether the rapid expansion of higher education following the "410 Reform" improved equity, specifically focusing on family background and geographic context. Using the Taiwan Social Change Survey （TSCS） （2005／2010／2020）, we analyzed two birth cohorts: 1969–1978 （pre–expansion, n=918） and 1979–1988 （post–expansion, n=886）. The primary independent variables included gender, family cultural capital （mother ≥ junior college; father ≥ university）, socioeconomic capital （father's managerial／professional occupation）, and geography （residence at age 15: urban／rural and region）. Binary logistic regression results indicate that gender was non–significant in both cohorts, suggesting females are no longer disadvantaged. However, parental education （cultural capital） remained a stable, positive predictor. For example, in the post–expansion cohort, the odds ratio （OR） for mothers with ≥ junior college was 4.47 （p < 0.001）, and for fathers with ≥ university degrees was 3.10 （p = 0.001）. In contrast, the father’s high–status occupation showed a significant positive effect only pre–expansion （OR=1.84, p = 0.009） and became non–significant post–expansion. Geographically, using the Northern region as the reference, the Eastern region showed a significant disadvantage pre–expansion （OR=0.21, p = 0.021） but this gap converged post–expansion. In conclusion, while expansion mitigated inequality related to occupation and geography, intergenerational cultural capital remains a persistent driver of educational stratification. Policy should continue balancing regional resources and significantly strengthen cultural and learning support for disadvantaged families starting from compulsory education.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 學校選址與入學制度何者更重要？以國立嘉科實驗高級中等學校為例之代理人基模型與教育機會均等分析
title_en: Which Matters More, School Location or Admission Policy? An Agent-Based Simulation of Educational Opportunity Equality for the National Experimental High School at Chiayi Science Park
keywords: 代理人基模型、教育機會均等、學校選址、入學制度、馬太效應
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在探討何種「政策組合」 （入學制度與校址設定） 最能促進嘉義地區的教育機會均等。鑒於傳統教育政策評估方法難以捕捉個別家長擇校決策的動態過程，及其在空間與社會網絡中所浮現的複雜宏觀效應，本研究首先建構教育機會指數 （Educational Opportunity Index, EOI） ，描繪嘉義縣市教育資源與學校可近性的空間分布，進而引入計算社會科學領域之代理人基模型 （Agent-Based Model, ABM） 方法論，建構一虛擬政策實驗場景。模型以嘉義縣市所有公立國中學區為地理邊界，模擬在不同入學制度（學區保障制 vs. 市場開放制）與校址設定下，具備異質性社經背景的家長（代理人）之擇校行為，如何共同「生成」 （emerge） 出區域教育資源分配的宏觀樣態，並以社經隔離指數、熵式區隔指標與通學時間等量化指標評估教育機會均等的變化。本研究的核心問題在於：嘉科實驗中學的『最佳選址』為何？ 透過 3（地點）× 2（制度）共 180 次的反事實模擬，本研究發現，在各項教育機會指標上，「入學制度」的主效應 F 值遠大於「學校選址」效應，顯示前者對教育公平的影響力遠遠壓倒後者。本研究據此為「最佳選址」問題提供了一個具層次性（入學制度作為總開關，校址設定作為微調鈕）的政策答案，並為教育資源的空間配置與公平性規劃提供新的實證依據。
abstract_en: This thesis examines which combination of admission policy and campus location best promotes educational opportunity equality in the Chiayi region of Taiwan. To move beyond static evaluations, the study builds a virtual policy experiment. First, an Educational Opportunity Index (EOI) maps the spatial distribution of access to upper secondary schools. Then an agent-based model (ABM) simulates how parents with different socioeconomic status choose schools under alternative policies.The model takes all public junior high school catchment areas in Chiayi City and County as its boundary, and compares two admission policies (neighborhood-based assignment versus open enrollment) and three locations for Jiake Experimental High School. Educational opportunity is evaluated with segregation and travel-time indicators. A 3 (location) × 2 (admission policy) design is run 180 times and analyzed with standard inferential statistics.Results show that, across all indicators, the admission policy has a far stronger effect on educational opportunity than school location. In other words, the policy operates as a master switch, while campus siting only fine-tunes outcomes. The study offers a layered answer to the “best location” question and provides empirical support for prioritizing admission rules when planning a fairer spatial allocation of educational opportunities.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 師資生從哪裡來？國立臺北科技大學師資生生源的縱貫性分析
title_en: Where do Teacher Education Students come from? A Longitudinal Analysis of the Origins of Teacher Education Students at National Taipei University of Technology.
keywords: 師資生、地理資訊系統、社會經濟地位、邏輯式迴歸分析
abstract_zh: 本研究運用 GIS 與邏輯式迴歸分析，檢視國立臺北科技大學 104 至 110 學年度師資生的生源地區分布及其影響因素，旨在探討地理因素與社經背景對學生選擇師培的影響。研究問題包括：（1）104至110學年間，國立臺北科技大學師資生的區域生源分布特徵為何？是否存在顯著的地理分布差異？（2）國立臺北科技大學學生與師資生之主要目標生源學校分布情形如何？師資生在各目標生源學校中的比例為何？（3）透過分析村里的社會經濟地位對師資生生源的影響，了解師資生的社會經濟背景特徵為何？本研究使用 104 至 110 年間國立臺北科技大學學生學籍資料與師資生名單，並結合內政部 110年村里層級統計數據，包括 15 歲以上人口教育程度、綜合所得稅所得總額申報統計及單歲年齡組學齡人口統計，進行地理與社經分析。研究結果顯示：（1）GIS 熱區分析發現，國立臺北科技大學師資生的主要生源分布於中部與南部地區。（2）師資生的質心逐年向彰化以南移動，顯示來自該區域的學生選擇師培的比例逐年增加。（3）畢業學校分布分析發現，彰化以南地區的學生選擇師培的比例顯著高於該區域在全體學生中的占比。（4）邏輯式迴歸分析結果顯示，在彰化以南的村里教育水平與該村里是否擁有師資生呈正相關，顯示彰化以南來自教育水平較高地區的學生更傾向選擇師培。本研究發現國立臺北科技大學師資生的選擇受到地理與社會經濟地位影響，並據此提出政策建議，未來師資培育大學可提供更彈性的實習機制及提供返鄉優先實習與就業機制等。
abstract_en: This study employs GIS and logistic regression analysis to examine the regional distribution and influencing factors of teacher education students at National Taipei University of Technology from academic years 104- 110. The research addresses three questions: (1) What are the regional origin characteristics of NTUT teacher education students during 104-110? Is there significant geographic disparity? (2) How do the primary feeder school distributions differ between NTUT general students and teacher education students? What are the proportions from each key feeder school? (3) What are the socioeconomic background characteristics of teacher education students' home villages? Data sources include NTUT student registry and teacher education rosters from 104-110, integrated with Ministry of the Interior 110 village-level statistics covering residents aged 15+ educational attainment, total declared comprehensive income tax data, and single-year age cohort population statistics for geographic and socioeconomic analysis. Key findings: (1) GIS hotspot analysis reveals teacher education students primarily originate from central and southern Taiwan regions south of Changhua County; (2) the geographic centroid of teacher education students' origins exhibits progressive southward migration; (3) feeder school analysis shows students from schools south of Changhua have significantly higher representation among teacher education students than their share in the general student body; (4) logistic regression indicates a positive association between village-level educational attainment and the presence of teacher education students south of Changhua. These findings demonstrate geography and socioeconomic status influence teacher education program choice. Policy recommendations include more flexible internship arrangements and establishing "return-to-home-region priority" mechanisms for internships and employment to leverage regional teacher supply advantages.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 創業教育、創業榜樣及創業意圖 之關係研究-以科技大學商管學院學生為例
title_en: A Study on the Relationships Among Entrepreneurship Education, Entrepreneurial Role Models, and Entrepreneurial Intentions among Students in Colleges of Business at Taiwanese Universities of Technology
keywords: 創業教育、創業榜樣、創業意圖、科技大學學生、商管學院
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在探討科技大學商管學院學生之創業教育、創業榜樣與創業意圖之關係。研究採問卷調查法，並以分層比例抽樣方式蒐集資料，共發放593份問卷，實際回收560份。依無效問卷共剔除76份不符合資料品質要求之問卷，最終保留484份有效樣本進行統計分析。研究結果如下：一、背景變項在創業教育成效、創業榜樣與創業意圖三個構面上呈現部分顯著差異，其中以修習創新創業課程學分數、是否具備校外實習經驗、是否具有家族創業經驗及學校屬性（公私立）之差異最為一致，顯示學生之學習經驗與教育情境可作為課程設計與資源配置之重要參考依據。二、創業教育成效對創業意圖具有顯著正向影響，且創業教育成效亦能顯著提升學生對創業榜樣之認知與認同，顯示創業教育不僅直接影響學生之創業意圖，亦透過教育歷程中所提供之榜樣接觸與學習經驗發揮關鍵作用。三、中介分析顯示，創業榜樣在創業教育成效與創業意圖之間具有顯著的部分中介效果，表示創業教育除可直接提升學生創業意圖外，亦會透過強化學生對創業榜樣之認同與觀察學習，進一步促進其創業意圖之形成。四、基於研究結果，教育與實務建議包括：強化行動導向與實作取向之課程設計、建立常態化且可近之創業榜樣互動機制（如校友、業師與創業者參與），並依學生不同學習經驗與背景條件，提供差異化支持，以提升創業教育成效與學生之創業意圖。最後，本研究受限於自陳式資料與橫斷式研究設計，可能影響因果推論及外部效度；未來研究可採多來源或縱貫式研究，並納入其他心理歷程變項，以進一步深化創業教育相關研究之理論與實務意涵。
abstract_en: This study investigates the relationships among entrepreneurship education effectiveness, entrepreneurial role models, and entrepreneurial intention among business and management students at universities of science and technology. A questionnaire survey was conducted using stratified proportional sampling. Of the 593 questionnaires distributed, 560 were returned. After excluding 76 questionnaires that failed to meet data quality criteria, 484 valid responses were retained for statistical analysis.The findings indicate that background variables exhibit partial significant differences across entrepreneurship education effectiveness, entrepreneurial role models, and entrepreneurial intention. In particular, consistent differences were observed in relation to entrepreneurship-related course credits completed, participation in off-campus internships, family entrepreneurial experience, and institutional type (public vs. private). Structural equation modeling results further show that entrepreneurship education effectiveness has a significant positive effect on entrepreneurial intention and significantly enhances students’ recognition and identification with entrepreneurial role models. Mediation analysis reveals that entrepreneurial role models play a significant partial mediating role between entrepreneurship education effectiveness and entrepreneurial intention, indicating that entrepreneurship education influences entrepreneurial intention both directly and indirectly through role model recognition.Based on these results, the study suggests strengthening action-oriented and experiential course design, establishing regular interaction mechanisms with entrepreneurial role models, and providing differentiated support according to students’ learning experiences. Limitations related to self-reported data and the cross-sectional design are acknowledged, and future research is encouraged to adopt longitudinal or multi-source approaches.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 探究式學習結合BYOD模式對學生問題解決能力之影響：以探究與實作歷史學探究課程為例
title_en: The Impact of Inquiry-Based Learning Integrated with the BYOD Model on Students' Problem-Solving Ability
keywords: 探究與實作、探究式學習、BYOD、問題解決能力
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在探討高中探究與實作課程中，結合BYOD模式之探究式學習，對學生問題解決能力之影響，並瞭解教師與學生對此教學模式之實施現況與困難。本研究以北部一所A高中進行，共分兩個班，甲班為實驗組（探究式學習結合BYOD模式）、乙班為對照組（傳統探究式學習）歷時 9 週教學。研究工具「問題解決能力評量表」，分為資料蒐集與分析、批判思考與問題解決、計畫與執行、討論與傳達、反思與評估及整體問題解決六構面。結果顯示，實驗組在六大構面及總分之後測表現皆顯著高於對照組，顯示BYOD 結合探究式學習能有效提升學生於歷史探究情境中的問題解決能力。質性結果顯示，教師認為BYOD能幫助學生在即時蒐集史料、進行多模態紀錄與表達，促進合作討論與自我反思。特別是在批判思考上，學生透過行動載具即時上網做資訊驗證與觀點比對。本研究證實在適當課程設計與教學策略支持下，探究與實作課程結合BYOD模式，在增進學生問題解決能力上均達顯著水準。
abstract_en: This study aims to investigate the effects of inquiry-based learning integrated with the Bring Your Own Device (BYOD) model on senior high school students’ problem-solving ability in an "Inquiry and Practice" history course. Additionally, it explores teachers’ and students’ perceptions of the implementation status and challenges of this instructional model.This study was conducted at a senior high school (High School A) in Northern Taiwan. Two classes participated in the study: Class A served as the experimental group (inquiry-based learning integrated with the BYOD model), while Class B served as the control group (traditional inquiry-based learning). The instructional intervention lasted for nine weeks. The research instrument used was the "Problem-Solving Ability Scale," which comprises six dimensions: data collection and analysis, critical thinking and problem-solving, planning and execution, discussion and communication, reflection and evaluation, and overall problem-solving.The results indicated that the experimental group significantly outperformed the control group in the post-test across all six dimensions and the total score, demonstrating that the BYOD model combined with inquiry-based learning effectively enhances students’ problem-solving ability in historical inquiry contexts. Qualitative findings further revealed that teachers perceived BYOD as beneficial for facilitating students’ real-time collection of historical materials, multimodal documentation and expression, and collaborative discussion and self-reflection.
