Specifically, regarding critical thinking, students utilized digital devices to verify information and compare multiple perspectives online.In conclusion, this study confirms that under the support of appropriate curriculum design and instructional strategies, the adoption of inquiry-based learning integrated with the BYOD model in the "Inquiry and Practice" course yields significant improvements in students’ problem-solving ability.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 軍事院校學生的創業家精神對創新工作行為之影響-心理資本之調節效果與創業意圖之中介效果
title_en: The Impact of Entrepreneurship on Innovative Work Behavior among Students of Military Academies -The Moderating Effect of Psychological Capital and The Mediating Effect of Entrepreneurial Intention
keywords: 軍事教育、創業家精神、創新工作行為、心理資本、創業意圖
abstract_zh: 在社會環境快速變遷的時代，創業已成為提昇國家競爭力重要推動力，培養具創新思維與行動力之人才是創業的根本，而軍事教育強調紀律與團隊協作等特質，與創業過程中所需能力有高度相關，但卻無相關文獻可獲得支持，因此本研究希望藉由探討不同背景變項之軍事院校大學生在創業家精神、創業意圖、心理資本及創新工作行為之間的差異與各變數之間關係，並檢視心理資本與創業意圖是否在創業家精神與創新工作行為間發揮調節與中介效果。本研究採用文獻探討及問卷調查等研究方法，透過網路問卷方式針對軍事院校三、四年級大學生進行資料蒐集，總計回收330份問卷，使用SPSS及Amos統計軟體，透過描述性統計、獨立樣本t檢定、相關分析、驗證性因素分析及結構方程模型等方式進行數據分析。研究結果發現，男性學生在創業家精神較高，軍人子女在心理資本較高，具有家族創業學生經驗之學生在創新工作行為及心理資本較高，具備幹部經驗之學生在創業家精神、創新工作行為及心理資本較高，創業家精神對創業意圖有顯著正向影響，心理資本對創業家精神與創新工作行為有顯著正向影響，心理資本在創業家精神與創新工作行為間發揮調節效果，創業意圖在創業家精神與創新工作行為間並無中介效果，研究啟示與建議將提供軍事院校具體建議，進而優化軍事教育與人才培育政策。
abstract_en: In an era of rapid social change, entrepreneurship has become an important driving force for enhancing national competitiveness. Cultivating talents with innovative thinking and action is the foundation of entrepreneurship. Military education emphasizes qualities such as discipline and teamwork, which are highly relevant to the abilities required in the entrepreneurial process. However, there is no relevant literature to support this. Therefore, this study aims to explore the differences between military academy students with different background variables in entrepreneurship, entrepreneurial intention, psychological capital, and innovative work behavior, and examine the moderating and mediating effects of psychological capital and entrepreneurial intention between entrepreneurship and innovative work behavior. This study employs a combination of literature review and survey methods. Data were collected from third- and fourth-year students at military academies via an online questionnaire, with a total of 330 valid responses. The data were analyzed using SPSS and Amos statistical software, employing descriptive statistics, independent samples t-test, correlation analysis, confirmatory factor analysis, and structural equation modeling. The research results found that male students have higher entrepreneurial spirit, children of military personnel have higher psychological capital, students with family entrepreneurial student experience have higher innovative work behavior and psychological capital, and students with cadre experience have higher entrepreneurial spirit, innovative work behavior and psychological capital. Entrepreneurial spirit has a significant positive impact on entrepreneurial intentions, and psychological capital has a significant positive impact on entrepreneurship and innovative work behavior. Psychological capital plays a moderating role between entrepreneurial spirit and innovative work behavior. Entrepreneurial Intention does not mediate the relationship between entrepreneurship and innovative work behavior. The research will provide specific suggestions for military academies and thus optimize military education and talent cultivation policies.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 短期培訓對營隊教師TPACK與教學自我效能之影響
title_en: The Impact of Short-Term Training on Camp Teachers’ TPACK and Teaching Self-Efficacy
keywords: 短期培訓、營隊教師、TPACK、教學自我效能
abstract_zh: 在數位時代背景下，教師的技術、教學與知識整合能力（TPACK）成為一個重要指標。然而，關於短期培訓（例如營隊教育）是否亦能提升教師之TPACK卻鮮有研究。因此本研究旨在探討短期培訓對於營隊教師「TPACK」與「教學自我效能」之影響。本研究採用前實驗研究法進行，研究對象為參與2024年國內具代表性的營隊主辦方A協會提供之短期培訓的營隊教師，本次研究總樣本數為164人，其中首次參與短期培訓之營隊教師為115人，非首次參與教師為49人。研究工具包含「職前教師教學與技術知識調查量表」及「教師自我效能量表」。教師須先接受前測，然後進行為期四天的培訓涵蓋營隊專業知識、教學方法及輔助課堂工具的使用等面向，再進行後測。研究結果如下，經過短期培訓的營隊教師，在TPACK七個構面上以及教學自我效能三個構面中均有提升。其中，首次參與短期培訓之營隊教師在TPACK與教學自我效能均高於非首次參與教師。建議未來在培訓的設計上應考慮個別化學習需求，針對營隊教師是否為首次參與提供不同的培訓內容。
abstract_en: In the context of the digital era, teachers’ ability to integrate technology, pedagogy, andcontent knowledge (TPACK) has become a crucial indicator of instructional competence. However, limited research has examined whether short-term training programs, such as camp based education, can effectively enhance teachers’ TPACK. Therefore, this study aims to investigate the impact of short-term training on camp instructors’ TPACK and teaching self-efficacy.This study adopted a pre-experimental research design. The participants were 164 camp instructors who attended the short-term training organized by Association A, a leading domestic camp organizer in the 113th academic year. Among them, 115 instructors were first time participants, while 49 had participated in similar training previously. The research instruments included the “Pre-service Teachers’ Technological and Pedagogical Content Knowledge (TPACK) Survey” and the “Teachers’ Self-Efficacy Scale.” Participants completed a pre-test prior to attending a four-day training program, which covered professional knowledge for camp instruction, teaching methods, and the application of classroom support tools, followed by a post-test.The results indicated that after the short-term training, participants showed improvements across all seven dimensions of TPACK and all three dimensions of teachingself-efficacy. Furthermore, first-time participants demonstrated higher gains in both TPACK and teaching self-efficacy compared to those who had previously participated. It is recommended that future training programs consider differentiated instructional design based on participants’ prior training experience to better address individual learning needs.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 以脈絡化期望價值理論觀點探討北區高級中學總務處組長之工作動機、工作滿意度與組織公民行為關係之研究
title_en: Exploring the Relations Among Work Motivation, Job Satisfaction, and Organizational Citizenship Behavior of General Affairs Office Section Chiefs in Northern Taiwan’s High Schools: A Situated Expectancy-Value Theory Approach
keywords: 脈絡化期望價值理論、工作動機、工作期望、工作價值、工作成本、工作滿意度、正向情感滿意度、負向情感滿意度、組織公民行為
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在藉由「脈絡化期望價值理論」（situated expectancy-value theory; SEVT）的觀點，探討臺灣北區高級中學總務處組長的工作動機（包括期望、價值與成本）、工作滿意度（正向情感滿意度與負向情感滿意度）與組織公民行為之間的關聯性。研究動機源於學術界對組織公民行為的持續關注，以及情境期望價值理論在解釋員工行為動機方面具備的理論潛力，期望透過理論整合為相關領域提供新的研究視角。研究採用問卷調查法收集實證資料，共發放450份問卷，成功回收343份，經嚴格資料篩選後，獲得有效問卷337份，有效回收率達74.89%。統計分析運用R軟體搭配Process套件進行，研究假設檢驗採用迴歸分析與bootstrapping方法，透過中介效果及路徑分析驗證理論模型。研究結果顯示，工作動機各構面對情感滿意度具有顯著影響。工作期望正向影響正向情感滿意度，工作價值認同對情感滿意度影響最為關鍵，特別在提升正向情感方面效果強烈。工作成本則對情感滿意度產生負面制約作用，強烈提升負向情感滿意度。情感滿意度與組織公民行為間存在顯著影響關係。正向情感滿意度顯著促進組織公民行為，負向情感滿意度則抑制組織公民行為，且正向情感的促進效果強於負向情感的抑制效果。中介效果分析顯示，情感滿意度在工作動機與組織公民行為間具有顯著中介效果。工作價值透過正向情感滿意度對組織公民行為產生最強烈的間接正向影響，工作成本則產生顯著負向中介效果。薪資能直接正向影響組織公民行為，但對正向情感滿意度影響不顯著。本研究所有假設均獲統計支持，證實此模型具有良好的解釋力與預測效果。本研究建議組織應積極構建工作價值認知提升策略、建立動態期望協調機制、實施系統性工作成本控制措施，並致力營造積極正向的組織情感環境。
abstract_en: This study explores relationships among work motivation (expectancy, value, and cost), job satisfaction (positive and negative affective satisfaction), and organizational citizenship behavior (OCB) of general affairs section chiefs in northern Taiwan's senior high schools through situated expectancy-value theory (SEVT).Results show significant impacts of work motivation on affective satisfaction. Work expectancy positively influences positive affective satisfaction, while work value recognition most critically affects affective satisfaction, particularly enhancing positive emotions. Work cost negatively constrains affective satisfaction, significantly increasing negative emotions. Positive affective satisfaction promotes OCB while negative affective satisfaction inhibits it, with positive effects stronger than negative ones.Mediation analyses reveal significant mediating effects of affective satisfaction between work motivation and OCB. Work value generates the strongest indirect positive impact on OCB through positive affective satisfaction, while work cost produces significant negative mediating effects. Salary directly influences OCB but not positive affective satisfaction. All hypotheses received statistical support, confirming robust model validity.The study recommends organizations develop work value enhancement strategies, establish expectancy coordination mechanisms, implement cost control measures, and cultivate positive emotional environments.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 印尼高等教育卓越計畫政策效果評估之研究：以11所旗艦大學為例
title_en: A Study on the Effectiveness Evaluation of Indonesia’s Higher Education Excellence Program: A Case Study of 11 Flagship Universities
keywords: 高等教育、全球化、國際化、大學自治、出版生產力、國際合作與流動性
abstract_zh: 本研究檢視了大學自治（UA）實施對自治高等教育機構（AHEI）出版生產力的影響。採用差異雙重差分法 (DID) 對 AHEI 和非 AHEI（對照組）的科學生產力進行定量和定性比較。此外，我們同樣使用了統計技術來比較國際合作的成長。分析結果顯示，UA 兩年後，AHEI 發表的科學出版數量明顯高於非 AHEI 發表的科學出版數量（p=0.027）。關於質量，本研究發現 UA 提高了出版物的品質（p=0.015）。此外，根據分析結果，以自治地位劃分的AHEIs也顯著加強了國際合作（p=0.006）。這些發現表明 UA 對出版生產力有顯著的正面影響。本研究還有兩個次要發現。本研究發現國際合作對出版品質有顯著的正面影響。國際合作撰寫的文章往往比國內合作撰寫的文章更高品質。此外，在國際合作出版品中，與流動科學家合作撰寫的文章品質明顯高於沒有流動科學家合作撰寫的文章。換句話說，科學家的流動性對他們的出版物產生了積極的影響。
abstract_en: This study examines the impact of university autonomy (UA) implementation on the publication productivity of Autonomous Higher Education Institutions (AHEIs). A Difference-in-Differences (DID) was applied to compare the scientific productivity of AHEIs and non-AHEIs (comparison group) quantitatively and qualitatively. Moreover, the same statistical technique was also used to compare the growth of international collaborations. The analysis result shows that two years after the UA, the number of scientific publications produced by AHEIs was significantly higher than those published by non-AHEIs (p=0.027). Regarding the quality, this study found that UA increased the quality of publications (p=0.015). Moreover, based on the analysis result, by autonomy status, AHEIs also significantly enhanced their international collaboration (p=0.006). These findings indicate that UA has a significant positive impact on publication productivity.There are also two secondary findings of this study. This study found that international collaboration has a significant positive impact on the publication quality. An article co-authored internationally tends to have higher quality than a domestically co-authored. Moreover, among internationally co-authored publications, articles co-authored with mobile scientists have significantly higher quality compared to articles co-authored without mobile scientists. In other words, the mobility of scientists positively impacts their publications.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 檢視台灣護理人員年齡、任期與工作情緒之間的關係
title_en: Examining the Relations between Age, Tenure, and Work Emotions among Taiwanese Nurses
keywords: 年齡、年資、工作情緒、護理人員
abstract_zh: 護理專業具有高度的情緒需求，護理人員需在高壓環境中應對複雜的病患需求，並在面對壓力、衝突與失落時維持情緒穩定與專業表現。這些要求使護理人員的情緒健康成為影響醫療品質、員工留任與組織穩定的重要議題。在眾多影響工作情緒的因素中，年齡與年資被視為重要的人口統計變項；然而，兩者的交互作用，特別是在臺灣護理情境下，仍缺乏深入探討。為填補此一研究空缺，本研究旨在探討年齡與年資對台灣護理人員負向工作情緒（包括憤怒、不悅與悲傷）的影響，並分析其交互作用。本研究採用量化橫斷式研究設計，運用嘉義地區私立醫院 348 位護理人員的次級問卷調查資料，資料來源為中央研究院學術調查研究資料庫。問卷包含人口統計變項與自我認知的工作負向情緒頻率量表。本研究進行描述性統計、探索性因素分析以驗證構念效度、多重共線性檢驗，以及納入年齡與年資交互項的多元迴歸分析，並將教育程度作為共變項控制。研究結果顯示，年齡與年資皆與部分負向情緒有顯著的關係，但關係的方向不盡相同。年齡與不悅呈顯著負相關，顯示年輕護理人員在日常工作互動中較容易感到不滿或不快。年資與三種負向情緒（憤怒、不悅、悲傷）皆無顯著相關，與原先預期不同。然而交互作用分析結果進一步顯示，年齡顯著調節年資與負向情緒的關係。年齡能削弱年資對負向情緒的正向影響，亦即年齡愈高，長年資所帶來的負向情緒壓力相對減輕。Johnson–Neyman方法的檢測更指出，當年齡超過特定門檻值時，年資對負向情緒的影響不再顯著，而此臨界年齡因情緒類型而異。相反地，年齡愈低，長年資所帶來的負向情緒壓力相對增加。本研究結果對臺灣醫療人力管理與政策制定具有重要啟示。首先，對於年輕且具長年資的護理人員，應著重於情緒調節能力的培養、導師制度的建立，以及工作負荷的調整，以降低倦怠風險。其次，對於年長且具長年資的護理人員，應關注其累積的工作壓力與職涯疲勞，透過職務輪調、同儕支持網絡及表揚制度來維持工作動力。整體而言，建立支持性的組織文化、提供可近用的心理健康資源、以及確保合理的護病比，都是提升護理人員情緒韌性的關鍵策略。本研究透過整合人口統計因素與情緒結果，不僅深化了對護理人員工作情緒的理論理解，也在實務面提供了針對性留任策略、培訓方案與政策改革的實證依據，期能促進臺灣護理人力的健康與穩定，並確保醫療服務品質的永續發展。
abstract_en: The nursing profession is characterized by high emotional demands, requiring practitioners to manage complex patient needs, work in high-pressure environments, and display emotional composure in the face of stress, conflict, and loss. These demands make nurses’ emotional well-being a central concern for healthcare quality, staff retention, and organizational stability. Among the many factors influencing emotional experiences at work, age and tenure have been identified as important demographic predictors; however, their combined effects, particularly within the nursing context in Taiwan, remain underexplored. Addressing this gap, the present study investigates the individual and interactive influences of age and tenure on negative work emotions—specifically anger, displeasure, and sadness—among Taiwanese nurses.A quantitative, cross-sectional research design was adopted, utilizing secondary survey data from 348 nurses employed in private hospitals in the Chiayi region. The dataset, sourced from the Survey Research Data Archive, included measures of demographic variables and self-reported frequencies of work-related negative emotions. Statistical analyses included descriptive statistics, exploratory factor analysis to confirm construct validity, multicollinearity diagnostics, and multiple regression models with interaction terms to assess moderation effects of age on the tenure–emotion relationship. Education level was included as a covariate.The findings revealed that age and tenure had differential associations with negative emotional responses. Age was significantly and negatively correlated with displeasure, indicating that younger nurses experienced higher levels of dissatisfaction in daily work interactions. Tenure, contrary to initial expectations, was not significantly associated with any negative emotions. However, interaction analyses demonstrated that the positive relationship between tenure and negative emotions was attenuated among older nurses, indicating that age serves as a partial buffer against the emotional costs of long-term service. Johnson–Neyman probing further identified age thresholds beyond which tenure no longer significantly predicted negative emotions, with the cut-off points varying by emotion type. In contrast, younger nurses with longer tenure were significantly more likely to experience heightened negative emotions.These results carry meaningful implications for workforce management and policy development in Taiwan’s healthcare sector. They underscore the importance of career stage–specific interventions: for younger nurses, especially those with extended tenure, support should focus on building emotional regulation skills, providing mentorship opportunities, and managing workload intensity to reduce burnout risk. For older, long-tenured nurses, interventions should address accumulated stress and the potential for career fatigue, such as through job rotation, peer support networks, and recognition programs. Across all groups, fostering a supportive organizational culture, providing accessible mental health resources, and ensuring adequate nurse-to-patient ratios are essential steps toward enhancing emotional resilience.By integrating demographic predictors with emotional outcomes, this study contributes to both the theoretical understanding and practical management of work emotions in nursing. It extends the literature by highlighting the nuanced interplay of age and tenure in shaping nurses’ emotional experiences, offering empirical evidence that can inform targeted retention strategies, training programs, and policy reforms aimed at sustaining a healthy, stable nursing workforce in Taiwan.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 北部地區技術型高中餐飲科僑生專班學生實習適應與社會支持之研究
title_en: A Study on the Internship Adaptability and Social Support among Overseas Chinese Students in the Rotary Cooperative Education Program of Department of Food and Beverage Management of Northern Taiwan’s Vocational High Schools
keywords: 僑生專班、實習適應、社會支持、建教合作
abstract_zh: 關鍵字：僑生專班、實習適應、社會支持、建教合作本研究探討臺灣北部地區技術型高中餐飲科僑生專班學生在校外的實習適應與社會支持之關係，以113學年度北部地區技術型高中餐飲科僑生專班三年級學生為研究對象，本問卷採便利抽樣，參考相關文獻據以自編之「北部地區技術型高中餐飲科僑生專班學生實習適應與社會支持調查問卷」為研究工具，發放份問204份，回收有效問卷204 份，有效問卷回收率為 100%。其中「北部地區技術型高中餐飲科僑生專班學生實習適應分量表」分為心理適應、工作適應和生活適應等三個構面，「北部地區技術型高中餐飲科僑生專班學生社會支持分量表」分為情緒性支持、訊息性支持和實質性支持三個構面，以描述性統計分析、獨立樣本t 檢定、單因子變異數分析、皮爾森積差相關分析等進行統計處理，並依據資料分析之結果歸納如下：一、僑生之實習適應整體及各構面均呈現皆中高程度，尤其是工作適應層面為最佳。二、性別為女性、22歲以上的僑生在實習適應的表現較佳。三、僑生之社會支持整體及各構面均呈現皆中高程度，尤其以訊息性支持的知覺最高。四、性別為女性、22歲以上的僑生知覺到的社會支持程度較高。五、社會支持與實習適應具有高度正向相關。本研究依據研究結果形成具體建議，以供主管教育行政機關、學校與特教教師及未來研究者參考。
abstract_en: Keywords: Overseas Chinese Student Program, Internship Adaptation,        Social Support, Cooperative Education ProgramThis study investigated the relationship between internship adaptation and social support among students enrolled in the Overseas Chinese Student Program of the Food and Beverage Department at technical senior high schools in Northern Taiwan. The research targeted third-year students from the 113th school year. A self-developed questionnaire, based on relevant literature, titled “Survey on Internship Adaptation and Social Support of Overseas Chinese Students in the Food and Beverage Program at Technical Senior High Schools in Northern Taiwan,” was used as the research instrument. A total of 204 questionnaires were distributed and  were successfully returned, yielding a 100% response rate.The “Internship Adaptation Scale” includes three dimensions: psychological adaptation, work adaptation, and life adaptation. The “Social Support Scale” includes emotional support, informational support, and instrumental support. The collected data were analyzed by using descriptive statistics, independent sample t-tests, one-way ANOVA, and Pearson's correlation analysis.The findings are summarized as follows:1. The overall internship adaptation of overseas Chinese students, as well as each dimension, reached a moderate to high level, with work adaptation being the most outstanding.2. Female students and those aged 22 and above demonstrated better performance in internship adaptation.3. The overall level of social support perceived by overseas Chinese students was also moderate to high, with informational support being the highest among all dimensions.4. Female students and those aged 22 and above reported a higher level of perceiving social support.5. A significant positive correlation was found between social support and internship adaptation.This study forms concrete suggestions based on the research results, providing references for  educational administrative authorities, schools, special education teachers, and future researchers.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 臺灣社會創業家從動機到行動：探究創業意圖、創業精神在創業動機與創業行為之中介效果
title_en: Taiwanese Social Entrepreneurs from Motivation to Action:The Mediating Effects of Entrepreneurial Intention and Entrepreneurship between Entrepreneurial Motivation and Entrepreneurial Behavior
keywords: 社會創業、創業動機、創業意圖、創業精神、創業行為
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在探討臺灣社會創業家的創業動機、創業意圖、創業精神與創業行為之間的影響關係，並驗證創業意圖與創業精神在創業動機與創業行為之間的中介效果。研究採用問卷調查法，以經濟部中小及新創企業署「社會創新組織登錄資料庫」之創辦人（負責人）為研究對象，透過分層隨機抽樣，取得有效問卷285份。研究統計採用皮爾森積差相關分析、階層迴歸分析及Sobel檢定驗證變項間關係，研究結果發現，創業動機對創業意圖與創業精神均有顯著正向影響；創業意圖與創業精神對創業行為均有顯著正向影響；創業意圖在創業動機與創業行為間扮演完全中介角色，而創業精神則是部分中介角色。另外，臺灣社會創業家展現「自我實現」為主的動機結構，金錢動機較不突出；創業意圖是創業動機轉化為行動的必要橋樑；創業精神呈現「使命導向與創新主動並重」的獨特結構；創業行為表現出顯著的規劃導向與實踐力。本研究核心發現，臺灣社會創業家從動機到行為的完整心理轉化機制：創業動機顯著預測創業意圖形成，創業意圖進而促進創業精神特質發展，最終透過創業精神驅動創業行為，形成「動機→意圖→精神→行為」的中介效應路徑。本研究不僅豐富了社會創業領域研究，填補社會創業研究的缺口，同時為社會創業政策制定與實務推動提供了科學依據。研究建議政府部門應強化社會創業家之培育，尤其是培養創業意圖並著重創業自我實現；同時社會創業家在保持使命導向的同時，積極發展商業模式創新能力與風險承擔的平衡型創業精神。實務上，社會創業生態系統各利害關係人應建立支持網絡，提供資源及社會資本，共同營造有利於從創業意圖轉化為具體創業行動的環境，以有效促進社會創業的實踐與永續發展。
abstract_en: This study aims to investigate the influence relationships among entrepreneurial motivation, entrepreneurial intention, entrepreneurship, and entrepreneurial behavior of Taiwanese social entrepreneurs, while verifying the mediating effects of entrepreneurial intention and entrepreneurship between entrepreneurial motivation and entrepreneurial behavior. Using a questionnaire survey method, this research targeted founders (responsible persons) from the "Social Innovation Organization Registration Database" of the Small and Medium Enterprise Administration, Ministry of Economic Affairs. Through stratified random sampling, 285 valid questionnaires were collected. Statistical analyses were conducted using Pearson’s product-moment correlation analysis, hierarchical regression analysis, and the Sobel test to verify relationships among variables. The results revealed that entrepreneurial motivation has a significant positive influence on both entrepreneurial intention and entrepreneurship; entrepreneurial intention and entrepreneurship both significantly and positively influence entrepreneurial behavior; entrepreneurial intention plays a fully mediating role between entrepreneurial motivation and entrepreneurial behavior, while entrepreneurship serves as a partial mediator. Taiwanese social entrepreneurs exhibit a motivational structure primarily focused on "self-actualization," with monetary motivation being less prominent; entrepreneurial intention serves as a necessary bridge for transforming entrepreneurial motivation into action; entrepreneurship displays a unique structure characterized by a "dual emphasis on mission-orientation and innovative proactivity"; and entrepreneurial behavior demonstrates strong planning orientation and practical execution capabilities. Moreover, a key finding of this research reveals the complete psychological transformation mechanism from motivation to behavior among Taiwanese social entrepreneurs: entrepreneurial motivation significantly predicts the formation of entrepreneurial intention, which further fosters the development of entrepreneurship traits, ultimately driving entrepreneurial behavior through entrepreneurship, forming a "motivation → intention → entrepreneurship → behavior" mediation pathway. This research not only enriches the field of social entrepreneurship and fills gaps in related research, but also provides a scientific basis for policy development and practical implementation. The study recommends that government departments strengthen the cultivation of social entrepreneurs, particularly in fostering entrepreneurial intention and emphasizing entrepreneurial self-actualization. Simultaneously, social entrepreneurs should develop business model innovation capabilities and balanced, forward-looking risk-taking in entrepreneurship while maintaining a sense of mission. In practice, stakeholders in the social entrepreneurship ecosystem should establish support networks, provide resources and social capital, and jointly create an environment conducive to transforming entrepreneurial intention into concrete entrepreneurial action, thereby effectively promoting the practice and sustainable development of social entrepreneurship.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 生成式AI融入大學生英文課程之研究 —以產學攜手合作計畫專班為例
title_en: A Study of Generative AI Into the English Course of College Students: The Industrial-Academic Cooperation Plan as an Example
keywords: 生成式AI、產學攜手合作計畫專班、學習動機、自我效能
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在探討生成式AI融入產學攜手合作計畫專班英文課程之學習動機與自我效能的影響。研究方法採用單組前後測設計與觀察研究法，研究對象為臺灣北部某大學二年級學生，學生人數38名。依據研究目的進行六週的生成式AI融入英文課程教學活動，教學前使用「學習動機量表」、「自我效能量表」測量學生的分數作為前測依據。在教學期間透過現場觀察學生使用生成式AI於課堂中之應用，並記錄於「觀察記錄表」，教學完成後執行量表後測與選取7位學生進行「半結構式訪談」，進而瞭解教學後的學習動機與自我效能之影響。研究發現與結果為生成式AI融入於產學攜手合作計畫專班英文課程，對學生的學習動機與自我效能具有明顯正向影響。量化數據顯示，在「學習需要」與「自我效能」構面之前後測達統計顯著差異，顯示教學後有助於提升其學習意願與完成任務的信心。訪談亦指出，多數學生認為生成式AI提供即時回饋、解決疑問與降低焦慮，有助於促進主動學習。進一步分析不同程度學生之表現變化，結果顯示：低分組學生的學習動機與自我效能提升最為顯著，中間組呈現差異化趨勢，高分組則提升有限甚至略有動機疲乏現象。整體而言，生成式AI對英文基礎能力或信心不足者具有良好支持效果，展現出高度應用潛力。
abstract_en: This study explored the effects of integrating generative AI into English instruction within an Industrial-Academic Cooperation Program on students’ learning motivation and self-efficacy. Adopting a one-group pretest-posttest design, the study involved 38 second-year university students in Taipei over a six-week period. Data were collected through motivation and self-efficacy scales, classroom observations, and semi-structured interviews.Results showed significant improvements in students’ learning needs and self-efficacy, indicating enhanced engagement and confidence. Students reported that generative AI provided timely feedback, reduced anxiety, and increased learning autonomy. Notably, the most substantial gains were observed among low-performing students, while high-performing students showed limited improvement. Overall, generative AI proved particularly beneficial for learners with lower proficiency or confidence, highlighting its potential as an educational support tool.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 偏遠地區技術型高中學生知覺教師創新教學行為對學習成效的影響－學習自我效能為中介變項
title_en: The Influence of Students' Perceived Teachers' Innovative Teaching Behavior on Learning Outcomes in Remote Vocational High Schools: The Mediating Role of Learning Self-Efficacy
keywords: 偏遠地區、技術型高中、創新教學行為、學習自我效能、學習成效、認知、情意、技能
abstract_zh: 偏遠地區技術型高中長期面臨學習動機不足與文化刺激匱乏的雙重挑戰，而創新教學成為激發學生學習動機，係促進升學、就業水到渠成的潛在解方。然既有研究多聚焦教師自評視角，缺乏從學生感知層面探討創新教學行為實徵證據。為彌合此缺口，本研究以問卷調查法，針對偏遠地區技術型高中發放1,200份問卷（回收1,164份，有效816份），探討(1)學生知覺教師創新教學行為現況，(2) 學習自我效能的中介作用，(3)上述因素對學習成效的影響路徑。結果顯示學生知覺教師創新教學行為、學習自我效能及學習成效整體呈中高水準，但存在顯著群體差異：男性學生在知覺教師創新教學與學習自我效能表現優於女性；高學業成就學生學習自我效能顯著高於低學業成就；海事水產類學生在知覺教師創新教學行為與學習自我效能均高於工業類與商業類學生。學習自我效能是知覺教師創新教學行為影響學習成效的主要中介機制，其中教學方法與策略雖能有效提升認知與技能水平，但情意成效更依賴於良好的師生關係與教學環境。值得注意的是，學生在真實產業環境中的技能應用信心仍有不足，突顯加強實作課程與職場銜接的迫切性。基於上述發現，本研究提出「精熟導向」教學框架，建議整合時事議題與產業情境，實施階段性實作任務與容錯評量機制，並擴展產業移地教學模式。這些成果為偏遠地區技職教育政策制定提供實徵依據，強調「信心驅動學習」的核心價值。
abstract_en: Vocational high schools in remote areas persistently face dual challenges of insufficient learning motivation and limited cultural stimulation, where innovative teaching emerges as a potential solution to engage students and facilitate their smooth transition to higher education or employment. However, existing research predominantly adopts teacher self-evaluation perspectives, lacking empirical evidence on students' perceptions of innovative teaching behaviors. To address this gap, this study employed a questionnaire survey with 1,200 distributed questionnaires (1,164 returned, 816 valid) targeting remote vocational high schools, examining: (1) students' perceived innovative teaching behaviors, (2) the mediating role of learning self-efficacy, and (3) pathways influencing learning outcomes.Findings indicate moderately high overall levels of perceived innovative teaching behaviors, learning self-efficacy, and learning outcomes, with significant group disparities: Male students outperformed females in perceiving teaching innovation and self-efficacy; High academic achievers demonstrated stronger self-efficacy than low achievers; Marine/fisheries students surpassed industrial/commerce peers in both teaching behavior perception and self-efficacy. learning self-efficacy served as the primary mediator between perceived innovative teaching and learning outcomes: while teaching methods effectively enhanced cognitive and technical skills, affective outcomes relied more substantially on positive teacher-student relationships and supportive learning environments. Crucially, students' confidence in applying skills within authentic industrial contexts remained inadequate, highlighting the urgent need to strengthen practical curricula and industry-academia alignment.Based on these insights, we propose a Mastery-Oriented Teaching Framework advocating: Integration of current affairs and industry scenarios; Implementation of progressive practical tasks with error-tolerant assessments; Expansion of industry-immersion teaching models. These evidence-based outcomes inform vocational education policy-making in remote regions, emphasizing "confidence-driven learning" as a core pedagogical value.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 生成式AI繪圖應用於國小三年級美術課程之研究
title_en: A Study on Applying Generative AI Drawing Tools to the Third-Grade Art Curriculum in Elementary School
keywords: 生成式AI繪圖、美術課程、美術表現
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在探討生成式 AI 繪圖應用於國小三年級美術課程之教學應用與學生美術學習表現，分析其在課堂實施後對學生創作與美術學習表現的影響。課程設計結合圖像生成工具與創作任務，引導學生從語句提示出發，發展個人構圖與作品表現，提升其創作參與與表現能力。本研究採準實驗設計，以新北市某私立國小三年級兩班學生為研究對象，分為實驗組30人與對照組30人，進行為期六週之教學實施。課程結束後，透過學生自覺美術表現量表、教師評估美術表現評分表與半結構式訪談等方式，蒐集量化與質性資料，以分析學生在認知、情意與技能等構面之學習表現與經驗。經過統計分析後，研究結論如下：一、在學生自覺美術表現方面，實驗組與對照組在認知、情意與技能三構面上皆未呈現顯著差異。二、教師評估美術表現評分表分析亦未發現兩組在作品表現上有統計上顯著差異，顯示生成式 AI 繪圖教學實施對學生作品完成度與表現尚未產生明確影響。三、從學生訪談結果觀察，學生表示生成式 AI 工具有助於激發構圖靈感與提升創作興趣，並分享其在使用過程中的個人經驗與看法。
abstract_en: This study aims to explore the instructional application of generative AI drawing in third-grade elementary art education and to analyze their impact on students’ creative engagement and artistic learning performance. The curriculum was designed by integrating image generation tools with creative tasks, guiding students to develop personal compositions and artistic expression through text prompts, with the goal of enhancing their participation and expressive abilities in art creation.A quasi-experimental design was adopted. Participants included two third-grade classes from a private elementary school in New Taipei City, with 30 students each assigned to the experimental and control groups. The instructional implementation lasted for six weeks. After the course, quantitative and qualitative data were collected through a student self-assessment scale of artistic performance, a teacher rating rubric, and semi-structured interviews, in order to analyze students' learning outcomes in cognitive, affective, and skill-related dimensions.Based on statistical analysis, the research results are as follows:1. Regarding students' self-perceived artistic performance, no significant differences were found between the experimental and control groups across the cognitive, affective, and psychomotor dimensions.2. Analysis of the teacher-rated art performance rubric also revealed no statistically significant differences in artwork performance between the two groups, indicating that the implementation of generative AI drawing instruction did not have a clear impact on students’ work completeness or performance.3. Observations from student interview responses indicated that generative AI tools were perceived as helpful in stimulating compositional ideas and enhancing creative interest. Students also shared their personal experiences and perspectives during the use of these tools.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 技術型高中素養導向評量試題之發展：以數位科技課程為例
title_en: The Development of Vocational High School Competency-Based Assessment Questions: Taking Digital Technology Courses as an Example
keywords: 素養導向評量、試題發展、數位科技課程、技術型高中
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在發展技術型高中商業與管理群「數位科技課程」之素養導向評量試題，建構試題評量架構與試題發展流程，並檢視試題品質與相關因素。試題由六位具備素養導向命題經驗之資處科教師編寫，由另三位具有同領域命題經驗的教師審題，最終完成19題素養導向評量試題，並自編「素養導向教學」與「素養導向學習」量表。本研究採立意叢集抽樣，針對設有資處科之技高商管群學校，依數位科技模擬考成績分為高、中、低三群，各選取兩所學校，每校抽取至少三班，共獲得528份有效樣本，進行測驗與問卷調查。測驗結果顯示整體難度適中(P = .59)，所有試題鑑別度皆在 .39 以上，KR-20 為 .77，題項與總分之相關係數皆在 .35 以上，顯示試題具一致性與同質性。另以商教學會所編6題高鑑別度素養題作為效標，進行同步施測，所得總分呈高度正相關，具備良好之效標關聯效度。透過測驗與問卷結果進行迴歸與中介分析指出，學生知覺教師素養導向教學能顯著正向預測其素養導向評量結果，且素養導向學習於此關係中具有完全中介效果。整體而言，本研究建構之評量工具有良好的信效度，能有效評量技高學生之數位科技素養，並揭示教師的素養導向教學需能促進學生的素養導向學習行為，才能對其評量結果產生正向影響。
abstract_en: This study aimed to develop competency-based assessment items for the "Digital Technology Curriculum" in the Commerce and Management Group of vocational high schools. It also sought to establish a reference framework and development process for the assessment, and to examine the quality of the items and related factors. Six teachers with experience in competency-based item writing were invited to construct the items, and reviewed by another three experts with similar backgrounds. A total of 19 competency-based test items were finalized. In addition, two self-constructed scales were developed to measure "Competency-Based Instruction" and "Competency-Based Learning". Purposive cluster sampling was employed, targeting schools with Department of Data Processing. Based on mock exam scores for the digital technology curriculum, schools were categorized into high, medium, and low performance groups. Two schools were selected from each group, and at least three classes were sampled from each school, resulting in 528 valid responses. Both the assessment and questionnaire were administered. The results showed that the overall difficulty level was moderate (P = .59), all items had a discrimination index above .39, and the KR-20 reliability coefficient was .77. The item-total correlations were all above .35, indicating good internal consistency and homogeneity. Furthermore, six high-discrimination items developed by the Business Education Association were used as external criteria for concurrent testing. The total scores were highly correlated, demonstrating good criterion-related validity. Regression and mediation analyses further revealed that students’ perceptions of competency-based instruction significantly predicted their assessment performance, with competency-based learning serving as a full mediator. Overall, the developed assessment tool demonstrated solid reliability and validity, effectively measuring students’ digital technology competencies. The findings highlight that competency-based teaching must foster students’ competency-based learning behaviors in order to positively influence assessment outcomes.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 生成式AI應用於國際專修部華語先修課程對僑外生學習動機、學業情緒與寫作學習成效之影響
title_en: The Impact of Generative AI in International Foundation Program Mandarin Preparatory Course on the Learning Motivation, Academic Emotions and Writing Performance of Overseas Chinese Students and International Students
keywords: 生成式AI、國際專修部、華語先修課程、學習動機、學業情緒、寫作學習成效
abstract_zh: 科技日益革新，生成式AI技術迅速發展，憑藉多模態生成能力，為語言教學提供創新支持。本研究旨在探討生成式AI應用於國際專修部華語先修課程對僑外生學習動機、學業情緒與寫作學習成效的影響，期望以科技輔助之教學模式增強學生的學習動機、正向學業情緒及寫作學習成效。本研究採用準實驗法，實驗為期八週，將研究對象（兩授課班級）分為實驗組與控制組。實驗組使用圖像式AI生成工具Microsoft Designer進行華語寫作與口說學習活動；控制組則沿用傳統課程寫作訓練與口語報告模式。數據收集採用Alamer（2022）第二語言自我決定理論量表、Bieleke等人（2021）簡化成就情緒問卷及國家華語測驗推動工作委員會（2023）華語文快篩寫作測驗標準化評分規準，測量學習動機、學業情緒和寫作學習成效，通過描述性分析及無母數分析檢驗教學模式的影響效果，並針對實驗組學生寫作文本進行質性觀察，探討生成式AI應用於華語課程寫作活動之成效。研究結果顯示，圖像式AI工具Microsoft Designer應用於華語寫作與口說學習活動，可提升僑外生之學習動機，增強正向學業情緒並抑制負向學業情緒。雖對總體寫作學習成效未見顯著提升，然在學生語用表現（如句式結構、文化聯想、詞彙擴充）等層面呈現明顯個體差異。
abstract_en: With the rapid advancement of science and technology, generative AI has emerged as a significant innovation in the field of education, offering multimodal capabilities which provide novel support for language acquisition. This study aims to investigate the impact of generative AI on the learning motivation, academic emotions and writing performance of overseas Chinese and International Students enrolled in International Foundation Program in a Mandarin preparatory course. By integrating a generative AI-based instructional model, the study seeks to enhance students' learning motivation, positive academic emotions, and overall writing performance.This research employs a quasi-experimental design over an eight-week period, dividing participants, two classes, into an experimental group and a control group. The experimental group utilized Microsoft Designer (an image-generative AI) to engage in Mandarin writing and speaking learning activities, while the control group followed regular short texts writing and oral presentation methods.To measure learning motivation, academic emotions, and writing performance, the study included Self-Determination Theory of Second Language Scale (Alamer, 2022), the Shortened Achievement Emotions Questionnaire (Bieleke et al., 2021), and the Standardized Scoring Rubric for the Rapid TOCFL Writing Proficiency Assessment (SCTOP, 2023). Descriptive and non-parametric statistical analyses are measured to evaluate the impact of the teaching methods. In addition, qualitative observations of the experimental group’s written texts are conducted to explore the effects of applying generative AI to Mandarin language instruction.The research results suggest that Microsoft Designer positively influences learning motivation, strengthening positive academic emotions and reducing negative academic emotions for students. However, no significant improvement was observed in overall writing performance. Nevertheless, individual differences in students’ pragmatic use of language were evident, particularly in areas such as sentence structure, cultural associations, and vocabulary expansion.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 主管領導風格、工作動機與學校計畫人員離職意願之研究
title_en: Examining the Relations among Leadership Styles, Work Motivation, and Turnover Intention Among School Project Staff
keywords: 轉換型領導、交易型領導、工作期望、工作價值、工作動機、離職意願
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在探討學校計畫人員對主管領導風格（轉換型與交易型）的知覺，如何透過工作動機中的三大構面：工作期望、工作價值與工作成本，間接影響其離職意願。研究採用問卷調查法，以某科技大學之計畫人員為對象，採立意抽樣方式，共回收97份有效問卷，研究方法包含描述性統計、Spearman等級相關分析與路徑分析，以驗證各變項間之關係。研究結果顯示，轉換型領導能顯著提升員工對工作價值的認同，並進而降低離職意願，顯現其透過提升情感連結與使命感，穩定人力的重要性。交易型領導則雖能降低工作成本感受，但未能間接降低離職意願，總而言之，僅「轉換型領導→工作價值→離職意願」此一中介路徑成立；建議主管應強化願景溝通、個別關懷與激勵行為，並由學校制度面提供職涯支持與友善工作環境，以提升人員認同與留任意願，穩定組織運作。
abstract_en: This study aims to explore how school project personnel’s perceptions of their supervisors’ leadership styles—specifically transformational and transactional leadership—indirectly influence their turnover intentions through three major components of work motivation: job expectancy, value, and cost. A questionnaire vocational was administered to the project personnel at a university. A total of 97 valid responses were collected. Research methods included descriptive statistics, Spearman’s rank correlation analysis, and path analysis to examine the relationships among the variables.The results indicate that transformational leadership significantly enhances employees’ task value, which in turn reduces their turnover intentions. This highlights the importance of emotional connection and sense of mission in retaining talent. While transactional leadership was found to reduce perceived job cost, it did not indirectly reduce turnover intention. Overall, only the mediating path of “transformational leadership → job value → turnover intention” was empirically supported. It is recommended that supervisors strengthen vision communication, individual consideration, and inspirational motivation. Additionally, institutions should provide career development support and create a supportive work environment to enhance employees job recognition and willingness to stay, thereby stabilizing organizational operations.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 私立技術型高中校長領導風格對學校組織創新 的影響：以董事會中介效果的角度探究
title_en: The Impact of Private Technical High School Principals' Leadership Styles on School Organizational Innovation: An Exploration from the Perspective of Board of Trustees' Mediating Effects
keywords: 校長領導風格、組織創新、董事會、私立技術型高中、教育領導力、治理
abstract_zh: 臺灣生育率持續下降，少子化與高齡化加劇，對教育體系帶來嚴峻挑戰。在此情勢下，學校需透過創新管理以維持競爭力與永續發展。校長的領導風格在推動組織創新上扮演關鍵角色，而董事會的支持亦為重要推力。本研究聚焦私立技術高中，探討校長領導風格對學校創新能力的影響，並分析董事會在其中的中介作用。本研究以臺灣北部 14 所私立技術高中為研究對象，共回收 475 份有效樣本，採用多元迴歸分析(Multiple Regression Analysis) 檢驗各變項間之關聯。本研究結果顯示：1. 校長的領導風格對董事會參與程度具有顯著正向影響，當校長展現積極、前瞻且具溝通力的領導特質時，能有效提升董事會的參與度與支持意願，進而強化治理結構並促進學校發展；2. 董事會對學校組織創新具有顯著正向影響，當其積極參與決策、提供資源與策略引導時，有助於推動創新教學、管理制度改革與整體競爭力的提升；3. 校長的領導風格對組織創新具有高度顯著的正向影響，具開放性與創新導向的領導者能激發教職員創意思維，形塑有利變革的組織文化，提升學校因應快速變遷的能力與永續發展潛力；4. 研究結果顯示，教師的性別、年齡、年資及職稱等人口統計變項，對其對校長領導風格的看法並無顯著影響。整體而言，教師無論背景差異，對於校長展現的同理心、激勵作為與創新引導等領導行為，皆抱持一致且正向的認知；5.年輕教師較能接受新科技與創新措施，資深教師則強調創新的可行性與穩定性，因此在推動創新過程中應兼顧不同背景教師的期待與需求，透過有效溝通與共識建立提升整體創新接受度；6. 董事會在校長領導風格與組織創新之間具有顯著的中介效果，顯示校長與董事會之協同合作是推動學校組織創新與永續發展的重要關鍵。總括而言，校長與董事會的合作對學校管理和創新發展具有深遠影響。只有當領導層和治理結構保持一致時，學校才能應對低出生率社會的挑戰，通過創新管理實現突破，並確保競爭優勢和可持續發展。
abstract_en: Taiwan’s declining fertility rate and increasingly aging population have generated critical structural challenges for the nation’s educational system. In response to these pressures, schools—particularly those in the private technical sector—must adopt innovative management strategies to sustain competitiveness and institutional viability. This study investigates the influence of principals’ leadership styles on organizational innovation within private technical high schools in northern Taiwan, with particular attention to the mediating role played by boards of trustees. Drawing upon a sample of 475 valid responses collected from 14 institutions, this research employed multiple regression analysis (MRA) to examine the structural relationships among key variables. The results of this study indicate: 1. The principal’s leadership style has a significant positive impact on the level of involvement of the board of trustees—when the principal demonstrates proactive, visionary leadership with strong communication skills, the board becomes more engaged and supportive, thereby strengthening the governance structure and promoting school development; 2. The board of trustees has a significant positive influence on school organizational innovation—when it actively participates in decision-making, provides resources, and offers strategic guidance, it helps drive innovation in teaching methods, management reforms, and overall school competitiveness; 3. The principal’s leadership style exerts a highly significant positive effect on organizational innovation—an open and innovation‑oriented leader can inspire creative thinking among staff, foster a culture that supports change, and enhance the school’s ability to adapt and sustain development in a rapidly evolving environment; 4. The research findings indicate that demographic variables such as gender, age, years of service, and job title do not have a significant impact on teachers’ perceptions of the principal’s leadership style. Overall, regardless of their backgrounds, teachers share a consistent and positive view of the principal’s display of empathy, motivational behavior, and innovation-oriented leadership; 5. Younger teachers are more open to new technologies and innovations, more experienced teachers focus on feasibility and stability, so innovation strategies should address diverse teacher needs through effective communication and consensus‑building; and 6. The board of trustees plays a significant mediating role between the principal’s leadership style and organizational innovation, highlighting that collaboration between the principal and the board is critical for promoting organizational innovation and sustainable development. The study concludes that alignment between leadership and governance structures constitutes a critical factor in promoting organizational adaptability and strategic responsiveness. A collaborative and strategically coherent relationship between school principals and boards of trustees is essential to driving innovation, navigating the constraints of demographic decline, and securing long-term institutional sustainability.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 遊戲化即時反饋系統對技術型高中學生資訊科技課程學習成效與學習情緒之影響
title_en: The Impact of Gamified Interactive Response System on Learning Performance and Learning Emotions for Senior Vocational High School Students in Information Technology Courses
keywords: 遊戲化、即時反饋系統、學習成效、學習情緒
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在探討遊戲化即時反饋系統對技術型高中學生資訊科技學習成效與學習情緒之影響，特別著重於自我競爭性遊戲元素（如小遊戲）的作用。隨著數位學習與108課綱實施的推動，遊戲化學習工具因趣味性與互動性，逐漸成為提升學生學習動機與專注力的重要教學工具。本研究採用準實驗設計，對象為技術型高中二年級兩班學生，一班為實驗組，使用包含小遊戲等遊戲化元素的即時反饋系統；另一班為對照組，則使用僅提供即時反饋功能的系統。兩組皆設計具自我競爭機制，旨在探討對學習成效與學習情緒的影響。研究於教學前進行學習成效前測與學習情緒量表的測量，教學五週後，再次進行相同工具之後測。最終依據學生前、後測成績與量表進行統計分析，探討遊戲化設計是否能顯著提升學習成效與促進正面情緒。經過統計分析後研究結論如下：一、經過五週教學實驗後，使用遊戲化即時反饋系統的實驗組，比使用非遊戲化即時反饋系統(僅有答題活動)的對照組，更能提升學生的學習成效。二、經過五週教學實驗後，使用遊戲化即時反饋系統的實驗組，比使用非遊戲化即時反饋系統(僅有答題活動)的對照組，更能提升學生的正面學習情緒（如自豪感與希望），降低負面情緒（如焦慮與倦怠）。
abstract_en: This study aims to explore the impact of a gamified Interactive Respond System on vocational high school students' learning performance and learning emotions, with a particular focus on the role of self-competitive game elements such as mini-games. In the context of digital learning and curriculum reform, gamified learning tools have emerged as effective methods for enhancing students’ motivation and concentration, owing to their interactivity and engagement. A quasi-experimental design was adopted, involving two second-year classes from a senior vocational high school. The experimental group used an Interactive Response System (IRS) with gamified elements (such as games), while the control group used a basic interactive response system without gamification. Both systems incorporated self-competition mechanisms to examine their specific effects on learning performance and emotional response. Before the instructional intervention, both groups completed a pre-test on learning performance and a learning emotion scale. After five weeks of instruction, they took a post-test and completed the same questionnaire again. By analyzing pre- and post-test scores and emotional changes, the study compared differences between the two groups. After statistics analysis, the research conclusions are as follows:1.The experimental group using a gamified interactive response system can more effectively improve students' learning performance than the control group using the non-gamified instant feedback system2.The experimental group using the gamified interactive response system can more effectively improve students' positive learning emotions (such as pride and hope) and reduce negative emotions (such as anxiety and burnout) than the control group using the non-gamified instant feedback system.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 國軍人員基本心理需求、工作動機、職業倦怠與超越奉獻的關係
title_en: The relatations Between Basic Psychological needs, Work motivation, Job burnout, and Career calling Among Military Personnel in Taiwan
keywords: 國軍人員、基本心理需求、工作動機、職業倦怠、超越奉獻
abstract_zh: 隨著國際局勢的變遷，臺灣國軍在國家安全中的地位變得愈來越重要，而臺灣獨特的地緣政治環境要求國軍具備高度的戰備能力和靈活的應變策略，這對國軍人員的心理素質與工作投入提出更高的要求。基於此背景，本研究針對現職志願役國軍人員進行問卷調查，並運用路徑分析方法進行資料分析，探討其基本心理需求與工作動機如何影響職業倦怠及超越奉獻行為。研究結果顯示，自主性對自主動機具有顯著正向影響；相對地，勝任感與關係感對自主動機的影響則未達顯著水準。在受抑制動機方面，自主性與其呈顯著負向關係，然而勝任感與關係感對受抑制動機的影響亦未具顯著影響。且進一步指出，自主動機與職業倦怠之間呈現顯著負向關係，顯示自主動機有助於減緩職業倦怠的產生；但受抑制動機對職業倦怠的影響未達顯著。關於超越奉獻，自主動機對其具有顯著正向影響，而受抑制動機則無顯著影響。此外，研究亦驗證基本心理需求經由工作動機對職業倦怠與超越奉獻的間接影響，結果發現，自主性透過自主動機對上述兩者均產生顯著間接效果；相對地，透過受抑制動機的間接效果則不顯著。總結而言，自主性在提升國軍人員自主動機方面具有關鍵作用，並對職業倦怠與超越奉獻產生顯著的影響。具體來言，自主動機能有效減緩職業倦怠的產生，同時提升國軍人員在超越奉獻方面的投入。基於此，未來國軍單位應更加重視提升自主性，以提升國軍人員的自主動機，減少職業倦怠，並增強國軍人員在超越奉獻方面的積極度，此研究結果可為國軍的管理實務提供有價值的參考。
abstract_en: With the changes in the international situation, the position of Taiwan's military in national security has become increasingly important. The unique geopolitical environment of Taiwan necessitates that the military maintain a high level of combat readiness and adaptable response strategies, placing higher demands on the psychological qualities and work engagement of military personnel. Against this backdrop, this study conducted a survey of current volunteer military personnel and utilized path analysis methods for data analysis to explore how their basic psychological needs and work motivation affect occupational burnout and extra-role behaviors. The results indicated that autonomy has a significant positive impact on intrinsic motivation; conversely, competence and relatedness did not reach significant levels in their impact on intrinsic motivation. Regarding controlled motivation, autonomy showed a significant negative relationship; however, the influences of competence and relatedness on controlled motivation were not significant. Furthermore, it was pointed out that intrinsic motivation has a significant negative relationship with occupational burnout, indicating that intrinsic motivation helps alleviate the occurrence of burnout, while controlled motivation’s impact on burnout was not significant. In terms of extra-role behavior, intrinsic motivation had a significant positive impact, while controlled motivation did not show significant effects. Additionally, the study also verified the indirect effects of basic psychological needs on occupational burnout and extra-role behaviors through work motivation, finding that autonomy has significant indirect effects through intrinsic motivation on both aspects; conversely, the indirect effects through controlled motivation were not significant. In summary, autonomy plays a key role in enhancing the intrinsic motivation of military personnel and has significant positive effects on occupational burnout and extra-role behaviors. Specifically, intrinsic motivation effectively alleviates the occurrence of burnout while increasing the involvement of military personnel in extra-role behaviors. Based on this, future military units should place greater emphasis on enhancing autonomy to boost intrinsic motivation, reduce occupational burnout, and enhance military personnel's active engagement in extra-role behaviors. The findings of this study can provide valuable references for the management practices of the military.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 雙北地區幼兒保育科多媒材創作實務課程師生互動與學習滿意度之研究
title_en: A Study on Learning Satisfaction in Multi-Material Creation Practical Courses in the Department of Early Childhood Care in Taipei and New Taipei City
keywords: 幼兒保育科、多媒材創作實務課程、師生互動、學習滿意度
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在探討雙北地區技術型高中多媒材創作實務課程中，師生互動與學生學習滿意度之關聯，並進一步分析不同背景變項對師生互動與學習滿意度之影響，以及不同師生互動模式對學生學習滿意度的差異情形。    本研究採用問卷調查法，對象為113 學年度（2024-2025 年）就讀於雙北地區技術型高中多媒材創作實務課程之學生。研究工具為自編之「雙北地區技術型高中多媒材創作實務課程師生互動與學生學習滿意度調查問卷」，共發放問卷500份，回收有效問卷401份，有效回收率為80.20%。所得資料以描述性統計、獨立樣本t檢定、單因子變異數分析及事後比較法進行統計分析，研究結論如下：一、  雙北地區幼兒保育科學生之「師生互動」在「被動遵從型」構面上，女學生感受顯著高於男學生。二、  雙北地區幼兒保育科學生「師生互動」之「自主探索型」與「引導控制型」構面在年級間呈現顯著差異。1.高年級學生在「自主探索型」構面中之感受顯著高於低年級學生。2.中高年級學生於「被動遵從型」互動中之感受顯著高於低年級學生。3.整體「師生互動」之感受隨年級遞增而顯著提升，三年級學生感受最高。三、  雙北地區幼兒保育科學生「師生互動」於學校地區間具顯著差異，尤以「合作創作型」、「引導控制型」與「被動遵從型」構面為主。1.新北市學生於「合作創作型」互動構面之感受顯著高於臺北市學生。2.新北市學生於「引導控制型」互動構面中之適應程度顯著高於臺北市學生。3.臺北市學生於「被動遵從型」互動構面得分顯著高於新北市學生。四、  不同師生互動類型對學生學習滿意度之影響具顯著差異，尤以「學習動機」、「學習表現」及「整體滿意度」構面最為明顯。1.採「自主探索型」互動之學生，在學習動機與整體滿意度構面皆表現最高。2.採「被動遵從型」互動之學生，在學習表現構面中表現最高。    本研究結果可提供教育現場作為課程設計與互動策略調整之參考，建議教師根據學生年級與互動需求，彈性調整教學風格與互動方式，以提升學生學習參與度與整體滿意度。未來研究亦可納入教師觀點與質性資料，深入探討互動歷程與教學成效間之關聯，拓展本研究之深度與廣度。
abstract_en: This study aims to explore the relationship between teacher-student interaction and students' learning satisfaction in multimedia creative practical courses in vocational high schools in the Taipei and New Taipei areas. Furthermore, it analyzes the impact of different background variables on teacher-student interaction and learning satisfaction, as well as the differences in students' learning satisfaction across different teacher-student interaction patterns.   A questionnaire survey was adopted, targeting students enrolled in the multimedia creative practical courses in the Taipei and New Taipei areas during the 113th Academic Year (2024-2025). The research instrument was the self-developed “Questionnaire on Teacher-Student Interaction and Learning Satisfaction in Multimedia Creative Practical Courses in Vocational High Schools in the Taipei and New Taipei Areas.” A total of 500 questionnaires were distributed, and 401 valid responses were collected, achieving an effective response rate of 80.20%. The collected data were analyzed using descriptive statistics, independent samples t-test, one-way ANOVA, and post hoc comparisons. The main findings are as follows:1.  In the "Passive Compliance" dimension of teacher-student interaction, female students reported significantly higher perceptions than male students.2.  Significant differences were found across grade levels in the "Self-Exploration" and "Guided Control" dimensions of teacher-student interaction:(1) Senior-grade students showed significantly higher perceptions in the "Self-Exploration" dimension compared to lower-grade students.(2) Middle- and senior-grade students exhibited significantly higher perceptions in the "Passive Compliance" dimension than lower-grade students.(3) Overall perceptions of teacher-student interaction increased significantly with grade level, with third-year students showing the highest perceptions.3.  Significant differences in teacher-student interaction were observed between school districts, especially in the "Collaborative Creation," "Guided Control," and "Passive Compliance" dimensions:(1) New Taipei City students reported significantly higher perceptions in the "Collaborative Creation" dimension compared to Taipei City students.(2) New Taipei City students showed significantly higher adaptation in the "Guided Control" dimension.(3) Taipei City students scored significantly higher in the "Passive Compliance" dimension than New Taipei City students.4.  Different teacher-student interaction styles had significant impacts on students' learning satisfaction, particularly in the "Learning Motivation," "Learning Performance," and "Overall Satisfaction" dimensions:(1) Students in "Self-Exploration" interactions showed the highest learning motivation and overall satisfaction.(2) Students in "Passive Compliance" interactions showed the most outstanding performance in the "Learning Performance" dimension.   The results of this study can serve as a reference for curriculum design and teaching interaction strategies. It is recommended that teachers adjust their instructional styles and interaction methods flexibly according to students' grade levels and interaction needs to enhance student engagement and overall learning satisfaction. Future research may incorporate teachers’ perspectives and qualitative data to further explore the dynamics of classroom interaction and instructional effectiveness, thereby enriching the depth and scope of the current findings.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 臺北市公立國中教師工作壓力對職業倦怠與退休態度之研究
title_en: A Study of Job Stress on Occupational Burnout and Retirement Attitude among Public Junior High School Teachers in Taipei City
keywords: 工作壓力、職業倦怠、退休態度、國中教師
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在探討臺北市公立國中教師在工作壓力、職業倦怠與退休態度三者間之關聯，並進一步分析不同背景變項（性別、年齡、教學年資、擔任職務、學校規模）對工作壓力感受及其對職業倦怠與退休態度之影響。本研究採用自編問卷，對113學年度(2024 – 2025)臺北市445位公立國中教師進行調查，回收率達85.58 %。研究運用描述統計、t檢定、單因子變異數分析與事後檢定等量化方法進行分析，結果如下：一、  臺北市公立國中教師「工作壓力」之整體及「學生問題」、「工作負荷」構面，會因教師「性別」不同而有顯著差異。1.  在「工作壓力」之「學生問題」構面中，女教師顯著高於男教師。2.  在「工作壓力」之「工作負荷」構面中，女教師顯著高於男教師。3.  在「工作壓力」之整體，女教師顯著高於男教師。二、臺北市公立國中教師「工作壓力」之整體及「行政支持」、「工作負荷」構面，會因教師「年齡」不同而有顯著差異。1.  在「工作壓力」之「行政支持」構面中，41~50歲顯著高於30歲以下。2.  在「工作壓力」之「工作負荷」構面中，41~50歲與51歲以上顯著高於30歲以下。3.  在「工作壓力」之整體達顯著差異，但經事後比較，組間無顯著差異。三、臺北市公立國中教師「工作壓力」之「行政支持」與「工作負荷」構面，會因「教學年資」不同而有顯著差異。1.  在「工作壓力」之「行政支持」構面中，教學年資11~25年顯著高於5年以下。2.  在「工作壓力」之「工作負荷」構面達顯著差異，但經事後比較，組間無顯著差異。四、臺北市公立國中教師「工作壓力」之整體及「學生問題」、「行政支持」、「工作負荷」與「專業知能」構面，會因「擔任職務」不同而有顯著差異。1.  在「工作壓力」之「學生問題」構面中，教師兼導師顯著高於教師兼行政。2.  在「工作壓力」之「行政支持」構面中，教師兼導師與教師兼行政顯著高於專任教師。3.  在「工作壓力」之「工作負荷」構面中，教師兼導師顯著高於專任教師與教師兼行政。4.  在「工作壓力」之「專業知能」構面中，教師兼導師顯著高於教師兼行政。5.  在「工作壓力」之整體，教師兼導師顯著高於專任教師與教師兼行政。五、臺北市公立國中教師「職業倦怠」之整體及「情緒耗竭」、「去人性化」、「個人成就感低落」構面，會因「工作壓力」之「學生問題」、「專業知能」與「政策變革」構面，呈現顯著差異。1.  在「職業倦怠」之「情緒耗竭」構面中，「學生問題」顯著高於「專業知能」與「政策變革」。2.  在「職業倦怠」之「去人性化」構面中，「學生問題」顯著高於「政策變革」。3.  在「職業倦怠」之「個人成就感低落」構面中，「學生問題」顯著高於「專業知能」。4.  在「職業倦怠」之整體，「學生問題」顯著高於「專業知能」與「政策變革」。六、臺北市公立國中教師「退休態度」之「情感層面」，在「工作壓力」之「政策變革」顯著高於「行政支持」與「學生問題」。本研究建議教育主管機關與學校行政單位應針對壓力來源提供制度性支持，設置教師心理與教學輔導機制，並針對政策變革加強溝通與協商平台，以減緩職業倦怠與不確定性所導致之提早退休意圖，協助教師穩定教學、專業發展與職涯規劃。
abstract_en: This study aimed to explore the relationships among job stress, occupational burnout, and retirement attitude of public junior high school teachers in Taipei City. Furthermore, it analyzed how different background variables (such as gender, age, teaching seniority, job title, and school size) affect teachers' perceptions of job stress and its impact on burnout and retirement attitudes. A self-developed questionnaire was used to survey 445 public junior high school teachers in Taipei City during the 2024–2025 academic year, achieving a response rate of 85.58%. Descriptive statistics, t-tests, one-way ANOVA, and post hoc comparisons were used for quantitative analysis. The results are as follows:1.  Significant gender differences were found in overall job stress and in the "Student Issues" and "Workload" dimensions.(1) In the "Student Issues" dimension, female teachers scored significantly higher than male teachers.(2) In the "Workload" dimension, female teachers scored significantly higher than male teachers.(3) In overall job stress, female teachers scored significantly higher than male teachers.2.  Significant age differences were found in overall job stress and in the "Administrative Support" and "Workload" dimensions.(1) In the "Administrative Support" dimension, teachers aged 41–50 scored significantly higher than those under 30.(2) In the "Workload" dimension, teachers aged 41–50 and those over 51 scored significantly higher than those under 30.(3) Although overall job stress showed significant differences, no significant differences were found in post hoc comparisons.3.  Teaching seniority had significant effects on the "Administrative Support" and "Workload" dimensions.(1) In the "Administrative Support" dimension, teachers with 11–25 years of experience scored significantly higher than those with less than 5 years.(2) The "Workload" dimension showed significant differences, but no significant group differences were found in post hoc comparisons.4.  Job position differences were significant in overall job stress and in the dimensions of "Student Issues," "Administrative Support," "Workload," and "Professional Competence."(1) In the "Student Issues" dimension, homeroom teachers scored significantly higher than teachers with administrative duties.(2) In the "Administrative Support" dimension, homeroom and administrative teachers scored significantly higher than subject teachers.(3) In the "Workload" dimension, homeroom teachers scored significantly higher than both subject and administrative teachers.(4) In the "Professional Competence" dimension, homeroom teachers scored significantly higher than administrative teachers.(5) In overall job stress, homeroom teachers scored significantly higher than subject and administrative teachers.5.  The overall level of “occupational burnout” among public junior high school teachers in Taipei City, as well as the dimensions of” emotional exhaustion”, “depersonalization”, and “reduced personal accomplishment”, show significant differences based on the dimensions of “student-related issues”, “professional knowledge”, and “policy changes” within their “job stress”.(1) In the "Emotional Exhaustion" dimension, "Student Issues" scored significantly higher than "Professional Competence" and "Policy Change."(2) In the "Depersonalization" dimension, "Student Issues" scored significantly higher than "Policy Change."(3) In the "Reduced Personal Accomplishment" dimension, "Student Issues" scored significantly higher than "Professional Competence."(4) Overall occupational burnout was significantly higher in "Student Issues" than in "Professional Competence" and "Policy Change."6.  In the emotional dimension of retirement attitude, the "Policy Change" stress dimension scored significantly higher than "Administrative Support" and "Student Issues."    This study recommends that educational authorities and school administrators provide systematic support targeting sources of stress. Psychological and instructional counseling mechanisms should be established. Moreover, communication and negotiation platforms should be strengthened regarding policy changes to alleviate occupational burnout and reduce uncertainty-induced early retirement intentions, thereby supporting teachers' professional development and career planning.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 探討個人背景變項與工作滿意度之關係:基於全國性資料的研究
title_en: Examining the Relations Between Personal Characteristics and Job Satisfaction: A National Study
keywords: 工作滿意度、員工行為模型、個人背景變項、重要性分析、結構方程模型、臺灣勞工、勞工生活及就業狀況調查、人力資源管理
abstract_zh: 本研究探討臺灣勞工工作滿意度的關鍵影響因素，並驗證Werner和DeSimone員工行為模型在臺灣的適用性。研究運用中央研究院調查研究專題中心 (SRDA) 資料，採用重要性分析方法來精確判斷變數重要性，克服傳統迴歸分析的侷限。研究動機源於企業對員工工作投入與滿意度的重視，高員工滿意度與企業成功密切相關。Werner 和 DeSimone 模型整合了個人背景變項、組織內部及外部環境因素。本研究聚焦於個人背景變項，包括性別、年齡、教育程度、婚姻狀況、工作收入及職業類別等，運用結構方程模型 (SEM) 和重要性分析，量化各因素對工作滿意度的貢獻程度。研究採用「2023年勞工生活及就業狀況調查」資料，有效樣本4,095份，並使用 SRDA 提供的權數進行分析並考量巢狀式數據結構，以推估臺灣整體勞工母體。工作滿意度定義為個人對工作及相關情境的整體感受與態度評價。研究結果顯示，職業類別和年齡是影響臺灣勞工工作滿意度的兩大主因。重要性支配分析表明這兩項因素的解釋力相對較高。不同職業類別之間的工作滿意度存在顯著差異，如基層技術工的工作滿意度低於主管人員。年齡與工作滿意度呈U型分布，年輕及年長員工的工作滿意度較高，中年員工較低。工作收入和婚姻狀況影響次之，而教育程度和性別影響最微弱。本研究建議企業可針對特定職業類別實施差異化工作滿意度提升策略，建立年齡導向的員工關懷與發展機制。人力資源管理可更聚焦於職業匹配和員工職涯階段，而非過度依賴性別或教育背景。未來研究可納入外部環境因素進行更全面分析，並開發更符合臺灣本土脈絡的員工行為模型。
abstract_en: This study examines key factors influencing job satisfaction among Taiwan's workforce and validates Werner and DeSimone’s employee behavior model in Taiwan. The research uses data from Academia Sinica’s Survey Research Data Archive (SRDA) and employs dominance analysis methods to determine relative importance of demographic variables, overcoming limitations of traditional regression analysis.The study analyzes personal background variables (gender, age, education, marital status, income, and occupation) using structural equation modeling and dominance analysis. Data from the 2023 Labor Life and Employment Status Survey with 4,095 valid samples was weighted to represent Taiwan’s overall labor population, with job satisfaction defined as an individual’s overall feelings toward their work and related circumstances.Results indicate that occupation type and age are the primary factors influencing job satisfaction. Dominance analysis shows these factors have higher explanatory power, with significant satisfaction differences among occupations and a U-shaped age distribution where younger and older employees report higher satisfaction than middle-aged workers. Work income and marital status have a secondary influence, while education level and gender play minimal roles.The study recommends that businesses implement differentiated job satisfaction strategies targeting specific occupational categories and establish age-oriented employee development mechanisms, focusing on occupational matching and career stages rather than educational background or gender. Future research should incorporate external factors and develop employee behavior models suited to Taiwan’s context.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 新北市市區公車駕駛人員工作職能及訓練需求之研究
title_en: A Study on the Occupational Competency and Training Needs of Bus Drivers in New Taipei City.
keywords: IPA、市區公車、駕駛人員、工作職能、職能內涵、職能基準、訓練需求
abstract_zh: 新北市市區公車已累計開通392條公車路線，為全國公車路線數最多的縣市，公車駕駛人員為該路線業者服務民眾的第一線，更是守護乘客及用路人安全的重要角色。本研究為探討市區公車駕駛人員應具備職能的重要程度和駕駛自評已具備職能的現況，分析職能缺口和教育訓練的優先順序；採用問卷調查法，進行量化研究。本研究問卷以美國O*NET職業資訊網路，「公車司機，交通與城際」職業項目之職能內涵作為問卷初稿的基礎進行編製，透過文獻整理及爬梳後，邀請專家學者逐條審查建立效度，得出場站管理者與駕駛人員之正式問卷。研究對象以新北市政府交通局管轄之15家市區客運業者之在職主管203人及駕駛人員2,441人進行問卷調查。主管問卷共回收119份，駕駛人自評問卷共回收1,440份。統計分析採用描述性統計、柯-史單一樣本適合度檢定、獨立樣本t檢定、單因子變異數分析及重要-表現分析法（IPA），分析結果：1.主管認為駕駛人員在知識職能內涵為：「身心狀態自我檢測項目」、「安全及防禦性駕駛相關知識」；技能內涵為「衝突處理及彈性應變」、「駕駛空間感知、反應及協調」；態度內涵為「自我管理」之重要性較高；2.新北市市區公車駕駛人員應加強訓練的職能內涵為「交通相關法律、法規」、「衝突處理及彈性應變」以及「壓力容忍」。另依據上述結論分別針對公車駕駛人員、公車營運業者、市區公車主管機關及後續研究者等四個方面提供相關建議，本研究工具亦可作為市區公車客運業者定期評估駕駛人員之訓練需求，據以調整培訓計畫，縮短職能落差，強化市區公車駕駛的職能內涵，進而提升服務品質及乘客安全。
abstract_en: New Taipei City has established a total of 392 urban bus routes, the highest among all counties and cities in Taiwan. Urban bus drivers serve as front line personnel for transportation operators, playing a critical role in safeguarding the safety of passengers and other road users. This study aims to investigate the importance of the competencies that urban bus drivers should possess and evaluate the current self-assessed competency levels of drivers, thereby identifying gaps between expected and actual competencies and prioritizing training needs. A quantitative research approach was adopted using a structured questionnaire developed based on the “Bus Drivers, Transit and Intercity” occupational framework from the U.S. O*NET system. After a comprehensive literature review, domain experts validated each item to ensure content validity, and two formal versions of the questionnaire were finalized—one for depot supervisors and one for drivers. The research targeted 15 urban bus operators under the jurisdiction of the New Taipei City Government Transportation Department, with responses collected from 203 supervisors and 2,441 drivers. In total, 119 supervisor questionnaires and 1,440 driver self-assessments were returned. Data analysis included descriptive statistics, Kolmogorov–Smirnov goodness-of-fit tests, independent sample t-tests, one-way ANOVA, and Importance–Performance Analysis (IPA). The results showed that supervisors identified the most important competencies as K10 “self-assessment of physical and mental condition,” K03 “defensive driving knowledge,” S10 “conflict handling and adaptability,” S03 “spatial perception and coordination,” and A01 “self-management.” Training priorities were identified in K01 “traffic laws and regulations,” S10 “conflict handling and adaptability,” and A02 “stress tolerance.” Based on these findings, the study provides recommendations for four stakeholder groups: urban bus drivers, bus operating companies, government regulatory agencies, and future researchers. The research instrument developed in this study may also serve as a tool for urban bus operators to regularly assess training needs, revise training programs accordingly, reduce competency gaps, and ultimately enhance service quality and passenger safety.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 以生成式人工智慧結合任務導向語言教學法提升大學生英語口說溝通能力之研究
title_en: Enhancing College Students’ English Oral Communicative Competence: Integrating Generative AI with Task-Based Language Teaching
keywords: 生成式人工智慧、任務導向語言教學、英語口語溝通能力、英語溝通自我效能、英語溝通意願
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在探討任務導向語言教學結合生成式人工智慧是否較同儕互動模式更能有效提升臺灣非英語主修大學生的英語口說表現、溝通自我效能與溝通意願。本研究採準實驗設計，以某科技大學83位大一學生為對象，分為實驗組與控制組。實驗組使用生成式人工智慧工具進行為期六週的口語任務練習，控制組則採用傳統同儕互動方式進行課程。研究工具包括英語口說能力前後測、溝通自我效能與溝通意願量表、實驗組與人工智慧互動的對話紀錄，以及 20 位學生的半結構式訪談。資料分析採用量化與質性並行的方法，包括描述性統計、成對樣本 t 檢定、共變數分析、非參數統計、訪談資料的歸納式編碼分析與認知網絡分析。研究結果顯示，在控制前測成績後，實驗組在內容表達、發音與流暢度三項指標的後測表現皆顯著優於控制組，尤其在任務較具挑戰性時，生成式人工智慧對流暢度的促進效果更為明顯。在溝通自我效能與溝通意願的後測表現上，雖然兩組之間未呈現顯著差異，但實驗組於組內比較中在聽力自信與形式導向的溝通意願方面皆有顯著進步。質性資料進一步指出，控制組學生重視來自同儕的社會支持，有助於提升表達信心；實驗組學生則肯定人工智慧提供的低焦慮練習環境，有利於語言輸出與修正。認知網絡分析結果顯示，不同英語程度的學生在與人工智慧互動時展現出相似的認知參與模式，而生成式人工智慧則會根據學生的互動程度調整其回饋策略。總結而言，生成式人工智慧在本研究中展現出作為語言學習鷹架的潛力，不僅能協助學習者提升特定口說能力，亦具備依據學習者表現提供適性支持的能力。本研究亦提醒教學設計者，應關注任務複雜度、學習者的情意面向，以及生成式人工智慧與同儕互動在促進語言參與及內化上的互補角色。最後，研究針對未來在任務導向語言教學中整合生成式人工智慧的實務應用提出建議。
abstract_en: This study explores whether task-based language teaching (TBLT) integrated with generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) is more effective than peer interaction-based TBLT in enhancing English oral performance, communicative self-efficacy (CSE), and willingness to communicate (WTC) among non-English major university students in Taiwan. A quasi-experimental pretest-posttest design was implemented with 83 first-year students from a university of technology. Two intact classes were designated as either the experimental group (EG, n = 45), which engaged with the GenAI tool Chat Everywhere, or the control group (CG, n = 38), which participated in peer-based oral tasks for six weeks.Data collection included oral pre- and posttests, CSE and WTC questionnaires (based on adapted CSEQ and WTCS), conversation logs with GenAI from the EG, and semi-structured interviews with 20 participants. A mixed-methods approach was employed, including descriptive statistics, paired-samples t-tests, ANCOVA, Mann-Whitney U tests, inductive coding, and Epistemic Network Analysis (ENA).After controlling for pretest scores, the EG significantly outperformed the CG in content, pronunciation, and fluency, with GenAI’s advantage particularly evident in more cognitively demanding tasks. Although no significant between-group differences emerged in posttest CSE or WTC, within-group analysis revealed that EG students showed notable gains in listening self-efficacy and form-focused WTC. Interview data further highlighted that CG students valued the emotional support provided by peers, while EG students appreciated the low-pressure environment afforded by GenAI, which helped them practice and revise their spoken output.ENA results revealed that students across proficiency levels exhibited similar patterns of cognitive engagement during GenAI interaction. However, GenAI demonstrated adaptive scaffolding behaviors, shifting from elaborative and dialogic responses with more engaged learners to more directive strategies.These findings suggest that GenAI has the potential to serve as an effective scaffolding tool to develop specific oral communication skills and providing personalized support. The study also emphasizes the need to consider task complexity, learner affect, and the complementary roles of GenAI- and peer interaction in instructional design. Practical implications are discussed to support the development of EFL learners’ oral communicative competence.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: Kagan結構式合作學習應用於技術型高中機械群專題實作課程對學生成就目標與團隊合作技能影響之研究
title_en: The Impact of Kagan’s Cooperative Learning Structure on Student’s Achievement Goal and Teamwork Skills in Vocational High School of Mechanical Project Practice Courses
keywords: 合作學習、Kagan結構式合作學習、成就目標、團隊合作技能、專題實作
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在探討運用Kagan結構式合作學習於技術型高中專題實作課程對學生成就目標與團隊合作技能之影響。本研究採用準實驗研究法，研究對象為新竹市某技術型高中機械科三年級兩班共89位學生，以班級為單位分成實驗組46人與控制組43人。實驗組以Kagan結構式合作學習進行專題實作課程教學，控制組則為傳統講述式教學法，進行八週、每週二節的專題實作教學實驗。本研究結果如下：一、實驗組學生在運用Kagan結構式合作學習教學後，在成就目標「精熟迴避目標」構面有顯著提升，控制組在成就目標四個構面上均無顯著差異；在控制成就目標前測分數的影響後，實驗組與控制組在成就目標四個構面均無顯著差異，顯示運用Kagan結構式合作學習教學在學生成就目標影響效果不顯著。二、實驗組學生在運用Kagan結構式合作學習教學後，在團隊合作技能「尋找和分享資訊」、「批判性和創造性思考」和「與隊友相處融洽」構面有顯著提升，控制組僅在「與隊友相處融洽」構面有顯著提升；在控制團隊合作技能前測分數的影響後，運用Kagan結構式合作學習教學在學生團隊合作技能的「批判性和創造性思考」表現優於傳統講述教學法。
abstract_en: This study aims to investigate the effects of implementing Kagan structured cooperative learning in vocational high school project practice courses on students' achievement goals and teamwork skills. A quasi-experimental research design was adopted, with the participants consisting of 89 third-year mechanical engineering students from a vocational high school in New Taipei City, divided into an experimental group (n=46) and a control group (n=43) based on class assignment. The experimental group received Kagan structured cooperative learning, while the control group was taught using traditional lecture-based instruction. The experiment lasted for eight weeks, with two sessions per week.The results of this study are as follows:After receiving instruction using Kagan structured cooperative learning, students in the experimental group showed a significant improvement in the "mastery-avoidance goal" dimension of achievement goals. However, no significant differences were observed across the four dimensions of achievement goals in the control group. After controlling for the pre-test scores of achievement goals, no significant differences were found between the experimental and control groups in all four dimensions, indicating that the effect of Kagan structured cooperative learning on students' achievement goals was not significant.In terms of teamwork skills, students in the experimental group exhibited significant improvements in the dimensions of "seeking and sharing information," "critical and creative thinking," and "getting along with teammates." In contrast, the control group only showed significant improvement in "getting along with teammates." After controlling for the pre-test scores of teamwork skills, the results indicated that Kagan structured cooperative learning was more effective than traditional lecture-based instruction in enhancing students' "critical and creative thinking" within teamwork skills.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 智慧手錶購買動機—科技準備度與資訊遺漏恐懼如何形塑消費者決策
title_en: Smartwatch Purchase Motivation: How Technology Readiness (TR) and Fear of Missing Out (FoMO) Shape Consumer Decisions
keywords: 智慧科技、智慧手錶、購買動機、消費者決策、科技準備度、資訊遺漏恐懼、跨文化分析
abstract_zh: 智慧科技的發展深刻改變消費模式與生活方式。智慧手錶作為智慧穿戴裝置的標誌性產品，其市場增長不僅反映消費者對健康管理、美學嚮往與環保永續的需求，更突顯個人價值觀與科技創新的互動與融合。本研究以科技準備度（Technology Readiness, TR）與資訊遺漏恐懼（Fear of Missing Out, FoMO）為核心理論基礎，探討這兩大心理構面如何形塑智慧手錶消費者的購買動機，並進一步分析購買動機的多元構面，包括價格投資、功能設計、時尚品味、身份表徵、價值觀與環保永續等因素。本研究透過中英文雙語問卷，廣泛蒐集來自亞洲、歐洲與北美洲等不同文化背景的消費者數據，共計回收666 份有效問卷，涵蓋不同年齡層與不同使用經驗的智慧手錶消費者。研究結果顯示，科技準備度的四大構面（樂觀、創新、不適感與不安全感）與資訊遺漏恐懼皆顯著影響購買動機，並在不同文化背景下展現有趣的變異。此外，購買動機的多元構面分析亦發現，消費者對智慧手錶的價值評估已超越價格與功能，且延伸至更深層次的文化蘊蓄與心理需求，例如環保意識、時尚追求與身份認同，突顯智慧手錶作為個人價值展現的象徵性意涵。本研究採取跨文化分析（Cross-Cultural Analysis）視角，深入探討科技準備度與資訊遺漏恐懼在智慧手錶市場定位與行銷佈局中的關鍵作用，填補智慧科技領域消費者購買動機的研究空白，並為智慧手錶產業提供嚴謹的學術觀點與實務建議。研究結果不僅有助於品牌方精準規劃市場細分策略，亦能為行銷創新與競爭優勢提供實證支撐，推動智慧科技的全球應用，開拓永續創新格局。在這個瞬息萬變的科技時代，智慧手錶的購買動機已超越單純的消費行為，演變為持續發展的動態歷程，深受個人價值觀與創新趨勢的交互影響。隨著科技與人類互動的深度交織，智慧科技正重新定義全球消費選擇與科技轉型，為科技與人文共融的未來解鎖無限可能。關鍵詞：智慧科技、智慧手錶、購買動機、消費者決策、科技準備度、資訊遺漏恐懼、跨文化分析
abstract_en: The evolution of Smart Technology has profoundly influenced consumer behavior and lifestyle preferences. As a hallmark product of the Wearable Tech industry, smartwatches not only fulfill consumer needs for health management, aesthetic appeal, and sustainability but also reflect the growing interplay between personal values and technological innovation. Grounded in the theoretical frameworks of Technology Readiness (TR) and Fear of Missing Out (FoMO), this study examines how these psychological constructs shape consumer purchase motivation for smartwatches. Furthermore, it explores diverse motivational dimensions, including perceived investment value, functional design, fashion appeal, symbolic significance, personal values, and environmental sustainability.By conducting a bilingual survey, this study collected data from consumers across Asia, Europe, and North America, obtaining 666 valid responses spanning diverse age groups and user experiences. The findings reveal that various dimensions of Technology Readiness (Optimism, Innovativeness, Discomfort, and Insecurity) and FoMO significantly influence purchase motivation, exhibiting intriguing variations across cultural contexts. Additionally, the analysis of motivational dimensions underscores that consumer evaluations of smartwatches extend beyond price and functionality, incorporating cultural depth and psychological drivers—ranging from environmental consciousness and fashion aspirations to identity expression.Adopting a cross-cultural analysis, this study delivers a comprehensive examination of how Technology Readiness and Fear of Missing Out shape smartwatch market positioning and marketing strategies. It addresses critical research gaps in consumer purchase motivation within the Smart Technology domain while offering rigorous academic insights and practical recommendations for the smartwatch industry. The findings not only aid brands in refining market segmentation strategies but also provide empirical support for marketing innovation and competitive differentiation, fostering the global adoption of Smart Technology and paving the way for sustainable innovation.In this era of rapid technological advancement, smartwatch purchase motivation has evolved beyond mere consumer behavior into a dynamic and continuously evolving process, shaped by personal values and emerging technological trends. As technology and human interaction deepen, Smart Technology is redefining global consumer choices and accelerating technological transformation, unlocking unprecedented possibilities at the intersection of technology and human experience.Keywords: Smart Technology, Smartwatch, Purchase Motivation, Consumer Decisions, Technology Readiness, Fear of Missing Out, Cross-Cultural Analysis

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 從自我決定理論的觀點來探討社會工作者個人-環境適配、基本心理需求與工作投入之相關性研究
title_en: Investigating the Relations between Social Workers' Person-Environment Fit, Basic Psychological Needs, and Work Engagement from a Self-Determination Theory Perspective
keywords: 社會工作者、個人-環境適配、基本心理需求、工作投入
abstract_zh: 社會工作者運用其專業知識推動社會支持系統，其帶著同理心去理解、傾聽服務對象，提供服務對象心理支持和實際幫助，協助服務對象重拾信心、走出困境。此以關懷與心理支持為核心的工作，不僅幫助服務對象的生活逐漸步入正軌，也深深觸動著社會的脈絡，吸引更多大愛之人投身於社會工作領域。然而，在工作環境中，社會工作者往往面臨高壓與情緒勞動，其自身的需求也同樣值得被重視與關注。因此，本研究旨在探討社會工作者之個人-環境適配與工作投入之間的關係，並分析基本心理需求於此兩者之間的中介效果。本研究採用問卷調查法，以社會工作者為調查對象，受測者共500位。對於維護社會工作者之基本心理需求以及提升其工作投入為一值得探討的重要議題，並進一步揭示其實踐意涵與學術價值。   本研究獲得以下結論：於個人-組織適配與基本心理需求方面(1)社會工作者之個人-組織適配對自主感呈負向影響；(2)社會工作者之個人-組織適配對勝任感呈負向影響。於個人-工作適配與基本心理需求方面(3)社會工作者之個人-工作適配對自主感呈正向影響；(4)社會工作者之個人-工作適配對勝任感呈正向影響；(5)社會工作者之個人-工作適配對關聯感呈正向影響。於個人-主管適配與基本心理需求方面(6)社會工作者之個人-主管適配對自主感呈正向影響；(7)社會工作者之個人-主管適配對勝任感呈正向影響；然而，(8)社會工作者之個人-主管適配對關聯感呈負向影響。於基本心理需求與工作投入方面(9)社會工作者之自主感對活力呈正向影響；(10)社會工作者之自主感對奉獻呈正向影響；(11)社會工作者之自主感對專注呈正向影響。(12)社會工作者之關聯感對專注呈正向影響。(13)社會工作者之個人-環境適配各構面（個人-組織適配、個人-工作適配、個人-主管適配）對工作投入各構面（活力、奉獻、專注）之影響未達統計顯著水準。   於基本心理需求之間接效果方面(14)社會工作者之自主感在個人-工作適配與活力關係間具有中介作用。(15)社會工作者之自主感在個人-工作適配與奉獻關係間具有中介作用。(16)社會工作者之關聯感在個人-工作適配與專注關係間具有中介作用。(17)社會工作者之自主感在個人-主管適配與活力關係間具有中介作用。(18)社會工作者之自主感在個人-主管適配與奉獻關係間具有中介作用。(19)個人-組織適配透過自主感進而對奉獻呈負向影響。(20)個人-主管適配透過關聯感進而對專注呈負向影響。
abstract_en: Social workers promote social support systems with their professional knowledge through empathy, understanding, and active listening, helping individuals regain confidence and overcome challenges. This care-centered work not only assists individuals in stabilizing their lives but also resonates within the broader social context, inspiring more people to engage in social work. However, social workers often experience high levels of pressure and emotional labor, highlighting the need to address their own psychological needs. The study aims to explore the relations between person-environment fit, basic psychological needs, and work engagement among social workers. A total of 500 social workers participated in this study. Investigating the basic psychological needs of social workers and improving their work engagement constitutes a vital area of research, highlighting both its practical ramifications and academic importance.   This study reached the following conclusions: Regarding person-organization fit and basic psychological needs, (1) the person-organization fit of social workers has a negative impact on their autonomy; (2) the person-organization fit of social workers has a negative impact on their competence. Regarding person-job fit and basic psychological needs, (3) the person-job fit of social workers has a positive impact on their autonomy; (4) the person-job fit of social workers has a positive impact on their competence; (5) the person-job fit of social workers has a positive impact on their relatedness. Regarding person-supervisor fit and basic psychological needs, (6) the person-supervisor fit of social workers has a positive impact on their autonomy; (7) the person-supervisor fit of social workers has a positive impact on their competence; however, (8) the person-supervisor fit of social workers has a negative impact on their relatedness. Regarding basic psychological needs and work engagement, (9) social workers’ autonomy has a positive impact on their vigor; (10) social workers’ autonomy has a positive impact on their dedication; (11) social workers’ autonomy has a positive impact on their absorption; (12) social workers’ relatedness has a positive impact on their absorption. Regarding person-environment fit and work engagement, (13) social workers’ person-environment fit (person-organization fit, person-job fit, person-supervisor fit) do not have statistically significant impacts on their work engagement (vigor, dedication, absorption).   Regarding the indirect effects of basic psychological needs, (14) social workers’ autonomy mediates the relation between person-job fit and vigor; (15) social workers’ autonomy mediates the relation between person-job fit and dedication; (16) social workers’ relatedness mediates the relation between person-job fit and absorption; (17) social workers’ autonomy mediates the relation between person-supervisor fit and vigor; (18) social workers’ autonomy mediates the relation between person-supervisor fit and dedication; (19) person-organization fit is negatively and indirectly related to dedication through the pathway of social works’ autonomy; (20) person-supervisor fit is negatively and indirectly related to absorption through the pathway of social works’ relatedness.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 業界帶團實務培訓對導遊專業職能與工作適應之個案研究
title_en: A Case Study on the Professional Functions and Work Adaptation of Tour Guides by Practical Training for Tour Guides in the Industry.
keywords: 業界帶團實務培訓、官方導遊職前訓練、導遊人員、導遊專業職能、導遊工作適應
