abstract_zh: 本研究旨在探討業界帶團實務培訓與官方導遊職前訓練對導遊專業職能與工作適應的效應及其關聯性。本研究為個案研究，以深度訪談的方式訪談了八位在業界帶團的導遊人員，其中四位是參加業界帶團實務培訓之後再接受官方導遊職前訓練，另外四位則是只接受官方導遊職前訓練的導遊。　　研究結果發現，官方導遊職前訓練對導遊專業職能的效應為：(1)戶外實務導覽能夠促進新手導遊對景點動線的認識；(2)缺乏景點解說的實際練習機會；(3)藉由案例分析能夠讓學員熟悉危機處理的步驟；(4)缺乏緊急狀況與情境式演練的機會。業界帶團實務培訓對導遊專業職能的效應為：(1)實際演練開車詞能夠訓練學員的口才與促進團體互動；(2)缺乏緊急應變與危機處理的實務操作課程；(3)提供旅遊行程設計與安排的實作演練；(4)食衣住行育樂的溝通協調教學。官方導遊職前訓練對導遊工作適應的效應：(1)講師的經驗分享能夠促進學員對導遊工作的認識；(2)成為新手導遊之後也必須持續進修培養更多知識與技能；(3)考核機制能夠促進學員之間的互動並訓練個人膽量；(4)缺乏其他導遊工作面向的考核。業界帶團實務培訓對導遊工作適應的效應為：(1)培養學員的換位思考能力兼顧各方利益；(2)訓練學員以非旅遊的心態組織帶團架構；(3)履歷撰寫教學及業界媒合機會；(4)提供學員正當的諮詢管道以確保資訊的正確性。兩種培訓各有優勢及可調整的部分，官方導遊職前訓練對觀光理論與知識方面的資訊比較齊全，導遊實務操作方面的訓練則是業界帶團實務培訓較為完整。
abstract_en: The purpose of this study is to investigate the effects and correlation between the practical training for tour guides in the industry and the pre-service training for official tour guides on tour guides' professional functions and work adaptation. The study is a case study. Eight tour guides who led tours in the industry were interviewed through in-depth interviews, four of whom received official pre-service training after attending practical training for tour guides in the industry, while the other four only received official pre-service training for tour guides.　The study found that the effects of official pre-service training on the professional functions of tour guides were: (1) outdoor practical tours could enhance novice tour guides' understanding of the movement of tourist attractions; (2) there was a lack of opportunities for practical practice in the interpretation of tourist attractions; (3) case studies could familiarize trainees with the procedures of crisis management; and (4) there was a lack of opportunities for emergency and situational rehearsals. The effects of practical training for tour guides in the industry on their professional functions are: (1) Practical exercises in driving speech can train the trainees' eloquence and promote group interaction; (2) There is a lack of practical courses on emergency response and crisis management; (3) Practical exercises in designing and arranging the tour itinerary; (4) Communication and coordination of food, clothing, housing, transportation, and recreation are taught. The effect of official pre-service tour guide training on tour guide work adaptation: (1) experience sharing by instructors can promote trainees' understanding of tour guide work; (2) after becoming a novice tour guide, it is necessary to continue to study and cultivate more knowledge and skills; (3) the assessment mechanism can promote interaction among trainees and train their personal courage; (4) there is a lack of other tour guide work-oriented assessment. The effects of practical training for tour guides in the industry on the adaptation of tour guides' work are: (1) cultivating trainees' ability to think differently and to take into account the interests of all parties; (2) training trainees to organize the structure of tour guides with a non-tourist mentality; (3) teaching résumé writing and opportunities for matchmaking in the industry; and (4) providing trainees with a proper channel of enquiry to ensure the correctness of information. Both types of training have their own advantages and adjustable parts. The official pre-service training for tour guides is more complete in terms of tourism theories and knowledge, while the practical training for tour guides is more complete in terms of the industry's practical training for leading tours.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 特殊奧林匹克運動會融合運動推動之現況調查及其對運動員及融合夥伴態度與技能的轉變
title_en: An Investigation of Special Olympics Unified Sports in Taiwan: Current Status and Transformation in Attitudes and Skills of Athletes and Unified Partners
keywords: 族群接觸理論、融合式體育、特殊奧林匹克運動會融合運動、融合夥伴、混合研究
abstract_zh: 近幾年來，臺灣受到融合教育思潮及身心障礙者權利公約之倡議，因而讓身心障礙者運動權利和融合運動意識抬頭並日漸盛行。國際特殊奧林匹克運動會(簡稱國際特奧會)起源於1968年，主要提供智能障礙者展現自我舞台，國內於2019年參與特奧夏季世界賽勇奪融合籃球史上首面金牌。因此，本研究為探討特奧運動員與融合夥伴在態度與技能的參與歷程與轉變情形。採混合研究之問卷調查和半結構式訪談，蒐集相關資料，並進行分析討論歸納，得到結論如下：一、各校教師與教練推動特奧融合運動實施情形：(一)學校簽訂特奧融合學校專案，創造融合的環境；(二)推動特奧融合運動人員以特教教師為主；(三)推動特奧融合運動以校內或全國融合活動較多；(四)推動特奧融合運動項目以融合滾球與融合籃球為優先；(五)招募人員以教師推薦與運動校隊為成員。二、特奧運動員及融合夥伴參與融合運動態度及技能之情形及差異：(一)整體態度與技能為中上程度，以態度之認知和情意構面的程度最高；(二)因性別有所差異，在態度與技能以男性高於女性；(三)因身分別有所差異，在態度與技能以運動員高於融合夥伴；(四)因區域有所差異，在態度與技能以東部及外島最高；(五)因運動年資有所差異，運動年資越長在態度與技能越高；(六)因運動競賽等級有所差異，運動員在態度與技能以參加國際體育競賽的最高。三、參與融合運動態度及技能之轉變歷程與關鍵因素：(一)校內簽訂特奧融合專案，並辦理體驗活動及彈性學習與社團；(二)校內尋找具積極和耐心的特質，及願意接納教學和具教學熱忱之運動員與融合夥伴；(三)透過實際參與經驗與互動，打破彼此刻板印象與提升社會技巧；(四)參與時間與共同生活經驗越長，為彼此關係帶來正向影響；(五)教師與教練提供運動平權的機會、促進互動與凝聚友善團隊；(六)教師與教練因應個別差異，提升個人相關技能與發掘終身運動。最後，根據上述研究結論提出具體建議，作為提供教育單位、體育組織和學校教師與教練對於特奧融合運動與後續研究者參考。
abstract_en: In recent years, Taiwan has embraced the movement of inclusive education and the principles of the Convention on the Rights of Persons with Disabilities (CRPD). This shift has led to greater focus on the sporting rights of individuals with disabilities and the promotion of Unified Sports. The Special Olympics World Games, which started in 1968, offer a platform for those with intellectual disabilities to display their abilities. Taiwan made history by winning its first gold medal in Unified Basketball at the Special Olympics World Summer Games in 2019. Thus, this study aims to explore the current status and transformation in attitudes and skills of athletes and unified partners. To achieve this, a mixed-methods approach, combining a questionnaire survey and semi-structured interviews, was used to collect relevant data and perform analysis. The findings are as follows:1. The implementation of Special Olympics Unified Sports by Educators and Coaches: (1) Schools sign onto the Special Olympics Unified Schools Project to foster an inclusive environment, (2) Special education teachers are crucial in promoting Unified Sports, (3) Inclusive activities at schools and nationwide are key methods for advancing Unified Sports, (4) Unified Bocce and Unified Basketball are prioritized in promotional efforts, and (5) Recruitment of participants typically occurs through teachers or sports team members within schools.2. Variations in Attitudes and Skills between Special Olympics Athletes and Unified Partners: (1) Overall, attitudes and skills are rated from medium high, with the highest ratings in the cognitive and affective aspects of attitudes, (2) Gender differences show that males generally perform better than females in both attitudes and skills, (3) Special Olympics athletes exhibit stronger attitudes and skills compared to Unified Partners, (4) Regional differences indicate that athletes from eastern regions and outer islands score highest in attitudes and skills, (5) Sports experience correlates positively with higher levels of attitudes and skills, and (6) Athletes who participate in international competitions demonstrate the highest levels of attitudes and skills.3. Processes and Key Factors Influencing Changes in Attitudes and Skills through Participation in Unified Sports: (1) Schools participate in Special Olympics inclusion projects, organize experiential activities, and provide flexible learning opportunities and clubs, (2) Schools select enthusiastic athletes and Unified Partners who possess positive and patient qualities and are receptive to inclusive teaching, (3) Through practical participation and interaction, stereotypes are broken and social skills are enhanced, (4) Longer participation and shared experiences foster positive relationships, (5) Teachers and coaches ensure equal opportunities in sports, promoting interaction and building supportive teams, and (6) Educators and coaches address individual differences, aiding students in enhancing personal skills and exploring lifelong sports options.Finally, specific suggestions are provided based on the above research conclusions as a reference for educational units, sports organizations, and school teachers and coaches involved in Special Olympics Unified Sports , as well as for future researchers.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 運用Minecraft數位遊戲輔助技術型高中學生程式設計學習成效之研究
title_en: A study on the use of Minecraft digital games to assist vocational senior high school students in programming learning
keywords: 程式設計教學、遊戲式學習、學習成效、自我效能
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在探究運用Minecraft數位遊戲輔助程式計教學對於技術型高中學生程式設計學習成效之影響。研究採準實驗研究法，實驗組27位學生，控制組32位學生，均為技術型高中三年級學生。進行為期9周的程式設計課程。透過研究者在Minecraft數位遊戲中自行設計的關卡，增加學生學習程式設計的樂趣與動機，學生在順利破關的同時，也學會該學習單元的主要程式設計概念。教學活動開始前，使用研究者自行研發之測驗卷進行學習前測驗，教學活動結束後進行學習後測驗，並實施自我效能量表調查。依學生學習前後測成績及自我效能量表分數，分析實驗組與控制組在程式設計學習成效及自我效能方面之差異。經過資料檢定、分析後研究結論如下：一、運用Minecraft數位遊戲輔助技術型高中程式設計學習在程式設計之變數、迴圈、條件及整體學習成效優於傳統教學，但在循序概念上與傳統教學無顯著差異。二、運用Minecraft數位遊戲輔助技術型高中程式設計學習在學生程式設計自我效能優於傳統教學。
abstract_en: This study aimed to investigate the impact of using Minecraft digital games to supplement programming instruction on the learning outcomes of vocational senior high school students. A quasi-experimental design was employed, with 27 students in the experimental group and 32 students in the control group, all of whom were third-year students at a vocational senior high school. The programming course lasted for 9 weeks. During the course, the researcher used custom-designed levels in Minecraft to motivate students to learn programming. As students successfully completed the levels, they also acquired key programming concepts relevant to the course unit. Prior to the instructional activities, students completed a self-developed questionnaire as a pre-test. After the instructional activities, students took a post-test and completed a programming self-efficacy scale. The differences between the experimental and control groups in terms of learning effectiveness and programming self-efficacy were analyzed based on the scores from the pre-test, post-test, and self-efficacy scale. After verifying and analyzing the data, the study reached the following conclusions:1. The use of Minecraft digital games to assist in programming instruction for technical high school students resulted in better learning outcomes in the areas of variables, loops, conditions, and overall programming effectiveness compared to traditional teaching. However, there was no significant difference in the learning of sequential concepts when compared to traditional teaching.2. The use of Minecraft digital games in programming instruction for vocational senior high school students led to higher self-efficacy in programming design compared to traditional teaching methods.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 運用設計思維於技術型高中生活文創工藝課程之行動研究
title_en: An Action Research of Applying Design Thinking to Living Cultural and Creative Crafts Course in Vocational High School
keywords: 設計思維、創意自我效能、問題解決能力
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在探討設計思維模式運用於技術型高中家政科生活文創工藝課程之成效，探究教學實施的步驟及過程中所產生的問題與其因應策略，以及技術型高中學生之創意自我效能和問題解決能力有何變化。本研究採行動研究，以研究者任教之技術型高中家政科二年級學生38名為研究對象，教學的過程分為三個階段，總共經歷12週，共24節課。研究結果顯示，學生課堂上時間有限，原型的製作時間比預期時間長，學生認為有些想法太過天馬行空，難以實現。因此教師須引導學生運用設計思維的步驟，對提出的創意進行實用性評估，選擇最可行的方案進行後續製作；另學生能力有限，無法有效地修正商品的缺點或找不到問題點。此時教師可提供學生必要的製作資訊或可以獲取資訊的平台，並請業師或其他相關的專業老師提供建議，以降低錯誤率或縮短學生修正的時間。而運用設計思維於技術型高中家政科生活文創工藝課程後，對學生創意自我效能和問題解決能力雖有正向提升，但在統計學上均無顯著差異。
abstract_en: The purpose of this study is to investigate the effectiveness of applying the design thinking model to the life arts and crafts programme of the Home Economics Department of a technical high school, to investigate the steps of teaching implementation, the problems arising from the teaching process and the strategies to deal with them, as well as the changes in the creativity self-efficacy and problem solving ability of the students of a technical high school.This study was an action research with 38 second-year students of Home Economics in a technical high school as the target group. The teaching process was divided into three phases, with a total of 24 lessons in 12 weeks. The results of the study showed that students' time in class was limited, and the production of prototypes took longer than expected, and students found some of the ideas to be too imaginative and difficult to realise. Therefore, teachers need to guide students to use the steps of design thinking to evaluate the practicality of the proposed ideas and select the most feasible option for subsequent production. On the other hand, students have limited ability to correct the shortcomings of the products or fail to find the problematic points effectively. In this case, teachers can provide students with the necessary production information or platforms where they can obtain information, and ask for advice from teachers or other relevant professionals to reduce the error rate or shorten the time for students to make corrections. The application of design thinking in the Living Arts and Crafts programme of the Home Economics course of the technical high school had positive effects on students' creative self-efficacy and problem-solving ability, but there was no statistically significant difference in these effects.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 生成式AI輔助視覺化程式語言教學對國中學生學習成效的影響
title_en: The Impact of Generative Artificial Intelligence Assisted Visual Programming Language on the Learning Effectiveness of Middle School Students
keywords: 生成式AI、視覺化程式語言、學習成效
abstract_zh: 人工智慧 (AI) 在教育領域的應用日益廣泛，其中以生成式AI 作為鷹架在視覺化程式語言在教學中的潛力值得探討。本研究探討生成式AI 輔助視覺化程式語言對國中學生學習成效的影響。特別關注其對程式語言學習成就和運算思維能力的影響，並深入分析學生提示詞使用情況。本研究採用準實驗設計，以臺北市立國中 4 個班級 83位八年級學生為樣本，將 83 位國中生分為實驗組(使用生成式AI 輔助教學)和控制組(使用傳統講述教學)，進行為期六週的Scratch程式設計教學實驗。研究結果顯示，生成式AI 輔助教學有效提升了學生的程式設計實作能力和特定運算思維能力(抽象化、通則化)。然而，在控制了前測成績後，生成式AI 輔助教學與傳統講述教學在程式設計概念理解、運算思維能力總分和整體學習成就方面並無顯著差異。學生所使用的提示詞分析結果顯示，學生較少描述設計細節，提示詞的具體性和品質直接影響AI輸出的效果，英文提示詞效果優於中文提示詞。在提示詞中若指定讓特定年齡程度理解的方式表述，可提升AI輸出內容的可理解性。
abstract_en: Artificial intelligence is increasingly used in education, and the potential of generative AI as a scaffold for teaching visual programming language is worth exploring. This study investigates the impact of generative AI-assisted visual programming language on the learning outcomes of middle school students in Taipei City. Particular attention was paid to the effects on programming language learning achievement and computational thinking ability, while also analyzing students' prompt usage. This study used a quasi-experimental design to conduct a six-week Scratch programming teaching experiment with a sample of 83 eighth-grade students in four classes at Taipei City Junior High School, divided into an experimental group (using generative AI to assist teaching) and a control group (using traditional lecture teaching). The results of the study showed that the generative AI-assisted instruction was effective in improving students' programming practical skills and computationally specific thinking skills (abstraction, generalization). However, after controlling for pre-test scores, there were no significant differences between generative AI-assisted instruction and traditional lecture instruction in terms of programming conceptual understanding, total computational thinking ability scores, and overall learning achievement. Analyses of the prompts used by students showed that students were less likely to describe design details, and that the specificity and quality of the prompts had a direct impact on the effectiveness of the AI output, with English prompts being more effective than Chinese prompts. Specifying age-specific expressions in the prompts can improve the comprehensibility of the AI output.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 東港木造王船匠師專門技術能力之研究
title_en: A study on the Professionals technical capabilities of the Shipwrights of the Donggang Wooden King
keywords: 木造王船匠師、專門技術能力
abstract_zh: 船是人類於海上行走的工具，也是漁民所賴以為生的生財工具之一，在臺灣的本島於西南沿岸的海域，被最為重視的信仰為王爺信仰，臨海佇地的東港，發展出臺灣海洋文化的特色，而在王爺的信仰最具代表性的民俗重要活動盛事就是東港迎王平安祭典，也表徵東港人民的心中對於王爺信仰的尊崇。東港迎王平安祭典於2010年經由當時的行政院文化建設委員會列為國家民俗重要慶典活動，從祭典的籌備所製作的木造王船，而匠師的專門技術都代表著東港人民對於木造王船匠師專門技術能力給予極為高度的肯定。因隨著時代變遷卻讓木造船的產業逐漸沒落，使得木造船的技術逐漸消失，更使得東港木造王船的匠師專門技術已經產生了危機，因此；本研究針對東港木造王船匠師專門技術能力進行研究，以建構「東港木造王船匠師專門技術能力」的基本指標，藉此；能將東港木造王船匠師專門技術符合之所需，進而達成專門技術能力之目的，在研究的成果並將提供給主管機關及有關單位參考之。本研究先透過文獻的探討與回顧並於東港木造王船匠師專門技術能力，將進行專家學者的訪談，在於訪談之後將綜合所有文獻與專家學者的意見與建議並彙整和歸納共計11項目和84條細目的基本指標，藉此；作為訓練之相關參考。從建構「東港木造王船匠師專門技術能力」的角度來探討東港木造王船匠師專門的技術，首先要從東港木造王船的製作所需要的基本指標與專門技術能力的結合，進而論述於木造王船的技術能力，並設置培訓基地的平臺，引入訓練資源，從訓練的專業技術養成，再做全面性而完整的整合，開辦木造王船技術能力的訓練課程，並招收學員，教導如何製作木造王船，並詳盡紀錄所有技術與細節和編纂木造王船製作的手冊與技術訓練教材及教案或是技術書籍，再以現代科技的技術與教育和訓練的方式重現王船製作的傳承。
abstract_en: The boat is a tool for human beings to walk on the sea, but also one of the tools for fishermen to make a living, in the sea area of Taiwan's main island in the southwest coast, the most valued belief is Wang Ye's faith, the Donggang near the sea, the development of Taiwan's maritime culture characteristics, and Wang Ye's belief in the most representative folk important event is the Donggang King Ping An Festival, but also represents the Donggang people's hearts for the respect for Wang Ye's faith.2010, the Donggang Yingwang Ping'an Festival was listed as an important national folk festival by the Cultural Construction Committee of the Executive Yuan at that time. Because with the change of the times, the wood shipbuilding industry has gradually declined, so that the technology of wood shipbuilding has gradually disappeared, and the craftsman expertise of the Donggang wooden kingship has produced a crisis, therefore; This study aims to study the technical competence of the king-builders of the East Port Wooden King, with a view to constructing the basic indicators of the "Know-how Capabilities of the King-made Shipwrights of the East Harbor Woodmakers". The results of the research will be provided to the competent authorities and relevant units for reference.This research will first discuss and review the literature and conduct interviews with experts and scholars on the technical capabilities of the Donggang Wooden King's shipwright. After the interview, all the literature and the opinions and suggestions of experts and scholars will be synthesized and summarized with a total of 11 items and 84 detailed basic indicators. As a relevant reference for training.From the perspective of constructing the "Donggang Wooden King's Shipwright's Specialized Technical Ability" to discuss the special technology of the Donggang Wooden King's Shipwright, we should first discuss the technical ability of the Donggang Wooden King's Ship from the combination of the basic indicators and specialized technical capabilities required for the production of the Donggang Wooden King's Ship, and then set up a platform for the training base, introduce training resources, and then do a comprehensive and complete integration from the professional and technical cultivation of the training, open the training of the technical ability course of the Wooden King's Ship, and recruit students to teach how to make a Wooden King's Ship. It also records all the techniques and details in detail, compiles manuals and technical training materials and lesson plans or technical books for the production of wooden kingships, and then reproduces the inheritance of kingshipmaking in the way of modern technology and education and training.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 學校推動線上同步政策對遠距教學課程學生學習行為和課程評量之學習分析
title_en: Learning Analytics of Institutional Synchronous Online Learning Policies Regarding Student Learning Behavior and Course Evaluation in Online Courses
keywords: 線上學習、遠距教學課程、學習分析、學習行為
abstract_zh: 本研究主要目的在探討個案學校推動線上同步政策對進修部學生學習行為和課程評量的影響，研究採用斷點迴歸設計（RDD），以107至111學年度進修部開設的123門遠距教學課程為研究對象，分析19,351位學生的非同步學習行為及課程評量資料，比較政策實施前後的變化。透過集群分析，識別出不同學習群體的特徵，並探討線上同步政策對各群體的差異影響。研究結果發現，線上同步政策實施後，進修部學生非同步學習行為呈現下降趨勢，但學生對課程的整體評價與滿意度卻有所提升。集群分析識別出三類學習行為特徵的課程班級群體：觀察型、平衡型和積極型；線上同步政策對不同學習群體的影響存在差異，尤其對觀察型課程班級群體影響最顯著。建議未來在遠距教學設計中，應優化混成教學模式，加強學習激勵機制，深化同步教學應用，並針對不同學習群體實施差異化教學策略，以提升整體教學效果。
abstract_en: This study aims to explore the impact of the institutional synchronous online learning policy on the learning behavior and course evaluation of students in the continuing education division. The study employs a Regression Discontinuity Design (RDD), focusing on 123 distance learning courses offered by the continuing education division of a case school during the academic years 2018 to 2022, analyzing the learning behavior and course evaluation data of 19,351 students to compare changes before and after policy implementation. Through cluster analysis, the study identifies the characteristics of different learning groups and examines the differential impact of the synchronous online policy on these groups.The results indicate that after the implementation of the synchronous online policy, there is a downward trend in asynchronous learning behavior among continuing education division students. However, overall course evaluation and satisfaction have improved. The cluster analysis identifies three types of learning behavior characteristics in course groups: Observational, Balanced, and Proactive. The impact of the synchronous online policy varies among these groups, with the most significant effect observed in the Observational group.The study recommends that future distance learning design should optimize the blended learning model, enhance learning motivation mechanisms, deepen the application of synchronous teaching, and implement differentiated teaching strategies tailored to different learning groups to improve overall teaching effectiveness.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 高中生服務學習培訓活動及實施成效之行動研究
title_en: An Action Research on the Training Activities and Implementation Effectiveness of Service-Learning for High School Students
keywords: 服務學習培訓活動、行動研究、團隊共識、領袖訓練、服務目標
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在探討高中生進行服務學習培訓活動中之遭遇問題與解決策略、實施成效及研究者的成長與省思。研究採用行動研究方法，以某技術型高中無人機服務團隊的學生為研究參與者，並與協同研究者進行活動反思與修正。為達此目的，本研究於2024年1月進行研究對象的招募，成員人數共17人，並將活動大綱透過專家審查後修正，於該年4-5月進行服務學習培訓活動，並從學生反思與回饋中修正教案及活動內容，研究工具包含「團隊共識測驗卷」、「服務學習動機量表」、「領袖訓練觀察表」、「服務目標測驗卷」、「研究者省思札記」、「協同研究者反饋單」、「培訓課回饋小卡」。研究結果得出以下結論：壹、研究者蒐集高中生六項問題，並提出解決策略以改進教學。貳、學生在團隊共識、領袖培訓、服務目標三個層面上實施成效良好。參、服務學習培訓活動帶動服務學習動機的提升。肆、研究者以活動歷程促進自我反思。  最後根據本研究的結論，提出具體可行的建議，以作為執行服務學習培訓活動的參考，並對未來的研究方向提供建議。
abstract_en: This study aims to explore the issues encountered and solutions developed during service-learning training activities for high school students, as well as the outcomes of implementation and the growth and reflections of the researcher. An action research method was adopted, with students from a drone service team at a technical high school as the study participants, in collaboration with a co-researcher to reflect and revise the activities. To achieve this goal, recruitment took place in January 2024, with a total of 17 participants. The training activities were conducted from April to May of the same year, after the activity outlines were reviewed and revised by experts. Adjustments to lesson plans and activities were made based on student reflections and feedback. The research tools included the "Team Consensus Questionnaire," "Service-Learning Motivation Scale," "Leadership Training Observation Form," "Service Goals Test," "Researcher's Reflection Journal," "Co-Researcher's Feedback Form," and "Training Feedback Cards." The findings of the study are as follows:1.The researcher collected six issues from high school students and proposed solutions to improve teaching.2.Students showed good performance in the three areas of team consensus, leadership training, and service goals.3.The service-learning training activities contributed to an increase in students' motivation for service-learning.4.The researcher's own reflections were enhanced through the process of the activities.Finally, based on the conclusions of this study, specific and feasible suggestions are proposed as a reference for implementing service-learning training activities and providing guidance for future research directions.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 影響高績效壽險業務員工作滿意度之因素研究-以Herzberg雙因子理論為例
title_en: A Study on Factors Affecting Job Satisfaction of High-Performance Life Insurance Agents- Taking Herzberg's Two-Factor Theory as an Example
keywords: 高績效、壽險業務員、工作滿意度、雙因子理論、Herzberg
abstract_zh: Herzberg(1959)提出激勵保健因子理論又稱為雙因子理論(two-factor theory)，其影響工作滿意的因素為激勵因子(motivators factors)與影響工作不滿意的因素為保健因子(hygiene factors)，是近70年來對於工作滿意度相關研究深具影響力的理論。本研究以Herzberg訪談方式，採半結構式訪談，受訪者為18位全臺灣都會地區的高績效壽險業務員，歸納出雙因子理論中對工作滿意度有影響的因子，和比較不同工作範圍、不同銷售通路及不同個人背景的雙因子差異分析，運用Herzberg雙因子理論的編碼再以類屬分析來整理資料。得到本研究結論為：(1)成就感在高績效壽險業務員激勵中為主導地位(2)與上司人際關係是高績效壽險業務員工作定著的首要關鍵(3)培訓督導在保險公司高績效壽險業務員是不滿意的關鍵因子(4)工作內容、銷售通路貨個人背景的高績效壽險業務員激勵因子與保健因子無差異。本研究根據研究結論提出兩面項建議：(1-1)對高績效壽險業務員設定明確目標與適時給予反饋；(1-2)提供心理健康與安全的職場環境；(1-3)鼓勵參與競賽與國際獎項最具激勵效果；(2-1)高績效壽險業務員與創新行為的研究；(2-2)保險經紀人的組織承諾與留任意願之探究。期望本研究的研究建議能讓保險業的管理者達致經管效果，及完成年度目標計畫。
abstract_en: Herzberg (1959) proposed the theory of motivators and hygiene factors, also known as two-factor theory, in which the factors affecting job satisfaction are motivators and the factors affecting job dissatisfaction are hygiene factors. It is one of the most influential theory in job satisfaction related research in the last 70 years. The interviewees were 18 high-performance life insurance salespersons from all over the Taiwan metropolitan area. We summarised the factors that have an impact on job satisfaction in the two-factor theory, and compared the two-factor analysis of variance across different job scopes, sales channels, and personal backgrounds, and then collated the data using the coding of Herzberg's two-factor theory and then analysed the data by using class analysis. The conclusions of this study were obtained as follows: (1) Sense of achievement is a dominant factor in the motivation of high-performance life insurance employees; (2) Interpersonal relationship with supervisors is the primary key to the job satisfaction of high-performance life insurance employees; (3) Training and supervision is a key factor of dissatisfaction for high-performance life insurance employees in an insurance company; and (4) There is no difference between the motivation factor and the hygiene factor of high-performance life insurance employees in terms of job scope, sales channels, and personal backgrounds. Based on the conclusions of this study, two recommendations were made: (1-1) setting clear goals and giving timely feedback to high-performance life insurance agents; (1-2) providing a mentally healthy and safe workplace environment; (1-3) encouraging participation in competitions and international awards as the most effective way to motivate people; (2-1) research on high-performance life insurance agents and innovative behaviours; and (2-2) exploring the organisational commitment and retention wishes of insurance brokers. It is hoped that the recommendations of this study will enable managers in the insurance industry to achieve management results and fulfil their annual objectives.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 臺灣私立科技大學生源縱貫分析：2017-2021
title_en: A Longitudinal Analysis of Student Enrollment at Private Technological Universities in Taiwan: 2017-2021
keywords: 私立科技大學、生源、通勤區、地理位置、面量圖、財務指標
abstract_zh: 本研究主要探討臺灣私立科技大學生源問題，聚焦三項議題：首先，從學校服務的觀點，探討通勤區內高三生源對大學生源的影響。其次，從空間分析的角度，檢視大學地理位置對生源的影響。再者，從學校財務健全的視角，評估各項財務指標對學校生源的影響。研究涵蓋了2017年至2021年的五年期間，採取次級資料之縱貫性研究設計。使用的方法包括集群分析、地理空間分析、變異數分析、與廣義最小二乘迴歸模型分析。集群分析結果顯示，明星組學校除了對通勤區以內的高三生具有吸引力外，對於通勤區之外的高三生亦具有吸引力，其大一新生平均人數在四個群組中排名第一；績優組的學校可以吸引通勤區內的高三生就讀，其大一新生平均人數保持穩定，在四個群組中排名第二；潛力組的學校對通勤區內的高三生吸引力不強，其平均大一新生人數逐年減少，在四個群組中排名第三；挑戰組學校其大一新生平均人數最少，對通勤區內的高三生不具有吸引力，在四個群組中排名最後。明星組的學校雖然處於通勤區高三生源平均較少的地區，但是其大一人數並未因此而減少，並且潛力組的學校雖然處於通勤區高三生源平均較多的地區，但是其大一人數並未因此而增加，表示尚有除了通勤區高三生源以外的其他影響因素。統計分析結果表示通勤區內的高三生源對大一學生人數有正向顯著性影響，亦即其選擇當地的私立科技大學就讀的人數多。除了高三生源對大一學生人數有影響以外，學校的地理位置對生源也有影響，地理位置除了花東地區不顯著以外，其他五個地區的高三通勤人數增加時，其大一學生人數也隨著增加，並且在雲嘉南地區的影響特別明顯。此外以鄉鎮市區別的高中畢業人數的面量圖為底圖，將高中職及各大學的所在位置，繪製地圖以比對大學地理位置與高三生源的關係時，可發現大學的位置落點，在空間上呈現群聚的現象。另外學校財務指標對生源也有影響，其中學雜費占收入比率與本期餘絀比率對大一學生人數有正向顯著性影響，表示這兩個指標比率越高，其大一學生人數就越多；可用資金比率表示大學支付人事費用的負擔能力對大一學生人數没有顯著性影響；負債權益比率對大一學生人數有接近負向顯著性影響，表示長期償債能力越低，其大一學生人數就傾向越少。
abstract_en: This study primarily investigates the issue of student sources at private technological universities in Taiwan, focusing on three aspects: First, from the school services perspective, it explores the impact of high school seniors within the commuting area on university student sources. Second, from a spatial analysis viewpoint, it examines the effect of the schools' geographic locations on student recruitment. Third, from the perspective of financial soundness, it assesses the influence of various financial indicators on student sources. The study spans from 2017 to 2021 and employs a longitudinal research design using secondary data. Methods used include cluster analysis, geographic spatial analysis, variance analysis, and generalized least squares regression model analysis. The cluster analysis results indicate that the schools in the "star group" attract high school seniors both within and outside the commuting area, with the highest average number of freshmen among the four groups. The schools in the "excellence group" are able to attract high school seniors within the commuting area, maintaining a stable average number of freshmen and ranking second among the groups. The schools in the "potential group" have a weaker appeal to high school seniors within the commuting area, with their average number of freshmen decreasing annually, ranking third. The schools in the "challenge group" have the lowest average number of freshmen and are unattractive to high school seniors within the commuting area, ranking last among the groups. Despite being located in areas with fewer high school seniors within the commuting zone, the schools in the "star group" have not seen a decrease in the number of freshmen. Conversely, the schools in the "potential group" despite being in areas with a higher number of high school seniors within the commuting zone, have not seen an increase in freshman numbers, indicating that there are other factors influencing student recruitment beyond the local high school senior sources. Statistical analysis shows that high school seniors within the commuting area have a significantly positive impact on the number of freshmen, indicating that many choose to attend the local private technological universities. In addition to the impact of high school seniors, the geographic location of universities also affects student sources. Except for the Hualien-Taitung area, where the impact is not significant, an increase in the number of high school seniors commuting in the other five areas leads to an increase in freshman numbers, particularly noticeable in the Yunlin-Chiayi-Tainan area. Furthermore, using choropleth maps of high school graduation numbers by township and district as the base layer, mapping the locations of high schools and universities to compare the relationship between university geographic locations and high school senior sources reveals a clustering phenomenon in the spatial distribution of universities. Additionally, financial indicators also affect student recruitment; specifically, the ratio of tuition and fees to income and the current surplus ratio have a significant positive impact on the number of freshmen, indicating that higher rates of these indicators correlate with more freshmen. The available funds ratio, which reflects the university's ability to cover personnel expenses, does not significantly affect the number of freshmen; however, the debt-to-equity ratio has a nearly significant negative impact, suggesting that lower long-term debt repayment capacity tends to result in fewer freshmen.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 臺北市技術型高中學生人工智慧運用與學習適應之研究
title_en: A Study of Artificial Intelligence Application and Learning Adaptation among Students in Technical High Schools in Taipei City
keywords: 技術型高中、人工智慧運用、學習適應
abstract_zh: 研究者採用問卷調查法以臺北市技術型高中學生不同背景變項其人工智慧運用與學習適應之差異情形。以112學年下學期就讀臺北市技術型高中一至三年級的學生為研究對象，採分層隨機抽樣進行研究，，以SPSS軟體進行Descriptive Statistics, One-Sample t-Test, and One-Way ANOVA分析，並獲得研究結論：一、臺北市技術型高中學生人工智慧運用以「績效期望」程度最高，「社會影響」最低。二、臺北市技術型高中學生學習適應以「學習態度」程度最高，「學習習慣」程度最低。三、不同性別臺北市技術型高中學生人工智慧運用無顯著差異。四、不同年級之臺北市技術型高中學生人工智慧運用均達顯著差異，在「績效期望」、「促成條件 」構面上，高三年級同學顯著高於高一同學；在「努力期望」構面上，高二年級同學顯著高於高一同學；「社會影響」構面上，高一年級同學顯著高於高三同學。五、使用不同類別的人工智慧產品於臺北市技術型高中學生人工智慧運用之整體差異性，研究結果無顯著差異。六、臺北市技術型高中學生在「績效期望」、「努力期望」構面上，家長教育程度為研究所的同學顯著高於家長教育程度為高中職的同學；在「社會影響」構面上，家長教育程度為高中職的同學顯著高於家長教育程度為研究所的同學；在「促成條件」構面上，家長教育程度為研究所與大學的同學顯著高於家長教育程度為高中職的同學。七、臺北市技術型高中學生人工智慧運用在學習適應中的「學習方法」、「學習態度」、「學習習慣」、「學習環境」四項構面均達非常顯著差異。
abstract_en: The researcher adopted a survey method to investigate the differences in the application of artificial intelligence and learning adaptation among technical high school students in Taipei City with different background variables. The study targeted students from the first to the third year of technical high schools in Taipei City during the second semester of the 112th academic year, using stratified random sampling. The data were analyzed using SPSS software for Descriptive Statistics, One-Sample t-Test, and One-Way ANOVA, and the conclusions of the study were as follows:1.Among technical high school students in Taipei City, the highest level of AI application was found in the "Performance Expectation" dimension, while the "Social Influence" dimension was the lowest.2.The highest level of learning adaptation among technical high school students in Taipei City was in the "Learning Attitude" dimension, while the "Learning Habit" dimension was the lowest.3. There were no significant differences in the application of artificial intelligence among technical high school students in Taipei City based on gender.4.Significant differences were found in the application of artificial intelligence among technical high school students in Taipei City across different grades. In the "Performance Expectation" and "Facilitating Conditions" dimensions, third-year students.5.There were no significant differences in the overall application of artificial intelligence among technical high school students in Taipei City based on the type of AI products used.6.In the "Performance Expectation" and "Effort Expectation" dimensions, students whose parents had a graduate level of education scored significantly higher than those whose parents had a high school education; in the "Social Influence" dimension, students whose parents had a high school education scored significantly higher than those whose parents had a graduate level of education; in the "Facilitating Conditions" dimension, students whose parents had a graduate or university level of education scored significantly higher than those whose parents had a high school education.7.The application of artificial intelligence among technical high school students in Taipei City showed highly significant differences in the four dimensions of "Learning Methods," "Learning Attitudes," "Learning Habits," and "Learning Environment" in terms of learning adaptation.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 創業教育對大學生創業自我效能、創造性傾向與創業動機影響之追蹤研究－以某科技大學為例
title_en: A Follow-up Study on the Effect of Entrepreneurial Education on Entrepreneurial Self-efficacy, Creative Tendencies, and Entrepreneurial Motivation of College Students – Taking a University of Technology as an Example
keywords: 創業教育、創業自我效能、創造性傾向、創業動機、縱貫性研究、實務專題、校外實習、潛在成長模型
abstract_zh: 創業教育對於大學生的創業自我效能(entrepreneurial self-efficacy, ESE) 、創造性傾向(creative tendency, CT)與創業動機(entrepreneurial motivation, EM)的跨時間平均趨勢是否會有影響？本研究採用縱貫性調查，在三年期間對177位科技大學學生連續採取三次調查，透過描述性統計、結構方程模式、潛在成長模型探討及多變量變異數統計方法進行統計分析，了解這一批大學生在選讀創業教育課程後，是否會增長他們的創業自我效能(ESE)、創造性傾向(CT)及創業動機(EM) 的跨時間平均趨勢，以及各變項在創業教育對創業自我效能、創造性傾向及創業動機的跨時間平均趨勢是否有影響。總體研究結果顯示，創業教育對「創業自我效能」、「創造性傾向」及「創業動機」三個構面在跨時間的平均趨勢沒有顯著成長。但是對於各背景變項而言，在「創業自我效能」構面中，接受創業教育後，未想過自行創業的大學生跨時間的平均趨勢有顯著正成長，有想過自行創業的大學生跨時間的平均趨勢有顯著負成長；無意願參加創業培訓的大學生跨時間的平均趨勢有顯著正成長；不願接受無息創業風險的大學生跨時間的平均趨勢有顯著正成長；有修習過校外實習課程的大學生的平均趨勢顯著高於未修習過校外實習課程的大學生；選修完整創業教育學程學分的大學生顯著高於選修部份創業教育學分的大學生。在「創造性傾向」構面中，無意願參加創業競賽的大學生跨時間的平均趨勢有顯著正成長；不願接受無息創業風險的大學生跨時間的平均趨勢有顯著成長；選修完整創業教育學程學分的學生顯著高於選修部份創業教育學分的大學生。在「創業動機」構面中，女生跨時間的平均趨勢有顯著正成長；未想過自行創業的大學生跨時間的平均趨勢有顯著正成長，有想過自行創業的大學生跨時間的平均趨勢有顯著負成長；無意願參加創業培訓的大學生跨時間的平均趨勢有顯著成長；無意願參加創業競賽的大學生跨時間的平均趨勢有顯著成長；有修習過校外實習課程的大學生平均趨勢顯著高於未修習過校外實習課程的大學生；選修完整創業教育學程學分的大學生顯著高於選修部份創業教育學分的大學生。建議規劃創業教育課程前，先調查大學生相關背景資料；鼓勵大學生參與校外實習課程，強化學生創業自我效能及創業動機等創業能力；鼓勵大學生選修完整的創業教育學程課程，以具備各項創業能力；多元規劃創業教育課程，依據性別安排不同創業教育課程，提升學生相關創業能力。
abstract_en: Does entrepreneurial education have an effect on the average movement over time of entrepreneurial self-efficacy (ESE), creative tendency (CT), and entrepreneurial motivation (EM) of university students? A longitudinal study was conducted for this research with three successive surveys conducted of 177 university of science and technology students over a three-year period. Statistical analysis was conducted using descriptive statistics, structural equation modeling (SEM), examination of latent growth models, and multi-variate analysis of variance (MANOVA) to determine whether electing to study an entrepreneurial education course affected the average movement over time for ESE, CT and EM in this cohort of students, and whether each variable had an influence on average movement over time for ESE, CT and EM. The overall outcomes of this research showed that entrepreneurial education did not result in any significant growth in average movement over time for the three aspects of ESE, CT, and EM. In terms of background variables, the ESE aspect saw significant positive growth in average movement over time among university students that undertook entrepreneurial education and did not consider becoming entrepreneurs, while university graduates that did consider becoming entrepreneurs saw significant negative growth in average movement over time; university students not interested in participating in entrepreneurial training saw significant positive growth in average movement over time; university students not willing to accept the risk of interest-free entrepreneurship saw significant positive growth in average movement over time; average movement among university students that undertook outside internship courses was significantly higher than university students that had not undertaken outside internship courses; university students that completed all the course credits for entrepreneurial education were also significantly higher than university students that elected to complete only some of the entrepreneurial education course credits. For the CT aspect, there was significant positive growth in average movement over time among university students not interested in taking part in entrepreneurship competitions; significant positive growth in average movement over time among university students not willing to accept the risk of interest-free entrepreneurship; university students that completed all the course credits for entrepreneurial education were also significantly higher than university students that elected to complete only some of the entrepreneurial education course credits. For the EM aspect, there was significant positive growth in average movement over time among women; significant positive growth in average movement over time among university students that did not consider becoming entrepreneurs, and significant negative growth in average movement over time among students that did think of becoming entrepreneurs; significant growth in average movement over time among students not interested in undertaking entrepreneurship training; significant growth in average movement over time among university students not interested in participating in entrepreneurship competitions; average movement among university students that undertook outside internship courses was significantly higher than university students that had not undertaken outside internship courses; university students that completed all the course credits for entrepreneurial education were also significantly higher than university students that elected to complete only some of the entrepreneurial education course credits. An investigation of university students’ background information is therefore recommended before entrepreneurial education courses are planned; university students should be encouraged to participate in outside internship courses to strengthen student ESE, EM and other entrepreneurship skills; university students should be encouraged to take all the entrepreneurial education courses to equip them with all entrepreneurship skills; different types of entrepreneurial education courses should also be developed and tailored to different genders to enhance the entrepreneurship skills of students.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 中華電信員工情緒智慧與職場衝突因應之研究
title_en: A Study on Employee Emotional Intelligence and Workplace Conflict Resolution at Chunghwa Telecom
keywords: 中華電信員工、情緒智慧、職場衝突因應
abstract_zh: 本研究以2024年中華電信公司在職正職員工為研究對象，採問卷調查法進行研究，探討不同背景變項之中華電信員工情緒智慧現況及其差異情況，並進一步探討中華電信員工不同的情緒智慧，其職場衝突因應之差異情形。研究工具包含「個人基本資料」、「中華電信員工情緒智慧量表」及「中華電信職場衝突因應量表」，採分層隨機抽樣方式依中華電信公司員工人數比例抽取員工進行抽樣調查，總共發放540份調查問卷，收回整理後的有效問卷為396份，有效問卷回收率為73.33%，對施測後資料進行全面分析，獲致以下結論：一、  中華電信員工在情緒智慧的整體及各構面得分均達中等以上，尤以「自我覺察」構面表現最為顯著，接著依序為「同理心」、「自我激勵」及「人際關係」，「情緒管理」為最低。二、  中華電信員工「職場衝突因應」之整體及各構面知覺屬中以上，其中以「合作」最高，接著依序為「妥協」、「逃避」及「抗爭」，「順應」最低。三、  中華電信員工「情緒智慧」會因「婚姻狀況」不同有顯著差異，已婚員工顯著高於未婚員工。四、  中華電信員工「情緒智慧」會因「教育程度」、「擔任不同職務」及「所屬單位」之不同而有部分顯著差異。五、  中華電信員工「情緒智慧」不因「性別」、「年齡」及「服務年資」之不同而有顯著差異。六、  中華電信員工「職場衝突因應」會因「情緒智慧」的差別產生顯著差異。就整體「職場衝突因應」而言，「自我激勵」情緒智慧的員工顯著高於「情緒管理」情緒智慧的員工；「同理心」情緒智慧的員工顯著高於「情緒管理」情緒智慧的員工。在「逃避」構面中，達顯著差異，但經事後比較，組間無顯著差異。在「順應」構面中，達顯著差異，但經事後比較，組間無顯著差異。在「妥協」構面中，採取「同理心」情緒智慧的員工顯著高於「自我覺察力」情緒智慧的員工；「同理心」情緒智慧的員工顯著高於「情緒管理」情緒智慧的員工；「同理心」情緒智慧的員工顯著高於「自我激勵」情緒智慧的員工；「同理心」情緒智慧的員工顯著高於「人際關係」情緒智慧的員工。在「合作」的構面中，採取「自我激勵」情緒智慧的員顯著高於「情緒管理」情緒智慧的員工。
abstract_en: This study focuses on full-time employees of Chunghwa Telecom in 2024 as the research subjects. Using a questionnaire survey method, the research explores the current status of emotional intelligence among Chunghwa Telecom employees with different background variables and examines the variations in these factors. Additionally, the study investigates how differences in emotional intelligence among Chunghwa Telecom employees affect their responses to workplace conflicts. The research tools include the "Personal Information Form," the "Chunghwa Telecom Employees' Emotional Intelligence Scale," and the "Chunghwa Telecom Workplace Conflict Response Scale." A stratified random sampling method was employed, with employees selected proportionally based on the number of employees at Chunghwa Telecom. A total of 540 questionnaires were distributed, and 396 valid responses were collected, resulting in a valid response rate of 73.33%. The collected data were thoroughly analyzed, leading to the following conclusions:1.  Chunghwa Telecom employees scored above average in overall emotional intelligence and across all dimensions, with "Self-Awareness" being the most prominent, followed by "Empathy," "Self-Motivation," and "Interpersonal Relationships," while "Emotion Management" was the lowest.2.  Chunghwa Telecom employees perceived their overall and dimensional responses to workplace conflict as above average, with "Collaboration" being the highest, followed by "Compromise," "Avoidance," and "Confrontation," while "Accommodation" was the lowest.3.  Significant differences in emotional intelligence were observed among Chunghwa Telecom employees based on "Marital Status," with married employees scoring significantly higher than unmarried employees.4.  Differences in emotional intelligence were also found to be significant based on "Education Level," "Job Position," and "Department."5.  No significant differences in emotional intelligence were observed based on "Gender," "Age," or "Years of Service."6.  Significant differences in "Workplace Conflict Response" were found based on variations in emotional intelligence. Overall, employees with higher "Self-Motivation" emotional intelligence scored significantly higher in workplace conflict response than those with higher "Emotion Management"; employees with higher "Empathy" scored significantly higher than those with higher "Emotion Management." In the "Avoidance" dimension, significant differences were observed, but post-hoc comparisons showed no significant differences between groups. Similarly, significant differences were found in the "Accommodation" dimension, but post-hoc comparisons showed no significant differences between groups. In the "Compromise" dimension, employees with higher "Empathy" emotional intelligence scored significantly higher than those with higher "Self-Awareness," "Emotion Management," "Self-Motivation," and "Interpersonal Relationships." In the "Collaboration" dimension, employees with higher "Self-Motivation" emotional intelligence scored significantly higher than those with higher "Emotion Management."

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 國際觀光旅館員工工作要求、工作資源、自我效能與幸福感關聯模式之研究
title_en: A Study on Relationship Model of Job Demands, Job Resources, Self-efficacy, and Well-being among Employees of International Tourist Hotels
keywords: 國際觀光旅館員工、工作要求、工作資源、自我效能、幸福感
abstract_zh: 本研究主要目的在探討工作要求與資源模型在臺灣國際觀光旅館背景下的適用性，並分析員工的工作要求、工作資源、自我效能與幸福感的關聯，進而檢驗員工自我效能在工作要求、工作資源對幸福感的中介作用，以及影響國際觀光旅館員工幸福感之路徑模式。採用問卷調查法，將臺灣國際觀光旅館分為北、中、南、東四區，透過分層立意抽樣，回收有效問卷共446份，並以統計軟體SPSS 24.0和AMOS 24.0進行分析。本研究結果如下：一、國際觀光旅館員工的工作要求、工作資源、自我效能與幸福感關聯模式具良好的配適度。二、國際觀光旅館員工的工作要求對自我效能與幸福感具有顯著負向影響。三、國際觀光旅館員工的工作資源對自我效能與幸福感具有顯著正向影響。四、國際觀光旅館員工的自我效能對幸福感具有顯著正向影響。五、國際觀光旅館員工的自我效能在工作要求與幸福感間具有顯著中介效果。六、國際觀光旅館員工的自我效能在工作資源與幸福感間具有顯著中介效果。本研究對國際觀光旅館人力資源管理的貢獻在於，提出了提升員工幸福感的具體建議，透過增強工作資源與員工的自我效能，減少工作要求對員工的負面影響，進一步提升員工的整體幸福感。此外，本研究的創新在於首次以臺灣國際觀光旅館為背景，建構員工工作要求、工作資源、自我效能與幸福感之模型，為後續相關研究提供實證基礎。
abstract_en: This study aims to investigate the applicability of the Job Demands-Resources (JD-R) model within the context of international tourist hotels in Taiwan. It examines the interrelationships among employees' job demands, job resources, self-efficacy, and well-being. Furthermore, the study assesses the mediating role of self-efficacy in the impact of job demands and job resources on well-being, elucidating the pathways influencing employee well-being. Employing a questionnaire survey method, the study utilized stratified purposive sampling across Taiwan's four regions (North, Central, South, and East), yielding 446 valid responses. Data analysis was conducted using SPSS 24.0 and AMOS 24.0.The findings are as follows: 1) The model encompassing job demands, job resources, self-efficacy, and well-being among employees in international tourist hotels exhibits excellent fit. 2) Job demands exert a significant negative impact on self-efficacy and well-being. 3) Job resources have a significant positive impact on self-efficacy and well-being. 4) Self-efficacy has a significant positive impact on well-being. 5) Self-efficacy significantly mediates the relationship between job demands and well-being. 6) Self-efficacy significantly mediates the relationship between job resources and well-being.This research contributes to human resource management in international tourist hotels by providing actionable recommendations for enhancing employee well-being. It suggests that increasing job resources and bolstering employees self-efficacy can alleviate the adverse effects of job demands, thereby improving overall employee well-being. Furthermore, the novelty of this study lies in its pioneering application of the JD-R model within the context of international tourist hotels in Taiwan, thus offering an empirical foundation for subsequent research.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 技術型高中化工科化工裝置實習課程運用5E探究式教學之行動研究
title_en: An Action Research on the Application of the 5E Inquiry-Based Teaching Method in the Chemical Equipment Practice Course of the Department of Chemical Engineering in Technical High Schools
keywords: 5E探究式教學、技術型高中專業實習課程、行動研究
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在探討技術型高中化工科化工裝置實習課程運用5E探究式教學過程中，教師教學及學生學習遭遇困難及因應策略，以及實施後學生之學習成效與教師的專業省思與成長。本研究採用行動研究法，研究對象為研究者任教之技術型高中化工科高中二年級學生共37人（含1位德國交換生），研究者擬於班級進行為期8週的研究。研究工具包含自編學生學習單、學習成效訪談紀錄表、學生學習單元訪談紀錄表、教學歷程省思札記、教案修改札記。根據行動研究歷程所蒐集之資料進行整理與分析後，本研究得到結論如下：一、教師在5E探究式教學中面臨探索階段時長不足、新舊概念連結困難、過度依賴人工智慧以及應用新知困難等問題。研究者透過延長探索時間、提供鷹架教材、調整AI使用策略及案例示範進行改進。二、學生在評量階段表達能力不足，實驗連結困難及學習意願低落，建議加強自主表達訓練、簡化實驗步驟及尊重分組意願。三、5E教學法促進學生複習舊知識、提高學習主動性和探究能力，教師亦在教學設計和專業能力上獲得成長。
abstract_en: This study aims to explore the challenges faced by teachers and students during the implementation of the 5E Inquiry-Based Teaching model in the Chemical Engineering Equipment Practice curriculum in a technical high school’s Chemical Engineering Department. It also seeks to examine the coping strategies employed, the learning outcomes of students, and the professional reflections and growth of teachers after implementation.The study adopts an action research approach. The participants include 37 second-year students (including one German exchange student) from the Chemical Engineering Department of the technical high school where the researcher teaches. The study is planned to be conducted over an 8-week period. Research tools include self-developed student worksheets, learning outcome interview records, student interview records, teaching process reflection notes, and lesson plan revision notes.Based on the data collected and analyzed from the action research process, several significant findings emerged.Firstly, teachers encountered various challenges while implementing the 5E Inquiry-Based Teaching model. A major issue was the insufficient time allocated for the exploration phase, which hindered in-depth student engagement. Additionally, linking new concepts with prior knowledge proved difficult, creating gaps in understanding. The heavy reliance on artificial intelligence tools also posed problems, as it sometimes overshadowed the students' critical thinking processes. Moreover, applying new knowledge in practical scenarios was challenging for students. To address these issues, the researcher extended the exploration phase, provided scaffolded instructional materials, adjusted the strategies for AI usage, and incorporated case demonstrations to facilitate better understanding.Secondly, students faced specific challenges during the learning process. Many students struggled with expressing their understanding during the evaluation phase, which indicated a need for improved communication skills. There was also a notable difficulty in connecting experimental activities with theoretical concepts, which affected their overall comprehension. Furthermore, a lack of motivation to learn was observed among some students, impacting their engagement and participation. To mitigate these issues, the researcher recommended enhancing training for autonomous expression, simplifying experimental procedures to make them more manageable, and respecting students' preferences in groupings to foster a more collaborative and motivating environment.Finally, the implementation of the 5E Inquiry-Based Teaching model yielded several positive outcomes. The approach facilitated the review of prior knowledge, helping students to build a stronger foundation for new concepts. It also increased students' learning initiative and inquiry skills, making them more active participants in their education. For teachers, the process contributed to growth in instructional design and professional competence, as they gained insights into more effective teaching strategies and reflective practices. These findings underscore the benefits of the 5E model in enhancing both student learning outcomes and teacher professional development.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 臺北市技術型高中學生知覺學務創新人力領導風格與幸福感之研究
title_en: The Consciousness of Leadership Styles of Student Affairs Innovation Manpower and Well-being in The Technical Senior High School Students of Taipei City
keywords: 學務創新人力、領導風格、幸福感
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在瞭解臺北市技高學生知覺學創人力領導風格與幸福感之差異情形；探討不同背景變項對臺北市技高學生知覺學創人力領導風格與幸福感之差異情形，並進一步探討臺北市技高學創人力不同領導風格影響學生幸福感之差異情形及其相關性。　　本研究採用「問卷調查法」，以「學創人力領導風格量表」與「學生幸福感量表」作為研究工具。問卷發放對象為110至112年入學之臺北市技高日間部在校學生（不包括綜合高中職業學程），共發放510份調查問卷，問卷回收率為91.96%，對施測後的問卷進行全面之資料數據分析，得出以下結論：1.臺北市技高學生知覺學創人力「領導風格」構面以「智能啟發」為最高，「魅力」為最低。2.臺北市技高學生之「幸福感」整體達中等以上顯著水準，其中以「自我肯定」為最高，最低為「身心健康」。3.臺北市技高學生知覺學創人力「領導風格」會因「性別」、「年級」以及「學校屬性」不同有顯著差異。4.臺北市技高學生「幸福感」會因「性別」、「年級」以及「學校屬性」不同有顯著差異。5.臺北市技高學生幸福感之「生活滿意」、「身心健康」以及「人際關係」會因學創人力領導風格不同而有顯著差異。
abstract_en: This study aims to understand the differences in perceived leadership styles of innovative student affairs personnel and well-being among technical high school students in Taipei City. It explores how different background variables influence these perceptions and further investigates the relationship and differences in student well-being based on the various leadership styles of innovative student affairs personnel in Taipei City's technical high schools.　　This study employs a questionnaire survey method, using the "Innovative Student Affairs Personnel Leadership Styles Scale" and the "Student Well-Being Scale" as research tools. The survey targets daytime students enrolled in Taipei City's technical high schools from the 110th to 112th academic years (excluding comprehensive high school vocational programs). A total of 510 questionnaires were distributed, with a response rate of 91.96%. Comprehensive data analysis of the collected questionnaires led to the following conclusions:1.Among the dimensions of perceived leadership styles of innovative student affairs personnel, technical high school students in Taipei City rated "Intellectual Stimulation" the highest and "Charisma" the lowest.2.The overall well-being of technical high school students in Taipei City reached a significant level above the median, with "Self-Affirmation" scoring the highest and "Physical and Mental Health" scoring the lowest.3.There are significant differences in the perceived leadership styles of innovative student affairs personnel among technical high school students in Taipei City based on "Gender," "Grade," and "School Attributes. "4.The well-being of technical high school students in Taipei City shows significant differences based on "Gender," "Grade," "School Attributes," and "Department."5.The well-being dimensions of "Life Satisfaction," "Physical and Mental Health," and "Interpersonal Relationships" among technical high school students in Taipei City show significant differences based on the different leadership styles of innovative student affairs personnel.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 公立科技大學約聘僱行政人員知覺領導風格及安靜離職之研究－以Ａ校為例
title_en: A Case Study on the Perceived Leadership Style and Quiet Quitting of Contract Administration Staff in A Public Technological University of Taiwan
keywords: 約聘僱行政人員、領導風格、安靜離職
abstract_zh: 新冠疫情期間，「安靜離職」概念開始受到關注，這種現象顯示員工雖然繼續履行職責，卻不再投入到工作中。約聘僱行政人員缺乏升遷機會，在沒有其他工作動機、無法取得內部同僚協助與組織支持的狀況下，單位主管在其工作場域便扮演了十分關鍵的角色。本研究旨在探討某公立科技大學Ａ校的約聘雇行政人員知覺主管領導風格與安靜離職之關係，自行編製「公立科技大學約聘僱行政人員知覺領導風格與安靜離職調查問卷」作為本研究之研究工具，以某公立科技大學A校之約聘僱行政人員為研究母群體進行普查，發出151份問卷，其中有效問卷總計140份，有效問卷回收率為92.72%。研究發現，A校約聘僱行政人員對領導風格整體上感知為高關懷體恤－高任務建構。特別是超過半數的生理男性、40歲以上、無私人機構就業經驗且在教學單位工作的約聘人員，對此領導風格的感知尤為明顯。整體來說，人員的安靜離職傾向屬於中等程度。值得注意的是，年齡未滿35歲且無私人機構就業經驗的行政人員較缺乏主動性。此外，知覺主管的高關懷體恤－高任務建構風格的行政人員會有較低的安靜離職傾向。最後本研究依據研究結果對政府機關、公立大學校院、行政主管及未來研究者提出具體建議。
abstract_en: The concept of "quiet quitting" has garnered significant attention during the COVID-19 pandemic. The term "quiet quitting" describes a situation in which employees fulfill their duties from their tasks while withdraw their engagement in their employment. Contract administrative staff have very limited prospects for promotion. In the absence of supplementary motivators and encouragement from peers or the employer, the function of their unit supervisors becomes crucial.This study endeavors to elucidate the relation between contract administration staff 's perceptions of their supervisors' leadership styles and the propensity for quiet quitting at a public technological university (henceforth referred to as University A). An original survey titled "Survey on Perceived Leadership Style and Quiet Quitting among Contract Administrative Staff at Public Technological Universities," was designed for the research as the primary research instrument. A total of 151 questionnaires were disseminated to the contract administrative staff at University A, with 140 responses deemed valid, resulting in a response rate of 92.72%.The results indicate that the contract administrative staff at University A predominantly perceive their supervisors' leadership style as exhibiting high levels of both benevolence and task orientation. This perception is especially salient among male individuals those aged over 40, without prior experience in private sector organizations while employed within academic departments. Overall, the inclination towards quiet quitting among the staff is moderate. It is noteworthy that administrative staff under the age of 35 and those devoid of private sector experience display diminished proactivity. Additionally, administrative staff who perceive their supervisors as embodying a high-care, high-task-oriented leadership style exhibit a reduced propensity for quiet quitting.In conclusion, the study will provide specific recommendations based on the research findings for government agencies, public university campuses, administrators, and future researchers.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 兩岸中等職業學校汽車科專業課程比較之研究
title_en: A Study of the Comparison on Automobile Professional Courses in Secondary Vocational Schools between Taiwan and Mainland China
keywords: 中等職業學校、技術型高中、專業課程、汽車、職業教育、貝瑞岱比較教育法
abstract_zh: 本研究目的在瞭解臺灣技術型高中與中國大陸中等職業學校汽車專業領域設置上的差異，及課程目標與架構的差異，在此差異下必修專業課程與課程的內涵有何不同，同時也瞭解在汽車專業的實習實訓在兩岸的差異情況。研究採取了貝瑞岱的比較教育研究模式，過程中分析兩岸政府對汽車專業的管理、課程設置、實習實訓的差異，透過專業設置、專業課程目標、專業課程架構、專業必修課程內涵及實習課程五個構面來深入分析比較，同時也進行半結構式專家訪談，以求研究結果盡量公允客觀。經過研究後得到如下的結論：1.臺灣技術型高中汽車科依據動力機械群課程綱要設置，中國大陸中等職業學校汽車專業則依據職業教育專業目錄來設立。2.臺灣技術型高中僅有汽車科，中國大陸中等職業學校汽車專業有汽車運用與維修、汽車車身修理、汽車美容與裝潢、新能源汽車運用與維修、汽車服務與營銷等五個專業。3.兩岸專業課程目標都強調養成職涯規劃與終身學習能力；臺灣注重奠定基礎能力要求多元與適性發展，中國大陸要求意識形態及更多的專業技能。4.專業課程架構上，臺灣除部訂的必修課程一致外，彈性的校訂課程使得每個學校都有不同的特色；而中國大陸課程架構較為單一。5.臺灣技術型高中汽車科部訂必修專業課程主要按類型界定，分為專業科目、實習科目及車輛技能領域。課程內涵設計注重適性發展。6.中國大陸中職汽車運用與維修專業主要必修的專業課程是按層次來界定分為專業基礎課、專業核心課。課程內涵設計注重職業能力需求。7.兩岸主要的必修專業課程上臺灣比較注重基礎理論與基礎實操技能的培養涵蓋較廣，中國大陸課程則針對企業崗位上的能力要求接軌緊密後續專業課程多。8.臺灣多數在校就可以完成實習課程，而臺灣雖然也可校外實習，但非強制；中國大陸專業實習課程多融入每個課程中強調理實一體化，而中國大陸有特有的「崗位實習」可以更有效直接接觸職場。
abstract_en: This study aims to understand the differences between technical high schools in Taiwan and secondary vocational schools in mainland China in the automotive field. It examines variations in curriculum objectives, structures, and the content of compulsory courses, as well as differences in practical training.Using Bereday's comparative education research model, the study analyzes government management, curriculum setup, and practical training in the automotive profession in both regions. The research includes professional setup, course objectives, course structures, compulsory course content, and practical training, supported by semi-structured expert interviews for fairness and objectivity. The study concluded with the following findings: 1.Taiwan's technical high schools set up automotive departments based on the curriculum guidelines for the Power Machinery Group, while mainland China's secondary vocational schools establish automotive programs according to the vocational education professional directory. 2.Taiwan's technical high schools only have an automotive department, whereas mainland China's secondary vocational schools offer five automotive-related majors: Automotive Application and Maintenance, Automotive Body Repair, Automotive Beauty and Decoration, New Energy Vehicle Application and Maintenance, and Automotive Service and Marketing. 3.Both regions emphasize career planning and lifelong learning abilities in their professional course objectives. Taiwan focuses on foundational abilities, diverse and adaptive development, while mainland China emphasizes ideology and more specialized skills. 4.In terms of professional course structure, apart from the unified compulsory courses set by the authorities, Taiwan's flexible school-based courses allow each school to have different characteristics, while mainland China's course structure is relatively uniform. 5.Taiwan's technical high schools' compulsory professional courses are mainly defined by type, divided into professional subjects, practical subjects, and vehicle skills areas, with course content design emphasizing adaptive development. 6.Mainland China's secondary vocational schools' compulsory professional courses for Automotive Application and Maintenance are defined by levels, divided into foundational professional courses and core professional courses, with course content design focusing on vocational ability requirements. 7.Taiwan's compulsory professional courses emphasize a broad foundation of theory and basic practical skills, whereas mainland China's courses are closely aligned with enterprise job requirements and have more follow-up specialized courses. 8.Most of Taiwan's internship courses can be completed within the school, although off-campus internships are possible but not mandatory. Mainland China's professional internship courses are integrated into each course, emphasizing a theoretical and practical integration. Mainland China also has unique "position internships" that provide more effective and direct workplace exposure.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 技術型高中工業類教師實務導向教學影響因素之研究
title_en: A Study on the Influencing Factors of Practice-Oriented Teaching for Industrial Teachers at Skill-Based Senior High Schools
keywords: 實務導向教學、計畫行為理論、態度、主觀規範、感知行為控制
abstract_zh: 本研究探討技術型高中工業類教師在學校進行實務導向教學的感受程度及影響因素。依計畫行為理論之做法，蒐集技術型高中工業類教師之意見，探討行為意圖、態度、主觀規範、感知行為控制、行為信念、規範信念及控制信念。本研究抽樣方法採立意抽樣，洽詢設有工業類群達三群之技術型高中協助填答，問卷共發送621份，獲得544位有效問卷之作答資料進行統計分析。經統計分析技術型高中工業類教師對進行實務導向教學之態度、主觀規範、感知行為控制可以解釋行為意圖66%的變異量。研究發現：態度對行為意圖影響最大；實習主任對工業類教師進行實務導向教學是關鍵角色；要留意化工群教師對於進行實務導向教學的看法；舉辦參與公民營機構研習或研究，有助推動工業類教師進行實務導向教學。本研究結論如下：一、技術型高中工業類教師有高度意願進行實務導向教學。二、感知行為控制直接影響行為意圖，未調節態度、主觀規範對行為意圖產生的影響。三、技術型高中工業類教師進行實務導向教學之行為信念即為態度之主要決定因素，依序為「教導職場所需之能力」、「教導如何處理實務的問題」、「提高學習者學習動機」、「縮短學用落差」、「教學活動與產業界相互鏈結」。四、技術型高中工業類教師進行實務導向教學之規範信念即為主觀規範之主要決定因素，依序為「教師專業學習社群」、「實習主任」、「資深教師」、「科主任」、「學生家長」、「教師團體」、「學生」、「產業界人士」。五、技術型高中工業類教師進行實務導向教學之控制信念即為感知行為控制之主要決定因素，依序是「產業發展趨勢」、「職場工作經驗」、「參與競賽接觸業界最新技術」。六、技術型高中教師「任教群別」、「有無參與公民營機構研習或研究」、「任教學校所在的區域」、「自108年起擔任行政職務年資」、「性別」，會影響進行實務導向教學。最後依據結論對主管教育行政機關、技術型高中及技術型高中教師及未來研究提出建議。
abstract_en: This study explores the degree of perception and influencing factors of practice-oriented teaching by industrial teachers at skill-based senior high schools. According to the Theory of Planned Behavior (TPB), the opinions of industrial teachers at skill-based senior high schools were collected to examine behavioral intentions, Attitudes (AT), Subjective Norms (SN), Perceived Behavioral Control (PBC), behavioral beliefs, normative beliefs and control beliefs. This study adopted purposive sampling, consulting skill-based senior high schools with three industrial clusters to assist in completing the survey. A total of 621 questionnaires were distributed, and 544 valid questionnaire responses were obtained for statistical analysis. The statistical analysis revealed that the attitudes, subjective norms, and perceived behavioral control of industrial teachers at skill-based senior high schools can explain 66% of the variance in behavioral intentions towards practice-oriented teaching.This study found that:1.Attitudes have the greatest impact on behavioral intentions.2.Practicum Administration Office Directors play a key role in promoting practice-oriented teaching among industrial teachers.3.It is crucial to pay attention to the views of chemical engineering teachers regarding practice-oriented teaching.4.Organizing and participating in training or research with public/private institutions can help promote practice-oriented teaching among industrial teachers.The results of this study confirm that:1.Skill-based senior high school industrial teachers have a strong willingness to engage in practice-oriented teaching.2.Perceived behavioral control directly affects behavioral intentions; there was no significant interaction between AT x PBC and SN x PBC.3.The behavioral beliefs of industrial teachers at skill-based high schools primarily shape their attitudes towards practice-oriented teaching. These beliefs prioritize "teaching workplace-required skills," "addressing practical problems," "boosting learners' motivation," "closing the gap between learning and application," and "connecting teaching activities with industry."4.The normative beliefs of industrial teachers at skill-based high schools are the key determinants of subjective norms in practice-oriented teaching. These influences are ranked as follows: "teacher professional learning community," "internship director," "senior teacher," "subject director," "student parents," "teaching groups," "students," and "industry professionals."5.The control beliefs of industrial teachers at skill-based high schools are the main determinants of perceived behavioral control in practice-oriented teaching. These factors are ranked as follows: "industrial development trends," "workplace experience," and "participating in competitions to gain exposure to the latest industry technology."6.Teaching group of skill-based senior high school teachers, participation in training or research with public/private institutions, the region where the school is located, experiences of administrative position since 2019, and gender affect the implementation of practice-oriented teaching.Finally, based on these conclusions, recommendations are provided for the Ministry of Education, schools, teachers, and future research.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 中等教育階段低視力學生使用最佳閱讀文字尺寸之研究
title_en: A Study on the Optimal Character Size for Low-vision Students in Secondary Education
keywords: 低視力學生、閱讀速度、閱讀距離、最佳閱讀文字尺寸
abstract_zh: 低視力學生日常學習多半在近距離情況下，對教材的內容進行辨識。但是由於低視力的緣故，將所要辨識的內容放大即成了最常見的需求。因國內針對繁體中文的放大相關研究缺乏系統性的實驗驗證過程，針對此問題，國際上常見方法是以臨界文字尺寸作為放大的依據，但近年部分國內外研究顯示臨界文字尺寸應用在實際的現場，與學生表現出來的需求有落差。因此本研究旨在瞭解中等教育階段低視力學生，使用標準化測量條件時使用臨界文字尺寸時的視角，與日常不受限閱讀條件時所使用的視角間是否存在差異。本研究採取前實驗設計，以2022與2023學年度全臺就讀公私立中等教育階段國中一年級至高中三年級之間的低視力學生為研究範圍，有效樣本30人。使用之研究工具為「繁體中文標準化臨界文字尺寸測驗」，透過標準化測驗蒐集受試者的臨界文字尺寸視角（理論值），再以不受限閱讀距離的一般閱讀情境下，給予臨界文字尺寸，蒐集受試者實際需要的文字尺寸視角（觀察值），比較兩者間是否有差異。實驗結果表明在控制背景變項的條件下，常用的文字尺寸11pt至55 pt範圍內，兩者間存在顯著差異。根據受試者的實際文字尺寸需求建立迴歸線函數為y = 0.0001x2 + 0.0088x + 0.0283，y為觀察值x為臨界文字尺寸，發現標準化測驗結果須以函數進行修正，依統計結果得到結論為，經過標準化測驗得到之文字尺寸逕行放大1.5倍後，可快速獲得該名受試者最佳閱讀文字尺寸。未來研究希望持續蒐集低視力受試者數據，進一步完善迴歸線函數。
abstract_en: Low vision students often need to magnify reading materials for better recognition, but systematic research on magnification methods for traditional Chinese characters in Taiwan is not well-researched. Internationally, critical print size is used for magnification, but recent studies show a gap between that and the actual size students need in daily practical life. This research aims to find out the difference.The pre-experimental design study included low vision students from grades 7 to 12 in Taiwan during the 2022 & 2023 academic year (n = 30). Using the "Standardized Critical Print Size Test for Traditional Chinese," the study collected theoretical visual angles under standardized conditions and compares them with actual visual angles in unrestricted reading conditions. Results indicated a significant difference between these values within the print size range of 11pt to 55pt.A regression function (y = 0.0001x² + 0.0088x + 0.0283) based on actual needs suggests that standardized test results need correction. The study concludes that magnifying the standardized test's critical print size by 1.5 times can quickly determine each student's optimal reading size. Future research will continue collecting data to refine the regression function.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 美髮連鎖企業Z公司人力資源競爭力及因應策略之研究
title_en: A Study on the Human Resource Competitiveness and Coping Strategies of Z Company in the Hairdressing Chain Industry
keywords: 美髮業、連鎖企業、人力資源、SWOT、TOWS
abstract_zh: 本研究深入探討美髮連鎖企業Z公司，在後疫情時代市場環境變遷下，企業經營者針對產業人才快速變化如何制定有效的策略和因應之道。透過文獻回顧，發現我國美髮業已呈現出產業化、成熟化、集團化、市場化及國際化的趨勢，然而近年來由於少子女化、高齡化社會的影響，加上Covid-19疫情帶來的後續效應，美髮產業面臨諸多挑戰，如勞動力短缺、企業經營困難、消費者消費模式的轉變，以及社群媒體在科技時代的崛起，對傳統營銷方式的衝擊。為了深入理解這些挑戰，本研究運用了SWOT（優勢、劣勢、機會、威脅）分析和TOWS（SO、ST、WO、WT）等分析方法，針對美髮連鎖企業Z公司人力資源進行全面的競爭力評估，研究對象係針對以國內規模一家大型美髮連鎖企業，高層經營管理及人力資源部門相關人員邀約進行半結構式訪談，以蒐集一手資料，透過對這家企業的深入分析研究，揭示了他們在面對後疫情時代的市場挑戰時人力資源競爭力和因應策略。經由訪談資料的蒐整歸納，分析人力資源管理上，人才的選才、用才、育才、留才，並結合SWOT競爭力分析及TOWS因應策略分析整理成結果，以經營層、管理層及技術層三層面進行探討，從而得出具體的結果和建議。
abstract_en: This study delves into how business owners of hair salon chain enterprise Z formulate effective strategies and coping mechanisms in response to the rapid changes in industry talent amid the post-pandemic market environment. Through literature review, it was found that the hair salon industry in Taiwan has shown trends towards industrialization, maturation, group formation, marketization, and internationalization. However, recent challenges in the hair salon industry include labor shortages, operational difficulties, changes in consumer consumption patterns, and the impact of social media on traditional marketing in the technological era, all exacerbated by an aging society with low birth rates, and the subsequent effects of the Covid-19 pandemic.To gain a deep understanding of these challenges, this study employed SWOTanalysis and TOWS analysis methods to comprehensively assess the human resource competitiveness of Hair Salon Chain Enterprise Z. The research focused on a large domestic hair salon chain, with semi-structured interviews conducted with senior management and human resources personnel to collect primary data. Through an in-depth analysis of this enterprise, the study reveals their human resource competitiveness and coping strategies in face of market challenges in the post-pandemic era.By collating and summarizing the interview data, the study analyzes human resource management aspects including talent selection, utilization, development, and retention. Combining SWOT competitiveness analysis and TOWS coping strategy analysis, the results are organized and discussed from three perspectives: executive level, management level, and technical level, providing in-depth insights and leading to specific outcomes and recommendations.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 技術型高中職業倫理學習內容及其權重之研究
title_en: A Study on the Content and Weighting of Vocational Ethics Learning in Vocational High Schools
keywords: 技術型高中、職業倫理、學習內容
abstract_zh: 本研究主要在探討技術型高中職業倫理學習內容及其權重之研究，並在適當的學習時段中加入職業倫理的學習內容，運用傳統在倫理與道德領域的文化知識、起始行為、經驗法則和分層架構，使得技術型高中職業類科的教與學向度，加入職業倫理的脈絡與專業的梗概，讓教學過程與學習成果，能更切合職場、配合輿情與時代背景，以達成有效的學習。本研究先透過文獻分析整理出適用於技術型高中職業倫理學習內容的指引，再委請3位大學教授、3位業界人資與3位技高主管協助進行專家諮詢問卷，並參與施測後的專家會議，彙整出職業倫理學習內容的初稿；另再分別邀請9位業界與9位技高的受試者，執行修正式德菲法的問卷調查（進行三次後達到收斂），產生學習內容與架構；最後再請36位受試者進行層級分析法，產生出「職場倫理實例」、「內部升遷與待遇平等性」和「勞動法規中的職場倫理規範」等前三名的職業倫理的重要學習項目。本研究歸納出適用於技術型高中職業倫理的4個構面、8個向度與23個學習項目、及其權重分析與重要性排序，提供給課程設計或教材編輯領域之學者專家，作為訂定課程或撰寫教科書之章節或單元主題參考之用。
abstract_en: This study primarily investigated the content and weighting of vocational ethics learning in vocational high schools. The main focus was to integrate content related to vocational ethics into the appropriate learning periods of vocational high schools. By utilizing traditional cultural knowledge in the fields of ethics and morality, initial behaviors, experiential rules, and hierarchical structures, the teaching and learning dimensions of vocational subjects of vocational high schools were enriched with vocational ethics and professional frameworks. This alignment aimed to make the teaching process and learning outcomes more workplace-relevant, aligned with public opinion, and reflective of contemporary contexts, thereby achieving efficient learning.The study began with a literature review to compile guidelines for vocational ethics content at the vocational high school level. Subsequently, three university professors, three industry HR professionals, and three technical high school supervisors were invited to assist with an expert consultation questionnaire and to participate in post-test expert meetings, leading to the initial draft of the vocational ethics issues content. Additionally, nine industry professionals and nine vocational high school participants were engaged in a Modified Delphi Method （MDM） questionnaire survey. After three rounds, they reached a consensus, producing the content and framework. Finally, the Analytic Hierarchy Process （AHP）, involving 36 participants, was adopted, identifying "Workplace Ethics Cases," "Internal Promotion and Equality in Treatment," and "Workplace Ethics Regulations in Labor Laws" as the top three important learning items for vocational ethics.This study summarized four dimensions, eight aspects, and twenty-three learning items suitable for vocational ethics in vocational high schools, along with their weight analysis and importance ranking. These findings can serve as a reference for scholars and experts in curriculum design or textbook editing when setting curriculum standards, outlines, or writing chapters or unit themes for textbooks.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 生成式AI輔助技術型高中學生作文學習之研究
title_en: A Study of Generative AI Assisted Composition Learning on Vocational High School Students
keywords: 生成式AI、技術型高中學生、寫作能力、寫作自我調整學習
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在探討生成式AI輔助對技術型高中學生寫作能力和寫作自我調整學習能力的影響。研究目的包括：1.探討生成式AI輔助對技術型高中學生作文能力的影響；2.探討生成式AI輔助對技術型高中學生寫作自我調整學習能力的影響。　　本研究以臺北市某技術型高中家政職群一年級學生為研究對象，採用準實驗研究法，一組為實驗組，一組為對照組，兩組均為30人。教學前，兩組學生先個別進行寫作能力、寫作自我調整學習能力量表之前測。教學中，實驗組以生成式AI輔助作文學習，對照組採同儕互評輔助作文學習，為期6週的實驗，進行兩篇作文寫作。教學後，實驗組與對照組學生個別進行寫作能力、寫作自我調整學習能力量表之後測。最後以SPSS軟體進行統計分析，以瞭解生成式AI輔助作文課程的影響，並參照結論來提出建議。本研究結果有二：一、實驗組學生在生成式AI輔助教學後，寫作能力在內容、組織和語言三個構面上均有顯著提升；對照組學生在同儕互評教學後，寫作能力僅在組織構面達顯著提升，但實驗組在組織和語言構面上的提升幅度均顯著高於對照組。顯示生成式AI輔助教學在提升技術型高中學生的寫作能力方面效果顯著。二、實驗組學生在生成式AI輔助教學後，修改策略、期望調整策略及適應性尋求協助策略均有顯著進步；對照組學生在同儕互評教學後，在修改策略、期望調整策略、適應性尋求協助策略及努力與堅持策略均有顯著進步。生成式AI輔助教學在適應性尋求協助策略方面顯著優於對照組，顯示生成式AI能夠更有效地幫助學生在寫作過程中主動尋求並利用資源來解決問題。
abstract_en: The purpose of this research was to explore the effects of generative AI assistants on vocational high school students' writing ability and writing self-regulated learning strategies.　　This study was a quasi-experimental research. The participants of this study were 60 first-year fashion styling students from a vocational high school in Taipei City. One group being the experimental group and the other being the control group, and both groups consisted of 30 students. Before teaching, the experimental group and the control group students had to take the pre-tests of writing ability and the writing self-regulated learning strategies individually. During instruction, the experimental group used generative AI to assist composition learning, and the control group used peer-assisted composition learning. The 8-week experiment consisted of two composition writing sessions. At the end of the instruction, both the experimental group and the control group completed the post-tests assessing writing ability and self-regulated learning scale.The results of this study are as follows:1. After generative AI-assisted instruction, students in the experimental group showed significant improvement in writing ability across content, organization, and language. While the control group also improved after peer-assisted instruction, the experimental group's gains in organization and language were significantly higher than those of the control group. This demonstrates that generative AI-assisted teaching is effective in enhancing the writing ability of technical high school students.2. Generative AI-assisted instruction significantly outperformed the control group in adaptive help-seeking strategies, indicating that generative AI can more effectively help students actively seek and utilize resources to solve problems during the writing process.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 北部地區公立高中職特殊教育教師專業認同與親師溝通之研究
title_en: A Study on the Professional Identity of Special Education Teachers and Parent-Teacher Communication in Public High Schools and Vocational Schools of Northern Taiwan
keywords: 特殊教育教師、教師專業認同、親師溝通
abstract_zh: 本研究探討北部地區公立高中職特殊教育教師專業認同與親師溝通之關係，以112學年度服務於臺灣北部地區公立高中職特教教師為研究對象。本問卷採便利抽樣，參考相關文獻據以自編之「高中職特教教師專業認同與親師溝通調查問卷」為研究工具，發放358份問卷，問卷回收201份，總回收率為56.1%，剔除無效問卷1份，有效問卷共有200份，有效問卷回收率為99.5%，其中，「高中職特教教師專業認同量表」分為意識型態、工作投入、情感承諾等三個構面，「高中職特教教師親師溝通量表」分成溝通態度、溝通內容、溝通作法等三個構面，以描述性統計、獨立樣本t檢定、單因子變異數、皮爾森積差相關、多元逐步迴歸分析等方法資料進行分析與處理，並依據資料分析之結果歸納如下：一、高中職特教教師整體專業認同達中高程度，尤其意識型態面向表現最佳。二、不同生理性別、教學年資、最高學歷、現任職務、學校類型、任教特教班別之高中職特教教師於教師專業認同無差異。三、以教師職務類別之年齡組討論教師專業認同，50歲(含)以上專任教師於整體教師專業認同呈現相對較佳。四、高中職特教教師整體親師溝通達中高至高程度，尤其溝通作法面向表現最佳。五、不同生理性別、教學年資、最高學歷、現任職務、學校類型、任教特教班別之高中職特教教師於親師溝通無差異。六、  以教師職務類別之年齡組討論親師溝通，50歲(含)以上教師兼任行政職於溝通內容相對較佳。七、  高中職特教教師於教師專業認同與親師溝通呈高度正向關係。八、  高中職特教教師於教師專業認同對親師溝通具有預測力。本研究依據研究結果形成具體建議，以供主管教育行政機關、學校與特教教師及未來研究者參考。
abstract_en: This study aims to investigate the relationship between professional identity and parent-teacher communication among special education teachers in public high schools and vocational schools of Northern Taiwan. The participants were special education teachers from these schools during the 112th academic year. A convenience sampling method was employed, utilizing the self-developed "Survey on Professional Identity and Parent-Teacher Communication of High School and Vocational School Special Education Teachers," which was constructed based on relevant literature. A total of 358 questionnaires were distributed, with 201 questionnaires returned, resulting in a return rate of 56.1%. After excluding one invalid questionnaire, there were 200 valid questionnaires, with a valid return rate of 99.5%. The "Professional Identity Scale for High School and Vocational School Special Education Teachers" included three dimensions: ideological, work involvement, and emotional commitment. The "Parent-Teacher Communication Scale for High School and Vocational School Special Education Teachers" included three dimensions: communication attitudes, communication contents, and communication methods. The data were analyzed using descriptive statistics, independent sample t-test, one-way ANOVA, Pearson correlation and multiple stepwise regression analysis. The study results showed that:1.  The overall professional identity of high school and vocational school special education teachers reached a medium-high level, with the ideological dimension performing the best.2.  Professional identity showed no significant variation across different genders, teaching experiences, education levels, positions, school types, or special education class types.3.  Full-time teachers aged 50 and above demonstrated higher overall professional identity compared to their younger counterparts.4.  The overall parent-teacher communication of high school and vocational school special education teachers reached a medium-high to high level, with communication methods performing the best.5.  Parent-teacher communication did not differ significantly by gender, teaching experience, education level, position, school type, or special education class type.6.  Teachers aged 50 and above with administrative roles showed superior communication contents.7.  A strong positive correlation exists between professional identity and parent-teacher communication.8.  Professional identity of those special education teachers is a predictor of parent-teacher communication effectiveness.This study forms concrete suggestions based on the research results, providing references for educational administrative authorities, schools, special education teachers, and future researchers.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 淨零永續管理人員職能落差與教育訓練需求評估之研究
title_en: A Study on Competency Gap and Training Needs Assessment of Net Zero Sustainability Manager
keywords: 淨零永續管理人員、工作職能、職能落差、教育訓練需求評估
abstract_zh: 隨著全球化的深入及ESG（環境、社會及公司治理）的議題持續高漲，「淨零永續管理人員」變得日益重要，本研究旨在探討淨零永續管理人員的職能內涵，藉由專家的意見與現行淨零永續管理人員自評的現況，依知識、技能與態度分析出職能落差缺口與教育訓練的優先排序。以官方職能基準做為問卷工具問項，並分為專家問卷及自評問卷，專家問卷共收回26份；現行淨零永續管理人員有效問卷則收回395份。統計分析採用描述性統計、K-S適合度檢定、獨立樣本t檢定、單因子變異數分析及IPA分析法，分析結果如下：（一）專家認為淨零永續管理人員重要程度高的工作職能，知識職能內涵：「企業永續發展概念」、「企業治理概念」；技能職能內涵：「溝通協調能力」、「跨單位溝通機制規劃能力」；態度職能內涵：「主動積極」。（二）專家認為淨零永續管理人員需具備大專學歷、3年以上服務年資及先具備相關證照（如ISO14064、ISO14067等）。（三）在製造業、大型企業與5年以上資歷的淨零永續管理人員在各項職能內涵的表現較佳。（四）淨零永續管理人員應加強且持續訓練的職能包含：企業永續發展概念、跨單位溝通機制規劃能力、主動積極。本研究依據結論提供淨零永續管理人員相關建議，以期未來進行培訓計畫的參考依據，減少職能落差的缺口，提升淨零永續管理人員的職能內涵，提升工作績效。
