abstract_en: With the deepening of globalization and the rising importance of ESG (Environmental, Social, and Corporate Governance) issues, the role of "Net Zero Sustainability Managers" has become increasingly significant. This study aims to explore the competencies of Net Zero Sustainability Managers by examining the opinions of experts and the self-assessment of current managers. It analyzes the competency gaps and prioritizes training needs in terms of knowledge, skills, and attitudes. The study uses official competency standards as the basis for the questionnaire, which is divided into expert and self-assessment sections. A total of 26 expert questionnaires and 395 valid self-assessment questionnaires from current Net Zero Sustainability Managers were collected. The statistical analyses include descriptive statistics, K-S goodness-of-fit test, independent sample t-test, one-way ANOVA, and IPA analysis. The results are as follows:1.Experts believe that the most important job competencies of net-zero sustainability managers are: "Corporate sustainable development concept" and "Corporate governance concept" in terms of knowledge competencies connotation; "Communication and coordination ability", "Cross-disciplinary ability" in terms of skill competencies connotation. Unit communication mechanism and planning ability"; in terms of attitude competencies connotation, it is "proactive".2.Experts suggest that net-zero sustainability managers should have at least a college degree, more than three years of work experience, and relevant certifications as prerequisites.3.Net-zero sustainability managers in the manufacturing sector, large corporations, and those with over five years of experience tend to perform better in various competency areas.4.Competencies that net-zero sustainability managers need to strengthen and continuously train in include: "Corporate Sustainability Concepts," "Cross-Unit Communication Mechanism Planning Skills," and being "Proactive and Positive."This study provides recommendations for net-zero sustainability managers based on the conclusions drawn, aiming to serve as a reference for future training programs. These recommendations are intended to reduce the competency gap, enhance the competency content of net-zero sustainability managers, and improve job performance.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 教育程度與主觀社會經濟地位關聯性研究：跨世代的比較
title_en: An Investigation into the Correlation Between Educational Attainment and Subjective Socio-Economic Status: A Cross-Generational Comparative Study Individual Subjective Social Status
keywords: 主觀社會經濟階層、教育程度、職業的技術層次
abstract_zh: 對於一般社會大眾而言，教育程度在成長背景中扮演重要角色，除家庭因素外，教育程度對個人的社會地位和發展產生深遠影響。教育在個人一生中扮演重要社會功能，反映社會狀態。主觀社會經濟地位（Subjective Social Status, SSS）是評估個人社會地位的關鍵指標之一。因此，本研究旨在探討教育程度與個人主觀社會經濟地位之間的關聯。教育的終極目標是促進就業機會，然而，隨著時代演變，教育和就業市場亦呈現多樣化。因此，本研究目的一主要關注探討不同世代公民教育程度與其從事之職業技術層次之間的相互關係。此外，本研究目的二將進一步探討不同世代公民教育程度對職業技術層次和個人主觀社會經濟地位的影響，以深入瞭解背後的差異和原因。本研究使用「臺灣社會變遷基本調查」問卷作為數據來源，本研究選擇將2005年、2010年、2015年和2020年中31至40歲的人群作為主要研究對象，這些樣本代表了臺灣不同教育層次及不同世代的國民。本研究方法採用描述性統計以及中介效果來探討臺灣不同世代公民教育程度是否透過職業技術層次與自我主觀社會經濟地位有關係。經過研究後證實了臺灣高等教育普及化現象、臺灣2005年至2020年不同職業技術層次人數比例的穩定趨勢，還有因為臺灣高等教育普及化的原因，大學畢業生產生從事低階工作的現象。而經過分析資料發現，2005年到2010年教育程度會透過職業技術層次對主觀社會經濟地位有著顯著的正向關聯，但到了2020年，此中介效果就消失了。最後，本研究建議針對教育制度，學校應強化職業教育課程，注重職業教育和技能培訓，提供多元教育選擇，以縮小教育與就業斷裂。加強職業指導和就業輔導，協助畢業生順利融入就業市場，調整人才培養方向，促進學生實踐能力與創新思維，滿足產業需求。
abstract_en: Education plays a crucial role in the upbringing of individuals in society, exerting profound effects on their social status and development, alongside familial factors. It serves significant societal functions throughout one's life, serving as a reflection of social standing. Subjective Social Status (SSS) stands as a key indicator in assessing individual social status. Therefore, this study aims to explore the correlation between education level and subjective social status. While the ultimate goal of education is to promote employment opportunities, the evolution of education and the job market has brought about diversification. Thus, this study primarily focuses on investigating the interrelation between education levels and the occupational skill levels of citizens across different generations. Furthermore, it aims to delve deeper into how varying educational levels among different generations influence both occupation and individual subjective social status, aiming to understand underlying differences and causes. Data from the "Basic Survey of Social Change in Taiwan" questionnaire serve as the basis for this research. The study selects individuals aged 31 to 40 in 2005, 2010, 2015, and 2020 as the main subjects, representing various educational backgrounds and generations in Taiwan. Descriptive statistics and mediation effects are employed to examine whether different generations of Taiwanese citizens' education levels are related to their occupations and subjective social status. The study confirms the phenomenon of higher education popularization in Taiwan, stable trends in the proportions of individuals across different occupational skill levels from 2005 to 2020, as well as the phenomenon of university graduates engaging in low-skilled jobs due to the popularization of higher education in Taiwan. Analysis of the data reveals that from 2005 to 2010, there is a significant positive correlation between education level and subjective social status through occupational skill levels, but this mediation effect disappears by 2020. Finally, the study suggests enhancements to the educational system, emphasizing vocational education curricula, focusing on vocational education and skills training, providing diverse educational choices to bridge the gap between education and employment. Strengthening career guidance and employment counseling to assist graduates in smoothly transitioning into the job market, adjusting talent development directions, promoting students' practical abilities, and innovative thinking to meet industry demands.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 社會情緒學習融入生涯發展課程對國中生生涯決策自我效能之影響
title_en: The Effects of Integrating Social Emotional Learning into Career Development Curriculum on Junior High School Students' Career Decision-Making Self-Efficacy
keywords: 社會情緒學習、社會情緒能力、生涯發展、生涯決策自我效能
abstract_zh: 隨著多元入學方案的實施，國中畢業生面臨更多的選擇，需要即時思考未來以進行抉擇。在這個過程中，學生會感到徬徨或是因生活經驗不足導致猶豫不決。而這幾年國內外推廣的「社會情緒學習（SEL）」課程逐漸受到重視。過往文獻顯示，藉由社會情緒學習課程，學生社會情緒能力顯著提升，對自身有積極的態度，進而提升表現。因此本研究旨在探討社會情緒學習融入生涯發展課程對國中生「社會情緒能力」及「生涯決策自我效能」之影響本研究採用準實驗研究法，研究對象為新北市某國中56位九年級學生，實驗組28人，對照組28人，每週一次課程，每次45分鐘，研究期間為九週。實驗期間實驗組採用社會情緒學習融入課程。課程設計依據美國「學業、社交與情緒學習組織」（CASEL）的「自我覺察」、「社會覺察」、「自我管理」、「人際關係技巧」、「做負責任的決定」五大核心能力。對照組則採用講述法。研究工具包含「社會情緒學習量表」、「生涯決策自我效能量表」。研究結果顯示，實驗組與對照組在實驗教學後，社會情緒學習與生涯決策自我效能皆優於實驗前，但經統計分析後，兩組之間的社會情緒學習與生涯決策自我效能表現未達顯著差異。故實施社會情緒學習融入生涯發展課程與講述法進行生涯發展課程，對學生的社會情緒學習與生涯決策自我效能差異不大。推測可能原因為社會情緒學習所強調的核心能力與生涯發展課程所涵蓋的議題相似。
abstract_en: With the implementation of the Diversity Enrollment Program, high school graduates are faced with more choices and need to think about their future in order to make choices. During this process, students may feel worried or hesitant due to lack of life experience. In recent years, social-emotional learning (SEL) programs have been promoted both domestically and internationally. Literature has shown that through SEL programs, students' social-emotional competence has been significantly improved, and they have positive attitudes toward themselves, which in turn improves their performance. Therefore, this study aims to investigate the effects of integrating social-emotional learning into career development programs on social-emotional competence and career decision-making self-efficacy of secondary school students in Taiwan.In this study, a quasi-experimental research method was used, and the subjects were 56 ninth-grade students in a junior high school in New Taipei City, with 28 students in the experimental group and 28 students in the control group, who were given weekly 45-minute sessions for a nine-week period. The experimental group used social-emotional learning to integrate into the curriculum during the experimental period. The design of the curriculum was based on the five core competencies of "self-awareness", "social awareness", "self-management", "relationship skills", and "responsible decision-making" of the American organization CASEL (Council for Academic, Social, and Emotional Learning). For the control group, the narrative method was used. The instruments used in the study included the Social-Emotional Learning Inventory and the Self-Efficacy for Career Decision Making Inventory.The results of the study showed that the social-emotional learning and career decision-making self-efficacy of the experimental group and the control group were better than that of the pre-test group after the experimental teaching, but after statistical analysis, the social-emotional learning and career decision-making self-efficacy of the two groups did not reach a significant difference in performance. Therefore, there was no significant difference between the social-emotional learning and career decision-making self-efficacy between the two groups after the statistical analysis. It was hypothesized that the core competencies emphasized in social-emotional learning were similar to the topics covered in the career development curriculum.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 探討網路學習環境對於技術型高中學生數位分心之研究
title_en: A Study on Digital Distractions for Technical High School Students in Online Learning Environments
keywords: 網路學習環境、數位分心、Google Classroom
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在探討網路學習環境對於技術型高中學生數位分心之研究，研究方法為問卷調查法，以北部某技術型高中多媒體設計科一年級的學生作為研究母體，採用Chandra and Fisher (2009); Halubanza 等 (2023)修改的「網路學習環境量表」(Web-Based Learning Environment Instrument, WBLEI)及Wu(2015)、Wu(2017)、Wu and Cheng(2019)開發及修正之「線上學習注意力與調節策略量表」(Online Learning Motivated Attention and Regulation Strategies v.2, OL-MARS v.2)作為施測工具，藉由兩份問卷量表了解目前技術型高中學生對於網路學習環境感知以及數位分心之線上學習注意力與調節策略。本研究發現結果如下：一、技術型高中學生呈現高程度的網路學習環境感知。二、技術型高中學生對於數位分心呈現較低的注意力問題感知。三、技術型高中學生對於數位分心呈現較低的注意力調節策略。四、不同性別技術型高中學生感知網路學習環境並無太大差異。五、技術型高中男性學生感知網路學習環境之互動性明顯高於女性學生。六、技術型高中男性學生感知網路學習環境之結果性明顯高於女性學生。七、不同性別技術型高中學生線上學習注意力問題感知並無太大差異。八、不同性別技術型高中學生線上學習注意力調節策略並無太大差異。九、技術型高中學生網路學習環境與數位分心之注意力問題感知和調節策略沒有明顯關聯。十、網路學習環境感知之「存取」與線上學習注意力與調節策略之「結果評鑑」有明顯相關。
abstract_en: This study aims to explore the impact of online learning environments on digital distraction among technical high school students. The research method employed is a questionnaire survey, with the study population being first-year students from the Multimedia Design Department of a technical high school in northern Taiwan. The instruments used include the "Web-Based Learning Environment Instrument (WBLEI)" modified by Chandra and Fisher (2009) and Halubanza et al. (2023), as well as the "Online Learning Motivated Attention and Regulation Strategies v.2 (OL-MARS v.2)" developed and revised by Wu (2015), Wu (2017), and Wu and Cheng (2019). Through these two questionnaires, the study seeks to understand current perceptions of online learning environments and digital distraction attention and regulation strategies among technical high school students.The findings of this study are as follows:1.Technical high school students exhibit a high level of perception of the online learning environment.2.Technical high school students have a low level of attention problem perception regarding digital distraction.3.Technical high school students exhibit a low level of attention regulation strategies for digital distraction.4.There is no significant difference in the perception of the online learning environment between male and female technical high school students.5.Male technical high school students perceive significantly higher interactivity in the online learning environment compared to female students.6.Male technical high school students perceive significantly higher outcomes in the online learning environment compared to female students.7.There is no significant difference in online learning attention problem perception between male and female technical high school students.8.There is no significant difference in online learning attention regulation strategies between male and female technical high school students.9.There is no significant correlation between the online learning environment and attention problem perception and regulation strategies for digital distraction among technical high school students.10.There is a significant correlation between the "access" aspect of the online learning environment perception and the "result evaluation" aspect of online learning attention and regulation strategies.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 虛擬實境應用於高中階段自閉症學生門市交易社會技巧訓練
title_en: The Effects of Virtual Reality on the Training of Workplace Social Skills for Students with ASD in the Senior High School
keywords: 虛擬實境、自閉症學生、社會技巧
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在探討虛擬實境融入社會技巧課程，對高中階段自閉症學生門市交易社會技巧訓練之成效，目標行為包括接待客人時的接待基本禮儀、與客人禮貌回應及交易行為等。本研究採用單一受試研究法的「A-B-C撤回設計」，自變項為「虛擬實境應用於門市交易社會技巧訓練方案」，依變項為「門市交易社會技巧立即成效」、「門市交易社會技巧維持成效」及「門市交易社會技巧類化成效」，研究對象為一名高中階段中度自閉症學生，透過虛擬實境應用於門市交易社會技巧訓練方案進行教學及評量，正式實驗階段分為A-B-C三個階段，於此三階段中，進行為期8週，共16次資料收集，並依據受試者於不同設計情境之應對及表現，進行質性描述與量化分析，採用圖示法以曲線呈現介入後的改變及技能保留情形。研究結果顯示，虛擬實境應用於高中階段自閉症學生接待基本禮儀、禮貌回應及交易行為訓練有立即效果，並於視覺提示撤除後有維持效果及完全撤除視覺提示及口語提示在校園環境實際演練時有類化效果，且於真實情境透過門市交易服務滿意度問卷，調查十位評分者所給予的總體滿意度達4.7分(滿分5分)。針對此次研究結果，提供課程規劃及教學目標、類化情境善用虛擬實境、技術及設備支持、擴展應用領域及增加受試者等研究及課程相關建議，作為未來研究者研究方向及教育現場教師教學融入的參考。針對此次研究結果，提供課程規劃及教學目標、類化情境善用虛擬實境、技術及設備支持、擴展應用領域及增加受試者等研究及課程相關建議，作為未來研究者研究方向及教育現場教師教學融入的參考。
abstract_en: The aim of this study is to investigate the effectiveness of integrating virtual reality into a social skills curriculum for high school students with autism spectrum disorder (ASD) in the context of retail transaction social skill training. Target behaviors include basic reception etiquette, polite responses to customers, and transactional behaviors.The study adopts a single-subject research design using an "A-B-C withdrawal design." The independent variable is "the application of virtual reality in a social skills training program for retail transactions," and the dependent variables are "immediate effects of social skills in retail transactions," "maintenance of social skills in retail transactions," and "generalization of social skills in retail transactions." The study subject is one high school student with moderate ASD. Teaching and assessment are conducted through the application of virtual reality in a social skills training program for retail transactions. The formal experimental phase consists of three stages: A-B-C, each lasting for 8 weeks with a total of 16 data collection sessions. Qualitative descriptions and quantitative analyses are conducted based on the subject's responses and performances in different design situations. Changes and skill retention after intervention are presented graphically using curves.The results indicate that the application of virtual reality in training high school students with ASD in basic reception etiquette, polite responses, and transactional behaviors has immediate effects. Furthermore, there is a sustained effect after the removal of visual prompts, and a generalization effect is observed when visual and verbal prompts are completely removed during actual practice in the school environment. Additionally, satisfaction surveys conducted with ten evaluators in real-life situations using retail transaction services yielded an overall satisfaction score of 4.7 out of 5.Based on the findings of this study, recommendations are provided for curriculum planning, instructional objectives, utilization of virtual reality in contextual scenarios, technical and equipment support, expansion of application areas, and increasing the number of subjects. These suggestions serve as directions for future researchers and as references for educators integrating such techniques into teaching practices.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 技術型高中學習障礙學生數學學習導入認知與後設認知策略教學之行動研究
title_en: An Action Research on Applying Cognitive and Metacognitive Strategy Instruction in Mathematics Learning for Students with Learning Disabilities in Vocational High School
keywords: 學習障礙、認知策略、後設認知策略
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在探討認知與後設認知策略教學對技術型高中學習障礙學生數學學習之影響，包含學生在數學學習之影響與挑戰及教學過程中教師設計與實施遭遇之問題與解決方法、專業省思與成長。   本研究採用行動研究法，研究對象為研究者任教之技術型高中安置於普通班的七位學習障礙學生，進行為期八週之研究。本研究採用龍騰版本技術型高中數學教材，搭配記憶策略、推理策略及自我教導策略、自我提問策略及自我監控策略進行教學。   根據行動研究歷程所蒐集之資料進行整理與分析後，本研究得到結論如下：一、教師設計及實施認知與後設認知策略教學時教材宜簡潔明瞭，可提供必要的鷹架或課前複習，以確保學生具備基礎能力；二、認知與後設認知策略教學對於提升學習障礙學生之數學學習有顯著提升效果，學習障礙特質可能影響學生使用後設認知策略之效果；三、經觀察，自我監控策略對學習障礙生較有挑戰性，多數學生缺乏修正錯誤的能力；四、應考量學生的學習障礙類型可能造成的影響，選用更適合的認知策略。
abstract_en: This study aimed to explore the impact of cognitive and metacognitive strategy instruction on mathematics learning for students with learning disabilities in Vocational high school. This included examining the effectiveness and challenges faced by students in mathematics learning, as well as the problems was encountered by teachers in designing and implementing instructional processes, along with their solutions, professional reflection, and growth.    This study adopted an action research and focuses on a group of 7 students with learning  disabilities in the vocational high school. The study lasted for 8 weeks. This study utilized the mathematics B curriculum from a vocational high school and incorporated learning strategies such as memory strategy,organizational strategy, self-instructional strategy, self-questioningstrategy, and self-monitoring strategy.    Based on the data collected and analyzed throughout the action research process, the conclusions of this study are as follows: 1. When designing and implementing cognitive and metacognitive strategy instruction, teaching materials should be clear and concise, with necessary scaffolding or pre-class review provided to ensure students have foundational skills. 2. Cognitive and metacognitive strategy instruction significantly improves mathematics learning for students with learning disabilities. However, the characteristics of learning disabilities may affect the effectiveness of students' use of metacognitive strategies. Therefore, it is essential to assess whether students are suitable for such strategies and to assist them in finding more suitable learning strategies. 3. Through observation, it was noted that self monitoring strategies pose more challenges for students with learning disabilities, as moststudents lack the ability to correct errors. 4. Consideration should be given to the potential impact of students' specific learning disabilities when selecting more suitable cognitive strategies.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 國立科技大學機械工程系產學訓專班畢業生學習經驗與就業力之研究
title_en: A study on the learning experience and employability of graduates from the industrial-academic training class of the Department of Mechanical Engineering of the National University of Science and Technology
keywords: 產學訓專班、學習經驗、就業力
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在探討國立科技大學機械工程系產學訓專班畢業生學習經驗與就業力之關係，瞭解不同背景變項之國立科技大學機械工程系產學訓專班畢業生在參訓期間的學習經驗與就業力之具備情形。本研究採用問卷調查法，研究工具為「國立科技大學機械工程系產學訓專班畢業生學習經驗與就業力」問卷，以2017至2021學年度之國立科技大學機械工程系產學訓專班畢業生為研究對象，共發出問卷313份，回收有效問卷為203份，有效回收率達 64.9%。統計方法採描述性統計、單一樣本t檢定、獨立樣本t檢定、單因子變異數分析與皮爾森積差相關進行資料分析。本研究獲得結論如下：一、  國立科技大學機械工程系產學訓專班畢業生整體學習經驗為良好，其中以職涯輔導活動最高。二、  國立科技大學機械工程系產學訓專班畢業生整體就業力為良好程度，其中以專業態度程度最高。三、  國立科技大學機械工程系產學訓專班畢業生整體學習經驗與整體就業力呈現非常高度相關。    根據結論提出若干建議及後續研究方向，提供相關人士參考。
abstract_en: This study aims to explore the relationship between the learning experience and employability of graduates from the industrial-academic training class of the Department of Mechanical Engineering at the National University of Science and Technology. It seeks to understand the learning experiences and employability of these graduates during their training period, considering different background variables. The study employs a questionnaire survey method, using the "Learning Experience and Employability of Graduates from the Industrial-Academic Training Class of the Department of Mechanical Engineering at the National University of Science and Technology" questionnaire. The subjects of the study are graduates from the academic years 2017 to 2021, with 313 questionnaires distributed and 203 valid responses collected, yielding a valid response rate of 64.9%. Statistical methods such as descriptive statistics, one-sample t-test, independent sample t-test, one-way ANOVA, and Pearson product-moment correlation were used for data analysis. The conclusions of this study are as follows:1.  The overall learning experience of graduates from the industrial-academic training class of the Department of Mechanical Engineering at the National University of Science and Technology is positive, with career counseling activities rated the highest.2.  The overall learning experience of graduates from the industrial-academic training class of the Department of Mechanical Engineering at the National University of Science and Technology is positive, with career counseling activities rated the highest.3.  The overall learning experience of graduates from the industrial-academic training class of the Department of Mechanical Engineering at the National University of Science and Technology is positive, with career counseling activities rated the highest.Based on these conclusions, several suggestions and directions for future research are proposed to provide reference for relevant parties.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 探討國中生的時型與情緒對數位分心之影響
title_en: Exploring the Influence of Junior High School Students' Chronotype and Emotion on Digital Distraction
keywords: 時型、情緒、數位分心
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在探討時型與情緒對數位分心的影響，研究方法為問卷調查法，採用「簡化MEQ量表」、「線上學習情緒量表」、「線上學習注意力與調節策略量表」作為施測工具，研究對象為臺北市某公立國中以線上學習為主之國中生，兩個班級共42位，課程內容為跨領域彈性課程，調查所得數據以描述性統計、獨立樣本t檢定、單因子變異數分析、皮爾森積差相關、多元線性迴歸進行分析，本研究結果歸結如下：一、國中生「中間型」的人數最多，次多為「夜晚型」，最少為「早晨型」；「無聊」情緒程度最高，「焦慮」情緒程度最低；「注意力自我調節策略」平均得分高於「感知注意力問題」，其中以「結果評鑑」最高。二、國中生性別與情緒、性別與數位分心皆無顯著差異。三、「早晨型」的國中生「結果評鑑」顯著低於「中間型」、「夜晚型」。四、國中生情緒與數位分心無顯著相關。五、國中生時型、情緒對於數位分心無顯著影響力。
abstract_en: This study aims to investigate the influence of chronotype and emotion on digital distraction. The research method employed was a questionnaire survey, utilizing the "Morningness-Eveningness Euestionnaire: A reduced scale, rMEQ", the "Online Learning Emotion Questionnaire", and the "Online Learning Motivated Attention and Regulatory Strategies scale v.2, OL-MARS v.2" as measurement tools. The participants were 42 junior high school students from a public junior high school in Taipei City, where online learning was the primary mode of instruction. The curriculum consisted of interdisciplinary flexible courses. The data collected from the survey were analyzed using descriptive statistics, independent samples t-tests, one-way analysis of variance (ANOVA), Pearson correlation coefficients, and multiple linear regression. The findings of this study are summarized as follows:1.Among junior high school students, the majority fall into the "Intermediate" chronotype category, followed by "Evening" types, and the fewest are "Morning" types. The highest level of emotional state is "Boredom," while the lowest is "Anxiety." The average score for "Self-Regulation Strategies" is higher than for "Perceived Attention Problem," with "Outcome Appraisal" being the highest among them.2.There are no significant differences between junior high school students' gender and their emotion or digital distraction.3."Morning" type junior high school students exhibit significantly lower "Outcome Appraisal" scores compared to "Intermediate" and "Evening" types.4.There is no significant correlation between junior high school students' emotion and digital distraction.5.The chronotype and emotion of junior high school students do not significantly influence digital distraction.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 翻轉教學對技術型高中自主學習動機之行動研究－以室內配線實習課程為例
title_en: Action Research on the Impact of Flipped Classroom Teaching on Autonomous Learning Motivation in Technical High Schools – A Case Study of Indoor Wiring Practicum Courses
keywords: 翻轉教學、實習課程、學習動機
abstract_zh: 在資訊科技蓬勃發展的時代，如何跳脫傳統的團體教學模式框架，在有限的課程時間內，透過「翻轉教學」之教學方式協助引導技術型高中學生學習，將課堂所需之教學影片上傳放置YouTube，再複製連結教學影片教材放置「通訊軟體群組」讓學生可隨時查看做課前準備及預習，亦提供學生豐富的學習資源及學習管道，並培育學生自主思考及自主學習的能力是目前教育需要探討的議題。技術型高中之教學課程現況，大多以透過教師之傳統講述及示範作教學，學生則遵循教師教學操作方式，這使得學生較為被動之學習模式，學生也較少自行思考與創意發想，及培養問題的解決能力。因此，本研究進行「翻轉教學」應用於技術型高中之室內配線實習課程學習動機之行動研究。根據研究目的，蒐集國內外文獻探討並研擬「翻轉教學」之課程教案，以國內某技術型高中二年級的學生37位學生為研究對象，期望採用質性為主，量化為輔之行動研究，以「翻轉教學」進行室內配線實習課程教學，並依據前述文獻探討作為理論基礎，探討翻轉教學運用在技術型高中室內配線實習課程中之學生學習成效及自主學習動機。本行動研究以教師觀察紀錄、教學省思、學生訪談、課堂講義與紀錄單等質性資料作為整理歸納；再輔以回饋單的填答進行量化分析，探討學生的學習成效，並根據本研究之結論，提出翻轉教學運用室內配線實習課程之具體建議，期以作為實作課程教師教之參考。經研究發現，獲得以下結論：一、翻轉教學適用於技術型高中之室內配線實習課程。二、本研究翻轉教學可提升實習術科成績表現。三、翻轉教學有效提升學生自主學習動機。
abstract_en: Qualitative data, including teacher observations, reflective teaching journals, student interviews, and class materials, were collected and analyzed. Quantitative analysis was conducted using feedback forms to explore students' learning outcomes. Based on the conclusions drawn from the research, specific recommendations for the application of flipped classroom in the indoor wiring practicum course are presented, serving as a reference for practical course instructors.The experimental findings led to the following conclusions：1.  Flipped classroom is applicable to technical high school indoor wiring practicum courses.2.  The implementation of flipped classroom enhances the performance of students in practical subjects.3.  Flipped classroom effectively boosts students' motivation for autonomous learning.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: The Relationship Among Entrepreneurship Education, Entrepreneurial Self-Efficacy, Psychological Capital, and, Entrepreneurial Intention for Students at one Technological University
title_en: The Relationship Among Entrepreneurship Education, Entrepreneurial Self-Efficacy, Psychological Capital, and, Entrepreneurial Intention for Students at one Technological University
keywords: Entrepreneurship、Entrepreneurship Education、Entrepreneurial Intention、Entrepreneurial Self-Efficacy、Psychological capital
abstract_zh: The purpose of this study is to examine value of entrepreneurship education and how it affects students' intentions and self-efficacy at Taiwan technological university. The study also attempts to look into how entrepreneurial self-efficacy and psychological capital mediate the relationship between students' entrepreneurial intention and entrepreneurship education. In order to research the method used in this study, a standardized questionnaire was used to conduct a cross-sectional survey among students at a technological institution. The survey data was analyzed in two phases: first, descriptive analysis was performed such as validity and reliability. Next, One-Way ANOVA, correlation analysis, and linear regression analysis were performed to verify the hypothesis. Finally, mediation analysis was performed using SPSS software's "The Process Macro." According to the findings of this study, first, the One-way ANOVA results shows that there is no significant difference among EI, ESE, PC between male and female students, students with different educational backgrounds and, students who attended any EEC. The study also shows that good entrepreneurship education is crucial by showing a positive relationship between EI, ESE, and PC. Additionally, the study highlights the strong predictive relationship between ESE and EI, PC and EI and point out the role of self-belief and, PC in motivating individuals’ intentions to pursue entrepreneurial endeavors and how ESE partially mediate relationship and on the other hand PC does not put any effect on the relationship between EE and EI. At the end, the implications of the study is that it illustrates the complex interactions that exist between entrepreneurship education intention, self-efficacy and psychological capital in the context of entrepreneurship.
abstract_en: The purpose of this study is to examine value of entrepreneurship education and how it affects students' intentions and self-efficacy at Taiwan technological university. The study also attempts to look into how entrepreneurial self-efficacy and psychological capital mediate the relationship between students' entrepreneurial intention and entrepreneurship education. In order to research the method used in this study, a standardized questionnaire was used to conduct a cross-sectional survey among students at a technological institution. The survey data was analyzed in two phases: first, descriptive analysis was performed such as validity and reliability. Next, One-Way ANOVA, correlation analysis, and linear regression analysis were performed to verify the hypothesis. Finally, mediation analysis was performed using SPSS software's "The Process Macro." According to the findings of this study, first, the One-way ANOVA results shows that there is no significant difference among EI, ESE, PC between male and female students, students with different educational backgrounds and, students who attended any EEC. The study also shows that good entrepreneurship education is crucial by showing a positive relationship between EI, ESE, and PC. Additionally, the study highlights the strong predictive relationship between ESE and EI, PC and EI and point out the role of self-belief and, PC in motivating individuals’ intentions to pursue entrepreneurial endeavors and how ESE partially mediate relationship and on the other hand PC does not put any effect on the relationship between EE and EI. At the end, the implications of the study is that it illustrates the complex interactions that exist between entrepreneurship education intention, self-efficacy and psychological capital in the context of entrepreneurship.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 我國公務人員彈性工時需求程度對工作滿意度之影響—以主觀幸福感為中介變項
title_en: The Impact of Flexible Working Hours Requirements for Civil Servants on Job Satisfaction in Taiwan –Taking Subjective Well-being as Mediator
keywords: 公務人員、彈性工時、工作滿意度、主觀幸福感
abstract_zh: 彈性工時的制度設計會提升員工的工作滿意度與幸福程度。而在我國公務人員的工作場域卻經常缺乏彈性。本研究旨在探討我國公務人員彈性工時需求程度對工作滿意度及主觀幸福感之影響，同時探討個人與家庭之不同背景變項的公務人員在彈性工時需求程度、工作滿意度及主觀幸福感的差異情況。本研究採問卷調查法，透過文獻探討發展出本研究之「公務人員彈性工時需求」、「工作滿意度」及「主觀幸福感」量表。調查採用分層叢集抽樣方式，以我國行政院各部會與臺灣地區地方政府行政機關之公務人員為研究對象，共回收有效問卷732份。本研究利用之統計方法包含描述性統計、獨立樣本t檢定、單因子變異數分析、皮爾森相關積差、迴歸分析等。本研究發現滿足公務人員彈性工時之需求，有助於提升其工作滿意度；滿足公務人員彈性工時之需求，有助於提升其主觀幸福感；公務人員之主觀幸福感有助於提升其工作滿意度等主要結論，亦針對我國公務人員彈性工時的相關議題與政策提出建議，希冀作為未來公務人員相關制度設計之參考。
abstract_en: Literature shows that flexible working hour designs may raise employees’ job satisfaction level and their happiness. Heretofore, civil servants are often work under an environment with less flexibility in Taiwan. This study investigates the relationships among the three dimensions demand for flexible working hours, job satisfaction, and subjective well-being, of civil servants in Taiwan. It also examines the diverging levels in these aspects of various individual’s and household’s characteristics. It develops a questionnaire incorporating measures for the three aspects. The sampling process collects data from civil servants of Executive Yuan and its associating agencies, and government agencies at county levels, yielding 732 valid questionnaires. The statistical methods utilized are descriptive statistics, independent sample t test, one-way ANOVA, Pearson correlation, and regression analysis. The result suggests that fulfilling the demand for flexible working hours enhances civil servant’s job satisfaction and subjective well-being. In addition, the subjective well-being of civil servants and their job satisfaction are positively correlated. The study concludes with suggestions for possible policies or working environment designs based on the results.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 技術型高中彈性學習課程規劃與實施現況之研究
title_en: A Study of the Current Status of Alternative Curriculum Planning and Implementation in Technical and Vocational High Schools
keywords: 技術型高中、彈性學習課程、規劃與實施現況
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在討論全臺（不含離島區域）之技術型高中彈性學習時間的「規劃及執行情形」、「執行成果」、「遭遇問題」及「因應策略」，並從教師個人背景變項及學校背景變項探究影響上述「執行成果」、「遭遇問題」及「因應策略」構面之差異性。本研究採文獻分析法及問卷調查法，首先，藉由文獻分析整理臺灣彈性學習時間的沿革、執行情形、遭遇問題及因應策略；再由高級中等學校課程計畫平臺取得34間前導學校的資料討論其課程開設樣態與面臨困境，以作為問卷設計之基礎。接著，參考「臺灣後期中等教育長期追蹤資料庫」之「110學年度高中、高職學校人員問卷」，結合前述文獻分析所得之資料編制「技術型高中彈性學習時間課程之規劃與實施調查問卷」，擬定為行政人員版及任課教師版研究工具初稿，經預試後確認研究工具的信效度。本研究從全臺灣北、中、南、東區域依學校規模之比例共抽取56校的行政人員及任課教師作為研究對象，共發放行政人員版問卷56份、任課教師版問卷1,080份，回收行政人員版問卷78份、任課教師版問卷670份；行政人員版有效問卷為78份，任課教師版有效問卷為665份，問卷有效回收率為65.4%。統計方法採描述性統計分析、單一樣本t檢定、獨立樣本t檢定、單因子變數分析、複選題分析等方法。經資料整理及統計分析後，得出以下結論：一、多數學校規劃彈性學習課程過程順利，有教授彈性學習課程教師以教授1-2門居多，修課學生多由同校跨群學生組成。二、教師對彈性學習課程執行成果，以「讓教師能運用更多元的教學方法」感受符合程度最高、「課程能提升教師教學熱忱」感受符合程度最低。三、教師對彈性學習課程遭遇問題，以「跨群科學生能力落差大」感受符合程度最高、「教師指定學生選課」感受符合程度最低。四、教師對彈性學習課程遭遇問題之因應策略，以「部分全學期授課課程可採計學分，提升學生學習動機。」同意程度最高、「整合學校鄰近資源，解決資源不足之問題。」同意程度最低。五、在不同背景教師部分，北部區域教師對彈性學習課程執行成果知覺較高，任教10年-未滿15年教師對其遭遇問題知覺程度較高。最後根據研究結論，並針對技術型高中、學校行政人員與任課教師提出建議。
abstract_en: This study aimed to examine the planning and implementation status, implementation outcomes, challenges encountered, and response strategies of alternative learning periods in technical and vocational high schools across Taiwan (excluding outlying islands). Furthermore, it investigated how the variables of school backgrounds and teacher personal backgrounds had affected the differences in the aspects of implementation outcomes, challenges encountered, and response strategies.This study employed a document analysis method alongside a questionnaire survey method. Initially, through document analysis, the evolution, implementation status, challenges encountered, and response strategies related to alternative learning periods in Taiwan were systematically organized. Subsequently, data were collected from 34 pilot schools out of the Senior High School Curriculum Planning Platform to explore their states and challenges of curriculum offerings, serving as the foundation for designing the questionnaire. Afterwards, referring to the 2021 High School and Vocational School Personnel Questionnaire in Taiwan Upper Secondary Database, the gathered information from the aforementioned document analysis was then integrated to compile the Investigation Questionnaire for Planning and Implementation of Alternative Learning Periods in technical and vocational high schools, drafted as the initial research instruments for two versions, including administrative staff and subject teachers. The initial drafts of these research instruments were then subjected to a pretest to confirm their reliability and validity.For this study, a total of 56 schools were selected in proportion to school sizes from the northern, central, southern, and eastern regions of Taiwan. Administrative staff and subject teachers from these schools were chosen as the research participants. A total of 56 sets of administrative staff questionnaires and 1,080 sets of subject teacher questionnaires were distributed. The collected responses consisted of 78 completed administrative staff questionnaires and 670 completed subject teacher questionnaires. A total of 78 valid administrative staff questionnaires and 665 valid subject teacher questionnaires were collected. The questionnaire's effective response rate was 65.4%. The applied statistical methods encompassed descriptive statistical analysis, onesample t-tests, independent-sample t-tests, one way analysis of variance (ANOVA), and analysis of multiple-choice questions. Following data organization and statistical analysis, the conclusions were drawn:1.The majority of schools successfully implemented alternative curriculum, with most teachers offering 1-2 courses, and students mainly comprising cross-group students from the same school.2.Regarding the implementation outcomes of the alternative curriculum, the teachers perceive the most degree of alignment with the aspect of being able to implement diverse teaching methodologies, and least degree of alignment with the aspect of enhancing their enthusiasm for teaching.3.Regarding encountering issues with the alternative curriculum, teachers perceive the highest degree of alignment with the significant gap in abilities among students from different disciplines, and the least degree of alignment with student course selection assigned by the teachers.4.Regarding the strategies in response to the issues encountered in alternative curriculum, teachers perceive the highest degree of alignment with the aspect that granting certain credits for certain full-semester courses can enhance students' motivation to learn, and the least degree of alignment with integrating nearby school resources to address resource shortages.5.Among teachers from different backgrounds, those in the northern region perceive higher implementation outcomes for alternative curriculum, and teachers with 10 to less than 15 years of teaching experience have a higher awareness of the issues they encounter.In conclusion, based on the research findings, recommendations are presented for technical and vocational high schools, school administrators, and subject teachers.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 創業教育、創業態度、創新行為及創業意圖之關係研究—以科技大學大學生為例
title_en: The Relationship among the Entrepreneurship Education, Entrepreneurial Attitude, Innovative Behavior and Entrepreneurial Intentions—Taking the Students of the Universities of Science and Technology in Taiwan as an Example
keywords: 創業教育、創業態度、創新行為、創業意圖、科技大學學生
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在探討創業教育、創業態度、創新行為及創業意圖之關係，並以科技大學大學生的角度探討接受創業教育後對其的影響，因此本研究欲了解不同背景變項的科技大學大學生在接受創業教育後，對創業態度、創新行為及創業意圖的差異情況。根據研究目的搜集相關文獻建立研究架構，並發展「創業教育量表」、「創業態度量表」、「創新行為量表」及「創業意圖量表」。採用叢集隨機抽樣方式，以科技大學大學生為研究對象，進行問卷施測。本研究總計發放 780 份問卷，共計回收 611 份問卷，汰除 9 份無效問卷後，最終得到 602 份有效問卷，有效問卷回收率為 77.2%。其中 389 份問卷為有修習創業教育課程，213 份為沒有修習創業教育課程，故選取 389 份樣本數進行資料分析。本研究採描述性統計、驗證性因素分析以及結構方程模式，包含測量模式與結構模式，進行資料分析，獲得以下結論：一、科技大學有參與校外實習及家族成員中有創業經驗的大學生，有較強烈的創業意圖二、科技大學有修習創業教育課程及家族成員中有創業經驗的大學生，有較積極的創業態度。三、科技大學有修習創業教育課程及家庭成員中有創業經驗的大學生，較能激發其創新行為。四、科技大學接受創業教育後的大學生對創業意圖產生顯著的負向影響。五、科技大學接受創業教育後的大學生對創業態度產生顯著的正向影響。六、科技大學接受創業教育的大學生對創新行為產生顯著的正向影響。七、科技大學大學生的創業態度對創業意圖產生顯著的正向影響。八、科技大學大學生的創新行為對創業意圖產生顯著的正向影響。九、創業態度在創業教育與創業意圖的關係之間具部分中介效果。十、創新行為在創業教育與創業意圖的關係之間具部分中介效果。綜合上述結論，科技大學大學生接受創業教育後，並未提升其創業意圖，反之，卻削弱創業意圖。但可經由培養學生創業態度及激發創新行為影響創業意圖，本研究建議在創業教育課程中應著重於培養學生的創業態度，且在創業教育課程中加入多元學習，激發學生的創新行為，達到提升創業意圖之效。
abstract_en: This study aims to investigate the relationships among entrepreneurial education, entrepreneurial attitudes, innovative behaviors, and entrepreneurial intentions. Based on the research objectives, relevant literature was collected to establish the research framework. Subsequently, scales for "Entrepreneurial Education," "Entrepreneurial Attitudes," "Innovative Behaviors," and "Entrepreneurial Intentions" were developed. Using a cluster random sampling method, university students from a technological university were selected as the research participants for the questionnaire survey. A total of 780 subjects were distributed and 611 subjects were collected. After excluding 9 invalid subjects, 602 valid subjects were collected, which represents a 77.2% recovery rate. Among them, 389 subjects had taken entrepreneurship education courses and 213 subjects had not taken entrepreneurship education courses, so 389 samples were selected for data analysis. This study used descriptive statistics, confirmatory factor analysis, and structural equation model, including measurement and structural models, to analyze the data and obtain the following conclusions:1.University students from science and technology institutes who engage in external internships and have family members with entrepreneurial experience exhibit a stronger intention for entrepreneurship.2.University students from science and technology institutes who have taken entrepreneurship education courses and have family members with entrepreneurial experience demonstrate a more proactive entrepreneurial attitude.3.University students from science and technology institutes who have taken entrepreneurship education courses and have family members with entrepreneurial experience are more likely to be inspired towards innovative behavior.4.University students from science and technology institutes, after receiving entrepreneurship education, exhibit a significant negative impact on entrepreneurial intentions.5.University students from science and technology institutes, after receiving entrepreneurship education, show a significant positive impact on entrepreneurial attitudes.6.University students from science and technology institutes who have undergone entrepreneurship education demonstrate a significant positive impact on innovative behavior.7.Entrepreneurial attitudes of university students from science and technology institutes have a significant positive impact on entrepreneurial intentions.8.Innovative behavior of university students from science and technology institutes has a significant positive impact on entrepreneurial intentions.9.Entrepreneurial attitudes partially mediate between entrepreneurship education and entrepreneurial intentions.10.Innovative behavior partially mediates between entrepreneurship education and entrepreneurial intentions.Summarizing the above conclusions, the entrepreneurial education received by university students in the University of Science and Technology did not enhance their entrepreneurial intention, but on the contrary, it weakened their entrepreneurial intention. However, entrepreneurial intention can be affected by cultivating students' entrepreneurial attitudes and stimulating their innovative behaviors. This study suggests that entrepreneurial education programs should focus on cultivating students' entrepreneurial attitudes and incorporate diversified learning into entrepreneurial education programs to stimulate students' innovative behaviors, so that entrepreneurial intention can be enhanced.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 訓練績優企業員工在工作自我效能對創新工作行為之影響：心理資本與社會資本的調節效果
title_en: The Effects of Work Self-Efficacy on Innovative Work Behavior from Excellent Training Performance Enterprises: The Moderating Effects of Psychological Capital and Social Capital of Employees
keywords: 訓練績優企業員工、工作自我效能、創新工作行為、心理資本、社會資本
abstract_zh: 企業組織的創新源自於員工的「創新工作行為」，組織成員的「創新工作行為」對於各種組織的競爭優勢及長期的生存有著非常重要的影響。本研究以近8年（2015至2022年）獲得「國家人才發展獎」之訓練績優企業員工為對象，探討該企業員工在「工作自我效能」對「創新工作行為」之影響，另透過「心理資本」及「社會資本」之調節作用，以瞭解對兩者間之影響。以「工作自我效能」為自變項，「創新工作行為」為依變項，分別以「心理資本」及「社會資本」為調節變項，針對訓練績優企業員工發放「網路問卷」，共計回收問卷563份，有效問卷554份，透過描述性統計、單一樣本t檢定、驗證性因素分析及結構模型分析等方式進行統計分析。研究結論發現，訓練績優企業員工之「工作自我效能」、「創新工作行為」、「心理資本」及「社會資本」整體表現均為「中上」程度。「工作自我效能」對「創新工作行為」具正向影響，「心理資本」對「工作自我效能」及「創新工作行為」間之關係具正向調節效果，「社會資本」對「工作自我效能」及「創新工作行為」間之關係具正向調節效果，建議訓練績優企業應透過提供適當的培訓、賦予員工自主權及創造支持性友善環境等，以強化員工的工作自我效能，以激發員工展現創新工作行為，另提供心理支持和激勵，鼓勵員工建立積極的工作關係，協助員工增強「心理資本」及「社會資本」，以提升企業的競爭力與創新能力。
abstract_en: The innovation of enterprise organizations can be traced back to the “innovative work behavior” of employees, while the “innovative work behavior” of organization members has an extremely important impact on the competitive advantage and long term existence of various organizations. This research targeted employees at excellent training performance enterprises that won National Talent Development Awards (NTDA) over a nearly eight year period (2015-2022) and discussed the impact of these employees in terms of “work self-efficacy” and “innovative work behavior.” It also focused on the moderating effects of “psychological capital” and “social capital” to better understand the impact these have on each other. This research took “work self-efficacy” as an independent variable and “innovative work behavior” as a dependent variable with “psychological capital” and “social capital” as moderating variables respectively. It also employed questionnaire surveys, issuing “online questionnaires to employees at excellent training performance enterprises, of which 563 were returned with 554 valid samples. Statistical analysis was then conducted employing descriptive statistics, a one sample t-test, confirmatory factor analysis (CFA) and structural model analysis. As a result, this research concluded that the overall performance of employees at excellent training performance enterprises in terms of “work self-efficacy,” “innovative work behavior,” “psychological capital” and “social capital” was above average. In addition, “work self-efficacy” has a positive impact on “innovative work behavior.” Furthermore, “psychological capital” has a positive moderating effect on “work self-efficacy” and “innovative work behavior.” Moreover, “social capital” has a similar positive moderating effect on “work self-efficacy” and “innovative work behavior.” In light of these findings, it is proposed that excellent training performance enterprises should employ suitable training to ensure employees have a supportive and friendly environment that promotes autonomy and creativity as this enhances “work self-efficacy” and encourage employees to demonstrate “innovative work behavior.” Additionally, the provision of psychological support and motivation encourages employees to establish proactive work relationships, while also helping them to strengthen their “psychological capital” and “social capital,” thereby improving the competitiveness and creative capability of the enterprise.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 國民中學新住民子女學業成就影響因素之建構-以生態系統理論之觀點
title_en: A Study on Constructing the Influencing Factors of Academic Achievement of New Residents’ Children in Junior High Schools— From the Perspective of Ecological Systems Theory
keywords: 國民中學、新住民子女、學業成就、生態系統理論
abstract_zh: 本研究以瞭解國民中學新住民子女微觀、中間、外圍及巨觀系統中影響學業成就之因素，與各因素間之中介效果，期建構國民中學新住民子女學業成就生態系統；採問卷調查方式，分層隨機抽樣，有效問卷955份，以描述性統計、t考驗、單因子變異數分析及結構方程模式等統計方法。研究者利用調查結果建構出新住民子女學業成就生態系統，其微觀系統包含性別、自尊心、人際關係、家長參與；中間系統有生活適應、社會支持；外圍系統有居住地區、家庭社經地位、父母親身分別；巨觀系統有社會歧視。此外，自尊心、人際關係、家長參與、生活適應具有中介效果。各系統中，微觀系統是新住民子女學業成就核心，又以人際關係為重；其次為外圍系統，又以居住地區影響較大。研究發現家長參與、社會支持在不同系統的影響力差距最為顯著，因此，善用家長參與、社會支持使其成為新住民子女學業成就的助力而非阻力；再者，師長可由班級經營中可透過同儕互動經驗強化新住民子女之自尊心及人際關係，亦可以透過家訪了解家庭社經地位、家長身分別，搭配平時的生活適應提供多面向的協助；家庭、學校及其生活環境應要將性別平等更有意識地落實，並營造有利讀書學習空間，皆將有利新住民子女的學業成就表現。
abstract_en: This study aims to explore the factors influencing academic achievement among new residents' children in junior high school within the micro, meso, exo, and macro systems, as well as the mediating effects among these factors, in order to construct an ecological systems framework for understanding their academic performance. A questionnaire survey was employed using stratified random sampling, yielding 955 valid responses. Statistical methods including descriptive statistics, t-tests, one-way ANOVA, and structural equation modeling were applied.Based on the survey results, the researchers constructed an ecological systems framework for the academic achievement of new residents' children. The micro system includes variables such as gender, self-esteem, interpersonal relationships, and parental involvement. The meso system involves variables related to life adaptation and social support. The exo system incorporates factors like residential area, family socio-economic status, and parental backgrounds. The macro system encompasses social discrimination. Furthermore, self-esteem, interpersonal relationships, parental involvement, and life adaptation were found to have mediating effects. Among the systems, the micro system emerged as the core of academic achievement for new residents' children, particularly with emphasis on interpersonal relationships. The exo system followed, with significant impact from the residential area.The study reveals that parental involvement and social support exhibit notable variations in influence across different systems. Thus, harnessing parental involvement and social support can contribute positively to the academic achievement of new residents' children. Moreover, educators can strengthen self-esteem and interpersonal relationships through peer interactions within classroom management, and through home visits to understand socio-economic backgrounds and parental roles, along with providing multidimensional assistance for life adaptation. To enhance academic achievement, fostering gender equality awareness and creating conducive study environments at both home and school settings are vital considerations.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 北部地區科技大學會計學系學生生涯自我效能與就業力關係之研究
title_en: A Study on the Relationship between Career Self-efficacy and Employability of the Accounting Students of Universities of Science and Technology in Northern Taiwan
keywords: 會計學、生涯自我效能、就業力
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在探討北部地區科技大學會計學系學生的生涯自我效能與就業力之關係，採用問卷調查法，參酌相關文獻據以自行編製之「科技大學會計學系學生生涯自我效能與就業力調查問卷」，並以111學年度北部地區科技大學會計學系學生為研究範圍進行調查，採分層比例抽樣，共計回收有效樣本307份。以描述性統計分析、獨立樣本t檢定、單因子變異數分析、皮爾森積差相關及逐步多元迴歸分析進行統計分析處理，瞭解科技大學會計學系學生生涯自我效能之現況與差異、就業力之現況與差異、生涯自我效能與就業力之關係、生涯自我效能對就業力之預測力。透過本研究得到以下結論：一、北部地區科技大學會計學系學生之生涯自我效能整體及各構面皆為中高程度，並以問題解決構面為最高分。二、四年級、具有會計實習或會計相關的工讀經驗之北部地區科技大學會計學系學生其生涯自我效能較高。三、北部地區科技大學會計學系學生之就業力整體及各構面皆為中高程度，資訊科技能力構面中之程式設計能力、數據分析能力較顯不足。四、四年級、就讀私立、具有會計實習或會計相關的工讀經驗之北部地區科技大學會計學系學生其就業力較高。五、北部科技大學會計學系學生對生涯自我效能與就業力具有高度正向相關。六、北部科技大學會計學系學生之生涯自我效能對就業力具有預測力。本研究將上述研究結果提出相關建議，並提供學校教學及輔導、學生學習以及未來研究者參考。
abstract_en: This study aims to investigate the relationship between career self-efficacy and employability of accounting students in universities of science and technology in northern Taiwan by using a survey to conduct the investigation. The scope of the study covered accounting students enrolled in universities of science and technology in northern Taiwan in 2022. After referring to the relevant literature, the researcher used a self-compiled survey titled “Survey on the Career Self-efficacy and the Employability of Accounting Students in Universities Science and Technology” as a research tool. Stratified proportional sampling was used, and a total of 307 valid responses were collected. Descriptive statistics, independent sample t-test, analysis of variance, Pearson product-moment correlation coefficient, and stepwise multiple regression analysis were used to conduct an analysis in order to understand the current status and differences in career self-efficacy, the current status and differences of their employability, the relationship between career self-efficacy and employability, and the predictive power of career self-efficacy on employability among the accounting students. The conclusions of this study are as follows:1. The overall career self-efficacy of the accounting students and each aspect of their career self-efficacy was at a medium-high level, with the problem-solving aspect receiving the highest scores.2. The career self-efficacy of the fourth-year accounting students who had an internship or part-time work experience related to accounting was higher.3. The overall employability of the accounting students and each aspect of their employability was at a medium-high level; however, their program design and data analysis capabilities in the IT competency aspect were somewhat insufficient.4. The fourth-year accounting students who were enrolled in a private university and possessed internship or part-time work experience related to accounting had higher employability.5. Career self-efficacy and employability had a highly positive correlation among the accounting students.6. Career self-efficacy was found to be predictive of employability among the accounting students.Recommendations are proposed for the aforementioned results in this study and are intended to be used as a reference for teaching and counseling in schools, students’ learning, and future researchers.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 技術型高中教師實施數位教學之研究
title_en: A Study on the Implementation of Digital Teaching for Vocational High School Teachers
keywords: 數位學習、數位載具、數位教學
abstract_zh: 數位時代快速崛起，影響教師教學模式。本研究根據中小學數位學習精進方案參與計畫學校，探究技術型高中教師在數位教學輔助課堂教學之使用現況。本研究採用問卷調查法以抽樣調查401位教師為研究對象，瞭解技術型高中教師參與數位教學現況和參與數位教學歷程，分析不同背景教師參與數位教學影響因素。研究結果顯示(1)六成教師回應推動數位教學計畫主導者以行政人員為主佔，近五成教師自行研發數位教材，超過五成教師提到學校藉由問卷調查蒐集評估數位教學成效。(2)超過六成教師近一年參與過數位培訓課程，近五成教師實施數位教學年資在五年以下，每年接受數位培訓少於10小時以下佔六成，約一半教師數位教材素材取自網路資源。(3)技術型高中教師認為學校行政、教師個人和環境資源對數位教學有中高程度影響，影響程度依序為教師個人因素、學校行政資源，及環境資源因素。(4)近一年有接受過數位培訓課程教師認為學校行政、教師個人和環境資源等三因素對參與數位教學影響高於沒有接受過培訓的教師。
abstract_en: The digital era has revolutionized education methods. According to the Digital Learning Enhancement Plan's participating schools, this study explores the current status of vocational high school teachers' use of digital teaching to supplement classroom instruction. This study utilized a questionnaire survey method, sampling 401 teachers as the research subjects. The study was conducted to understand the current situation of teachers' participation and their experiences in digital teaching, and to analyze the factors affecting teachers' participation in digital teaching from different backgrounds.The results of the study showed that (1)60% of the teachers responded that administrators were the main actors in the promotion of digital teaching programs, nearly 50% of the teachers developed their own digital teaching materials, and more than 50% of the teachers mentioned that their schools had evaluated the effectiveness of digital teaching through questionnaire surveys. (2)More than 60% of teachers have participated in a digital training program in the past year; Nearly 50% of teachers have been implementing digital teaching for less than five years; 60% of teachers receive less than 10 hours of digital training per year, and about half of the teachers' digital teaching materials are taken from online resources. (3)Vocational high school teachers believed that school administration, individual teachers and environmental resources have a medium-high level of influence on digital teaching, with the order of influence being individual teachers' factors, school administration resources, and environmental resources. (4)Teachers who had received digital training courses in the past year perceived that the three factors of school administration, individual teachers and environmental resources had a higher impact on participation in digital teaching than those who had not received any training.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 大學生線上學習時間型態與線上測驗表現之分析
title_en: Analysis of University Students' Online Learning Time Patterns and Online Test Performance
keywords: 學習時間型態、線上學習、線上測驗次數、測驗表現、教育資料探勘
abstract_zh: 本研究透過數位發展部DataStation網站之公開數據資料，研究242位大學生之學習行為日誌數據，收集了學生的學習時間型態和測驗表現數據，共297,511筆課程資料進行分析。研究採用描述性統計、相關性分析、集群分析等方法進行，探討不同背景學生在線上學習行為差異，特別聚焦於「時間型態」的角度，包含選修課堂數、課程影片觀看時間，以及測驗作答時間，並且進一步探討這些行為與線上測驗次數及首次作答正確率之間的關聯性。採用集群分析的方法，將學生按照他們的學習行為分為不同的群體，以揭示學生的學習策略與效能的多元性。研究結果發現學生在線上學習平台上的學習時間型態和測驗表現受到性別與學科背景的影響。男性學生在線上測驗之測驗作答次數顯著高於女性學生，科技背景學生每堂課的測驗作答次數較人文社會背景學生為高。本研究另揭示了三種主要的學習型態：常規型學習者傾向於選修接近規定的課程數量，並關注達到最低學習要求；任務導向型學習者的學習動機可能與實現計畫標準有關，而在學習過程中的參與度可能較低；深度型學習者會投入長時間的學習，並選修較多的課程。
abstract_en: This study examined the learning behavior logs of 242 university students through the publicly available data on the DataStation website of the Ministry of Digital Affairs, and collected data on students' learning time patterns and test performance, with a total of 297,511 pieces of course data for analysis. Descriptive statistics, correlation analysis, and cluster analysis were used to investigate the differences in online learning behaviors among students from different backgrounds, focusing on the "time pattern" perspective, which includes the number of courses taken, the time spent on watching videos, and the time spent on tests, as well as the correlation between these behaviors and online test attempts and first-time score. Cluster analysis was used to classify students into different groups according to their learning behaviors to reveal the diversity of students' learning strategies and their effectiveness.The results showed that students' learning time patterns and test performance on the e-learning platform were affected by gender and academic background. Male students had a significantly higher test attempts than female students on the online tests. Students from technological backgrounds had a higher online test attempts per lesson than students from humanities and social sciences backgrounds.The study also revealed three main learning styles: regular learners tended to take a number of courses close to the required minimum and were concerned with meeting the minimum learning requirements; task-oriented learners were likely motivated by achieving program standards and were less engaged in the learning process; and deep learners invested in long hours of study and took more courses.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 學區入學選擇制度對區域整體學生表現的影響:代理人模型的模擬研究
title_en: An Agent-Based Modeling Framework for Examining the Catchment area system versus choice-based systems
keywords: 代理人模型、跨區入學、家長選擇權、家庭社經地位
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在深入探討開放跨區入學制度對區域內學生整體表現所產生的影響。為了達成這一目的，我們採用了模型法，透過開發一個基於代理人模型（Agent-based model）的應用模型，來模擬在學區入學制度和開放跨區入學制度的情況下，區域內不同社經地位的家庭學生如何進行學校選擇，並觀察這些選擇對區域內學校學生的社經地位比例、整體就學人口數以及學習成就表現等方面的變化情況。在進行模型建構時，我們以教育部、內政部和臺北市政府的公開數據作為代理人模型的起始參數，確保研究的可信度和準確性。  透過本研究的模擬和分析，我們得出了一些發現。首先，開放跨區入學政策可能導致學校發展上的馬太效應，即更好的學校會變得更好，而較弱的學校則可能面臨學生減少的情況。這種現象可能加劇區域內學校之間的差距，進而影響學生的學習環境和教育品質。其次，開放跨區入學政策可能讓高社經地位的家庭學生在階級複製方面佔有更多的優勢。這是因為在選擇學校時，這些家庭更有可能選擇較好的學校，進而提升了這些學校的社經地位學生比例。這可能造成一個惡性循環，使得社會中的不平等現象進一步加劇。
abstract_en: This study aims to thoroughly examine the impact of the open inter-district school enrollment system on the overall performance of students within the region. To achieve this goal, we utilized a modeling approach, developing an application model based on an Agent-based model. This model simulates scenarios under district-based and open inter-district enrollment systems, depicting how students from various socioeconomic backgrounds within the region make school choices. Additionally, we observe the effects of these choices on factors such as the socioeconomic distribution of students, the total student population, and academic achievement within the regional schools. During the model construction, we used publicly available data from the Ministry of Education, Ministry of the Interior, and Taipei City Government as initial parameters for the Agent-based model, ensuring the credibility and accuracy of the research.Through the simulation and analysis of this study, we have identified certain findings. Firstly, the open inter-district enrollment policy may lead to the Matthew Effect in school development, where better schools tend to excel further while weaker schools might face a decrease in student enrollment. Secondly, the open inter-district enrollment policy could potentially grant greater advantages to students from higher socioeconomic backgrounds in terms of social class reproduction.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 新北市技術型高中美容科學生挫折容忍力與生涯自我效能之研究
title_en: The Frustration Tolerance and Career Self-Efficacy for the Students of Beautification Department in Vocational High Schools in New Taipei City
keywords: 美容科、技術型高中、挫折容忍力、生涯自我效能
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在探討新北市技術型高中美容科學生挫折容忍力與生涯自我效能之現況、比較不同背景變項之差異，並探討挫折容忍力與生涯自我效能之相關情形。本研究以問卷調查法進行，採取立意抽樣，共抽取新北市3所技術型高中美容科一到三年級的學生，發出360份問卷，有效問卷回收計有279份，有效問卷回收率達77.5％。本研究採用自編的「技術型高中挫折容忍力與生涯自我效能量表」作為研究工具，其中「技術型高中美容科學生挫折容忍力量表」分為等三個構面困難偏好取向、挫折後情感反應及挫折後行為取向。「技術型高中美容科學生生涯自我效能量表」分為自我了解、生涯計劃與資料蒐集、目標選擇及問題解決等四個構面。問卷資料以次數分配、百分比、平均數與標準差、獨立樣本t檢定、單因子變異數及皮爾積差相關等方式進行資料統計與分析處理。本研究之結論如下：一、新北市技術型高中美容科學生整體挫折容忍力達中等程度，以挫折後行為取向得分最高。二、新北市技術型高中美容科學生整體生涯自我效能達中等至中高程度，以自我了解與目標選擇得分最高三、不同就讀年級與就讀國中技藝學程之新北市技術型高中美容科學生生涯自我效能皆無差異四、新北市技術型高中美容科學生整體挫折容忍力與生涯自我效能達中度正相關。    本研究彙整上述之研究結果形成具體建議，以供主管教育行政機關、學校、教師、學生與家長及未來研究者參考。
abstract_en: This study aimed to explore the current status of frustration tolerance and career self-efficacy among students of the beautification department in vocational high schools in New Taipei City. Additionally, the study aimed to compare differences in these aforementioned aspects based on various background variables and investigate the correlation between frustration tolerance and career self-efficacy. The research was conducted by a questionnaire survey method, employing purposive sampling. A total of 360 questionnaires were distributed to students from the first to third grades in three vocational high schools in New Taipei City. The study successfully collected 279 valid questionnaires, resulting in an effective response rate of 77.5%.The study employed self-developed“Frustration Tolerance Scale’’ and“Career Self-efficacy Scale’’ for vocational high school students as the instruments. The “Frustration Tolerance Scale’’ for the students of“beautification department’’ in vocational high schools consisted of three dimensions: difficulty preference orientation, emotional response after setbacks, and behavioral orientation after setbacks. The “Career Self-efficacy Scale ’’for the students of beautification department in vocational high school included four dimensions: self-understanding, career planning and data collection, goal selection, and problem-solving. Questionnaire data were analyzed using frequency distribution, percentage, mean and standard deviation, independent sample t-test, one-way ANOVA, and Pearson Product-Moment Correlation. The findings of this study are as follows:1. Students of the beautification department in vocational high schools in New Taipei City exhibited a moderate level of overall frustration tolerance, with the highest scores observed in the dimension of behavioral orientation after setbacks.2. Students of the beatification department in vocational high schools in New Taipei City exhibited a level of overall career self-efficacy ranging from moderate to moderately high,  with the highest scores observed in the two dimensions of Self-Understanding and Goal Selection.3. There were no significant differences in career self-efficacy among the students of the beautification department in vocational high schools in New Taipei City based on different grade levels, and whether they had attended a junior high school skills education course.4. There is a moderate positive correlation between the overall frustration tolerance and career self-efficacy among the students of beautification department in vocational high schools in New Taipei City.This study compiled the aforementioned research findings to provide specific practical suggestions for educational administrative authorities, schools, educators, students, parents, and prospective researchers to take into account.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 主管教練行為、主管與部屬交換關係與員工工作績效之關係 – 以P超商為例
title_en: The Relationships among Supervisory Coaching Behavior, Leader-Member Exchange Status and Work Performance: A Case Study of P Convenience Store
keywords: 主管教練行為、主管與部屬交換關係、工作績效
abstract_zh: 有效的領導行為可以帶領員工朝著目標前進，達成預期目標，為組織創造工作績效，主管教練行為是影響員工工作績效的重要因素之一。愈來愈多企業試圖導入教練概念及其相關技能，透過對員工展現的主管教練行為後，員工能夠在學習和激勵下發生變化，因而產生行為上的改變。因而本研究以 P 超商員工為研究對象，探討主管教練行為、主管與部屬交換關係與工作績效之現況，以及探討主管教練行為、主管與部屬交換關係與工作績效之間的關係，本研究採問卷調查法，正式問卷方放996份，回收有效331份，有效回收率33.2 %。    問卷調查結果透過SPSS統計軟體進行描述性統計、單一樣本t檢定、獨立樣本t檢定、變異數分析、簡單迴歸進行分析。研究結果發現P 超商員工對主管教練行為、主管與部屬交換關係與工作績效知覺感受度高；不同年齡、工作年資、與現在主管共事時間、門市性質、工作職務的員工，對主管教練行為知覺有顯著差異；不同教育程度、門市性質的員工，對主管與部屬交換關係知覺有顯著差異；主管教練行為對員工工作績效有正向影響；主管與部屬交換關係對員工工作績效有正向影響。
abstract_en: Effective leadership behavior can lead employees to move towards their goals, achieve expected goals, and create work performance for the organization. Supervisory Coaching Behavior is one of the important factors that affect employee work performance. More and more companies are trying to introduce the concept of coaching and related skills. After the Supervisory Coaching Behavior is shown to employees, employees can change under learning and motivation, resulting in behavioral changes. Therefore, this study takes P Convenience Store employees as the research object to explore the current situation of Supervisory Coaching Behavior, Leader-Member Exchange Status and Work Performance, as well as the relationships among Supervisory Coaching Behavior, Leader-Member Exchange Status and Work Performance. In the questionnaire survey method, 996 formal questionnaires were released, and 331 valid questionnaires were recovered, with an effective recovery rate of 33.2%.The survey results were analyzed using the SPSS statistical software, including descriptive statistics, single-sample t-test, independent-sample t-test, analysis of variance, and simple regression. The results of the study found that employees of Convenience Store have a high perception of Supervisory Coaching Behavior, Leader-Member Exchange Status and Work Performance. There are significant differences, employees with different education levels and store nature have significant differences in perception of Leader-Member Exchange, Supervisory Coaching Behavior has a positive impact on employee Work Performance, Leader-Member Exchange has a positive impact on employee Work Performance.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 以零時體育活動提升技術型高中智能障礙學生注意力之行動研究
title_en: An Action Research on Zero Hour PE Program on the Attention of the Students With Intellectual Disabilities in Vocational High School
keywords: 零時體育、技術型高中智能障礙學生、注意力
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在探討零時體育活動對技術型高中智能障礙學生注意力之影響，研究內容包含分析零時體育活動設計適切性，實施過程所遭遇的問題與解決策略，以及零時體育活動對注意力表現之影響。本研究採用行動研究法，研究對象為研究者所任教之技術型高中餐飲服務科二年級，4位智能障礙學生，進行一週3天為期7週之研究。研究工具包含導師回饋單、同儕教師回饋單、學生回饋單、零時體育活動紀錄與國小兒童注意力測驗等。根據行動研究歷程所蒐集之資料進行整理與分析後，本研究得到結論如下:一、零時體育活動設計應包含全身性跳躍或身體移動，搭配教學策略提升參與動機；二、零時體育活動之遭遇問題與解決策略包括:（1）滾動式修正使活動時間能妥善運用（2）事先擬定好最適心跳率測量規則，避免過度在意心跳率影響活動本質（3）考量天氣、場地、健康因素應擬定替代可行方案（4）因應學生個別能力提供適當調整；三、零時體育活動能提升技術型高中智能障礙學生之整體注意力，減少分心、焦慮行為。
abstract_en: This study aims was to explore the impact of Zero Hour PE activities on the attention of students with intellectual disabilities in technical high schools. The research includes analyzing the appropriateness of the design of Zero Hour PE activities, identifying the problems encountered during implementation and the corresponding solutions, as well as investigating the effects of Zero Hour PE activities on attention performance.This study adopts an action research approach and focuses on a group of 4 students with intellectual disabilities in the second grade of a technical high school's Catering Service Courses.The study spans 7 weeks, with activity conducted three times a week. The research tools used include teacher feedback forms, peer teacher feedback forms, student feedback forms, records of Zero Hour PE activities, and the Attention Scales for Elementary School Children.After collation and analysis of the data collected in the course of action research, the conclusions of this study are as follows: 1.The design of Zero Hour PE activities should include whole-body jumping or body movements, coupled with instructional strategies to enhance participation motivation. 2.The problems encountered in zero-hour sports activities and the solutions include: (1) Rolling corrections enable proper use of activity time. (2) Preparing heart rate rule in advance to avoid excessive concern about heart rate affecting the nature of the activity. (3) Consider weather, venue, and health factors to formulate alternative feasible plans. (4) Provide appropriate adjustments according to individual student abilities.3. Zero-hour PE activities can improve the overall attention of students with intellectual disabilities in technical high schools and reduce distraction and anxiety behaviors.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 員工體驗、敬業度與留任意願關係—以L電腦連鎖補習班為例
title_en: The Relationships among Employee Experience, Engagement, and Intention to Stay: The Case of the L Computer Chain Training Center
keywords: 員工體驗、敬業度、留任意願
abstract_zh: 企業推動以人為本的員工體驗，可提升員工敬業度與對組織的忠誠度，進而提高人才的留任意願，以增進企業的長久競爭力。事實上，人才是企業最重要的資產，而關鍵人才更是企業重要的戰略資源，對補教業來說，員工不但是服務的提供者，更是企業的最佳代言人。因而本研究以L電腦連鎖補習班的員工為研究對象，探討員工體驗、敬業度與留任意願的關係，以及敬業度在員工體驗與留任意願間的中介效果。採用問卷調查法，正式問卷發放302份，回收有效問卷244份，有效回收率為80.8%。問卷調查結果透過SPSS統計軟體進行描述性統計、獨立樣本t檢定、單因子變異數分析、皮爾森積差相關分析、多元迴歸分析及階層迴歸分析，研究結果發現L電腦連鎖補習班員工的員工體驗感受及敬業度均佳且留任意願高；不同年齡、最高學歷、服務年資與職務的員工體驗，不同婚姻狀況、年齡、最高學歷、服務年資、職務的員工敬業度，以及不同婚姻狀況、最高學歷、職務的留任意願有顯著差異；員工體驗、敬業度與留任意願有正向關係，且敬業度與留任意願亦有正向關係，同時敬業度在員工體驗與留任意願間則有部分中介效果。
abstract_en: The enterprise promoted a people-centric employee experience, which can enhance employee’s engagement and loyalty to the organization, thereby increasing talent retention and enhancing the long-term competitiveness of the company. In fact, talent is the most important asset of a company, and key talent is even more crucial as a strategic resource. For the tutoring industry, employees are not only service providers but also the best ambassadors for the company. Therefore, this study focuses on the employees of L Computer Chain Training Center to explore the relationship between employee experience, engagement, and intention to stay, as well as the mediating effect of engagement between employee experience and intention to stay. The research methodology involves a questionnaire survey, with 302 questionnaires distributed, and 244 valid questionnaires collected, resulting in an effective response rate of 80.8%.The survey results were analyzed using SPSS statistical software, including descriptive statistics, independent samples t-test, one-way ANOVA, Pearson correlation analysis, multiple regression analysis, and hierarchical regression analysis. The research findings revealed that the employees of L Computer Chain Training Center had positive perceptions of their employee experience and engagement, and they also showed a high intention to stay. Employees' experiences varied significantly among different age groups, highest education levels, years of service, and job positions. Similarly, there were significant differences in employees' engagement among different marital statuses, age groups, highest education levels, years of service, and job positions. Additionally, employees' intention to stay showed significant differences among individuals with different marital statuses, highest education levels, and job positions. The study found positive relationships between employee experience, engagement, and intention to stay. Moreover, there is a positive relationship between employee experiences, engagement, and retention intention. Moreover, engagement also exhibits a positive relationship with retention intention. At the same time, engagement acts as a partial mediator between employee experiences and retention intention.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 婦女靈性健康與生活壓力因應之研究 -以A靈性教育工作坊為例
title_en: A Study on Women's Spiritual Health and Coping with Life Stress - An Example of a Spirituality Education Workshop
keywords: 婦女、靈性健康、生活壓力因應
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在探究婦女靈性健康與生活壓力因應之關係，以2018到2022年曾在研究者服務之A靈性教育工作坊學習之婦女學員共318人進行研究。本研究採取的研究方法為問卷調查法，並採用自編的「婦女靈性健康與生活壓力因應調查問卷」作為研究工具，其中，「婦女靈性健康量表」分為活出意義、與人締結、生態關懷、天地合一與自我超越等五個構面，「婦女生活壓力因應量表」分成積極因應問題、消極因應問題、積極因應情緒、消極因應情緒等四個構面。以次數分配、百分比、平均數與標準差、獨立樣本 t 檢定、 單因子變異數分析、皮爾森積差相關及多元逐步迴歸等進行統計分析處理。本研究之結論如下：一、婦女總體靈性健康達中高程度，尤以天地合一構面表現最佳。二、學歷為大專（含）以上的婦女其靈性健康程度相對較佳。三、婦女總體生活壓力因應達中等程度，尤以積極因應問題構面表現最佳。四、年齡在30歲（含）~未滿40歲的婦女其採用整體生活壓力因應的程度相對較高。五、婦女在不同婚姻狀態及有無宗教信仰在靈性健康與生活壓力因應上皆無顯著差異。六、婦女靈性健康與生活壓力的因應呈正向關係。七、婦女靈性健康對其生活壓力的因應具有預測力。    本研究綜整上述之研究結果形成具體建議，以供婦女及未來研究者參酌。
abstract_en: The aim of this study is to explore the relationship between women's spiritual health and coping with life stress. The research was conducted on 318 female participants who attended the A Spiritual Education Workshop, a program provided by the researchers, between 2018 and 2022. The study utilized a questionnaire survey method and employed a self-developed "Women's Spiritual Health and Life Stress Coping Survey Questionnaire" as the research instrument. The "Women's Spiritual Health Scale" consisted of five dimensions, including living a meaningful life, connecting with others, ecological care, unity of nature, and self-transcendence. The "Women's Life Stress Coping Scale" comprised four dimensions, including positive problem-focused coping, negative problem-focused coping, positive emotion-focused coping, and negative emotion-focused coping. Descriptive statistics, independent sample t-test, one-way ANOVA, product-moment correlation, and multiple stepwise regression were used to evaluate the collected data. The conclusions drawn from this research are as follows:1. The overall spiritual health of women is at a medium to high level, especially the aspect ofthe unity of nature is the best.2. The spiritual health of women with a college degree or above is relatively better.3. Women's overall life stress coping reached a moderate level, especially the aspect of positive  coping with problems was the best.4. Women aged 30 years (inclusive) to less than 40 years old have a relatively higher degree of  coping with overall life stress.5. There is no significant difference in spiritual health and life stress coping among women in  different marital statuses and religious beliefs.6. There is a positive relationship between women's spiritual health and coping with life stress.7. Women's spiritual health has the predictive power of coping with life stress.Based on the research findings, this study presents specific recommendations for women and future researchers to consider.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 日本電子遊戲產業領域與高等教育系所課程發展關聯性之研究
title_en: A Study on the Relationships among Japanese Digital Game Industry and the Curriculum Development of Higher Education Departments
keywords: 高等教育、電子遊戲課程內容、電子遊戲產業、文字探勘、日本
abstract_zh: 台灣對於遊戲產業發展及有關於教育的研究甚少，多數著眼在技術層面的更新與開發或是營業面向的客群相關調查，本研究期望以學術研究方式綜述日本發展遊戲產業的過程、政府政策及高等教育課程的安排，進而達到一個全面性的了解。本研究主要以日本為主，在產業方面也以日本電子遊戲公司為主要研究對象，或與日本合資的公司為研究對象。本研究參考的資料來源有：日本政府相關方網站、子遊戲公司相關官方網站、日本高等教育學校相關官方網站、日本電子遊戲產業之日文及英文的期刊研究及著作。在本研究選用資料探勘軟體於文字探勘分析技術，根據探勘結果，提出研究結論如下：壹、遊戲產業的發展並不完全依賴國家政策。遊戲產業在瓶頸時仰賴其他新科技技術的應用轉型。遊戲產業在蓬勃發展時依靠政府法令解決產業引起的社會問題。貳、受政府影響的影響，遊戲人才培育課程大都含有人工智慧及職涯教育兩大類課程。參、學校在專業課程上與遊戲產業技能，可匹配為電腦繪圖類對應繪圖模型能力，資訊工程類對應程式語言能力，遊戲製作類對應遊戲製作能力。
abstract_en: There are very few researches on the development of the game industry and education in Taiwan. Most of them focus on the update and development of technology or the investigation of customer groups for business. This study aims to provide a comprehensive understanding through academic research summarizing the process of Japan's development of the game industry, government policies, and the arrangement of higher education courses. This research primarily focuses on Japan, with Japanese video game companies as the main research subjects, or companies jointly invested with Japan.The sources of information referenced in this study include: related websites of the Japanese government, official websites of subsidiary game companies, official websites of higher education institutions in Japan, and Japanese and English journal research and works of Japanese video game industry.Using data mining software for text mining analysis techniques, the study presents the following research conclusions based on the mining results:First, the development of the game industry does not completely depend on national policies. When the game industry is at a bottleneck, it relies on the application transformation of other new technologies, and it relies on government laws and regulations to solve social problems caused by the industry during prosperous development.Second, affected by the influence of the government, most of the game talent training courses include artificial intelligence and career education courses.Third, the professional courses and game industry skills can be matched to computer graphics classes corresponding to the ability to draw models, information engineering classes corresponding to programming language skills, and game production classes corresponding to game production capabilities.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 地區差異與家庭社經地位對學生職業期望的影響：以PISA2018臺灣資料為例
title_en: The Influence of Regional Disparities and Family Socioeconomic Status on Students' Career Expectations: A Case Study of PISA 2018 Data in Taiwan
keywords: 家庭社經地位、城鄉地區、學生職業期望、PISA2018
abstract_zh: 職業期望對於未來就業的選擇有著一定程度的影響，而國內在影響職業期望的研究相對稀少。因此本研究目的為探討不同背景的學生在職業期望上的差異。本研究使用2018年國際學生評估計畫（Program for International Student Assessment, 簡稱PISA）的公開數據，分析臺灣國中生社會經濟地位的落差與城鄉差距對學生職業期望的影響。本研究將以數據分析控制之變項為學生能力、學生家庭的社會經濟地位以及城鄉地區等進行迴歸分析。  研究結果發現原生家庭社經地位對於個人未來職業期望的直接影響，這種影響超越了學生所居住地點的影響。即使在控制個人數學能力、語文能力以及科學能力之後，原生家庭社經地位仍然對於個人的職業期望產生顯著的影響。而都市化程度較高的地方，原生家庭社經地位對學齡孩童未來職業期望的影響更加明顯。這反映了在都市地區，原生家庭社經地位對於學生職業期望的影響更為顯著。這種地區性差異可能與都市地區所擁有的教育與文化資源有關，這些資源能夠放大原生家庭社經地位對學生職業期望的影響。然而，也值得注意的是，都市地區的貧富差距可能導致低社經地位家庭的學齡孩童對於未來職業期望較為缺乏信心。
abstract_en: The career expectations of students have a significant impact on their future employment choices, yet research on the factors influencing career expectations in Taiwan is relatively scarce. Therefore, the purpose of this study is to explore the differences in career expectations among students from various backgrounds. The study utilizes publicly available data from the 2018 Programme for International Student Assessment (PISA) to analyze the influence of socio-economic disparities and urban-rural gaps on the career expectations of Taiwanese junior high school students. The regression analysis will control for variables such as student abilities, socio-economic status of the family, and urban-rural location.The research findings reveal that the original family socio-economic status directly impacts individuals' future career expectations, surpassing the influence of the students' residential location. Even after controlling for individual math, language, and science abilities, the family socio-economic status continues to have a significant effect on personal career expectations. Moreover, in highly urbanized areas, the impact of the family socio-economic status on the career expectations of school-age children becomes even more pronounced. This indicates that in urban regions, the influence of family socio-economic status on students' career expectations is more significant. This regional difference may be attributed to the educational and cultural resources available in urban areas, which amplify the impact of family socio-economic status on students' career expectations. However, it is worth noting that the wealth disparity in urban areas may lead to lower confidence in future career expectations among school-age children from low socio-economic backgrounds.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 運用BOPPPS教學模式於技術型高中中餐烹調課程之行動研究
title_en: An Action Research on the Implementation of BOPPPS Modules in Chinese Cuisine Curriculum of Senior Vocational High School
keywords: 技術型高中、餐飲管理科、BOPPPS教學模式、中餐烹調
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在透過BOPPPS教學模式運用在技術型高中餐飲管理科中餐烹調課程之行動研究，提出兩個研究目的：一、分析BOPPPS教學模式運用於技術型高中餐飲管理科中餐烹調課程之學生學習成效；二、省思BOPPPS教學模式運用於技術型高中餐飲管理科中餐烹調課程之教師實踐過程。本研究採取行動研究取向，以研究者所任教學校之公立技術型高中111學年度入學之餐飲管理科一年級的學生共33名學生為研究對象，運用BOPPPS教學模式於中餐烹調課程與教學，進行為期9週之行動研究。首先探討BOPPPS教學模式於中餐烹調課程之教學後，學生在中餐烹調課程之學習成效。本研究以「中餐烹調丙級術科量表」為量化研究工具，分析學生在BOPPPS教學模式運用於中餐烹調課程前、後表現的差異，並輔以小組學習紀錄表、學生晤談紀錄分析表、教學觀察省思紀錄表、課程學習單等質性資料之蒐集，以進行綜合分析其學習成效、教師之教學歷程實踐與省思及教師專業成長。根據研究結果獲致以下結論：一、實施BOPPPS教學模式教學後，學生對中餐烹調課程學習參與度明顯提升。二、實施BOPPPS教學模式教學後，學生對中餐烹調課程同儕互動程度明顯提升。三、實施BOPPPS教學模式教學後，學生對中餐烹調課程作品完成度明顯提升。四、實施BOPPPS教學模式教學後，學生於中餐烹調課程丙級術科測量明顯提升。五、實施BOPPPS教學模式易增加教師於課前課後負擔，教學進度未掌控好，亦容易壓縮學生操作時間。六、實施BOPPPS教學模式有助於教師對於BOPPPS教學模式熟練度提升、精進教學專業知能及強化班級經營能力。最後，依據本研究之實踐過程及結果提出省思，研擬未來教學再出發之方向，並進一步對後續教學及研究者提出建議。
abstract_en: The action research is a study that aimed to analyze the learning efficiency and to reflect the teaching process of the implementation of BOPPPS modules in Chinese cuisine curriculum in a senior vocational high school.In this study, the researcher aimed the BOPPPS modules at 33 senior vocational high students in Chinese cuisine curriculum for 9 weeks. And then focused on the influence which students got on their professional knowledge and skills after using the BOPPS modules.During this quantitative research, the researcher use “Level C Technician for Chinese Culinary Scale” as a research instrument. According to the results of the questionnaires, the author analyzed the differences between the before-after implementation of BOPPPS in students’ skills and learning efficiency. Along with the group cooperation record sheets, students interview records, teaching observation records and working sheets, the researcher did the cross confirm and gain the outcomes. Based on the outcomes, the conclusions are as follows:1. The implementation of BOPPPS was able to improve students’ participation in Chinese Culinary class.2. The implementation of BOPPPS helped students make great progress on peer interaction in Chinese Culinary class.3.
