The implementation of BOPPPS enhanced students’ accomplishments in Chinese Culinary class.4. The implementation of BOPPPS made students perform better on the Level C Technician for Chinese Culinary examination.5. The implementation of BOPPPS tended to add workloads on teachers, and might cut down the time students' practicing if the teaching progress wasn’t well controlled.6. The implementation of BOPPPS improved teachers’ problem-solving ability, mastered   teachers’ profession skills and strengthened teacher’s class-managing ability.  At last, the researcher offered some suggestions based on the conclusions so as to make further research great.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 臺北市國中技藝教育學程學生學習動機與課程滿意度之研究
title_en: A Study on the Learning Motivation and Course Satisfaction of Junior High School Students in Taipei Participating in the Technical Arts Education Programs
keywords: 技藝教育學程、學習動機、課程滿意度
abstract_zh: 本研究係探究臺北市國中技藝教育學程之學生在學習動機與課程滿意度之現況，對於臺北市國中技藝教育學程學生之不同背景變項進行分析，比較其學習動機及課程滿意度之不同情形，且探討二者之間的關係。本研究研究對象為臺北市國中技藝教育學程九年級學生、臺北市技術型高中校長、實習輔導主任及相關承辦人，運用問卷調查研究法與半結構式訪談等研究方法，以資料處理以描述性統計、獨立樣本t檢定、單因子變異數分析及皮爾遜積差相關等方式進行統計分析。本研究結論：（一）國中技藝教育學程學生在學習動機表現上為中高程度，以「學習價值」之現況最佳，「外界期待」之現況相對較低；（二）在課程滿意度表現上，國中技藝教育學程學生為高程度，並以「教師教學」之現況最佳，「課程內容」之現況相對較低；（三）國中技藝教育學程學生以生理女、學業成績在90分以上者，其學習動機較佳；（四）國中技藝教育學程學生以低家庭社經地位與中家庭社經地位者，其課程滿意度較高；（五）國中技藝教育學程在學生學習動機與課程滿意度部分有顯著正相關。 (六) 技術型高中在學生學習動機提升之策略上，透過課程資源的調度給予學生成就感，維持學生的學習動機。(七) 技術型高中端在提升學生課程滿意度之策略上，重視其學習與職涯試探需求；(八) 技術型高中端在技藝教育學程之政策上，回饋了其對透過多元夥伴關係將職業試探機會加深加廣之期待；為供未來學者與政府部門之政策制定參考，本研究結果提出相關具體建議，以持續改善我國技藝教育，讓學生得以適性發展。
abstract_en: The purpose of this study is to understand the current situation of the learning motivation and course satisfaction of students in the Vocational Technical Education Class of Junior High School in Taipei City, to analyze the differences in the learning motivation and course satisfaction of students with different background variables in the Vocational Technical Education Class of Junior High School in Taipei City, and to explore the relationship between the two. In this study, the ninth-grade students of Vocational Technical Education Class of Junior High School in Taipei City, the directors of the Internship and Counseling Section and related persons in charge of Vocational Technical Senior High School in Taipei City were used as the research objects. The methods adopted, such as Survey Research and Semi-structured Interview, the data processing was statistically analyzed by statistic methods, including Descriptive Statistics, Independent Samples t-test, One-way Analysis of Variance and Pearson Product-moment Correlation. The conclusions acquired from this study are as follows: (I) In terms of learning motivation performance for the students of Vocational Technical Education Class of Junior High School, it is medium to high, with the current situation of "Learning Value" being the best, and the current situation of "External Expectations" is relatively low. (II) In terms of course satisfaction performance for the students of Vocational Technical Education Class of Junior High School, it is high, with the current situation of "Teacher’s Teaching" being the best and the current situation of "Course Content" being relatively low. (III) Students of Vocational Technical Education Class of Junior High School who are physiologically female and have academic score higher than 90 points last semester have a higher degree of course satifaction. (IV) Due to the different social and economic status of their families, students have different course satisfaction performance. Students of Vocational Technical Education Class of Junior High School with low social and economic status and middle social and economic status have a higher degree of performance. (V) There is a positive correlation between learning motivation and course satisfaction for the students of Vocational Technical Education Class of Junior High School. (VI) In terms of the strategy to improve students’ learning motivation, the Vocational Technical Senior High Schools dedicatedly arranging course resource, including teachers and equipment, for the Vocational Technical Education Classes. (VII) In terms of the strategy to improve students’ course satisfaction, the Vocational Technical Senior High Schools value students' learning and career exploration needs when arranging the curriculum for the Vocational Technical Education Classes. (VIII) In terms of the feedback of related policies, the Vocational Technical Senior High Schools expect to broaden and deepen the oppoturnuty of career exploration for all students through diverse partnerships. Lastly, based on the study results, specific suggestions are put forward for reference by future scholars and policy makers, so as to continuously improve our country's vocational technical education so that students can develop adaptively.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 永續發展與社會設計觀點於大學服裝設計教育之個案研究
title_en: A Case Study of Sustainable Fashion and Social Design Perspectives in University Fashion Design Education
keywords: 服裝設計、服裝設計教育、永續發展、社會設計
abstract_zh: 服裝設計的演變和永續發展與社會設計觀點的演進是進步的過程。服裝設計產業應注重企業社會責任與品牌力，以實現永續發展目標。融入永續發展和社會責任觀念的設計教育，能夠培養學生對環境和社會的關注，促進永續發展。本研究以臺北實踐大學為個案研究，探討永續發展和社會設計對服裝設計教育的影響。本研究結果如下：一、「永續發展」與「社會設計」觀點在服裝設計產業之發展永續發展觀點在服裝設計產業的發展分為：(1)服裝設計師的認知；(2)企業社會責任的共識；(3)消費者的教育。而社會設計觀點則為：(1)符合時代需求的跨領域社會設計價值觀；(2)社會責任和消費的平衡關係；(3)產業社會設計執行的差異及其影響。二、「永續發展」與「社會設計」觀點在服裝設計教育之實踐在服裝設計教育方面，永續發展與社會設計的實施現況在正式課程多為教師自行決定是否安排於課程；在非正式課程永續發展多為工作營或研討會，社會設計則多以工作營或公益活動的形式呈現。對服裝設計教育未來的展望，永續發展觀點包含：(1)永續發展定義釐清之必要；(2)教學輔助工具運用之重要性；(3)永續發展教學設計之規劃需要延續性；(4)永續發展教學需傳遞與整合；(5)解決永續發展上成本過高的契機；(6)研討會工作營及社區主導型活動的推動；(7)建立永續發展學程並成立專責單位；(8)回到教育及設計的初心；(9)虛實整合數位化永續教學的趨勢。社會設計觀點則包含：(1)社會設計課程宜以專題導向學習方式進行；(2)成立社會設計實踐中心；(3)學校培養教師社會設計理念；(4)由校方主導推動社會設計；(5)與服裝設計產業合作教學授課；(6)以永續發展及社會設計觀點融入教學是未來潮流趨勢。
abstract_en: The evolution of apparel design and sustainable development and the evolution of social design perspectives is a progressive process. The apparel design industry should focus on corporate social responsibility and brand power in order to achieve the goal of sustainable development. Design education that incorporates the concepts of sustainable development and social responsibility can foster students' concern for the environment and society, and promote sustainable development. This study uses Taipei Shih Chien University as a case study to investigate the impact of sustainable development and social design on apparel design education. The results of this study are as follows.The development of the sustainable development perspective in the apparel design industry is divided into: (1) awareness of apparel designers; (2) consensus on corporate social responsibility; and (3) consumer education. The social design perspective is divided into (1) cross-disciplinary social design values that meet the needs of the times; (2) the balanced relationship between social responsibility and consumption; and (3) the differences in the implementation of social design in the industry and its impact.The Practice of "Sustainable Development" and "Social Design" in Fashion Design Education In terms of fashion design education, the implementation of sustainable development and social design in formal courses is mostly at the discretion of the teachers, while in informal courses, sustainable development is mostly in the form of work camps or seminars, and social design is mostly in the form of work camps or public service activities. As for the future of fashion design education, the perspectives of sustainable development include (1) the need to clarify the definition of sustainable development; (2) the importance of using teaching aids; (3) the need for continuity in the planning of sustainable development teaching design; (4) the need for transmission and integration of sustainable development teaching; (5) the opportunity to solve the excessive cost of sustainable development; (6) the promotion of seminar work camps and community-oriented activities; and (7) the establishment of a sustainable development curriculum and the establishment of a special task force. (7) establishing a sustainable development curriculum and a dedicated unit; (8) returning to the original vision of education and design; and (9) integrating the virtual and the real into the digital trend of sustainable teaching. The social design perspective includes: (1) social design courses should be conducted in a topic-oriented learning approach; (2) social design practice centers should be established; (3) schools should cultivate social design concepts among teachers; (4) schools should take the lead in promoting social design; (5) collaboration with the apparel design industry in teaching and learning; and (6) integrating sustainable development and social design perspectives into teaching is a trend for the future.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 高科技產業員工情緒勞務與組織承諾之研究-以鴻海科技集團臺灣區公司員工為例
title_en: A Study on the Relationship Between Emotional Labor and Organizational Commitment of Employees in High Technology Industries：A Case Study of Foxconn Group Employees in Taiwan
keywords: 高科技產業員工、情緒勞務、組織承諾
abstract_zh: 本研究目的在探討不同背景變項之高科技產業員工情緒勞務與組織承諾整體現況，並進一步探究高科技產業員工情緒勞務與組織承諾之間的差異。本研究採用問卷調查法做為研究方法，以「高科技產業員工情緒勞務量表」與「高科技產業員工組織承諾量表」為研究工具。問卷發放對象為高科技產業員工以鴻海科技集團台灣區員工進行抽查，共發放份975調查問卷，有效問卷回收率為79.38%，對施測後的資料進行了全面的分析，得出以下結論：1.高科技產業員工的「情緒勞務」之整體以及各構面都達到了中等以上程度，在「互動程度」為最高，而「情緒的深層行動」為最低。2.高科技產業員工的「組織承諾」之整體以及各構面都達到了中等以上程度，在「努力意願」為最高，依序是「組織認同」居中，而「留職傾向」則顯示相對最低。3.高科技產業員工的「情緒勞務」受到「教育程度」、「工作職務」、「服務年資」不同的影響而呈現顯著差異。4.高科技產業員工的「組織承諾」受到「年齡」、「教育程度」、「工作職務」、「服務年資」不同的影響而呈現顯著差異。5.高科技產業員工在「組織承諾」的構面「努力意願」、「組織認同」、「留職傾向」會因為「情緒勞務」的不同而呈現顯著差異。
abstract_en: The purpose of this study is to investigate the overall status of emotional labor and organizational commitment among high-tech industry employees with different background variables. Furthermore, it aims to explore the differences in emotional labor and organizational commitment among high-tech industry employees.The research employed a questionnaire survey as the research method, utilizing the "High-Tech Industry Employees' Emotional Labor Scale" and "High-Tech Industry Employees' Organizational Commitment Scale" as research instruments. The survey was conducted among employees in the Taiwan region of Hon Hai Technology Group, and a total of 975 questionnaires were distributed. The effective response rate was 79.38%. The collected data was analyzed comprehensively, leading to the following conclusions:High-tech industry employees' overall level of "emotional labor" and its various dimensions were above average. The highest dimension was "interactions," while the lowest was "deep acting."High-tech industry employees' overall level of "organizational commitment" and its various dimensions were above average. The highest dimension was "effort commitment," followed by "affective commitment," and the lowest was "continuance commitment."The "emotional labor" of high-tech industry employees showed significant differences influenced by variables such as "educational level," "job position," and "years of service."The "organizational commitment" of high-tech industry employees showed significant differences influenced by variables such as "age," "educational level," "job position," and "years of service."Within the dimensions of "organizational commitment," namely "effort commitment," "affective commitment," and "continuance commitment," there were significant differences due to variations in "emotional labor."

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 臺北市記帳士事務所員工職家衝突與幸福感之研究
title_en: A Study on Work-Family Conflict and Wellbing of Employees of Bookkeepers Office in Taipei City
keywords: 記帳士事務所員工、職家衝突、幸福感
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在探討於不同背景變項臺北市記帳士事務所員工職家衝突之整體現況，並進一步探究臺北市記帳士事務所員工職家衝突與幸福感之間的差異。本研究採用問卷調查法，以「記帳士事務所員工職家衝突量表」與「記帳士事務所員工幸福感量表」為研究工具。問卷發放對象係對臺北市記帳士事務所員工進行抽查，共發放469份調查問卷，有效問卷回收率為78.09%，將施測後所得資料以描述性統計、單一樣本t檢定、獨立樣本t檢定、單因子變異數分析、事後比較等統計方法加以分析，其結論如下:一、  臺北市記帳士事務所員工「職家衝突」之整體及各構面知覺屬中等以上程度，其中以「工作對家庭行為衝突」最高，「工作對家庭壓力衝突」居中，「工作對家庭時間衝突」最低。二、  臺北市記帳士事務所員工「幸福感」之整體及各構面知覺屬中等以上程度，其中以「人際關係」最高，接著依序為「工作成就」、「生活滿意」，「身心健康」最低。三、  臺北市記帳士事務所員工「職家衝突」會因「性別」、「年齡」、「教育程度」、「婚姻狀態」、「家庭型態」、「記帳士事務所工作年資」不同而有顯著差異。四、  臺北市記帳士事務所員工之「幸福感」會因不同「職家衝突」的不同而有顯著差異。在「幸福感」構面中，「工作對家庭行為衝突」顯著高於「工作對家庭壓力衝突」與「工作對家庭時間衝突」。根據結論提出建議及後續研究方向，提供未來研究者參考。
abstract_en: This study was conducted to examine the overall status of work-family conflict among the employees of the Taipei City bookkeeper’s office in different background variables and to further investigate the differences between work-family conflict and well-being of the employees of the Taipei City bookkeeper’s office.This study used a questionnaire survey to investigate the employees of the Taipei City bookkeeper’s office. A total of 469 questionnaires were distributed by using the “Bookkeeper’s Work-Family Conflict Scale” and the “Bookkeeper’s Well-Being Scale” and the validity rate was 78.09%.  The data were analyzed by descriptive statistics, single-sample t-test, independent sample t-test, one-way analysis of variance, and post hoc comparisons.  The results are as follows:1. The overall and each aspect perception of “work-family conflict” among the employees of the Taipei City bookkeeper’s office was above the medium level, with “work-family behavior conflict” being the highest, “work-family stress conflict” being the middle, and “work-family time conflict” being the lowest.2. The overall and each aspect perception of “well-being” among the employees of the Taipei City bookkeeper’s office was above the medium level, with “interpersonal relationship” being the highest, followed by “job achievement”, “life satisfaction”, and “physical and mental health” being the lowest.3. The “work-family conflict” of the employees of the Taipei City bookkeeper’s office was significantly different depending on “gender”, “age”, “education”, “marital status”, “family type”, and “years of experience in bookkeeping”.4. The “well-being” of the employees of the Taipei City bookkeeper’s office was significantly different depending on "work-family conflict".  In the aspects of the “well-being”, the “work-family behavioral conflict” was significantly higher than “work-family stress conflict” and “work-family time conflict”.Based on the results, suggestions and follow-up research directions are put forward for the future researchers.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: POE教學策略結合互動式模擬教材應用於國小學習障礙學生數學學習之研究
title_en: A Study of POE Teaching Strategy Integrated with Interactive Simulation Teaching Materials for Mathematics Learning of Elementary School Students with Learning Disabilities
keywords: POE教學策略、互動式模擬教材、學習障礙、數學學習成效
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在透過POE教學策略結合互動式模擬教材之教學來提升國小學習障礙學生於數學中「分數」此單元的學習成效。本研究採用單一受試實驗研究法之跨受試多試探設計，研究對象是國民小學中的兩位四年級的學習障礙學生，自變項為POE教學策略結合互動式模擬教材教學，依變項為研究對象在數學「分數」單元之學習成效。實驗教學的過程依序為基線期、介入期及維持期，資料分析方式採視覺分析法及簡化時間序列分析法進行研究結果分析與討論，並透過訪談蒐集質性資料以瞭解研究者之學習觀感，研究結果如下。一、運用POE教學策略結合PhET互動式模擬教材，對於國小學習障礙學生學習數學分數單元，具有立即成效以及維持成效。二、國小學習障礙學生對於使用POE教學策略結合PhET互動式模擬教材學習數學分數單元，學生自述可以提高作答信心、幫助自己掌握學習重點以及提升數學學習興趣。
abstract_en: This study aimed to improve the learning performances of elementary school students with learning disabilities in the "fractions" unit of mathematics by using a POE Teaching Strategy combined with interactive simulation teaching materials. This study used a cross-test multi-test design with a single-test experimental study method to study two fourth grade students with learning disabilities in a national elementary school. The experimental teaching process was divided into baseline, intervention, and maintenance periods. And the data were analyzed using visual analysis and simplified time series analysis to analyze and discuss the results.The results of the study are as follows: (1) The use of the POE teaching strategy combined with PhET interactive simulation teaching materials has immediate and sustained effects on the learning of fractional units in mathematics for elementary school students with learning disabilities. (2) Students with learning disabilities in elementary school have reported that using the POE teaching strategy combined with the PhET interactive simulation teaching materials to learn fractional math units improved their confidence, helped them master essential learning focuses, and increased their interest in learning math.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 我國大學人事人員工作壓力與工作滿意之研究
title_en: A Study on Job Stress and Job Satisfaction of the University Personnel Staffs in Taiwan
keywords: 大學人事人員、工作壓力、工作滿意
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在瞭解我國大學人事人員工作壓力與工作滿意之關係，分析比較不同背景變項之大學人事人員工作壓力與工作滿意之差異情形，並探討大學人事人員工作壓力與工作滿意之相關情形。期望透過本研究能引起相關學校機關對人事人員工作壓力與工作滿意之重視，並協助發展有效策略，以減輕人事人員工作壓力，進而提升其工作滿意度。    本研究採用問卷調查法，研究對象為2022學年度大學人事室辦理人事業務人員。採用分層比例抽樣方式進行，先將我國大學依北部、中部、南部、東部及離島地區進行劃分，再依公、私立大學屬性及一般、科技大學進行抽樣調查，總計發放239份問卷，剔除無效問卷後，有效問卷共計174份，有效回收率為72.80%。經過處理與分析資料後，獲致以下結論：一、大學人事人員之整體工作壓力屬於中等程度，以「工作負荷」之壓力程度相對較高，「人際關係」之壓力程度相對較低。二、男性及公立大學人事人員之工作壓力相對女性及私立大學人事人員高。三、大學人事人員之整體工作滿意屬於中等程度，各層面中以「同僚關係」之滿意程度相對較高。四、不同背景變項之大學人事人員整體工作滿意無顯著差異。五、大學人事人員之工作壓力與工作滿意無顯著相關性。
abstract_en: The purpose of this study was to understand the relationship between job stress and job satisfaction of university personnel staffs in Taiwan, analyze and compare the differences between university personnel staff's job stress and job satisfaction with different background variables, and explore the relationship between university personnel staff's job stress and job satisfaction. It is hoped that through this research, relevant school authorities will pay more attention to the job stress and job satisfaction of personnel staffs, and help develop effective strategies to reduce the job pressure of personnel staffs and improve their job satisfaction.    This study adopts the questionnaire survey method, and the research object is the staff of the Office of Student Affairs in the 2022 academic year. Stratified proportional sampling was used. Stratified proportional cluster sampling method was used to divide the universities in Taiwan according to the northern, central, southern, eastern and outlying islands, and then conduct a sample survey according to the attributes of public and private universities and general and technological universities. A total of 239 questionnaires were distributed and excluded After the invalid questionnaires, there were 174 valid questionnaires, and the effective recovery rate was 72.80%. After processing and analyzing the data, the following conclusions were drawn:1.The overall work pressure of university personnel is at a medium level, the pressure level of "work load" is relatively high, and the pressure level of "interpersonal relationship" isrelatively low.2.The work pressure of male and public university personnel is higher than that of female and private university personnel.3.The overall job satisfaction of university personnel is at a medium level, and the satisfaction level of "colleague relationship" is relatively high among all levels.4.There is no significant difference in the overall job satisfaction of university personnel with different background variables.5.There is no significant correlation between job stress and job satisfaction of university personnel.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 壽險業理賠人員工作職能內涵與訓練需求評估之研究
title_en: A Study on Occupational Competency for Life Insurance Claims Personnel and Training Needs Assessment
keywords: 理賠給付、理賠人員、職能內涵、職能基準、訓練需求
abstract_zh: 理賠給付為壽險公司對保戶承諾的最具體的實踐，本研究為探討壽險業理賠單位承辦人員應具備職能的重要程度和已具備職能的現況，並依據知識、技能和態度三方面的職能內涵，分析職能缺口和教育訓練的優先順序，研究工具使用iCAP壽險業理賠人員之職能基準為基礎發展正式問卷內容，並以問卷調查方式針對壽險業理賠部門在職主管和承辦同仁進行網路問卷調查，共回收372份有效問卷，其中主管問卷32份，承辦人員問卷340份。主管問卷評定理賠人員所需職能內涵的重要性和使用頻率，用以了解壽險業理賠人員應具備職能的標準；承辦人員問卷用於自我評估壽險業理賠人員之已具備職能現況，並使用獨立樣本t檢定、單因子變異數、IPA重要表現法等統計分析方法，進而發現壽險業理賠人員應具備職能中，最重要的職能內涵在知識職能內涵方面為「風險管理」、「法律/法規」；在技能職能內涵方面為「溝通能力」、「衝突管理」等；在態度職能內涵方面為「正直誠實」、「壓力容忍」；具備程度最高的職能內涵在知識職能內涵方面為「法律/法規」、「金融商品」；在技能職能內涵方面為「正確傾聽」、「溝通能力」；在態度職能內涵方面為「 正直誠實」、「 親和力」；應具備職能內涵與已具備職能內涵在「壓力容忍」、「風險管理」、「衝突管理」職能內涵表現上落差值最高；職能缺口中應加強且優先訓練的知識職能內涵為「風險管理」、「金融商品」；技能職能內涵為「衝突管理」、「問題解決」等；態度職能內涵為「壓力容忍」、「主動積極」等；具有理賠人員資格及年資大於4年的理賠承辦人員以「金融商品」「 時間管理」、「問題分析」等的職能內涵表現較佳。提供壽險業理賠單位在制定培訓計劃時的參考依據，以加強職能缺口，驥提升理賠人員之職能內涵，進一步擁有更佳的工作績效。
abstract_en: Claims payment is the most concrete practice of the commitment made by life insurance companies to policyholders. This study aims to explore the importance and current status of competencies required by claim handlers in the life insurance industry. Based on the dimensions of knowledge, skills, and attitudes, the study analyzes competency gaps and prioritizes educational training. The research tool utilizes the iCAP competency framework for life insurance claim handlers to develop a formal questionnaire. A web-based survey is conducted among in-service supervisors and claim handlers in the claim departments of life insurance companies. A total of 372 valid questionnaires are collected, including 32 from supervisors and 340 from claim handlers.The supervisor questionnaire assesses the importance and frequency of competency requirements for claim handlers, in order to understand the standards for the competencies that life insurance claim handlers should possess. The claim handler questionnaire is used for self-assessment of the current competencies of claim handlers in the life insurance industry. Statistical analysis methods such as independent samples t-test, one-way ANOVA, and the Importance-Performance Analysis (IPA) are employed. The study reveals that the most important competency dimensions for life insurance claim handlers are "risk management" and "legal/regulatory" in the knowledge dimension, "communication skills" and "conflict management" in the skills dimension, and "honesty/integrity" and "stress tolerance" in the attitudes dimension. The highest level of competency is found in the knowledge dimension for "legal/regulatory" and "financial products", in the skills dimension for "active listening" and "communication skills", and in the attitudes dimension for "honesty/integrity" and "affability". The largest gaps between required and possessed competencies are observed in the dimensions of "stress tolerance", "risk management", and "conflict management". The knowledge competencies that require strengthening and priority training are "risk management" and "financial products", while the skills competencies are "conflict management" and "problem-solving", and the attitudes competencies are "stress tolerance" and "proactiveness". Claim handlers who are qualified and have more than four years of experience perform better in competencies such as "financial products", "time management", and "problem analysis".These findings provide a reference basis for life insurance claim units in developing training programs to enhance competency gaps and improve the competency profile of claim handlers, leading to better job performance.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 新北市公立幼兒園教保服務人員組織公平與當責關係之研究
title_en: A Study on the Relationship between Oraganizational Justice and Accountability of Public Preschool Teachers and Educare givers in New Taipei City
keywords: 教保服務人員、組織公平、當責
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在探討新北市公立幼兒園教保服務人員組織公平與當責的知覺程度與關係，分析比較不同背景變項之新北市公立幼兒園教保服務人員在組織公平與當責之知覺差異情形。本研究採用問卷調查法，研究工具為「新北市公立幼兒園教保服務人員組織公平與當責知覺」問卷，以2022學年度新北市公立幼兒園正式教師與教保員為研究對象，共發出問卷394份，回收有效問卷352份，有效回收率達89%。統計方法採描述性統計、單一樣本t檢定、獨立樣本t檢定、單因子變異數分析與皮爾森積差相關進行資料分析。本研究獲得結論如下：一、新北市公立幼兒園教保服務人員整體組織公平為中上程度，其中以互動公平程度最高。二、新北市中型規模公立幼兒園之教保服務人員組織公平知覺程度高於大型規模幼兒園之人員。三、新北市公立幼兒園教保服務人員整體當責為中上程度，其中以個人當責程度最高。四、新北市中型規模公立幼兒園之教保服務人員當責知覺程度高於大型規模幼兒園之人員。根據結論提出若干建議及後續研究方向，提供相關人員參考。
abstract_en: The purpose of this study was to investigate the relationship between organizational justice and accountability of public preschool teachers and educare givers in New Taipei City, and to investigate the differences in organizational justice and accountability of public preschools staff in New Taipei City across different background variables.  In this study, the questionnaire was sent out 394 questionnaires, and 352 valid questionnaires were returned, with a valid return rate of 89%.  Collecting 352 valid pieces, the data were analyzed by ont-sample test, independent sample t-test, one-way ANOVA and Pearson product-moment correlation.  The conclusions are as follows:1.The perception of organizational justice of public preschool teachers and educare givers in New Taipei City was significantly higher than average, with the highest level of perception was interactional justice.2.The level of perception of organizational justice of public preschool teachers and educare givers of medium-sized schools is higher than that of large-sized schools.3.The perception of accountability of public preschool teachers and educare givers in New Taipei City was significantly higher than average, with the highest level of perception was personal accountability.4.The level of perception of accountability of public preschool teachers and educare givers of medium-sized schools is higher than that of large-sized schools.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 大學生人格特質、生涯自我效能與就業力關係之研究-以某科技大學電資領域為例
title_en: A Study of the Relationship Among Personality Traits, Career Self-Efficacy and Employability for College Students- Taking the Electrical Engineering and Computer Sciences in Universities of Science and Technology as an Example
keywords: 電資領域、科技大學大學生、人格特質、生涯自我效能、就業力
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在探討科技大學大學生人格特質、生涯自我效能與就業力之關係，並探究生涯自我效能對人格特質與就業力之間是否具有中介效果。期許研究結果能提供科技大學電資領域大學生瞭解本身具備的人格特質，並有效提升生涯自我效能，以符合企業所需的人才標準，增加就業力。本研究採問卷調查，以科技大學電資領域日間四年制大學生為研究對象，而根據問卷回收的調查資料，並利用單一樣本t檢定、獨立樣本t檢定、單因子變異數分析、卡方檢定、相關分析、迴歸分析及階層迴歸分析等統計方法，獲得之研究結果如下：一、科技大學電資領域大學生在五大人格特質中皆有較佳的表現，其中具有開放學習性人格特質的比例最高，且其在生涯自我效能和就業力有較佳的表現。二、科技大學電資領域女性大學生比男性大學生更具有親和性人格特質。三、科技大學電資領域大二的大學生比其他年級的大學生更具有開放學習性人格特質。四、科技大學電資領域光電工程系的大學生比其他系別的大學生更具有神經質人格特質與開放學習性人格特質，且光電工程系的大學生比其他系別的大學生在生涯自我效能與就業力的表現較佳。五、科技大學電資領域有校外實習經驗的大學生較具備開放學習性人格特質，且有校外實習經驗的大學生在生涯自我效能與就業力上的表現較佳。 六、科技大學電資領域大學生的五大人格特質對生涯自我效能皆具有影響力，尤其以外向性人格特質影響力最大。七、科技大學電資領域大學生的五大人格特質對就業力皆具有影響力，尤其以開放學習性人格特質影響力最大。八、透過提高生涯自我效能，可有助於提升科技大學電資領域大學生的就業力。九、透過提高生涯自我效能，可有效的降低或避免科技大學電資領域大學生的人格特質對就業力的影響。
abstract_en: This study aims to explore the relationship between personality traits, career self-efficacy and employability of university students of science and technology and explore whether career self-efficacy has a mediating effect on the relationship between personality traits and employability. The research results are expected to provide college students of the electrical engineering and computer sciences in universities of science and technology to understand their own personality traits, and effectively improve their career self-efficacy, so as to meet the talent standards required by enterprises and increase their employability. This study adopts a questionnaire survey, taking daytime four-year college students of the electrical engineering and computer sciences in universities of science and technology as the research object, and according to the survey data collected by the questionnaire, and using statistical methods such as one sample t-test, independent sample t-test, one way ANOVA, chi-square test, correlate analysis, regression analysis and hierarchical regression analysis, the research results obtained are as follows：1. College students of the electrical engineering and computer sciences in universities of science and technology have better performance in the five major personality traits, among which the proportion of open learning personality traits is the highest, and they have better performance in career self-efficacy and employability.2. Female college students of the electrical engineering and computer sciences in universities of science and technology have more agreeable personality traits than male college students.3. Sophomore college students of the electrical engineering and computer sciences in universities of science and technology have more open-learning personality traits than college students in other grades.4. College students in the Department of Electro-optical Engineering of the electrical engineering and computer sciences in universities of science and technology have more neurotic personality traits and open learning personality traits than college students in other departments, and college students in the Department of Electro-optical Engineering of the electrical engineering and computer sciences have higher career self-efficacy and employability than college students in other departments.5. College students with off-campus internship experience of the electrical engineering and computer sciences in universities of science and technology are more open to learning personality traits, and college students with off-campus internship experience perform better in career self-efficacy and employability.6. The five major personality traits of college students of the electrical engineering and computer sciences in universities of science and technology all have an impact on career self-efficacy, especially the extroversion personality trait has the greatest influence.7. The five major personality traits of college students of the electrical engineering and computer sciences in universities of science and technology all have an impact on employability, especially the personality trait of open learning has the greatest influence.8. By improving career self-efficacy, it can help to improve the employability of college students of the electrical engineering and computer sciences in universities of science and technology.9. By improving career self-efficacy, it can effectively reduce or avoid the impact of university students' personality traits on employability of the electrical engineering and computer sciences in universities of science and technology.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 新北市國民小學學生知覺教師情緒勞務及其情緒智力之研究
title_en: The Study on the Relationship Between Elementary School Students’ Perception on Teachers’ Emotional Labor and Their Emotional Intelligence in New Taipei City
keywords: 新北市、國民小學學生、情緒勞務、情緒智力
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在探討新北市國民小學學生知覺教師情緒勞務及其情緒智力之現況與關係，研究方法採問卷調查法，以「新北市國民小學學生知覺教師情緒勞務及其情緒智力量表」為施測工具。本研究採分層隨機取樣方式，選取新北市10所國民小學，共541位高年級學生為研究對象。調查所得資料以描述統計、t檢定、皮爾森積差相關及多元迴歸等方法進行分析。本研究歸納結果如下：一、新北市國民小學學生知覺教師整體情緒勞務達中上程度；整體情緒智力表現達中上程度。二、年級、學生性別及是否擔任班級幹部等背景變項，對於新北市國民小學學生知覺教師情緒勞務有顯著差異。三、年級、學生性別及是否擔任班級幹部等背景變項，對於新北市國民小學學生情緒智力有顯著差異。四、新北市國民小學學生知覺教師情緒勞務與情緒智力間具有正相關。五、新北市國民小學學生知覺教師情緒勞務對情緒智力具預測力，又以「情緒勞務規範」對情緒智力的解釋力較高。最後，綜合以上研究結果，分別就教育相關單位、學校行政單位、班級教師及未來研究者提出相關建議。
abstract_en: The aim of this study was to examine the current situation and correlation between students' perception of teachers' emotional labor and their emotional intelligence in elementary schools in New Taipei City. The quantitative research was designed based on a questionnaire survey. It obtained data via a measurement scale, ”Students’ perception of teachers' emotional labor and their emotional intelligence scale in elementary schools in New Taipei City ”, as a survey tool.This study adopted a convenience sampling method to collect data from participants of 541 senior graders of ten elementary schools. The research data was analyzed with descriptive statistics, t-test, Pearson correlation, multiple regression analysis. The results were as below:1.The students’ perception of teachers' emotional labor is medium to high. And the performance of emotional intelligence is medium to high.2.The background variables such as grade, student gender, and members of class leaders, etc., have a significant difference towards the students’ perception of teachers' emotional labor.3.The background variables such as grade, student gender, and members of class leaders, etc., have a significant difference towards students' emotional intelligence.4.There is a positive correlation between students’ perception of teachers' emotional labor and their emotional intelligence.5.There is a predictive effect on students’ perception of teachers' emotional labor and their emotional intelligence and  compared to others, the regulations of emotional displays have great explanatory power on emotional intelligence.Based on the conclusion of the study above, the researcher would like to give some suggestions related to education departments, school administration departments, teachers and future researchers on this topic.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 中等學校旅遊實務素養導向課程設計與教學實施
title_en: The Competency-Based Course Design and Teaching Practice of Travel Agency Practice in Post-secondary School
keywords: 餐旅群、課程設計、素養導向、資訊科技融入教學、行動研究
abstract_zh: 科技蓬勃發展一直不斷地改變現代人的生活模式，學校教育也同樣受到影響與衝擊。為此，世界各國在21世紀的教育改革中皆推行素養教育，我國教育部亦於2019年正式實施《108課綱》，期望學生能經由教師的素養導向教學習得關鍵素養，讓他們能夠解決生活中面臨的各種問題。本研究之研究目的為探討「中等學校旅遊實務素養導向課程設計與教學實施」，研究者以餐旅群部定科目旅遊實務為主，並應用BOPPPS教學模式進行素養導向課程設計和教學實施。本研究採取行動研究取向，並採用訪談法和觀察法等研究方法，經由計畫、行動、反思、修正等一連串的循環歷程後，獲得以下研究結論：一、在教學設計方面，應用BOPPPS教學模式能夠將教師的教學設計轉換成以學生為中心、由教師自行設計的素養導向課程較能符合不同環境背景之學生特質和需求。二、在教學歷程方面，小組合作學習、資訊科技融入教學、參與式學習活動和多元評量等教學方式更適合內隱素養的學習。三、在行動反思方面，素養導向教材需要持續編修以符合每屆學生特質和需求、以教師立意方式進行同質分組比隨機分組更能提升小組組員參與率。最後，本研究依據課程設計、教學實施與行動反思的結果對主管機關、學校、教師及未來研究者提出建議，期能提供政策規劃及未來其他課程實施素養導向教學之參考。
abstract_en: Our society and daily lives continually mold out of technology today. So do schools and educations. Therefore, most countries around the world are promoting competency-based education in the 21st-century education reform. The Ministry of Education of Taiwan (MOE) officially implemented “108 Curriculum Guidelines” (the so-called Master Framework for the 12-year Basic Education Curriculum Guidelines) in 2019 as well. It is expected that students can learn core competencies and know how to solve the problems they face during their daily life through teachers’ competency-based teaching practice.The main purpose of this study aims to explore “the competency-based course design and teaching practice of travel agency practice in post-secondary school.” The researcher focuses on the course of travel agency practice of hospitality group and applies BOPPPS teaching model to develop competency-based instructional design and teaching practice. This study follows an action research approach with interview method and observation method. After the processes of an action research, including planning, action, reflection and revision, the following conclusions can be drawn. Firstly, in the aspect of instructional design, the BOPPPS model can help teachers develop student-centered instructional designs; the competency-based instructional design can meet the needs of students in different contexts. Secondly, in the aspect of teaching practice, group collaborative learning, information technology integrated into instruction, participatory learning activities and multiple assessments are more suitable for implicit competencies learning; competency-based teaching materials are revised continuously to meet the needs of students from time to time. Thirdly, in the aspect of reflections from the teaching practice, homogeneous grouping by teachers’ intentions can increase the participation rate of group members more than random grouping.Finally, based on the results of course design, teaching practice and action reflection, this study offers suggestions to the authorities, schools, teachers, and future researchers, hoping to provide further references for policy planning and the implementation of competency-based teaching in other courses in the future.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 資訊視覺化數位教材對學習者學習成就與認知負荷之影響
title_en: The Effects of Information Visualization Digital Teaching Materials on Learner’s Learning Achievement and Cognitive Load
keywords: 資訊視覺化、數位教材、學習成就、認知負荷
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在提出適用於數位教材的資訊視覺化流程與原則，並探討觀看資訊視覺化版本之教育心理學數位教材，對學習者學習成就、認知負荷之影響。本研究採用實驗法，研究對象為未修讀教育學程及心理學相關課程之大學生及研究生，共招募60位研究對象，以隨機分派方式分為控制組與實驗組。控制組觀看一般版教育心理學數位教材；實驗組觀看資訊視覺化版教育心理學數位教材。兩個版本的知識來源及內容量一致，亦採用相同之旁白敘述音檔，僅畫面呈現方式不同。一般版係參照教學現場常見之簡報型數位教材製作而成；實驗版則依據資訊視覺化流程與原則製作。本研究結果提出資訊視覺化流程共七個階段，依序為設定溝通目標、蒐集資訊內容、進行內容篩選、安排資訊結構、進行設計規劃、開始設計製作、最終測試與調整，並歸納12項資訊視覺化原則為三大類—資訊內容、資訊呈現、資訊設計。在學習表現方面，實驗組在教育心理學學習成就表現顯著優於控制組，且實驗組在學習過程中的認知負荷程度亦顯著低於控制組。由以上研究結果可知資訊視覺化版數位教材，能夠有效降低學習者的認知負荷程度，亦能提升學習者的學習成就成就。
abstract_en: The purpose of this study is to propose the process and principles of information visualization for digital teaching materials and to investigate the effects of using information visualized versions of educational psychology digital teaching materials on learners' learning achievement and cognitive loads. In this study an experimental approach was used. A total of 60 subjects were recruited from university and graduate students who had not taken pre-service teacher education programs or psychology-related courses and were randomly assigned into a control group and an experimental group. The control group used the general version of the educational psychology digital teaching materials; the version of experimental group used the information visualization. The two versions had the same source of knowledge and content and used the same narration audio files, but only the presentation of the images was different. The general version was presented as a presentation-based digital learning material commonly used in the teaching field; while the experimental version was produced based on the information visualization process and principles.The results of this study suggest that there are seven stages in the information visualization process of digital teaching materials, namely, setting communication goals, collecting information content, selecting content, arranging information structure, planning design, starting design production, and finally testing and adjusting. The study also summarized the 12 principles of information visualization into three categories: information content, information presentation, and information design. In terms of learning performance, the experimental group performed significantly better than the control group in learning achievement in educational psychology, and the experimental group had a significantly lower cognitive load on the learning process than the control group. From the above findings, it is clear that the information visualization version of digital teaching materials can effectively reduce the cognitive load of learners and enhance the learning achievement of learners.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 以雙因子理論探討技術型高中輔導教師工作滿意度之研究
title_en: A Study on Job Satisfaction Among Counseling Teachers in Vocational Senior High Schools：based on Two-Factor Theory
keywords: 技術型高中、雙因子理論、工作滿意度
abstract_zh: 本研究以雙因子理論探討技術型高中輔導教師之工作滿意度，本研究採問卷調查法，以110學年度技術型高中輔導教師為研究對象，以便利取樣，獲得有效問卷245份。統計採用平均數與標準差、單一樣本t檢定、獨立樣本t檢定、皮爾森積差相關、單因子變異數分析及階層迴歸分析，獲致以下結論：一、技術型高中輔導教師工作滿意度未達滿意程度，與國中、國小輔導教師相關研究比較滿意程度較低。二、技術型高中輔導教師對激勵因素各項目均未達滿意程度。依序為責任感、成就感、工作本身挑戰性、賞識感、升遷。升遷之滿意程度尤低，值得重視。三、技術型高中輔導教師對保健因素各項目均未達滿意程度。其中保健因素較滿意之前三者依序為人際關係、主管領導、工作環境；較低滿意程度前三者為薪資待遇、個人學習與成長、個人生活。四、本研究驗證技術型高中輔導教師激勵因素影響工作滿意度，其中保健因素具有調節變項的效果。五、技術型高中輔導教師的工作滿意度，公立學校教師顯著高於私立學校教師；年資2年以下者高於年資6年至10年者；東部及離島學校輔導教師高於南部學校輔導教師；其餘皆未有顯著差異存在。六、本研究未能支持赫茲伯格之「激勵因素滿意時，就會激起個體高度工作滿意度。當激勵因素不滿意時，並不會導致工作不滿意；只是使個體無法獲得工作滿意。當保健因素不滿意時，就會導致工作的不滿意，若保健因素存在時，則不一定會引起工作的滿意度」的理論。
abstract_en: The purpose of this study was to explore the research on the job satisfaction of vocational senior high school counseling teachers based two-factor theory. Using the questionnaire survey method, taking the vocational senior high school counseling teachers in the 110 academic year as the object, taking convenience sampling, 245 valid questionnaires.Statistically, the mean and standard deviation, single-sample t-test, independent-sample t-test, Pearson Correlation Coefficient, analysis of variance and hierarchical regression analysis were used to obtain the following conclusions:1.Vocational senior high school counseling teachers are not satisfied with their job satisfaction, and compared with secondary and elementary school counselors, the satisfaction is lower.2.Vocational senior high school counseling teachers are not satisfied with the items of motivators is responsibility, achievement, work itself, growth, advancement. The level of satisfaction with advancement is particularly low, which deserves attention.3.Vocational senior high school counseling teachers are not satisfied with the items of hygiene factors. Among them, the top three hygiene factors are interpersonal relationship, supervisory leadership, and work environment; the top three hygiene factors are salary, personal learning and growth, and personal life.4.This study verifies that the motivational factors of vocational senior high school counseling teachers affect job satisfaction, and the hygiene factors have the effect of moderating variables.5.The job satisfaction of vocational senior high school counseling teachers are significantly higher for public school teachers than for private school teachers; those with less than 2 years of experience are higher than those with 6 to 10 years of experience; eastern and outlying island school teachers are higher than southern school teacher; There are no significant differences in the rest.6. This study fails to support Herzberg's theory."Satisfactory motivating factors will arouse high individual job satisfaction. When motivating factors are dissatisfied, it does not lead to job dissatisfaction; When hygiene factors are dissatisfied, it will lead to job dissatisfaction, and if hygiene factors exist, it will not necessarily lead to job satisfaction”.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 大專校院畢業生知覺行為控制、心理資本及社會資本對創業意圖與創業行為的影響－主觀規範的調節效果
title_en: The Effects of Perceived Behavioral Control, Psychological Capital and Social Capital on Entrepreneurial Intention and Entrepreneurial Behavior of Graduates from Colleges and Universities-The Moderating Effect of Subjective Norms
keywords: 知覺行為控制、心理資本、社會資本、主觀規範、創業意圖、創業行為
abstract_zh: 創業被視為改善社會經濟及推動經濟發展的重要途徑，可知其在現今社會的重要性。目前各國均積極推動創業活動，希冀推展創新創業，以活絡國家經濟發展。本研究以國內EMBA在職生為研究對象，探究影響其創業意圖與創業行為的前因，瞭解知覺行為控制、心理資本、社會資本對畢業生的創業意圖與創業行為的影響，以及主觀規範於其中有無調節效果。以知覺行為控制、心理資本、社會資本為本研究之自變項，創業意圖與創業行為作為依變項，主觀規範則為調節變項，運用結構方程模型進行資料分析。針對EMBA在職生發放網路問卷，回收392份問卷，有效問卷366份。研究結果發現，EMBA在職生其知覺行為控制對創業意圖具正向影響，心理資本對創業意圖具正向影響，社會資本對創業意圖具正向影響，創業意圖對創業行為亦有顯著正向影響，主觀規範對知覺行為控制與創業意圖之關係有負向調節效果，而創業意圖對知覺行為控制與創業行為之關係則有中介作用。建議高等教育提升學生知覺行為控制與心理資本素養、強化學生個人社會資本與資源運用、降低主觀規範對於個人心理約束，以提高創業意圖並增進創業行為。
abstract_en: Entrepreneurship is regarded as an important way to improve social economy and promote economic development, which shows its importance in today's society. At present, all countries are actively promoting entrepreneurial activities, hoping to promote innovation and entrepreneurship and activate the development of the national economy. This study intends to take graduates of domestic colleges and universities as the research object, and explore the antecedents that affect their entrepreneurial intentions and entrepreneurial behaviors. To understand whether Perceptual Behavioral Control, Psychological Capital and Social Capital influence graduates' entrepreneurial intention and entrepreneurial behaviors. Whether subjective norm has a moderating role. The independent variables discussed in the research framework are perceived behavioral control, psychological capital and social capital, and the dependent variables are entrepreneurial intention and entrepreneurial behavior. Structural equation modeling was used for data analysis to understand the findings. Online questionnaires were distributed to graduates of colleges and universities, and 392 questionnaires were collected, with 366 valid questionnaires. The results of the study found that the perceived behavioral control, psychological capital and social capital of college graduates have a positive impact on entrepreneurial intentions, entrepreneurial intentions also have a significant positive impact on entrepreneurial behavior, and subjective norms have a positive impact on perceived behavioral control and entrepreneurial intentions. Negative moderating effect, entrepreneurial intention has a mediating effect on perceived behavioral control and entrepreneurial behavior. It is recommended that higher education provide relevant innovation and entrepreneurship courses that strengthen students' psychological quality, encourage students to innovate and start businesses, and weaken the negative impact of the environment on their entrepreneurial intentions.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 工作滿意度、職場幸福感與工作投入關係之研究－以中華郵政臺北郵件處理中心員工為例
title_en: The Relationships among Employee's Job Satisfaction, Workplace Well-being and Work Involvement: The Case Study of Chunghwa Post Taipei Mail Processing Center
keywords: 臺北郵件處理中心員工、工作滿意度、職場幸福感、工作投入
abstract_zh: 臺北郵件處理中心員工，每日須擔負繁重大量郵件處理及郵件載運，並常處於高壓工作環境之中，故提升員工的工作滿意與職場幸福，讓員工得以發揮工作熱忱，全心投入於工作當中，已成為值得探討的重要議題。本研究旨在探討員工的工作滿意度對工作投入影響，以及職場幸福感在工作滿意度與工作投入間中介效果。本研究採用調查研究法，以臺北郵件處理中心郵件部門員工共479人為調查對象，採用隨機抽樣發放調查問卷356份，回收有效問卷302份，有效回收率84.8%。本研究獲致下列結論：(1)臺北郵件處理中心員工有中度的工作滿意度，以「內在滿意度」較高、「外在滿意度」較低。(2)臺北郵件處理中心員工有中高度的職場幸福感，以「心理幸福感」較高、「情緒幸福感」較低。(3)臺北郵件處理中心員工有中度的工作投入程度。(4)不同性別、工作性質、教育程度與服務年資員工的工作滿意度無顯著差異。(5)內勤工作、高中職（含）以下教育程度員工的職場幸福感較低。(6)內勤工作、高中職（含）以下教育程度員工的工作投入程度較低。(7)員工的工作滿意度正向影響工作投入程度，以「外在滿意度」的影響力較大。(8)員工的工作滿意度正向影響職場幸福感，以「內在滿意度」的影響力較大。(9)員工的職場幸福感正向影響工作投入程度，以「情緒幸福感」的影響力較大。(10)員工的職場幸福感在工作滿意度與工作投入關係間具中介效果。
abstract_en: The employee's of the Taipei Mail Processing Center are responsible for handling and transporting a large number of mails every day, and are often in a high-pressure working environment. Therefore, employee's job satisfaction and workplace well-being are improved, and employee's can display their enthusiasm for work and devote themselves to their work. ,has become an important topic worthy of discussion.The purpose of this study is to investigate the effect of job satisfaction on work involvement and the effect of workplace well-being in mediating between job satisfaction and work involvement. In this study, 479 employee's in the mail department of Taipei Mail Processing Center were surveyed by survey research method, and 356 questionnaires were distributed by random sampling, and 302 valid questionnaires were collected, with an effective recovery rate of 84.8%.This study reached the following conclusions:(1)The employee's of Taipei Mail Processing Center have moderate job satisfaction, with higher "internal satisfaction" and lower "external satisfaction".(2)The employee's of Taipei Mail Processing Center have medium to high workplace well-being, with "psychological well-being " being higher and "emotional well-being " being lower.(3)The employee's of Taipei Mail Processing Center have a medium level of work involvement.(4)There is no significant difference in job satisfaction among employee's of different genders, job nature, education level and years of service.(5)The workplace well-being of the employee's in housekeeping and with high school education is lower.(6)The level of work involvement of employee's with internal work and education up to high school level is relatively low.(7)Employee's job satisfaction positively affects work involvement, with "external satisfaction" having a greater impact.(8)Employee's job satisfaction positively affects workplace well-being, and the influence of "internal satisfaction" is greater.(9)Employee's workplace well-being positively affects work involvement, with "emotional well-being" having a greater impact.(10)Employee's workplace well-being has a mediating effect between job satisfaction and work involvement.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 幼兒園在地化課程之歌仔戲教學活動行動研究
title_en: An Action Research on Taiwanese Opera Teaching Activities for Localized Education Curriculum in Preschool.
keywords: 幼兒園、在地化課程、歌仔戲教學活動、學習成果
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在探討幼兒園在地化課程之歌仔戲教學活動的發展，教學活動歷程中面臨的實施困境與解決策略，以及幼兒的學習成果。本研究以行動研究進行，依據課程大綱六大領域課程目標，運用歌仔戲表演元素發展歌仔戲教學活動，以達成在地化課程教學體驗化及深刻化。研究者以新北市深坑國小附設幼兒園快樂班、年齡介於5-6歲的大班幼兒，共26位為研究對象，進行八週的在地化課程之歌仔戲教學活動。研究期間藉由蒐集與分析教學省思札記、教學觀察回饋表、同儕教師訪談紀錄表、幼兒學習單、闖關活動評量表、成果展演的家長回饋問卷等質性資料。本研究結論歸納如下：一、幼兒園在地化課程結合在地教學資源與歌仔戲，依據課程大綱設計「深坑老街好????迌」單元教學活動。二、幼兒園在地化課程以歌仔戲的劇目、表演、音樂、及舞臺美術四大表演元素，設計「深坑老街好????迌」單元教學活動內容。三、幼兒園在地化課程之歌仔戲教學活動的實施困境與解決策略，包括：1.教學的圖卡太小，幼兒觀察有困難；搭配PPT簡報播放，讓幼兒易於觀察；2.分組活動進行前的教學指令說明不清楚，導致幼兒無所適從；進行分組教學活動時，先詳述活動進行方式；3.受新冠病毒疫情影響致全園停課，教師需隨應變調整教學方式；4.幼兒在課堂的學習時間有限，善用轉銜時間增加幼兒練習機會；5.學齡前幼兒認知能力有限，學習歌仔戲文本有困難；將文本製成大字報輔助幼兒感官記憶學習。四、在地化課程之歌仔戲教學活動的學習成果為：1.身體動作與健康領域能掌控組合各種肢體動作，展現肢體表達及創造本質的能力；2.認知領域能藉由唱唸歌仔戲文本辨識察覺文化產物訊息，加深在地文化印象；3.語文領域能提升閩南語表達能力，以肢體、口語、圖像、自創符號表達訊息類文本；4.情緒領域能運用角色扮演促進情緒表達能力；5.美感領域能以歌仔戲表演進行個人獨特表現，體驗多元美感經驗與藝術元素。最後，根據研究結果提出對教學者與後續研究者建議，作為未來教學或研究之參考。
abstract_en: This study aimed to explore the development of Taiwanese Opera teaching activities in localized curriculum in kindergartens, the difficulties faced and solutions found during the research, and the learning outcomes of children. This research was conducted through Action Research based on the six objectives from the curriculum outline. The Taiwanese Opera performance elements were used to design the teaching activities, so as to achieve and deepen the experience of localized curriculum teaching.The research objects were a total of 26 children aged 5-6 years old from the Happy Class of the Kindergarten attached to Shenkeng Elementary School in New Taipei City. An eight-week localization courses of Taiwanese Opera teaching activities were conducted. During the study, qualitative data such as teaching reflective notes, teaching observation feedback forms, peer teacher interview forms,  children's study sheets, checkpoint activity evaluation forms, and parent feedback questionnaire for performance were collected and analyzed. The conclusions of this study were summarized as follows:A. The Localized Education Curriculum in Preschool combined localized education resources with Taiwanese Opera and designed “Having Fun in Shenkeng Old Street” unit education activities based on the curriculum outline.B. Localized Education Curriculum used four elements of Taiwanese Opera: opera, performance, music, and stage art to design the contents of “Having Fun in Shenkeng Old Street” unit education activities.C.The difficulties and solutions during implementing localized curriculum of Taiwanese Opera in the kindergartens included: 1. The picture cards during teaching were too small, and it was difficult for children to observe; with PowerPoint presentations, it was easier for children to experience; 2. The teaching instructions before the group activities were not clearly explained, causing children not knowing what to do; while conducting group teaching activities, describe the activities in detail at first; 3. Due to the impact of COVID-19, the entire kindergarten was closed. Teachers had to adjust teaching methods accordingly ; 4. Children have limited learning time in the classroom. Make good use of the transition time to increase children's practice opportunities; 5. Preschool children have limited cognitive ability and have difficulties learning the text of Taiwanese Opera; making the text into big-character posters helped children's sensory memory learning.D. The learning outcomes of the localization coureses of Taiwanese Opera teaching activities were: 1. Body movements and the health field can control various body movements and demonstrate the abilities of body expression and creative essence; 2. Cognition field can identify and perceive the information of cultural products and deepen the impression of local culture by singing and reciting the text of Taiwanese Opera; 3. Language field can improve Taiwanese expression ability and express information texts with body, spoken language, images, and self-created symbols; 4. Emotional field can use role-playing to facilitate the ability of emotion expression; 5. Aesthetic field can demonstrate unique personal behavior through Taiwanese Opera performances and experience multiple aesthetic experiences and artistic elements.Finally, according to the research results, suggestions for teachers and follow-up researchers were mentioned as references for future teaching or research.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 臺鐵內部講師訓練課程訓練遷移之研究
title_en: The Transfer of Training on Train-the-Trainer Program : The Case of Taiwan Railways Administration
keywords: 臺灣鐵路管理局、內部講師訓練班、訓練課程、訓練遷移
abstract_zh: 臺灣鐵路管理局員工訓練中心授課講師多以內部講師為主，為協助內部講師提升教學技巧，開辦「內部講師授課技巧訓練班」，期能提升訓練成效。本研究採深度訪談法，探討臺灣鐵路管理局2021年開辦之2期「內部講師授課技巧訓練班」訓練課程之訓練遷移情形。依據Baldwin及Ford的訓練遷移過程模型的訓練設計面向進行研究，分析訓練課程在「教學方法及策略」與「管理能力」的訓練遷移成效，以及訓練遷移之影響因素。研究結果希能提供訓練單位規劃訓練課程之參考，同時提出對企業實務應用與學術研究的建議。根據研究結果，本研究獲致下列結論：一、  內部講師訓練課程產生激勵並維持學員的學習動機、有效教學表達、促進有效學  習、有效提問、適時澄清和回饋、促進學員在工作中應用所學知能之「教學方法及策略」訓練遷移成效。二、  內部講師訓練課程產生有效教學環境管理、有效教學過程管理之「管理能力」訓練遷移成效。三、  「過度學習」與「講師效度」為初期遷移，「舊的學習影響新的學習」為維持遷移，「過度學習」、「確定如何應用訓練技巧」與「注重程序上的知識」為近遷移，「刺激多樣性」與「討論訓練的應用」為遠遷移之影響因素。
abstract_en: Most of the lecturers in the employee training center of the Taiwan Railways Administration are internal lecturers. In order to help internal lecturers improve their teaching skills, the "Internal Lecturer Teaching Skills Training Class" is held to improve the training effect.This study adopted the in-depth interview method to explore the training transfer situation of the trainees who have completed the two courses of  "Internal Lecturer Teaching Skills Training" organized by the Taiwan Railways Administration in 2021. According to the training design orientation of Baldwin and Ford's training transfer process model, the training transfer effect of the trainees in "teaching methods and strategies" and "management ability" was analyzed, as well as the influencing factors of training transfer. The research results hope to provide a reference for training units to plan training courses, and at the same time put forward suggestions for enterprise practical application and academic research. According to the results of data processing and analysis, this study draws the following conclusions.1.Internal lecture training courses generate motivations and maintain students' learning motivation, effective teaching expression, improvement of effective learning, effective questioning, timely clarification and feedback, and enhance the "teaching methods and strategies" training transfer effects for students to apply what they have learned in their work .2.Internal lecturer training courses cause the "management ability" training transfer effect including effective teaching environment management and effective teaching process management.3."Over-learning" and "Instructor Effectiveness" are initial transfer, "old learning influences new learning" is maintaining transfer; "over-learning", "determining how to apply training skills" and "emphasis on procedural knowledge "are near transfer, "stimulus diversity" and "discussion training application" are the influencing factors of far transfer.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 教官全面退離後學務創新人力對私立大專校院校園安全工作影響之研究
title_en: A Study of Campus Safety-The Impact of Innovative Manpower in Student Affairs After the Total Withdrawal of Military Education Instructors in Private Institutions of Higher Education
keywords: 校園安全、軍訓教官、學務創新人力、大專校院、教官退出校園
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在探討當教官全面退出大專校院，並由學務創新人力接替執行原由軍訓教官所執行的各項校園安全工作後，對於一向倚重軍訓教官的私立大專校院而言將會對校內的人員，以及爾後各項校園安全工作的執行上造成何種影響，以及未來可採取的相關因應作為為何，依此本研究擬定了：對校內行政人員造成何種影響及因應對策為何、對校內教師造成何種影響及因應對策為何、對校內學生造成何種影響及因應對策為何、對校園安全值勤工作造成何種影響及因應對策為何、對學生生活輔導工作造成何種影響及因應對策為何、對意外事件處理造成何種影響及因應對策為何以及對安全維護事件處理造成何種影響及因應對策為何等七項待答問題，並以訪談法邀請任職於私立大專校院，且對學務創新人力具有專業見解及實務處理經驗的校長、副校長、學務長及軍訓室主任等共6位實施訪談，並就訪談所得進行分析、解構與重組後歸結出，對學務創新人力在執行校園安全相關工作上造成影響的主軸因素共有「學務創新人力與軍訓教官身分不同」、「法規制度不夠完善」以及「人員教育訓練不足」等三項，並獲致本研究結論為「雖然目前學務創新人力在執行校園安全工作上會造成影響，但並非完全無法替代軍訓教官」，並依研究結論提出「完善法令規章」、「持續辦理人員教育訓練」、「建立勞資雙方共識」以及「調整校內工作現況」等四項具體建議。因現階段正處轉型的過渡時期，且學務創新人力全面接替軍訓教官，對於已實施多年的現行體制而言實為重大變革，所涉及的層面也相當廣泛，因此期望在本研究的建議事項能夠引起相關單位的注意，同時也有後續的研究者能對其他影響層面進行更進一步的探討。
abstract_en: The purpose of this study is to examine the impact on the withdrawal of military education instructors from institutions of higher education (HEI) and replaced by student affairs innovative manpower to perform various campus safety tasks, specifically, the impact on private HEIs, which have heavily relied on military education instructors to execute various safety tasks, and relevant actions that can be taken by those HEIs in the future. Accordingly, this study has formulated seven questions to figure out the possible impacts and actions. What kind of impacts on administrative staff? What kind of impacts on teachers? What kind of impacts on students? What kind of impacts on campus safety daily duties? What kind of impacts on student guidance and counseling tasks? What kind of impacts on accident management? And what kind of impacts on campus safety endurance? To answer these questions, The author interviewed Presidents, Vice Presidents, Deans of Student Affairs, and Directors of Military Training Instructor’s Office who are working in private HEIs and have professional insight and practical experience in innovative manpower. After analyzing, deconstructing, and reorganizing the interview results, this study concluded that the three main factors that have impact on the innovative manpower of student affairs in performing campus safety-related tasks, which are "the fundamental identity of personnel is different," "the legal system is not perfect," and "the training of personnel is insufficient." Furthermore, it gets the concludes that “the current innovative manpower in student affairs does have a positive impact on campus safety, and could have the competency to be the substitute of military education instructors.” Accordingly, the study also gives solid recommendations as "improvement of laws and regulations," "continuous staff education and training," "establishment of consensus between employers and employees" and "adjustment of working conditions on campus". Currently, the system is in the transitional period of transformation, meanwhile, the innovative manpower of student affairs is also taking over safety tasks from military education instructors. It is a major change to the system which has been implemented for many years and involves a wide range of aspects. Thus, the author hopes that the recommendations in this study can draw the attention of the relevant authorities, and could be beneficial to follow-on studys.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 高中非藝術才能班學生美感素養感知能力提升課程之研究
title_en: A Study on the Sensibility Module of Aesthetic Literacy for Non-Art-Talent Class Students in High School
keywords: 美感素養、感知能力、華德福教育
abstract_zh: 感知能力是影響美感素養的關鍵因素之一，本研究主要針對高中非藝術才能班學生設計美感素養感知能力提升之課程。第一階段首先透過文獻探討與分析，建立課程設計發展之基礎。並根據人文主義取向精神發展課程的設計，其教學內涵立基在華德福教育十二感官理論。初步課程透過專家訪談、實施課程前導實驗建立信效度。第二階段，根據第一階段調整過之感知能力提升課程，進行正式實驗。實驗對象共四組，分屬四間不同高中，每組含實驗組與對照組，授課時間每周二小時。教師可在實驗組班級導入感知能力提升課程，對照組班級亦能在課程設定主題相似的課程中進行課程，實驗組與對照組教學實施前後分別使用高敏感族群量表、美感素養量表進行感知能力、美感素養之前後測。最後，本研究將透過感知能力提升課程實施過程中之學生個別歷程檔案記錄評量、教師觀察本位評量、表現實做評量之質性資料以及高敏感族群量表、美感素養量表之前後測結果進行討論與分析，提出「感知能力提升課程」，且從研究結果顯示感知能力提升課程對於感知能力與美感素養皆有正向提升之影響，最後亦將提出感知能力提升課程之相關建議，企盼本研究能作為美感素養的取徑以及後續相關研究重要的參考資料。
abstract_en: Sensibility is one of the key factors affecting aesthetic literacy. This research is mainly aimed at designing module for improving the sensibility of the senior non-artistic-class students of high schools. In the first stage, the foundation of module design and development was established through literature review and analysis. And based on the design of the humanistic-oriented spiritual development curriculum, the teaching content was built on the theory of the twelve senses of Waldorf education. The reliability and validity of the preliminary module were established through expert interviews and the implementation of pre-course teaching experiments. In the second stage, formal teaching experiments were carried out according to the adjusted sensibility improvement module in the first stage. There were four groups of subjects in the experiment, belonging to four different high schools. Each group included the experimental and the control classes. The teaching time was two hours a week. Teachers could introduce sensibility improvement module in the experimental-group classes, and the control-group classes could conduct similar theme-based courses as well. The experimental group and the control group used the high-sensitivity group scale and the aesthetic literacy scale to perceive the results before and after the teaching implementation. Finally, this research would be carried out through the evaluation of students’ individual portfolios during the module, the teacher's observation-based evaluation, the qualitative data of the actual performance evaluation, the high-sensitivity group scale, and the pre- and post-test results of aesthetic literacy. After the discussion and analysis, we would know the “sensibility improvement module” and the research results showed that the sensibility improvement module had a positive impact on both sensibility and aesthetic literacy. Finally, relevant suggestions for the sensibility improvement module would be put forward. I will look forward to this research which could be used as an approach to aesthetic literacy and an important reference for subsequent related research.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 產學訓專班學員訓練滿意度與訓練成效關係之研究
title_en: The Relationship Between Training Satisfaction and Training Effectiveness of Students in The Industry-Academy-Training Programs
keywords: 產學訓合作訓練計畫、產學訓專班學員、訓練滿意度、訓練成效
abstract_zh: 產學訓合作訓練計畫與其他制度最大不同之處在於，它納入了政府機關所辦的職業訓練。這樣的設計是否發揮成效，目前並無相關研究。因此，本研究旨在探討產學訓專班學員訓練滿意度與訓練成效，藉以瞭解計畫辦理情形。本研究採用問卷調查法，以勞動力發展署所屬各分署2019-2021年辦理的產學訓專班之完成職業訓練學員共555名為調查對象，問卷調查結果採用描述性統計、單一樣本t檢定、獨立樣本t檢定、單因子變異數分析、積差相關分析、迴歸分析等統計方法分析。本研究獲致結論如下：一、產學訓專班學員的訓練滿意度良好，以教學師資的訓練滿意度最高。二、產學訓專班學員的訓練成效良好，以技能的訓練成效最高。三、不同證照取得情形、畢業群別、就讀系別、辦理分署別的學員之訓練滿意度有顯著差異。四、不同證照取得情形、畢業群別、就讀系別、辦理分署別的學員之訓練成效有顯著差異。五、產學訓專班學員的訓練滿意度正向影響訓練成效，以教學師資滿意度對訓練成效的影響力最大。
abstract_en: The biggest difference between the Industry-Academy-Training Collaboration Program and other systems is that the Industry-Academy-Training Collaboration Program incorporates vocational training provided by government agencies. There is no relevant research on whether such a design is effective. Therefore, the purpose of this study is to explore the training satisfaction and training effectiveness of the students in the Industry-Academy-Training programs, so as to understand the situation of the Program. The researcher adopted the questionnaire survey method, with a total of 555 students finished vocational training from 2019 to 2021 in the Industry-Academy-Training programs handled by the branches of the Labor Development Administration. The results of the questionnaire survey was analyzed by statistical methods including: descriptive statistics, one sample t-test, independent samples t-test, one-way ANOVA, product moment correlation analysis, and regression analysis.The acquired conclusions of the study as below:1.The training satisfaction of the students in the Industry-Academy-Training programs was good, and the satisfaction of the teaching staff was the highest.2.The training effectiveness of the students in the Industry-Academy-Training programs was good, and the effectiveness of skills was the highest.3.There were significant differences of training satisfaction among the students with different background variables of license’s obtaining, grades, departments of study, the branches of the Labor Development Administration.4.There were significant differences of training effectiveness among the students with different background variables of license’s obtaining, grades, departments of study, the branches of the Labor Development Administration.5.The training satisfaction to the students had a positive influence on the training effectiveness to the students, and the satisfaction of the teaching staff had the greatest influence on the training effectiveness.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 混成學習對科技大學學生指甲彩繪課程實作能力之行動研究
title_en: An Action Research of Blended Learning on Students' Practical Skills in Nail Painting Course at the University of Science and Technology
keywords: 混成學習、指甲彩繪、實作能力
abstract_zh: 混成學習打破時間與空間的限制，不論課前預習或課後復習都更加方便，不僅能讓學習場域更加彈性，也能提供學生更便捷的學習機制。本研究目的在探討如何將混成學習應用在指甲彩繪課程教學上，以提升技能實作能力。本研究採用行動研究，以某科技大學化妝品應用系選修「指甲彩繪實務」課程的31位學生為研究對象，以了解混成學習是否能提升學生的技能實作能力。本研究結果如下：一、本行動研究所遭遇的困境與因應策略包含(1) 增加數位教材內容，以因應疫情影響；(2)調整教學策略以克服數位教學平台流量問題；(3)鼓勵學生在線上討論與留言，養成主動參與課程互動的習慣。二、運用混成學習於科技大學指甲彩繪技能課程後，學生指甲彩繪實作能力後測表現高於前測。
abstract_en: Blended learning breaks the constraints of time and space, making it more convenient for students to pre-study before and review after class. It not only makes the learning area more flexible, but also provides students with a more convenient learning mechanism.The purpose of this study is to investigate how blended learning can be applied to the teaching of nail painting course to enhance students' practical skills. An action research was conducted with 31 students enrolled in the "Nail Painting Practice" course in the department of cosmetic application at a university of science and technology to find out whether blended learning could improve students' practical skills. The results of this study are as follows.The dilemmas encountered in this action research and the strategies to address them included (1) increased the content of digital materials to cope with the curriculum planning affected by the epidemic; (2) adjusted the teaching strategy to overcome the traffic problem of e-learning platform; (3) encouraged students to discuss and leave comments online to help students actively participate in course interaction.After applying blended learning in the nail painting skills course at a university of science and technology, the students' post-test performance of nail painting skills was higher than the pre-test.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 團體導向學習法對五專護理科學生學習成效之研究-以內外科護理學呼吸系統單元為例
title_en: Evaluating the Effectiveness of Team Based Learning on Learning Outcomes of Nursing Students in a Five-Year Junior College: Respiratory System as Example
keywords: 五專護理科學生、團體導向學習法、講述教學法、內外科護理學、學習成效
abstract_zh: 本研究目的為探討團體導向學習在內外科護理學課程學科成績、自主學習及合作學習經驗之成效，採用準實驗研究方法。實驗對象為北部某大學五專護理科修習內外科護理學課程的三年級學生，採隨機分派51位實驗組與50位對照組，依據內外科課程之期中考成績，將實驗組分成高中低三組；實驗組接受TBL法，而對照組接受講述教學，進行為期四週實驗活動。    實驗研究為2021 年4月至6月，三份測驗卷依照課程目標，選取1999-2020年之國考題目，依照學習目標每次20題選擇題進行前後測。量表部份採用教育部自學習量表及合作經驗量表兩份信效度良好之問卷，聘請護理專家進行詞語修訂。在學期結束一個月，進行學生的調查問卷填寫。學科測驗及問卷回收後進行描述性統計、相依相本t檢定及變異數分析。研究結果如下：一、實驗組與對照組的學科成績無顯著差異，實驗組進行學科測驗成效，三次的成績有顯著差異。成績延宕表現實驗組與對照組無顯差異，實驗組在控制前測後側差異，看到段考有成效。二、實驗組高中低分組之學科成績無顯著差異，高分組、中分組及低分組三次測驗各別是有明顯進步，高分組優於低分組。三、實驗組及對照組在自主學習是無顯著差異，在實驗組自主學習組內有顯著差異。然在合作學習經驗實組與對照組明顯不同。四、實驗組高中低組在自主學習及合作學習經無顯著差異。實驗組高中低組自主學習均有顯差異，實驗組在合作學習經驗學習項中僅有同儕與學習動機有顯著相關。實驗組的學科成績較對照組稍高，可見學生學習潛能是可以被發展。建議此教師廣泛經驗參與，協助學生在主動學習及合作學習內化，進而促使學生潛移默化在未來臨床工作上。
abstract_en: The purpose of this study was to use a quasi-experimental research approach to investigate the effectiveness of team-based learning in terms of subject tests, self-directed learning, and cooperative learning experiences. The subjects were third-year students enrolled in a medical-surgical nursing course at a university in northern Taiwan. 51 experimental groups and 50 control groups were randomly assigned, and the experimental groups were divided into three groups according to the midterm exam results of the medical-surgical course; the experimental groups received the TBL method, while the control groups received the lecture method.   The experimental study will be conducted from April to June 2021, and the three tests will be based on the curriculum objectives, selected from the 1999-2020 national examinations, and administered as a pre and post test with 20 multiple-choice questions each according to the learning objectives. The Ministry of Education Self-Teaching Inventory and the Cooperative Experience Inventory were used for the scale, and nursing experts were hired to revise the terminology. Student surveys were completed one month after the end of the semester. Descriptive statistics, correlation t-tests, and analysis of variance were performed after subject scores and questionnaires were collected. The results of the study are as follows:1.There was no significant difference in the academic test scores between the experimental and control groups, but there was a significant difference in the validity of the three academic tests in the experimental group. There was no significant difference in the delay scores between the experimental group and the control group, and the experimental group effectively controlled the difference between the pre-test and the post-test.2.There was no significant difference between the academic score of the high, middle, and low scoring groups in the experimental group, and the high scoring group was better than the low scoring group.3.There was no significant difference between the experimental group and the control group in terms of independent learning, while there was a significant difference between the experimental group and the independent learning group. However, there were significant differences in the cooperative learning experience between the experimental and control groups.4.There was no significant difference between the experimental group and the high school and low school groups in independent learning and cooperative learning. There were significant differences in the autonomous learning between the high and low groups in the experimental group, and only the peers in the experimental group had a significant correlation with learning motivation in cooperative learning experiences.   The subject scores of the experimental group were significantly higher than those of the control group, indicating that students' learning potential can be developed. It is suggested that this extensive experience will help students to internalize learning and cooperative learning, which in turn will help students to implicitly develop their clinical work in the future.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 新北市區公所公務人員工作壓力、工作滿意、關係型心理契約與離職傾向關係之研究
title_en: Relationships among Job Stress, Job Satisfaction, Relational Psychological Contract and Turnover Intention of Civil Servants in the District Offices of New Taipei City
keywords: 公務人員、工作壓力、工作滿意、關係型心理契約、離職傾向
abstract_zh: 地方機關面臨組織再造、員額精簡及民眾要求日益提高的壓力下，基層人員離職率不斷攀升，不僅影響服務品質與工作效能，亦出現大量的人力缺口及青黃不接等問題。本研究旨在探討區公所公務人員的工作壓力、工作滿意、關係型心理契約與離職傾向間之關係，以及工作滿意、關係型心理契約在工作壓力與離職傾向間之中介效果。    本研究以新北市區公所公務人員為研究對象，以立意取樣方式進行資料蒐集，共回收656份有效調查問卷，有效回收率為79.04%，採用敘述性統計分析、信度與效度分析、相關分析、迴歸分析及Sobel檢定等統計方法進行資料處理。研究結論如下：一、區公所公務人員有中等程度的工作壓力、工作滿意、關係型心理契約與離職傾向知覺。二、區公所公務人員以工作負荷量過度的工作壓力較高。三、區公所公務人員以薪資和工作量相比，以及工作能給予升遷機會的工作滿意較低，且內在滿意高於外在滿意。四、區公所公務人員以機關有明確規劃職業生涯路徑的關係型心理契約較低。五、區公所公務人員以有尋找其他工作念頭的離職傾向較高。六、區公所公務人員的工作壓力對離職傾向有顯著正向影響力；工作壓力對工作滿意、工作壓力對關係型心理契約、工作滿意對離職傾向、關係型心理契約對離職傾向均呈現顯著負向影響力。七、區公所公務人員的工作滿意、關係型心理契約在工作壓力與離職傾向間皆存在顯著部分中介效果。
abstract_en: Under the pressure of organizational reorganization, staff reduction and increasing demands from the public, the turnover rate of entry-level personnel continues to rise, which not only affects service quality and work efficiency, but also presents a large number of manpower gaps. The purpose of this study was to investigate the relationship between job stress, job satisfaction, relational psychological contract and turnover intention among civil servants in district offices, as well as the mediating effect of job satisfaction, relational psychological contract on job stress and turnover intention.    This study took the civil servants in the district offices of New Taipei City as the research object, and collected data by means of intentional sampling. A total of 656 valid questionnaires were recovered, and the effective recovery rate was 79.04%. Descriptive statistical analysis, reliability and validity analysis, correlation Statistical methods such as analysis, regression analysis and Sobel test were used for data processing. The research conclusions are as follows:1.The civil servants in the district office have a moderate degree of job stress, job satisfaction, relational psychological contract and perception of turnover intention.2.The civil servants in the district office have high job stress due to excessive workload.3.Compared with the salary and workload, and the opportunity for promotion, the civil servants in the district office are less satisfied with their jobs, and their internal satisfaction is higher than their external satisfaction.4.The relational psychological contract of the civil servants in the district office with a clearly planned career path is relatively low.5.The civil servants in the district office have a higher tendency to leave for other jobs.6.The job stress of the civil servants in the district office has a significant positive influence on turnover intention; it has a significant negative effect on job satisfaction. Also, job stress on relational psychological contract, job satisfaction on turnover intention, and relational psychological contract on turnover intention all present negative effects.7.The civil servants’ job satisfaction and relational psychological contract in district office have significant partial mediating effects between job stress and turnover intention.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 運用翻轉教室於技術型高中智能障礙學生服務導論課程之行動研究
title_en: An Action Research of Applying Flipped Classroom on the Introduction to Store Service Course for Students with Intellectual Disabilities in Vocational High School
keywords: 翻轉教室、智能障礙、學習成效
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在運用翻轉教室，以瞭解技術型高中智能障礙學生的學習成效改變及實施過程中所遭遇的問題及解決策略。實施的課程為技術型高中服務群科一年級部訂必修服務導論課程，為門市服務科學生重要的基礎概念課程，對於智能障礙學生未來的相關課程學習、校外職場實習或就業皆是相當必要的基石，奠定良好基礎對學生未來就業與獨立自主有相當大的助益。本研究採用行動研究，研究對象則為臺北市某技術型高中一年級共11位智能障礙學生，男生6人，女生5人。在10週的服務導論課程期間，研究者於課前準備與該週教學內容有關的基礎概念影片，讓學生提前進行學習，在於課堂中引導學生進行分組討論，以了解翻轉教室對學生的學習成效之影響。本研究結果如下：一、翻轉教室運用於技術型高中智能障礙學生課程中應在課前影片觀看、討論及發表方式進行調整。二、翻轉教室實施過程中於課前、課中遭遇到的問題均有因應的解決策略。三、翻轉教室能提升技術型高中智能障礙學生之學習成效。
abstract_en: The purpose of this study is to use the flipped classroom to understand the changes in learning performance of students with intellectual disabilities in vocational high schools, as well as the problems encountered in the implementation process and strategies to solve them. The course is an introduction to store service, which is a required course for the first year of service group in vocational high school and is an important foundation course for service group students in related courses of study and in their future careers.This study was an action research. The subjects were 11 students with intellectual disabilities, 6 males and 5 females, in the first grade of a vocational high school in Taipei. During the 10-weeks introduction to store service course, the researcher prepared several videos of basic concepts related to the week's content for students to study in advance, and then led group discussions in class to understand the effect of the flipped classroom on students' learning performance.The results of this study are as follows:1. The flipped classroom for students with intellectual disabilities in vocational high schools should be appropriately designed for pre-class video watching, class discussion and presentation.2. In the process of implementing the flipped classroom, there were strategies to solve the problems encountered before and during the class.3. The use of flipped classroom could enhance the learning performance of students with intellectual disabilities.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 擴增實境數位教材對企業新進人員學習成效之影響
title_en: A Study on Using Augmented Reality to Improve Enterprise's Novice Employees' Learning Performance
keywords: 擴增實境數位教材、網頁式數位教材、企業培訓、新柯氏四層成效評估模式
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在探究以擴增實境數位教材應用於企業新進人員培訓，是否有助於提升學習成效。本研究採用準實驗研究法，研究對象以研究者所任職的電信公司為例，分為實驗組32人，控制組35人，實驗組以擴增實境數位教材進行教學，控制組則以網頁式數位教材進行教學。各組別所運用之數位教材皆安排於授課前使用，並於遠距同步教學的前半段再次用於講師補充講授。資料蒐集包含先對數位教材進行SUS可用性評估。另依據新柯氏四層評估模式，觀察業績達成率（對應成果層級）、實作檢核評量成績（對應行為層級）、線上測驗前、後測成績（對應學習層級），及學習者滿意度（對應反應層級）等數據。研究結果顯示，擴增實境數位教材的開發門檻已降低，可由企業內部人員自主開發，但相較於網頁式數位教材，其困難度較高且需留意更多注意事項；而網頁式數位教材之可用性評估分數較擴增實境數位教材更為優異，且達顯著差異。但依照必要性互動要素開發之擴增實境數位教材的使用者接受度已達「接受邊緣」等級，未來僅需修改後即可正式投入培訓現場；在學習成效的表現上，應用擴增實境數位教材較網頁式數位教材在成果層級（業績達成率）及反應層級（學習者滿意度）能有更好的表現，但其餘學習成效層級皆未達顯著差異。
abstract_en: The purpose of this study is to investigate whether the application of augmented reality digital materials to the training of new employees in a company can help improve their learning performance. This study adopted a quasi-experimental research method. The research subjects were divided into 32 participants in the experimental group and 35 participants in the control group at the telecommunication company where the researcher worked. The augmented reality digital materials were used for the experimental group and web-based digital materials for the control group. The digital materials used in each group were arranged to be used before the class, and then used again in the first half of the distance synchronous teaching for the instructor to supplement the lecture. The data collection included the SUS usability assessment of the digital materials. In addition, the new world Kirkpatrick model was used to observe the performance achievement rate (corresponding to the outcome level), the performance review assessment scores (corresponding to the behavior level), the online pre-test and post-test scores (corresponding to the learning level), and the learner satisfaction (corresponding to the response level).The study results showed that the development threshold for augmented reality digital materials has been lowered and can be developed by in-house staff, but it is more difficult and requires more attention than web-based digital materials. The usability score of the web-based digital materials was better than augmented reality digital materials. However, the user acceptance level of the augmented reality digital materials developed in accordance with the necessary interactive elements has reached the "margin of acceptance" level, and they can be put into the training field with only modifications in the future. In terms of learning performance, the application of augmented reality digital materials perfoemed better than the web-based digital materials at the outcome level (performance achievement rate) and the response level (learner satisfaction), but the rest of the learning performace level did not reach significant difference.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 密室逃脫遊戲融入國小五年級數學線對稱圖形教學之研究
title_en: The Study of Integrating Room Escape Game Into Instruction of Line Symmetry Graphics on Fifth Grade
keywords: 密室逃脫、數學學習成就、數學學習態度、合作學習、線對稱圖形
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在探討密室逃脫遊戲融入國小五年級數學線對稱圖形教學對於學生數學學習成就、數學學習態度以及合作學習行為表現之影響，並瞭解學生對密室逃脫遊戲融入數學課程教學的感受與心得。本研究採前實驗研究之單組前－後測設計，以22名國小五年級學生做為研究對象進行六節線對稱圖形單元教學實驗。將本研究結果歸納如下：一、密室逃脫遊戲融入國小五年級數學線對稱圖形教學採用合作學習法，能有效提升學生數學學習成就，尤其是低分組的學生。二、密室逃脫遊戲融入國小五年級數學線對稱圖形教學對學生數學學習態度具有正面之影響，尤其對低分組學生在「學習數學的自信」的向度表現。三、合作學習法加入密室逃脫遊戲教學對學生的合作行為表現中，學生較欠缺「鼓勵同學」與「幫助同學」之行為表現。四、多數學生對密室逃脫遊戲融入數學課程的教學方式抱持正向的態度與感受。最後，根據本研究提出結論與提供建議做為未來相關研究參考之方向。
abstract_en: The purpose of this study is to explore the effects of integration of escape room game into the mathematics teaching of line symmetry graphics on 5’th grade’s  mathematics learning achievement, mathematics learning attitude and cooperative learning behavior, and to comprehend the students' feelings and experiences. The pre-experimental research method was adopted in this study, which had 22 fifth-grade students using escape room game integrating into mathematics teaching during six lessons of line symmetry graphics unit.The results of this study are summarized as follows:1.The escape room game integrated into the mathematics line symmetry graphics teaching of 5’th grade elementary school. The cooperative learning has positive effects on raising student performance, especially for students in low-scoring student.2.  The escape room game integrated into the mathematics line symmetry graphics teaching has a positive effect on student’s mathematics learning attitude, especially the performance of the "confidence in mathematics learning" dimension of students in low-scoring student.3.In the cooperative behavior performance of students, when the cooperative learning method is added to the teaching of escape room games, students lack the behaviors of "encouraging classmates" and "helping classmates".4.Most students have positive attitudes and feelings towards the teaching method that escape room games are integrated into the mathematics curriculum.   Based on this study, the conclusions and suggestions are provided as the reference for future research.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 使用擴增實境運動App改善技術型高中腦性麻痺學生動作表現之成效
