title_en: The Effect of Using an Augmented Reality Sports App to Improve Motor Performance in Vocational High School Students with Cerebral Palsy
keywords: 擴增實境、腦性麻痺、動作表現
abstract_zh: 腦性麻痺學生常因肢體上的限制及不方便導致生活型態多為被動及久坐式，所以需要規律的運動增加身體的適能、提升心肺耐力及維持其肢體動作的基本能力。擴增實境應用在特殊教育課程，有助於學生注意力的訓練並且減少分心行為，也能提升學習的成效。本研究旨在探討使用擴增實境運動App方案介入腦性麻痺學生動作表現之成效，使用Active Arcade此App中的「WHACK A MOLE」和「BONNY HOP」此兩款遊戲，探討是否能藉此改善腦性麻痺學生的核心穩定以及下肢肌力。研究對象為一名臺北市某技術型高中腦性麻痺學生，研究方法採單一受試研究法之撤回設計（A-B-A），實施共8週的擴增實境運動App課程，皆以「特奧會健康運動趣味體適能手冊」中的動作當作施測項目要素，蒐集基線期、介入期及撤回期研究參與者之動作表現分數進行目視分析與C統計考驗，並整理質性資料以了解研究成效，本研究說明結果如下：一、擴增實境運動App對技術型高中腦性麻痺學生動作表現具有立即成效。二、擴增實境運動App對技術型高中腦性麻痺學生動作表現不具維持成效。三、使用擴增實境運動App融入功能性動作訓練課程，特殊教育人員持正向看法。四、家長及學生對於使用擴增實境運動App皆持正向看法。
abstract_en: Students with cerebral palsy often have passive and sedentary lifestyles due to physical limitations and inconveniences. Therefore, regular exercise is required to increase their physical fitness, improve cardiorespiratory endurance and maintain the fundamental body movements. Studies have shown that Augmented Reality (AR) apply to special education courses can help to train the attention and reduce distractions from the students, which can also improve their learning performance.The purpose of this study is to investigate the effect of using the Augmented Reality sports App to improve the motor performance of students with cerebral palsy. The two games "WHACK A MOLE" and "BONNY HOP" from the Active Arcade App were used as the research tools, to explore whether they could improve the core stability and lower-limb muscle strength of students with cerebral palsy.The study was conducted on a student with cerebral palsy from a vocational high school in Taipei City. The research method was a single subject study with a withdrawal design (A-B-A), and an 8-week Augmented Reality sports App program was implemented. The movements in the "Special Olympics Sports Health FUNfitness Manual" were used as the test items. The movement performance scores of the participant in the baseline, the intervention, and the withdrawal periods were collected for visual analysis and C statistics tests. The qualitative data were also collected to understand the effectiveness of this study.The results of this study are as follows:1. The Augmented Reality sports App had immediate effect on the motor performance of vocational high school student with cerebral palsy.2. The Augmented Reality sports App was not effective in maintaining the motor performance of vocational high school student with cerebral palsy.3. Special education teacher had positive perceptions of using the Augmented Reality sports App to integrate into functional motor training program.4. Both parent and student hold positive perceptions of the use of the Augmented Reality sports App.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 運用Kirkpatrick評估員工教育訓練對成就動機與工作績效相關性-以B公司為例
title_en: The Correlation Between Employee Motivation and Performance by Using Kirkpatrick Four Levels of Evaluation - An Example from Company B
keywords: Kirkpatrick、數位學習、教育訓練、成就動機、工作績效
abstract_zh: 各種產業加速進行數位轉型與數位化的服務，以因應後疫情時代的社會轉變，除了彈性與便利等優勢，也可提高組織收益。本研究探討B公司員工使用內部數位學習平台之教育訓練課程中，對於成就動機與工作績效之間的關係，並以Kirkpatrick四層次評估模式為理論架構來評估B公司訓練成效。    本研究方法使用問卷調查作為蒐集資料之工具，以網路問卷發送共87份問卷，有效問卷為76份，網路問卷回收率為99%。以描述性統計分析、信度分析、獨立樣本t檢定、單因子變異數、皮爾森積差分析與多元階層回歸分析，進行資料統計分析，研究結果如下： 一、不同背景變項，員工參與數位學習平台的訓練成效是有部分產生正向影響。 二、員工參與數位學習平台教育訓練課程後，對於反應、學習、行為、結果這四個層面的訓練成效是有正向影響。 三、探討運用數位學習平台教育訓練課程，員工的成就動機及工作績效相關性，是有明顯相互關係。
abstract_en: Various industries are accelerating their digital transformation and digitisation of services to cope with the social changes in the post-epidemic era, which not only offers advantages such as flexibility and convenience, but also enhances organisational profitability. This study investigates the relationship between motivation and performance of employees in Company B's education and training programmes using an in-house e-learning platform, and uses the Kirkpatrick four-level evaluation model as a theoretical framework to assess the effectiveness of training in Company B.    A total of 87 questionnaires were distributed through an online survey and 76 valid questionnaires were returned, with a return rate of 99%. Descriptive statistics, reliability analysis, independent sample t-testing, one-way variance, Pearson's analysis of variance and multilevel regression analysis were used to analyse the data.(1)  The training effectiveness of employees' participation in the e-learning platform waspartially positively affected by different background variables(2)  After participating in the training courses on the e-learning platform, there is a positiveeffect on the training effectiveness of the four dimensions of reaction, learning, behaviour and outcome.The four dimensions of training effectiveness, namely response, learning, behaviour and outcome, are positively affected.(3)  The motivation of employees to achieve and the relevance of their performance whenusing the e-learning platform for education and training programmes.The correlation between the motivation of employees and their performance is significant.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 公立圖書館館員工作自我效能與創新工作行為之關係-知覺組織創新氣候之調節效果
title_en: A Research on the Relationship Among Work Self-efficacy and Innovative Work Behavior of Public Librarians- The Moderating Effect of Perceived Organizational Innovation Climate
keywords: 工作自我效能、組織創新氣候、創新工作行為、COVID-19、圖書館館員
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在探討公立圖書館館員工作自我效能於COVID-19疫情期間創新工作行為間之關係，且研究知覺組織創新氣候是否具調節作用。本研究採問卷調查，發放對象以公共圖書館統計系統與教育部2020年12月底之統計資料，國立圖書館計有3所與六都市立圖書館均屬公立圖書館，其現職編制內館員共計927人，正式發放500份問卷，而實際回收問卷，將回答不完整之問卷視為無效問卷剔除後，共計回收464份，有效問卷回收率92.8%，並使用獨立樣本t檢定、單因子變異分析、相關分析、迴歸與階層迴歸分析，而獲致以下結論：    一、公立圖書館館員工作自我效能、疫情期間創新工作行為及知覺組織創新氣候表現均達中高等程度。    二、公立圖書館館員中專業人員、主管人員、年齡越長、年資及職等越高者其工作自我效能表現較高。    三、公立圖書館館員中專業人員、主管人員、年齡越長者、學歷及職等越高者其創新工作行為表現較高。    四、公立圖書館館員工作自我效能對創新工作行為具正向顯著影響。    五、公立圖書館館員知覺組織創新氣候對疫情期間創新工作行為具正向顯著影響。    六、公立圖書館館員知覺組織創新氣候子構面組織支持、工作挑戰性及工作自主性等對疫情期間創新工作行為子構面構想產生、構想推展及構想實現均具正向顯著影響。    七、公立圖書館館員知覺組織創新氣候在工作自我效能與疫情期間創新工作行為間具正向調節效果。    八、公立圖書館館員知覺組織創新氣候子構面中組織支持、主管鼓勵及工作自主性對工作自我效能與創新工作行為各子構面均具正向調節效果。    綜上，由所獲得之結果，表示組織可藉由訓練課程或知識分享等方式提高館員工作自我效能，進而促使館員提升創新工作行為；亦可藉由凝聚組織願景共識與政策措施提升組織創新氣候，激發並提高館員工作自我效能與創新工作行為。
abstract_en: This study was to examine the relationship among work self-efficacy and innovative work behaviors of public librarians in Taiwan, and uses organizational innovation climate as a moderating variable. This research adopts a questionnaire survey and distributes the statistical data of the public library statistical system and the Ministry of Education as of the end of December 2020. There are 927 librarians in the public libraries. 500 questionnaires were officially distributed, but the actual questionnaires were recovered. After excluding invalid questionnaires, a total of 464 valid questionnaires were recovered, and the recovery rate of valid questionnaires was 92.8%. By means of a census, it is expected that an independent sample t test, One-way ANOVA, correlate Analysis , regression analysis and hierarchical regression analysis be used after the questionnaire is collected.1. The performance of public librarians' work self-efficacy, perceived organizational innovation climate and innovative work behaviors all reached a medium to high level.2. Among the public librarians, professionals, supervisors, older people, higher seniority and higher grades have higher job self-efficacy.3. Among the public librarians, professionals, supervisors, older persons, higher education and occupational levels have higher performance of innovative work behaviors.4. The work self-efficacy of public librarians has a positive and significant impact on innovative work behavior.5. Public librarians' perception of organizational innovation climate has a positive and significant impact on innovative work behavior during the epidemic.6. Public librarians' perception of organizational innovation climate sub-facet organizational support, work challenge and work autonomy have a positive and significant impact on the sub-facet concept generation, concept promotion and concept realization of innovative work behavior during the epidemic.7. Public librarians' perceived organizational innovation climate has a positive moderating effect between work self-efficacy and innovative work behavior during the epidemic.8. Organizational support, supervisor encouragement and work autonomy in the sub-scale of public librarians' perception of organizational innovation climate have positive moderating effects on each sub-scale of work self-efficacy and innovative work behavior.In summary, The results obtained from that organizations can improve librarians' work self-efficacy through training courses or knowledge sharing, thereby promoting librarians to improve their innovative work behaviors; they can also enhance organizational innovation climate by building organizational vision consensus and policy measures, inspiring and Improve librarian work self-efficacy and innovative work behavior.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 不同技術層次學生在測量工程瞄準角度時腦波頻率差異之研究
title_en: A Study on the EEG Frequency Domains Between Students with Different Aiming Angle Skill Levels in Survey Engineering
keywords: 測量、瞄準角度、實作技能、腦波、頻率分析
abstract_zh: 神經科學利用腦波儀記錄動作表現當時的腦波資料，探討心智與動作之間的連結，在運動技能精準動作(如射擊、射箭)上的研究已見成果，在技職教育的實作技能上卻未見探索。本研究採準實驗研究法探討不同技術層次學生在測量工程瞄準角度時腦波頻率之差異性，研究於111年3月招募技專校院52位曾經修過「測量」相關學分的學生進行，26位學生具有乙級工程測量技術士證或曾參與競賽者列為「高技能組」；另26位具有丙級或未考取丙級技術士證者為「一般技能組」。每位學生使用電子經緯儀做進行不同距離之瞄準角度，每次8個點共有4個週期，同時透過腦波儀收集每一點位在瞄準確定前8秒大腦的資料。其間有7位學生操作不當，以45位學生的瞄準角度數據進行效度分析，以獨立樣本單因子變異數分析測量之數據，確認「高技能組」、「一般技能組」分組具有效度。扣除腦波訊號無法判讀者，以42位學生的腦波資料進行傅立葉轉換，以「不同技術層次」x「不同距離」x「時間區段」三因子混合設計重複量數變異數分析。研究結論如下：一、測量角度採單點瞄準以標準差判斷技能水準具有效度，適宜成為新測驗題型。二、測量瞄準角度實作時的左顳葉區（T3電極）α波腦波資料顯示：「一般技能組」在執行瞄準作業時，可能自我對話的頻率較高；「高技能組」執行圖像瞄準作業時（右顳葉區，T4電極），愈接近瞄準確定階段的α波功率較高，顯示其動作執行的自動化程度較高。三、測量瞄準角度實作時右顳葉區（T4電極）的β波腦波資料顯示：「高技能組」比「一般技能組」瞄準注意力的表現較佳，搜尋瞄準圖案目標的效率較高。四、測量瞄準角度實作時額葉區（Fz電極）的θ波腦波資料顯示：「高技能組」選擇性注意力的表現較佳，在意識瞄準的工作效率較高。五、測量瞄準角度實作時動作區（Cz電極）的SMR腦波資料顯示：「高技能組」在瞄準過程時，SMR功率顯著高於「一般技能組」，其腦部動作區的動作執行效率較佳。六、射擊與測量的瞄準技能在「瞄準動作」、「瞄準時靜止程度」、「眼睛到瞄準器距離」、「瞄準是否回朔」有明顯差異。測量瞄準的腦波「活化程度」在不同技術層次上，「高技能組」功率顯著大於「一般技能組」、測量「接近瞄準完成」時腦波在4個時間區段，各頻率呈現逐漸下降的趨勢。七、高技能組參與者在測量的瞄準角度實作時，在腦波頻率θ、α、β及SMR的功率顯著優於一般技能組的表現；射擊與測量作業在整個瞄準階段，α波資料在左顳葉區及枕葉區呈現不同的剖面，射擊採取α波功率逐漸上升的「自動化」模式，測量則採取α波功率逐漸下降的「意識控制」模式。
abstract_en: Neuroscience uses an electroencephalogram to record the brainwave data during action performance to explore the connection between mind and action. Research on precision movements in sports skills (e.g., shooting, archery) has been explored, but not in vocational and technological education. A quasi-experimental study was conducted to investigate the difference in EEG frequency domains between students with different skill levels on the aiming angle in survey engineering. Fifty-two students who had taken surveying-related courses in vocational and technological colleges were recruited in March 2022. Among them, twenty-six students with a Level B Surveying Technician Certificate or who had participated in competitions were classified as "High-Skilled Group"; the other 26 students with a Level C Surveying Technician Certificate or who had not obtained a Level C Surveying Technician Certificate were classified as "General-Skilled Group." Each student used the electronic theodolite to angle aiming at a different distance. Eight points each time for four cycles, and EEG data were collected eight seconds before the aiming was confirmed. Seven students did not operate properly; therefore, the data from forty-five students were analyzed by one-way analysis of variance of the independent samples, and the validity of the high-skilled group and the general-skill group was confirmed. Forty-two students' brainwave data were analyzed by Fourier transformations, and the data of "different skill levels" x "different distances" x "time intervals" were used as a three-factor mixture to repeat the analysis of variance.The conclusions of the study are as follows:1.The single-point aiming angle is valid for judging the skill level by standard deviation and is suitable as a new test type.2.The alpha brain wave data in the left temporal lobe area (T3 electrode) during the aiming angle showed that the general-skilled group might have a higher frequency of self-talk when performing the aiming action. The high-skilled group performed the aiming image action (right temporal lobe area, T4 electrode), and the alpha wave power was higher as it approached the aiming determination stage, indicating a higher degree of automation in action execution.3.The beta brain wave data in the right temporal lobe area (T4 electrode) during the aiming angle showed that the high-skilled group performed better than the general-skilled group in terms of aiming attention and searching for the target of the aiming pattern more efficiently.4.The theta-wave brainwave data in the frontal lobe area (Fz electrode) during the aiming angle showed that the high-skilled group had better performance in selective attention and higher efficiency in awareness aiming.5.The SMR brain wave data of the action area (Cz electrode) during the aiming angle showed that the SMR power of the high-skill group was significantly higher than that of the general-skill group during the aiming process, and their brain action area was more efficient in performing the aiming action.6.There were significant differences between the shooting and measuring aiming skills in aiming action, stillness while aiming, distance from eyes to aimer, and whether aiming is retracted. The activation level of brain waves for aiming was significantly higher in the high-skilled group than in the general-skilled group, and the frequency of brain waves during the measurement of "nearing aiming completion" showed a gradual decrease in each of the four-time intervals.7.The participants in the high-skilled group showed significantly higher power in brain wave frequencies θ, α, β, and SMR than the general-skilled group during aiming angle; the alpha wave data showed different profiles in the left temporal lobe and occipital lobe areas throughout the aiming stage of the shooting and surveying. The shooting adopts the "automatic" mode in which the alpha power gradually increases, and the surveying adopts the "conscious control" mode in which the alpha power gradually decreases.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 新北市公立國小高年級學童幸福感與學校生活適應之相關研究
title_en: A study on the Relationship between well-being and School Life adjustment of upper elementary school children in New Taipei City
keywords: 高年級學童、幸福感、學校生活適應
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在探究新北市公立國小高年級學童幸福感與學校生活適應之相關。研究者以新北市公立國民小學五、六年級學生為研究對象，採用分層隨機抽樣的方式，抽取9所國民小學，24個班級。受試者施以「新北市公立國小高年級學童幸福感與學校生活適應之相關研究問卷」後，所得資料以描述性統計、皮爾遜積差相關、t考驗、變異數分析進行假設考驗。得到的結論如下：一、新北市公立國小高年級學童之幸福感屬於中上程度，其中最高分的是「生活滿足」。二、新北市公立國小高年級學童學校生活適應普遍良好，其中最適應的是「學習適應」。三、在「生活滿足」、「人際相處」、「整體幸福感」層面，與爸媽同住的高年級學童表現比只與（外）祖父母同住或與親戚同住的高年級學童好四、國小高年級學童的學校生活適應，在「師生關係」層面上，中間子女相較於老么有更好的表現。五、新北市公立國小高年級學童幸福感與學校生活適應之間有顯著正相關。研究者根據上述的研究成果提出建議，以作為未來教學及研究之參考。
abstract_en: The purpose of this study was to examine the correlation between well-being and school life adjustment among upper elementary school students in public elementary schools in New Taipei City. A stratified random sample of 24 classes from 9 public elementary schools in New Taipei City was used as the study population. The participants were administered the "Questionnaire on the Relationship between Well-being and School Life Adjustment of Upper Elementary School Students in New Taipei City Public Elementary Schools" and the data were tested with descriptive statistics, t-tests, Pearson's product-deviation correlation, and analysis of variance. The following conclusions were obtained：1.The well-being of the upper elementary school students was in the middle to upper range, with the highest score being "life satisfaction".2.Upper elementary school students generally adapt well to school life, with the most important adaptation being the "learning adaptation".3.There is a significant difference in well-being between seniors who live with their parents and those who live only with their grandparents.4.There is a significant difference between the middle child seniors and the older seniors in terms of adjustment to school life.5.There was a significant positive correlation between the well-being of upper elementary school children and their adjustment to school life.Based on the above findings, the researcher proposes recommendations for future teaching and research.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 應用因材網於國小六年級數學教學提升數學學習成就之行動研究
title_en: An Action Research on the Application of the Adaptive Learning of 6th Grade Students on Learning Mathematics Achievement.
keywords: 因材網、數學學習成就、數位學習
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在探討應用於因材網國小六年級數學教學提升數學學習成就之行動研究， 深入探討學生在利用因材網融入數學教學過程中的學習效果與歷程，以及教師運用因 材網融入教學後的自我省思與教學成長。本研究採用行動研究，以桃園市某國小六年級 27 位學童為研究對象。研究者透過 研究者出的數學成就測驗前、後測蒐集量化資料並結合教學觀察紀錄、 教學省思札記、 學生的訪談以及學生數學筆記等質性資料，編碼後利用三角交叉校正法進行分析。研究結果發現:一、 因材網應用於數學教學之教學活動設計內涵，從課前預習、 課堂分享、課後複習之實施皆搭配因材網為核心設計教學活動。二、學生接受因材網 應用於數學教學能提升學習成效，尤其是在低成就學生最為顯著。三、實施因材網應 用於數學教學能增進教師自我成長。研究者根據上述的研究成果提出建議，以作為未來教學及研究之參考。
abstract_en: The purpose of this study was to investigate the action research applied to the teaching of mathematics in the sixth grade in the Internet to enhance the learning achievement of mathematics, and to investigate the learning process and achievement of students in the teaching process, as well as the self-reflection of teachers to grow in teaching.The researcher collected quantitative data through pre- and post-tests and combined them with qualitative data such as classroom observations, teaching observation records, teaching reflection journals, and student interviews, and then coded them for analysis using the triangulation method.The results of the study revealed that:1. The design of the teaching activities for the application of the Web in mathematics teaching, from pre-study, classroom sharing, and post-study implementation, were all designed with the Web as the core of the teaching activities.2. The students accept that the application of the Web to mathematics teaching can improve the learning effectiveness, especially in low-achieving students.3. The implementation of the web-based approach to mathematics teaching enhanced teachers' self-improvement.This study can provide a reference for Math teachers and future researchers.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 以ADDIE模式發展國小五年級數位閱讀素養課程之研究
title_en: Using the ADDIE Model on Digital Reading Literacy Curriculum for Fifth Grade Students
keywords: ADDIE教學設計模式、國小五年級、數位閱讀素養
abstract_zh: 由於近年來受到疫情影響，許多教學課程必須透過電子載具、網際網路等數位媒介進行，故學生透過數位載具進行閱讀已經是重要能力之一。本研究旨在透過ADDIE教學設計模式中的分析、設計、發展、實施、評鑑五個階段，來發展一套學習課程，在課程教學實施之後，觀察學生於課程後的學習成效，並提出建議。本研究之研究結果為實施ADDIE教學設計模式的學生在「資訊搜尋」無差異，而在「內容瀏覽」、「知識整合」則達顯著，代表在此兩面向的能力經由本實驗研究是有所提升的。本研究探究以下之目的：一、應用ADDIE教學設計模式發展國小五年級生之數位閱讀素養課程。二、應用ADDIE教學設計模式發展出的課程與傳統教學在「數位閱讀素養」課    程對學生數位閱讀素養之能力為何？
abstract_en: Due to the impact of the epidemic in recent years, many teaching courses must be conducted through digital media such as electronic vehicles and the Internet. Therefore, students' reading through digital devices is already one of the important abilities. The purpose of this study is to Analyze, Design, Develop, Implement, and Evaluate the ADDIE instructional design model through its five phases to develop a learning curriculum that after the implementation of the course, we will observe the students' learning outcomes after the course and make recommendations. The results of this study showed that there was no difference in "information search" among students who implemented the ADDIE instructional design model, while "content browsing" and "knowledge integration" were significant. This study investigated the following objectives:1. Apply the ADDIE instructional design model to develop a digital reading literacyprogram for elementary school fifth graders.2. What is the difference between the curriculum developed using the ADDIE modeland traditional instruction in the "Digital Reading Literacy" program to students' digital reading literacy?

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 高科技產業經校園招募員工對組織承諾與工作滿意度之研究
title_en: A Study on Job Satisfaction and Organizational Commitment of Employees in High Technology Industry and Recruited From Campus
keywords: 高科技產業、校園招募、組織承諾、工作滿意度
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在探討高科技產業經校園招募員工對組織承諾與工作滿意度，探討經由不同背景變項之高科技產業員工經由不同校園招募對組織承諾之差異情形，進一步探討經由不同校園招募對工作滿意度之差異情形。本研究採問卷調查方式，以2020～2022年台灣高價值企業100強，且經由校園招募進入高科技產業的員工為研究對象，自編「高科技產業經校園招募員工對組織承諾與工作滿意度調查問卷」為研究工具，共發放問卷1000份，有效問卷751份，有效問卷回收率75%。將施測後所得資料以描述性統計、單一樣本t檢定、獨立樣本t檢定、單因子變異數分析及事後比較等統計方式加以分析，其研究發現如下：一、經由校園招募進入高科技產業的員工之組織承諾整體及各構面程度屬中等以上，以「留職傾向」程度最高，「努力意願」程度最低。二、經由校園招募進入高科技產業的員工之工作滿意度整體及各構面程度屬中等以上，以「工作本身」程度最高，「人際關係」程度最低。三、經由校園招募進入高科技產業的員工之組織承諾會因「性別」不同而在整體及構面上有顯著差異，在組織承諾整體與「努力意願」上，「女性」顯著高於「男性」。四、經由校園招募進入高科技產業的員工之組織承諾會因「婚姻狀況」不同而在整體及構面上有顯著差異，在組織承諾整體與「組織認同」上，「已婚」顯著高於「未婚」。五、經由校園招募進入高科技產業的員工之組織承諾會因「年齡」不同而在整體及構面上有顯著差異。六、經由校園招募進入高科技產業的員工之組織承諾會因「教育程度」不同而在整體及構面上有顯著差異。七、經由校園招募進入高科技產業的員工之組織承諾會因「年資」不同而在組織認同構面上有顯著差異。八、經由校園招募進入高科技產業的員工之組織承諾會因「職別」不同而在整體及構面上有顯著差異。九、經由校園招募進入高科技產業的員工之組織承諾會因「經由不同校園招募進入職場的受試者」不同而在整體及構面上有顯著差異。十、經由校園招募進入高科技產業的員工之工作滿意度會因「經由不同校園招募進入職場的受試者」不同而在整體及構面上有顯著差異。
abstract_en: The purpose of this study is to explore the organizational commitment and job satisfaction of high-tech industry employees recruited through campuses, to explore the differences in organizational commitment of high-tech industry employees recruited through different campuses through different background variables, and to further explore job satisfaction through campus recruitment. degree of difference.This research adopts a questionnaire survey method, taking employees of the top 100 high-value enterprises in Taiwan from 2020 to 2022 and recruited into the high-tech industry through campus as the research object. A total of 1,000 questionnaires were distributed, 751 valid questionnaires, and the effective questionnaire recovery rate was 75%. The data obtained after the test was analyzed by descriptive statistics, single-sample t-test, independent-sample t-test, one-way analysis of variance and post-hoc comparison. The research findings are as follows:1. The organizational commitment of the employees recruited into the high-tech industry through campus is above average in overall and in all aspects, with the highest degree of "retention tendency" and the lowest degree of "willingness to work hard".2. The overall and various aspects of job satisfaction of employees recruited into the high-tech industry through campus are above average, with the highest degree of "job itself" and the lowest degree of "interpersonal relationship".3. The organizational commitment of employees recruited into the high-tech industry through campus is significantly different in overall and dimension due to different genders. In terms of overall organizational commitment and "willingness to work", "women" are significantly higher than "men".4. The organizational commitment of employees recruited into the high-tech industry through campus will vary significantly in overall and in terms of "marital status". In terms of overall organizational commitment and "organizational identity", "married" is significantly higher than "unmarried".5. The organizational commitment of employees recruited into the high-tech industry through campus varies significantly in overall and dimension by "age".6. The organizational commitment of employees recruited into the high-tech industry through campuses varies significantly in overall and dimension by "educational level."7. The organizational commitment of employees recruited into the high-tech industry through campus will have significant differences in organizational identity due to different "seniority".8. The organizational commitment of employees recruited into the high-tech industry through campuses varies significantly in overall and dimension by "occupation".9. The organizational commitment of employees recruited into the high-tech industry through campuses varies significantly in overall and dimension due to differences in "subjects recruited into the workplace through different campuses".10. The job satisfaction of employees recruited into the high-tech industry through campuses varies significantly in overall and dimension due to the differences in "subjects recruited into the workplace through different campuses".

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 雙北地區技術型高中身心障礙學生知覺導師領導風格與學習動機之研究
title_en: A Study on the Leadership Style of the Home Room Teachers and the Learning Motivation of Students with Disabilities in the Technical High Schools of Taipei and New Taipei City
keywords: 技術型高中身心障礙學生、技術型高中導師、領導風格、身心障礙學生學習動機
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在瞭解雙北地區技術型高中身心障礙學生知覺導師領導風格與學習動機之關係，探討不同背景變項的技術型高中身心障礙學生之學習動機，並瞭解其知覺導師的領導風格與學習動機之差異情形。本研究採用問卷調查法，以雙北地區(新北市及臺北市)110學年度就讀技術型高中的身心障礙學生為研究對象，且該生為安置於普通班級的身心障礙學生。以自編的「雙北地區技術型高中身心障礙學生知覺導師領導風格與學習動機之研究問卷」為研究工具，共計發出853份，回收有效問卷為643份，有效問卷回收率為75.3%。將施測後所得之資料以描述性統計、單一樣本t檢定、獨立樣本t檢定及單因子變異數分析、事後比較等統計方法加以分析，其結論如下:一、雙北地區技術型高中身心障礙學生知覺導師領導風格構面以「條件式酬賞」最高，其次依序為「魅力」、「激發動機」、「知識啟發」，以「個別關懷」為最低。二、雙北地區技術型高中身心障礙學生「學習動機」，以「內在動機」高於「外在動機」。三、雙北地區技術型高中身心障礙學生知覺導師領導風格以「男性」顯著高於「女性」。四、雙北地區技術型高中身心障礙學生知覺導師領導風格以「感官或身體功能損傷」顯著高於「心智功能損傷」、「多重功能損傷」及「其他障礙」。五、雙北地區技術型高中身心障礙學生知覺導師領導風格以「二年級」顯著高於「三年級」及「一年級」。六、雙北地區技術型高中身心障礙學生知覺導師領導風格以「商業類」顯著高於「家事類」及「工業類」、「海事水產類」、「農業類」及「藝術與設計類」。七、雙北地區技術型高中身心障礙學生知覺導師以「激發動機」及「知識啟發」之領導風格，學生整體的學習動機均顯著高於「條件式酬賞」之領導風格。
abstract_en: This study aims to understand the effects of the leadership style of the home room teachersand the learning motivation of students with disabilities in Taipei and New Taipei City technical high schools,to explore the differences in learning motivation and mentor’s leadership style of students with different backgrounds with disabilities.The research is conducted by self-made questionnaires.A total of 853 questionnairs was distributed,and 643 of effective ones were collected.The recovery rate of valid questionnaires is 75.3%.The data obtained after the test were analyzed by descriptive statistics,single sample t test,independent sample t test,single factor anova analysis,post hoc comparison and other statistical methods.The conclutions are as follow:1.In the aspect of leadership styles,”if-then rewards” was the highest,followed by ”charisma”,”inspirational”,” intellectual stimulation”,and “individualized consideration” was the lowest.2.The aspect of “learning motivation” of students with disability in the technical high schools of Taipei and New Taipei City,”intrinsic motivation” was higher than “extrinsic motivation”.3.The male students with disability in the technical high schools of Taipei and New Taipei City perceived the“leadership styles”of the home room teachers for the are significantly higher than those of the female students.4.The “sensory functions & pain” students perceived the“leadership styles”of the home room teachers for the are significantly higher than those who were “mental impairment”,” multiple disabilities” and “others”.5.The “second grade” students with disability in the technical high schools of Taipei and New Taipei City perceived the“leadership styles”of the home room teachers for the are significantly higher than “first and third grade”.6.The study area of “business” students with disability in the technical high schools of Taipei and New Taipei City perceived the“leadership styles”of the home room teachers for the are significantly higher than “home economics”,” industry”,”fisheries and aquatic”,”agriculture” and “art and design”.7.The leadership styles of the home room teachers of ”inspirational”and ”intellectual stimulation”,and overall “learning motivation” of the students’ were significantly higher than the leadership styles of “if-then rewards”.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 新北市公立國小教師使用即時通訊軟體對組織溝通效能與工作壓力之影響
title_en: A Study on the Impact of Using Instant Communication Software on Organizational Communication Effectiveness and Work Pressure by Teachers of Public Primary School in New Taipei City
keywords: 即時通訊軟體、國小現職教師、組織溝通效能、工作壓力
abstract_zh: 本研究主要為探討新北市公立國小教師使用具即時性的通訊軟體對組織溝通效能與工作壓力關係之研究。本研究採用問卷調查法，研究對象為新北市公立國小現職教師，依照新北市政府依地域性將公立國小分為九大分區，並依照普通班級的數量，將學校的規模劃分成小型學校、中型學校以及大型學校進行叢集抽樣，將於九大分區各區抽取兩間學校進行施測，共發放375份問卷，問卷收回後剔除無效之問卷，有效問卷數量為318份，回收率84.8%。本研究將採描述性統計、獨立樣本t考驗、單因子變異數分析、卡方檢定、相關分析以及迴歸分析進行資料分析。 本研究重要發現如下所示：一、40歲以下教師偏向「有空再回」；兼任行政教師與導師多為「上下班皆使用」；使用時間長短上，兼任行政教師多為「2小時以上」、導師則為「1小時內」；導師為下班後「有時使用」、「有空再回」；除文山分區外，其它地區多為「上下班皆使用」；使用時間長短上，三鶯分區偏向「1小時內」；回覆狀況上，文山分區多為「立即回覆」、瑞芳分區則多為「有空再回」。二、使用具即時性的通訊軟體進行組織溝通，具良好的溝通效能。三、使用具即時性的通訊軟體進行組織溝通，具適中的工作壓力。四、擔任導師者的溝通效能高於擔任科任教師者；任教於雙和分區之教師其溝通效能高於淡水分區、新莊分區之教師；任教於板橋分區之教師其溝通效能高於新莊分區之教師。五、任教於淡水分區、瑞芳分區之教師其工作壓力高於板橋文山分區之教師。六、善用具即時性的通訊軟體能提高組織溝通效能進而可能降低工作壓力。七、下班後持續使用即時通訊軟體進行組織溝通，會增長工作壓力。八、使用具即時性的通訊軟體進行組織溝通，溝通效能越高則工作壓力越低。
abstract_en: The purpose of this study is examine the impact the connection between the efficacy of organizational communication and work pressure from using instant communication software as main discussion tool by teachers of primary school in New Taipei City. In this study, a questionnaire survey will be used to examine the effects of using instant communication software on the organizational communication effectiveness and work pressure among public primary school teachers in New Taipei City. The questionnaire will be revised to become a formal research instrument. After the revision, a total of 18 public primary school from two schools in each of the nine districts of New Taipei City were sampled in a cluster sampling method, and a total of 375 questionnaires were distributed, and after excluding invalid questionnaires, 318 questionnaires were valid, with a recovery rate of 84.8%.The obtained data were analyzed by descriptive statistics, t-test, one-way ANOVA、Chi-square tests and regression analysis, etc.The essential findings were presented as the follows:1.In terms of usage time, part-time administrative teachers mostly used the service for "more than 2 hours" and instructors for "within 1 hour"; instructors used the service after work for "sometimes" and "when available"; except for Wenshan district, other districts mostly used the service for "all work"; in terms of usage time, Sanying district favored "within 1 hour". In terms of response status, Wenshan district mostly replied "immediately", while Ruifang district mostly replied "when available".2.Use instant communication software for organizational communication, with good communication performance.3.The use of instant communication software for organizational communication has moderate work pressure.4.Teachers in Shuanghe district have higher communication effectiveness than teachers in Xinzhuang district; teachers in Banqiao district have higher communication effectiveness than teachers in Xinzhuang district.5.Teachers in the Tamsui and Ruifang districts have higher work pressure than teachers in the Wenshan district of Banqiao.6.The use of instant communication software can improve the effectiveness of organizational communication and thus may reduce work pressure.7.The use of instant communication software for organizational communication after work will increase work pressure.8.The higher the communication efficiency, the lower the work pressure.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 臺北市國中導師親師溝通策略與班級經營效能之研究
title_en: A Study on the Teacher-parent Communication Strategies and Classroom Management Effectiveness of the Junior High School Homeroom Teachers in Taipei
keywords: 國中導師、親師溝通策略、班級經營效能
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在瞭解臺北市國中導師親師溝通策略與班級經營效能之差異情形。透過研究者自編「臺北市國中導師親師溝通策略與班級經營效能」之問卷為研究工具，總計發放之問卷共810份，有效問卷637份，有效問卷回收率為78.64%。將施測後收回的數據資料以描述性統計、獨立樣本t檢定及單因子變異數分析、事後比較等統計方法進行分析，所得結論如下：一、臺北市國中導師之「親師溝通策略」不論在整體或各構面都有中等以上之知覺程度，各構面中以「真誠」最高，接著依序為「傾聽」、「主動」及「同理心」，「事實描述」為最低。二、臺北市國中導師「班級經營效能」不論在整體或各構面都有中等以上之知覺程度，其中以「親師關係」為最高，接著依序為「師生互動」、「教學效能」及「班級常規」，「班級氣氛」最低。三、臺北市國中導師「親師溝通策略」會因年齡、導師年資、婚姻狀況及學校規模而有顯著差異。四、臺北市國中導師「親師溝通策略」不因「性別」及「主要任教科目」而有顯著差異。五、臺北市國中導師「班級經營效能」會因「親師溝通策略」的不同而有顯著差異。就整體「班級經營效能」而言，「主動」及「真誠」親師溝通策略的導師顯著高於「同理心」親師溝通策略的導師。在「班級常規」構面中「主動」親師溝通策略的導師顯著高於「同理心」親師溝通策略的導師，在「班級氣氛」構面中「主動」及「事實描述」親師溝通策略的導師顯著高於「同理心」親師溝通策略的導師，在「親師關係」構面中「真誠」親師溝通策略的導師顯著高於「同理心」及「事實描述」親師溝通策略的導師。
abstract_en: The aim of this study is to investigate the differences of junior high school homeroom teachers in Taipei using different teacher-parent communication strategies to the classroom management effectiveness. 810 questionnaires are distributed in total and 637 copies are collected with an effective rate of 78.64%. All information has been analyzed through independent-samples t-test, descriptive statistics, one-way analysis of variance, and post-hoc  comparisons. The conclusions are as follows:1. For homeroom teachers in Taipei junior high school, teacher-parent communication strategies are high among the study samples, and the score of sincerity ranks the highest, along with listening, activeness, and empathy, the score of fact description ranks the lowest.2. For homeroom teachers in Taipei junior high school, the overall and partial aspects in classroom management effectiveness stand at an intermediate level of perception. Teacher-parent relationship scores the highest, along with teacher-student interaction, teaching efficiency, and classroom rules, classroom climate scores lowest.3. In terms of teacher-parent communication strategies, homeroom teachers in Taipei junior high school show significant differences in age, seniority, marital status, and school scale.4. In terms of teacher-parent communication strategies, homeroom teachers in Taipei junior high school show no significant differences in gender and teaching subject.5. In terms of classroom management effectiveness, homeroom teachers in Taipei junior high school show significant differences in teacher-parent communication strategies. With regard to the overall classroom management effectiveness, homeroom teachers with activeness and sincerity rank high than those with empathy. With regard to the classroom rules, homeroom teachers with activeness rank higher than those with empathy. With regard to the classroom climate, homeroom teachers with activeness and fact description rank higher than those with empathy. With regard to the teacher-parent relationship, homeroom teachers with sincerity rank higher than those with empathy and fact description.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 臺北市醫療器材商業務員人格特質與工作滿意度之研究
title_en: A Study on the Personality Traits and Job Satisfaction of Salespersons of Medical Equipment Manufacturers in Taipei City
keywords: 醫療器材商業務員、人格特質、工作滿意度
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在瞭解臺北市醫療器材商業務員人格特質與工作滿意度之差異情形。本研究採問卷調查法，以2021年以前加入臺北市醫療器材商業同業公會且設立於臺北市之醫療器材商的業務員為研究對象。自編「臺北市醫療器材商業務員人格特質與工作滿意度關係調查問卷」為研究工具，共發放297份問卷，回收有效問卷218份，有效問卷回收率73%。施測後所得資料以描述性統計、單一樣本t檢定、獨立樣本t檢定及單因子變異數分析等統計方法加以分析，其研究結論如下：一、臺北市醫療器材商業務員之人格特質以「勤勉正直性」最多，其次為「親和性」及「經驗開放性」，再次為「情緒穩定性」，最後為「外向性」。二、臺北市醫療器材商業務員知覺工作滿意度以「工作本身」為最多，其次依序為「主管領導」、「薪資福利」、「工作環境」、「人際關係」。三、臺北市醫療器材商業務員之「人格特質」會因「學歷」不同有顯著差異。四、臺北市醫療器材商業務員之「人格特質」會因「從事醫療器材業務工作年資」不同有顯著差異。五、臺北市醫療器材商業務員「工作滿意度」，會因「人格特質」不同有顯著差異。
abstract_en: The purpose of this study is to understand the differences in personality traits and job satisfaction among salespeople of medical equipment dealers in Taipei City.This research adopts the questionnaire survey method, and selects the salesmen of the medical equipment dealers established in Taipei City who joined the Taipei Medical Equipment Business Association before 2021 as the research object. Self-compiled "Taipei Medical Equipment Salesperson Personality Traits and Job Satisfaction Questionnaire" as a research tool. A total of 297 questionnaires were distributed, 218 valid questionnaires were recovered, and the effective questionnaire recovery rate was 73%. The data obtained after the test was analyzed by statistical methods such as descriptive statistics, single-sample t-test, independent-samples t-test and one-way analysis of variance. The research conclusions are as follows:1. The personality traits of the salespersons of medical equipment dealers in Taipei City are "diligence and integrity" the most, followed by "affinity" and "experience openness", again "emotional stability", and finally "extroversion".2. The perceived job satisfaction of the salesmen of medical equipment dealers in Taipei City is highest in the "job itself", followed by "supervisors", "salary and benefits", "work environment", and "interpersonal relationships".3. The "personality traits" of the salespersons of medical equipment dealers in Taipei will be significantly different depending on the "educational background".4. The "personality traits" of the salespersons of medical equipment dealers in Taipei City will be significantly different depending on the "experience of working in the medical equipment business".5. The "job satisfaction" of the salespersons of medical equipment dealers in Taipei City will have significant differences due to different "personality traits".

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 中等學校師資生靈性健康與生涯定向之研究
title_en: A Study on Pre-Service Teachers’ Spiritual Health and Career Anchor of Secondary School
keywords: 中等學校、師資生、靈性健康、生涯定向
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在探究中等學校師資生靈性健康與生涯定向之關係，以我國設有師資培育機構之大學並修習中等教育學程之師資生為母群體進行實證研究。本研究採分層比例便利抽樣，共抽取16所師培大學發放問卷，發出645份問卷，有效問卷共有539份，有效問卷回收率為83.57%，並採用自編的「中等學校師資生靈性健康與生涯定向調查問卷」作為研究工具，其中，「中等學校師資生靈性健康量表」分為活出意義、與人締結、生態關懷、天地合一與自我超越等五個構面，「中等學校師資生生涯定向量表」分成生涯確定與生涯滿意等二個構面，以次數分配、百分比、平均數與標準差、獨立樣本t檢定、單因子變異數分析、Pearson積差相關及多元逐步迴歸等進行統計分析處理。本研究之結論如下：一、中等學校師資生整體靈性健康達中高程度，尤以天地合一得分最高。二、就讀研究所、曾參加校內外師培相關服務性活動或課程、曾修習人文關懷或生命教育等相關課程或有宗教信仰之師資生其靈性健康相對較佳。三、中等學校師資生整體生涯定向達中高程度，尤以生涯滿意得分最高。四、就讀研究所、就讀人文類與社會類、曾參加校內外師培相關服務性活動或課程、曾修習人文關懷或生命教育等相關課程或有宗教信仰之師資生其生涯定向相對較佳。五、不同性別、就讀學校體系與就讀學校性質之師資生於靈性健康與生涯定向皆無差異。六、中等學校師資生靈性健康與生涯定向呈正向關係。七、中等學校師資生靈性健康對生涯定向具有預測力。本研究彙整上述之研究結果形成具體建議，以供主管教育行政機關、學校與師資生及未來研究者參酌。
abstract_en: The main purpose of this study was to investigate the relationship between spiritual health and career anchor among secondary school pre-service teachers. An empirical study was conducted using pre-service teachers from Taiwanese universities with professional teacher training programs and taking in secondary teacher education programs as the population. This study adopted stratified proportional convenience sampling. 16 universities were sampled and 645 questionnaires were sent, with 539 valid questionnaires and an 83.57% valid questionnaire return rate. The questionnaire “Spiritual Health and Career Anchor Survey for Secondary School Pre-Service Teachers” was utilized for this study. The “Spiritual Health Scale for Secondary School Pre-Service Teachers” had five dimensions, including living a meaningful life, connecting with others, ecological care, unity of nature, and self-transcendence; while the “Career Anchor Scale for Secondary School Pre-Service Teachers” had two dimensions, including career certainty and career satisfaction. Descriptive statistics, one-sample t-test, independent sample t-test, one-way ANOVA, Pearson product-moment correlation, and multiple stepwise regression were used to evaluate the collected data. The results of this investigation have been summarized below.1.  The overall spiritual health of secondary school pre-service teachers is moderately high, with the highest score for “unity of nature.”2.  The spiritual health of pre-service teachers who are now attending graduate schools, participated in service-learning activities or taken courses related to teacher education on or off campus, taken courses related to humanistic concern or life education, or held religious beliefs performed relatively better.3. The overall career anchor of secondary school pre-service teachers is moderately high, with the highest score for “career satisfaction.”4. The career anchor of pre-service teachers who are now attending graduate schools, majoring in humanities and social sciences, participated in service-learning activities or taken courses related to teacher education on or off campus, taken courses related to humanistic concern or life education, or held religious beliefs performed relatively better.5. There are no significant gender, school system, or school type differences in pre-service teachers’ spiritual health and career anchor.6. There is a positive relationship between secondary school pre-service teachers’ spiritual health and their career anchor.7. The spiritual health of secondary school pre-service teachers can predict their career anchor.This study has synthesized the aforementioned findings in order to formulate specific suggestions for the education administration authority, universities, pre-service teachers, and future researchers.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 成人學習者學習動機與生涯定向之研究—以空中進修學院為例
title_en: A Study on Learning Motivation And Career Anchor of Adult Students-Take Open Continuing College as Example
keywords: 成人學習者、學習動機、生涯定向、空中進修學院
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在探討空中進修學院成人學習者學習動機與生涯定向問題（即生涯未定向）之整體現況及其關係。本研究採用問卷調查法，以「空中進修學院學生學習動機量表」及「空中進修學院學生生涯定向問題量表」為研究工具。研究對象為110學年度空中進修學院學生，共發出問卷861份，有效回收問卷670份，有效問卷回收率為77.82%，問卷回收後經由SPSS 23.0 版進行分析，統計方法採次數分配、百分比、平均數及標準差、獨立樣本t考驗、單因子變異數分析與皮爾森積差相關等方法進行資料分析，本研究結論整理如下：一、空中進修學院學生整體學習動機達中高程度，尤以求知興趣表現最佳。二、空中進修學院延修生的學習動機比一、二年級學生高。三、空中進修學院學生整體生涯定向問題趨於中低程度，以生涯決策焦慮與信心不足較為明顯。四、延修生、20歲（含）以上未滿35歲、未婚、無工作或待業中及軍公教與工作年資低的學生生涯定向問題程度相對較高。五、不同學制、性別與教育程度之空中進修學院在學生學習動機與生涯定向問題皆無差異。六、空中進修學院學生學習動機與生涯定向問題相關程度低。本研究彙整上述之研究結果提出建議並供空中進修學院、學生及未來研究者參考。
abstract_en: The main purpose of this study was to examine the relationship between learning motivation and career anchor problem(career undecided) of open continuing college students. The questionnaire survey method was adopted. The instruments included “The scale of learning motivation by open continuing college students” and “The scale of career anchor problem by open continuing college students”. The subjects were open continuing college students during the academic year of 2021. A total of 861 questionnaires were distributed and officially collected 670, and the valid response rate was 77.82%. The data were analyzed by frequency distribution, percentage, average, standard deviation, independent sample t-test, one-way ANOVA and Pearson product-moment correlation. The findings were summarized as follows:1.The open continuing college students were perceived an intermediate-to-high degree of overall learning motivation, with the degree in the dimension of “Cognitive Interest” was the highest.2.The returned probationary students’s learning motivation was highter than first and second year’s students.3.The open continuing college students were perceived an intermediate-to-low degree of overall career anchor problem, with the degree in the dimension of “career decision-making self-efficacy” and “insufficient confidence” was the highest.4.The open continuing college students who were returned probationary, between 20 to 35 years old, unmarried, unemployed, governmental employees, faculty, and military personnel, lower seniority had the highest career undecision.5.There was no difference between overall learning motivation and career anchor problem among different degree programs, genders, education level.6.There was a low correlation between learning motivation and career anchor problem of open continuing college students.Based on the finds, some propositions were preposed to education mechanisms and future researchers.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 主管真誠領導、組織承諾與心理資本關係之研究-以勞工保險局員工為例
title_en: The Relationships among Employee's Perception of Line Manager's Authentic Leadership, Organizational Commitment and Psychological Capital : The Case of the Civil Servants of Bureau of Labor Insurance, Ministry of Labor
keywords: 主管真誠領導、組織承諾、心理資本
abstract_zh: 公務人員在沉重的業務及身兼不同角色壓力的情況下，造成公務員在不同機關問的流動及離職率不斷攀升，為了政府各機關的服務品質與施政績效，提升各機關員工的組織承諾十分重要；以正向組織行為學來說，藉由主管真誠的領導的模式提升員工心理資本進而強化員工的組織承諾是本研究重要的目的。本研究旨在探討勞工保險局員工知覺直屬主管真誠領導對員工組織承諾的影響，以及員工心理資本在主管真誠領導與員工組織承諾間的中介效果。本研究採用調查研究法，以勞保局的8個業務單位薦任7職等以下非主管職的員工為研究對象共1,114人，採分層比例隨機抽樣方式，以企劃管理組等8個組別為分層原則，依各組別員工人數佔總人數的比例抽取樣本數，發放500份問卷，有效問卷331份，有效回收率66%。問卷調查結果透過描述性統計、獨立樣本t 檢定、單因子變異數分析、多元迴歸分析及階層迴歸分析等統計方法分析。本研究獲致結論：(1)勞保局員工知覺主管有中高程度的真誠領導力。(2)勞保局員工有中度的組織承諾。(3)勞保局員工有中度的心理資本。(4)不同婚姻狀況、教育程度與工作組別員工知覺的主管真誠領導力有顯著差異。(5)不同婚姻狀況、教育程度與工作組別員工的組織承諾程度有顯著差異。(6)不同年齡、婚姻狀況、教育程度、工作年資與工作組別員工的心理資本程度有顯著差異。(7)主管真誠領導正向影響組織承諾。(8)主管真誠領導正向影響心理資本。(9)員工的心理資本正向影響組織承諾。(10)員工的心理資本在主管真誠領導及組織承諾間有中介效果。
abstract_en: Under the circumstances of heavy duties and pressure from multiple role-playing, mobility and turnover rate of civil servants working for different agencies keep soaring. For the consideration of the quality of service and performance of implementation, it is essential to increase civil servants’ organizational commitment in various government agencies; through the model of line manager’s authentic leadership to improve the civil servants’ psychological capital and further enhance the commitment to the organization in positive organizational behavior, which is the main purpose of the study.  The purpose of the study is to explore the influence of employee’s commitment to the organization through employee’s perception of line manager's authentic leadership in the Bureau of Labor Insurance Ministry of Labor, futher to explore the employee’s psychological capital intervening effect between the line manager's authentic leadership and the commitment to the organization.This study adopted a survey research method, and the survey was distributed the executive of officer under the grade 7 in the Bureau of Labor Insurance Ministry of Labor. A total 1,114 people in 8 units were surveyed using stratified random sampling, which was calculated on the ratio of the number of civil servants(employees) in the unit occupies the total number. In total, 500 copies of questionnaires were distributed, of which 331 questionnaires were collected with validity and an effective recovery rate at 66%. The survey result was analyzed through the statistical method of descriptive statistics, independent sample t-test, One-way ANOVA, multiple regression and multiple hierarchical regression analysis.The acquired conclusion of the study as below,(1)Employees’ perception of their line managers are showing a medium to high ability of authentic leadership.(2)Employees’ commitment to the organization are just a moderate level.(3)Employees have a moderate level of psychological capital.(4)The employee’s perception appears to be significantly different from the line manager's authentic leadership in various marriage conditions, academic degrees, and the variety of the team they belong to.(5)The employee's commitment to the organization appears to be significantly different from in various marriage conditions, academic degrees, and the variety of the team they belong to.(6)The employee's degree of psychological capital appears to be significantly different in various ages, marriage conditions, academic degrees, the years of work and history, and the variety of the team they belong to.(7)Line manager's authentic leadership has a positive influence on employees’ commitment to the organization.(8)The line manager's authentic leadership has a positive influence on employees’ psychological capital.(9)The employee's psychological capital has a positive influence on employees’ commitment to the organization(10) The employee's psychological capital has the mediating effect between the line manager's authentic leadership and the commitment to the organization.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 高級中等學校藥物濫用學生輔導人員經驗之敘事研究
title_en: A Narrative Study on the Counselors' Experiences of Dealing with Drug-addicted Students at Senior high schools
keywords: 藥物濫用、學生輔導、敘事研究
abstract_zh: 本研究藉敘事訪談，透過2位曾輔導藥物濫用學生社工師的經驗敘說，以研究者主觀價值加以詮釋分析，得出學校輔導藥物濫用學生應有的信念、輔導藥物濫用學生可行的作法及輔導藥物濫用學生時的得面臨心境與壓力，並強調組織氛圍的重要性，依此提出相關建議及後續研究參考。
abstract_en: This research uses narrative interviews, through the narrative of the experience of two social workers who have counseled drug abuse students, and interprets and analyzes with the subjective value of the researchers, and concludes the beliefs that school counseling drug abuse students should have, and the feasible practices and counseling for drug abuse students. The mood and pressure faced by students in drug abuse, and the importance of organizational atmosphere is emphasized, and relevant suggestions and follow-up research references are put forward accordingly.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 技術型高中生學習歷程檔案認知落差因素之研究─以桃園市某技術型高中為例
title_en: Study on the Factors of e-Portfolio Cognitive Gap Using Technical High School in Taoyuan City for Example
keywords: 學習歷程檔案、認知落差、國中教育會考成績
abstract_zh: 有鑑於學習歷程檔案為108課綱之政策重點，瞭解學生對學習歷程檔案的認知程度有其重要性。本研究旨在探討桃園市技術型高中高三生對學習歷程檔案的認知落差與其背後影響的因素，以布魯姆 (Bloom) 認知領域六層次為基礎，採用雙向細目表，經專家共識會議形成學習歷程檔案認知題目與操作性定義。首先以桃園市某技術型高中曾參與學習歷程檔案工作坊的102位高三生為對象，蒐集其性別、所屬群科及國中教育會考成績與學習歷程檔案認知，並藉由專家共識會議將學習歷程認知編碼分成五種等級作為學生學習歷程檔案認知落差依據，透過卡方檢定檢測性別、所屬群科及國中教育會考成績與學習歷程檔案認知相關程度。研究結論有：普遍高三生能理解學習歷程檔案基本的功能與目的；學習歷程檔案認知程度與性別、所屬群科及國中教育會考成績無顯著相關等，提供技術型高中教師輔導學生建置與理解學習歷程檔案之參考運用。
abstract_en: The e-Portfolio is the point of 108 Curriculum Guidelines and it is important to understand the level of cognition of e-Portfolio. This paper aims to investigate the factors of e-portfolio cognitive gap and influence in technical high school in Taoyuan City. Based on the Bloom's cognitive domain and use two-way specification table, the question and operational definition of cognition of e-Portfolio is formed through the expert consensus meeting. The case study uses expert consensus and chi-square test. Firstly, selecting the one hundred two participants who had taken part in the e-portfolio workshop and collect their gender, subject group, grade of Comprehensive Assessment Program for Junior High School Students and cognition of e-Portfolio. Then chi-square test is used to detect the degree of correlation between gender, subject group, grade of Comprehensive Assessment Program for Junior High School Students and cognition of e-Portfolio. The preliminary findings are listed as follows:1. Generally high school senior students can understand the basic functions and purposes of e-Portfolio.2. The cognitive level of e-Portfolio is not significantly related to gender, the group subject, and grade of Comprehensive Assessment Program for Junior High School Students.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 追逐世界大學排名是否有助高等教育永續發展：臺灣觀點
title_en: Can the Pursuit of Higher University Ranking Benefit the Development of Higher Education? Insights from Taiwan
keywords: higher education、world university ranking、global competition、sustainable development、governance
abstract_zh: The driving forces of neoliberalism, globalization, and the knowledge economy have escalated global competition in higher education. Growing higher education institutions and governments make significant efforts to compete for the global talents to support the future development of innovation and the economy. And the corresponding needs for information grow along.The emergence of the world university rankings (WURs) is the trigger for elevating this global competition. WURs offer the world an easy and accessible way to review the predefined competitiveness of the HEIs worldwide by using predetermined indicators, simplified numerical scores, and league tables to measure and disclose their relative standing on a global scale, an illustration of the world HEIs landscape. It significantly influences the strategic directions and resource allocation of policymakers, institutional leaders, and stakeholders.Investigating the subject of higher-ranking pursuits requires extensive knowledge in WUR and rich experience in institutional operation, international affairs, academic affairs, research and development, and higher education policies. This study uses in-depth interviews with purposive sampling to gather insights from higher education institutions, academia, and government.This study identifies the institutional and systemic-positive and -negative influences of higher-ranking pursuits and provides specific higher-ranking pursuit implications to institutional leaders and policymakers in Taiwan. WURs could offer valid information for weak point detection, recalibrating the resource allocation, and governance. WURs could be manipulative due to their media-run commercial-based nature. A concrete understanding of ranking indicators and a specific aim of developmental pursuit are central. Interpreting ranking results must be inclusive across different WURs and adopt the needed information only. Higher-ranking pursuit is a competition and could be a healthy competition. Appropriate governance is the key to reversing the global competitive pressures of higher-ranking pursuit into the driving force for sustainable higher education development.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 大學生 Instagram 用戶人格特質與 FoMO 症候群相關之研究
title_en: Research on the Correlation Between Personality Traits of University Instagram Users and Fear of Missing out (FoMO)
keywords: 大學生、Instagram、人格特質、FoMO 症候群
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在探討大學生Instagram用戶人格特質與FoMO症候群之現況與關係，研究方法採問卷調查法，以「五大人格特質量表」與「FoMO量表」為施測工具。本研究採便利抽樣法，以1,163位大學生Instagram用戶為主要研究對象。調查所得資料以描述統計、獨立樣本t檢定及單因子變異數分析、皮爾森積差相關及多元迴歸等方法進行分析。本研究結果歸納如下：一、大學生Instagram用戶「親和性」層面得分最高，而「神經質」層面得分較低；整體FoMO症候群屬中等程度。二、性別、所屬校院、整體使用頻率、10大Instagram系統功能與學校區域背景變項，對於大學生Instagram用戶五大人格特質有顯著差異。三、性別、年級、整體使用頻率、整體使用時間與10大Instagram系統功能背景變項，對於大學生Instagram用戶FoMO症候群有顯著差異。四、大學生Instagram用戶越具「外向性」、「開放性」與「神經質」特質傾向者，FoMO症候群現象較高，而越具「嚴謹性」與「親和性」特質傾向者，FoMO症候群現象較低。五、大學生Instagram用戶人格特質五個層面皆對FoMO症候群具有顯著影響力，其中，「外向性」、「開放性」、「神經質」對FoMO症候群具有正向影響力；而「嚴謹性」與「親和性」則對FoMO症候群具有負向影響力。綜合以上結果，分別對教育及輔導人員、大學生Instagram用戶及未來研究者提出相關建議。
abstract_en: The research aims to explore the current situation and relationships between comprehensive Instagram users’ profiles and FoMO. The study adopts a questionnaire survey, using the "biggest personality trait quality scale" and "FoMO" as the measurement tools, which totalling 1,163 university student’ Instagram users as the research objects. The data obtained were analyzed by methods such as description, independent sample point verification and univariate analysis of variance. Peel product correlation and multiple regressions were also taken into account. The results of this study were summarized as follows:1. Instagram users consisits of university students have the highest score for "Affinity", while the score for "Neuroticism" was lower; the overall FoMO was moderate.2. Gender, affiliated school, overall frequency usage, top 10 Instagram system functions and school regional background, those variables above have caused significant differences in the five personality traits of university student’ Instagram users.3. Gender, grade, overall frequency of use, overall time of use, and the top 10 Instagram system functions, those variables above have caused significant differences in the FoMO of university student’ Instagram users.4. University students’ Instagram users tend to be more “extroverted”, “open minded” and “neurotic”. Those who have a higher FoMO, and the more "rigorous" and "affinity" traits tend to be while their FoMO is low.5. The five levels of personality traits of college students' Instagram users all have a significant impact on FoMO. Power, among which "extroversion", "openness", and "aneurysm" have a positive impact on FoMO, while “Rigorousness” and “Affinity” have a negative influence on FoMO.Based on the above results, relevant suggestions were made for educators and counselors, university students' Instagram users, and future researchers.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 科技大學應用Babson College實務教學之創業課程教學成效
title_en: Teaching Effectiveness of Applying Babson College's Entrepreneurship Program at the University of Technology
keywords: 創業教育、創業課程、實務教學、Babson College、紮根理論
abstract_zh: Babson College的創業教育享譽國際，更25次被評選為第一名的創業大學，但過往的研究僅探討Babson College創業教育的課程內容與其教育系統，而較少的研究在探討應用Babson College創業課程的教學成效。本研究已透過質性研究的深度訪談方法訪談4位曾經到訪過美國Babson College交流學習之北部某科技大學教授，以瞭解北部科技大學的教師應用Babson College實務教學歷程，以及訪談10位曾修習過相關課程的學生，以瞭解科技大學的教師應用Babson College實務教學之創業課程教學是否提升學生的創業認知、創業精神、創業能力、創業興趣及創業意願，並運用紮根理論進行編碼與資料分析，得到本研究結論為：(1) OPSAE創業教學模式分為教學目標(O)、課前準備(P)、教學策略(S)、教學活動(A)及教學評鑑(E)等五階段；(2)實務教學之創業課程不易提升學生的創業知識；(3)講座型的創業課程可提升學生風險承擔的眼界、理論型的創業課程可提升學生創新思維、實戰型的創業課程可提升學生勇敢的態度；(4)實戰型的創業課程可提升學生的創業能力；(5)實務教學之創業課程可提升學生的創業興趣；(6)實務教學之創業課程可喚起學生創業的省思，釐清對創業的意願。根據研究結論，本研究建議使用Babson College實務教學之創業課程的教師：(1)創業課程的時數彈性化；(2)加強創業精神的課程內容；(3)增加實作的課程內容；(4)講座型與實戰型的創業課程豐富業師的資源。期望本研究的建議能協助行政單位優化創業教育課程，提高創業教育的教學成效，增加學生創業興趣與創業意願。
abstract_en: Babson College is internationally renowned for its entrepreneurial education and has been ranked as the number one entrepreneurial university 25 times. However, previous studies have only explored the curriculum and educational system of Babson College's entrepreneurial education, and fewer studies have explored the effectiveness of applying Babson College's entrepreneurial curriculum in teaching. In this study, four professors from a northern university of technology who had visited Babson College in the United States for exchange study were interviewed through in-depth interviews in a qualitative study to understand the application of Babson College's entrepreneurship program at university of technology. We also interviewed 10 students who had taken the course to find out whether the teachers of the University of Technology applied Babson College's entrepreneurship program to enhance students' entrepreneurial awareness, entrepreneurial spirit, entrepreneurial ability, entrepreneurial interest, and entrepreneurial willingness, and conducted coding and data analysis using the grounded theory. The study concluded that: (1) the OPSAE entrepreneurship teaching model is divided into five stages: objectives (O), preparation (P), strategies (S),  activities (A), and evaluation (E); (2) practical entrepreneurship courses do not easily enhance students' entrepreneurial knowledge; (3) lecture-based entrepreneurship courses can enhance students' vision of risk-taking, theoretical entrepreneurship courses can enhance students' innovative thinking, and practical entrepreneurship courses can enhance students' brave attitude; (4) practical entrepreneurship courses can enhance students' entrepreneurial ability; (5) practical entrepreneurship courses can enhance students' interest in entrepreneurship; and (6) practical entrepreneurship courses can stimulate students' introspection on entrepreneurship and clarify their desire to start a business. Based on the study's conclusions, this study recommends that teachers of applying Babson College's entrepreneurship program should: (1) flexibly increase the number of hours of entrepreneurship courses; (2) strengthen the content of entrepreneurship courses; (3) increase the content of hands-on courses; and (4) enrich the resources of teachers with lecture-based and hands-on entrepreneurship courses. It is expected that the recommendations of this study will help administrative units optimize entrepreneurship education programs, improve the effectiveness of entrepreneurship education, and increase students' interest and willingness to start their own businesses.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 員工知覺轉型領導、組織公民行為、 創新氛圍及創新工作行為關係之研究 -以臺灣本國銀行員工為例
title_en: A Research on the Relationship Among the Perception of Transformational Leadership,Innovative Climate, Organizational Citizenship Behavior, and Innovative Work Behavior - Evidence from Domestic Banking Stuff in Taiwan
keywords: 轉型領導、組織公民行為、創新氛圍、創新工作行為
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在探討銀行員工轉型領導、組織公民行為、創新氛圍及創新工作行為之關係，並以員工角度探討領導對其的影響，因此，本研究欲了解不同背景變項的銀行員工在轉型領導、創新工作行為、組織公民行為及創新氛圍的差異情況。依據研究目的進行後續研究探討，本研究採問卷調查法，透過文獻探討方式發展出本研究之「轉型領導量表」、「組織公民行為量表」、「創新氛圍量表」及「創新工作行為量表」。採用分層比例抽樣方式，以本國銀行員工為研究對象，本研究共發放849份問卷，其中有效問卷647份，有效問卷回收率76.3%，使用SPSS進行描述性統計、獨立樣本t檢定、單因子變異數分析、皮爾森相關積差、階層迴歸分析等資料統計與分析，本研究最終結果發現：一、不同背景變項之銀行員工創新工作行為存在部分差異情形，惟現任職別層面具有顯著差異，且非管理職的員工創新工作行為感受程度高於管理職員工。二、銀行主管轉型領導對員工之創新工作行為子購面表現情形達高度相關且具正向顯著影響，其中以「創意推廣」之影響較大。三、銀行主管轉型領導對員工之組織公民行為表現情形達高度相關且具正向顯著影響。四、銀行員工之組織公民行為對創新工作行為子購面表現情形達中度相關且具正    向顯著影響，其中以「創意推廣」之影響較大。五、銀行主管轉型領導對員工間創新氛圍子購面表現情形達高度相關且具正向顯著影響，其中以「領袖鼓勵」與之影響較大。六、銀行員工之創新氛圍對創新工作行為子購面表現情形達高度相關且具正向顯著影響，其中以「創意實施」間影響較大。七、組織公民行為在轉型領導與創新工作行為之間具中介效果。八、創新氛圍在轉型領導與創新工作行為之間具中介效果。綜合上述可知，銀行員工知覺轉型領導與創新氛圍影響最大，故銀行主管應重視轉型領導以營造創新氛圍，此外創新氛圍銀行員工間創新工作行為亦存高度正相關，團隊創新氛圍能鼓勵員工樹立願景，並促進組織成員執行創新想法，實際投入工作。此外，本研究根據以上研究發現，進一步提出後續研究限制與未來研究的發展方向建議，期能作為後續相關銀行員工之領導者風格與創新工作行為研究參考。
abstract_en: The purpose of this study is to investigate the relationship between transformational leadership, organizational citizenship behavior, innovative climate, and innovative work behavior among Banking Staff, and to examine the influence of leadership on them from the employees' perspective. To follow up on the study objectives, the Transformational Leadership Scale, the Organizational Citizenship Behavior Scale, the innovative Climate Scale, and the Innovative Work Behavior Scale were developed through a literature-based survey. A total of 849 questionnaires were distributed, of which 647 were valid, with a valid questionnaire return rate of 76.2%. Descriptive statistics, independent sample t-testing, one-way ANOVA, Pearson correlation coefficient, regression analysis, and hierarchy regression analysis were conducted using SPSS.1. There are some differences in innovative work behavior among bank employees with different backgrounds, but there are significant differences at the current job level, and non-managerial employees have a higher degree of innovative work behavior than managerial employees.2. The transformation of bank supervisors' leadership has a high correlation and a positive and significant impact on employees' innovative work behavior sub-purchase performance, among which the impact of "creative promotion" is more significant.3. The transformation of bank supervisors' leadership has a high correlation and a positive and significant impact on employees' organizational citizenship behavior.4. The organizational citizenship behavior of bank employees is moderately correlated with the performance of innovative work behavior sub-purchase.    Among them, the influence of "creative promotion" is more significant.5. The transformation of bank supervisors' leadership has a high correlation and a positive and significant impact on the performance of the innovative climate among employees, among which "leadership encouragement" has a greater impact.6. The innovative climate of bank employees has a high correlation and a positive and significant impact on the performance of innovative work behavior sub-purchase, among which "creative implementation" has a greater impact.7. Organizational citizenship behavior mediates between transformational leadership and innovative work behavior.8. Innovative climate mediates the relationship between transformational leadership and innovative work behavior.In addition, there is a high positive correlation between the innovative Climate and the innovative work behavior among bank employees. The innovative atmosphere of the team encourages the employees to set up a vision and motivates the organization members to implement innovative ideas and actually work on them. In addition, based on the above findings, this study proposes further limitations and directions for future research, which will serve as a reference for future research on leadership styles and innovative work behaviors among bank employees.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 情緒智能、工作自我效能及創新工作行為之關係研究－以北部地區科技大學行政人員為例
title_en: A Study of the Relationship Among Emotional Intelligence, Work Self-Efficacy, and Innovative Work Behavior – Taking Administrative Staff of the University of Science and Technology in Northern Taiwan as an Example
keywords: 情緒智能、工作自我效能、創新工作行為、行政人員、北部學校行政
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在探討學校行政人員情緒智能、創新工作行為及工作自我效能之間的關係。本研究採用問卷調查方式，根據本研究目的，首先運用文獻蒐集建構本研究架構，並發展「情緒智能」、「創新工作行為」及「工作自我效能」作為本研究調查之工具。本研究採分層比例叢集抽樣方式，針對110學年度北部地區科技大學之行政人員進行問卷施測，以2所公立科技大學與12所私立科技大學學校行政人員為主要研究對象，本研究共發放600份問卷，實際回收417份，將15份無效問卷剔除，最終所得402份有效問卷，有效樣本回收率為67%。經由SPSS進行皮爾森積差相關分析、描述性統計、單因子變異數分析、獨立樣本t檢定、迴歸分析及階層迴歸分析等統計方式進行資料分析，獲得以下結論：一、北部地區科技大學學校行政人員情緒智能、工作自我效能及創新工作行為均達中高程度二、北部地區科技大學學校行政人員為已婚者、擔任主管、工作年資及年 齡越長者其情緒智能較高。三、北部地區科技大學學校行政人員男性、已婚者、擔任主管、工作年資及年齡愈長者其工作自我效能較高。四、北部地區科技大學學校行政人員男性、已婚者、擔任主管、工作年資及年齡愈長者其創新工作行為較高。五、北部地區科技大學學校行政人員之情緒智能整理對創新工作行為子構面表現情形達具正向顯著影響，其中以「想法推廣」影響較大。六、北部地區科技大學學校行政人員之情緒智能子構面對工作自我效能表現情形具正向顯著影響，其中以「運用情緒」影響較大。七、北部地區科技大學學校行政人員之工作自效能對創新工作行為子構面表現情形具正向顯著影響，其中以「想法產生」影響較大。八、北部地區科技大學學校行政人員工作自我效能在情緒智能與創新工作行為中具有部分中介效果。綜合上述得知，北部地區科技大學學校行政人員之情緒智能與創新工作行為相關性較高，故表示組織可以透過課程培訓以提升成員之情緒智能，而重視成員之情緒智能亦有助於提升員工創新工作行為的展現。不僅如此，激發學校行政人員的工作自我效能感能間接提升成員創新工作行為。
abstract_en: The purpose of this study was to examine the relationship between emotional intelligence, work self-efficacy, and innovative work behaviors of administrators staff. In accordance with the purpose of the study , a questionnaire was used to establish the research framework through literature review and to develop "emotional intelligence", "innovative work behavior", and "work self-efficacy" as the instruments for this study. A total of 600 questionnaires were distributed, and 417 valid responses were collected, 15 invalid questionnaires were excluded, and 402 valid questionnaires were returned, with a valid sample collection rate of 67%. The data were analyzed by SPSS descriptive statistics, t-test, one-way ANOVA,  descriptive statistics, pearson's product correlation analysis, regression analysis, and hierarchical regression analysis, and the following conclusions were drawn:1.Emotional intelligence, Work self-efficacy and Innovative work behaviour of administrative staff of the university of science and technology in northern taiwan have a medium to high level.2.Emotional intelligence were higher among married, in supervisory positions, seniority, and older school administrators.3.Work self-efficacy was higher among male, married, in supervisory positions, seniority, and older school administrators.4.Innovative work behaviors were higher among male, married, in supervisory positions, seniority, and older school administrators.5.The emotional intelligence of school administrators in the northern taiwan university of science and technology has a significant positive and significant impact on the substructures performance of innovative work behavior, and the effect of "idea promotion" is greater.6.The emotional intelligence subconstructs of school administrators in the northern taiwan university of science and technology has a significant positive and significant impact on the work self-efficacy, and the effect of "using emotions" is greater.7.The work self-efficacy of school administrators in the northern taiwan university of science and technology has a significant positive and significant impact on the substructures performance of innovative work behavior, and the effect of "idea generation" is greater..8.The work self-efficacy of school administrators in the northern taiwan university of science and technology partially mediated the effect of emotional intelligence and innovative work behavior.In summary, the correlation between emotional intelligence and innovative work behaviors among school administrators of the university of science and technology in northern Taiwan was found to be high, therefore suggesting that organizations can enhance the emotional intelligence of their members through training programs, and that valuing the emotional intelligence of their members will help to enhance the demonstration of innovative work behaviors among their employees. In addition, stimulating the self-efficacy of school administrators can indirectly enhance their innovative work behaviors.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 國中地理科重理解的課程設計（UbD）之行動研究
title_en: An Action Research on the Development of Middle School Geography Curriculum Using Understanding by Design（UbD）Framework
keywords: 重理解的課程設計、UbD、國中地理科、行動研究
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在探討國中地理科運用「重理解的課程設計（Understanding by Design, UbD）」進行教案設計及實施教學後，教案發展歷程的省思、遭遇問題與解決策略以及學生的意見回饋。    本研究採取行動研究法，為期十四週。研究對象為研究者任教地理課程之九年級學生。研究前三週運用UbD教案設計表單進行課程設計，在隨後十一週以此教案進行教學。再藉由蒐集與分析同儕教師教案回饋表、教案修改札記、教學歷程省思札記、同儕教師觀課回饋表、學生回饋單與學生訪談紀錄表等質性資料，研究結果可分為三方面：    第一，教案發展歷程的省思，包括：1.領綱解讀與學習表現的選擇會影響教案內容的設計；2.學習表現的挑選應包含認知、情意與技能三構面；3.透過教師專業學習社群訂定更全面的評量規準；4.情意層面學習結果難以評量；5.階段三的WHERETO可同時為教案設計及實施的檢核要素；6.教案表單設計的欄位為系統思考的歷程；7.教案設計表單可加入架構圖與時間欄位；8.須提醒設計者重視課程的持續理解；9.UbD為互有關聯之三階段逆向設計。    第二，國中地理科UbD教案實施之遭遇問題與解決策略，包括：1.掌握重要概念且有效運用課堂時間，可解決教學內容緊湊的問題；2.預先規劃應變方式，因應資訊設備臨時不能使用；3.適時調整教案內容，因應學校臨時行事對課堂的影響；4.引導學生熟悉UbD的課程教學模式，可促進學生學習；5.回顧與引導新舊知識連結，因應節與節之間相隔時長的問題；6.清楚說明活動方式，因應教學活動的多樣化；7.學習單中新增學生自我檢核欄，提供證據評價學生學習成效。    第三，學生對UbD課程教學的實施給予正向之意見回饋，包括：1.對跳脫教科書順序的課程教學感受新奇，且有效促進學生理解；2.大概念引導的課程內容有助課前、課中、課後的理解與學習；3.可從實作任務獲得成就感且加深印象，情境設定易投入其中；4.分組活動促進理解及提升學習興趣；5.學生期待繼續維持UbD課程的教學模式。    最後，根據研究發現提出研究者之省思，並對教學者及後續研究者提出建議。
abstract_en: The study aimed to investigate the reflections for the lesson planning process, difficulties encounters and the solutions, and feedback from students through development of the middle school geography curriculum using Understanding by Design（UbD）framework.This study conducted action research over 14 weeks. Participants were all ninth-grade students enrolled in the teacher (i.e., the researcher)’s geography courses.The UbD template was used for the curriculum design in the first three weeks, while the curricula were implemented during the following 11-week period. Through the collection and analysis of qualitative data including partnership teachers’ lesson plan feedback, lesson plan revision notes, teaching process reflection notes, partnership teachers’ observation feedback, student feedback sheet, and student interview record, the findings of this study were listed below:First, the reflections for the lesson planning process, including i) interpreting curriculum guidelines and choosing of learning performance will affect the design of lesson plan content, ii) the selection of learning performance should include three aspects of cognition, affection and skills, iii) developing more comprehensive assessment standards through the teachers' professional learning community, iv) affective domain learning outcomes were difficult to measure, v) the WHERETO of the third step can be used as a check element for lesson plan design and implementation at the same time, vi) the field of the UbD template was the process of systems thinking, vii) the UbD template can add curriculum framework diagram and time field, viii) curriculum designers should be reminded to pay attention to the enduring understanding of the curriculum, ix) UbD was an interrelated three-stage backward design.Second, the problems encountered and solutions in the implementation of the UbD lesson plan on the middle school geography curriculum, including i) mastering big idea and using class time effectively can solve the difficulties of compact content of the lesson plan, ii) pre-planning contingency methods, in case of emergency information equipment can not be used, iii) timely adjusting the content of the lesson plan to account for the impact of the school's temporary actions, iv) leading students to familiarize themselves with UbD's curriculum and teaching mode, which can promote students’ learning, v) reviewing and promoting the connection between old and new knowledge, in response to the difficulties of the time interval between lessons, vi) clearly explaining the way of activities to adapt to the diversity of instructional events, and vii) a new student self-check column was added to the worksheet to provide evidence to assessment students' learning effectiveness.Third, positive feedback was got on the implementation of UbD lesson plan, including i) novelty about the lesson plan that skips the sequence of textbooks, and effectively promotes students' understanding, ii) the content of the lesson plan guided by big ideas can help understanding and learning before, during and after class, iii) can get a sense of accomplishment and deepen your impression from the performance task, and the situation setting is easy to put into it, vi) group activities to promote understanding and enhance learning interest, and v) students look forward to continuing the teaching model of UbD lesson plan.Based on the findings of the study, reflection of the researcher and suggestions for teachers and further research were made.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 技術型高中智能障礙學生適應體育教學之行動研究
title_en: An Action Research on Adapted Physical Education of the Students with Intellectual Disabilities in Vocational High School
keywords: 適應體育、智能障礙、健康體適能、行動研究
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在探討技術型高中智能障礙學生在適應體育教學後，在健康體適能及職業體能上的表現，並探討適應體育在教學設計與實施之間所遭遇的問題與解決策略。    本研究採用行動研究法，研究對象為研究者所任教之技術型高中服務群科三年級學生，全班共15人，皆為智能障礙學生，進行為期8週之研究。研究工具包含教學觀察省思紀錄表、學生訪談紀錄表、健康體適能檢測與功能性能力評估等。    根據行動研究歷程所蒐集之資料進行整理與分析後，本研究得到結論如下：一、適應體育教學之遭遇問題與解決策略包括：（1）提示策略設計應符合學生需求，且簡單易懂、（2）分組競賽活動宜簡化，並提供嘗試練習機會、（3）課程實施與設計有落差時，應彈性調整教學、（4）教師應留意學生身體狀況，並適時調整內容、（5）原場地因狀況無法使用時，需找尋替代空間、（6）課堂時間被借用時，需修改原先的教學規劃；二、適應體育教學能提升學生健康體適能之心肺適能、肌肉適能及柔軟度表現，但對身體組成則無明顯效果；三、適應體育教學能提升學生職業體能之移動及負重能力表現。
abstract_en: The study investigates the physical fitness performance in health and occupational-related activities of vocational high school students with intellectual disabilities, after adapting physical education teaching, while considering the problems and solutions between the design and implementation of the adapted physical education teaching.    The study adopted action research with 15 participants who are third-grade students with intellectual disabilities in the customer service group of the vocational high school for an 8-week experiment. The research tools included teaching observation and reflection records, student interview records, health-related physical fitness tests, and occupational physical fitnesstests.    After the data analysis, the finding are as follows:1.The challenges of applying adapted physical education teaching and the solutions: (1) The design of prompting strategies should be student-friendly and easy to understand. (2) Group competition activities require simplification and practicing opportunities. (3) The teaching should be flexibly for the gap between design and implementation of the curriculum. (4) Teachers should pay attention to the physical condition of students and adjust the lesson plan in a timely manner. (5) The alternative space is required while the original site is not available. (6) When the course schedule encounters sudden changes, the lesson plan needs modification. 2. Adapted physical education teaching can improve the performance of cardiorespiratory fitness, musculoskeletal fitness, and flexibility of students' health-related physical fitness, but there is no obvious effect on body composition. 3. Adapted physical education teaching can improve the performance of movement and weight-bearing ability of students' occupational physical fitness.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 運用PBL教學模式在技術型高中數學課程之研究
title_en: A Study of Using PBL Teaching Model in Vocational High School Mathematics Curriculum
keywords: 問題導向學習、數學學習成就、問題解決能力、技術型高中
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在探討運用PBL問題導向學習於技術型高中數學課程對學生學習成就與問題解決能力之影響。本研究採用準實驗研究法，研究對象為桃園市某技術型高中時尚造型科及室內設計科三年級兩班共58位學生，以班級為單位分成實驗組32人與控制組26人。實驗組以PBL問題導向學習進行數學教學，控制組則為傳統講述式教學法，進行八週、每週二節的數學教學實驗。研究結果顯示，兩組在實驗教學後之問題解決能力與數學學習成就皆分別優於實驗前。但經統計分析後，實驗組與控制組在學生之問題解決能力表現未達顯著差異；然而在數學學習成就方面，實驗組學生明顯優於控制組。故實施PBL問題導向教學模式，比傳統講述教學法之數學教學模式，更能提升學生的數學學習成就。
abstract_en: The purpose of this study was to investigate the effect of using problem-based learning (PBL) on students' learning achievements and problem-solving abilities in a vocational high school mathematics curriculum. In this study, a quasi-experimental method was used to study a total of 58 students in two third grade classes of Fashion Design and Interior Design in a vocational high school in Taoyuan City. And the classes were divided into an experimental group of 32 students and a control group of 26 students. The experimental group used PBL to teach mathematics, while the control group used traditional narrative teaching method to teach mathematics for eight weeks with two sessions per week. The results of the study showed that the problem-solving ability and mathematics learning achievement of the two groups after the experimental teaching were better than those before the experiment. However, after statistical analysis, there was no significant difference between the experimental group and the control group in terms of students' problem-solving ability; However, the experimental group was significantly better than the control group in terms of mathematics learning achievement. Therefore, the implementation of the problem-based learning was more effective than the traditional lecture-based mathematics teaching model in improving students' learning achievements in mathematics.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 技術型高中資訊科基本電學運用同儕師徒制教學之行動研究
title_en: An Action Research on Applying Peer-Mentoring in the Learning of Basic Electricity in the Department of Computer Sciences in Vocational High School
keywords: 同儕師徒制、基本電學、行動研究
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在探討技術型高中資訊科基本電學運用同儕師徒制。其研究目的有二：探討實施問題與省思修正與學生學習成就之影響。研究者以技術型高中資訊科一年級任教班級39名學生為研究參與者，依研究條件配對為13組師徒，每組師傅生1人、徒弟生2人，以行動研究的方式進行，實施階段有10週的教學研究。本研究採用工具包括：教學省思與觀察紀錄表、師傅生輔導紀錄表、徒弟生輔導紀錄表、學習單、評量試卷。並蒐集學生前測、第一次期中段考評量及第二次期中段考評量成績，採用SPSS套装統計軟體程式，全班學習成就進行相依樣本t檢定，師傅生與徒弟生學習成就使用Wilcoxon等級符號檢定的統計分析，以檢視研究實施後參與者的基本電學學習成就是否有所顯著提升。由質性資料和量化數據分析，瞭解參與者對基本電學科目學習及運用同儕師徒制的想法。最後獲得以下結論：一、本教學第1次循環師傅生學習成就達顯著提升，徒弟生與全班未達顯著，第2次循環時師傅生學習成就平均略為進步但未達顯著，徒弟生與全班達顯著改善。二、教學實施運用同儕師徒制在研究者、師傅生及徒弟生三方面所遭遇問題，經研究者反思並調整實施方式皆能得到正面成效。
abstract_en: This study explores the effects of incorporating peer mentoring into the education of basic electricity in the Department of Computer Sciences in vocational high schools. There are two main objectives to this study: The former is to explore implementing questions and adjusting lines of thinking, and the latter was to explore the influences they have on the academic performances of students. The research subjects were 39 freshmen students of the Department of Computer Sciences in a vocational high school, and the researcher divided them into 13 mentoring groups. Each group of students had one “mentor student” as well as two “apprentice students,” and the action research method was implemented in the study throughout a duration of 10 weeks. The tools of the study included: Record sheet of teaching observation and thoughts, Record sheet of the mentor students’ counseling, Record sheet of the apprentice students’ counseling, Worksheets, Assessment sheets. The students’ grades on the first and second mid-term examinations were also collected as a pretest and run through the Statistical Package for Social Science. The academic performances of the entire class were managed with the Paired Sample t-test, and the academic performances of the mentor students and apprentice students were analyzed with the Wilcoxon sign rank in order to see if the academic performances of the students improved after implementing the aforementioned education methods. Additionally, it is also possible to understand the students’ perspectives about the education methods for basic electricity as well as the Peer Mentoring. In conclusion: Firstly, an apparent improvement could be noticed from the first cycle of mentor students whereas the apprentice students and the entire class had a less noticeable change. During the second cycle, there was an improvement in the average performance of the mentor students but it was not apparent while the average of the apprentice students as well as the entire class had slight advancements. Secondly, multiple issues surfaced between the aspects of the researchers, the mentor students and the apprentice students during the implementation of the Peer Mentoring in education. After careful contemplation and drafting suitable adaptive strategies, ameliorations should be seen after execution of strategies.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 合作學習法結合Padlet即時反饋系統於技術型高中機械力學課程之行動研究
title_en: An Action Research of Using Cooperative Learning and Interactive Response System with Padlet in a Vocational High School Mechanics Course
keywords: 合作學習、Padlet、機械力學、行動研究
