abstract_zh: 本研究旨在探討合作學習法結合Padlet即時反饋系統於技術型高中機械力學課程。分析在教學過程中所遭遇之問題與因應策略，以及技術型高中學生對機械力學課程之學習成就及學習態度。本研究採用行動研究，以研究者任教之技術型高中機械科二年級學生15名為研究對象，教學歷程分為三階段，共歷時十二周24節課，最後結合量化及質性資料進行分析與統整，本研究之結論如下：一、教師在運用合作學習法結合Padlet即時反饋系統於技術型高中之機械力學課程，所遭遇的困難及因應的策略包括：（1）教師講述時間過長，可在公式推導時利用口述代替板書；（2）學生利用Padlet特性照抄答案，教師須多走下講臺關心學生；（3）不會的同學占多數導致無法討論，需教師介入協助增加互動；（4）積分沒有指定獎勵，後與學生共同設立獎勵目標；（5）討論時聊天、玩手機等情況，可要求各組分享討論結果；（6）學生反應公式多且難，反覆複習並抄寫於黑板一側；（7）學生計算理解能力低弱，可提供非同步線上學習，加強課後練習。二、運用合作學習法結合Padlet即時反饋系統於技術型高中之機械力學課程，學生學習成就為正向提升。三、運用合作學習法結合Padlet即時反饋系統於技術型高中之機械力學課程，學生學習態度為正向提升。
abstract_en: The purpose of this study is to investigate the cooperative learning approach combined with Padlet's interactive response system (IRS) in a vocational high school mechanics course. The study analyzes the problems and strategies encountered during the teaching process, as well as the learning achievements and attitudes of vocational high school students towards the mechanics course.This study was an action research in which 15 students in the second year of mechanical science in a vocational high school taught by the researcher were the subjects. The teaching process was divided into three stages and lasted for 12 weeks and 24 lessons in total. The quantitative and qualitative data were combined to analyze and consolidate. The results of this study are as follows:The difficulties encountered by teachers in applying the cooperative learning method combined with the Padlet IRS in a vocational high school mechanics course and the strategies to deal with them include: (1) the instructor took too long to explain, and could use dictation instead of slate in the derivation of formulas; (2) students used Padlet features to copy answers, the instructor needed to come off the podium more often to care for students; (3) the majority of students who didn't understand the content made it impossible to discuss, so the teacher needed to intervene to help increase interaction; (4) there was no specified reward for the points, so the teacher set the reward goal together with students; (5) to prevent students from chatting and playing with cell phones during the discussion, groups could be asked to share the results of the discussion; (6) students responded that the formulas were many and difficult, so the teacher repeatedly reviewed the formulas and copied them on the side of the board; (7) For those students with low computational comprehension, teachers could provide asynchronous online learning to enhance after-school practice.In addition, using the cooperative learning method combined with the Padlet IRS in a vocational high school mechanics course, students' learning achievements and learning attitudes were positively enhanced.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 臺灣旅行業經理人職能分析及其教育訓練需求評估之研究
title_en: A Research on the Competency Analysis and Training Needs Assessment of Travel Industry Professionals in Taiwan
keywords: 旅行業經理人、職能分析、訓練需求評估
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在探討臺灣旅行業經理人應具備職能之重要程度與實際已具備程度，依據其知識、技能及態度與其他人格特質之職能內涵，分析其教育訓練需求評估。透過專家訪談、焦點團體訪談、專家和業者之問卷調查，使用獨立樣本t檢定、單因子變異數、IPA重要表現法等統計分析，進而發現職能缺口，再以專家認為職能內涵的使用頻率評定，發現應加強訓練之知識職能內涵優先序為：企業營運方針與策略、相關產業業務脈絡之數位行銷及風險管理策略；技能職能內涵優先序前5項為：評估求職者的能力、知識與經驗，是否適合目前組織文化的批判思考技能、解析市場潮流訊息和行銷計畫、評估商業數據與成本結構的計算技能、溝通同事及利害關係人諮詢環境與社會責任議題、讓旅客有對環境保護之責任及規劃和實施風險管理流程的組織和管理技能；態度與其他人格特質職能內涵為：謹慎細心、壓力容忍。從職能內涵重組優先序發展出加強訓練4堂課、維持訓練9堂課與少量訓練7堂課；以旅行業經理人建議訓練課程60小時為例，依職能內涵個數比例配置加強訓練7小時、維持訓練32小時與少量訓練21小時；得出旅行業經理人訓練需求建議課程之評定優先順序為評估選才技巧、營運及領導者特質、數位行銷數據分析、情緒智能管理、風險管理、客服系統管理等20堂課程。最後檢視原有旅行業經理人講座訓練課程對應，發現業者對於數位行銷、遊程產品、客戶服務課程之訓練需求時數較高。提供建議給承辦訓練單位參考，戮力彌補旅行業經理人之能力落差，厚實觀光旅遊產業培育人才之職能內涵，進而提昇競爭力。
abstract_en: The purpose of this study is to explore the importance of the competencies that Taiwan's travel industry professionals should have and the degree they actually have, and to analyze their training needs assessments based on the competency’s connotations of their knowledge, skills, attitudes and other personality traits. Through expert interviews, focus group interviews, questionnaire surveys between experts and practitioners, and statistical analysis using independent sample t-test, one-way anova analysis, IPA important-performance analysis, etc., to find competency gaps, and then evaluate the frequency of use of competency’s connotations considered by experts.It is found that the priority of knowledge competency’s connotations that should be strengthened training is: enterprise operation policy and strategy, digital marketing and risk management strategy of related industry business context; the top 5 priority of skills competency’s connotations priority are: evaluating the ability, knowledge and experience of job seekers, critical thinking skills appropriate to the current organizational culture, interpreting market trend messages and marketing plans, calculating skills to evaluate business data and cost structures, communicating with colleagues and stakeholders to consult environmental and social responsibility issues, and making travelers accountable for environmental protection and organizational and managerial skills to plan and implement risk management processes; Attitude and other personality traits competency’s connotations are: prudence, stress tolerance. From the reorganization of competency’s connotations, 4 courses of intensive training, 9 courses of maintenance training and 7 courses of light training have been developed. Taking the 60-hour training course recommended by travel industry professionals as an example, 7 hours of intensive training will be allocated in proportion to the number of competency’s connotations. , 32 hours of maintenance training and 21 hours of small training; the evaluation priorities of the recommended courses for the training needs of travel industry professionals are evaluation of talent selection skills, operation and leadership characteristics, digital marketing data analysis, emotional intelligence management, risk management, customer service 20 courses including system administration. Finally, checked the correspondence of the original training courses for travel professionals, and found that the operators have a high demand for training hours for digital marketing, travel products, and customer service courses. Provide suggestions to the training units for reference, strive to make up for the gap in the ability of professionals in the travel industry, and enrich the functional connotation of cultivating talents in the tourism industry, thereby enhancing competitiveness.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 技術型高中教師評鑑性思考量表發展之研究
title_en: A Study on the Development of Evaluative Thinking Scale for Vocational Senior High School Teacher
keywords: 評鑑性思考、量表發展、常模
abstract_zh: 因應十二年國教及新課程大綱之推動，在教育場域中教師面對有關評鑑相關事務比重逐漸提升，且提升評鑑性思考對於學校及教師皆有所助益。為此，本研究主要目的在於建構一份評鑑性思考量表，以了解技術型高中教師對於評鑑性思考之認知程度，首先進行國內外相關文獻分析及彙整，彙編成德懷術問卷，透過14位專家小組進行三回合之德懷術問卷，以平均數及標準差作為判斷刪題之標準，形成一份李克特五點量表初稿。量表施測分為二階段，第一階段為量表初稿之預試，以便利抽樣方式，共抽取296名教師作為預試樣本，將預試統計結果進行量表信效度驗證及題目篩選後，產生正式量表；第二階段為正式施測，共計回收1,231份正式量表，將正式施測統計結果進行差異性分析，並建立全國性常模以供後續測驗參考對照，本研究結果如下：一、評鑑性思考量表由七個構面39個題項組成，其中包含有「知識與能力」(8題)、「思考與觀點」(5題)、「態度與信念」(7題)、「運用與結果」(5題)、「自我反思」(5題)、「自我超越」(4題)及「領導與組織」(5題)等。二、量表具有良好之信效度，包含有：內部一致性α係數部分，各構面為.866~.912，整體量表為.969、組合信度CR值為.870~.912，平均變異量萃取量為.508~.676，顯示量表具有良好之信度；因素負荷量為0.632~0.875，顯示量表具有收斂效度；在區別效度部分，每一配對組中受限模式與未受限模式之卡方值差異量皆大於10.83，達.001顯著水準，量表中各構面之間均具有區別效度。三、建立量表之常模，依據正式施測之結果，分別建構七個百分等級對照常模表，供後續實際使用本量表施測後進行量表結果解釋之用。四、差異分析結果，除性別、年齡及任教領域等三項背景變數沒有差異性外，在學校性質、學校區域、學歷、任教年資以及職務等背景變項中，其統計值顯示，皆具有顯著差異性。最後依據研究結果部分，針對技術型高中、技術型高中教師及未來研究提出相關建議。
abstract_en: In response to the execution of the 12-year compulsory education and the new curriculum outline, teachers facing evaluative-related matters in the education field have gradually increased. Therefore, improving evaluative thinking is helpful among schools, teachers and administrative.The main purpose of this study was to develop an Evaluative Thinking Scale in order to understand the evaluative thinking awareness of technical and vocational senior high school teachers. This study was conducted by Delphi Technique. First, review relevant literature and compiled them into a questionnaire for Delphi Technique. Secondly, a group of 14 experts were selected to conduct three rounds of Delphi Technique questionnaire; the mean and standard deviation were used as the criteria for questions deletion and selection. After forming the questions, they were compiled into the first draft of the Likert five-point scale. Two stages of scale testing were carried out. The first stage was the preliminary test of the first draft of the scale. A total of 296 teachers from North, Central, South and East part of Taiwan were selected as pre-samples for the convenience sampling. The results were analyzed by reliability and validity test through internal consistency analysis and confirmatory factor analysis. The items were edited into a formal scale. The second stage was the formal test. A total of 1231 formal scales were collected and the difference analysis of the results was carried out, and a national norm was established for the follow-up test reference comparison. The results of this study were as follows:1.The Evaluative Thinking Scale consists of 39 items in seven constructs. It was an anonymous Likert five-point scale including 8 questions of Knowledge and Capability, 5 questions of Thoughts and Opinions, 7 questions of Attitude and Faith, 5 questions of Implantation and Results, 5 questions Self-Reflection, 4 questions of Self- Transcendence, 5 questions of Leadership and Organization.2.The reliability and validity of the scale was good. Internal consistency α, each construct was .866~.912, the overall scale was .969, and the value of Composite Reliability was .870~.912, the average variance extracted was .508~.676, indicating that the scale had good reliability. Factor loading was 0.632~0.875, indicating that the scale had convergent validity. For discriminant validity, the difference in chi-square value between restricted and unrestricted model was greater than 10.83, reaching a significant level of .001, indicating that each construct had discriminant validity.3.Establish a norm for the scale. According to the results of the formal measurement, construct seven percentile comparison norm tables for the subsequent interpretation of the scale results after the actual use of this scale.4.According to the data from the formal test, background variables such as school nature, school area, education background, teaching years, and position were in significant differences. There was no difference in gender, age and teaching field.Finally, based on the results of this study, relevant suggestions were proposed for technical high schools, technical high school teachers and future research.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 雙北地區技術型高中特教教師情緒勞務與教學效能之研究
title_en: A Study on the Relationship between Emotional Labor and Teaching Effectiveness of Special Education Teachers of Vocational Senior High School in Taipei and New Taipei City.
keywords: 雙北地區、技術型高中、特教教師、情緒勞務、教學效能
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在探討雙北地區技術型高中特教教師情緒勞務與教學效能之現況表現與相關程度，以「雙北地區技術型高中特教教師情緒勞務與教學效能量表」進行問卷調查。選取195名雙北地區技術型高中特教教師作為研究對象。所得資料運用SPSS統計軟體進行描述統計、t 檢定及單因子變異數分析、Pearson積差相關及多元迴歸等進行分析。本研究歸納結果如下：一、雙北地區技高特教教師整體情緒勞務表現達中上程度；整體教學效能表現達中上程度。二、雙北地區技高特教教師之整體情緒勞務不因背景變項而有差異。三、20年(含)以上之任教年資及臺北市特教教師，在整體教學效能表現上顯著較高。四、雙北地區技高特教教師之情緒勞務與教學效能間具有中度正相關。五、雙北地區技高特教教師之情緒勞務對教學效能存在預測力，又以「多樣性」層面較高。最後，綜合上述研究結果提出相關建議，供教育主管機關、學校單位、特教教師及未來研究者參酌。
abstract_en: The main intention of this study was to investigate the current circumstance and conjunction of emotional labor and teaching effectiveness of special education teachers of vocational senior high school in Taipei and New Taipei City. By using Questionnaire Survey to gather the data and“Scale of the emotional labor and teaching effectiveness of special education teachers of vocational senior high school in Taipei and New Taipei City” was the research instrument. This study was conducted in the academic year 109 and seclected 195 special education teachers of vocational senior high school in Taipei and New Taipei City. By using SPSS to analyze the data , mean, standard deviation,Pearson correlation and multiple regression analysis were utilized. The result is described below.1. The overall emotional labor status of special education teachers of vocational senior high school in Taipei and New Taipei City tends to be medium to high; the overall teaching effectiveness tends to be medium to high.2.The teaching effectiveness has no different in any variable.3.Teachers who have teached above 20 years and teach in Taipei City have greater performance in teaching effectiveness.4.There is Moderately positive correlated between emotional labor and teaching effectiveness.5. The emotional labor of  special education teachers is predictive on teaching effectiveness,with higher interpretation of self-efficacy by“diversity”.Ultimately, based on research consequences , providing practical recommendation to educational administration,schools,special education teachers and future studies.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 技術型高中室內設計科專業及實習科目對應室內設計助理職能基準之研究
title_en: A Study of Corresponding with Professional Subjects and Practicum Subjects at the Department of Interior Design in Technical Senior High School and the Occupational Competency Standard of Interior Design Assistant
keywords: 專業科目、實習科目、室內設計、職能基準
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在探討技術型高中室內設計科、室內空間設計科（以下簡稱室設科）部定專業科目、實習科目、技能領域實習科目學習主題與勞動部室內設計助理職能基準職能內涵之對應情形。本研究採問卷調查法進行，研究對象其一為108課綱技術型高中室設科部定專業、實習科目之學習主題，其二為問卷填答對象，含全臺公、私立技術型高中室設科專任教師25位、雙北地區業界室內設計師25位，共50位。以內容分析法、描述性統計及卡方考驗進行資料分析。研究結果如下：（一）業界室內設計師認為設計群部定專業科目應加強培育「基礎圖學」知識職能內涵；（二）業界室內設計師認為設計群部定實習科目應多加強化「建築相關法規」、「基礎圖學」及「室內設計繪圖軟體應用」三項職能內涵；（三）業界室內設計師認為室內設計技能領域實習科目應加強深化學生「職場倫理」、「驗收程序執行」及「態度職能內涵」；（四）技術型高中室設科部定專業科目與室內設計助理職能基準對應程度最高者為「持續學習」，其次為「材料認識與應用」，對應程度最低者為「水電消防相關法令」；（五）技術型高中室設科部定實習科目與室內設計助理職能基準對應程度最高者為「設計圖繪製」，其次為「基礎圖學」，對應程度最低者為「驗收程序執行」；（六）技術型高中室設科部定技能領域實習科目與室內設計助理職能基準對應程度最高者為「建築相關法規」，其次為「產業專業用語」，對應程度最低者為「自我管理」。
abstract_en: The purpose of this research was to explore the comparison between the learning themes of technical senior high schools interior design subjects, interior space design subjects (hereinafter referred to as interior design subjects) designated professional subjects, practice subjects and technical field practicum subjects, and the functional connotation of the interior design assistant functions of the Ministry of Labor. This research was conducted with a questionnaire survey method. The first of the research subjects was the 108 Curriculum Guidelines technical senior high schools, and the other was the questionnaire respondents, including 25 full-time teachers of the Department of Interior Design in public and private technical senior high schools across Taiwan and 25 interior designers in Taipei and New Taipei region, a total of 50. The data used Content analysis, Descriptive Statistics, and Chi-Square test were used to analyze. The results of the study are as follows: 1. The industry interior designer believes that the professional subjects of the design group should strengthen the knowledge and functions of "Basic Graphics"; 2. The industry interior designer believes that the practicum subjects of the design group should strengthen the functions of "Construction Related Regulations", "Basic Graphics" and "Interior Design Drafting Software Application"; 3. The industry interior designer believes that the practicum subjects of the interior design skill area should strengthen the functions of "Workplace Ethics", "Acceptance Procedures Implementation" and "Attitude" of the students. 4. The highest degree of correspondence with the technical senior high school interior design department's professional subjects and the interior design assistant function benchmark is "Continuing Studies", followed by "Materials Understanding and Application", and the lowest degree of correspondence is "Plumbing and Fire Fighting Related Laws". 5. The highest degree of correspondence with the technical senior high school departmental practicum subjects and the benchmark of the interior design assistant function is "Design Drawing", followed by "Basic Drawing", and the lowest degree of correspondence is "Acceptance Procedure Execution". 6. The highest degree of correspondence with the technical senior high school interior design assistant function benchmark and the technical high school's departmental skill area practicum subject is " Construction-related regulations", followed by "Industrial professional language", and the lowest degree of correspondence is "Self-management".

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 技術型高中家政群學生自我效能、結果預期、學習興趣與生涯選擇關係之研究
title_en: The Relationships among Self-efficacy, Outcome Expectation, Learning Interest and Career Choices of Home Economics Students at Vocational Senior High Schools
keywords: 技術型高中家政群學生、自我效能、結果預期、學習興趣、生涯選擇
abstract_zh: 近年來服務產業人力需求大量增加，家政群學生除升學相關科系外，就業領域除傳統職業外，還擴增了個人工作室、設計、休閒娛樂等相關服務行業，畢業生的生涯選擇比以往更加多元。因此本研究選取社會認知生涯理論的生涯選擇模組，藉以驗證學生的自我效能、結果預期、學習興趣對生涯選擇之影響。    本研究結果顯示：一、家政群學生的自我效能信念、結果預期程度、學習興趣與生涯選擇相關性均佳。二、不同年級、證照取得、學校地點與學校屬性的家政群學生之學習興趣有顯著差異。三、不同年級、科別、證照取得、學校地點的家政群學生之自我效能信念、結果預期程度與生涯選擇有顯著差異。四、家政群學生的自我效能與結果預期、學習興趣及生涯選擇有顯著正向關係。五、家政群學生的結果預期與學習興趣、生涯選擇有顯著正向關係。六、家政群學生的學習興趣與生涯選擇有顯著正向關係。七、學習興趣為自我效能與生涯選擇的中介變項。    研究結果可提供家政群科課程規劃與教師教學參考，期能提升學生的學習意願，並促進個人的生涯選擇。
abstract_en: The demand for manpower in the service industry has increased significantly in recent years. The employment field for students from domestic department has expanded. The personal studio for design, leisure and entertainment service has become one main trend in the field. Graduates from domestic relevant departments now have more career choices than before. Therefore, this study selects the career choice module of social cognitive career theory to verify the influence of students' self-efficacy, result expectation, and learning interest on career choices.    The result shows:i.The self-efficacy beliefs, expected results, learning interests, and career choices of technical high school home economics students are good.ii.There are significant differences in the learning interests of home economics students in different grades, licenses, school locations and school attributes.iii.There are significant differences in self-efficacy beliefs, expected results, and career choices among students in the housekeeping group of different grades, subjects, licenses, and school locations.iv.There is a significant positive relationship between the self-efficacy of the domestic students in the home economics group and the expected results, learning interests and career choices.v.There is a significant positive relationship between the outcome expectation of the home economics group students and their learning interests and career choices.vi.There is a significant positive relationship between the learning interest and career choice of the home economics group students.vii.Learning interest is the mediating variable between self-efficacy and career choice.    The results of the research can provide a reference for home economics and group subject curriculum planning and teachers' teaching, which can enhance students' learning willingness and promote personal career choices.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 技術型高中教師輔導與管教壓力與生涯自我效能之相關研究
title_en: A Study on the Relationship Between Student Guidance and Discipline Stress and Career Self-Efficacy among Vocational Senior High School Teachers
keywords: 技術型高中教師、輔導與管教壓力、生涯自我效能
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在探討技術型高中教師輔導與管教壓力與生涯自我效能之關係，並分析不同背景變項教師在兩者上的差異情形。本研究採問卷調查法，以彰化縣及雲林縣技術型高中教師為研究對象，研究工具包含「教師輔導與管教壓力量表」及「生涯自我效能量表」。正式問卷共回收 332 份，扣除無效問卷 11 份後，有效問卷為 321 份。資料分析方法包括描述性統計、獨立樣本 t 檢定、單因子變異數分析、皮爾森積差相關及多元迴歸分析。研究結果顯示：1. 技術型高中教師輔導與管教壓力屬於中上程度，其中以「支持系統壓力」最高。2. 技術型高中教師生涯自我效能屬於中等程度，其中以「信心強度」較高。3. 技術型高中教師輔導與管教壓力因擔任職務、服務年資具顯著差異，年齡、性別與教育程度則不具顯著差異。4. 技術型高中教師生涯自我效能因服務年資及年齡具顯著差異，擔任職務、性別與教育程度則不具顯著差異。5. 技術型高中教師輔導與管教壓力與生涯自我效能呈顯著負相關，表示輔導與管教壓力越高，生涯自我效能越低。6、輔導與管教壓力各構面對生涯自我效能具有預測力，其中僅「工作負荷壓力」具有顯著負向預測力。基於以上研究結果，本研究對於教育主管機關、技術型高中教師及未來相關研究提出建議，以供參考。
abstract_en: This study aimed to investigate the relationship between student guidance and discipline stress and career self-efficacy among vocational senior high school teachers, and to analyze differences in these two variables among teachers with different background characteristics. A questionnaire survey method was adopted, with vocational senior high school teachers in Changhua County and Yunlin County as the research participants. The research instruments included the “Teacher Student Guidance and Discipline Stress Scale” and the “Career Self-Efficacy Scale.” A total of 332 formal questionnaires were collected. After excluding 11 invalid questionnaires, 321 valid questionnaires remained. The data were analyzed using descriptive statistics, independent samples t-test, one-way ANOVA, Pearson product-moment correlation, and multiple regression analysis.The results showed that: 1. The student guidance and discipline stress of vocational senior high school teachers was at a moderately high level, with “support system stress” being the highest. 2. The career self-efficacy of vocational senior high school teachers was at a moderate level, with “confidence strength” being relatively higher. 3. There were significant differences in vocational high school teachers’ counseling and discipline stress according to position and years of service, whereas no significant differences were found in terms of age, gender, or educational attainment. 4. There were significant differences in vocational high school teachers’ career self-efficacy according to years of service and age, whereas no significant differences were found in terms of position, gender, or educational attainment. 5. Student guidance and discipline stress was significantly negatively correlated with career self-efficacy among vocational senior high school teachers, indicating that the higher the student guidance and discipline stress, the lower the career self-efficacy. 6. The dimensions of student guidance and discipline stress had predictive power for career self-efficacy, among which only “workload stress” had a significant negative predictive effect.Based on the above findings, this study provides suggestions for educational administrative authorities, vocational senior high school teachers, and future related research as references.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 生成式AI融入設計思考教學對廣告設計科學生學習歷程之探討
title_en: Exploring the Learning Processes of Advertising Design Students in Design Thinking Pedagogy Integrated with Generative AI
keywords: 焦慮量表、主題式分析、ADDIE、鷹架學習、AI自我效能
abstract_zh: 本研究以技術型高中廣告設計科《基本設計實習》為研究場域，探討生成式 AI 融入設計思考教學後，學生在 AI 輔助設計歷程中所面臨之挑戰、學習轉變，以及不同類型學生的學習歷程路徑。研究對象為雲林某公立技術型高中廣告設計科一年級共 70 名學生，課程歷時八週，涵蓋企業識別系統設計、扁平人物設計與視覺傳達海報設計三個單元，以設計思考五階段結合生成式 AI 為核心教學策略。研究採質性取向，以焦點團體訪談及結構化學習單為主要資料來源，並輔以主題分析法進行歸納。研究結果顯示，AI 在設計思考的前、中、後期皆具備鷹架功能：前期協助學生形成訪談題綱、整合零散靈感；中期支撐構圖發展、文字表達與素材生成；後期則在流程清晰化、效率提升與情緒支持方面發揮作用。然而，AI 的效益並非線性增長，而是與學生的焦慮程度、AI自我效能及技術掌握程度交互作用。初期學生常因工具陌生、生成結果不可預期而感到不安，並在技術層面面臨提示詞精準度不足、結果與預期落差過大、作品同質化等困難；外在條件方面，使用額度限制、網路延遲與設備不足亦會中斷課堂節奏，壓縮反覆迭代的空間。面對上述限制，學生逐步發展出調適策略，包含跨工具比對、多版本取優，以及由前期依賴 AI 生成逐漸轉向自主構想、再以 AI 局部輔助的使用模式。進一步分析顯示，學生在 AI 結合設計思考課程中呈現三種學習歷程路徑：AI 高依賴路徑的學生完成速度較快，但易出現風格趨同與自主性下降；AI 平衡路徑的學生能在效率與品質之間取得折衷，並保有一定的設計判斷；AI 高自主路徑的學生以自我創作為主、AI 為輔助，較能維持設計思考的反思性與循環性。基於上述發現，本研究建議教師依設計思考各階段明確界定 AI 的介入功能、強化提示詞與視覺判讀能力的雙重鷹架，並以歷程外顯化設計降低同質性與依賴傾向；同時針對三種路徑學生提供差異化的教學支持，以促進學生逐步建立設計判斷與創作自主性。
abstract_en: This study explored the challenges, learning changes, and learning pathways of vocational high school students participating in design thinking instruction integrated with generative artificial intelligence (AI), situated within the Basic Design Practice course. Participants were 70 first-year students enrolled in an advertising design program at a public vocational high school in Yunlin County, Taiwan. The eight-week curriculum, structured around the five stages of design thinking, covered corporate identity system design, flat character design, and visual communication poster design. A qualitative approach was adopted, with data collected through focus group interviews and structured learning worksheets and analyzed using thematic analysis.          The findings indicated that generative AI served as a scaffold throughout the design thinking process, supporting interview question development and idea organization in the early stages, composition, textual expression, and visual material generation in the middle stages, and workflow clarity, efficiency, and emotional support in the later stages.                     However, its effectiveness did not increase linearly, but interacted with students' anxiety, AI self-efficacy, and technical proficiency. Early unfamiliarity and unpredictable outputs led to imprecise prompts, result discrepancies, and stylistic homogeneity, while usage quota limits, network delays, and insufficient devices disrupted classroom pacing and compressed room for iterative refinement.          Students gradually developed adaptive strategies, including cross-platform comparison, selecting from multiple versions, and shifting from reliance on AI-generated content toward self-directed ideation with targeted AI assistance. Three learning pathways emerged: high AI dependency, marked by rapid completion but reduced autonomy and greater homogeneity; balanced AI use, which sustained efficiency, quality, and design judgment; and high learner autonomy, in which students retained creative control while preserving the reflective, iterative nature of design thinking, using AI only as a supplementary tool.          The study suggests that teachers should clearly define AI's role at each design thinking stage, scaffold prompt construction and visual evaluation, externalize students' design processes to reduce homogeneity and dependency, and offer differentiated support to strengthen design judgment and creative autonomy across the three pathways.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 國小高年級STEAM課程融入情意能力及社會情緒能力提升情形之研究
title_en: Study on the Improvement of Affective Skills and Social-Emotional Competence by Integrating STEAM Curriculum in Senior Elementary Schools
keywords: STEAM教育、合作學習教學法、社會情緒學習、情意學習
abstract_zh: 當今教育非常重視讓學生學習到能夠帶著到未來生活中也能使用到的技能，我國十二年國民教育課程綱要中也將終身學習、人際溝通、團隊合作等重要能力納入其中，這也意味的教育中已經有越來越多人意識到，學生除了學業成績之外，情意以及社交能力對於學生個人生涯的影響更是影響深遠，然而學生在學校學習的過程中，較缺乏學習情意以及社交能力的機會，這也使學生在未來遇到相關問題時較無法去解決問題。STEAM 教育的課程中經常使用合作學習教學的策略進行課程活動，而合作學習教學法的內涵與與社會情緒學習中涵蓋的能力是能夠互相呼應的，社會情緒學習中，強調由認識自我為起始點，接著進行自我管理、了解他人、與他人保持友好的人際關係的循環；而合作學習教學法中強調的是以團體為單位進行課程活動，並且為所屬團隊做出符合自己能力的貢獻。本研究旨在國小 STEAM 教育課程中，以樂高為 STEAM 課程教具，使用合作學習教學策略結合社會情緒學習，探討學生的社會情緒能力以及情意能力之成效，本研究採準實驗研究法，實驗組使用合作學習教學結合社會情緒學習策略，對照組使用一般合作學習教學策略，研究樣本共計 40 名學生。教學內容為研究者結合樂高自行設計之五週課程。研究結果顯示：一、社會情緒能力中自我覺察面向、人際技巧面向、負責任的決策面向兩組學生成效之提升具有顯著差異，且實驗組優於對照組。二、社會情緒能力中自我管理面向、社會覺察面向兩組學生成效之提升雖然沒有顯著差異，但實驗組之前後測成績變化優於對照組。三、情意能力統計結果雖然不具顯著差異，但實驗組後測成績優於對照組。四、課程中對於其他組別作品之評分成績，實驗組優於對照組，且統計結果具有顯著差異。
abstract_en: In contemporary education, there is a strong emphasis on equipping students with skills that are transferable to their future lives. Taiwan's 12-Year Basic Education Curriculum Guidelines have integrated key competencies such as lifelong learning, interpersonal communication, and teamwork. This shift reflects a growing recognition that, beyond academic performance, students’ affective and social abilities significantly influence their personal development and career trajectories. However, students lack opportunitiesto develop learning motivation and social skills during the learning process, which makes it more difficult for them to solve related problems when they go to school in the future.STEAM education frequently incorporates cooperative learning strategies into its curriculum activities. The principles of cooperative learning closely align with the competencies covered in social and emotional learning (SEL). SEL emphasizes a developmental cycle beginning with self-awareness, followed by self-management, understanding others, and building positive interpersonal relationships. Similarly, cooperative learning centers on group-based activities where students contribute to their team in a manner that reflects their individual strengths.This study explores the impact of integrating SEL with cooperative learning strategies in elementary school STEAM education, using LEGO as a teaching tool. A quasi-experimental design was employed, with the experimental group receiving instruction that combined cooperative learning and SEL strategies, while the control group engaged in standard cooperative learning instruction. A total of 40 students participated in the study. The instructional content consisted of a five-week curriculum designed by the researcher integrating LEGO-based STEAM activities.The findings revealed that: (1) There were significant improvements in selfawareness, relationship skills, and responsible decision-making within the SEL dimensions for the experimental group compared to the control group. (2) Although the improvements in self-management and social awareness were not statistically significant, the experimental group demonstrated greater positive change between pre- and post-tests. (3) In terms of affective competence, statistical differences were not significant, but the experimental group still outperformed the control group in post-test scores. (4) The experimental group also received significantly higher peer assessment scores when evaluating projects from other groups.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 交互教學法配合六何法融入繪本於國小數學學習態度與閱讀動機以及數學閱讀理解之探究
title_en: Reciprocal Teaching Method Combined with the 5W1H Method to Integrate Picture Books into Elementary school Mathematics A Study on Learning Attitude, Reading Motivation and Mathematical Reading Comprehension
keywords: 交互教學法、繪本、數學閱讀理解、學習態度、閱讀動機
abstract_zh: 自從108課綱開始，發現許多學生缺乏閱讀素養，連帶影響本身對於理解題意的不懂，身處教學現場，發現學生學習單元時只要不是減就是加，絲毫無察覺讀懂題目這件事。因此，研究者認為讓學生要有一定的閱讀理解，才能去理解題意。本研究探討國小數學，使用數學繪本去進行數學教學，並設計六何法學習單，探討學生數學閱讀理解、閱讀動機、數學學習態度有無提升，將數學課融入繪本當中，去進行數學課程教學，協助教師提升學生的閱讀素養及閱讀理解，幫助學生建立閱讀好習慣、提高學習成效，值得深入探討學生為什麼數學學得不好。本研究探討交互教學法配合六何法融入繪本於國小數學學習態度與閱讀動機以及數學閱讀理解之探究。本研究採準實驗研究法，研究對象為雲林縣某鄉鎮國民小學四年級兩個班級，共計38名學生，進行八週的實驗教學。實驗組採交互教學法配合六何法融入數學繪本教學策略，對照組採傳統的一般教學法配合六何法教學策略。教學內容為運用數學繪本，融入數學課程中，與研究者自行設計之課程內容進行教學。讓學生在學習的過程中，可以多些對數學的探討，輔助學生學習數學。研究結果：一、交互教學法配合六何法的學習策略下，對實驗組學生在數學閱讀理解之提升有顯著成效。二、交互教學法配合六何法的學習策略下，對實驗組學生在閱讀動機之提升有顯著成效。三、交互教學法配合六何法的學習策略下，透過半結構式訪談，訪談結果實驗組感受優於對照組。四、交互教學法配合六何法的學習策略下，學生在數學學習態度、閱讀動機、課內交互教學法相關性分析是有顯著相關的。五、交互教學法配合六何法的學習策略下，學生在數學前測、數學閱讀理解、課程學習單相關性分析中，數學前測和數學閱讀理解之間沒有顯著，課程學習單和數學前測是有顯著相關的。
abstract_en: Since the implementation of the 2019 Curriculum Guidelines (108 Curriculum Guidelines), it has become evident that many students lack reading literacy, which in turn affects their ability to understand the meaning of questions. As someone working on the front lines of education, the researcher has observed that when students are learning a unit, they tend to focus solely on whether the problem involves addition or subtraction, without realizing the importance of actually understanding the question. Therefore, the researcher believes that students must have a certain level of reading comprehension in order to truly grasp the meaning of the problems.This study explores the use of mathematical picture books in elementary school mathematics instruction. By integrating picture books into math lessons and designing worksheets based on the "5W1H" (Who, What, When, Where, Why, How) questioning method, the research investigates whether students show improvement in mathematical reading comprehension, reading motivation, and attitudes toward learning mathematics. The integration of picture books into math classes aims to help teachers enhance students’ reading literacy and comprehension skills, foster good reading habits, and improve learning outcomes. It is also worth further exploring the underlying reasons why some students struggle with learning mathematics.This study explores the integration of Reciprocal Teaching and the 5W1H strategy into picture book-based instruction in elementary mathematics, focusing on its effects on students’ learning attitudes, reading motivation, and mathematical reading comprehension. A quasi-experimental research design was adopted. The participants were two fourth-grade classes from an elementary school in a rural township of Yunlin County, with a total of 38 students. The experimental teaching was conducted over eight weeks. The experimental group received instruction using a combination of Reciprocal Teaching and the 5W1H strategy integrated with mathematical picture books, while the control group received traditional instruction paired with the 5W1H strategy.The instructional content involved incorporating mathematical picture books into the math curriculum, combined with lessons designed by the researcher. This approach aimed to encourage students to engage more deeply with mathematical concepts and support their learning through integrated instruction.Research Findings: 1. Under the instructional strategy combining Reciprocal Teaching with the 5W1H approach, the experimental group showed significant improvement in mathematical reading comprehension. 2. This combined teaching strategy also led to a significant enhancement in the reading motivation of students in the experimental group. 3. Semi-structured interviews revealed that students in the experimental group had a more positive learning experience compared to those in the control group. 4. Correlation analysis indicated a significant relationship among students' mathematics learning attitudes, reading motivation, and their experience with the in-class Reciprocal Teaching approach when paired with the 5W1H strategy. 5. Further correlation analysis showed no significant relationship between students’ pre-test scores in mathematics and their mathematical reading comprehension. However, there was a significant correlation between students’ pre-test scores and their performance on the curriculum worksheets.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 雲林縣國小學童對引入外籍教師英語教學之學習滿意度探究
title_en: The Study on the Satisfaction of Elementary School Students in Yunlin County Towards the Introduction of Foreign Teachers in English Teaching
keywords: 外籍教師、學習滿意度、質性研究、協同教學、英語學習動機
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在探討雲林縣國小高年級學童在實施中外師協同教學模式下，對外籍教師授課之學習經驗與滿意度。本研究採質性個案研究取向，以雲林縣三所國民小學共10位曾接受外師教學達一年以上之高年級學童為研究對象，透過半結構式深度訪談蒐集資料，並運用主題分析法進行文本編碼與歸納。研究結果顯示：（1）外籍教師入校教學為缺乏校外英語學習資源的學童，提供了接觸外籍英語教學人員與全英語情境的管道；（2）將外國節慶文化與繪本故事等非制式教材融入課程，符合學童之偏好並能引發內在學習動機；（3）結合數位載具（如平板電腦）與遊戲化競賽之教學活動，有助於形塑低焦慮之課堂氛圍，學童主觀認為有助於提升參與意願；（4）外師運用肢體語言、數位翻譯工具，以及與本國籍教師進行協同翻譯等教學鷹架，能協助學童跨越全英語授課時的理解障礙；（5）學童對外師教學總體呈現正向滿意度，其印象深刻之事件多聚焦於跨文化體驗與真實之人際互動。總結而言，引進外籍教師不僅提供語言教學，亦增加學生跨文化接觸與互動經驗。依據上述研究結果，本研究針對教育行政單位與教學實務工作者，提出維持外師教學資源、適度應用數位設備，以及安排中外師協同備課時間等實務建議。
abstract_en: This study aims to explore the learning experiences and satisfaction of senior elementary school students in Yunlin County regarding foreign teachers' instruction under the co-teaching model. Adopting a qualitative case study approach, this research conducted semi-structured in-depth interviews with 10 senior students from three elementary schools in Yunlin County who had been taught by foreign teachers for at least one year. Thematic analysis was applied for data coding and synthesis.The findings indicate that: (1) The introduction of foreign teachers provides an authentic all-English environment for students who lack after-school educational resources; (2) Incorporating non-traditional materials, such as cultural festivals and picture books, aligns with students' preferences and stimulates their internal learning motivation; (3) The integration of digital devices (e.g., tablet computers) and gamified activities helps create a low-anxiety classroom atmosphere and was perceived by students as encouraging classroom participation. (4) Foreign teachers establish instructional scaffolds through body language, digital translation tools, and translation collaboration with local teachers, assisting students in overcoming language comprehension barriers; (5) Students demonstrate positive overall satisfaction with foreign teachers' instruction, and their memorable experiences mainly focus on cross-cultural exposure and authentic interpersonal interactions.In conclusion, the foreign teacher policy not only provides language instruction but also increases students’ opportunities for cross-cultural exposure and interaction. Based on the findings, this study provides practical recommendations for educational authorities and teaching practitioners, including sustaining foreign teacher resources, utilizing digital equipment, and scheduling co-planning time between local and foreign teachers.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 國小教師生涯角色認同與轉化因素研究: 以雙因素、三域模式與公平理論詮釋
title_en: Research on Factors Influencing Career Role Identity and Transformation in Elementary School Teachers: Perspectives from Two-Factor, Three Domain Model and Equity Theories
keywords: 教師專業角色認同、雙因素理論、公平理論
abstract_zh: 在少子女化與教育政策頻繁變動的環境下，國小教師承受著前所未有的外部究責與角色壓力。本研究旨在探討國小教師面對這些複雜挑戰時，其角色認同的衝突內涵、心理調適策略，以及專業認同如何隨之轉變的動態歷程。    本研究採用質性研究的主題分析法，對六位不同年資的國小教師進行深度訪談。在資料分析上，運用「雙因素理論」、「三域模型」及「公平理論」作為理論視角，對訪談內容進行系統性的編碼與歸納。    研究結果歸納出三個重要發現：第一：從雙因素與三域模型來看，「看見學生成長」是支持各世代教師留在崗位上的核心動力；而學校的行政態度與同儕氛圍則是決定教師是否耗竭的關鍵，冷漠的科層體制會加劇人才流失，友善的支持則能有效緩衝倦怠。第二：從公平理論分析，教師普遍面臨「投入心力極高，實質回報卻嚴重失衡」的困境。為了維持心理平衡，教師常需透過改變比較對象或降低期望值來自我調適。第三：在角色認同的轉變上，所有受訪教師都會透過「策略性縮減」來為自己設立停損點。資深教師多能憑藉豐富經驗堅持教育初衷；然而，年輕與中生代教師在現實衝擊下，容易產生「認同疏離」，甚至尋求轉職或發展斜槓的退路。    教師的角色認同是與教育體制不斷磨合的過程。本研究建議，教育主管機關應增聘專職行政人員，落實「教學與行政分離」；學校主管也應提升法律與輔導知能，成為基層教師的堅實後盾。唯有從根本改善學校的支持系統，才能減緩教師的熱忱耗損，化解新世代師資流失的危機，進而維繫基礎教育的品質。
abstract_en: Amidst declining birth rates and frequent shifts in educational policies, elementary school teachers face unprecedented external accountability and role pressure. This study aims to explore the nature of role identity conflicts, psychological adjustment strategies, and the dynamic transformation process of professional identity among elementary school teachers navigating these complex challenges.  Adopting a qualitative approach using thematic analysis, this study conducted in-depth interviews with six elementary school teachers of varying years of teaching experience. For data analysis, Herzberg’s Two-Factor Theory, Dinham and Scott’s Three-Domain Model, and Adams’ Equity Theory were utilized as theoretical lenses to systematically code and synthesize the interview content.  The research findings are summarized into three key points: First, from the perspectives of the Two-Factor Theory and the Three-Domain Model, "witnessing student growth" serves as the core motivation sustaining teachers across all generations in their roles. Meanwhile, school administrative attitudes and peer atmosphere are critical determinants of teacher burnout; apathetic bureaucratic systems exacerbate talent drain, whereas friendly support effectively buffers against exhaustion. Second, analyzed through the lens of Equity Theory, teachers universally confront the dilemma of "extremely high effort investment coupled with severely disproportionate tangible rewards." To maintain psychological equilibrium, teachers frequently resort to self-adjustment by shifting their comparative targets or lowering their expectations. Third, regarding the transformation of role identity, all interviewed teachers employ "strategic reduction" to establish boundaries for themselves. Senior teachers often rely on their rich experience to persist in their original educational intentions; however, young and mid-career teachers, under the impact of reality, are prone to experiencing "identity alienation," and may even seek career changes or develop "slash" (multiple career) exit strategies.  The role identity of teachers is a continuous process of negotiation with the educational system. This study suggests that educational authorities should hire dedicated administrative staff to implement the "separation of teaching and administration." Furthermore, school administrators should enhance their legal and counseling competencies to serve as a solid backing for frontline teachers. Only by fundamentally improving the school support system can the depletion of teachers' enthusiasm be mitigated and the crisis of new-generation teacher attrition be resolved, thereby maintaining the quality of basic education.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 基於畢業生職涯發展與滿意度之音樂教育學程成效評估研究
title_en: An Evaluation Study of Music Education Program Based on Alumni Career Pathways and Satisfaction: A Case Study at Universitas Islam Riau
keywords: 音樂教育、課程評估、CIPP模式、畢業生滿意度、職涯發展
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在評估廖內伊斯蘭大學（Universitas Islam Riau, UIR）音樂教育學程之成效，透過分析畢業生之職涯發展、學習滿意度，以及所獲能力與職場需求之契合程度進行探討。本研究採用情境（Context）、投入（Input）、過程（Process）與成果（Product）之CIPP評估模式，作為整體分析架構。本研究採用混合研究方法。量化資料來自102位畢業生之問卷調查，質性資料則透過半結構式訪談取得。量化資料以描述性統計進行分析，質性資料則採主題分析法加以詮釋。研究結果顯示，多數畢業生已成功進入職場，且相當比例從事與音樂相關之工作。整體而言，畢業生對於學程在各個CIPP面向上皆持正向評價，包括課程之相關性、教學資源、教學歷程以及能力培養成果。本學程在培養學生之專業音樂能力以及可轉移能力（如溝通能力、合作能力與創造力）方面，具有顯著成效。然而，本研究亦發現若干需改進之處，特別是在強化產業連結、提升實務導向學習，以及整合數位音樂科技於課程設計方面。綜合而言，UIR音樂教育學程在促進畢業生就業能力與專業能力發展方面展現良好成效。本研究結果可作為未來課程改善與高等音樂教育發展之重要參考依據。
abstract_en: This study evaluates the effectiveness of the Music Education Program at Universitas Islam Riau (UIR) by examining alumni career pathways, satisfaction, and the alignment between acquired competencies and professional demands. The evaluation is conducted using the Context, Input, Process, and Product (CIPP) model as a comprehensive framework. A mixed-methods approach was employed. Quantitative data were collected through a structured questionnaire from 102 alumni, while qualitative insights were obtained through semi-structured interviews. The quantitative data were analyzed using descriptive statistics, and the qualitative data were analyzed through thematic analysis. The findings indicate that most alumni have successfully entered the workforce, with a considerable proportion working in music-related fields. Overall, alumni expressed positive perceptions of the program across all CIPP dimensions, including curriculum relevance, learning resources, instructional processes, and competency outcomes. The program was found to contribute significantly to the development of both technical musical skills and transferable skills such as communication, collaboration, and creativity. However, the study also identifies several areas for improvement, particularly in strengthening industry relevance, enhancing practical learning experiences, and integrating digital music technology into the curriculum. In conclusion, the Music Education Program at UIR demonstrates a generally positive contribution to graduate employability and professional competency development. The findings provide valuable insights for curriculum improvement and institutional development in music education within higher education contexts.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 比較幼兒在不同種類桌遊所展現之社會互動技巧
title_en: Comparing the Social Interaction Skills Demonstrated by Young Children in Different Types of Board Games
keywords: 桌上遊戲、合作性桌遊、競爭性桌遊、社會互動技巧、幼兒
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在瞭解幼兒使用合作性桌遊與競爭性桌遊所展現之社會互動技巧,並探究不同類型桌遊之幼兒社會互動技巧之差異。本研究採用實驗研究法,以雲林縣某國小附設幼兒園植物班(化名)6 位大班幼生為對象進行研究。以「自編社會互動觀察表」做為研究工具,將評定表觀察結果編碼製表,以此輔助質性說明,再加上錄影、省思、與搭班老師討論及訪問幼兒等質性資料,作為研究說明的資訊。依據資料分析結果,得出以下結論:一、在合作性桌遊中看見幼兒與彼此對話中表現出積極參與及合作意願。二、在桌遊遊戲中,看見幼兒由自我中心的想法發展出群體意識。三、提供幼兒符合身心發展桌遊之重要性。四、適時介入可引導提升幼兒合作行為。依據研究結論提出相關建議,提供幼兒園、教保服務人員與未來研究之參考。
abstract_en: This study aims to understand the social interaction skills exhibited by young children using cooperative and competitive board games, and to explore the differences in social interaction skills among different types of board games.This study employed an experimental research method,using five kindergarten students from a botany class(pseudonyms)at an elementary school in Yunlin Countyas the research subjects.Using a "self-designed Social Interaction Observation Form" as the research tool, the observation results of the rating form were coded and tabulated. This is used to support qualitative descriptions, along with qualitative data such as video recordings, reflections, discussions with co-teachers, and interviews with children, as information for the research description.A degree the results of this study showed that:1. In cooperative board games, children demonstrate active participation and a willingness to cooperate through conversations with each other.2. In board games, we can see young children develop a sense of community from egocentric thinking.3. The Importance of Providing Board Games that Meet the Physical and Mental Development Needs of Young Children.4. Timely intervention can guide and enhance children's cooperative behavior.According to the conclusion, this study proposed recommendations as references for preschool, preschool educators, and future studies.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: TFETP外師實地訪視紀錄表指標改善分析
title_en: An Improvement Analysis of On-Site Classroom Observation Form Indicators for TFETP Foreign English Teachers
keywords: 教育部擴大引進外籍英語教學人員計畫、外籍英語教師、實地訪視、指標改善、文件分析
abstract_zh: 隨著雙語教育政策的推行，「教育部擴大引進外籍英語教學人員計畫（TFETP）」已成為提升臺灣學生英語素養之關鍵。然而，現行針對外籍英語教師之實地訪視紀錄表，常面臨指標過於籠統、未能體現外師教學特質。本研究旨在透過訪談外師，改善現行外師實地訪視指標，以提升教學訪視之效度與實務引導功能。研究結果發現：1. 現行指標多偏重於教學行政程序，缺乏對外師自然語境輸入（Language Input）與學生產出（Student Output）比例之具體觀測；2. 中外師實地訪視指標之同質性過高，未能突顯外師在跨文化啟發之核心價值。最後，本研究根據分析結果提出一套具備「行為描述化」特徵之改善實地訪視紀錄表。
abstract_en: Following the implementation of bilingual education policies, the Taiwan Foreign English Teacher Program (TFETP) has become a cornerstone in enhancing the English proficiency of students in Taiwan. However, the current on-site classroom observation forms for Foreign English Teachers (FETs) often face challenges such as overly vague indicators and a failure to reflect the unique teaching characteristics of foreign teachers. This study aims to optimize these observation indicators through interviews with FETs to enhance the validity and practical guidance of instructional visits.The research findings indicate that: 1. Current indicators emphasize administrative procedures but lack concrete observation regarding the ratio of natural language input (from teachers) to student output. 2. There is an excessive homogeneity (undifferentiated nature) between the indicators for local and foreign teachers, which fails to highlight the core value of FETs in intercultural inspiration. Finally, based on the analytical results, this study proposes an improved on-site observation record form characterized by behavioral descriptors.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 中油石化部安全領導、安全文化與員工不安全行為關係之研究：自我實現之中介效果
title_en: Relationship on Safety Leadership. Safety Culture, and Employee Unsafe Behavior of the Petro Chemical Business Division of CPC Corporation: The Mediating Effect of Self-actualization.
keywords: 安全領導、安全文化、自我實現、不安全行為
abstract_zh: 中油石化部為石化業巨擘，成立25餘年，並列全球500大企業。近年來事故頻繁，中油石化部形象及居民觀感影響之鉅。筆者在中油石化部工安部門服務已有35年資歷，筆者對於安全領導、安全文化及不安全行為等核心議題有相當的敏覺度及專業度。    本研究以中油石化部從業人員自我實現為基礎，以自我實現為中介變項，釐清安全領導、安全文化及不安全行為之關係。分析中油石化部從業人員不同背景在安全領導、安全文化、不安全行為及自我實現之差異情形，再探究四者之相互相關。本研究透過文獻探討之理論與架構建構問卷，經過預試、項目分析、效度分析及信度分析後，透過統計資料分析，提出研究結論與建議。本文研究對象為中油石化部從業人員，共發出300份問卷，回收後剔除無效問卷，其有效問卷為282份，有效回收率為94 %。經實證分析後獲得以下結論：一、  安全領導、安全文化在性別、學歷有部份顯著差異；不安全行為在性別、職務、年資有部份顯著差異；自我實現在不同年齡、學歷、婚姻及職務有顯著部份差異。二、安全領導與不安全行為具有顯著正相關；安全文化與不安全行為具有顯著正    相關；自我實現與不安全行為具有顯著正相關；安全領導與自我實現具有顯    著正相關；安全文化與自我實現具有顯著正相關。三、安全領導、安全文化、自我實現對不安全行為都具有預測力。四、自我實現在安全領導對不安全行為之關係間具有中介效果；自我實現在安全    文化對不安全行為之關係間具有中介效果。    最後根據研究結果分析，分別對中油石化部及後續研究者提出相關建議，以使其提升中油石化部主管安全領導、組織安全文化之水準，強化自我實現之意識及消彌不安全行為之因素。
abstract_en: PetroChemical Business Division of CPC Corporation is a giant in the petrochemical industry. It has been established for more than 25 years and is ranked among the top 500 companies in the world.Accidents have occurred frequently in recent years, which has had a huge impact on the image and residents' perception of CPC Petrochemicals. The author has served in the industrial safety department of CPC Petrochemicals for 35 years. The author has considerable sensitivity and professionalism in core issues such as safety leadership, safety culture and unsafe behaviors.    This study is based on the self-realization of employees of PetroChemical Business Division of CPC Corporation , and uses self-realization as a mediating variable to clarify the relationship between safety leadership, safety culture, and unsafe behaviors. The differences in safety leadership, safety culture, unsafe behaviors, and self-realization among employees from different backgrounds of PetroChemical Business Division of CPC Corporation are analyzed, and the correlation between the four is explored. This study constructs a questionnaire based on the theory and framework of literature research. After pre-testing, item analysis, validity analysis, and reliability analysis, the research conclusions and suggestions are proposed through statistical data analysis.    The research subjects of this paper are employees of the PetroChemical Business Division of CPC Corporation. A total of 300 questionnaires were sent out. After the invalid questionnaires were removed, 282 valid questionnaires were obtained, and the effective recovery rate was 94%. After empirical analysis, the following conclusions were obtained:1.Safety leadership and safety culture have some significant differences in gender and  education level; unsafe behaviors have some significant differences in gender, position,  and years of service; self-realization has some significant differences in different ages,  education levels, marital status, and positions.2.Safety leadership is significantly positively correlated with unsafe behavior; safety  culture is significantly positively correlated with unsafe behavior; self-realization is  significantly positively correlated with unsafe behavior; safety leadership is  significantly positively correlated with self-realization; safety culture is significantly  positively correlated with self-realization.3.Safety leadership, safety culture, and self-actualization all have predictive power for  unsafe behaviors.4. Self-actualization has a mediating effect on the relationship between safety leadership  and unsafe behavior; self-actualization has a mediating effect on the relationship  between safety culture and unsafe behavior.    Finally, based on the analysis of the research results, relevant suggestions are made to the PetroChemical Business Division of CPC Corporation and subsequent researchers to improve the level of safety leadership and organizational safety culture of the PetroChemical Business Division of CPC Corporation , strengthen the awareness of self-realization and eliminate the factors of unsafe behaviors.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 問題指甲消費者對理想與執業健康指甲管理師 專業素養認同度差異與關係之研究
title_en: A Study on the Differences and Relationships in Consumers' Recognition of the Ideal and Practical Professional Competency of Healthy Nail Managers Regarding Problematic Nails
keywords: 問題指甲消費者、健康指甲管理師、理想專業素養認同度、執業專業素養認同度
abstract_zh: 現今消費者對指甲健康照護需求日益迫切，然目前有關「健康指甲管理」之研究仍付之闕如，亟需進行探討。本研究旨在：一、探討問題指甲消費者對「理想」健康指甲管理師「專業素養認同度」的看法與差異；二、探討問題指甲消費者對「執業」健康指甲管理師「專業素養認同度」的看法與差異；三、比較問題指甲消費者對「理想」與「執業」健康指甲管理師「專業素養認同度」的差異；四、分析「理想」與「執業」健康指甲管理師「專業素養認同度」的關聯情形；五、分析「理想」對「執業」健康指甲管理師專業素養認同度之預測力。本研究以台北、新竹與台中地區之問題指甲消費者為研究對象，研究工具採自編「理想健康指甲管理師專業素養認同度調查問卷」及「執業健康指甲管理師專業素養認同度調查問卷」，量表內容包括「健康照護」、「專業知能」、「服務管理」及「環境衛生」等4大構面。本研究發放問卷350份，有效問卷回收190份，有效問卷回收率100%。所得資料以描述性統計、獨立樣本t檢定、相依樣本t檢定、單因子變異數分析、皮爾遜積差相關、簡單迴歸分析，以及逐步多元迴歸分析等統計方法進行分析。本研究結論如下：一、問題指甲消費者「高度認同」理想健康指甲管理師之「專業素養」；不同年齡、教育程度、擔任職務、服務年資之消費者對其專業素養認同度具顯著差異。二、問題指甲消費者「高度認同」執業健康指甲管理師之「專業素養」；不同年齡、教育程度、擔任職務、服務年資之消費者對其專業素養認同度具顯著差異。三、問題指甲消費者對「理想」健康指甲管理師的「專業素養認同度」高於業」者。四、「理想」與「執業」健康指甲管理師「專業素養認同度」具「高度正相關」。五、「理想」對「執業」健康指甲管理師「專業素養認同度」具「顯著預測力」。本研究所得提供產業主管機關、健康指甲管理機構，以及執業健康指甲管理師，推動與執行健康指甲管理「健康照護知能、專業技術能力、服務管理品質、環境衛生安全」之實徵支持，對健康指甲管理效益有諸多助益。
abstract_en: With the escalating consumer demand for nail health care, academic inquiry into "Healthy Nail Management" remains scarce and warrants immediate investigation. The purposes of this study are to: (1) explore the perceptions and group differences among consumers with problematic nails regarding their recognition of the professional competency of "Ideal" Healthy Nail Managers; (2) examine the perceptions and group differences regarding their recognition of the professional competency of "Practicing" Healthy Nail Managers; (3) compare the differences in recognition of professional competency between the "Ideal" and "Practicing" models; (4) analyze the correlation between the recognition of the "Ideal" and "Practicing" Healthy Nail Managers; and (5) determine the predictive power of the recognition of the "Ideal" model on that of the "Practicing" Healthy Nail Managers.The study targeted consumers with problematic nails in Taipei, Hsinchu, and Taichung. The research instruments included two self-developed questionnaires: the "Questionnaire on Recognition of Professional Competency of Ideal Healthy Nail Managers" and the "Questionnaire on Recognition of Professional Competency of Practicing Healthy Nail Managers." These scales encompassed four major dimensions: Health Care, Professional Knowledge and Skills, Service Management, and Environmental Hygiene. A total of 350 questionnaires were distributed, and 190 valid copies were retrieved, yielding an effective response rate of 100%. Data were analyzed using descriptive statistics, independent-samples t-tests, paired-samples t-tests, one-way ANOVA, Pearson product-moment correlation, simple regression analysis, and stepwise multiple regression analysis.The conclusions of this study are as follows: (1) Consumers with problematic nails expressed a high level of recognition for the professional competency of "Ideal" Healthy Nail Managers. Significant differences were found based on age, education level, position, and service tenure. (2) Consumers expressed a high level of recognition for the professional competency of "Practicing" Healthy Nail Managers. Significant differences were likewise observed based on age, education level, position, and service tenure.    (3) Consumers' recognition of the professional competency of "Ideal" Healthy Nail Managers was significantly higher than that of "Practicing" ones. (4) There is a strong positive correlation between the recognition of professional competency for "Ideal" and "Practicing" Healthy Nail Managers. (5) The recognition of the "Ideal" model possesses significant predictive power for the recognition of "Practicing" Healthy Nail Managers' professional competency.These findings provide empirical support for industry authorities, healthy nail management organizations, and practicing healthy nail managers. The results serve as a reference for promoting and implementing core competencies in health care knowledge, professional technical skills, service management quality, and environmental hygiene safety, thereby enhancing the overall effectiveness of healthy nail management.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 視覺化資訊統整教學於高中生資訊素養、閱讀素養與學習成果關係之研究
title_en: A Study of Visual Information Integration Teaching for High School Students: Relationship among Information Literacy, Reading Literacy, and Learning Outcomes
keywords: 高中生、視覺化資訊統整教學、資訊素養、閱讀素養、學習成果
abstract_zh: 視覺化資訊統整能力對高中生資料組織與知識架構建構極為重要，然其教學成效為何，亟待進行研究。本研究目的如下：一、瞭解高中生視覺化資訊統整教學資訊素養、閱讀素養與學習成果之現況。二、探討不同背景高中生視覺化資訊統整教學資訊素養、閱讀素養與學習成果之差異情形。三、分析高中生視覺化資訊統整教學資訊素養、閱讀素養與學習成果之相關情形。四、探討高中生視覺化資訊統整教學資訊素養對閱讀素養與學習成果之預測力。為達上述研究目的，本研究採用自編「高中生視覺化資訊統整教學資訊素養、閱讀素養與學習成果調查問卷」為研究工具。調查問卷施測後，共回收268份問卷，有效問卷樣本268份，有效問卷回收率100％。所得資料以描述性統計、獨立樣本t檢定、單因子變異數分析及事後比較、皮爾森積差相關、簡單迴歸分析、逐步多元迴歸分析等進行分析。本研究結論如下：一、高中生視覺化資訊統整教學具中低度資訊素養、中度閱讀素養及中高度學習成果。二、不同背景高中生視覺化資訊統整教學資訊素養有顯著差異：（一）「女高中生」視覺化資訊統整教學的資訊素養及其構面（取得資訊、利用資訊、綜合資訊、評估資訊）均高於「男高中生」。（二）「醫農生物運動學群高中生」視覺化資訊統整教學的資訊素養及其構面（資訊搜尋策略、利用資訊）均高於「工程理化資訊學群高中生」。（三）「文法藝術商管學群高中生」及「醫農生物運動學群高中生」視覺化資訊統整教學資訊素養的「取得資訊」構面皆高於「工程理化資訊學群高中生」。（四）「醫農生物運動學群高中生」視覺化資訊統整教學資訊素養的「綜合資訊」構面高於「文法藝術商管」及「工程理化資訊」學群高中生。三、高中生視覺化資訊統整教學資訊素養、閱讀素養與學習成果及其各構面彼此皆具中度正相關，惟獨閱讀素養與學習成果之學習滿意度構面呈低度正相關。四、高中生視覺化資訊統整教學資訊素養與各構面對閱讀素養與學習成果及其各構面皆具顯著預測力。本研究所得提供主管教育行政機關及高級中等學校，推動與實施視覺化資訊統整教學資訊素養、閱讀素養與學習成果關係之實徵支持，對高中視覺化資訊統整教學有諸多助益。
abstract_en: In the era of information explosion and the trend toward competency-based education, high school students are required to develop information literacy and reading literacy as essential foundations for lifelong learning and knowledge transformation. Visualized information integration instruction has the potential to enhance students’ abilities in data organization and knowledge structure construction; however, its instructional effectiveness and impact warrant further empirical investigation. This study aims to examine the relationships among visualized information integration instruction, information literacy, reading literacy, and learning outcomes of high school students.The research objectives are as follows:1.To investigate the current status of high school students’ information literacy, reading literacy, and learning outcomes under visualized information integration instruction.2.To examine differences in information literacy, reading literacy, and learning outcomes among high school students with different background characteristics.3.To analyze the relationships among information literacy, reading literacy, and learning outcomes.4.To examine the predictive power of information literacy on reading literacy and learning outcomes.  To achieve these objectives, a self-developed questionnaire was administered to 268 high school students. The collected data were analyzed using descriptive statistics, independent-samples t tests, one-way analysis of variance (ANOVA), Pearson product–moment correlation analysis, and stepwise multiple regression analysis.The conclusions are summarized as follows:1.High school students demonstrated low-to-moderate levels of information literacy, moderate levels of reading literacy, and moderate-to-high levels of learning outcomes under visualized information integration instruction.2.Significant differences in information literacy were found among students with different background characteristics, particularly in terms of gender and academic cluster.3.Information literacy, reading literacy, and learning outcomes were moderately and positively correlated with one another.4.Information literacy and its sub-dimensions significantly predicted reading literacy and learning outcomes.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 臺灣美容職類國際技能競賽國手創業經驗之研究 -創業生態系統的觀點
title_en: A Study of Entrepreneurial Experiences of Taiwan’s Beauty Therapy Competitors in World Skills Competitions: The Perspective of the Entrepreneurial Ecosystem
keywords: 美容職類、國際技能競賽、創業經驗、創業生態系統、技職教育
abstract_zh: 本研究以「創業生態系統」為理論架構，探討臺灣歷屆參與國際技能競賽之美容職類國手的創業經驗。而美容產業亦為技職教育的重要發展領域，而國手身分結合高度專業訓練與競賽歷程，其創業歷程更具代表性與研究價值，歸納其創業動機、挑戰因應與創業生態網絡之建構歷程。本研究的目的在於：（一）瞭解我國美容國手的創業歷程與動機；（二）分析其創業經驗分析；（三）以生態系統觀點建構符合臺灣美容產業特性的創業模式，並詮釋國手人格特質、競賽培訓與產業環境在創業系統中的互動關係。研究採取質性研究取向，透過六位歷屆國手之深度訪談與焦點團體討論資料，以主題分析法(Thematic Analysis) 歸納其創業行動的脈絡與意義，並依據「創業生態系統理論」的文化、社會與支持三層面，發展出具臺灣在地化特色的「532 美容創業生態系統」。研究結果顯示，美容國手的創業歷程並非線性進行，而是一個由技術精進、價值轉化、品牌塑造到事業擴張的多階段發展歷程。其創業動機兼具內在與外在雙重因素：內在動機源自對專業實踐的熱情、追求自我成就與自我實現；外在動機則來自追求市場機會、顧客信任、家庭支持及社會期待等。研究發現，國手的競賽歷程不僅強化其專業技術與自我效能，更轉化成為創業初期的重要文化與社會資本。「532 美容創業生態系統」旨在「文化系統層面」中，國際競賽的榮耀象徵與專業標準強化了社會大眾對美容產業價值的肯定，國手的專業形象轉化為品牌信任與市場認可，形成支持創業的文化氛圍；在「社會系統層面」中，導師指導、同儕互助與國手社群的凝聚力構成關鍵的社會支持網絡，協助創業者在資源整合、顧客拓展與市場定位上取得優勢；在「支持系統層面」中，技職教育訓練、政府補助、創業貸款與數位行銷平台等，為創業提供現實基礎與資源動能。儘管多數國手面臨資金不足與經營管理挑戰，但其展現高度的學習意願、適應力與創新行動，成功克服外部限制。此外，研究指出人格特質與競賽經驗在系統中扮演核心驅動角色。國手普遍展現高度自律、堅毅、抗壓與持續學習的特質，使其能在創業歷程中延續競賽精神，面對不確定的市場環境仍能維持穩定的成長力與創新力。競賽培訓過程中所養成的專業態度與精準操作能力，不僅奠定創業成功的基礎，也使美容服務能以更高標準進入市場競爭。綜合分析可知，「532 美容創業生態系統」一方面呼應創業生態系統理論三大構面之理論精神，另一方面亦呈現出美容產業在地化的獨特性。創業生態系統理論的模型著重於區域創業環境的鉅觀結構，而本研究則強調技職教育脈絡下的微觀實踐，特別是競賽榮耀如何轉化為文化資本，導師人脈與社群關係如何形塑社會支持網絡，以及政策、資金與數位平台如何構成創業支持基礎。此一模型不僅擴充了創業生態系統理論的應用範疇，更為臺灣技職教育與女性創業研究提供新的理論視角與實證貢獻。根據研究結果，本研究提出三項建議：（一）教育層面：技職教育應建立「國手創業資源平台」，將競賽經驗融入創業輔導與課程設計，促進專業轉化與職涯延伸；（二）政策層面：政府應完善美容產業創業扶助政策，包含創業貸款、場域協助及創新創業獎勵措施；（三）強化體驗環境規劃：根據市場需求採用專業、舒適、放鬆等體驗環境，可提高顧客滿意度。（四）後續研究層面：後續可擴展至其他技職領域國手群體，或採混合方法研究，更深入探討技職教育與創業生態互動機制的理解。本研究不僅揭示美容國手創業歷程的系統性結構與動態關聯，也突顯技職教育在培育創業人才、促進女性創業與推動產業升級中的關鍵價值。
abstract_en: This study adopts the theoretical framework of the entrepreneurial ecosystem to explore the entrepreneurial experiences of Taiwan’s beauty professionals who have previously participated in international skills competitions. As the beauty industry represents a vital field within Taiwan’s technical and vocational education, these national competitors—distinguished by their advanced technical training and rigorous competition experience—serve as exemplary cases for understanding how professional expertise and competition-based discipline translate into entrepreneurial development.The study aims to: (1) examine the entrepreneurial trajectories and motivations of Taiwan’s beauty champions; (2) analyze their entrepreneurial experiences and challenges; and (3) construct an ecosystem model that reflects the characteristics of Taiwan’s beauty industry while interpreting the interaction between personality traits, competition training, and environmental factors within the entrepreneurial system.Employing a qualitative research approach, this study conducted in-depth interviews and focus group discussions with six former beauty champions. Through thematic analysis, the findings were interpreted according to three dimensions of the entrepreneurial ecosystem—cultural, social, and supportive systems—culminating in the development of a localized analytical framework termed the “532 Beauty Entrepreneurial Ecosystem.”The findings reveal that the entrepreneurial processes of beauty champions are non-linear and evolve through multiple phases: skill enhancement, value transformation, brand formation, and business expansion. Their motivations integrate both intrinsic and extrinsic factors. Intrinsic motivations include professional passion, self-fulfillment, and autonomy, whereas extrinsic motivations arise from market opportunities, client trust, family support, and social expectations. Competition experiences were found to strengthen self-efficacy and professional credibility, transforming into significant forms of cultural and social capital in the early stages of entrepreneurship.Within the “532 Beauty Entrepreneurial Ecosystem,” the cultural system emphasizes how competition prestige and professional recognition reinforce the social value of the beauty industry, converting professional image into brand trust and market legitimacy. The social system highlights mentorship, peer collaboration, and the solidarity of champion networks as critical social supports that facilitate resource integration and client development. The supportive system encompasses vocational education, government subsidies, entrepreneurial loans, and digital marketing platforms, which collectively provide material and institutional foundations for entrepreneurship. Despite challenges such as limited funding and business management pressures, the champions demonstrated adaptability, resilience, and innovative strategies to overcome constraints.Furthermore, personality traits and competition experiences act as pivotal drivers within this system. High self-discipline, perseverance, stress tolerance, and continuous learning enable champions to sustain competitive vitality in uncertain market environments. The professional standards and discipline acquired through competition training translate into superior service quality and entrepreneurial advantage.The study concludes that the “532 Beauty Entrepreneurial Ecosystem” both aligns with and extends the theoretical dimensions of the entrepreneurial ecosystem model by incorporating Taiwan’s localized vocational context. It emphasizes the transformation of competition prestige into cultural capital, the formation of mentor-based social networks, and the integration of policy, funding, and digital platforms as supportive mechanisms. Based on these findings, four recommendations are proposed: (1) vocational institutions should establish national champion entrepreneurial resource platforms to bridge competition experience and entrepreneurial education; (2) government agencies should enhance entrepreneurship-support policies for the beauty industry; (3) salon environments should be designed to provide professional, comfortable, and customer-oriented experiences; and (4) future research should expand to other vocational sectors or employ mixed-method designs to deepen understanding of the interaction between technical education and entrepreneurial ecosystems.This research contributes theoretically and practically by illuminating the systemic structure and dynamic relationships underpinning beauty entrepreneurship, highlighting the crucial role of vocational education in fostering entrepreneurial talent, promoting women’s entrepreneurship, and advancing industrial innovation.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 十二年國教素養導向教學之國小教師的教師信念、實踐挑戰與因應策略之研究
title_en: A Study of Elementary School Teachers’ Beliefs, Practical Challenges, and Coping Strategies in Implementing Competency-Based Instruction under the 12-Year Basic Education Curriculum
keywords: 素養導向教學、教師信念、實踐挑戰、因應策略
abstract_zh: 摘要   本研究探討在十二年國民基本教育推動下，國小教師於素養導向教學的信念、實踐挑戰與因應策略。有鑑於教育改革的持續推進，教師信念與教學行為間的潛在落差，以及實踐新課綱所面臨的外部困境，本研究旨在深入了解教師在轉型過程中的真實經驗與心路歷程，以期為教育政策的實施與教師專業發展提供實證基礎。   本研究採用質性研究方法，透過半結構性訪談八位國小教師，並輔以文件分析，探討其對素養導向教學的看法，以及在教學實踐中遭遇的困境與採取的策略。研究發現，教師們普遍肯定素養導向教學的教育精神，但在實踐上，面臨來自社會地位下降、親師溝通壓力、行政工作繁重及學生學習熱情低落等多重挑戰。這些外部因素導致教師教學信念與實際行為產生落差，並迫使他們發展出如「濃縮教學」等因應策略。    研究結論顯示，教師專業信念的實踐，除了個人熱情與能力外，更高度依賴於外部環境的支持。因此，建議主管機關應建立信任教師專業的文化，精簡行政事務，並明確教師管教權限，以協助教師克服實務困境，有效落實素養導向教學。未來研究可納入教學觀察或採用量化方法，並從家長與學生視角進行探討，以獲得更全面的研究結果。
abstract_en: Abstract    This study explores the beliefs, practical challenges, and coping strategies of elementary school teachers regarding competence-oriented instruction under the Twelve-Year Basic Education Curriculum. In view of the continuous advancement of educational reforms, the potential gap between teacher beliefs and teaching behaviors, and the external difficulties encountered in implementing the new curriculum, this study aims to gain an in-depth understanding of teachers' genuine experiences and psychological journeys during this transformation. The findings are intended to provide an empirical basis for educational policy implementation and teacher professional development.   The study employs a qualitative research approach, utilizing in-depth interviews with eight elementary school teachers and document analysis to investigate their views on competence-oriented instruction and the difficulties and strategies they face in their teaching practice. The findings indicate that while teachers generally affirm the spirit of competence-oriented instruction, they face multiple challenges in practice, including declining social status, parent-teacher communication pressures, heavy administrative workloads, and students' low learning motivation. These external factors lead to a gap between teacher beliefs and actual behaviors, compelling them to develop coping strategies such as "condensed teaching."    The study concludes that the implementation of teachers' professional beliefs, in addition to personal passion and ability, is highly dependent on external environmental support. Therefore, it is recommended that educational authorities establish a culture of trusting teacher professionalism, streamline administrative tasks, and clarify teachers' disciplinary authority to help them overcome practical difficulties and effectively implement competence-oriented instruction. Future research could incorporate classroom observation or quantitative methods, and explore perspectives from parents and students to obtain more comprehensive results.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 國中教師面對投訴其心理韌性之研究
title_en: A Study on the Psychological Resilience of Junior High School Teachers Facing Complaints
keywords: 國中教師、投訴、心理韌性
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在探討國中教師在面對家長投訴時，如何因應壓力並展現心理韌性的歷程。研究聚焦於教師在角色期待、教學與班級經營以及親師溝通等面向中，所經歷的投訴帶來的挑戰，並進一步分析教師如何透過自我調適與支持系統維持心理健康與專業熱忱。研究方法採用質性研究取向中的敘事研究法，以立意取樣方式邀請五位具代表性的研究參與者，透過半結構式深度訪談蒐集其在投訴經驗中的生命故事。資料分析採用敘事分析法，整理與歸納教師面對投訴時的因應策略與心理調適經驗，並從中萃取出具有共同性的主題與意義。研究結果顯示，教師的投訴壓力來源主要集中在「親師生互動關係」與「學校行政處理」兩個層面。教師常因家長或學生的質疑，以及學校內部行政壓力而感到焦慮；相對而言，「教學本身」雖具挑戰性，但多數教師能以專業自處，並不視為主要壓力來源。在心理韌性的展現上，教師多以「自我反思與正向思考」作為內在支持因子，並仰賴同事情誼、行政協助與家人支持等外部資源來調適情緒，逐步走出困境，重建教學信念。本研究進一步指出，國中教師在投訴壓力下展現的心理韌性，並非單一策略的產物，而是內外在保護因子交互作用的結果。此發現有助於理解教師在教育現場如何維持專業身分與心理平衡，亦可作為後續教師支持政策與專業發展方案的參考。
abstract_en: This study explores how junior high school teachers cope with stress and demonstrate psychological resilience when facing parental complaints. It focuses on challenges arising from role expectations, classroom management, and parent–teacher communication, and analyzes how teachers maintain mental health and professional enthusiasm through self-adjustment and support systems. Using a qualitative narrative approach, five representative teachers were selected through purposive sampling. Semi-structured, in-depth interviews were conducted to collect their life stories, and narrative analysis was applied to identify coping strategies and common themes.Findings show that stress mainly stems from “parent–teacher–student relationships” and “school administrative processes.” Teachers often feel anxious due to parental criticism or administrative pressure, while teaching itself is less likely to be perceived as a major stressor. Psychological resilience is reflected through “self-reflection and positive thinking” as internal supports, along with external resources such as collegial bonds, administrative help, and family support, enabling teachers to recover and rebuild confidence.Overall, teachers’ resilience under complaint-related stress results from the interaction between internal and external protective factors. These insights enhance understanding of how teachers sustain professional identity and emotional balance and provide reference for teacher support policies and professional development.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 大學橄欖球員專業訓練身體素養評估指標之研究
title_en: Study on the Evaluation Indicator of Physical Quality for College Rugby Players in Professional Training
keywords: 大學橄欖球員、專業訓練、身體素養、評估指標認同度
abstract_zh: 橄欖球賽乃高強度訓練、激烈攻防、思考靈活及求勝精神的特殊運動，專業訓練身體素養為影響比賽績效的重要因素。因之，亟需進行探究，以建構大學橄欖球員專業訓練身體素養的評估指標。本研究旨在建構大學橄欖球員專業訓練身體素養評估指標；瞭解橄欖球員專業訓練身體素養的認同程度；探討不同背景橄欖球員專業訓練身體素養認同度差異；以及分析專業訓練身體素養的相對權重。本研究對象為南部地區甲組及乙組橄欖球球員，研究工具為自編之「大學橄欖球員專業訓練身體素養評估指標調查問卷」。調查問卷施測後，共回收235份問卷，有效問卷樣本227份，有效問卷回收率96.6%。所得資料以描述性統計、獨立樣本ｔ檢定、單因子變異數，以及層級分析法（AHP）進行分析。本研究結論如下：一、大學橄欖球員專業訓練身體素養包括：「認知、情意、技能」3個評估指標，以及「健康知識」、「技能概念」、「運動知識」、「技能原理」、「健康覺察」、「正向態度」、「學習態度」、「運動欣賞」、「健康技能」、「生活技能」、「技能表現」及「策略運用」等12項評估因素。二、大學橄欖球員高度認同專業訓練身體素養（認知、情意、技能）3個評估指標及12項評估因素。三、不同背景大學橄欖球員對專業訓練身體素養評估指標無顯著差異，部份評估因素有顯著差異：前鋒橄欖球員在「正向態度」、「學習態度」及「策略運用」等3項評估因素均高於後衛；球齡3–5 年橄欖球員在「運動知識」與「技能原理」2項評估因素的認同度均高於球齡3 年以下者。四、大學橄欖球球員專業訓練身體素養評估指標重要程度依序為：情意、技能、認知等3項；而評估因素重要程度依序為：學習態度、正向態度、技能概念、技能原理、技能表現、策略運用、健康技能、生活技能、健康知識、運動知識、運動欣賞及健康覺察等12項。本研究為大學橄欖球員專業訓練身體素養評估指標與評估因素提供實證研究，對橄欖球員訓練設計、訓練強度規劃，以及人才養成等具實證意涵。根據研究發現，本研究提出具體建議，供選取與訓練大學橄欖球員、訂定訓練目標、教學發展，以及人才選用之參據。
abstract_en: Rugby is a sport characterized by high-intensity training, fierce competition, flexible thinking, and a strong will to win. Among the factors influencing performance, professional training in physical literacy plays a critical role. Therefore, it is necessary to establish appropriate evaluation indicators for assessing the physical literacy of college rugby players.This study aims to construct evaluation indicators of physical literacy for college rugby players, examine players’ recognition of physical literacy, explore the differences in recognition across players with different backgrounds, and analyze the relative weights of the evaluation factors.The research subjects were rugby players from Group A and Group B teams in southern Taiwan. The instrument used was a self-developed “College Rugby Players’ Physical Literacy Evaluation Questionnaire.” A total of 235 questionnaires were collected, with 227 valid responses, yielding a valid return rate of 96.6%. The collected data were analyzed using descriptive statistics, independent sample t-tests, one-way ANOVA, and Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP).The main findings of this study are as follows:1. The physical literacy of college rugby players consists of three evaluation indicators—cognition, affect, and skills—and twelve evaluation factors, including health knowledge, skill concepts, sport knowledge, principles of skills, health awareness, positive attitude, learning attitude, appreciation of sport, health skills, life skills, skill performance, and strategy application.2. Players demonstrated a high level of recognition of the three indicators (cognition, affect, and skills) and all twelve evaluation factors.3. No significant differences were found across background variables in the three major indicators, but some evaluation factors showed significant differences: forwards scored higher than backs in positive attitude, learning attitude, and strategy application; players with 3–5 years of experience scored higher in sport knowledge and principles of skills than those with less than 3 years.4. The relative importance of the three evaluation indicators was ranked as affect, skills, and cognition. Among the twelve factors, the order of importance was: learning attitude, positive attitude, skill concepts, principles of skills, skill performance, strategy application, health skills, life skills, health knowledge, sport knowledge, appreciation of sport, and health awareness.This study provides empirical evidence for constructing evaluation indicators and factors of physical literacy among college rugby players. The results have practical implications for training program design, training intensity planning, and talent development. Based on the findings, concrete recommendations are proposed for player selection, training goal setting, teaching development, and personnel management.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 探討運算思維融入虛擬實驗室對工程教育學生之動機、參與度和高層次思維之影響
title_en: Investigating the Impact of Incorporating Computational Thinking Approach into Virtual Labs on Students’ Motivation, Engagement, and Higher-Order Thinking Skills in Engineering Education
keywords: 運算思維、虛擬實驗室、學習動機、學習參與度、高層次思維能力
abstract_zh: 工程學生的培育目標在於，成為具備解決問題能力的人才，且必須具備應對真實世界問題的能力。為因應工程專業領域的快速變遷，學生應接受問題解決、批判性思考與創造性思維等核心能力的訓練。因此，工程教育於高等教育的階段過程，應致力於提供能夠促進問題解決與批判性思維能力的教學策略。本研究旨在探討於虛擬實驗室中，將運算思維融入工程教育中，對學生的學習動機、學習參與度與高層次思維能力之成效。本研究採用混合式的研究設計，結合量化與質性進行資料蒐集與分析。量化部分採準實驗研究法，質性部分則透過訪談，進行實務瞭解與補充性資料蒐集。研究對象為印尼某公立大學電機工程系之48名學生。 研究結果顯示，在虛擬實驗教學中導入運算思維教學策略，能顯著提升實驗組學生的學習動機、學習參與度程度及高層次思維能力，顯著優於對照組。此外，結構方程模式（Structural Equation Modeling, SEM）分析亦顯示，運算思維對學生的高層次思維與學習參與度具有顯著且正向的影響，且學生的學習參與度進一步促進其高層次思維能力的發展。
abstract_en: Engineering students will become problem solvers. They need the capability to solve problems in the real world. To keep up with the constantly changing engineering profession, students should be taught problem-solving, critical thinking, and creative thinking skills. Hence, engineering education in higher institutions is expected to provide learning strategies to promote problem-solving and critical-thinking skills. This study aimed to investigate the impact of incorporating computational thinking into virtual laboratories on enhancing student motivation, engagement, and higher-order thinking skills in engineering education. In this research, a mixed-methods research design will be implemented, using a quantitative approach through a quasi-experimental study methodology and a qualitative method through interviews. The research participants are 48 students from the electrical engineering department at a public university in Indonesia. The findings indicate that incorporating a computational thinking approach into virtual labs markedly enhances student motivation, engagement, and higher-order thinking skills in the experimental group when contrasted with the control group. Furthermore, the SEM analysis indicated that computational thinking has a substantial and beneficial impact on higher-order thinking and student engagement. Consequently, student engagement cultivates the advancement of higher-order thinking skills in learners.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 技綜高學生在校表現與統測升學成績關聯性研究-新課綱實施前後比較
title_en: A Study on the Correlation between School Performance and Joint College Entrance Examination Score of Vocational and Comprehensive High School students before and after the Implementation of the New Curriculum
keywords: 國中教育會考、成績預測、學習滿意度、學習成效、結構方程模型
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在探討技術型高中與綜合高中專門學程學生的在校學習歷程，與其四技二專統一入學測驗（統測）成績之間的關聯性，並進一步分析新課綱（108課綱）與舊課綱（99課綱）制度實施下學生學習表現與升學結果的差異。隨著十二年國教政策與108課綱的全面推動，技職教育現場面臨課程內容與教學方式的重大轉型，因此本研究從成績表現與主觀學習經驗雙重面向切入，期能提供學校教學與教育決策之實證依據。本研究分為兩個階段進行。第一部分進行成績預測分析，以嘉義市某技術型高中107至113學年度機械群（機械科、製圖科、綜合高中電腦輔助機械學程）與土木與建築群（建築科、綜合高中建築技術學程）等學生共1050位為樣本，蒐集其背景資料、國中教育會考成績、三年在校各科成績、五次模擬考成績與統測成績，透過Z分數標準化與SPSS統計軟體進行相關性與多元線性迴歸分析，以建構統測成績預測模式。第二部分則透過問卷調查方式，以114年6月畢業學生為對象，涵蓋11個科別共439人，皆來自同一所技術型高中，包含各群科與綜合高中專門學程學生。問卷內容聚焦於學生的學習態度、課程參與、學習歷程檔案經驗與升學準備情形，藉由SmartPLS進行結構方程模型（SEM）分析，驗證各構面與學習滿意度、學習成效間的潛在關係，建構學生學習經驗對學習成效的影響模式。本研究所獲致之結論如下：一、學生在校成績與統測成績之間具有高度正相關。二、模擬考成績能有效預測統測表現，尤以高三後期模擬考具最強預測力。三、國中教育會考成績具長期預測效力，精熟等級學生在統測表現顯著較佳。四、不同群科、科別與學程學生的學習與統測成績存在顯著差異。五、舊課綱學生在統測總成績上略優於新課綱學生，主要因其入學基礎成績較高。六、學生整體對學校課程學習與升學準備抱持正面評價。七、學習滿意度與學習成效之間具有顯著正向關聯。八、學習態度為影響學習成效的重要直接變項。九、背景變項（性別、補習經驗、家長學歷等）會顯著影響學習滿意度與成效。十、課程學習與學習滿意度可共同有效預測學習成效，SEM模型驗證結果具良好適配度。本研究結果可作為技術型與綜合高中課程設計與升學輔導之參考，協助學校因應課綱轉變下學生學習樣態的變化。建議學校應強化學生學習歷程與升學銜接，整合課程模組、模擬考與學習歷程檔案指導，落實素養導向教學，提升整體教學效能與升學成果，俾供學校行政、教師與後續研究參考，促進技職教育穩健發展。
abstract_en: This study aims to investigate the relationship between E-portfolios for students studying in vocational high schools and specialized programs in comprehensive high schools and their test scores on the Technical Vocational Education Joint College Entrance Examination. Furthermore, it seeks to analyze the differences in students’ academic performance and admission outcomes under the implementation of the new curriculum guidelines (Curriculum Guidelines of 2019, or "108 Curriculum") compared to the previous guidelines (Curriculum Guidelines of 2010, or "99 Curriculum"). With the full implementation of Taiwan’s 12-Year Basic Education policy and the 108 Curriculum, vocational education has undergone significant transformations in both curriculum content and teaching methods. Therefore, this research adopts a dual approach—examining both academic performance and students’ subjective learning experiences—to provide empirical evidence for school instruction and educational policy-making.The study is conducted in two phases. The first phase focuses on predicting students’ test scores on the Technical Vocational Education Joint College Entrance Examination. A sample of 1,050 students was drawn from a vocational high school in Chiayi City, covering the academic years from 2018 to 2024 (107 to 113 in the ROC calendar). The sample includes students from the Mechanical Cluster (including Departments of Mechanical Engineering, Drafting, and the Computer-Aided Mechanical Engineering Program in the comprehensive high school) and the Civil and Architectural Cluster (including the Department of Architecture and the Architectural Technology Program in the comprehensive high school). Data collected include students’ background information, Junior High School Basic Competency Test scores, subject grades over three years of high school, results from five mock exams, and final TVE Joint College Entrance Examination scores. These data were standardized using Z-scores and analyzed with SPSS software through correlation and multiple linear regression analyses to construct a predictive model for TVE Joint College Entrance Examination performance.The second phase of this study employed a questionnaire survey targeting students graduating in June 2025 (Academic Year 114), with a sample size of 439 students across 11 departments. All participants were from the same vocational high school, representing various technical clusters as well as specialized programs in the comprehensive high school.The questionnaire focused on students’ learning attitudes, course engagement, experiences with E-portfolios, and their preparation for further education.
