By using SmartPLS, Structural Equation Modeling (SEM) was conducted to examine the latent relationships among various constructs, including learning satisfaction and learning outcomes. The analysis aimed to construct a model illustrating how students’ learning experiences influence their academic effectiveness.Research Conclusions1.  There is a strong positive correlation between students’ in-school academic performance and their scores on the Technical Vocational Education Joint College Entrance Examination. (TVE Joint College Exam).2.  Mock exam scores are effective predictors of TVE Joint College Exam performance, with the strongest predictive power found in the mock exams administered in the third year of high school.3.  Scores from the Junior High School Basic Competency Test demonstrate long-term predictive validity; students achieving the "Advanced" proficiency level tend to perform significantly better on the TVE Joint College Exam.4.  Significant differences in learning outcomes and TVE Joint College Exam scores exist among students from different clusters, departments, and specialized programs.5.  Students under the old curriculum guidelines (99 Curriculum) slightly outperformed those under the new guidelines (108 Curriculum) on the TVE Joint College Exam overall, primarily due to higher grades on their Junior High School Basic Competency Test.6.  Overall, students expressed a positive feedback on their school courses learning and their preparation for higher education.7.  There is a significant positive relationship between learning satisfaction and learning outcomes.8.  Learning attitude is a critical direct variable influencing learning outcomes.9.  Background variables—such as gender, experience with private tutoring, and parental education level—significantly affect both learning satisfaction and outcomes.10.  Both courses learning and learning satisfaction are significant joint predictors of learning outcomes. The results from the Structural Equation Modeling (SEM) analysis indicate a good model fit.The findings of this study can serve as a valuable reference for curriculum design and college admission counseling in vocational and comprehensive high schools. They offer guidance for schools to better respond to the evolving learning patterns of students brought about by curriculum reform. It is recommended that schools strengthen the connection between students’ E-portfolios production and their TVE Joint College Entrance Examination Preparation by integrating curriculum modules, mock exams, and guidance on compiling E-portfolios.Moreover, the implementation of competency-based teaching practices should be reinforced to enhance overall instructional effectiveness and student outcomes in higher education admissions. These insights may inform school administration, teaching strategies, and future research, thereby contributing to the sustainable development of technical and vocational education.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 藉由AI 聊天機器人支援思考、配對、分享之協同學習策略應用於英語口語課程
title_en: The Benefits of AI Chatbot-Supported Think-Pair-Share Collaborative Learning Strategy in EFL Speaking Classroom
keywords: 思考-配對-分享、人工智慧聊天機器人、外語口說焦慮、外語學習樂趣、動機、參與度、口語表現
abstract_zh: 對於英語作為外語（EFL）的學生而言，由於缺乏參與實際練習的環境，他們往往在英語口說能力方面面臨重大的挑戰，這對其口語表現產生了負面影響。這一問題可歸因於英語學習動機不足、學習過程缺乏樂趣，以及外語口說焦慮等因素。因此，大學有必要從傳統的以教師為中心的教學模式，轉型為以學生為中心的學習模式，著重於應對上述挑戰，協助學生提升英語能力。此外，隨著科技日益整合於英語教學與學習過程中，英語教師也應重新思考其教學方法。人工智慧聊天機器人能透過文字或語音，模擬與使用者進行智慧對話，為學生提供個人化的練習機會，以提升其英語口說技巧。此類人工智慧聊天機器人解決方案可防止學生對學習過程感到厭倦，進而降低學習動機與參與程度。透過與人工智慧聊天機器人進行英語溝通練習，能有效減輕學生的口說焦慮，並提升學習樂趣。因此，本研究旨在探討將創新協同學習策略「思考－配對－分享」（Think-Pair-Share, TPS）與人工智慧聊天機器人結合，是否能有效減緩外語口說焦慮（FLSA），提升外語學習樂趣（FLE）、學生的積極性與參與度，進而增進其口語表現。本研究採用混合方法設計，結合準實驗設計，為期六週。研究對象為印尼一所國立大學 2022/2023 學年秋季學期的 75 名新生，其中對照組有 36 名學生參與傳統 TPS 協同學習，實驗組則有 39 名學生參與 AI 聊天機器人支援的 TPS 協同學習。研究資料透過問卷調查、口說測驗與訪談方式進行蒐集研究結果顯示，相較於傳統的 TPS 協同學習，結合 AI 聊天機器人支援的 TPS 模式能顯著降低外語口說焦慮，提升外語學習樂趣、學習動機、參與程度以及口語表現。
abstract_en: English as a foreign language (EFL) students often face significant challenges in their English speaking abilities due to a lack of opportunities to engage in practice environments, which negatively affects their speaking performance. This issue can be attributed to a deficiency in motivation for English learning, the absence of enjoyment in their English learning experience, and their foreign language speaking anxiety. Consequently, universities are expected to transition from traditional teacher-centred learning to a more student-centred learning, with a focus on addressing this challenge and helping students develop their proficiency in English. In addition, it is time for English teachers to reconsider their teaching methodologies in light of the integration of technology in English teaching learning process. The use of AI chatbots, known for simulating intelligent conversations with users via text or speech, offers a means for students to enhance their English speaking skills with personalized practice opportunities. This AI chatbot solutions are able to prevent student disinterest, diminishing motivation, and reduced engagement in the learning process. Practicing communication in English with AI chatbots, can effectively alleviate speaking anxiety among students and enhance their enjoyment of the learning experience. Therefore, the aim of this study is to investigate the use of an innovative collaborative learning strategy, Think-Pair-Share (TPS), incorporated by an AI chatbot to alleviate foreign language speaking anxiety (FLSA), enhance foreign language enjoyment (FLE), student motivation and engagement, and ultimately improve their speaking performance. This study employed a mixed-methods approach, incorporating a quasi-experimental design, and was carried out over a six-week period. The study involved 75 freshmen from a state university in Indonesia during the fall semester of the 2022/2023 academic year, with 36 control group students participating in the conventional TPS collaborative learning and 39 experimental group students participating in AI chatbot-supported TPS collaborative learning approach. Data were gathered through questionnaires, speaking tests, and interviews. The findings show that AI chatbot-supported TPS collaborative learning created considerably lower FLSA, enhanced FLE, motivation, engagement, and speaking performance than conventional TPS collaborative learning.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 疫情時期馬來西亞之學生數學自我效能、主動學習行為及教學方法對數學學習成效影響路徑之分析
title_en: Mediational Pathways Analysis of Mathematics Self-Efficacy, Active Learning, and Teaching Methods on Student Achievement During COVID-19 Pandemic Period
keywords: 數學自我效能、數學成就、PISA 2022、Covid-19、馬來西亞
abstract_zh: 本研究探討Covid-19疫情期間馬來西亞學生的數學學習表現機制。研究聚焦於兩類數學自我效能（基礎計算應用能力與高階思維能力）如何透過中介變項影響學生數學成就。主要中介變項包括學生主動學習行為，以及教師在培養推理能力和數學思維方面的教學策略。研究以學生性別和學校停課時間為控制變項，分析不同類型數學自我效能經由主動學習行為與教師教學方法對數學成就產生影響的中介路徑，旨在深入理解疫情期間數學學習的運作機制與關鍵影響因素。本研究採用次級資料分析方法，資料來源為PISA官方網站發布的PISA 2022資料庫，從中篩選出馬來西亞籍學生資料作為研究樣本，共計7,069名學生，其中男學生3,477名（49.2%），女學生3,592名（50.8%），性別分布相對均衡。根據疫情期間學校停課時長，樣本學生可區分為三個群組：短期停課群組（3個月以下）佔17.7%，中期停課群組（1-6個月）佔40%，長期停課群組（6個月以上）佔42.3%，顯示多數學生經歷了中長期的學校停課狀況。本研究將運用Process中的模型4進行統計分析，以檢驗各變項間的中介效果。本研究之研究結果如下：（一）主動學習行為在數學自我效能與數學成就之間發揮關鍵的中介作用，但其效應模式因自我效能類型而顯著不同；（二）數學高階思維技能主要通過間接效果影響數學成就，即主要依賴激發學生主動學習行為來促進學習成果；（三）基礎計算應用能力則主要通過直接效果發揮作用；（四）教師教學方法的中介效應呈現明顯的條件性特徵，教師培養推理能力在兩種自我效能模型中均有效，但教師培養數學思維僅在高階思維技能模型中顯著，反映了教學方法與學生認知發展水準匹配的重要性；（五）COVID-19疫情背景下呈現兩項特殊現象：女學生在數學成就方面展現優勢表現，以及學校停課時間延長對學生數學成就產生正向影響效果。研究建議如下：（一）培養數學高階思維自我效能的教學策略，透過適度挑戰性問題讓學生體驗數學推理成功經驗，並強化主動學習行為培養；（二）實施差異化教學與性別平等的數學教育實踐，針對不同自我效能特徵學生採用匹配性教學策略，審視性別偏見並提供女生更多數學成功經驗；（三）優化線上線下混合教學設計，善用數位工具個人化功能支持學生自主學習，建立有效線上互動機制；（四）馬來西亞數學教育政策革新建議，於課程標準中強調高階數學思維培養，改革評量制度提升推理能力比重，加強教師專業發展；（五）建構彈性教育體系與促進數位學習公平，制定完善遠距教學指導方針，縮小不同社經背景學生數位學習資源差距。
abstract_en: This study explores the mechanisms of mathematics learning performance among Malaysian students during the COVID-19 pandemic. The research focuses on how two types of mathematical self-efficacy (basic computational application ability and higher-order thinking skills) influence student mathematics achievement through mediating variables. The primary mediating variables include students' active learning behaviors and teachers' instructional strategies in developing reasoning abilities and mathematical thinking. Using student gender and school closure duration as control variables, this study analyzes the mediation pathways through which different types of mathematical self-efficacy affect mathematics achievement via active learning behaviors and teaching methods, aiming to develop a deeper understanding of the operational mechanisms and key influencing factors of mathematics learning during the pandemic.This study employed a secondary data analysis approach, using data from the PISA 2022 database published on the official PISA website. Malaysian student data were selected from this database as the research sample, totaling 7,069 students, comprising 3,477 male students (49.2%) and 3,592 female students (50.8%), representing a relatively balanced gender distribution. Based on school closure duration during the pandemic, the sample students were categorized into three groups: short-term closure group (less than 3 months) accounting for 17.7%, medium-term closure group (1-6 months) representing 40%, and long-term closure group (more than 6 months) comprising 42.3%, indicating that the majority of students experienced medium to long-term school closures. This study will employ Process Model 4 for statistical analysis to examine the mediation effects among variables.The research findings are as follows: (1) Active learning behaviors play a crucial mediating role between mathematical self-efficacy and mathematical achievement, but their effect patterns differ significantly by self-efficacy type; (2) Mathematical higher-order thinking skills primarily influence mathematical achievement through indirect effects, mainly relying on stimulating students' active learning behaviors to promote learning outcomes; (3) Basic computational application ability primarily operates through direct effects; (4) The mediating effects of teaching methods exhibit distinct conditional characteristics, with teacher cultivation of reasoning abilities being effective in both self-efficacy models, while teacher cultivation of mathematical thinking is significant only in the higher-order thinking skills model, reflecting the importance of matching teaching methods with students' cognitive developmental levels; (5) Two special phenomena emerged in the COVID-19 pandemic context: female students demonstrated superior performance in mathematical achievement, and extended school closure duration had positive effects on students' mathematical achievement.The research recommendations are as follows: (1) Develop instructional strategies for cultivating mathematical higher-order thinking self-efficacy by providing appropriately challenging problems that allow students to experience successful mathematical reasoning experiences and strengthening the cultivation of active learning behaviors; (2) Implement differentiated instruction and gender-equitable mathematical education practices by adopting matched instructional strategies for students with different self-efficacy characteristics, examining gender bias, and providing female students with more mathematical success experiences; (3) Optimize online-offline blended learning design by leveraging the personalized functions of digital tools to support student autonomous learning and establishing effective online interaction mechanisms; (4) Propose Malaysian mathematics education policy reform recommendations by emphasizing higher-order mathematical thinking cultivation in curriculum standards, reforming assessment systems to increase the proportion of reasoning abilities, and strengthening teacher professional development; (5) Construct flexible educational systems and promote digital learning equity by developing comprehensive distance learning guidelines and reducing digital learning resource gaps among students from different socioeconomic backgrounds.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 技術型高中學生整體滿意度影響因素之探究
title_en: The Exploration of Factors Influencing Overall Satisfaction of Technical High School Students
keywords: 技術型高中、整體滿意度、後期中等資料庫、次級資料分析
abstract_zh: 摘要本研究旨在探討技術型高級中等學校學生（簡稱技職生）之整體滿意度，並分析其受學生背景、群科學習構面及學校構面因素之影響。研究樣本為110學年度全國技職高三學生，使用教育部後期中等教育資料庫問卷資料進行次級資料分析，透過t檢定與階層迴歸等統計方法，進一步探討各構面變項對學生整體滿意度之解釋力與預測力。研究結果發現，在背景變項中，公私立別對學校生活快樂程度、課業學習興趣與滿意度，以及整體滿意度皆具有顯著差異，整體上以公立學校學生表現較佳；在群科構面中，自主學習與整體滿意度呈現顯著正向關聯；學校構面中，學校歸屬感與自我效能為預測整體滿意度的重要變項，其中學校歸屬感的解釋力尤為顯著。 整體而言，各構面變項均對學生整體滿意度具有一定程度之影響。具體研究結論如下所示。 一、技職學生整體滿意度具備多層次影響來源，提升學生滿意度之關鍵在於整合專業 課程學習、學校文化與觀感與學生心理發展三者的系統性設計。 二、背景變項中各變項對整體滿意度皆有顯著影響，女性學生、公立技職學校學生、 其他類學生與專業抽象性低的學生對整體滿意度與各變項顯著較高。 三、群科構面中，「專業課程學習成果」對整體滿意度影響最為顯著，是影響技職學 生整體滿意度之最重要因素。 四、學校構面中，「自我效能」與「學校歸屬感」對整體滿意度影響顯著，並且學校 歸屬感為學校構面中最關鍵的影響因素。 五、整體迴歸模型顯示「學校構面」變項的預測力高於其他構面，因此群科構面與學 校構面具交互影響，且學校構面因素具更高解釋力。六、輔以質性訪談分析得出，學科導向與升學壓力係影響學生整體滿意度的核心、實 作經驗有助於建立信心與補償學科挫敗感以及學校制度與管理風格對歸屬感與滿 意度產生強烈影響。本研究不僅提供108課綱實施後技職學生學習感受的實證分析，也對技職教育經營策略、課程設計與學生支持系統建構提出具體建議。關鍵字：技術型高中、整體滿意度、後期中等資料庫、次級資料分析
abstract_en: AbstractThis study aims to explore the overall satisfaction of students in technical senior secondary schools (hereafter referred to as Technical High School Students) and analyze the influence of personal background, program-level learning aspects, and school-level factors. The research sample comprises third-year Technical High School Students across Taiwan in the 2021 academic year. Secondary data analysis was conducted using questionnaire data from the Ministry of Education’s Post-Secondary Education Database. Statistical methods such as t-tests and hierarchical regression were employed to further examine the explanatory and predictive power of variables at each level on students’ overall satisfaction.The results revealed that, among background variables, school type (public vs. private) significantly affected students’ happiness in school life, interest and satisfaction in academic learning, and overall satisfaction, with students in public schools generally performing better. At the program level, autonomous learning showed a significant positive correlation with overall satisfaction. At the school level, school belonging and self-efficacy were important predictors of overall satisfaction, with school belonging demonstrating particularly strong explanatory power. Overall, variables at each level had a certain degree of influence on students’ overall satisfaction.The specific conclusions of this study are as follows:1. The overall satisfaction of vocational high school students is shaped by multiple levels of influence. The key to improving student satisfaction lies in the systematic integration of professional course learning, school culture and perceptions, and students’ psychological development.2.All background variables significantly affected overall satisfaction. Female students, students in public technical high schools, students in “other” program categories, and those in programs with low levels of abstract content reported higher levels of overall satisfaction and its sub-dimensions.3.At the program level, “learning outcomes of professional courses” had the most significant impact on overall satisfaction, making it the most critical factor for Technical High School Students’ satisfaction.4.At the school level, “self-efficacy” and “school belonging” significantly influenced overall satisfaction, with school belonging being the most critical school-level factor.iii5.The overall regression model showed that school-level variables had stronger predictive power than other levels. Program-level and school-level factors had interactive effects, with school-level factors having greater explanatory strength.6.Supplementary qualitative interview analysis revealed that academic orientation and pressure to advance to higher education were core influences on students’ overall satisfaction; practical experiences helped build confidence and compensate for academic frustration; and school systems and management styles strongly influenced students’ sense of belonging and satisfaction.This study not only provides an empirical analysis of Technical High School Students’ learning experiences after the implementation of the 2019 Curriculum Guidelines, but also offers concrete suggestions for vocational education management strategies, curriculum design, and the development of student support systems.Keywords: Technical High School, Overall Satisfaction, Post-Secondary Education Database, Secondary Data Analysis

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 國小高年級學生社團參與態度、正向情緒與學習成效之研究
title_en: A Study on Activities Participation Attitude, Positive Emotions, and Learning Outcomes in Senior Elementary School Students
keywords: 社團參與態度、正向情緒、學習成效
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在探討國小高年級學生之社團參與態度、正向情緒與學習成效三者間之關聯性，並分析不同背景變項對各構面之差異。本研究採用經前人編製且具良好信效度之「社團參與態度量表」、「正向情緒量表」與「學習成效量表」為研究工具，以彰化縣田中區公立國小五、六年級學生為研究對象，採分層隨機抽樣方式，回收有效問卷共計300份。資料分析方法包括描述性統計、獨立樣本t檢定、單因子變異數分析及皮爾森積差相關分析。研究結果如下：一、學生在社團參與態度、正向情緒與學習成效三變項上皆達中高程度，整體表現出正向參與傾向。二、在社團參與態度構面中，「社團認知」與「社團行動」得分最高，「社團情感」最低，顯示學生認知明確、行動積極，情感投入仍待提升。三、根據量表結果，「愉悅」與「心流」構面得分皆為 4.26，顯示學生在社團活動中普遍經驗快樂與滿足情緒，且具專注投入表現。四、社團參與態度、正向情緒與學習成效三者間皆呈顯著正相關。五、性別在正向情緒構面上存在顯著差異，男生在情緒感受上高於女生。六、統計結果顯示，社團類型在「心流」與「整體正向情緒」構面上具顯著影響，其中體育性社團學生在此兩構面表現顯著優於其他類社團；惟在「愉悅」構面上差異未達顯著水準。七、學生每週參與社團活動以 4 至 6 節為佳，能帶來最強的情感投入；過度參與則可能導致疲乏，降低參與熱情。八、是否自願參與社團與對目前社團的喜好程度，對社團參與態度與正向情緒皆具顯著差異。九、研究結果顯示，提升學生的社團參與態度與正向情緒，有助於其在認知理解、技能精進與生涯探索等學習成效上的整體表現。例如，社團參與態度中的「社團認知」與「社團行動」構面，與學習成效各構面皆呈現高度正相關；正向情緒中的「愉悅」與「心流」也與學習表現顯著相關，顯示積極參與與正向體驗對學習具有促進作用。本研究建議學校應強化學生社團參與的自主選擇權，設計具多元性與彈性的課程，激發參與動機與情感投入，提升正向情緒與學習成效。同時，教學歷程應整合「認知—行動—情緒—學習成效」四構面，並依學生年級、參與經驗與興趣差異，調整課程內容與挑戰任務，以促進學生持續參與、自我探索與整體發展。
abstract_en: This study aimed to explore the relationships among activities participation attitudes, positive emotions, and learning outcomes among senior elementary school students. It also examined the differences in these variables based on various background factors.Standardized instruments with established reliability and validity were adopted, including the "Activities Participation Attitude Scale," the "Positive Emotion Scale," and the "Learning Outcome Scale." The participants consisted of 300 valid responses from fifth- and sixth-grade students in public elementary schools in Tianzhong District, Changhua County, Taiwan, selected through stratified random sampling. Data were analyzed using descriptive statistics, independent samples t-tests, one-way analysis of variance (ANOVA), and Pearson’s product-moment correlation analysis.The main findings were as follows:1.Students achieved upper-moderate levels in club participation attitudes, positive emotions, and learning outcomes, demonstrating an overall positive tendency toward participation.2.Among the dimensions of participation attitudes, "Cognitive Understanding" and "Behavioral Engagement" scored the highest, while "Emotional Involvement" was the lowest, indicating clear recognition and active involvement, but relatively lower emotional investment.3.Based on the scale results, both "Pleasure" and "Flow" scored 4.26, suggesting that students generally experienced joy, satisfaction, and focused engagement during club activities.4.Significant positive correlations were found among activities participation attitudes, positive emotions, and learning outcomes.5.Gender differences were significant in the domain of positive emotions, with boys showing higher emotional responses than girls.6.Statistical results indicated that club type had a significant effect on the "Flow" and "Overall Positive Emotion" dimensions, with students in sports-related clubs performing significantly better than those in other types; however, no significant difference was found in the "Pleasure" dimension.7.The optimal emotional engagement occurs when students participate in club activities for 4 to 6 sessions per week; excessive participation may lead to fatigue and reduced enthusiasm.8.Whether students joined clubs voluntarily and whether they liked their current clubs significantly affected their attitudes and emotional responses.9.The findings suggest that enhancing students’ activities participation attitudes and their positive emotions can effectively promote learning outcomes in areas such as cognitive understanding, skill development, and career exploration. For example, the “Cognitive” and “Behavioral” dimensions of activities participation attitudes were highly correlated with all dimensions of learning outcomes, while “Pleasure” and “Flow” in positive emotions also showed significant relationships with learning outcomes.This study recommends enhancing students’ autonomy in club selection and designing diverse, flexible curricula to boost motivation, emotional engagement, and learning outcomes. The instructional process should integrate cognition, action, emotion, and learning effectiveness, while adapting content and tasks to students’ grade level, experience, and interests to foster continuous participation, self-exploration, and holistic development.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 技術型高中設計群學生自我效能、社會支持與電腦向量繪圖學習成效之研究
title_en: A Study on Self-Efficacy, Social Support, and Learning Outcomes in Computer Vector Graphics Practice among Technical High School Design Cluster Students
keywords: 技術型高中設計群學生、自我效能、社會支持、電腦向量繪圖、學習成效
abstract_zh: 隨著數位設計與科技應用的普及，電腦繪圖已成為技術型高中設計群學生不可或缺的核心能力，除影響其學習表現外，也關係到未來升學與職涯競爭力。有鑑於此，本研究旨在探討學生在電腦向量繪圖學習中，自我效能與社會支持對學習成效之影響與關聯。本研究以中部某技術型高中廣告設計科二年級67名學生為對象，採全面調查方式進行資料蒐集。研究工具包含基本資料調查表、自我效能與社會支持量表，以及學習成效指標（學期成績與作品集成績，各占50%），透過問卷與實作評量進行資料收集。所得資料經描述性統計、t 檢定、單因子變異數分析、皮爾森相關及逐步多元迴歸分析後，研究結果顯示：學生在自我效能整體表現上屬中上程度，其中以「能力取向」構面得分最高，而「學習方法」構面相對較低，反映學生在策略運用方面尚有精進空間；在社會支持部分，「老師支持」的感受程度最高，顯示教師於課程中扮演重要支持角色。進一步分析發現，自我效能與學習成效之間具有顯著正相關，而社會支持與學習成效之間則未達顯著水準。此外，自我效能中的「學習方法」構面對學習成效三項指標（總成績、作品集、學期成績）皆具顯著預測力，為最具影響力之變項。整體而言，提升學生在課堂中的策略性學習能力，有助於強化其電腦向量繪圖表現；而教師所提供的支持亦為學習過程中的關鍵推動力。基於上述實證結果，本研究提出教學實務與後續研究之建議，作為往後技術型高中設計群課程規劃與學習支持策略之參考。
abstract_en: As digital design and technological applications become increasingly prevalent, computer graphics has emerged as an essential competency for students in technical high school design programs. It not only affects their academic performance but also plays a vital role in shaping their future educational opportunities and career competitiveness. In response, this study explores the influence and relationship of self-efficacy and social support on students’ learning outcomes in vector-based computer graphics courses.Participants were 67 second-year students from the Advertising Design Department of a technical high school in central Taiwan. Data were collected through a census survey using a demographic questionnaire, self-efficacy and social support scales, and learning outcome indicators (semester grades and portfolio scores, each weighted at 50%). Analysis methods included descriptive statistics, t-tests, one-way ANOVA, Pearson correlation, and stepwise multiple regression. Results showed students had moderately high self-efficacy, with the highest scores in "ability orientation" and the lowest in "learning strategies," indicating room for improvement in strategy use. Teacher support was rated highest among social support sources, highlighting the teacher's critical role in the classroom.Further analysis revealed a significant positive correlation between self-efficacy and learning outcomes, while social support showed no significant correlation. Among all variables, the "learning strategies" dimension of self-efficacy was the strongest predictor of all three performance indicators. Overall, enhancing students’ strategic learning abilities and reinforcing teacher support can improve their computer graphics performance. The study offers recommendations for teaching practice and future research to support curriculum and learning strategies in technical high school design education.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 國民小學教育人員生命教育評鑑指標認同度之研究
title_en: A Study on the Recognition of Life Education Evaluation Indicators in Elementary School Educators
keywords: 國民小學、教育人員、生命教育、生命教育評鑑指標、認同度
abstract_zh: 摘要    目前國內國小生命教育評鑑指標付之闕如，亟需建構之。本研究旨在建構國小生命教育評鑑指標並瞭解教育人員對其認同度之差異、相關及影響關係模式。冀望研究結果提供主管教育行政機關與縣市學校推動與實施生命教育實務工作參考。研究目的如下：（一）建構國小生命教育評鑑指標。（二）瞭解國小教育人員對生命教育評鑑指標之認同度。（三）探討不同背景國小教育人員對生命教育評鑑指標認同度之差異。（四）分析國小教育人員生命教育評鑑指標認同度之相關情形。（五）分析國小教育人員生命教育評鑑指標項目之影響關係模式。    為達到上述目的，本研究針對全國113學年度公立國小教育人員進行問卷施測，以自編之「國民小學生命教育評鑑指標調查問卷」進行資料蒐集。本研究發放問卷490份，有效問卷回收460份，回收率93.9%。本研究將蒐集的資料進行描述性統計、獨立樣本t檢定、單因子變異數分析、相關分析、結構方程模式分析驗證。本研究結論如下：  一、建構國小教育人員生命教育評鑑指標，包含「支持環境」、「創新發展」、「合作分享」、「績效特色」4個評鑑項目，16個評鑑細項，83個項目指標。  二、國小教育人員對整體生命教育評鑑指標具有高度認同；認同度最高之評鑑項目為「合作分享」，其次為「支持環境」，接著為「創新發展」，最低為「績效特色」。  三、不同背景變項國小教育人員對生命教育評鑑指標認同度之差異，在不同「性別」及「教育程度」項目獲得大部份支持；在不同「擔任職務」項目獲得部份支持；在不同「學校規模」項目僅獲得少部分支持。  四、國小教育人員對生命教育評鑑指標「支持環境」、「創新發展」、「合作分享」與「績效特色」認同度，項目間彼此具有顯著高度正相關；項目與細項及各細項間之相關為中度至高度正相關。  五、國小教育人員生命教育評鑑指標認同度具顯著直接影響關係。「支持環境」對「創新發展」具有影響力；「創新發展」對「合作分享」具有影響力；「合作分享」對「績效特色」具有影響力；「績效特色」對「支持環境」具有影響力；「績效特色」對「創新發展」具有影響力。且「績效特色、支持環境與創新發展」間有部分中介效果。    最後，根據研究結果發展出生命教育評鑑指標，提出生命教育評鑑推動之作法。分別針對中央及地方教育主管機關、學校及未來研究提出具體建議，以作為後續生命教育推動及研究之參考。關鍵詞：國民小學、教育人員、生命教育、生命教育評鑑指標、認同度
abstract_en: ABSTRACT  At present, there is a lack of evaluation indicators for life education in elementary schools in China, and it is urgent to construct them. This study aims to construct evaluation indicators for life education in elementary schools and understand the differences, correlations and influence relationship patterns among educators in their recognition. It is hoped that the research results will provide reference for the competent education administrative authorities and county and city schools to promote and implement life education. The research objectives are as follows: 1. Construct evaluation indicators for life education in elementary schools. 2. Understand the recognition of life education evaluation indicators by elementary school educators. 3. Explore the differences in recognition of life education evaluation indicators among elementary school educators from different backgrounds. 4. Analyze the relevant circumstances of recognition of life education evaluation indicators by elementary school educators. 5. Analyze the influence relationship pattern of life education evaluation indicator items for elementary school educators.  To achieve the above objectives, this study conducted a questionnaire survey on elementary school educators in the 113th academic year in public elementary schools across the country, and collected data using the self-compiled "National Elementary School Life Education Evaluation Indicator Survey Questionnaire". This study distributed 490 questionnaires, and 460 valid questionnaires were collected, with a collection rate of 93.9%. This study will conduct descriptive statistics, independent sample t test, one-way variance analysis, correlation analysis, and structural equation model analysis to verify the collected data. The conclusions of this study are as follows:1. Constructing the evaluation indicators of life education for elementary school educators, including 4 evaluation items, "supportive environment", "innovative development", "cooperative sharing", and "performance characteristics", 16 evaluation items, and 83 item indicators.2. Elementary school educators have a high degree of recognition of the overall life education evaluation indicators; the evaluation item with the highest recognition is "cooperative sharing", followed by "supportive environment", then "innovative development", and the lowest is "performance characteristics".3. The differences in the recognition of life education evaluation indicators by elementary school educators with different background variables are mostly supported in different "gender" and "education level" items; partially supported in different "positions" items; and only a small number of supported in different "school size" items.4. The recognition of the life education evaluation indicators "supportive environment", "innovative development", "cooperative sharing" and "performance characteristics" by elementary school educators shows a significant and highly positive correlation between each other; the correlation between the items and the details and between the details is moderate to highly positively correlated.5. The recognition of life education evaluation indicators by elementary school educators has a significant direct influence relationship. "Supportive environment" has an influence on "innovative development"; "innovative development" has an influence on "cooperative sharing"; "cooperative sharing" has an influence on "performance characteristics"; "performance characteristics" has an influence on "supportive environment"; "performance characteristics" has an influence on "innovative development". There is also a partial mediating effect between "performance characteristics, supportive environment and innovative development".  Finally, based on the research results, life education evaluation indicators are developed and methods for promoting life education evaluation are proposed. Specific suggestions are made for central and local education authorities, schools and future research as a reference for subsequent promotion and research of life education.Keywords: elementary school, educators, life education, life education evaluation indicators, recognition

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 職業訓練課程對學員職業心理認知與職業能力提升之研究-以台灣液晶顯示器維修聯合協會為例
title_en: A Study on the Effects of Vocational Training Programs on Trainees’ Occupational Psychological Cognition and Professional Skill Development: A Case Study of the Taiwan LCD Maintenance Association
keywords: 職業訓練課程、職業心理認知、職業能力層次、液晶顯示器維修
abstract_zh: 研究採質性研究方法，透過三位具代表性且符合條件之學員進行半結構式深度訪談，並輔以課程紀錄與實作成果進行三角驗證，旨在探討職業訓練課程對學員職業心理認知與職業能力提升之影響。研究對象為參與液晶顯示器維修協會訓練課程逾六個月且出席率達80%以上之學員，以確保具備穩定且完整之學習經驗。研究聚焦於職業心理認知四構面（價值觀、性格、自我效能與興趣）與職業能力三層次（反應、學習與行為），並進一步分析背景變項（如年齡與職業經驗）所可能造成之影響。    研究結果顯示，職訓課程有助於提升學員對職涯目標之清晰度、正向職業態度與自我效能，並促進其對職業興趣之探索與投入。在能力層面，學員普遍展現高度參與度與良好學習成效，並於實務情境中展現積極行為，如問題解決、溝通協作與技術應用等核心能力。另發現，不同年齡與經驗背景對學習動機與行為展現具有差異性：資深學員傾向務實應用，新手學員則展現彈性與探索動能。    綜合研究發現，建議職訓機構依學員特性規劃差異化學習策略，強化心理認知養成與實務能力整合，並建立持續性支持系統（如實習安排與職涯輔導），以提升整體訓練效益。本研究可作為技職教育課程優化與訓練政策制定之參考依據。
abstract_en: This study adopted a qualitative research approach to explore the impact of vocational training programs on trainees’ occupational psychological cognition and the enhancement of their professional competencies. Three representative and eligible trainees were selected for semi-structured in-depth interviews, supplemented by course records and practical work outcomes for triangulation to strengthen the validity of the findings. The participants were individuals who had attended the LCD Maintenance Association’s training program for over six months with an attendance rate exceeding 80%, ensuring stable and complete learning experiences. The research focused on four dimensions of occupational psychological cognition—values, personality traits, self-efficacy, and interest—as well as three levels of professional competence: reaction, learning, and behavior. The study also analyzed the potential influence of background variables such as age and work experience.  The findings indicate that vocational training programs significantly enhance trainees’ clarity of career goals, foster positive occupational attitudes and self-efficacy, and promote exploration and engagement with occupational interests. In terms of competence development, participants generally demonstrated high levels of course participation, solid learning outcomes, and practical application of core competencies such as problem-solving, communication, and technical skills in real-world contexts. Moreover, differences in learning motivation and behavioral performance were observed based on age and prior experience: experienced trainees tended to exhibit pragmatic application of skills, while novices displayed greater learning flexibility and exploratory motivation.  Based on the findings, it is recommended that vocational training institutions develop differentiated learning strategies tailored to trainee characteristics, strengthen the integration of psychological cognition and practical skills, and establish continuous support systems such as internship placements and career counseling. This study offers valuable reference for optimizing technical and vocational education programs and informing the development of relevant training policies.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 組織支持對護理師倫理規範實踐與病人安全行為影響之研究-以南部某醫院為例
title_en: A Study on the Influence of Organizational Support on Nurses' Ethical Practice and Patient Safety Behaviors: A Case Study of a Hospital in Southern Taiwan
keywords: 組織支持、倫理規範實踐、病人安全行為
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在探討組織支持對護理師倫理規範實踐與病人安全行為之影響，並進一步分析不同背景變項在三者之間所產生之差異與關聯性。研究以南部某醫院之護理師為對象，涵蓋急診室、一般病房、加護病房及護理之家等單位，排除任職未滿六個月及大夜班人員，以確保樣本具備穩定的臨床經驗與對工作環境之熟悉度。問卷調查共回收223份有效樣本，並透過描述性統計、單因子變異數分析及結構方程模式（SEM）進行資料分析與模型驗證。    研究結果顯示，組織支持（標準化路徑係數β＝0.231）與倫理規範實踐（β＝0.233）皆對病人安全行為具顯著正向預測力，且模型整體適配度佳（χ²/df＝1.154、RMSEA＝0.026、Durbin–Watson＝1.760）。此結果驗證，當護理人員感受到良好的組織支持並落實倫理規範時，更能展現正向的病人安全行為。    本研究填補了南部地區臨床護理師相關實證研究之缺口，並針對臨床實務與醫院管理提出三點建議：一、整合情境模擬課程以強化倫理教育與病人安全訓練；二、建構公平透明且具彈性之組織支持系統；三、建立跨部門溝通與回饋機制，以深化病人安全文化。期盼本研究成果能作為醫療機構制定相關政策與訓練計畫之重要依據，進而提升整體醫療照護品質與病人安全。
abstract_en: This study aims to explore the influence of organizational support on nurses’ ethical practice and patient safety behaviors, while further analyzing the differences and correlations among these variables across diverse background characteristics. The research targeted nurses from a hospital in southern Taiwan, including staff from the emergency department, general ward, intensive care unit, and nursing home. To ensure participants had stable clinical experience and familiarity with their work environment, those with less than six months of tenure and night-shift staff were excluded. A total of 223 valid responses were collected via a structured questionnaire. Data were analyzed using descriptive statistics, one-way ANOVA, and structural equation modeling (SEM).  The results revealed that both organizational support (standardized path coefficient β = 0.231) and ethical practice (β = 0.233) had significant positive predictive effects on patient safety behaviors. The overall model fit was acceptable (χ²/df = 1.154, RMSEA = 0.026, Durbin–Watson = 1.760), indicating that when nurses perceive strong organizational support and uphold ethical standards, they are more likely to demonstrate positive patient safety behaviors.  This study helps bridge the empirical research gap on clinical nurses in southern Taiwan and offers three key recommendations for clinical practice and hospital administration: (1) integrate scenario-based simulations to enhance ethics education and patient safety training; (2) establish a fair, transparent, and flexible organizational support system; and (3) implement cross-departmental communication and feedback mechanisms to strengthen the culture of patient safety. It is hoped that the findings will serve as a valuable reference for healthcare institutions in developing relevant policies and training programs, ultimately enhancing overall care quality and patient safety.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 國中資源班社會技巧課程融入成長心態教案之影響研究
title_en: A Study of social skill Curriculum on Junior High School Resource-Classed students’ Growth Mindset Development
keywords: 資源班、社會技巧、成長心態
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在探討將成長心態融入國中資源班社會技巧課程中，對學生培養成長心態、情緒覺察、社交能力之影響。研究採用質性研究中的行動研究（Action Research）方法，並輔以半結構式訪談法以及課堂學習單的方式，以深入了解學生的學習歷程、教學面臨的挑戰及教學調整歷程。研究者運用三角驗證法（Triangulation）提升結果的可靠性與有效性。結果顯示，透過成長心態教學方案的融入，學生在心理健康、面對壓力與衝突、心態的改變及情緒覺察等皆有顯著改變。同時，教師透過持續的教學反思與適時調整教學策略，有助於提升學生課程參與度與互動。本研究提供了多元的社會技巧課程實踐經驗，並建議教育者在教學設計中融入成長心態的核心理念，以強化國中資源班學生的社交能力與情緒韌性，促進其整體心理適應與正向發展。
abstract_en: This study aims to explore the impact of integrating a growth mindset into a social skills curriculum for junior high school resource room students, focusing on the development of their growth mindset, emotional awareness, and social competence. The research adopts a qualitative approach through action research, supplemented by semi-structured interviews and classroom worksheets to gain an in-depth understanding of students’ learning processes, the challenges faced during instruction, and the progression of instructional adjustments. To enhance the reliability and validity of the findings, the researcher employed triangulation for data verification.The results indicate that the integration of a growth mindset teaching program led to significant improvements in students’ mental well-being, their responses to stress and conflict, mindset transformation, and emotional awareness. Moreover, teachers’ continuous instructional reflection and timely strategy adjustments contributed to increased student engagement and interaction in the classroom.This study offers diverse practical experiences in implementing social skills curricula and recommends that educators incorporate core concepts of growth mindset into instructional design. Doing so may enhance the social abilities and emotional resilience of junior high school resource room students, thereby promoting their overall psychological adaptation and positive development.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 企業界新晉主管領導職能的建構歷程
title_en: A Study on Leadership Development Processes for New Supervisors in the Corporate World
keywords: 新晉主管、領導職能、角色轉換、領導權威、質性研究
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在深入探討製造業中新晉升主管在領導職能建構過程中所面臨的挑戰與適應策略。研究採用質性方法，透過深度訪談三位晉升未滿六個月的製造業主管進行。研究發現，這些主管的晉升多為被動性，導致其心理與技能準備不足，面臨巨大的角色轉換壓力，這包括心理調適、責任增加及與前同事關係的變化。領導職能的核心在於人際溝通與角色適應，新晉主管需建立領導權威、有效管理團隊並協調跨部門事務。他們透過積極溝通與展現專業能力來建立領導地位。研究強調組織支持系統（如上級指導、同儕協助、培訓）對降低新主管焦慮和提升適應能力具有關鍵效果。前同事對新主管的期望（如清晰領導方向、果斷決策、溝通公平性）也對其角色適應與職能提升產生重要影響。新主管應對壓力與自我懷疑的方法包括設定優先順序、尋求協助與持續學習。研究建議企業應提供完善的晉升制度、明確職責與持續培訓，同時新晉主管需展現積極調整的意願與能力，學習新管理技能並調整互動方式，以順利完成角色轉換並提升績效。研究限制包括樣本量小、研究對象限於製造業與男性主管，可能影響結果普遍性。總體而言，本研究強調了組織支持與個人主動適應對新晉主管發展的重要性。關鍵字：新晉主管、領導職能、角色轉換、領導權威、質性研究
abstract_en: This study aims to explore the challenges and adaptation strategies of newly promoted supervisors in the manufacturing industry during the development of their leadership competencies. Employing a qualitative research method, in-depth interviews were conducted with three supervisors who had been promoted for less than six months in manufacturing contexts.The findings reveal that promotions were largely passive, resulting in insufficient psychological and skill preparation and significant role-transition stress, which included psychological adjustments, increased responsibilities, and altered relationships with former colleagues. At the core of leadership competencies are interpersonal communication and role adaptation. Newly promoted supervisors must establish leadership authority, manage teams effectively, and coordinate cross-departmental affairs. They establish their leadership positions through proactive communication and demonstration of professional competencies.The study highlights that organizational support systems, such as guidance from superiors, peer assistance, and targeted training programs, play a critical role in reducing anxiety and enhancing adaptability among new supervisors. Additionally, the expectations of former colleagues, such as clear leadership direction, decisive decision-making, and fairness in communication, significantly influence their role adaptation and the improvement of leadership competencies. Methods adopted by new supervisors to cope with stress and self-doubt include prioritizing tasks, seeking assistance, and continuous learning.The research recommends that organizations provide comprehensive promotion systems, clear job responsibilities, and ongoing training. Concurrently, newly promoted supervisors need to exhibit a willingness and capability for active adaptation, learning new managerial skills, and adjusting their interaction approaches to successfully complete role transitions and improve performance. The limitations of the study include a small sample size and the focus exclusively on male supervisors within the manufacturing industry, potentially affecting the generalizability of the findings. Overall, this study emphasizes the importance of organizational support and individual proactive adaptation for the development of newly promoted supervisors.Keywords: newly promoted supervisors, leadership competencies, role transition, leadership authority, qualitative research

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 從企業領域生產線中階主管職能培育之需求研究 以S公司為例
title_en: A study on the leadership development training demands for middle level managers A Case Study of S Company
keywords: 製造業、營運需求、管理能力、中階主管、訓練需求、三角驗證
abstract_zh: 隨著時代進步，在21世紀生產技術不斷創新之下，許多企業積極發展並培訓人才，唯有不斷培訓人才，企業才能保持在生產技術的前端。現今，多數企業十分重視訓練與發展的重要性，但在組織中，對多數員工能力發展的方式及內容缺乏完整的架構與歸納。在企業組織中，中階主管是核心策略價值的傳遞者，扮演舉足輕重的角色，能否達成組織所賦予的目標是影響組織成敗的關鍵因素。生產部門的中階主管在組織中就像一個齒輪，充當基層與高階主管間的溝通橋樑。中階主管的能力培養，將使工作績效更加符合組織的期待與需求。本研究根據研究目的，針對個案公司在營運需求上對即將升任或在職中階主管應具備的管理能力與技術能力進行探討，找出所需能力的訓練需求，為人資部門提供培訓中階主管管理能力的參考指標。本研究將透過文獻探討了解中階主管在企業管理中的核心職能，包括概念能力、人際溝通能力及技術能力，並以問卷調查與訪談方式，針對高階主管、中階主管及基層主管進行資料收集。問卷與訪談的內容分別聚焦於四個面向：專業能力、管理能力、溝通能力與創新能力，共包含20道問卷題目與5道訪談題目。根據問卷結果，以加權分數計算各題項的分數後再以描述統計分析方式統計出平均值找出前三大項能力需求，並通過三角驗證法將問卷與訪談內容交叉比對，以提高研究的可信度。透過本研究，期望能幫助個案公司找出針對中階主管能力提升的訓練需求，並進一步了解高階主管及基層主管對於中階主管應具備能力的訓練需求，以及中階主管對自身能力提升的需求。
abstract_en: With the progress of the times and the continuous innovation of production technology in the 21st century, many companies are actively developing and training talents. Only by continuously training talents can companies stay at the forefront of production technology. Nowadays, most companies attach great importance to the importance of training and development. However, in the organization, there is a lack of complete structure and summary of the methods and content of the ability development of most employees.In corporate organizations, middle-level managers are the transmitters of core strategic values and play a pivotal role. Whether they can achieve the goals assigned by the organization is a key factor affecting the success or failure of the organization. The middle-level supervisor in the production department is like a cog in the organization, serving as a communication bridge between junior and senior managers. The ability development of mid-level supervisors will make work performance more in line with the expectations and needs of the organization.According to the purpose of the research, this study discusses the management and technical abilities that mid-level supervisors who are about to be promoted or are currently employed in the operational needs of the case company, find out the training needs for the required abilities, and provide training for middle-level supervisor management for the human resources department. Reference indicators of ability.This study will explore the core functions of middle-level supervisors in business management through literature research, including conceptual abilities, interpersonal communication skills, and technical abilities. It will also conduct questionnaire surveys and interviews on senior supervisors, middle-level supervisors, and lower-level supervisors. Data collection. The content of the questionnaire and interview focused on four aspects respectively: professional ability, management ability, communication ability and innovation ability. It included a total of 20 questionnaire questions and 5 interview questions. Based on the results of the questionnaire, the weighted scores were used to calculate the scores for each item, and then descriptive statistical analysis was used to calculate the average value to find out the top three ability needs. The questionnaire and interview content were cross-compared through triangulation verification method to improve the research. credibility.Through this study, we hope to help the case company identify the training needs for improving the abilities of middle-level supervisors, and further understand the training needs of senior supervisors and lower-level supervisors for the abilities that middle-level supervisors should have, as well as the training needs of middle-level supervisors for improving their own abilities. needs.Keywords: manufacturing industry, management capabilities, operational needs, mid-level supervisors, training needs

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 成功創業領導主要因素研究:從伊斯蘭文化的角度看待
title_en: A study on the major factors of successful entrepreneurial leadership: taking perspectives of Islamic culture
keywords: 領導、企業、社會資本主義、文化資本主義、伊斯蘭學科
abstract_zh: 在當今快速變化的世界中，企業家領導者在推動創新和經濟增長的同時，還需應對複雜的社會與文化問題。他們扮演著至關重要的角色。本研究旨在探討成功企業家領導者的主要特質，以及促使他們成功的重要因素。同時，本研究亦探討伊斯蘭學科與全球背景下企業家領導者經驗的契合程度。  本研究採用質性研究方法與扎根理論方法進行全面分析，結合文獻回顧、分析方法，以及對成功的臺灣領導者的訪談，以尋找符合伊斯蘭學科的共同特質。  本研究圍繞兩個主要問題展開。首先，它探討了哪些關鍵特質使個體能夠成為高效的企業家領導者。其次，它研究了伊斯蘭學科如何與這些企業家領導者在全球化時代的經驗相契合。  本研究預期的成果包括歸納成功領導者的主要特質，並將其歸類於伊斯蘭學科框架及其延伸內容。這些特質包括:敬虔——覺知與遠見、正義——決策能力、商議——團隊建設、誠信——社交網絡建立，以及耐心——適應能力。因此，本研究豐富了我們對企業家領導力在文化與社會資本主義背景下的理解。研究結果為領導力發展提供了寶貴的見解，並為企業家與領導者在其組織與社區內實現永續成長與繁榮提供指導。
abstract_en: In today's rapidly changing world, entrepreneurial leaders play a vital role in driving innovation and economic growth while handling complex social and cultural issues. This study aims to the main traits of successful entrepreneurial leaders and the important factors that help them succeed. It also explores how well Islamic disciplines align with the experiences of entrepreneurial leaders in the global context.A comprehensive analysis is conducted using a qualitative approach and Grounded Theory methodology, combining literature review, analytical methodologies, and interviews with successful Taiwanese leaders to find common traits aligned with Islamic disciplines.The research addresses two major questions within its context. First, it investigates the key characteristics that enable individuals to become effective entrepreneurial leaders successfully. Second, it explores how Islamic disciplines align with these entrepreneurial leaders' experiences in the global era.Anticipated outcomes include the delineation of major traits of successful leadership, categorized within Islamic disciplines and extending beyond, including Piousness- awareness and visionary, justice- decision making, consultation- team building, trustworthiness -networking, and patient-adaptability. Thereby enriching our understanding of entrepreneurial leadership within cultural and social capitalism. This study's findings offer valuable insights for leadership development, guiding entrepreneurs and leaders toward sustainable growth and prosperity within their organizations and communities.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 數位輔助學習對國小高年級學生參與壘球擲遠之研究
title_en: A Study on Digital-Assisted Learning for Upper-Grade Elementary School Students' Participation in Softball Throw
keywords: 數位輔助學習、核心素養、壘球擲遠
abstract_zh: 隨著科技的快速進步，數位輔助學習在教育領域的應用日益受到重視，成為提升學習成效的重要工具之一。本研究以國小高年級學生參與田徑壘球擲遠活動為對象，探討數位輔助學習對學生運動技術表現與學習態度之影響，並運用行動研究方式進行驗證。研究聚焦於五位女學生，透過質性研究方法深入了解她們在數位輔助學習環境中的學習歷程、感受及自我提升經驗。本研究在教學過程中使用數位輔助學習工具，提供投擲技巧的逐步指導、即時回饋及個人化的學習資源。研究過程中進行教學介入、觀察和訪談，全面收集資料以探討數位學習環境對學生學習成效的具體影響。透過數位技術的支持，學生能夠即時觀察並修正自己的投擲動作，逐步提升技術細節掌握，並有效促進其學習反思和技能精進。此外，數位學習工具還促進了學生間的互動與合作，使她們在訓練中建立起團隊意識和支持性關係，並激發出更強的學習動力。研究結果顯示，數位輔助學習提升了學生的壘球擲遠技術表現，同時增強了她們的學習動機和自我反思能力。學生透過觀看動作回放和數據結果，能夠明確掌握自身的優勢與不足，逐漸培養出自我檢視的學習習慣和改進動力，並且在參與過程中表現出高度的學習興趣和積極性。總體而言，本研究為國小高年級學生運用數位輔助學習參與田徑壘球擲遠活動的經驗提供了多元課程，並建議教育者在教學實踐中結合數位科技，以提升學生的學習體驗及成效。
abstract_en: With the rapid advancement of technology, the application of digital-assisted learning in the field of education has gained increasing attention and has become one of the important tool for enhancing learning effectiveness. This study explores the impact of digital-assisted learning on the athletic performance and learning attitudes of upper-grade elementary students participating in track and field and softball throwing activities, using action research to validate the findings. The study focuses on five female students, using qualitative research methods to deeply understand their learning experiences, feelings, and self-improvement through the digital-assisted learning environment.    In the teaching process, digital learning tools were used to provide step-by-step guidance on throwing techniques, real-time feedback, and personalized learning resources. The research involved teaching interventions, observations, and interviews to comprehensively collect data on the specific impact of the digital learning environment on students' learning outcomes. With the support of digital technology, students were able to observe and correct their throwing motions in real time, gradually improving their technical skills and fostering learning reflection and skill refinement. Moreover, the tools facilitated student interaction and collaboration, helping build teamwork awareness and supportive relationships, while motivating greater learning enthusiasm.    The results showed that digital-assisted learning significantly improved the students' throwing performance and enhanced their learning motivation and self-reflection ability. Students were able to clearly understand their strengths and weaknesses by viewing motion replays and data, gradually developing habits of self-assessment and improvement. Overall, this study offers valuable insights into the experience of upper-grade elementary students using digital-assisted learning in track and field softball activities, and suggests that educators integrate digital technology in teaching to enhance student learning experiences and outcomes.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 結合問題導向學習（PBL）與運算思維（CT）以提升英語學習者的寫作表現與學習動機
title_en: Integrating Problem-Based Learning (PBL) and Computational Thinking (CT) to Enhance EFL Learners' Writing Performance and Motivation
keywords: 問題導向學習、運算思維、EFL 寫作、動機、學術寫作、準實驗研究
abstract_zh: 本研究探討結合問題導向學習 (Problem-Based Learning, PBL) 和運算思維 (Computational Thinking, CT) 對英語為外語學習者 (EFL) 動機與寫作表現的影響。本研究採用準實驗混合方法設計，參與者為 58 名就讀於大學學術寫作課程的三年級學生。學生分為兩組：控制組採用傳統的 PBL 教學法，而實驗組則在 PBL 教學中融入 CT 策略，包括分解 (Decomposition)、泛化 (Generalization)、抽象化 (Abstraction)、演算法思維 (Algorithmic Thinking) 和評估 (Evaluation)。 量化研究結果顯示，實驗組學生在所有寫作階段 (寫作一、寫作二、寫作三和最終寫作) 的寫作表現均有顯著提升。與控制組相比，實驗組學生展現出更高的內在動機和外在動機。質性分析結果源自半結構式訪談，進一步支持量化發現，指出結構化問題解決方法、協作式同儕回饋，以及系統化學習策略的優勢。CT 的整合提供了清晰的框架，幫助學生有系統地應對寫作任務，減輕認知負擔並培養批判性思維。 本研究對教師、課程設計者及政策制定者具有教育啟示，倡導在 EFL 教學中整合 PBL 與 CT，以提升問題解決能力、協作能力及寫作能力等 21 世紀核心技能。未來研究可進一步探討其長期影響及在不同教育情境中的廣泛應用。
abstract_en: This study investigates the impact of integrating Problem-Based Learning (PBL) with Computational Thinking (CT) on motivation and writing performance among English as a Foreign Language (EFL) learners. A quasi-experimental mixed-method design was employed, involving 58 third-year university students enrolled in an Academic Writing course. Participants were divided into control and experimental groups: the control group followed a traditional PBL approach, while the experimental group received PBL instruction enhanced with CT strategies, including decomposition, generalization, abstraction, algorithmic thinking, and evaluation. Quantitative findings revealed significant improvements in writing performance for the experimental group across all writing stages (Writing 1, Writing 2, Writing 3, and Final Writing). Students demonstrated higher levels of intrinsic and extrinsic motivation compared to their counterparts in the control group. Qualitative analysis, derived from semi-structured interviews, further supported these results, highlighting the benefits of structured problem-solving, collaborative peer feedback, and systematic learning strategies. The integration of CT provided a clear framework for approaching writing tasks, reducing cognitive burden and fostering critical thinking. This study offers pedagogical implications for educators, curriculum designers, and policymakers, advocating for the incorporation of PBL and CT in EFL contexts to enhance 21st-century skills such as problem-solving, collaboration, and writing proficiency. Future research should explore long-term effects and broader applicability across diverse educational settings.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 以合作學習法加強高職學生閱讀理解互動教學
title_en: Strengthening Reciprocal Teaching for Students’ Reading Comprehension with Collaborative Learning Approach in Vocational Higher Education
keywords: 互惠教學、協作學習、閱讀理解技能、理工科學生、學習效果、學習動機、學習積極性
abstract_zh: 閱讀理解是學生在高等教育中取得學術成功所需的基本且最被需求的技能。然而，許多學生仍然難以應對。學生們在理解英語文本方面表現缺乏熟練度，缺乏興趣，在閱讀任務中持有負面看法，以及所接受的教學方法枯燥乏味。本研究旨在開發有效的閱讀策略，以支持候選技術員確保他們的閱讀能夠促進學習和理解。該研究考察了教學方法，將互惠教學（RT）與合作學習（CL）方法相結合，以提高英語閱讀理解課程的學習成果。採用準實驗研究設計，涉及25名對照組學生，他們單獨參與傳統的互惠教學法。而實驗組的25名學生則採用涉及同伴互動的小組合作學習方法進行互惠教學。實驗在2021-2022學年秋季學期的六週內，在印度尼西亞東部的國立職業技術學院理工學院進行。 測試成績、工作表評分標準、問卷調查和訪談被用於收集數據。結果表明，互惠教學結合合作學習方法顯著提高了學習表現、學習動機和學習積極性，優於傳統的互惠教學課堂。此外，在異質羣體中採用互惠教學與合作學習方法的同伴互動，通過同伴教學中的實踐指導，積極解決了低能力和高能力學生之間的學習差距。
abstract_en: Reading comprehension is a fundamental and the most demanded skill for students to achieve academic success in post-secondary education. However, many students still struggle with its courses. Students show unsatisfactory proficiency in comprehending English texts, lack of interest, negative views in reading tasks, and the drab teaching method students received. This research aims to develop effective reading strategies to support candidate technicians in ensuring their reading leads to learning and comprehension. This research examines the pedagogical teaching methodology, integrating reciprocal teaching (RT) with collaborative learning (CL) approach to enhance learning outcomes in English reading comprehension courses. A quasi-experimental research design was used, involving 25 students in the control group engaged in the traditional reciprocal teaching method individually. While 25 students in the experimental group received reciprocal teaching with collaborative learning approach involving peer interactions in group work. The experiment was conducted for six weeks during the fall semester of the 2021-2022 academic year at the State Polytechnic in Eastern Indonesia. Test scores, worksheet rubrics, questionnaires and interviews were used to collect data. The results indicate that reciprocal teaching combined with collaborative learning approach significantly improved learning performance, motivation, and activeness compared to traditional reciprocal teaching classroom. Furthermore, peer interactions within heterogeneous groups of reciprocal teaching with collaborative learning approach positively address learning gaps between low- and high-ability students through assistance and guidance from practice in peer teaching during group text discussions.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 臺中市教保服務人員對理想園長與現任園長認同度之研究
title_en: Ideal Expectation and Current Principals’ Recognition Among Preschool Educators in Taichung City
keywords: 臺中市、教保服務人員、理想園長、現任園長、認同度
abstract_zh: 目錄幼托整合後，幼稚園和托兒所更名為「幼兒園」，園長的類型多元，有必要探討理想幼稚園園長的內涵，作為其經營領導之參據。本研究旨在瞭解教保服務人員對理想園長與現任園長認同度與差異，探討理想與現任園長認同度的差異，以及分析兩者的相關與預測力。為達研究目的，本研究以臺中市教保服務人員為研究對象，透過自編「教保服務人員對理想園長與現任園長認同度調查問卷」對五類幼兒園（國小附設幼兒園、市（區）立幼兒園、非營利幼兒園、私立幼兒園和準公共幼兒園）的教保服務人員，進行資料搜集。回收有效問卷416份，有效問卷回收率達95%。本研究以描述性統計、t檢定、單因子變異數分析，以及迴歸分析等統計方法進行資料分析。本研究結論如下：一、教保服務人員對理想園長有「極高度」的認同度，認同度最高者為「領導風格」，依序為「組織效能」、「創新經營」。「男性」、「研究所以上學歷」、「任教年資21年以上」及「擔任園長或中、小學校長等教保服務人員」，對理想園長的認同度高於「女性」、「教育大學」、「幼保系或教育系」、「任教年資8年以下」與「9-14年」，以及「教保員」的教保服務人員。二、教保服務人員對現任園長有「中高度」的認同度，認同度以「領導風格」最高，「組織效能」最低。「男性」、「51歲以上」高於「女性」、「31-40歲」教保服務人員；「園長或中、小學校長」在「領導風格」上高於「幼教師」、「專任園主任」和「教保員」；研究所以上在「制度和規範」上高於「專科加修幼保專業知能課程」者。三、參、教保服務人員對理想園長「整體」、「各構面（領導風格、創新經營、組織效能）」、「各分構面」的認同度皆高於現任園長「整體」、「各構面」及「各分構面」的認同度。四、教保服務人員對理想園長的「整體」、「各構面」、「各分構面」認同度與現任園長的、「整體」、「各構面」、「各分構面」認同度間具有顯著「低度正相關」，形成一種影響關係模式。 五、教保服務人員對理想園長的「整體」、「各構面」、「各分構面」認同度對現任園長的「整體」、「各構面」、「各分構面」認同度間呈現顯著「正向預測力」。根據本研究結果，提出具體建議供主管教育行政機關和幼兒園，推動與落實幼兒園經營領導、創新經營及組織效能之參考。一、為提升對理想幼兒園園長的瞭解和認同程度，宜增加幼兒園園長、主任、組長和教師的交流溝通，以了解其對理想幼兒園園長概念的表達，進而提高理想幼兒園園長的實施效果。二、宜舉辦幼兒園推動理想幼兒園園長座談活動，邀請單位主管和承辦人員參與，聆聽教保服務人員的觀點，以制定更簡明、系統化的理想幼兒園園長方案，並整合評鑑類別，提升其實施效能。三、宜定期對幼兒園進行現任園長的評估，以確切了解理想幼兒園園長的執行情況，並及時進行修正，建立一個動態的回饋系統。四、宜將背景變項差異納入理想幼兒園園長檢討的項目之一，以期發揮理想幼兒園園長的效能。五、宜根據對理想幼兒園園長和現任園長之議題進行分析，發展專業研究工具，以揭示問題背後的特性。六、宜重視理想幼兒園園長三個構面間複雜的交互作用關係，以及理想幼兒園園長的實施機制。七、幼兒園園長宜加強「創新經營」知能，以提升創新經營的效能。八、幼兒園園長宜參與專業社群學習，強化幼兒園特色經營及行銷。九、幼兒園園長宜藉由參與各類專業發展社群，涵育領導素養，提升幼兒園經營效能。十、宜加強教保服務人員對理想幼兒園園長的瞭解，並適時進行工作輪調與對話，以提升其對理想幼兒園園長的認同程度。十一、針對小型幼兒園（12班以下），宜透過政策宣導、說明會等活動，提升幼保服務人員對理想幼兒園園長與現任園長的認同程度。關鍵詞：臺中市、教保服務人員、理想園長、現任園長、認同度
abstract_en: ABSTRACTThe integration of preschools and nursery schools has led to their renaming as "preschools," resulting in a diverse range of principal types. It is necessary to explore the ideal qualities of a preschool principal to serve as a reference for their leadership and management. This study aims to understand the alignment and differences between early childhood education staff's perceptions of the ideal and current principals, analyze the differences between their perceptions, and examine the correlation and predictive power between the two.To achieve the research objectives, this study targeted early childhood education staff in Taichung City, utilizing a self-developed "Survey on Early Childhood Education Staff's Recognition of Ideal and Current Preschool Principals." Data were collected from staff in five types of preschools: preschools affiliated with elementary schools, district public preschools, non-profit preschools, private preschools, and quasi-public preschools. A total of 416 valid questionnaires were returned, with a response rate of 95%. The data were analyzed using descriptive statistics, t-tests, one-way ANOVA, and regression analysis. The conclusions of the study are as follows:1.Early childhood education staff showed a "very high" level of recognition for the ideal principal, with the highest recognition for "leadership style," followed by "organizational effectiveness" and "innovative management." Male staff, those with a graduate-level education or higher, over 21 years of teaching experience, and those serving as principals or elementary/middle school principals had a higher level of recognition compared to female staff, those with an education university background, those with a degree in early childhood education or education, less than 8 years of teaching experience, 9-14 years of teaching experience, and early childhood care workers.2.The recognition of the current principal by early childhood education staff was at a "moderate to high" level, with "leadership style" receiving the highest recognition and "organizational effectiveness" the lowest. Male staff and those over 51 years old had higher recognition compared to female staff and those aged 31-40. Principals and elementary/middle school principals showed higher recognition of "leadership style" compared to early childhood teachers, full-time preschool directors, and early childhood care workers. Those with a graduate-level education or higher showed higher recognition of "systems and regulations" compared to those with a specialized course in early childhood education.3.The overall recognition and recognition of various dimensions (leadership style, innovative management, organizational effectiveness) and sub-dimensions of the ideal principal were higher than those of the current principal.4.There was a significant "low positive correlation" between the overall recognition and recognition of various dimensions and sub-dimensions of the ideal principal and the overall recognition and recognition of various dimensions and sub-dimensions of the current principal, forming an influence model.5.The overall recognition and recognition of various dimensions and sub-dimensions of the ideal principal showed a significant "positive predictive power" for the overall recognition and recognition of various dimensions and sub-dimensions of the current principal.Based on the findings, specific recommendations are made for education administration authorities and preschools to promote and implement effective leadership, innovative management, and organizational effectiveness in preschools.Key words: Taichung City, preschool educators, ideal principal, current principal, recognition.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 應用不同教學策略與SDGs議題融入國小資訊科技課程對學生5C能力之影響
title_en: The Impact of Applying Different Teaching Strategies and Integrating SDGs Topics into Elementary School Information Technology Courses on Students' 5C Abilities
keywords: 5C關鍵能力、SDGs議題、合作學習、情境式學習、問題導向式學習
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在應用合作式翻轉學習、情境式教學、PBL問題導向式學習三種不同教學策略與SDGs議題融入針對國小資訊科技課程對學生5C能力之影響探究，期望藉此幫助學生提升5C關鍵能力與SDGs議題素養能力。本研究分別依據合作式翻轉學習來增強學生的協作和自主學習能力，並應用情境式教學提供學生真實情境中的學習體驗，強調學生在面對現實問題時的主動學習過程，並依據PBL問題導向式的理論框架進行課程設計。結果顯示，透過三種不同教學策略的設計與實施，學生在問題解決過程中能夠提高5C的批判思維、創造能力、問題解決、溝通表達與團隊合作能力。這些能力的提升來自於學生應用不同教學策略，情境式的學習與面對問題時的深入探究、策略制定與實施，以及持續的反思與評估所提升的成效。因此，三種不同的教學策略不僅有助於解決具體問題，還能促進學生在多方面能力上的全面發展，使其在實際生活中更具備應對複雜挑戰的能力。
abstract_en: This study aims to explore the impact of three different teaching strategies collaborative flipped learning, situated learning, and problem-based learning combined with Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) topics on elementary school students' 5C competencies in the information technology curriculum. The goal is to help students enhance their 5C key competencies and SDGs literacy. The study employs collaborative flipped learning to strengthen students' collaboration and self-directed learning abilities, applies situated learning to provide students with real-world learning experiences, and emphasizes active learning in the face of real-world problems based on the theoretical framework of PBL for course design.The results show that through the design and implementation of these three different teaching strategies, students were able to improve their critical thinking, creativity, problem-solving, communication, and teamwork skills in the problem-solving process. These abilities were enhanced by the students' application of different teaching strategies, their engagement in situated learning, in-depth exploration when faced with problems, strategic planning and implementation, as well as continuous reflection and evaluation. Therefore, the three different teaching strategies not only help in solving specific problems but also promote the overall development of students in various aspects, equipping them with the ability to tackle complex challenges in real life.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 鐵道文化創生人員職能模式發展之研究
title_en: A Study of Occupational Competency Model Development for Regional Revitalization Staff of Railway Heritage
keywords: 鐵道文化、創生人員、職能分析、職能模式表
abstract_zh: 本研究主要在發展建構鐵道文化創生人員職能模式，作為未來鐵道文化創生人員選才、訓練、留用、激勵部屬之參考依據。鐵道文化創生人員職能模式，係利用職能分析法中之「職能訪談法」為基礎，邀請 5 位鐵道文化創生人員相關之從業人員進行初步訪談，用以產出「職能模式表」以確認本研究之成效。當初步成效建立之後，再運用「專家會議」（蝶勘法（Dacum））邀請專家會議2場共計16 人，共同探討職能模式內容，將職能基準中的主要職責及工作任務進行評估，並確認職能基準級別、工作產出及職能內涵，再予以定稿。本研究依據資料分析與問卷調查結果說明如下：壹、鐵道文化創生人員之主要職責為工作職責工責前置準備、鐵道文化職場調查、營運管理作業、鐵道文化經營行銷、工作職責完成驗收品質等，共5項職責。貳、鐵道文化創生人員之工作任務為現場勘查及需求確認、進行耆老及青年共識會議、建立職業安全與衛生環境、進行提案前置作業、進行田野及鐵道文化調查、鐵道文化場域經營定位、實施鐵道文化創生旅遊規劃作業、實施鐵道文化創生旅遊營運分析、管理財務、預算規劃、管理工作流程、管理及提升服務品質、行銷策略規劃、建立品牌與企業形象、檢測旅遊品質、成果展示、結案核銷，共17項工作任務。參、鐵道文化創生人員之工作任務為行為指標為能夠於現場勘查及需求確認、耆老及青年共識會議、能夠遵守職業安全衛生規範及作業場所安全規則，並穿戴安全防護裝備、能夠依據提案之需求，並確認旅遊之範疇，並完成提案前置作業、進行田野及鐵道文化調查、掌握場域特性，經營定位與行銷方案、能夠依據鐵道文化創生之需求，並正確完成規劃行程、能夠建立鐵道文化創生旅遊，以利進行後續品牌作業、能夠建立鐵道文化創生旅遊規劃，以利進行後續執行作業、理解營運報表，發覺異常數字或狀況，並針對差異提出解決方法、根據各項經營需求進行成本分析與收支管理、根據銷售預算，規劃業績與預算分配、根據經營計畫屋各項工作之標準作業流程，提升經營效率、管理員工執行各項工作、根據鐵道空間特性提出行銷活動推展，達成預定目標、根據營運目標與目的規劃場域品牌，建立企業形象領念、能夠正確完成旅遊品質檢驗測試、成果展、示結案核銷，共19項行為指標。肆、本研究歸納鐵道文化創生人員之工作任務共有17項，而鐵道文化創生創生人員所必須具備之專業職能內涵包括41項知識、38項技能和16項態度。
abstract_en: This study mainly develops and constructs functional benchmarks for localindustrial creation personnel, as a reference for selecting, training, retaining, andmotivating subordinates for local industrial creation personnel in the future. Thefunctional benchmark of local industrial creation personnel is based on the "functionalinterview method" in the functional analysis method. Five relevant practitioners of localindustrial creation personnel are invited to conduct preliminary interviews to produce a"functional model table" for confirmation. The results of this study. After the initialresults are established, use the "Expert Meeting" (DACUM METHOD) to invite 2expert meetings with a total of 15 people to discuss the content of the functional model,evaluate the main responsibilities and tasks in the functional benchmark, and Confirmthe functional benchmark level, work output and functional connotation, and thenfinalize it.This study is based on data analysis and questionnaire survey results as follows:1. The main responsibilities of rail culture regeneration staff include pre-jobpreparation, workplace surveys of rail culture, operational management tasks,rail culture business marketing, and quality verification upon job completion,totaling five responsibilities.2. The work tasks of rail culture regeneration personnel include onsiteinspections and requirement confirmation, conducting consensus meetingswith elders and youth, establishing a safe and healthy work environment,pre-proposal preparations, conducting field and rail culture surveys,positioning of rail culture venues, implementing rail culture regenerationtourism planning, implementing operational analysis for rail cultureregeneration tourism, financial management, budget planning, managingworkflows, managing and enhancing service quality, marketing strategyplanning, establishing brand and corporate image, inspecting tourism quality,showcasing results, and final project closure and accounting, totaling 17tasks.3. The work tasks for rail culture regeneration personnel are behavior indicatorswhich include being able to conduct on-site inspections and requirementconfirmations, consensus meetings with elders and youth, adhering tooccupational safety and health standards as well as workplace safety rules,and wearing appropriate safety gear. They must be able to follow therequirements of proposals, confirm the scope of tourism, and completepre-proposal tasks. They also carry out field and rail culture surveys, manageiithe characteristics of venues, and determine operational positioning andmarketing plans. Personnel must be able to establish rail culture regenerationtourism based on specific needs, facilitating subsequent branding operations,and planning tasks for effective execution. They must understand operationalreports, identify any discrepancies or unusual figures, and propose solutions.They conduct cost analysis and revenue management based on variousoperational needs, plan performance and budget allocations according to salesbudgets, enhance operational efficiency through standard operatingprocedures according to management plans, manage staff in performing tasks,propose marketing activities based on the characteristics of the rail space toachieve set goals, plan venue branding and establish a corporate image basedon operational goals and objectives, correctly complete inspections and testsfor tourism quality, showcase results, and close projects with properaccounting, totaling are the 19 behavior indicators.4. This study summarizes that there are 17 work tasks for rail cultureregeneration personnel. The professional competencies required for thesepersonnel include 41 items of knowledge, 38 skills, and 16 attitudes.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 探討運用跨境電商模擬遊戲與專案導向翻轉教室於學生創業知識和技能、態度、意向及高層次思維之影響
title_en: Investigating the Impact of using Cross Border e-commerce Simulation Games and Flipped classrooms with PBL on Students' Entrepreneurial Knowledge and Skills, Attitude, Intention and Higher-order Thinking
keywords: 跨境電商、創業知識技能、創業態度、創業意圖、高層次思維能力、翻轉課堂、跨境電商模擬遊戲
abstract_zh: 隨著全球經濟逐步向數位化轉型，跨境電商已成為現代創業的重要領域之一。在高等教育中，運用創新的數位工具來改進教學效果具有深遠的意義。特別是當適當的模擬遊戲與專案導向的翻轉教室相結合時，可以有效地將課程理論與實踐融合，並將專業教育與創業教育有機結合，這是培養學生成為未來商業領袖所面臨的核心挑戰之一。在 21 世紀，擁有高層次思維技能是每個人必須具備的基本能力，包括解決問題、批判性思維和創造力。這些技能使個體在面對複雜且快速變化的環境時，能夠表現出更強的適應性和創新能力。在這樣的背景下，跨境電商模擬遊戲作為一種創新的教育工具，為學生提供了一個基於模擬的平台，使他們能夠深入了解和探索跨境電商運營及創業過程中的各種複雜情境。 本文旨在探討在課程中引入跨境電商模擬遊戲與專案導向翻轉教室的模式，對於學生的創業知識和技能、創業態度、創業意圖及高層次思維能力的影響。為了達到這個目的，本研究採用了準實驗設計，對來自中國浙江某科技大學的 60名學生進行分析，這些學生被分為控制組和實驗組。兩組學生均參與專案式翻轉教室的活動，但實驗組額外接受了模擬遊戲的教學。 研究結果顯示，控制組和實驗組學生在創業知識和技能、創業態度、創業意圖以及高層次思維能力方面存在顯著差異。經過 t 檢驗和單因子共變數分析後，我們發現：1. 專案式翻轉教室能夠提升學生的創業知識和技能、創業態度、創業意圖及高層次思維能力。2. 當專案式翻轉教室中加入跨境電商模擬遊戲時，學生的創業知識和技能、創業態度、創業意圖及高層次思維能力進一步提升。3. 參與了跨境電商模擬遊戲的學生，在提升創業知識和技能、創業態度、創業意向及高層次思維能力方面，優於僅參與專案導向翻轉教室的控制組。
abstract_en: As the global economy increasingly shifts towards digitization, cross-border ecommerce has emerged as a pivotal realm for entrepreneurship. In high education, the digital tool is to enhance teaching performance profound importance.Particularly noteworthy is the integration of apt simulation games within project-based flipped classrooms, facilitating a seamless fusion of theoretical insights with hands-on application. This synergy not only integrates professional education with entrepreneurial course but also poses a fundamental challenge in grooming students to lead in future business landscapes.In the 21st century, possessing higher order thinking skills is a fundamentalrequirement for everyone. These skills include problem-solving, critical thinking, and creativity. Such capabilities allow individuals to exhibit greater adaptability and innovative capacity when facing complex and rapidly changing environments. In this context, cross-border e-commerce simulation games, as an innovative educational tool,provide students with a simulation-based platform, enable them to deeply understand and explore the various complex scenarios involved in cross-border e-commerceoperations and the entrepreneurial process.This paper aims to investigate the impact of introducing cross-border e-commercesimulation games and project-based flipped classroom models into courses on students' entrepreneurial knowledge and skills, entrepreneurial attitudes, entrepreneurial intentions, and high-level thinking abilities. To achieve this objective, the study employed a quasi-experimental design, analyzing 60 students from a technology university in Zhejiang, China. These students were divided into a control group and an experimental group. Both groups participated in project-based flipped classroom activities, but the experimental group received additional instruction through simulation games.The research results reveal significant differences between the control group andthe experimental group in terms of entrepreneurial knowledge and skills, entrepreneurial attitudes, entrepreneurial intentions, and high-level thinking abilities. After conducting t-tests and one-way ANCOVA, we found that:Project-based flipped classrooms can enhance students' entrepreneurial knowledgeand skills, entrepreneurial attitudes, entrepreneurial intentions, and high-level thinking abilities.When cross-border e-commerce simulation games are incorporated into projectbased flipped classrooms, students' entrepreneurial knowledge and skills, entrepreneurial attitudes, entrepreneurial intentions, and high-level thinking abilities are further improved.Students who participated in the cross-border e-commerce simulation games demonstrated superior gains in entrepreneurial knowledge and skills, entrepreneurial attitudes, entrepreneurial intentions, and high-level thinking abilities compared to those who only participated in the project-based flipped classroom.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 大型賽會餐飲服務志工參與動機與訓練成效之研究
title_en: A Study on the Participation Motivation and Training Effectiveness of Catering Services Volunteers in a Mega Event
keywords: 大型賽會、餐飲服務志工、參與動機、訓練成效
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在探討大型賽會餐飲服務志工於訓練及服務期間，其參與動機與訓練成效之關係。研究採用問卷調查法，以2017年臺北世界大學運動會選手村餐廳的餐飲服務志工為研究對象，並使用研究者自編之志工訓練研究調查問卷進行調查。針對所有餐飲服務志工發出問卷763份，回收510份，扣除無效問卷42份，最終獲得有效問卷468份，有效問卷回收率為61.33%。本研究採用獨立樣本t檢定、單因子變異數分析及結構方程模型等統計方法來檢驗各項假設。分析結果顯示，不同背景的志工在參與動機、訓練成效反應、學習、行為及結果層次上有所不同。志工的參與動機和各層次的訓練成效之間存在直接影響，而不同層次的訓練成效之間則存在時序上的直接效果。本研究結構模型具有中等解釋力，其解釋效果良好，模型適配度佳。此外，參與動機和訓練成效各層次之間存在多重中介關係。本研究模型在不同背景志工的比較下，具有一定程度的可複製性。根據這些結果，總結出十三點結論，七項實務建議及四項研究建議。結論包括：女性與大學生是主要的志工來源；志工訓練成效佳；稀少性、國際觀及人際拓展是主要的志工參與動機；專業背景與服務屬性契合的志工訓練成效較佳；大學生在訓練成效前二層次的表現較優於高中生；志工再任意願高者對於訓練成效有高度相關性；參與動機與訓練成效關係密切，證實對於訓練成效有正向效果；訓練成效反應、學習、行為、成果各層次之間具有時序性的關係存在；反應層次、學習層次、行為層次是參與動機與結果層次的部分中介因素；反應層次、學習層次是參與動機與行為層次的部份中介因素；反應層次是參與動機與學習層次的部份中介因素；本研究概念化模型可泛化在志工生理性別、教育程度及再任意願等類別；打工經驗、志工經驗及相關科系類別在概念模型中的表現有不同。實務建議包括：在志工召募時提供獨特且具吸引力的誘因；針對活動服務特性召募對應專業的志工以提升訓練成效；與大學保持良好關係以建立穩定的志工來源；提供適合志工屬性的訓練資源；妥善管理志工訓練流程以提升各階段訓練成效；對志工訓練計畫建立評估及改善機制；設定明確的訓練目標以提升志工自我認知及滿意度。未來研究建議為：從志工及管理者的不同視角進行訓練成效評估；基於不同理論觀點的評估模式進行驗證；針對不同服務屬性的志工進行訓練成效評估；探討不同調節變項的影響效果。
abstract_en: This study aims to explore the relationship between the motivation for participation and the training effectiveness of catering service volunteers in mega events during training and service. Questionnaires developed by the researcher, taking the catering service volunteers in the restaurant of the athletes' village of the Taipei 2017 Summer Universiade as the research subjects, were issued to conduct the survey. 763 questionnaires were officially issued, and 510 were collected. After deducting 42 invalid questionnaires, the research obtained 468 valid ones, with a valid questionnaire recovery rate of 61.33%. This study applied statistical methods such as independent t-test, ANOVA, and SEM to test various hypotheses. The results show that volunteers from different backgrounds have different motivations among participation, training response, learning, behavior and results. Volunteers' motivation has direct effects on the training effectiveness at each level, while there is a direct effect along time sequence on the training effectiveness at different levels. The structural model of this study has medium explanatory power, and both its explanatory effect and the model fit are good enough. In addition, there are multiple mediating relationships among direct effects, indirect effects, and overall effects among various levels of participation motivation and training effectiveness. This research model has a certain degree of replicability when compared with volunteers from different backgrounds. On the bases of these results, thirteen conclusions were finalized, and seven practical suggestions were put forward to the host institution, as well as four research suggestions were provided for future researchers.The conclusions include: female and college students are the main sources of volunteers; volunteer training is super-effective; rarity, global perspective, and expanding individual network are the main motivations for volunteer participation; volunteer training that matches professional background and service attributes is more effective; the performance of college students in the first two dimensions of training effectiveness is better than that of high school students; those with high willingness to re-volunteer are highly correlated with training effectiveness; participation motivation is highly correlated to training effectiveness, confirming that it has a positive effect on training effectiveness; there are sequential relationship among different levels of training effectiveness response, learning, behavior, and results; the reaction level, learning level, and behavior level are partial mediators between the participation motivation and the result level; the reaction level and the learning level are partial mediators between the participation motivation and the behavior level ; response level is a partial mediator between participation motivation and learning level; the conceptual model of this study can be generalized to demographic variables such as volunteers’ biological gender, education level, and willingness to re-employ; conversely, demographic variables such as work experience, volunteer experience, and related departments cannot be generalized to this conceptual model .Practical suggestions include: providing unique and attractive incentives when recruiting volunteers; recruiting volunteers with corresponding majors according to the characteristics of the activity to improve training effectiveness; maintaining good relationships with universities to establish a stable foundation of recruiting volunteers; providing suitable volunteers oriented training resources; properly manage the volunteer training process to improve training effectiveness at each stage; establish an evaluation and improvement mechanism for volunteer training plans; set clear training goals to enhance volunteer self-awareness and satisfaction. Suggestions for future research are: evaluate training effectiveness from different perspectives of volunteers and managers; verify evaluation models based on different theoretical perspectives; evaluate training effectiveness for volunteers with different service attributes; and explore the impact of different moderating variables.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 高中校長發揮個人靈性、營造職場靈性、 運用個人自主性與幸福感之研究
title_en: A Study on Exerting Personal Spirituality, Creating Workplace Spirituality, Using Personal Autonomy and Well-being for High School Principals
keywords: 高中校長、個人靈性、職場靈性、個人自主性、幸福感
abstract_zh: 近年來，幸福感成為學校教育目標之一，高中校長幸福感不僅攸關師生幸福感，亦是校長領導的一種效標反映，更是校長學研究的重要內涵，因之，本研究有其重要性。本研究旨在探討高中校長發揮個人靈性、營造職場靈性、運用個人自主性與幸福感的關係，研究目的如下：一、建構靈性觀點的高中校長幸福感模型假設理論。二、瞭解高中校長知覺其發揮個人靈性、營造職場靈性、運用個人自主性與幸福感的現況看法。三、探討不同背景高中校長幸福感的差異情形。四、分析高中校長在發揮個人靈性、營造職場靈性、運用個人自主性與幸福感的關聯情形。五、分析高中校長於發揮個人靈性、營造職場靈性、運用個人自主性對幸福感的預測力。六、分析高中校長營造職場靈性、運用個人自主性於發揮個人靈性對高中校長幸福感的影響上，所具備多元中介效果。七、釐清高中校長運用個人自主性於「發揮個人靈性→幸福感」直接調節效果、「發揮個人靈性→營造職場靈性→幸福感」，和「發揮個人靈性→運用個人自主性→幸福感」路徑的調節式中介效果。為達研究目的，本研究以全國公私立高中校長為母群對象，透過問題意識之自我敘事話語分析、文獻探討，提出高中校長幸福感模型的假設性理論，依此自編「高中校長發揮個人靈性、營造職場靈性、運用個人自主性與幸福感調查問卷」。問內經內容效度審查，預試量表預試，信度、效度分析，刪減題項和調整題項文字與順序，再發展成正式量表進行施測，有效問卷回收率68.8%。本研究基礎資料統計分析以描述性統計、獨立樣本t檢定、單因子變異數、皮爾森積差相關及線性廻歸為之。而中介效果、調節效果、調節式中介效果分析，以Hayes之SPSS外掛PROCESS模組，因應小樣本多次重覆取樣的拔靴法（bootstrap），估算路徑效果的信賴區間，進行假設考驗和模型驗證。本研究結論如下：一、高中校長幸福感模型理論，「發揮個人靈性→營造職場靈性→運用個人自主性→幸福感」之因果關係，經驗證確實可行。二、高中校長發揮個人靈性、營造職場靈性、運用個人自主性和幸福感的現況皆達中高符合程度，但個人靈性方面認知和實踐的知行差距現象值得關注。三、北部地區以外與宗教信仰較高程度的高中校長幸福感顯著較高，值得後續追蹤研究。四、高中校長發揮個人靈性、營造職場靈性、運用個人自主性和幸福感皆具顯著正相關，其中以運用個人自主性具高度正相關。五、高中校長發揮個人靈性（IS）、營造職場靈性（WS）、運用個人自主性（IA）對幸福感（WB）具顯著預測力，得出幸福感模型的因果結構：IS→WS→IA→WB。六、營造職場靈性、運用個人自主性顯著的中介效果實證，高中校長幸福感有兩條幸福道路，第一條是「發揮個人靈性→運用個人自主性→幸福感」－－個體意志行動自由理性利己之路。第二條是「發揮個人靈性→營造職場靈性→運用個人自主性→幸福感」－－兼顧群體共善理性利他和個體自由理性利己之路。七、運用個人自主性具調節式中介效果，較低的理性利己可正向調節發揮個人靈性對幸福感的影響力。根據研究結果，本研究提出對主管教育行政機關、高中校長及對未來研究的具體建議如下：一、主管教育行政機關可參考本研究的量表作為高中校長自我評鑑之參考。二、主管教育行政機關可參考本研究高中校長幸福感模型作為校長儲訓之內涵。三、主管教育行政機關可規劃高中「校長學」在職進修課程，辦理高中校長「幸福感」、「個人靈性」素養、「營造職場靈性」實務，以及「運用個人自主性」等工作坊，以滋養高中校長幸福感。四、高中校長學校領導可依據精神性領導模型，由「發揮個人靈性」到「營造職場靈性」的歷程，以發展社會性職場的共善利他。五、高中校長學校經營理念可依序由「發揮個人靈性」、「營造職場靈性」及「運用個人自主性」為之。六、未來進一步研究可參考本研究發展的高中校長幸福感量表進行之。七、本研究高中校長幸福感模型充實校長學之理論，可作為後續研究的參考。八、未來高中校長幸福感的研究，可依不同樣本數採用適宜的統計模型，以持續進行理論驗證。
abstract_en: The subject of this study is Taiwan's high school principals. From past research, we know that the high school stage is related to future national happiness, and the well-being of high school principals is positively related to effective school management. It can be seen that the research on the well-being of contemporary high school principals is very important. First, through self-narrative discourse analysis and literature discussion, the theoretical hypothesis of the well-being model is put forward. High school principals can significantly predict the dependent variable well by using two mediating variables: creating workplace spirituality and using personal autonomy. -being. Secondly, a scale was developed based on hypotheses, and the questionnaire was completed after expert review. Nearly 30% of high school principals and 150 people were randomly selected to receive the test. After data processing and verification of hypotheses, the final results found that: in the well-being model, personal spirituality, The results of the survey on the current perception of the four scales of creating workplace spirituality, using personal autonomy and well-being show that the overall perception results of Taiwan high school principals in each scale are medium to high levels of performance; in terms of background factors, only the degree of religious belief is higher Those with higher scores have higher well-being.
