The well-being of school principals in the northern region is lower than that of other regions. There is no significant difference in the other background factors. The four variables in the correlation analysis are all positively correlated with each other. The correlation between the independent variables and well-being is significant. The order is: using personal autonomy, creating workplace spirituality, and exerting personal spirituality; the verification of the regression prediction hypothesis, exerting personal spirituality (IS), creating workplace spirituality (WS), and using personal autonomy (IA) to influence well-being ( WB) all have significant predictive effects, supporting the well-being model's causal relationship: IS→WS→IA→WB; through mediation effect analysis, it is found that the first type of high school principal's well-being performance belongs to the IS→IA→WB path type ( 51.7%), which is a manifestation of moral individualism of rational self-interest. The second manifestation of happiness belongs to the IS→WS→IA→WB path type (33.8%), which is a balanced manifestation of rational self-interest and rational altruism. Through moderated mediation Effect analysis found that the interaction between the use of personal autonomy and personal spirituality can be moderated through the intermediary relationship between the use of personal autonomy and well-being. It shows that the current high school principals in Taiwan are exerting personal spirituality and using personal autonomy to obtain well-being. In the process of using personal autonomy, in addition to having a mediating effect, it also has a regulatory mediating effect of reflection and restraint, allowing a lower degree of personal autonomy to be used (which can be interpreted as appropriate rational self-interest), and positively regulating and amplifying the use of personal spiritual function to affect the acquisition of well-being (IS→IA→WB). Finally, based on the results of this study, this well-being model theory can not only provide high school principals with practical school management theory and reference for training, selection and training; in practice, the scale developed in this study can be used as an evaluation index for high school principals. For reference, as for on-the-job lifelong learning for principals, administrative units can regularly organize well-being workshops, personal spiritual literacy workshops, workplace spiritual practice workshops, and personal autonomy workshops for current high school principals.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 技術型高中學生學習歷程檔案之學習態度模式建構
title_en: Constructing Learning Attitude Model of Learning Portfolio for Technical High School Students
keywords: 技術型高中、108課綱、自我調整學習、學習歷程檔案、鷹架支持知覺
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在探討技術型高中學生學習歷程檔案之學習態度模式，透過驗證Zimmerman自我調整學習三個階段歷程模式在「預思（forethought）、表現（performance）、自我反思（self-reflection）」加上外生變項鷹架支持知覺，推論出學生在學習歷程檔案準備之情形，以實施108課綱參採學習歷程檔案第一、二屆之技術型高中學生為調查對象，進行問卷調查分析，研究結果與發現：（一）技術型高中學生歷程檔案學習自我調整學習理論「自我動機信念」、「自我觀察」、「自我判斷」呈現較積極的學習態度。（二）生理女在自我調整學習理論「任務分析」、「自我動機信念」、「自我控制」、「自我觀察」、「自我判斷」、「自我反應」、「鷹架支持知覺」皆顯著地優於生理男。（三）「私立」技術型高中在「任務分析」、「自我動機信念」、「自我觀察」「自我判斷」、「鷹架支持知覺」皆顯著優於「公立」技術型高中。（四）技術型高中學生在「就讀大學年級」在「自我控制」、「自我觀察」，大學二年級優於大學一年級。（五）「技高報考統測群科別」在「任務分析」、「自我動機信念」、「自我判斷」、「自我反應」有所差異。（六）技術型高中在「技專入學管道」在「自我控制」、「自我觀察」、「鷹架支持知覺」有所差異，其中在「鷹架支持知覺」，發現甄選入學優於登記分發。（七）技術型高中「技高學校所在地」在「自我反應」有顯著的差異。（八）技術型高中學生在自我調整學習理論構面學習態度的模式指標適配度可獲得支持，能有效解釋本研究主要變項間的互相影響效果。（九）「鷹架支持知覺」在「表現」及「自我反思」間有調節效果。此外，針對研究結果提出建議包括：增加提供學習歷程檔案友善的環境，如：課程導引、政策宣導；學校課程加強運用自我調整學習策略；技專校院進行校務資料庫與科系契合度分析。
abstract_en: The study aims to explore the learning attitude model of vocational high school students towards e-portfolios, by verifying Zimmerman's three-phase self-regulated learning model ("forethought," "performance," and "self-reflection") with the addition of the exogenous variable perceived scaffolding support. The study infers students' preparation for learning portfolios based on a survey conducted among vocational high school students who implemented the 108 Curriculum Guidelines in the first and second cohorts. The questionnaire analysis reveals the following findings:1.  Vocational high school students show a more positive learning attitude in self-regulated learning theory components such as "self-motivational beliefs," "self-observation," and "self-judgment."2.  Female students significantly outperform male students in "task analysis," "self-motivational beliefs," "self-control," "self-observation," "self-judgment," "self-reaction," and "perceived scaffolding support."3.  Private vocational high schools significantly outperform public vocational high schools in "task analysis," "self-motivational beliefs," "self-observation," "self-judgment," and "perceived scaffolding support."4.  Second-year university students outperform first-year students in "self-control" and "self-observation."5.  There are differences in "task analysis," "self-motivational beliefs," "self-judgment," and "self-reaction" based on the group of technical subjects tested in the unified entrance exams.6.  There are differences in "self-control," "self-observation," and "perceived scaffolding support" based on the vocational high school admission pathways, with the selection admission outperforming the joint registration and assignment in "perceived scaffolding support."7.  There are significant differences in "self-reaction" based on the location of the vocational high school.8.  The model fit indicators for the learning attitude components of self-regulated learning theory among vocational high school students are supported, effectively explaining the mutual influence among the main variables of the study.9.  "Perceived scaffolding support" has a moderating effect between "performance" and "self-reflection."Based on the research findings, suggestions include increasing the provision of a friendly environment for learning portfolios, such as curriculum guidance and policy advocacy; strengthening the use of self-regulated learning strategies in school curricula; and conducting compatibility analysis of the alignment between Institutional databases and departmental fit in technical and vocational colleges.”

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 技術型高中學生群科學習成果與相關因素關係之研究
title_en: A Study on the Relationship Between Group Subject Learning Outcomes and Related Factors in a Vocational High School
keywords: MOA理論、校務研究、技術型高中、次級資料分析
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在探討中部某技術型高中實施108課綱畢業生之自主行動、興趣價值、教師教學感受和專業群科教學感受對專業科目學習成果、實習課程學習成果及專業群科認同之關係模式，並探討以學校整體感受為中介變項分析其差異性，根據MOA（動機－機會－能力）理論觀點加以實證，經由校務研究（Institutional Research, IR）方式進行研究，其研究發現供為該校辦學之重要依據。本研究採用次級資料分析法，研究資料取自臺灣後期中等教育長期追踪資料庫（Taiwan Upper Secondary Education Database, TUSED）中108、109、110三個學年度之學生調查問卷及109、110、111三個學年度之學生調查問卷，以該校108課綱實施後兩屆之畢業生為分析對象，本研究有效樣本共654人，第一屆畢業生334人，第二屆畢業生320人；女學生353人，男學生301人；就讀商管群468人，就讀機械群186人。資料以描述性統計、結構方程模式、中介效果檢驗及多群組分析進行資料分析與檢驗之。研究結果發現如下：一、自主行動對學習成果未達顯著，建議學校應強化辦學細膩與服務。二、興趣價值對學習成果有顯著影響，顯現多數學生知覺選擇正確。三、教師教學感受對學習成果未達顯著，可能歸因於COVID-19疫情影響甚鉅。四、專業群科教學感受對學習成果有顯著影響，政府挹注經費強化設備和本校用心規劃發展特色。五、學校整體感受對學習成果有顯著影響，顯示校方善用資源用心經營師生有感。六、學校整體感受在教師教學感受與學習成果之關係為具有完全中介效果，學校整體感受扮演關鍵角色。七、學校整體感受在專業群科教學感受與學習成果之關係為具有部分中介效果。八、各群組間對結構模型可泛化程度具良好性。最後依據研究結果，提出實務應用與未來進一步研究的建議。關鍵字：MOA理論、校務研究、技術型高中、次級資料分析
abstract_en: This study aims to explore the relationship model between self-directed action, interest value, perceptions of teachers' teaching, and perceptions of professional group subject teaching among graduates under the 108 curriculum guidelines at a vocational high school in central Taiwan, and their professional subject learning outcomes, internship course learning outcomes, and professional group identity. Additionally, the study examines the differences by analyzing the overall school perception as a mediating variable, based on the Motivation-Opportunity-Ability (MOA) theory perspective. Conducted through Institutional Research (IR), the findings of this study will provide significant insights for the school's educational practices.This study employs secondary data analysis, utilizing data from the Taiwan Upper Secondary Education Database (TUSED). The research focuses on graduates from two cohorts who completed their studies after the implementation of the 108 curriculum guidelines. The first cohort of students filled out questionnaires in 108, 109, and 110 academic years, while the second cohort filled out questionnaires in 109, 110, and 111 academic years. The effective sample consists of 654 students, with 334 from the first cohort and 320 from the second cohort. Among them, 353 are female and 301 are male; 468 students are from the Business and Management group, and 186 are from the Mechanical group. Data were analyzed and tested using descriptive statistics, structural equation modeling, mediation effect testing, and multi-group analysis.The research findings are as follows:1.Self-directed action did not have a significant impact on learning outcomes, suggesting that the school should enhance the meticulousness of its educational practices and services.2.Interest value had a significant impact on learning outcomes, indicating that the majority of students perceive their choice as correct.3.Perceptions of teachers' teaching did not significantly affect learning outcomes, likely due to the substantial impact of the global COVID-19 pandemic.4.Perceptions of professional group subject teaching had a significant impact on learning outcomes, reflecting the government's investment in enhancing equipment and the school's dedicated planning for feature development.5.Overall school perception had a significant impact on learning outcomes, demonstrating the effective use of resources and the diligent management by the school to create a strong sense of engagement among teachers and students.6.Overall school perception fully mediated the relationship between perceptions of teachers' teaching and learning outcomes. The overall perception of the school plays a crucial role.7.Overall school perception partially mediated the relationship between perceptions of professional group subject teaching and learning outcomes.8.The structural model's generalizability across different groups was found to be satisfactory.Based on the research findings, practical applications and suggestions for further research are proposed.Keywords: MOA Theory, Institutional Research, Vocational High School, Secondary Data Analysis

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 技術型高中機械群學習歷程檔案課程學習成果準備指引之發展
title_en: Development of Guidelines for Preparing Learning Achievement Portfolio in Machining Cluster of Vocational High School
keywords: 課程學習成果、學習歷程檔案、準備指引
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在編製一份專門針對技術型高中機械群學生撰寫課程學習成果的準備指引，期望藉此幫助機械群學生，讓學生更有方向地完成課程學習成果的撰寫。研究過程主要分為四個步驟：首先，彙整並分析「113學年度四技二專各入學管道備審資料準備指引」中，機械群升學之國立大專院校對於課程學習成果的建議撰寫方式，其次，根據分析結果，進行準備指引的編輯，為增加指引的完整度與實用性，研究者邀請了專家協助優化此指引，最後一步，研究者根據專家學者的建議，進一步編輯並完成指引。透過系統化的準備指引，期望機械群學生在撰寫課程學習成果時，能夠更有方向感和條理性，此準備指引提供具體的撰寫方式與範例，本研究編製的準備指引對於技術型高中機械群學生在課程學習成果撰寫方面期望具有顯著的價值與實用性。
abstract_en: This study aims to develop a preparation guide specifically designed for students in the mechanical engineering group at technical high schools to aid them in writing their course learning outcomes. The goal is to provide these students with clear directions to complete their course learning outcomes more effectively. The research process involves several key steps. Initially, the "Guidelines for Preparing Application Materials for the 113th Academic Year for Four-Year Technological and Two-Year Junior College Programs" were collected and analyzed to identify the recommended writing methods for course learning outcomes for mechanical engineering students applying to national universities. Based on the analysis results, a preparation guide was edited. To enhance the completeness and practicality of the guide, experts were invited to optimize it. The guide was then further edited and finalized according to the suggestions from these experts.Through this systematic preparation guide, it is expected that mechanical engineering students will have a clearer sense of direction and organization when writing their course learning outcomes. The guide provides specific writing methods and examples. This preparation guide is anticipated to be significantly valuable and practical for technical high school mechanical engineering students in composing their course learning outcomes.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 產學攜手班學生的學習歷程經驗與生涯決定之研究
title_en: Research on Students' Learning Experiences and Career Decision-Making in Industry-Academia Collaboration Programs
keywords: 產學攜手計畫、學習經驗、生涯決定
abstract_zh: 產學攜手計畫的學生在學業與實習壓力的雙重挑戰下，面臨著影響其生涯發展與選擇的複雜情境。本研究旨在深入探討產學班學生在這種壓力情境下所採取的生涯決定策略，以及他們在面臨選擇時所考慮的因素。透過立意抽樣方式選出6位不同公司的學生，採質性研究法中的半結構式訪談進行資料蒐集，我們將關注學生的觀點、經驗和應對策略，以深入瞭解他們在這個關鍵時期的生涯決定過程。經過研究得到以下結論：一、  參與學生的家庭大多屬於中產階級，能夠負擔學費。由於較無經濟壓力，故學生退學率高於往年。二、  學生參與此計畫的原因多數是受到老師和同學的影響。三、  在職前訓練中，技高端把學生抽離原班級，組織成新班級的訓練方式，對學生銜接公司還有大學端都有較佳的表現。四、  學生假日需要投入近12小時的學習，平日又得在公司工作，遇到課業問題時無法即時詢問老師，因此良好的時間管理顯得尤為重要。五、  大多數畢業生選擇離職，主要是因為薪資未達預期，以及公司距離住家過遠。六、  學生通過提早進入職場，能更清楚地了解自己喜歡和適合的工作。關鍵字：產學攜手計畫、學習經驗、生涯決定
abstract_en: The students involved in the Industry-Academia Collaboration Program face the dual challenges of academic demands and internship pressures, encountering a complex situation that influences their career planning and choices. This study aims to delve into the career planning strategies adopted by students in the Industry-Academia Collaboration Program under such pressure situations, as well as the factors they consider when making choices. Through purposeful sampling, six students from different companies in the program were selected, and qualitative research methods, specifically semi-structured interviews, were employed for data collection. The study focuses on understanding the students' perspectives, experiences, and coping strategies to gain insight into their career development during this crucial period. The following conclusions were drawn from the research:1.  Students participating in the program mostly come from middle-class families, capable of affording tuition fees. Due to less economic pressure, the dropout rate among students is higher than in previous years.2.  Most students participate in this project primarily due to influence from teachers and classmates.3.  In vocational high schools' pre-employment training, one approach involves separating students from their original classes and organizing them into new classes, which has better performance in connecting students to companies and universities.4.  Students devote nearly 12 hours to studying on holidays, while balancing work in companies on weekdays. They face challenges in seeking immediate help from teachers when encountering academic issues, highlighting the importance of effective time management.5.  Most graduates choose to leave their jobs primarily because salaries do not meet expectations and companies are too far from their residences.6.  By entering the workforce early, students gain clearer insights into the types of jobs they enjoy and are suited for.Keywords: Industry-Academia Collaboration Program, Learning Experiences, Career Decision Making

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 產學攜手專班學生學習滿意度及職涯發展之研究
title_en: A Study of Students' Learning Satisfaction and Career Development in the Industry-University Cooperative Program
keywords: 產學攜手合作計畫、學習滿意度、職涯發展滿意度
abstract_zh: 本研究採用半結構方式訪談參加3+4精密機械加工產學攜手合作計畫專班學生(包括中途退出產學攜手合作計畫專班的學生)、技術型高中教師、科技大學教授和師父，經由與第一線的師生訪談，可以獲得更多執行層面的相關問題。深入瞭解學生就讀產學攜手合作專班的動機、就讀產學攜手合作專班的學習歷程、就讀產學攜手合作專班的滿意度和就讀產學攜手合作專班畢業後的生涯發展。研究發現：1. 產學攜手合作計畫優勢吸引國中生就讀，但是要堅持下去有困難度。2. 優秀行政團隊用心規劃執行計畫促使產學合作學生在原合作企業留任率高。3. 產學攜手合作計畫結合國立技術型高中會吸引學習弱勢學生就讀。4. 產學攜手合作計畫結合優質合作企業會吸引家庭經濟弱勢學生就讀。5. 招生宣導有助於產學攜手合作計畫的推廣並招收優秀的學生。6. 搭配國立科技大學會增強學生參加產學攜手合作專班計畫。7. 大學教授針對產學攜手合作專班學生的課業要求實務操作。8. 產學攜手合作專班學生對於合作企業工作崗位的實習自信心十足。9. 部分產學攜手合作專班學生在大學畢業之後再進修碩士學位。10.企業知名度會吸引產學攜手合作專班學生持續留任合作企業服務。11.合作企業對於產學合作專班學生的工作崗位輪調有確實實施。12.合作企業提供的待遇與福利會吸引學生持續在合作企業發展。13.合作企業同事間相處氛圍融洽會促使學生對合作企業產生向心力。14.合作企業的未來發展前景會影響產學攜手合作專班學生去留。
abstract_en: This study utilized semi-structured interviews with participants including students of the 3+4 Precision Machinery Manufacturing Industry-University Cooperative Program, vocational high school teachers, university professors, and industry mentors, including students who dropped out of the collaboration program midway. Through interviews with frontline teachers and students, more insights into the operational aspects of the program can be obtained. The study aimed to delve into the motives of students enrolling in the collaborative program, their learning processes within the program, satisfaction levels, and post-graduation career development.Key Findings:1. Industry-University Cooperative Program have the advantage of attracting junior high school students to enroll, but it is challenging to persist in the long run.2. An excellent administrative team carefully plans and executes projects, promoting a high retention rate for students in industry-university cooperative within the original partner companies.3. Industry-University Cooperative Program combined with national technical high schools will attract underprivileged students to enroll.4.Industry-University Cooperative Program combined with high-quality partner companies will attract students from economically disadvantaged families to enroll.5. Enrollment promotion aids in the outreach and recruitment of outstanding students for Industry-University Cooperative Programs.6. Collaboration with national universities enhances student participation in Industry-University Cooperative Programs.7. University professors tailor their academic requirements for Industry-University Cooperative Program students towards practical applications.8. Students of Industry-University Cooperative Programs exhibit confidence in internship opportunities at collaborating companies.9. Some Industry-University Cooperative Program students pursue postgraduate studies after graduating from university.10. The reputation of companies attracts Industry-University Cooperative Program students to continue serving in collaborating companies.11. Collaborating companies effectively implement job rotation for Industry-University Cooperative Program students.12. Compensation and benefits provided by collaborating companies attract students to continue developing their careers within the companies.13. Harmonious interpersonal relationships among colleagues in collaborating companies foster students' loyalty towards the companies.14. The future development prospects of collaborating companies influence the decisions of Industry-University Cooperative Program students to stay or leave.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 後期中等學校外語群學生學習困擾相關因素之研究
title_en: The Study of the Learning Disturbance for Foreign Language Group Students in Upper -Secondary Schools
keywords: 後期中等教育、外語群、學習困擾
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在探討影響後期中等教育階段外語群學生學習困擾之相關因素。研究資料取自臺灣後期中等教育長期追蹤資料庫所釋出之｢107學年度高二（專二）學生調查｣全國現場版資料，問卷題目來自｢107學年度高二（專二）學生調查問卷｣。本研究篩選出外語群學生進行分析，研究樣本數為2,370人，男學生636人，女學生1,734人。資料分析方法採用信、效度分析、描述性統計分析、獨立樣本t檢定與多元迴歸分析探討來自外語群學生的個人因素、學校因素、家庭因素與不同背景變項對學習困擾因素的相關性，經過研究得到以下結論：一、外語群學生不同性別對「教師教學風格」、「父母管教方式」、「同儕人際關係」與「學校內偏差行為」四項構面有顯著差異。二、外語群學生就讀不同公、私立學校屬性對「教師教學風格」構面有顯著差異。三、在個人因素中的「憂鬱情緒」與「自我效能」兩項構面皆對外語群學生學習困擾有相關性。四、在學校因素中的「同儕人際關係」與「教師教學風格」兩項構面皆對外語群學生學習困擾有相關性，「學校內偏差行為」則無相關性。五、在家庭因素中的「家庭支持」與「父母管教方式」構面對外語群學生學習困擾皆無相關。六、外語群學生之「性別」與「就讀學校公私立屬性」兩項背景變項對學習困擾皆無顯著關聯。七、外語群學生學習困擾影響程度最高的構面依序為「憂鬱情緒」、「教師教學風格」、「自我效能」與「同儕人際關係」。
abstract_en: The study aims to explore the factors related to learning disturbance among students in foreign language group in upper secondary education. The questionnaire items and research data were obtained from Taiwan Upper Secondary Education Database (TUSED), on-site data, Upper Secondary Student Survey: High School 11th Graders and Sophomore of Junior College (2018). The study selected foreign language group students for analysis, with a sample size of 2,370 students, 636 male students, and 1,734 female students. The data analysis method adopted reliability and validity analysis, descriptive statistics, independent sample t-test, and regression analysis to explore the relevance of individual factors, school factors, family factors, and different background variables to learning disturbances.The following conclusions were: (1) There are significant differences in "teacher teaching style", "parental discipline", "peer relationships", and "deviant behavior within the school" among foreign language group students of different genders. (2) There are significant differences in "teacher teaching style" among foreign language group students who attend public or private schools. (3) In individual factors, "depression" and "self-efficacy" were found to be related to foreign language group students' learning disturbances. (4) In school factors, " peer relationships " and "teacher teaching style" were found to be related to foreign language group students' learning disturbance, while "school deviant behavior" was not. (5) In family factors, "family support" and "parenting style" were not found to be related to foreign language group students' learning disturbances. (6) There is no significant between foreign language group students' "gender" and "public or private schools" and their learning disturbances. (7) The most influential factors in foreign language group students' learning disturbances were "depression", "teacher teaching style", "self-efficacy", and " peer relationships " in that order.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 將計算思維導入STEAM課程之學生參與度、自我效能及問題解決能力之調查
title_en: Investigation of Student Engagement, Self-Efficacy, and Problem-Solving Inventory for Introducing Computational Thinking into STEAM Course
keywords: STEAM教育、無人機、計算思維、參與度、自我效能感、問題解決
abstract_zh: STEAM 教育是一種涉及多學科的複雜學習方法。這種複雜性要求學生具備實際的問題解決能力。運算思維被視為可一種系統化的問題解決方法並在各種活動中採用和實施，其中包括課堂學習。然而，在教育領域中，該邏輯的思維常不被使用來當作解決問題首要條件。因此，本研究旨在探討將運算思維導入 STEAM 課程來針對學生參與度、自我效能感和問題解決技能之影響。研究開始於先開發運算思維系統，接著整合到學習主題中的教學設計和策略。本研究採用了準實驗方法，分別為對照組與實驗組，每組各有 13 名學生。參與團體來自一所小學的夏令營且參與者皆為自願參加。依據統計分析結果顯示，兩組從前測到後測都有所改善；而對於 ANCOVA 分析顯示，在承諾與自我效能感變量上，對照組和實驗組相互沒有差異，但在問題解決技能上卻存有顯著的差異性。另一方面，t 檢驗的分析顯示，對照組進步幅度未達顯著差異，而實驗組的所有進步項目均達顯著。
abstract_en: STEAM education is a complex approach to learning that involves multiple disciplines. This complexity requires students to have practical problem-solving skills. Computational thinking is proposed as a systematic problem-solving method that can be adopted and implemented in various activities, including classroom learning. However, computational thinking is rarely presented as a systematic approach to problem-solving in educational settings. Therefore, this study aims to investigate the effects of incorporating computational thinking into STEAM courses on student engagement, self-efficacy, and problem-solving skills. The research begins with developing instructional designs and strategies for integrating computational thinking into learning topics. This study used a quasi-experimental approach with 13 students in the control group and 13 students in the experimental group. Participants volunteered during a summer camp at a primary school. The results of the descriptive analysis showed an improvement from pre-test to post-test in both groups. Further ANCOVA analysis showed no differences between the control and experimental groups in the variables of commitment and self-efficacy, while there was a difference in problem-solving skills. Meanwhile, the t-test analysis showed that the improvement in the control group was insignificant, unlike the experimental group, where all improvements were significant.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 核心能力、職業選擇及相關影響因素的模式建構研究：以烏干達大學商學院學生為例
title_en: A Modeling Study of Core Competencies, Career Choices, and Relevant Influential Factors: The Case of Business College Students in Ugandan Universities
keywords: 生涯興趣、生涯選擇、核心能力、職業選擇、商業教育、學生觀點、高等教育、烏干達、發展中國家、結構方程模型
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在探討大學生職業選擇與核心職能發展的相關影響因素。期能在日常生活和企業領域中，有助於個體在勞動力市場進入的各個階段需要進行職業選擇和決策。在當今動態變化快速的世界裡，特別是對於不同生涯階段的個人，包括學生來說，這些生涯的統整決策是一項複雜的任務。在不斷變化的就業市場中，培養核心職業能力成為關鍵因素，不可或缺。當代雇主在招聘過程中優先考慮核心能力，將其視為進入勞動力市場和有效生產力的關鍵“門票”。因此，特別是大學等教育機構持續呼籲必須在大學階段中培養這些能力，以確保順利過渡到成功的職業生涯。儘管現有文獻廣泛涵蓋了職業及其相關的影響變項，但在商業教育背景下整合核心能力和職業選擇之間存在顯著的不確定因素。因此，本研究旨在通過深入了解烏干達四所城市大學的商學院學生的視角來解決上述不足的環節。本研究採用調查法進行研究，根據文獻與理論基礎，發展具有信、效度的問卷工具，通過網路調查問卷的形式，對烏干達大學的544名商學院最後一年的本系大學生樣本進行了調查，探討了學生對核心能力、職業選擇及其相關影響因素之間關係的看法。通過Likert5等第自陳量表，問卷收集的數據在導入到結構方程模型使用AMOS v24進行分析之前，先進行了SPSS v24的處理。研究分析結如下：1.可接受的適配模型，其中外生變項和內生變項之間存在顯著關係，2.模型驗證構建之間，生涯興趣與核心能力之間的影響具有部分中介效應，3.相比男性學生，女性學生觀察到的影響更為溫和，儘管這些變量之間的性別差異在統計上並不顯著。研究結論陳述心理因素對職業選擇和核心能力有著強烈且顯著的影響，而情境因素的影響效果則不一，職業信息特別是在女性學生中作為一個顯著的調節因素。因此，提供了討論、影響及建議以及對未來研究的建議。
abstract_en: In both everyday life and the corporate sphere, individuals navigate career choices and decisions throughout the phases of labour market entry. Negotiating these decisions, particularly in today’s dynamic world, proves to be a complex task for individuals across various life stages, including students. The cultivation of essential skills emerges as a key factor in navigating the ever-changing job markets. Employers in the contemporary landscape prioritises core competencies during recruitment, viewing them as a crucial “ticket” for labour market entry and effective productivity. Consequently, there is a persistent call for educational institutions, particularly universities, to instil these capabilities in their graduates to ensure a seamless transition to successful careers.This study, conducted through an online survey questionnaire with 544 final-year undergraduate college business students in Ugandan universities, explores the perceptions of students on the relationship among core competencies, career choices, and their relevant influence factors. While existing literature extensively covers aspects of careers and associated variables, there is a notable gap in integrating core competencies and career choices within the context of business education. Therefore, this study seeks to address this gap by delving into the perspectives of college business students from four urban-based universities in Uganda.Data collected through self-reported questionnaire was subjected to SPSS v24 before importing into structural equation modelling using AMOS version 24 for analysis. The results revealed (i) an acceptable model fit where significant relationship between exogenous and endogenous variables, (ii) a partial mediation effect between constructs, (iii) a more moderate impact was observed among female students compared to male students, although the gender difference in the relationship between these variables was not statistically significant.The study concludes that psychological factors strongly and significantly influence career choices and core competencies, while contextual factors yielded mixed results with career information acting as a significant moderator, especially among female students. Thus, discussion, implications and recommendations and suggestion for future research were provided.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 運用翻轉學習與拼圖式教學法以提高學生國際營銷管理課程之成效
title_en: Enhancing Students’ Learning Outcomes on International Marketing Management Course by Utilizing Flipped Learning and Jigsaw II Approach
keywords: 翻轉學習、拼圖II法、國際行銷管理、學生學習成果、學生態度、動機、自我效能、參與、高階思考能力、學習績效
abstract_zh: 研究人員發現，在不同教育程度的課程中將翻轉學習與拼圖方法結合起來會產生正面的影響。 另一方面，利用翻轉學習和拼圖 II 方法來培養現實世界的行銷實務技能，同時提高學生在行銷課程中的學習成果，卻很少受到關注。 本研究的主要目的是探索利用創新的教學方法模型，結合翻轉學習和拼圖 II 方法，與常規翻轉學習相比，促進國際行銷管理課程取得更好的學習成果。 採用準實驗設計，25位控制組學生參與常規翻轉學習，25位實驗組學生參與翻轉學習與拼圖II法。 該實驗於 2021-2022 學年秋季學期在印尼的一所機構持續了六週。 使用問卷、測驗分數和訪談來收集資料。 研究結果表明，翻轉拼圖 II 比普通翻轉教室創造了更好的態度、動機、自我效能、高階思維能力、參與度和學習表現。 此外，就學習表現而言，翻轉學習和拼圖II方法對低能力和高能力學習者都有更大的有益影響。
abstract_en: Researchers have found that combining flipped learning with the jigsaw approach separately across courses at various educational levels has a positive impact. The use of flipped learning and the jigsaw II approach to nurture real-world marketing practice skills while increasing students’ learning outcomes in a marketing course, on the other hand, has received little attention. This research is predominantly aimed at exploring the utilization of an innovative pedagogical model of teaching methodology with the flipped learning and jigsaw II approach to promote better learning outcomes in the International Marketing Management course compared to regular flipped learning. A quasi-experimental study was used, with 25 control group students participating in the regular flipped learning and 25 experimental group students participating in flipped learning and the jigsaw II approach. The experiment lasted six weeks during the fall semester of the 2021-2022 academic year at an Indonesian institution. Questionnaires, test scores, and interviews were used to collect data. The findings show that flipped jigsaw II created considerably better attitude, motivation, self-efficacy, higher-order thinking skills, engagement, and learning performance than regular flipped classroom. Furthermore, in terms of learning performance, the flipped learning and jigsaw II approach had a greater beneficial influence on both low- and high-ability learners.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 芳香療法對中學教師工作壓力、睡眠品質與幸福感之影響
title_en: Effect of Aromatherapy on Work Stress, Sleep Quality, and Well-being for Middle School Teachers
keywords: 芳香療法、中學教師、工作壓力、睡眠品質、幸福感
abstract_zh: 工業5.0時代來臨，教師工作壓力問題成為主要身心議題，透過芳香療法協助中學教師減輕工作壓力、改善睡眠品質及增進幸福感，至為重要。本研究旨在探討中學教師使用芳香療法後對工作壓力、睡眠品質與幸福感之影響。研究目的如下：一、瞭解中學教師使用芳香療法「工作壓力、睡眠品質與幸福感」的滿意度。二、探討不同背景中學教師對使用芳香療法「工作壓力、睡眠品質與幸福感」滿意度的差異。三、探討芳香療法對中學教師「工作壓力、睡眠品質與幸福感」之影響。四、分析使用芳香療法中學教師「工作壓力、睡眠品質與幸福感」之相關情形。五、分析使用芳香療法中學教師「工作壓力」各構面對「睡眠品質與幸福感」之預測力。為符合上述目的，本研究以嘉義地區25歲以上中學教師為研究對象，進行不等組前後測實驗設計，分為實驗組A組「複方精油嗅吸 + 按摩」、B組「複方精油嗅吸」、C組「複方精油按摩」、D組「純基底油按摩」等四組，以及對照組E組「無任何芳香療法介入」，以探討中學教師使用芳香療法後對工作壓力、睡眠品質與幸福感的影響。本研究以自編「中學教師工作壓力量表」、「中學教師幸福感量表」及引用衛福部「匹茲堡睡眠品質量表」搜集資料。所得資料以描述性統計、獨立樣本t檢定、成對樣本t檢定、單因子異數分析、共變數分析、皮爾遜績差相關分析、逐步多元迴歸分析，本研究結論如下：一、中學教師使用芳香療法的「工作壓力」為能負擔範圍，「睡眠品質」有障礙及「幸福感」滿意程度普通。二、中學專任教師使用芳香療法的「幸福感」滿意度高於教師兼行政（含導師）及代理代課教師。三、中學教師使用芳香療法能減緩「工作壓力」、增進「睡眠品質」及提升「幸福感」；不同的芳香療法對減緩「工作壓力」、增進「睡眠品質」及提升「幸福感」有不同的功效。四、中學教師使用芳香療法的「工作壓力」與「睡眠品質」、「幸福感」具低度負相關，即「工作壓力」越小，「睡眠品質」越佳，「幸福感」越好。五、中學教師使用芳香療法「工作壓力」的「情感因素」、「心理因素」及「支持系統」構面對「睡眠品質」具預測力；「情感因素」、「心理因素」對「幸福感」具預測力。本研究所得提供芳香療法對中學教師工作壓力、睡眠品質與幸福感之實徵支持，對「主管教育行政機關」、「中等學校」及「中學教師」就芳香療法減輕中學教師工作壓力，增進睡眠品質，以及提升幸福感相關政策與實務應用等，有諸多助益。關鍵詞：芳香療法、中學教師、工作壓力、睡眠品質、幸福感
abstract_en: With the advent of the Industry 5.0 era, teachers’ work stress has become a major physical and mental issue. It is extremely important to help middle school teachers reduce work stress, improve sleep quality and enhance well-being through aromatherapy. This study aims to explore the impact of aromatherapy use on work stress, sleep quality and well-being among middle school teachers. The research objectives are as follows: 1. To understand the satisfaction of middle school teachers with work stress, sleep quality and well-being using aromatherapy. 2. To explore the differences in the satisfaction of middle school teachers with different backgrounds on the use of aromatherapy for work stress, sleep quality and well-being. 3. To explore the effects of aromatherapy on work stress, sleep quality and well-being of middle school teachers. 4. To analyze the situation of work stress, sleep quality and well-being of middle school teachers who use aromatherapy. 5. To analyze the predictive power of each component of work stress in middle school teachers using aromatherapy to sleep quality and well-being.To meet these objectives, this study focuses on middle school teachers aged 25 and above in the chiayi region, employing an experimental pre-test and post-test design. The groups are divided into four experimental groups A group (intervention compound essential oil sniffing plus massage), group B (compound essential oil sniffing), group C (compound essential oil massage), and group D (pure base oil massage), and the control group E group (without any aromatherapy intervention). The study investigates the impact of aromatherapy on work stress, sleep quality, and well-being among middle school teachers in the chiayi region. Data is collected using self-developed scales for middle school teacher work stress, middle school teacher well-being, and the ministry of health and welfare's pittsburgh sleep quality Index. The data obtained are based on descriptive statistics, paired sample t-test, independent sample t-test, single factor analysis, covariate analysis, pearson poor performance correlation analysis, and stepwise multiple regression analysis. The research conclusions are as follows:1.The work stress of middle school teachers who use aromatherapy is within the affordable range, the sleep quality is impaired, and the well-being satisfaction level is average.2.The satisfaction of the well-being of full-time middle school teachers using aromatherapy was higher than that of teachers, administrators (including tutors) and substitute teachers.3.Middle school teachers use aromatherapy to reduce work stress, improve sleep quality and enhance well-being, different aromatherapies have different effects on relieving work stress, improving sleep quality and enhancing well-being.4.There was a low negative correlation between work stress and sleep quality and well-being in the use of aromatherapy by secondary school teachers, the lower the work stress, the better the sleep quality and the better the well-being.5.Middle school teachers used the affective factors, psychological factors and support systems of aromatherapy to predict sleep quality and emotional factors and psychological factors to predict well-being.This research provides practical support for aromatherapy in the work stress, sleep quality and well-being of middle school teachers, and will be of great benefit to the policies and practical applications of aromatherapy for the competent education administration, middle schools and middle school teachers to reduce the work stress of middle school teachers, improve sleep quality, and enhance well-being.Keywords: aromatherapy, middle school teachers, work stress, sleep quality, well-being

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 全國高級中等學校技藝競賽美髮職種獲獎選手生涯自我效能之研究
title_en: A Study on the Career Self-Efficacy of Hairdressing Skills Competition Winners in National High School Skills Competition
keywords: 全國高級中等學校技藝競賽、生涯自我效能
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在瞭解選手如何評價自身之自我效能，並探索自我效能在職業興趣、選擇及定向中的影響，及職業生涯適應能力及職業生涯決策現象。研究對象選擇了參與「全國高級中等學校技藝競賽」家事類美髮職種選手之獲獎選手，並以質性研究方法紮根理論進行，藉由五位受訪者的分享，分析自我效能對生涯的相關影響。本研究發現美髮職種獲獎選手自我效能之評價結論如下：1.美髮領域選手國中時期多數學業低成就、自我效能低，升讀高中偏向選擇職業學校、2.美髮選手培訓過程指導老師的評價直接影響學生的自我效能認知，其他因素包含超越他人的成就感、3.美髮選手之參賽結果影響選手自我效能認知、4.多數美髮領域選手對自己在專業領域有較佳的自我效能；第二部分自我效能在職業興趣、職業選擇及職業定向中的影響獲致以下結論：1.美髮選手的初期職業興趣多來自家庭成員從事美髮相關工作或早期相關經驗所啟發、2.部份美髮選手在國中階段也曾表現出對其他職業的興趣，但在相關競賽活動中獲獎後，往往選擇專注美髮領域的發展、3.美髮選手會透過學校老師、家人和網路媒體的意見，綜合自己的觀點做出高中畢業後的職業選擇；而且選手們深刻認知美髮業現場實務經驗(學力)比學歷更為重要、4.美髮選手對於高中階段的訓練與競賽經歷普遍持正向態度，因此也更熱衷參與其他美髮競賽活動、5.多數選手認為美髮領域未來還有提升和發展的空間，因此高中畢業後的職志仍多傾向於美髮領域、6.美髮選手畢業後在職場上期望擁有較高層的職位，當面對機會時部份選手也能果斷地做出自行決定開業、換店或離職轉換跑道的決定；最後在職業生涯適應能力及職業生涯決策現象結論如下：1.美髮選手綜合評估生涯決策時會考量家庭、工作環境、學習資源、薪資以及自我實現等因素、2.顧客的正向回饋及業績成長是美髮選手選擇繼續從事美髮工作的主要激勵因素、3.美髮選手的職涯發展過程遭遇挫折時多能保有自信堅持的態度，以積極心態尋找解決辦法、4.美髮選手在職場上持續的學習進修並保持對流行趨勢的敏感性，有助於為因應職場環境的快速變遷。
abstract_en: This study aims to understand how individuals evaluate their own self-efficacy and explore the impact of self-efficacy on career interests, choices, orientation, as well as career adaptation abilities and career decision-making phenomena. The research focuses on award-winning participants in the "National High School Skills Competition" in the Hairdressing Skills Competition Winners, employing a qualitative research approach grounded in theory. Through interviews with five participants, the study analyzes the influence of self-efficacy on their careers.The findings regarding the Career Self-Efficacy assessment of Hairdressing Skills Competition Winners are as follows: 1. During junior high school, most participants had low academic achievement and low Career Self-Efficacy, leading them to choose vocational high schools. 2. The evaluation from teachers during the training process directly affects students' Career Self-Efficacy perceptions, along with factors such as a sense of achievement surpassing others. 3. The competition results significantly impact participants' Career Self-Efficacy perceptions. 4. Most Hairdressing Skills Competition Winners have a better Career Self-Efficacy in their professional field.The second part explores the influence of Career Self-Efficacy on career interests, choices, and orientation, yielding the following conclusions: 1. Early career interests in the hairdressing field often stem from family members' involvement or early experiences. 2. Despite showing interest in Other professions during junior high school, Hairdressing Skills Competition Winners tend to focus on developing their careers in the hairdressing field after winning competitions. 3. Hairdressing Skills Competition Winners consider opinions from school teachers, family members, and online media in making post-high school career choices. Practical experience in the hairdressing industry is perceived as more crucial than formal education. 4. Hairdressing Skills Competition Winners maintain a positive attitude towards training and competition experiences in high school, actively participating in other hairdressing competitions. 5. Most Hairdressing Skills Competition Winners believe there is room for improvement and development in the hairdressing field, leading them to lean towards a career in this area post-graduation. 6. After graduation, Hairdressing Skills Competition Winners aspire to higher positions in the workplace, with some making decisive choices such as starting their own business, changing salons, or switching career paths.In conclusion, regarding career adaptation abilities and career decision-making phenomena: 1. Hairdressing Skills Competition Winners consider various factors such as family, work environment, learning resources, salary, and self-realization when evaluating career decisions. 2. Positive feedback from clients and business growth are major motivating factors for Hairdressing Skills Competition Winners to continue working in the hairdressing industry. 3. Hairdressing Skills Competition Winners display a resilient attitude in the face of setbacks in their career development, actively seeking solutions with confidence. 4. Continuous learning and staying sensitive to fashion trends in the workplace contribute to adapting to the rapidly changing work environment.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 矯正機關收容人生命教育與技職教育之研究
title_en: The Study on Life Education and Vocational Education for Detainees in Correctional Institutions
keywords: 矯正機關收容人、生命教育、技職教育、社會復歸
abstract_zh: 因著觸犯國家刑罰，以致在法律的保障與規範下，收容人走進矯正機關，接受一系列矯正教育。然而矯正機關的功能，已經由消極性懲罰性的應報外，朝向積極矯正處遇發展：以教化矯正的預防性工作，來取代威嚇懲罰性的預防，俾令矯正能夠真正發揮長效，以降低收容人重返獄所的可能性，同時亦可促進社會安寧與秩序維護。換言之，矯正機關之隔離，是手段而不是目的，矯正教育亦必須以收容人之人權為核心而開展，終極目的乃是達成矯治教化之目的，以使收容人能夠順利復歸社會。本研究之進行立足於生命歷程犯罪學之理論基礎；研究目的聚焦於目前矯正機關中生命教育課程與技職教育課程之施行，檢視其對收容人之意義、發揮之功效以及於其回歸社會所產生之助力與支持。以雲林地區監獄收容人為研究對象，於2023年5-9月期間，經由對收容人的半結構式訪談法以及對負責實施課程之矯正工作者進行焦點團體訪談。以得到個人主觀敘述以及旁觀視角的佐證，並按犯罪學理論來加以分析。本研究成果共有三項：一、  服刑期間經由生命教育課程促使收容人重新省視自我定位並重置人我關係。二、  技職教育課程之推動賦予收容人於個人成長與謀生技能之雙向滿足。三、  生命教育與技職教育課程有機會成為收容人生命歴程之軌跡與轉變之雙因子。唯本研究亦因著研究方法之使用與研究場域之影響，而致出現限制，亦於本研究中加以說明。關鍵字：矯正機關收容人、生命教育、技職教育、社會復歸
abstract_en: As a result of the state's criminalization, the inmates, under the protection and regulation of the law, go to the correctional institutions to receive a series of correctional education. However, the function of the correctional institutions has changed from negative punitive response to positive correctional treatment. To Execute preventive correctional work replaces punitive prevention with correctional education, so that correctional treatment can really bring long-term effects to reduce the possibility of the inmates returning to prison, and at the same time promote the maintenance of social peace and order. In other words, the segregation of correctional institutions is a means, not an end, and correctional education must be carried out with the human rights of the inmates as the core, with the ultimate goal of achieving correctional education so that the inmates can return to the society smoothlyThis study is based on the theoretical foundation of life course criminology; the purpose of the study is to focus on the implementation of life education courses and technical education courses in correctional institutions. The study examined the meaning and effectiveness of the programs for the inmates and the assistance and support they had provided for their reintegration into society.The study was conducted from May to September 2023, using semi-structured interviews with inmates and focus group interviews with correctional workers responsible for implementing the programs. The results of this study were analyzed in terms of criminological theories in order to obtain corroboration of individual subjective narratives and peripheral perspectives. The results of this study are drawn as follows:1. The life education program during the incarceration period helped the inmates to re-examine their self-orientation and reset their relationships with others.2. The promotion of technical and vocational education programs empowers the inmates to achieve two-way satisfaction in personal growth and life skills.3. Life education and vocational education programs may become the trajectory of the life history of the inmates and the double factor of change.However, there are limitations in this study due to the use of research methodology and the influence of the research field, which are also explained in this study.KeyWords: Correctional Inmates, Life Education, Technical Education, Social Rehabilitation

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 技高家事類群時尚造型科建教生離職意向影響因素之研究
title_en: Fashion and Styling Department of Technical High School Housework Group A Study on the Factors Influencing Resignation Intention of Construction Education Students
keywords: 時尚造型、建教生、離職意向、專業技能
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在探討技高家事類群時尚造型科建教生離職意向影響之因素，採用混合方法研究設計、蒐集分析詮釋與研究主題相關之資料，並以量化研究為主，質性研究為輔。　　研究之主要目的：一、探討時尚造型科建教生「背景變相」與「離職意向」之關係；二、探討時尚造型科建教生「背景變相」與「專業技能」之關係；三、探討時尚造型科建教生「離職意向」與「專業技能」之關係。研究工具為自行設計發展並經由專家審查修定成正式測驗工具，包括:技高家事類群時尚造型科建教生「離職傾向量表」(α=.930)及技高家事類群時尚造型科建教生「專業技能量表」(α=.790)。　　問卷發出與回收均為400份，剔除填答不完整、不誠實填答之無效問卷27份，有效問卷計373份，回收率達100%、有效問卷達93%。施測所得數據資料，採以SPSS22.0 for windows 統計套裝軟體進行分析，主要研究發現: 一、技高家事類群時尚造型科建教生整體之離職意向「偏高」; 二、技高家事類群時尚造型科建教生整體之專業技能「偏低」;三、技高家事類群時尚造型科建教生專業技能與離職意向之間具顯著相關性且兩者之間呈現正相關。
abstract_en: The aim of this study is to explore the factors influencing turnover intention of cooperative educational student of fashion styling and design department of technical high school housework category. A mixed-method research design was adopted to collect, analyze, and interpret data related to the research topic, with quantitative research as the mainstay and qualitative research as the supplement.　　The main purposes of the study are: (1) to explore the relationship between “student’s turnover intention” and “student’s background”; (2) to explore the relationship between “student’s background” and “student’s professional skills”; (3) to explore the relationship between "student’s background " and "student’s professional skills". The research tools are self-designed and developed and revised into formal test tools after expert review which include "Turnover Intention Scale" (α=.930) and “Professional Skills Scale” (α=. 790) for the cooperative educational student of fashion styling and design department of technical high school housework category.　　A total of 400 questionnaires were sent out and returned. After excluding 27 invalid questionnaires with incomplete answers or dishonest answers, there were 373 valid questionnaires, with a recovery rate of 100% and a valid questionnaire rate of 93%. The data obtained from the test were analyzed using the SPSS 22.0 for Windows statistical software. The main research findings were as follows: (1)The overall turnover intention of cooperative educational student of fashion styling and design department of technical high school housework category is "on the high side"; (2)The overall professional skills of cooperative educational student of fashion styling and design department of technical high school housework category are relatively low; (3) For the cooperative educational student of fashion styling and design department of technical high school housework category, there is a significant correlation between the professional skills and their turnover intention, and there is a positive correlation between the two.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 印尼高等教育學術顧問職涯成就的回饋歷程研究
title_en: A Study of Feedback Process on Professional Career Achievement of Indonesia Higher Education Academic Advisors
keywords: 回饋、學術顧問、高等教育學術顧問的職業成就
abstract_zh: 在學習過程中，學生將面臨既有學術活動中的問題，也有來自學術活動以外的限制。在這裡，高等教育學術顧問的角色是引導學生剋服問題，直到完成他們的學業。本研究旨在探討回饋對高等教育學術顧問的專業職業成就的影響。 本研究的參與者為印尼主要公立大學的 5 位專業學術顧問。 資料分析的研究方法採用質性研究法，透過深入訪談獲取深入的畫面。研究顯示高等教育學術顧問的角色是多元的，不僅是解決學術問題，還在解決學生面臨的非學術問題中扮演重要角色。 本研究也強調了高等教育學術顧問提供的回饋在協助學生方面的重要性。 在指導活動中，必須提供某些類型的回饋，還有一些必須避免的，學術顧問需要有能力提供與每個學生的需求相適應的建設性和有意義的回饋。本研究強調了高等教育學術顧問在維護其回饋的品質和效果方面的作用。 本研究也提出了幾種實現這一目標的策略，包括維持良好的專業形象，評估回饋，並確保回饋提供者的能力。 這些策略有助於提高所提供回饋的價值和影響。 在學術顧問的專業發展方面，本研究概述了高等教育學術顧問提高其在提供回饋方面的品質和績效的各種途徑。 這包括符合標準化的知識、技能和工作態度，利用經驗，閱讀專業文獻，與同事分享經驗，並在提供回饋方面保持堅強。 這些策略涉及學術顧問的整體專業發展和成長。 回饋過程對學術顧問職涯的影響顯示，大學學術顧問提供的回饋對其職業發展產生了一些正面的結果。 這包括提供更好的回饋和及時的指導給畢業生，提高學生的質量，並增加對校園問題解決的貢獻。 這意味著學術顧問的職業成功與他們在提供回饋和促進學生成功方面的有效性有關。
abstract_en: In the learning process, students will face problems, both problems in academic activities and constraints from outside academic activities. Here the role of the higher education academic advisor  is  to  guide  students  to  overcome  the  problems  until  they  complete  their  studies.  This research aimed to explore the effect of feedback on the professional career achievement of higher education  academic  advisors.  The  participants  in  this  study  were  5  professional  academic advisors at  major public universities in  Indonesia. The  research method  for data analysis was carried out using qualitative research methods in in-depth interviews to get an in-depth picture.The research findings show that the role of higher education academic advisors is diverse, not  just  solving  academic  problems,  but  also  playing  an  important  role  in  overcoming  non-academic  problems  faced  by  students.  This  study  also  highlights  the  importance  of  feedback provided  by  higher  education  academic  advisors  in  assisting  students.  In  guiding  activities, certain  types  of  feedback  must  be  given,  and  also  some  that  must  be  avoided,  and  academicadvisors need to have the ability to provide constructive and meaningful feedback, tailored to the needs of each student. This research emphasizes the role of higher education academic advisors in maintaining the quality and effectiveness of their feedback. This research also suggests several strategies to achieve this, including maintaining a good professional image, evaluating feedback, and ensuring the competency of the feedback provider. These strategies contribute to increasing the  value  and  impact  of  the  feedback  provided.  In  the  professional  development  of  academicadvisors,  this  study  outlines  various  ways  for  higher  education  academic  advisors  to  improve their quality and performance in providing feedback. This includes knowledge, skills, and work attitudes  that  adhere  to  standardization,  utilizing  experience,  reading  professional  literature, sharing experiences  with colleagues, and being strong in providing feedback. These strategies relate to the overall professional development and growth of the academic advisor. The impact of the feedback process on the careers of academic advisors shows that the feedback provided by college academic advisors has several positive results on their career growth. This includes theability  to  provide  better  feedback,  and  timely  guidance  to  graduates,  improve  the  quality  of students,  and  increase  contributions  to  problem-solving  on  campus.  This  implies  that  the professional success of academic advisors is related to their effectiveness in providing feedback and contributing to student success.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 體育課程遠距教學關鍵發展因素探討 -使用兩階段混合模型
title_en: A Study of Key Development Factors for Remote Physical Education Curriculum - Using a Two-stage Mixed Model
keywords: 體育遠距教學、灰色理論、灰色決策實驗室分析法、灰色決策實驗室分析法之網路層級分析法
abstract_zh: 自COVID-19疫情爆發後，為確保學生教育權益，各國教育機構迅速轉向遠距教學，此方法廣被認為是疫情期間的最佳選擇。隨著人們日益重視健康，認知到強健體魄可降低感染風險，體育課程在遠距教學中的地位逐步提升。然而，遠距教學中的體育課程難以如同實體課堂般有效傳授學生團體合作和運動技巧。因此，尋找適切且有效的遠距體育教學策略及其關鍵因素，成為了一項至關重要的任務。本研究使用一個混合的多準則決策分析 (Multiple Criteria Decision-Making) 來討論上述體育課程遠距教學關鍵發展因素的評估問題。其中的維度和準則都經過項目分析、探索性因素分析、信度分析、及驗證性因素分析等統計方法的驗證，以保證其信賴性和效度。研究接著深入探討不同因素間的關聯和相對重要性。在分析過程中，我們特別採用灰色理論 (Grey Theory)，以更準確地捕捉專家在訪談中所表達的不確定性和樣本大小的限制。我們的模型涵蓋兩大階段，首先使用灰色決策實驗室分析法 (Grey Decision Making Trail and Evaluation Laboratory, GDEMATEL) 描述了各因素間的因果影響關係，並繪製了因果關係圖。其次，結合GDEMATEL的網路層級分析法 (GDEMATEL-based Analytic Network Process, GDANP) 來確定每一因素的相對權重和優先次序。研究結果發現，體育課程遠距教學具有12項關鍵發展因素，這些關鍵發展因素可建構成一套完善的評估框架。關鍵發展因素前五名分別為因應遠距教學的課程設計變更、成果成效評估機制、教學系統與設備、數位學習環境與風氣、組織或學校補助遠距教學經費；最重要的維度構面為教學內容。在各因素之間的相互影響關係，獲得教學應變能力、教學系統與設備、數位學習環境與風氣為主要影響的因，運動學習課程的基礎知識、師生互動與課程進度掌握、因應遠距教學的課程設計變更、成果成效評估機制為主要被影響的果。在這項研究，我們成功識別了體育課程遠距教學的核心發展因素。這個模型不僅具有可複製性，適用於多個領域，也可以應用到其他的遠距教學課程中。
abstract_en: Since the outbreak of the COVID-19 pandemic, educational institutions worldwide have implemented distance learning methods to minimize the loss of students' educational rights during the pandemic. Distance learning has been widely recognized as the best solution during such a crisis. In recent years, there has been an increasing awareness of the importance of health, as a strong physical condition can help reduce the risk of infection. As a result, physical education programs have gained more emphasis in the context of distance learning. However, teaching students group cooperation, physical postures, and skills through distance learning is challenging compared to traditional face-to-face classes. Therefore, it is crucial to identify key factors for the development of an effective and adaptable physical education curriculum for distance learning. This study proposes a hybrid approach that uses Multiple Criteria Decision-Making (MCDM) to evaluate the key factors for the development of a physical education curriculum in distance learning. A comprehensive evaluation framework was established, and the dimensions and criteria within the framework were rigorously analyzed using statistical techniques such as item analysis, exploratory factor analysis, reliability analysis, and confirmatory factor analysis to ensure their reliability and validity. The study then explored the relationships among the factors and determined the influence weights of the identified factors. Besides, the Grey Theory was incorporated into the analysis to effectively capture the uncertainty in expert responses during interviews and overcome the limitation of a small sample size. The proposed model consists of two stages. Firstly, a causal relationship diagram was constructed using the Grey Decision Making Trail and Evaluation Laboratory (GDEMATEL) to describe the interdependencies and influences among the factors. Then, the GDEMATEL-based Analytic Network Process (GDANP) was applied to determine the influence weights and prioritize the factors. The model was demonstrated with a focus on educational institutions at various levels in Taiwan. The study results suggest that there are 12 key development factors for distance learning in physical education, and these key development factors can be constructed into a complete evaluation framework. The top five key development factors are changes in curriculum design in response to distance learning, evaluation mechanisms for outcomes and effectiveness, teaching systems and equipment, digital learning environments and culture, and subsidies from organizations or schools for distance learning funds. The most important dimension is instructional content. In terms of the mutual influence among various factors, the main influencing causes are the acquisition of teaching adaptability, teaching systems and equipment, as well as digital learning environments and culture. The main influenced effects are the basic knowledge of the sports learning curriculum, teacher-student interaction and course progress control, changes in curriculum design for distance learning, and evaluation mechanisms for outcomes and effectiveness. The results indicate that the study successfully identifies the key factors for the development of physical education curricula in distance learning. Moreover, the model demonstrated in this research is replicable and applicable in different fields, as well as other distance learning programs.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 課綱及升學考試內容影響教師教學導向之探索性研究─以108課綱技高數學科課程為例
title_en: An Exploratory Study for the Impact of the Curriculum Design Contents of the Entrance Exam on Vocational Educator's Teaching Method and Attitude ─ Perspective from 108 Curriculum Math Teachers
keywords: 108課綱、考試引導教學、數學科學、技高、教學現場、素養課程認知、認同落差
abstract_zh: 現行的108課綱屬於全面性的改革，自其實施以來，從政策公布到教學現場課程的落實，再以入學測驗三個階段進行成果評量來看，教學現場是政策目的達成的最大變數。本研究主要希望透過與技術型高級中等學校(簡稱技高)數學科在職教師深度實地訪談，彙整並歸納初級資料後，對於影響技高數學科教學現場實踐教育政策的因素進行初探，以提供未來教學端或相關研究之參考。本研究之研究設計主要參照文獻分析法、半結構式實地訪談法並輔以質性研究輔助軟體進行分析。透過紀錄深度訪談北、中、南、東、外島及公私立技高等十位具有十年以上教學經驗之教師初級資料，再經由MAXQDA研究軟體歸納後，研究初探的結果可歸納為：1.技高數學科教師對課綱素養認知程度雖屬中偏高，認同度尚可，但視教授學生背景、教學年資有所不同；2.在各項配套下，課堂時數尤多有不足，而教材仍多以教科書或參考書為主；3.數學科成績較好的班級，多以升學測驗題型模擬練習，教學方向通常多以入學測驗為標的。
abstract_en: The current Curriculum Guidelines of Year 2019 Ministry of Education, implemented as a comprehensive reform, have undergone three stages of evaluation, including policy announcement, curriculum implementation in the teaching environment, and assessment through entrance examinations. Among these stages, the teaching environment stands out as the most influential factor in achieving the goals of the policy. This study aims to explore the factors influencing the implementation of educational policies in the teaching environment of the Mathematics subject in vocational senior high schools. To achieve the research goal, primary data was collected through interviews with in-service teachers of Mathematics in vocational senior high schools. The findings of this study are expected to provide insights and serve as a reference for future teaching practices and related research.The research design of this study primarily adopts literature analysis, semi-structured field interviews, and qualitative research software for analysis. The primary data was collected through in-depth interviews with ten teachers who have more than ten years of teaching experience in vocational senior high schools, including those located in the northern, central, southern, and eastern regions of Taiwan, as well as the outlying islands, and both public and private institutions. Results of the preliminary investigation, summarized using MAXQDA research software, can be categorized as follows: 1. Vocational senior high school mathematics teachers exhibit a moderate to high level of perception regarding the content of the competency-driven curriculum, with varying degrees of acceptance based on students' backgrounds and teachers' teaching experience. 2. Despite the availability of supporting materials, there is still a lack of sufficient class hours. Textbooks and reference books remain the primary teaching resources. 3. Classes of students with better performance in mathematics often focus on simulated practice tests that align with entrance examinations, shaping the teaching direction.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 新住民子女母國連繫情懷之研究
title_en: A Study on The Attachment of Immigrants’ Children with Mother Countries
keywords: 新住民子女、母國、母國情懷
abstract_zh: 本研究為新住民子女母國連繫與情懷，期以此研究透過訪談以及教學現場觀察來進行探討並了解新住民子女母國連繫與情懷。本研究背景是因教育部統計資料顯示新住民子女學生數上升，且因教學現場一直都能接觸到新住民子女，故對其在母國族群認同和情懷表現的情況就值得探討。因近年多有推動新住民多元文化活動，足見新住民子女在參與活動和分享母國經驗所顯現的自信和大方。研究目的在於期以透過訪談法和參與觀察，進行探討族群認同及雙國籍、多元文化、文化資本等，藉以了解新住民子女學生對於母國人、事和物互動與生活經驗之研究。研究對象為研究者教學的國中九年級學生和七年級生，九年級七位，七年級二位，共九位研究對象。研究方法使用質性研究法，實施過程採半結構式訪談法，將訪談資料及參與觀察資訊蒐集整理加以詮釋分析。    研究結果發現：一、新住民子女對族群認同的狀況，因與母國親人的良善互動，促使其對母國族群認同更深刻，且與親人有持續性的聯繫。但，回母國次數會使新住民子女對母國情懷有不同的表現。二、新住民子女學生相當樂於分享母國經驗，也因此過程揭露自我並更能認同母國文化，且聽者亦樂於聽其分享，由此有多元文化交流的展現。三、新住民子女學生因具有學習母國語言的資源，能在適當情境展現語文能力。因此對未來的職涯可能會有更多元的想法並懂得如何善用母國文化資本中的資源。
abstract_en: This study is about the connection and feelings of the children of new residents with their home countries. This study aims to explore and understand the connection and feelings of the children of new residents with their home countries through interviews and teaching on-site observations. The background of this study is that statistics from the Ministry of Education show that the number of students with children of new residents has increased, and since the children of new residents are always exposed to the teaching site, their expression of ethnic identity and feelings in their home country is worth exploring. In recent years, many multicultural activities have been promoted for new residents, which shows the confidence and generosity shown by the children of new residents in participating in activities and sharing their experiences in their home country. The purpose of the research is to explore ethnic identity, dual nationality, multiculturalism, cultural capital, etc. through interview methods and participant observation, so as to understand the interaction and life experience of the children of new residents on people, things and things in their home country. The research subjects are ninth-grade students and seventh-grade students taught by the researcher, seven in ninth grade and two in seventh grade, a total of nine research subjects. The research method used qualitative research method, and the implementation process adopted semi-structured interview method. The interview data and participant observation information were collected, organized, interpreted and analyzed.    The research results that:1. The ethnic identity of the children of new residents. The good interactions with their relatives in the home country have prompted them to have a deeper identification with the ethnic group in their home country and have continuous connections with their relatives. However, the number of times they return to their home country will affect the children of new residents’ affection for their home country. 2. Students who are the children of new residents are quite willing to share their experiences in their home country. As a result, they reveal themselves in the process and are more able to identify with the culture of their home country. The listeners are also willing to listen to their sharing, thus demonstrating multicultural exchanges.3. Students who are children of new residents have the resources to learn the language of their home country and can demonstrate their language skills in appropriate situations. Therefore, they have more diverse ideas about their future careers and probably know how to make good use of the resources in the cultural capital of their home country.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 運算思維方法融入英語寫作翻轉教室對學生情感和認知領域之影響
title_en: Integrating Computational Thinking Approach into Flipped Classroom of English Writing to Influence Students’ Affective and Cognitive Domains
keywords: 翻轉課堂、英語寫作、運算思維、情感領域、寫作焦慮、寫作動機、學習投入、學習滿意度、認知領域、高階思維、寫作表現
abstract_zh: 這項研究探討了在英語寫作教學背景下，將運算思維（CT）方法整合到翻轉課堂（FC）教學中。CT與英語寫作有若干共通之處，如問題解決、計劃、抽象化和評估。這項研究致力於在教授CT方法和FC指導於英語寫作方面橋接一個關鍵的差距。這種整合允許探索學生情感和認知領域之間的複雜相互作用。這項研究採用了準實驗設計，涉及實驗組29名參與者和對照組29名參與者。在此，採用了參數測試來比較兩種教學策略中學生情感和認知領域的差異。結構方程模型（SEM）分析被用於確定在使用CT方法於FC教學的學生中，寫作焦慮、寫作動機、學習投入、學習滿意度、高階思維、和寫作表現之間的顯著關係。研究發現顯示，與對照組相比，這種整合顯著地改善了實驗組學生的情感和認知領域，包括寫作焦慮、寫作動機、學習投入、學習滿意度、高階思維、和整體寫作表現。這種教學方法還促進了實驗組參與者CT技能的培養。此外，SEM分析顯示，學習參與可以顯著且正面地影響高階思維和寫作表現。因此，CT方法有助於學生發展他們的英語寫作技能。
abstract_en: This study explores the integration of the Computational Thinking (CT) approach within Flipped Classroom (FC) instruction in the context of English writing instruction. CT and English writing have several commonalities, such as problem-solving, planning, abstraction, and evaluation. This study endeavors to bridge a critical gap in teaching the CT approach and FC instruction in English writing. This integration allows for an exploration of the complex interplay between student affective and cognitive domains. A quasi-experimental design was employed in this study, involving 29 participants in the experimental group and 29 participants in the control group. In which a parametric test was employed to compare student affective and cognitive domains between two instructional strategies. Structural equation model (SEM) analysis was employed to determine the significant relationship between writing anxiety, writing motivation, learning engagement, learning satisfaction, higher-order thinking, and writing performance among the students who use the CT approach in FC instruction. The findings reveal that this integration significantly improves student affective and cognitive domains in the experimental group compared to the control group, including writing anxiety, motivation, engagement, satisfaction, higher-order thinking, and overall writing performance. This pedagogical approach also promotes the cultivation of CT skills among experimental group participants. Moreover, the SEM analysis showed that learning engagement can significantly and positively influence higher-order thinking and writing performance. Therefore, the CT approach helps students develop their English writing skills.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 高級中等學校學務主任工作壓力、角色知覺、工作投入與職業倦怠之相關研究
title_en: A Study on the Relationships among Work Stress, Role Perception, Work Engagement, and Job Burnout of the Directors of Students’ Affairs in Secondary Schools
keywords: 高級中等學校學務主任、工作壓力、角色知覺、工作投入、職業倦怠
abstract_zh: 摘 要本研究旨在探討高級中等學校學務主任工作壓力、角色知覺、工作投入及職業倦怠之現況及其關係，根據文獻探討結果擬定研究架構，完成「高級中等學校學務主任工作壓力、角色知覺、工作投入及職業倦怠相關研究」之問卷編製，利用問卷調查法蒐集所需資料，共得363份以111學年度現仍在職的學務主任為研究對象的有效樣本。並採用「個人基本資料」、「工作壓力」、「角色知覺」、「工作投入」與「職業倦怠」等量表作為施測工具，以相關的統計方法進行分析，進而歸納研究結果與發現，以暸解高級中等學校學務主任工作壓力、角色知覺、工作投入及職業倦怠之現況與影響因素。採描述統計、t考驗、單因子變異數分析、皮爾森積差相關分析及結構方程模式等統計方法進行分析。根據研究發現，歸納結論如下：一、高級中等學校學務主任的角色知覺與工作投入的感受程度高，且工作壓力與職業倦怠的狀況並不嚴重。二、不同背景變項對工作壓力、角色知覺、工作投入及職業倦怠均具有顯著的差異。三、高級中等學校學務主任工作壓力、角色知覺、工作投入及職業倦怠間具有顯著的相關性。四、高級中等學校學務主任續任意願與工作壓力、角色知覺、工作投入、職業倦怠之間均具有關聯性。五、高級中等學校學務主任的工作壓力可顯著地預測職業倦怠；角色知覺對工作壓力影響職業倦怠具有顯著的中介效果，而工作投入對於工作壓力影響職業倦怠的中介效果並不明顯。最後，根據研究結論提出各項建議，作為有相關教育主管當局、學校行政、高級中等學校學務主任及未來相關研究之參考。關鍵詞： 高級中等學校學務主任、工作壓力、角色知覺、工作投入、職業倦怠
abstract_en: Abstract     The purpose of this study was to explore the current situation of work stress, role perception, work engagement, and job burnout among the directors of students’ affairs in secondary schools and their relationships with each other. Method of Questionnaire Survey Research was adopted in this study, instruments including a set of scales on “Demographics”, " Work Stress", " Role Perception", " Work Engagement", and " Job Burnout" to gather available information to analyze the results and findings of the study. A total of 363 valid samples were collected from the in-service directors of students’ affairs in the 111th school year to understand the current situation and factors influencing work stress, role perceptions, work engagement, and job burnout of them. These data were statistically analyzed by Descriptive Statistics, t-test, One-way ANOVA, Pearson’s Product-moment Correlation, and Structural Equation Models, SEM. The conclusions of this study were summarized as follows: First, the role perceptions and work engagement of directors of students’ affairs in secondary schools were high, and the work stress and job burnout were not serious. Second, there were significant differences in job stress, role perception, job engagement, and burnout among different demographic variables. Third, there were significant correlations between work stress, role perception, work engagement, and job burnout among directors of students’ affairs in secondary schools. Fourth, there were correlations among turnover intention and work stress, role perception, work engagement, and job burnout. Fifth, work stress might be viewed as a significant predictor of burnout on the directors of students’ affairs in secondary schools, while role perception could also significantly mediate the effect of work stress on job burnout, whereas job engagement did not have a significant mediating effect of job stress on burnout. Finally, based on the above findings, the suggestions were made to provide for reference of the relevant educational authorities, school administrators, directors of student affairs in secondary schools, and future studies.Keywords:  directors of students’ affairs in secondary schools, work stress,   role perception, work engagement, job burnout

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 休閒相關學系大學生就業職能、職業興趣、職涯決定之 相關模式研究：基本心理需求及社會支持之調節效果
title_en: A Study on Correlation Model of Competence, Vocational Interest and Career Decision Making for Leisure and Recreation-related Department Students - The Moderating Effect of Basic Psychological Needs and Social Support
keywords: 核心能力、生涯認知、自我決定、生涯支持
abstract_zh: 隨著經濟的發展，與社會型態的轉變，休閒活動受到人們的高度重視，休閒產業也因應這股潮流蓬勃發展，促使休閒產業人才需求的增加。因此各大學也因應市場需求相繼設立休閒相關系所。然而大學教育與學生職業生涯有著密不可分的關係，尤其在相關職能課程設計應兼顧學生職業興趣與職涯發展輔導方面，必能影響相關學系學生未來投入休閒相關領域職業的意願。本研究欲探討休閒相關學系大學生就業職能、職業興趣與職涯決定之關係，並進一步瞭解基本心理需求、社會支持與就業職能、職業興趣對職涯決定之調節效果。共取得640份問卷，採用描述性統計、獨立樣本t檢定、單因子變異數分析與偏最小平方法進行統計分析，研究結果發現：一、個人背景變項與就業職能、職業興趣、職涯決定、基本心理需求、社會支持等研究變項有部分顯著差異存在二、就業職能對職業興趣具有正向顯著影響三、就業職能對職業決定具有正向顯著影響四、職業興趣對職業決定具有正向顯著影響五、基本心理需求在就業職能、職業興趣與職業決定有部分調節效果六、社會支持在就業職能、職業興趣與職業決定具有調節效果。最後依據研究結果，提出具體建議，提供大學相關學系課程設計與編排、教師職涯輔導工作、大學生自我認識與未來相關研究參考。
abstract_en: As the economy develops and social patterns change, leisure activities have been highly valued by people, and the leisure industry has flourished in response to this trend, causing the demand for talents in the leisure industry to increase. Therefore, several universities have successively established leisure and recreation-related departments in response to market demand. However, university education is closely related to students' career development, especially in terms of curriculum design for relevant professional courses, which should take into account students' vocational interests and career development guidance. This will inevitably affect the willingness of students in related departments to enter the leisure industry in the future.This study aims to explore the relations between competence, career interests, and career decision-making of university students majoring in leisure and recreation-related departments and further understand the moderating effects of basic psychological needs, social supports, competence, and vocational interests on career decision making.A total of 640 questionnaires were collected, and descriptive statistics, the independent sample t-test, one-way ANOVA, and the partial least squares method were used for statistical analysis.The results of the study found out1. There are partial significant differences between personal background variables and research variables including competence, vocational interests, career decision making, basic psychological needs, and social supports2. There is a positive and significant impact of competence on career interests3. There is a positive and significant impact of competence on career decision making4. There is a positive and significant impact of  Vocational interests on career decision making5. There is a partial moderating effect of  basic psychological needs on competence, vocational interests, and career decision making6. There is a moderating effect of social supports on competence, vocational interests, and career decision making.Finally, according to the research results, specific recommendations are made for the design and arrangement of courses in relevant university departments, teachers' career counseling work, university students' self-cognition, and future research on related issues.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 線上課輔國小學童學習投入之研究
title_en: A Study of the Learning Engagement of Online Course of Elementary School Students
keywords: 線上課輔、線上同步教學之策略、學習投入
abstract_zh: 隨著線上課程的普及和教學模式的轉變，線上課輔老師在線上教學中扮演著重要的角色。本研究旨在探討學童在參與線上課程時的學習投入程度及探討線上課輔老師在執行線上課程時的經驗並從中了解線上課輔老師在教學方法和互動模式上的調整。為了達到研究目的，採用質性研究方法，包括半結構式訪談和課室觀察，以收集相關資料。研究對象為六位國小三年級學生，觀察他們在線上課程中的學習投入情況。根據研究結果，我們得出以下四個結論：一、線上課輔老師在教學前須調整教學模式及教材呈現方式二、線上課輔老師設計不同難度之挑戰任務，能提升學生認知投入。三、線上課輔老師以身作則示範行為投入讓學生仿效，能提升學生行為投入。四、線上課輔老師營造正面積極的上課氣氛，能感染學生正向情緒投入。最後本研究依據研究結果，針對教學方面及未來研究提出建議。
abstract_en: With the popularity of online courses and the transformation of teaching models, online tutors play an important role in online teaching. The purpose of this study is to explore the degree of learning engagement of students when participating in online courses, explore the experience of online tutors in implementing online courses, and understand the adjustments of online tutors in teaching methods and interaction modes. In order to achieve the research purpose, qualitative research methods, including semi-structured interviews and classroom observations, were used to collect relevant data. The subjects of the study were six third-grade elementary school students, and observed their learning engagement in online courses. Based on the research results, we draw the following four conclusions:1. Online tutoring teachers must adjust the teaching mode and presentation of teaching materials before teaching2. Online tutors design challenging tasks of different difficulty, which can enhance students' cognitive investment.3. Online tutoring teachers set an example to demonstrate behavioral engagement for students to follow, which can improve students' behavioral engagement.4. Online tutors create a positive class atmosphere, which can infect students with positive emotional investment.Finally, based on the research results, this study puts forward suggestions for teaching and future research.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 高職美容科學生技能學習復原力影響因素之研究
title_en: Research on Influencing Factors of Resilience in Skills Learning of Higher Vocational Cosmetology Students
keywords: 高職美容科、自我效能、社會支持、目標導向、技能學習復原力
abstract_zh: 本研究目的在瞭解高職美容科學生技能學習復原力影響因素之現況，針對不同背景變項研究之差異情形，最後探討其相關性，研究對象為高職美容科學生，並採便利抽樣方式進行電子問卷之調查，共回收312份有效問卷進行統計分析。研究使用描述性統計、項目分析、因素分析、獨立樣本t檢定、單因子變異數分析、皮爾森積差相關及多元逐步迴歸分析來進行資料分析。研究結果如下:一、不同背景變項在學生技能學習復原力中有部分顯著的差異存在。二、自我效能與技能學習復原力有顯著相關性。三、社會支持與技能學習復原力有顯著相關性。四、自我效能與社會支持對目標導向有顯著的預測力。五、目標導向在自我效能、社會支持與技能學習復原力中有部分中介預測力。
abstract_en: The research aim is understanding the status of the influencing factors of higher vocational college students' ability to learn skills, and to investigate the differences in different research backgrounds, and finally to explore its correlation. , a total of 312 valid forms were recovered for statistical analysis.The study used descriptive statistics, item analysis, component analysis, independent sample testing, single gene analysis of variance, Pearson product difference correlation and multiple regression analysis to conduct data analysis. The research results are as follows: 1. There are some significant differences in the complex ability of students' skill learning in different background change items. Second, there is a significant correlation between self-awareness and skill learning compound ability. 3. There is a significant correlation between social support and skill learning compound ability. 4. Self-expression and social support have significant predictive power on goal orientation. 5. Goal orientation has some inherent predictive power in self-expression, social support and skill learning compound ability.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 雲林縣安心即時上工計畫實施之CIPP評鑑模式研究
title_en: A Study on the CIPP Evaluation Model Analysis for the An-sin Program of Getting to Work in Yunlin County.
keywords: 雲林縣、安心即時上工計畫、CIPP評鑑模式、認同度
abstract_zh: 近年來深受新冠疫情之影響，造成全球經濟供給面及需求面受到雙重打擊，而透過相關就業輔導方案改善失業問題及穩定就業，為當前公共就業服務至關重要政策。本研究旨在以CIPP評鑑模式探討雲林縣安心即時上工計畫實施之研究，冀望透過對計畫執行的調查分析，探討計畫在背景、輸入、過程及成果之認同度及影響。研究目的如下：一、瞭解進用人員對安心即時上工計畫背景評鑑、輸入評鑑、過程評鑑及成果評鑑的認同度。二、探討進用人員對安心即時上工計畫背景評鑑、輸入評鑑、過程評鑑及成果評鑑認同度的差異情形。三、分析進用人員對安心即時上工計畫背景評鑑、輸入評鑑、過程評鑑及成果評鑑的相關情形。四、分析進用人員對安心即時上工計畫背景評鑑、輸入評鑑、過程評鑑及成果評鑑變項影響關係模式。為了達到上述目的，本研究以雲林縣安心即時上工計畫之計畫人員為研究對象，以自編「安心即時上工計畫實施之CIPP評鑑模式調查問卷」對計畫人員進行資料蒐集，回收有效問卷315份，有效問卷回收率為100%，將蒐集的資料進行描述性統計、獨立樣本t檢定、單因子變異數分析、相關分析、結構方程模式分析驗證獲得以下研究結果：一、安心即時上工計畫背景評鑑、輸入評鑑、過程評鑑及成果評鑑皆為高度認同，變項中各構面最高者，分別為「計畫背景」、「行政配合事項」、「對象參與情形」、「目標達成程度」。二、不同用人單位、特定身分、累積工作年資對「背景評鑑」、「輸入評鑑」、「過程評鑑」及「成果評鑑」的認同度部分具有顯著差異。三、CIPP評鑑模式「背景評鑑」、「輸入評鑑」、「過程評鑑」與「成果評鑑」認同度有顯著高度正相關；各構面與整體及各構面間之相關皆為中度至高度正相關。四、CIPP評鑑模式具直接影響關係，背景評鑑對輸入評鑑具有影響力；輸入評鑑對過程評鑑具有影響力；過程評鑑對成果評鑑具有影響力；背景評鑑對成果評鑑具有影響力。最後，根據研究結果，提出具體建議，供勞政主管機關、公立就業服務機構及用人單位執行及改進計畫之參考。
abstract_en: In recent years, the global economy has been affected by the new epidemic, resulting in a double blow to both the supply and demand sides of the economy. The purpose of this study is to investigate the recognition of the program and the effectiveness of the An-sin program of getting to work immediately among related personnel in Yunlin County, and to investigate the impact and satisfaction of the program in terms of background, input, process, and results through the survey and analysis of the program implementation. The objectives of the study are as follows:1.To understand the current status of the recognition of the background, input, process, and result evaluation of the An-sin program of getting to work immediately among related personnel. 2. To explore the differences in the recognition of the background, input, process and outcome evaluation of the An-sin Program of Getting to Work Immediately among related personnel. 3. To analyze the background, input, process, and outcome evaluations of the An-sin program of getting to work immediately among related personnel. 4. To analyze the relationship patterns between the background evaluation, input evaluation, process evaluation, and outcome evaluation components of the An-sin program of getting to work immediately among related personnel.In order to achieve the above purpose, this study takes the planners of the Yunlin County Safe and Immediate Work Project as the research object, and uses the self-compiled " A study on the cipp evaluation model analysis the An-sin program of getting to work immediately among related personnel in Yunlin County" to evaluate the project The personnel collected data, recovered 315 valid questionnaires, and the effective questionnaire recovery rate was 100%. The collected data were subjected to descriptive statistics, independent sample t test, single factor analysis of variance, correlation analysis, and structural equation model analysis to obtain the following research result:1. Start working with peace of mind. Project background evaluation, input evaluation, process evaluation, and achievement evaluation are all highly recognized. The highest levels of each aspect are "plan background", "administrative cooperation items", and "participation of objects". Circumstances” and “Goal Achievement Degree”.2. There were significant differences in context evaluation, input evaluation, process evaluation and product evaluation among different employers, specific status and accumulated work experience.3. CIPP evaluation model "context evaluation", "input evaluation", "process evaluation" and "product evaluation " have a significant positive correlation; the correlation between each aspect and the whole and each aspect is moderate to be highly positively correlated.4. CIPP evaluation mode has direct influence on input evaluation, input evaluation has influence on process evaluation, process evaluation has influence on outcome evaluation, background evaluation has influence on outcome evaluation.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 線上社群學習環境對於減少科大生之英語口說焦慮及提升英語簡報能力之研究
title_en: Creating an Online Community-based Context to Reduce College Students’ Speaking Anxiety and Improve English Oral Presentation
keywords: 線上學習社群學習環境、英語簡報、英語口說焦慮、同儕反饋及評量、同儕互改
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在探討以英語為第二外語（EFL）之科大學生如何透過線上學習社群學習環境降低其英語口說焦慮，並提升其英語簡報能力。本研究共招募七十二名科大學生在線上學習社群學習系統中進行同儕互改、同儕反饋及評量。參與者被隨機分為實驗組及對照組。蒐集資料包括：英語簡報之前後測成績、英語簡報講稿之初稿及最終稿、紙本學習記錄、線上學習社群學習系統之同儕互改過程的線上學習記錄、英語簡報評分表、英語口說焦慮量表（FLSA）之前後測，與開放式問卷調查。研究結果顯示，在線上學習社群學習環境中，線上同儕互改有效地輔助實驗組學生降低其英語口說焦慮，對照組則反之。研究結果亦進一步發現，使用線上學習社群學習系統之學生在其英語簡報內容之引言、正文、結論、簡報架構之邏輯發展、演說技巧之肢體語言活力、英語口語清晰度與流暢度，及觀眾互動方面皆優於對照組學生之表現。因線上學習社群系統組之學生經歷了更多的多重社會互動（multiple social interaction）與自我反思（self-reflection），故產出品質大幅提升之最終簡報講稿及英語簡報。然使用傳統紙筆方式的對照組學生在其英語簡報內容與簡報架構方面，幾乎沒有作出任何大幅修改，他們僅依照同儕的反饋訂正了文法錯誤。線上學習社群學習環境之同儕互改、同儕反饋和評量有效地促進以英語為第二外語之科大學生進行更頻繁的多重社會互動，包含；開放式溝通（open communication）、情感之表達（emotional expression），及團隊凝聚力（group cohesion），因學習系統具不受時間與空間之限制優勢，故學生可以更深度地自我反思學習問題，進行個人化的學習干預（personalized learning intervention），最終達到減少英語口說焦慮，並提升其英語簡報能力之目的。
abstract_en: Aiming to investigate how English as a Foreign Language (EFL) technological college students reduced speaking anxiety and improved oral presentation, this study involved seventy-two participants in an online community-based context to undergo peer review with peer feedback and assessment. The participants were randomly assigned to the control and experimental groups. Data comprised the participants’ first and final presentation scripts and scores, paper-based records, log files on the online community-based system documenting peer review process, evaluation rubric, pre- and post-survey of Foreign Language Speaking Anxiety (FLSA), and an open-ended questionnaire. The results showed that the online community-based peer review effectively assisted the students in the experimental group to reduce their FLSA, while the students in the control group did not. It was found the students in the online community-based group outperformed the students in the control group in the dimensions of introduction, body, conclusion, logical development, body vitality, speech clarity and fluency, and awareness of audience needs. The online community-based group experienced multiple social interaction and self-reflection to a greater extent and produced better quality final scripts and oral presentation while the paper-and-pencil-based group made few revisions in content and structure. They merely corrected grammatical mistakes based on peers’ feedback. Peer review with peer feedback and assessment in the online community-based context facilitates EFL technological college students to access more multiple social interaction with open communication, emotional expression, and group cohesion without time and space limitations, self-reflect on learning problems, and make further personalized learning intervention in reducing speaking anxiety and improving oral presentation.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 線上3D數位軟體融入基礎圖學實習課程提升技術型高中學生圖學能力、空間旋轉能力與空間能力之研究
title_en: Integrating Online 3D Digital Software into Basic Graphics Practice Course to Enhance Technical High School Students' Graphic Abilities, Spatial Rotation Abilities, and Spatial Abilities
keywords: 圖學教育、圖學能力、空間能力、線上3D數位軟體
abstract_zh: 隨著數位科技的進步，許多線上3D數位軟體的功能也越來越完善，可以清楚展示物件的特徵，讓使用者能容易理解圖形細節，而資訊科技融入教學已成為教育的趨勢之一，如何將線上3D數位軟體與傳統課程結合，協助教師提升教學成效，幫助學生建立專業知識、提高學習成效，便成為一個可以深入探討的方向。本研究旨在探討應用線上3D數位軟體於基礎圖學實習課程對技術型高中一年級學生在圖學能力、空間旋轉能力、空間能力以及課程滿意度之影響。本研究採準實驗研究法，研究對象為高雄某市立技術型高中一年級兩個班級，共計60名學生，進行兩週的實驗教學。實驗組採線上3D數位軟體融入基礎圖學實習課程教學策略，對照組採傳統的基礎圖學實習課程教學策略。教學內容為運用線上3D數位軟體，融入基礎圖學實習課程，與研究者自行設計之課程內容進行教學。其線上3D數位軟體的特色，即是在網路上取得方便、免付費、易上手，可以讓學生在學習圖學知識的過程中，輔助學生學習、協助教師展示教材。研究結果:一、基礎圖學實習課程應用不同教學策略於技術型高中一年級學生圖學能力之提升，實驗組高於對照組，有顯著成效。二、基礎圖學實習課程應用不同教學策略於技術型高中一年級學生空間旋轉能力之提升，實驗組高於對照組，有顯著成效。三、基礎圖學實習課程應用不同教學策略於技術型高中一年級學生空間能力之提升，實驗組高於對照組，有顯著成效。四、基礎圖學實習課程應用不同教學策略於技術型高中一年級學生之課程滿意度，兩組皆有顯著成果，深入分析兩組學生課程滿意度總分的平均差異不顯著，意即課程滿意度，兩組學生沒有顯著的差異。
abstract_en: With the advancement of digital technology, many online 3D digital software applications have become increasingly sophisticated in their features, allowing for clear display of object characteristics and facilitating users' understanding of graphical details.
