The integration of information technology into education has become one of the trends in the field, and exploring the integration of online 3D digital software with traditional curricula has become a direction worth exploring. This study aims to investigate the impact of applying online 3D digital software in a foundational graphics lab course on the graphic abilities, spatial rotation abilities, spatial abilities, and course satisfaction of tenth grade students in a technical high school. The study adopts a quasi-experimental research design and includes two classes of tenth grade students from a municipal technical high school in Kaohsiung, totaling 60 students, who participate in a two-week experimental teaching intervention. The experimental group incorporates online 3D digital software into the instructional strategies of the foundational graphics lab course, while the control group follows traditional instructional strategies for the course. The instructional content involves utilizing online 3D digital software to supplement the foundational graphics lab course and is delivered using curriculum materials designed by the researchers. The distinguishing features of the online 3D digital software include its convenient web-based accessibility, free availability, and user-friendly interface, which assist students in their learning process and facilitate teachers in presenting instructional materials. The research findings are as follows: 1. Applying different instructional strategies in the foundational graphics lab course significantly improves the graphic abilities of tenth grade students in a technical high school, with the experimental group outperforming the control group.2. Applying different instructional strategies in the foundational graphics lab course significantly enhances the spatial rotation abilities of tenth grade students in a technical high school, with the experimental group outperforming the control group. 3. Applying different instructional strategies in the foundational graphics lab course significantly enhances the spatial abilities of tenth grade students in a technical high school, with the experimental group outperforming the control group. 4.Applying different instructional strategies in the foundational graphics lab course leads to significant improvements in course satisfaction for tenth grade students in a technical high school in both the experimental and control groups. Further analysis reveals no significant difference in the average total score of course satisfaction between the two groups, indicating that there is no significant disparity in course satisfaction between the two groups of students.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 台灣創業家成功關鍵因素研究
title_en: A Study on the Key Factors of Taiwanese Entrepreneurs' Success
keywords: 創業、成功關鍵因素、紮根理論
abstract_zh: 幾十年來，網路技術高度發達並普遍盛行，年輕人自主創業已成為新的趨勢。然而，有限的企業家由於在現實商業世界中難得的經驗和準備，在競爭激烈的商業世界中欲取得成功，卻甚至沒有完全瞭解自己的特點。　　因此，本研究旨在調查促進台灣企業家在商業旅程中取得成功的關鍵因素，重點關注在他們的個性、內在心態、有效的社交網絡、跨領域整合方法等。採用質性研究方法，著重在紮根理論，經過深度採訪並詳細觀察了6位台灣成功企業家，每人擁有千萬美元以上的企業資產。之後對收集到的數據以：一、專業背景歷程、二、面對困難的心態與解決問題的具體策略、三、面對社會變化與洞察市場機會的經驗和能力、四、執業中對尋求資源和運作的社交策略、五、看待自己與員工、合作夥伴的心態、以及合作策略等五大項進行分析和驗證後，有見地綜合分析下得到了以下一些重要發現：    第一，台灣成功的創業家的成功並非主要來自於專業領域的知識，而是源自於他們原本就具備的個性特質。    第二、成功的創業家普遍都從小就願意踏入社會去闖蕩、去學習，並且不拘泥於正式或穩定的工作。    第三、台灣成功的創業家具有勇於突破現狀的挑戰，野心勃勃並且充滿狂大的自信心。　　第四、台灣成功的創業家面對困難時，最常使用的是提高自己的格局去看待問題，並且善於自省提高自己的眼界並願意設身處地的甘願犧牲自己的休息時間，不齒下問成功人士為客戶解決問題贏得客戶的信任與依賴。    第五、台灣成功的創業家也善用自己敏銳細心的觀察力去多方發展最有利的生意通道，並且對於金錢相對的小氣，不會因為利小而不為。他們也能夠善用別人的知識完成自己的目標，並且知道效率比努力重要。    第六、台灣成功的創業家能夠看見環境的變化中所隱藏的商機，並且能夠適時調整經營策略以應對市場變化，並善於展現自己的核心價值觀，延續自己的理念，建立口碑讓商業活動自行滾動行銷。    第七、台灣成功的創業家懂得如何與員工及客戶建立良好的會員關係，並且具備看見未來的能力，善於構思並且具備自律的精神。   第八、台灣成功的創業家把員工視為事業的夥伴而不是純粹的雇傭關係，並且把員工視為同盟業者而不是下屬，他們在內心自大的同時，外表謙遜，同時，虔誠的信仰也是台灣成功的創業者所共同具備的特點。　　因此成功的台灣創業家具備上述關鍵因素，包括個性特質、解困能力、洞察市場機會、運用社交策略及與員工、合作夥伴建立良好的關係等等，這些因素使得台灣成功的創業家能夠克服困難，看到商機並把握機會，以達到自己的目標，他們的成功也能為社會帶來貢獻，創造就業機會，促進經濟發展，讓整個社會受益，因此對於那些有意創業的人來說，學習這些成功的台灣創業家的經驗與策略是非常重要的，可以幫助他們更好地創業，並且取得成功。
abstract_en: n recent decades, with the highly developed and widely prevalent Internet technology, young people venturing into entrepreneurship has become a new trend. However, many aspiring entrepreneurs lack the necessary experience and preparation in the competitive business world, often without a complete understanding of their own characteristics.    Therefore, this study aims to investigate the key factors that contribute to the success of Taiwanese entrepreneurs in their entrepreneurial journey, focusing on their personality traits, internal mindset, effective social networks, and interdisciplinary integration methods. Using qualitative research methods, particularly grounded theory, the study conducted in-depth interviews and detailed observations of six successful Taiwanese entrepreneurs, each possessing assets worth over tens of millions of dollars. The collected data was analyzed and verified under five categories: 1) professional background and trajectory, 2) mindset in facing challenges and specific problem-solving strategies, 3) experiences and abilities in dealing with social changes and identifying market opportunities, 4) social strategies for seeking resources and operations, and 5) attitudes towards oneself, employees, and partners, as well as collaborative strategies. Based on the comprehensive analysis and insights gained from these categories, the study yielded several important findings:    The success of Taiwanese entrepreneurs does not primarily stem from knowledge in their professional fields but from their inherent personality traits.Successful entrepreneurs in Taiwan are generally willing to venture into society and learn from an early age, without being confined to formal or stable employment.Taiwanese entrepreneurs who achieve success exhibit the characteristics of challenging the status quo, ambitious goals, and an abundance of self-confidence.When faced with difficulties, successful entrepreneurs in Taiwan often employ a mindset that focuses on expanding their perspectives to view problems and are adept at self-reflection. They willingly sacrifice their leisure time, consider themselves problem solvers for their clients, and gain their trust and reliance.    Taiwanese entrepreneurs who succeed also utilize their keen and attentive observation skills to develop multiple advantageous business channels. They are not stingy when it comes to money, as they prioritize efficiency over mere profitability. They leverage others' knowledge to achieve their goals and understand the importance of efficiency over effort.    Successful Taiwanese entrepreneurs are able to recognize hidden business opportunities amidst environmental changes. They adjust their business strategies accordingly, effectively showcase their core values, perpetuate their ideals, and establish a strong reputation that facilitates organic marketing of their business activities.    Successful Taiwanese entrepreneurs know how to build good relationships with employees and customers, possess the ability to foresee the future, excel in conceptualization, and demonstrate self-discipline.Taiwanese entrepreneurs who achieve success view employees as partners in their business rather than mere employees. They treat them as allies, displaying humility despite their inner confidence. Furthermore, sincere faith is a common characteristic among successful entrepreneurs in Taiwan.    Therefore, successful Taiwanese entrepreneurs possess the aforementioned key factors, including personality traits, problem-solving abilities, market insight, social strategies, and building good relationships with employees and partners. These factors enable them to overcome challenges, identify and seize opportunities, and achieve their goals. Their success also contributes to society by creating employment opportunities and promoting economic development, benefiting the entire community.Therefore, for those intending to start their own businesses, learning from the experiences and strategies of these successful Taiwanese entrepreneurs is crucial, as it can help them become better entrepreneurs and achieve success.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 以社會認知生涯理論探討成人進修教育生涯選擇模式之研究
title_en: A Study on the Career Choice Model of Adult Continuing Education Based on Social Cognitive Career Theory
keywords: 回流教育、社會認知生涯理論、社會支持、生涯自我效能、結果預期、目標設定
abstract_zh: 本研究主要以社會認知生涯理論探討成人進修教育生涯選擇模式，問卷調查對象，係以雲林地區三所公私立科技大學參與進修教育的夜間四年制進修學制的成人學習者，上課時間為平日周間晚上，正式授予學位文憑的學制。問卷調查結果以項目分析、描述性統計分析、單因子變異數分析及結構方程模式，進行資料之分析，研究結果如下：一、成人學習者參與進修教育的社會支持良好，且以情感支持層面較高。二、成人學習者參與進修教育的生涯自我效能與年齡有關，而與性別、職業及婚姻狀況無關。三、成人學習者參與進修教育的結果預期良好，且以期望報酬層面較高。四、成人學習者參與進修教育的目標設定良好，且以目標投入層面較高。五、成人學習者參與進修教育在社會認知生涯理論選擇模式的指標適配度良好。    本研究根據問卷調查，所發現的問題，提出對參加進修教育之成人學習者、辦理回流進修教育的學校機關團體、在職回流教育教職員工及相關單位的參考和後續研究的改進建議。
abstract_en: This study examines the career choice model of adult learners in continuing education based on social cognitive career theory. The participants of the survey were adult learners enrolled in the evening four-year continuing education programs offered by three public and private technological universities in Yunlin County. Classes were held on weekday evenings, and the program awarded formal degrees. The survey data was analyzed using item analysis, descriptive statistics, one-way ANOVA, and structural equation modeling. The findings of the study are as follows:Adult learners participating in continuing education demonstrated good social support, with a higher emphasis on emotional support.Career self-efficacy of adult learners in continuing education was related to age but not influenced by gender, occupation, or marital status.Adult learners had positive expectations regarding the outcomes of their participation in continuing education, with a strong focus on expected rewards.Adult learners exhibited good goal setting in continuing education, with a higher level of goal commitment.The indicators of adult learners' participation in continuing education aligned well with the choice model proposed by the social cognitive career theory.Based on the survey findings, this study provides improvement suggestions for adult learners participating in continuing education, educational institutions organizing re-entry education programs, in-service re-entry education staff, and relevant entities. These recommendations serve as valuable references for addressing the identified issues and for future research in this area.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 大學生參與海外實習跨文化適應歷程及生涯發展之研究－以新南向學海築夢計畫為例
title_en: A Study on the Cross-cultural Adaptation Process and Career Development of University Students Participating in Overseas Internships : A Case of Overseas Study Dream Program of the New Southbound Policy
keywords: 新南向學海築夢計畫、海外實習、跨文化適應、生涯發展
abstract_zh: 本研究欲瞭解大學生參與新南向學海築夢計畫期間面臨跨文化時適應之歷程及生涯發展狀況之改變。為達上述之目的，本研究以滾雪球抽樣的方式選取六位曾受新南向學海築夢計畫補助至新加坡實習的大學生，並以質性研究的半結構式訪談法進行資料分析。研究結果如下：一、學生若具備明確的海外實習動機及充分的事前準備，有助於短時間內適應文化衝擊期。二、學生面臨跨文化的衝擊與挑戰主要有語言能力不足、跨文化溝通障礙、文化環境差異、跨文化認知落差及工作瓶頸。三、因應跨文化衝擊與不適的調適方法必須適時自我調整心態並勇於嘗試，必要時需主動尋求協助或與他人傾訴。四、海外實習使學生提升語言與專業能力、學會尊重多元文化並培養職場所需能力。五、海外實習的經驗使學生有更明確的生涯發展方向。六、新南向學海築夢計畫提供的津貼補助具有實質性的幫助，但調整薪資與房租補貼仍是海外實習生需協助解決之事項。最後根據以上結論，對學校、家長及未來至其他國家展開實習生活或正在海外進行實習的學生們及未來研究提出具體之建議。
abstract_en: This study was conducted to understand the cross-cultural adjustment process and career development changes of university students during their participation in the Overseas Study Dream Program of the New Southbound Policy. In order to achieve the above purpose, this study selected six university students who had been sponsored to intern in Singapore under the New Southbound Dream Project by a snowball sampling method, and analyzed the data using a semi-structured interview method of qualitative research. The results of the study are as follows:1.Students with clear motivation and adequate preparation for overseas internship can adapt to the culture shock within a short period of time.2.Students face cross-cultural impact and challenges such as language proficiency, cross-cultural communication barrier, cultural environment difference, cross-cultural cognitive gap and work bottleneck.3.Students should adjust their mindset and try to adapt to the intercultural impact and discomfort, and if necessary, seek help or talk to others.4.Overseas internships enable students to improve their language and professional skills, learn to respect diverse cultures, and develop the skills needed for the workplace.5.The experience of overseas internship gives students a clearer direction for their career development.6.The subsidy provided by the Overseas Study Dream Program of the New Southbound Policy is of substantial help, but salary adjustment and rent subsidy are still issues that overseas interns need assistance in solving.Finally, based on the above conclusions, suggestions are made for schools, parents, and students and future research directions.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 石化產業安全督導員工安實作課程訓練成效之研究
title_en: A Study on the Training Effectiveness of Safety Practical Course for Safety Supervisor in Petrochemical Industry
keywords: 工安、實作訓練課程、訓練成效、柯式模式
abstract_zh: 石化產業中製程安全管理是生產管理最關鍵的環節，其中「安全督導員」扮演著相當重要的角色，所以如何落實「安全督導員」的教育訓練是確保石化產業生產製造的安全、穩定及連續運轉。本研究以A公司近十年累積的大數據為基礎，以安全督導員工安實作課程訓練合格者為研究對象，利用統計方法進行受訓前後的成效分析，來呈現石化產業的安全督導員實作課程訓練的成效。本研究採用KirkPatrick四階層訓練評估模，探討學員在行為層次及成果層次的表現，再依年齡及年資分層進一步探討其間之表現差異。本研究使用敘述性統計和成對樣本t檢定，進行安全督導員工安實作課程訓練成效分析檢定。硏究結果顯示，經安全督導員工安實作課程訓練合格者的成效表現如下：一、顯著提高證照加分分數；二、顯著降低內外稽核之異常次數；三、顯著增加考績成績；四、提高部門評核分數。進一步分析不同背景屬性的行為及成果表現結果顯示如下：一、年齡在20-29歲，對於證照加分、年度考績、部門年度評核分數等項目助益較大；二、年資在10年以下，對於證照加分、內外稽異常數、年度考績、部門年度評核分數等項目助益較大。根據研究結果，未來於課程單元設計及教材教法，導入實務作業危害情境探討，並結合行為與認知科學研究成果，及資訊科技應用工具輔助教學活動，以有效提升訓練成效。
abstract_en: Process safety management in the petrochemical industry is the most critical link in safety production. Safety supervisors play a key role in process safety. Therefore, how to effectiveness training of safety supervisors is the most important subject to ensure the safe, stable and continuous operation in the petrochemical industry. This research is based on the big data accumulated by Company A in the past ten years. Collect those who have been the training of safety supervisory staff safety practice course as the research object. Use scientific statistical methods to analyze and compare the performance before and after training to present the effectiveness of the practical training of safety supervisors in the petrochemical industry. This study adopts KirkPatrick's four-level training evaluation model. To analysis the performance of trainees at the training behavior level and outcome level. Then stratified by age and seniority to further explore the differences in training performance. In this study, descriptive statistical analysis and paired t-test methods are used to test the effectiveness of safety supervisor’s safety course training.The results of the research show that: (1) Significantly increase the certificate bonus points; (2) Significantly reduce the number of abnormalities in internal and external audits; (3) Significantly increase performance appraisal scores; (4) Improve department assessment scores. The results of further analysis in different background attributes are as follows: (1) Those aged 20-29 are more helpful to the certificate bonus points, annual performance appraisal scores, and departmental annual appraisal scores. (2) If the seniority is less than 10 years, it will be of great help to the certificate bonus points, reduce the number of abnormalities in internal and external audits, increase performance appraisal scores, and departmental annual assessment scores. According to the research results, in the future, in the design of course units and teaching materials and methodology import the discussion of practical accident cases study which combine the research results of behavioral and cognitive science, and the application tools of information technology (IT) will be assist teaching activities, so as to effectively improve the training effect.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 印度尼西亞商業職業教育學生能力驗證研究
title_en: A Study on the Validation of the Competencies of Business Vocational Education Students in Indonesia
keywords: 能力、商業職業教育、模糊德爾菲法、方面
abstract_zh: 本研究目的是基於專家判斷所需的未來能力清單徵得專家小組的同意。 本研究採用模糊德爾菲法 (FDM)，在確定維度、能力和定義時優先考慮專家共識。本研究選擇了來自不同專業背景的 21 位專家：院士、能力評估師和課程開發人員。 該方法的第一步是文件分析，包括從 25 份文件中準備、提取、分析和提煉結果。 第二步是工具有效性，即使用五個驗證器的表面有效性。 第三步是模糊德爾菲分析，分析專家對勝任力及其定義的意見的模糊性共識。研究結果定義了職業商業教育學生必須具備的四個維度、四十一個能力及其定義。 四個維度，即個人、方法論、社會和技術。本研究還揭示了專家們一致認為最重要的未來能力如下：“高度誠信”、“有效溝通”、“分析能力”、“解決問題”、“客戶導向”、“適應性和靈活性” 、“思維敏捷”、“開放心態”、“批判性思維”、“團隊合作”和“自我管理”。 這些能力在職業商業教育學生的能力需求中排名最高。最後，本研究為職業商業教育未來能力的學術文獻做出了貢獻，商業教育者、商業項目開發人員和課程專家可以用來開發基於能力的課程和培訓模型，以考慮雇主和印度尼西亞人的未來需求 語境。
abstract_en: The purpose of this study is to obtain consent from a panel of experts regarding a list of future competencies required based on expert judgment. This study employs the Fuzzy Delphi Method (FDM), prioritizing expert consensus in determining the dimension, competency, and definition. The study has selected twenty-one experts from various professional backgrounds: academicians, competency assessors, and curriculum developers. The first step in the method is documental analysis, which involves preparing, extracting, analyzing, and distilling the findings from 25 documents. The second step is instrument validity which is employed face validity using five validators. The third step is fuzzy Delphi analysis to analyze the fuzziness consensus of experts’ opinions on the competencies and their definitions.The results have identified four dimensions, forty-one future competencies, and their definitions that students in vocational business education must possess. The four dimensions namely personal, methodological, social, and technical. The finding also reveals the most important of future competencies agreed upon by experts were listed as follows: ‘high integrity’, ‘effective communication’, ‘analytical skills’, ‘problem-solving’, ‘customer orientation’, ‘adaptability and flexibility’, ‘mental agility’, ‘open mindset’, ‘critical thinking’, ‘teamwork’, and ‘self-management’. These competencies have the highest ratings among the competency’s students need in vocational business education students. Ultimately, this study contributes to the academic literature on future competencies in vocational business education and could be used by business educators, business program developers, and curriculum specialists to develop competency-based curricula and training models that consider the future demands of employers and the Indonesian context.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 印度尼西亞技術和職業高等教育機構學術人員對聯合國可持續發展目標概念的認知和行為研究
title_en: A Study on the Cognition and Behavior of Academic Staff of Indonesian Technical and Vocational Higher Education Institutions towards the Concept of The United Nations Sustainable Development Goals
keywords: 可持續發展目標、文獻分析、訪談分析、SWOT 分析、MAXQDA
abstract_zh: 可持續發展目標（SDGs）的概念可以說是多學科的、系統的、複雜的，但確立這一概念無疑是一項非凡的使命。 鼓勵包括技術和職業高等教育機構在內的高等教育機構根據 17 項可持續發展目標採取行動。 作者使用文獻分析調查了印度尼西亞的三所公立大學，以實現聯合國教科文組織可持續發展和聯合國可持續發展目標的優先領域； 經濟維度、環境維度和社會文化維度。 接下來，除了進行 SWOT 分析以評估實施這些 SDG 的內部（優勢和劣勢）以及外部（機會和威脅）因素外，還進行了訪談分析以確定學術人員在日常生活中對 SDG 的認知和行為 技術和職業教育機構的課程。 本研究的人群是印度尼西亞公立大學的學術人員。 本次研究對象由三位院長/院長/副院長、三位系主任/系主任、六位教師/講師組成。 分析和編碼過程概括為三個階段：分類、概念化和理論化。 MAXQDA 計算機程序將用於此目的。
abstract_en: The concept of Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) is arguably multidisciplinary, systematic, and complex, yet establishing the concept is undoubtedly an extraordinary mission. Higher education institutions, including technical and vocational higher education institutions, are encouraged to take action according to the 17 SDGs. The author uses documentary analysis to investigate three public universities in Indonesia for achieving the priority areas of Sustainable Development UNESCO and the SDGs of the United Nations; Economic Dimension, Environmental Dimension, and Socio-Cultural Dimension. Next, the interview analysis to determine the cognition and behavior of academic staff toward SDGs in their daily lives, in addition to conducting a SWOT analysis to assess internal (strengths and weaknesses) as well as external (opportunities and threats) factors in implementing these SDGs programmes at technical and vocational education institutions. The population of this study is academic personnel in Indonesian public universities. The subject of this study consists of three directors/deans/vice deans, three chairman/heads of departments, and six teachers/lecturers. The analysis and coding processes were summarized in three phases: categorization, conceptualization, and theorization. The MAXQDA computer programme will be used for this purpose.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 以科技接收模式探討繪本產業人員技能培訓的遠距教學之研究—以陳璐茜Lucy想像力開發教室為案例
title_en: Distance Teaching on Skill Training for Picture Book Creators: A Case Study of Lucy 's Imagination Development with Technology Acceptance Model
keywords: 遠距教學、繪本創作、數位化轉型教學系統、教學策略、學習成效
abstract_zh: 傳統的實體教學課程結合遠距繪本創作教學課程，發展出一系列的教學方案，已成為當前翻轉教學的重要教育課題。本研究採取量化及質化混合設計研究，旨在以科技接受模式探討繪本產業人員技能培訓的數位化轉型之研究。本研究的課題是以陳璐茜Lucy老師所開設的「遠距繪本創作教學系統」如何從傳統的現場教學轉型為遠距教學，師生教學互動，以及教學的成果。研究目的包括探討繪本創作教材數位化課程設計、教學方式轉型以及建構遠距繪本數位創作學習量表。具體操作目的為探討課程學員在遠距繪本數位創作學習在「認知面向」、「主觀態度面向」及「行為面向」三個面向的認同程度差異、相關性及結構關係模式。本研究的質性分析是邀請具有繪本遠距教學經驗者進行調查，以深度訪談蒐集Lucy老師及其課程學員的教學與學習歷程資料並進行分析。量化分析則是採取自編「遠距繪本數位創作學習量表問卷」對繪本學員進行施測，將蒐集的量化資料進行描述性統計、獨立樣本t檢定、單因子變異數分析、相關分析、結構方程模式分析驗證。最後統整資料分析，獲得以下研究結果：一、「遠距繪本創作教學系統」的研究架構之建構及研究方法論具有可行性。二、透過遠距繪本數位創作受訪者質性資料分析，可知在遠距繪本教學過程的影響因素、數位化課程設計、教材發展、教學師生互動情形、教學成效及學員學習評量皆與傳統教學有明顯不同之處。三、不同背景研究對象對於遠距繪本創作學習在「認知面向」、「主觀態度面向」及「行為面向」皆有高度認同度且無顯著差異。四、遠距繪本創作學習整體認同程度與各構面認同程度相關獲得支持，但各構面間及各構面與分構面間的認同程度相關，只有部分獲得支持。五、「認知面向」、「主觀態度面向」及「行為面向」彼此之間具有顯著直接影響的直接效果。而且「認知面向」透過「主觀態度面向」而影響「行為面向」，具有間接影響的中介效果。最後，根據研究結果，提出具體建議，提供繪本領域教師遠距課程發展的專業增能之參考。
abstract_en: Recently, a series of teaching programs have been developed by combining traditional on site teaching courses with technological distance teaching courses, which have become an important educational topic of flipped teaching. This study adopted both quantitative and qualitative mixed design research, aiming to explore the digital transformation of creation skills training for the learners in the picture book industry through the technology acceptance model.The main topic of this research is how the "distance picture book creation teaching system" opened by teacher Lucy Chen transformed from traditional on-site teaching to distance teaching. Further, how was the interaction between teachers and students during the teaching process. Additionally, what was the result of picture book creation by distance teaching.Concretely, the purpose of the research includes exploring the digital curriculum design of picture book creation textbooks, the transformation of teaching methods, and the construction of a learning assessment questionnaire for digital creation of picture books. The specific analysis included exploring the differences, correlations and structural relationship model in the three teaching aspects namely, "cognitive aspect", "subjective attitude aspect" and "behavioral aspect" in the distance teaching and learning of picture books creation.The qualitative analysis of this study was to invite those who have experience in distance teaching of picture books to conduct a survey, collect and analyze the teaching and learning process data of Teacher Lucy and her course students through in-depth interviews. Quantitative analysis used the "Distance Picture Book Digital Creation Learning Scale Questionnaire" for students attended the distance courses, and the collected quantitative data was analyzed with descriptive statistics, t-test, ANOVA, Pearson’s correlation analysis, and structural equation modeling analysis was adopted to verified the fitness of the model. Finally, the integrated data analysis obtained the following research results:1.The construction of the research framework and research methodology of         the "Teaching System for Distance Picture Book Creation" is feasible.2.Through the qualitative data analysis of the interviewees in the digital creation of distance picture books, the process significantly different from traditional teaching. It can be seen that the influencing factors in the transformation process of distance picture book teaching, digital course design, teaching material development, teaching teacher-student interaction, teaching effectiveness and student learning evaluation are all important factors.3.Research subjects with different backgrounds demonstrated a high degree of recognition in all three aspects and hence without significant difference in all the "cognitive aspect", "subjective attitude aspect" and "behavioral aspect" of distance picture book creation and learning.4.The overall identity degree of distance picture book creation learning is correlated to the degree of identity of each aspect, but the degree of identity between each aspect. In terms of the correlation among each aspect and sub-dimension, only part of them are supported.5.The "cognition aspect", "subjective attitude aspect" and "behavior aspect" have significant direct influence effects on each other. Moreover, the "cognitive aspect" affects the "behavioral aspect" through the "subjective attitude aspect", which has an indirect mediating effect.Finally, according to the research results, specific suggestions are put forward to provide references for the professional empowerment of distance course development for teachers in the field of picture books.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 優質醫院護理服務之特質分析
title_en: A Study on the Characteristics of Nursing Services In Excellence Hospitals
keywords: 優質醫院、護理服務、特質分析
abstract_zh: 社會發展驅使人們對於醫療機構品質要求的提升和轉變，優質醫療機構除具備頂尖先進的醫療設備之外，更需堅強團結的醫療團隊，團隊成員須具備專業的知識與技能、瞭解及掌握市場的需求及未來發展的趨勢、奪得先機先預培育專業人才、才能有優質的服務。優質醫療團隊提升對內效能與對外溝通服務的運作機制，具國際視野及遠見，強調研究創新，與時俱進的知能及技術提供高質量的醫療服務，醫事專業人員的技能，培養醫療專業科目，發展醫療特色，使病人精準治療，少併發症及快速恢復健康。本研究以台灣優質醫院的經營管理者為研究對象，邀請13名優質醫院的護理主管，主要探討優質醫療機構中護理部門之經營理念與服務特色，維繫醫療機構前端醫療品質之護理部具體作為、護理人才培育之內涵與推動策略、以及領導者之前瞻思維。採質性研究方法，透過系統性取得核心資料的方法，文獻分析、質性訪談、三角驗證及建構主題，檢核及拓展視野，綜合性分析優質醫療機構中護理部門之服務特色、護理人才培育之內涵與推動策略、前端醫療品質之護理部具體作為、護理領導者之前瞻思維，並呈現對機構、病人、社會及個人的貢獻及價值，未來發展等。最終得到以下結論：（一）現代優質醫療機構的特色在於本身能夠著眼於社會發展的趨勢而洞察民眾健康照顧的全面性需求，並且窺見醫療需求的前瞻性，以此建立院方的社會使命。（二）優質醫療機構普遍能夠自我定位為社會需求的先驅者和醫療同業機構的領導者，而成立各項專業任務的醫療知能開發的研究中心，研發和推廣先驅醫療知識和技術，並且帶領同業專項醫療和服務的新發展。（三）在優質醫療機構中的護理部門多以醫療護理和服務的典範自許，積極配合先進醫療技術開發之同時，致力於開發出協助醫療和復原效益的先進護理專業項目。（四）優質醫療機構中護理部門的專業重點已由傳統的醫護服務項目進升至協同醫師共同面對發展中的疾病、預先發掘社會民眾的潛在需求和健康經營、並且擴展至身心靈的健康照顧。（五）護理部主管普遍已是醫療機構中重要的專業領導人，重在領導護理人員精進專業護理知能、協同醫技人員和學術機構推動專業護理項目之跨國性研究和實務推廣、並且致力於培育護理人員跨越族群（如醫師、醫技人員、社會民眾等等）之和諧溝通能力。
abstract_en: Social development drives people to improve and change the quality requirements of medical institutions. Those high-quality medical institutions need not only top and advanced medical equipment, but also strong medical teams. Team members who must own professional knowledge and skills, could predict the demands and future development trends of the medical-service market, seize the opportunity to pre-train themselves with professional talents, and show out high-quality medical service. The high-quality medical team who can improve the internal efficiency and the operation mechanism of external communication services masters an international vision and foresight. It can emphasize research and innovation of medical services, and provide high-quality medical services where there are knowledge and technology that keep pace with the times and the skills of medical professionals. Finally, because of the excellent medical development, patients who receive precise treatment reduce complications and are cured quickly.The research treats the managers of high-quality hospitals in Taiwan as the research objects and invites 13 nursing supervisors of high-quality hospitals. The main themes of the research discuss the operating philosophy and characteristics of the service of the nursing department in high-quality medical institutions and understand the specific actions of the nursing department to maintain the advanced medical quality of medical institutions, the connotation and promotion strategy of nursing cultivation, and the forward-looking thinking of leaders. The research belongs to qualitative research, which contains the method of systematically obtaining core data, literature analysis, qualitative interviews, triangulation, and construction of themes to check, expand horizons and find out comprehensive analysis of the service characteristics of nursing departments in high-quality medical institutions, the cultivation of nursing talents, the connotation, and promotion strategy, the specific actions of the nursing department in front-end medical quality, the forward-looking thinking of nursing leaders, the contribution and value to institutions, patients, society and individuals, and future development.Finally, the following conclusions are: (1) The characteristic of modern high-quality medical institutions is that they can focus on the trend of social development, realize the comprehensive needs of people's health care clearly, and develop forward-looking medical needs, so as to establish the social mission of the hospital. (2) High-quality medical institutions can generally position themselves as pioneers of social needs and leaders of medical institutions, and establish research centers that can develop and promote medical knowledge and technology to meet various professional tasks, and lead the medical industry to create new developments in specialized medical care and services. (3) Nursing departments of high-quality medical institutions evaluate themselves as excellent models of medical care and services which actively open up advanced nursing professional programs that assist in medical treatment and recovery benefits through the development of advanced medical technology. (4) The professional focus of the nursing department in high-quality medical institutions has been upgraded from traditional medical care services to doctors’ joint consultations. It can face developing diseases, discover the potential needs of the public in advance and health management, and expand to the health care of the body and mind. (5) The head of the nursing department acts as an important professional leader in medical institutions who focus on leading nursing staff to improve professional nursing knowledge, cooperating with medical technicians and academic institutions to promote translational research and professional nursing projects practically, and dedicate to educate the harmonious communication ability of nursing staff across ethnic groups (such as doctors, medical technicians, social people, etc.).

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 探討運用商業模擬遊戲與翻轉教室於學生創業知識和技能、態度、意圖、參與度、高層次思維和學習成績之影響
title_en: Investigating the Impact of using Business Simulation Games and Flipped classrooms on Students' Entrepreneurial Knowledge and Skills, Attitude, Intention, Engagement, Higher-order Thinking, and Learning Achievement
keywords: 創業教育、創業知識技能、創業態度、創業意向、學生敬業度、高層次思維能力、學習成績、翻轉課堂、商務模擬遊戲
abstract_zh: 隨著各國大專校院創業教育的迅速發展，我國政府也越來越重視創業教育。創業教育一直是促進經濟振興和發展的潛在媒介和驅動力。通過創業教育的答疑解惑，學生可以變得更有進取心，也更有助於初創企業發展壯大。本文的主要研究目的，首先是探討在翻轉課堂中使用商業模擬遊戲（BSG）進行創業教育對提升學生創業知識與技能、創業態度、創業意向、學生參與、高層次思維能力（HOTS）及學習成就的效果，其次是探討創業知識與技能對學生創業態度、創業意向、學生投入、高層次思維能力及學習成就的影響。 研究方法採用實驗組和對照組的准實驗設計，以及半結構式訪談的定性研究。 研究對象為來自印尼的48名大學生。實驗組和對照組都參與了翻轉課堂，其中實驗班的教學材料為BSG。研究結果表明，在翻轉課堂中使用 BSG對創業知識和技能、態度、意向、學生參與、學習成就和提高 HOTS產生顯著影響。此外，新冠肺炎疫情妨礙了樣本的獲取。未來研究將選取大樣本和相關度高的科系學生為研究對象。
abstract_en: The Government expresses a growing interest in entrepreneurship education (EE), and there has been tremendous growth in EE at the world's higher education institutions. The potential of entrepreneurship as a medium to promote economic rejuvenation and development has been the driving force behind this expansion. EE was founded on the concept that entrepreneurship can be taught, that students can become more enterprising, and that this can make it easier for new businesses to start.The primary purpose of the study is, first,  to explore the effect of EE using Business Simulation Game (BSG) in flipped classrooms on improving students' entrepreneurial knowledge and skills, entrepreneurial attitude, intention, student engagement, higher-order thinking skills (HOTS), and learning achievement, and, second, to examine the influence of entrepreneurial knowledge and skills on students’ entrepreneurial attitude, entrepreneurial intention, student engagement, higher-order thinking skills, and learning achievement. The research design is a quasi-experiment with one control group and one experiment group, while the semi-structured interview is applied for a qualitative approach. The total participants are 48 undergraduate students from Indonesia. Both the experimental and control groups participated in the flipped classrooms. However, the instructional materials for the experimental class used a BSG. The quantitative and qualitative analysis results showed that using BSG in flipped classrooms positively affected entrepreneurial knowledge and skills, attitude, intention, student engagement, learning achievement, and improved HOTS. In addition, the COVID-19 epidemic hindered the sampling and representation of respondents. Future studies should employ a larger sample size and students who have taken courses relating to the topic under discussion.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 翻轉教學與創客教育應用於會展解說導覽之研究
title_en: A Study on Application of Flipped Teaching and Maker Education into Interpretation and Guided Tour in MICE
keywords: 翻轉教學、創客教育、學習成效、學習投入、學習滿意度
abstract_zh: 本研究旨探討以翻轉教學與創客教育應用在課程以進行實驗教學，不僅於教學過程方法不同，也需要學生集體創作以產出成果作品。以準實驗設計研究來瞭解大學生的學習成效、學習投入及學習滿意度之影響。分為實驗組54位學生以翻轉教學與創客教育模式並行實施；控制組48位學生，採用一般傳統課堂教學模式。實驗設計課程內容規畫均相同，實施為期12週的準實驗研究不等組前後測設計之研究，在實驗教學進行前對全體學生實施學習成效和學習投入問卷之前測，實驗教學完成後均接受學習成效和學習投入問卷後測，加以比較兩組間的不同差異。另外，對實驗組學生進行教學滿意度問卷調查及焦點團體訪談以瞭解翻轉教學與創客教育應用在課程的感受與意見。經研究結果發現，實驗組學生的學習成效及學習投入總量表皆顯著優於對照組；在學習投入構面分析，認知、行為、社交等三大構面，實驗組表現顯著高於控制組的學生，但在情感構面部分的表現則不顯著。此外，實驗組學生對學習滿意度於互動性、課程設計、教師教學、課程管理及科技技術運用大部份是具有肯定且正面的感受。可得知，在實驗研究後顯示翻轉教學模式的過程是具有教育價值，並且強調從中做、做中學的成果產出之創客教育意義。
abstract_en: This research aims to explore the application of flipped teaching and maker education in experimental teaching courses, not only in the teaching process method, but also in the needs of the- student collective creation to produce results. A quasi-experimental design study to understand the effects of college students on learning outcomes, learning engagement, and learning satisfaction. Divided into the experimental group of 54-student who implemented flipped teaching and maker education models in parallel; the control group of 48-student, adopted the general traditional classroom teaching mode. The content of the experimental design course is the same, with a 12-week quasi-experimental study for all students before the experimental teaching, from pre-test design to post-test design. Post-tests of the learning effectiveness and learning engagement questionnaires were used to compare the differences between the two groups can find it in different circumstances of above research experimental. In addition, through the teaching satisfaction questionnaire and focus group interviews of the students in the experimental group, we can understand the feelings and opinions of flipped teaching and the application of maker education in the curriculum.    The results of the study found that the learning effect and total learning engagement scale of the students in the experimental group were significantly better than those in the control group; in the analysis of the three dimensions of learning engagement, cognition, behavior and social interaction, the performance of the experimental group was significantly higher than the control group. On other hand, the performance on the emotional dimension was not significant. In addition, most students in the experimental group had positive feelings about learning satisfaction in terms of interactivity, curriculum design, teacher teaching, curriculum management, and technology use. Experimental research shows that the process of flipping the teaching model has educational value, emphasizing the educational significance of maker education of learning by doing and learning by doing.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 工業設計系學生創造力對應新進工業設計師職能基準關係之研究
title_en: A Research on the Relationship between the Creativity of Industrial Design Student and Government Occupational Competency Standard of New Industrial Designer
keywords: 工業設計、創造力、職能基準
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在探究工業設計系學生創意程度與新進工業設計師職能關係，以大專院校工業設計系大四學生為調查對象。本研究以自編之問項結合威廉斯創造力測驗-創造性傾向量表發展問卷，依北、中、南各地共發出問卷334份，回收有效問卷290份，有效回收率86.8%；質性部分，訪談三位工業設計產業主管專家，探討專家於產業所觀察之現象。本研究經綜合分析所得結論如下：(一)大學四年級的準工業設計師之創造力程度對於職能具備程度是有關聯性的，且具有正向相關性。冒險性、好奇性、挑戰性創造力傾向與知識內涵具有正向相關性。好奇性、想像力與技能內涵具有正向相關性。冒險性、好奇性、想像力、挑戰性四種類型與態度內涵均具有正向相關性。(二)原就讀高中-普通科與技術類科背景學生經恆等性分析結果顯示，對於創造力程度與職能內涵具備程度間不存在差異性。而設計類科與非設計類科是存在差異，設計類科群組學生認為創造力傾向程度與職能具備程度是無相關性。(三)公立大學與私立大學是不存在差異，表示對於創造力傾向程度與職能具備程度是無正向相關性。普通大學與科技大學之間對於創造力傾向程度與職能具備程度均是具有正向相關性且並無差異程度。(四)生理性別-男性與女性之間對於創造力傾向程度與職能具備程度具有正向相關性且並無差異程度。依據上述相關結論提出之建議如下：(一)工業設計系所調整以產業所需之設計人才職能為學習主軸對接產業需求。(二)以政府資源投入系所補助小班教學維持重點人才發展。(三)應重視並妥善規劃手繪能力課程足夠之授課時數，藉以強化邏輯思考與專業手繪等課程規劃。(四)落實技術型高中設計背景科系學生之職涯規劃輔導，讓手繪表現優秀與喜歡新事物的學生可以順利進入大學工業設計系所就讀。(五)工業設計產業為應用型產業，回歸普通大學與科技大學於工業設計系之特色教學環境。
abstract_en: The purpose of this study is to explore the relationship between the degree of creativity of industrial design students and the functions of new industrial designers. The questionnaire of this research is combined with the Williams Creativity Scale with self-made questions. A total of 334 questionnaires were sent out in North, Central, and South regions, and 290 valid questionnaires were recovered, with an effective recovery rate of 86.8%; the qualitative part , interviewed three experts in charge of the industrial design industry, and discussed the phenomena observed by the experts in the industry.The conclusions drawn from the comprehensive analysis of this study are as follows: (1) The degree of creativity of prospective industrial designers in the fourth year of college is related to the degree of functional competence, and has a positive correlation. Risk-taking, curiosity, complexity creativity tendencies are positively correlated with knowledge connotation. Curiosity, imagination and skill content are positively correlated. Risk-taking, curiosity, imagination, and challenge are all positively correlated with attitude connotation. (2) The identity analysis results show that there is no difference between the degree of creativity and the degree of functional connotation of the students with the background of high school-general subjects and technical subjects. However, there are differences between design subjects and non-design subjects. The design subjects group students believe that the degree of creativity tendency and the degree of functional competence are not related. (3) There is no difference between public universities and private universities, indicating that there is no positive correlation between the degree of creativity tendency and the degree of functional competence. There is a positive correlation between the degree of creativity inclination and the degree of functional competence between ordinary universities and universities of science and technology, and there is no difference. (4) Biological gender: There is a positive correlation between the degree of creativity tendency and the degree of functional competence between men and women, and there is no difference.Recommendations based on the above conclusions are as follows: (1) The Department of Industrial Design adjusts the functions of design talents required by the industry as the main learning axis to meet the needs of the industry. (2) To maintain the development of key talents by subsidizing small-class teaching by the government resources invested by the department. (3) Pay attention to and properly plan enough teaching hours for hand-painting ability courses, so as to strengthen logical thinking and professional hand-painting and other curriculum planning. (4) Implement career planning guidance for students in the design background department of technical high schools, so that students who have excellent hand-painting performance and like new things can smoothly enter the university's industrial design department. (5) The industrial design industry is an application-oriented industry, returning to the characteristic teaching environment of the industrial design department of ordinary universities and universities of science and technology.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 國中生英語學習焦慮之相關研究
title_en: The Study of Junior High School Students' English Learning Anxiety
keywords: 國中生、英語學習策略、學生知覺教師教學行為、英語學習焦慮
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在國中生英語學習焦慮之相關研究，依據文獻分析建立研究架構，整合出國中生英語學習焦慮之相關因素。另外，本研究利用研究者自編之問卷作為研究工具，研究對象為一百零八學年度國一至國三的學生，有效問卷樣本為820份，透過相關統計方式進行分析，獲得結論如下：一、國中生不同背景變項在英語學習策略上部分達顯著差異。二、國中生不同背景變項在學生知覺教師教學行為上部分達顯著差異。三、國中生的英語學習策略會影響其英語學習焦慮。四、國中生的英語學習策略會影響其學生知覺教師教學行為。五、國中學生知覺教師教學行為會影響其英語學習焦慮。六、本研究之三項變項相互影響模式與資料具有適配姓。
abstract_en: This study was to explore the related situations of English Learning Anxiety for junior high school students. Based on the results of the study.In this study, the data were collected by using the questionnaire compiled by the researcher. The research objects were junior high school students from the school year 108. The effective samples are 820 copies. Through the ways of the analysis obtains the results as follows:1.The differences background variables of junior high school students are significantly different in terms of English learning strategies.2.Different background variables of junior high school students have significant differences in students' perception of teachers' teaching behavior.3.The English learning strategies of junior high school students will affect their English learning anxiety.4.Junior high school students' English learning strategies will affect their students' perception of teachers' teaching behavior.5.Junior high school students perceive that teachers' teaching behavior will affect their English learning anxiety.6.The three variables with each other of the data are suitable.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 居家服務督導員賦權知覺、跨專業合作能力、角色知覺與督導功能之相關研究
title_en: The Relationships among the Empowerment Perception, Inter-professional Cooperation Competency, Role Perception, and Supervisory Function of Home Service Supervisors
keywords: 居家服務督導員、賦權知覺、跨專業合作能力、角色知覺、督導功能
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在探討居家服務督導員賦權知覺、跨專業合作能力、角色知覺對其督導功能之關係，本研究採取量化研究方法，透過文獻蒐集探討、專家效度檢驗與預試分析，藉以建立本研究調查問卷，並以全國北、中、南及東部四區域居家服務督導員為研究對象，進行抽樣調查，總計回收有效問卷332份，進行資料統計分析，獲得之研究結論如下：壹、居家服務督導員賦權知覺、跨專業合作能力、角色知覺及督導功能實際情形呈現中上良好程度。一、居家服務督導員賦權知覺以「工作意義」認知程度最高。二、居家服務督導員跨專業合作能力以「跨專業倫理價值」表現最好。三、居家服務督導員角色知覺以「調解溝通知覺」認知程度最高。四、居家服務督導員督導功能以「支持調適功能」表現最好。貳、不同背景居家服務督導員之賦權知覺、跨專業合作能力、角色知覺與督導功能具有差異。一、居家服務督導員賦權知覺會因年齡、教育程度、專業背景、照顧服務年資、督導年資、教育訓練及服務區域不同而有所差異，其中年齡較長且以高中（職）或研究所畢業具備較長照顧服務年資，督導年資在3至6年之居家服務督導員賦權知覺程度較高。二、居家服務督導員跨專業合作能力與督導員性別、年齡、教育程度、督導年資及服務區域不同而有所差異，其中女性督導員且年齡較長，以研究所或專科畢業具備3至6年督導年資之居家服務督導員跨專業合作能力程度較高。三、居家服務督導員角色知覺與督導員性別、年齡、教育程度、督導年資及服務區域不同而有所差異，其中女性督導員且具備3至6年督導年資之居家服務督導員角色知覺程度較高。四、居家服務督導員督導功能與督導員年齡、照顧服務工作年資、督導年資、教育訓練及服務區域不同而有所差異，其中年齡越長且具備3至6年督導年資之居家服務督導員督導功能程度較高。參、居家服務督導員之賦權知覺、跨專業合作能力、角色知覺與督導功能，彼此具有中、高度的正相關性且相互影響。一、居家服務督導員賦權知覺越高、跨專業合作能力也越好，對角色知覺程度及督導功能程度也越高。二、居家服務督導員對跨專業合作能力程度越好，對於角色知覺與督導功能程度也越好。三、居家服務督導員角色知覺程度越高，在督導功能表現越好。肆、居家服務督導員的賦權知覺、跨專業合作能力、角色知覺與督導功能所建構之結構方程模式適配度良好且具可行性。一、居家服務督導員的賦權知覺、跨專業合作能力、角色知覺與督導功能的結構方程模式適配度良好。二、居家服務督導員的賦權知覺對跨專業合作能力及角色知覺具有正向預測關係，而跨專業合作能力、角色知覺對督導功能有正向預測關係，其中以角色知覺對督導功能的預測力最高。伍、居家服務督導員的賦權知覺，會透過跨專業合作能力及角色知覺的完全中介效果影響督導功能，顯示督導賦權知覺與督導功能的關係會透過專業合作能力與角色知覺完全中介。
abstract_en: The purpose of this study was to explore the relationships among the empowerment perception, inter-professional cooperation competency, role perception, and supervisory function of home service supervisors. It mainly adopted the quantitative research, through the literature collection and discussion, expert review and pre-test analysis, to form the questionnaire of this research, and took the sample of home service supervisors in the four regions of the north, middle, south and east of the country as the research object. The total effective sample of the questionnaire was 332, statistically analyzed accordingly. The results of this study were as follows:1.The empowerment perception, inter-professional cooperation competency, role perception and supervisory function of home service supervisors were in good level.（1）The highest degree of empowerment perception of home service supervisors was “the meaning of occupation”.（2）The highest degree of inter-professional cooperation competency of home service supervisors was "inter-professional ethical value".（3）The highest degree of role perception of home service supervisors was " the perception of mediation ".（4）The highest degree of supervisory function of home service supervisors was " the function of supportive ".2.The empowerment perception, inter-professional cooperation competency, role perception and supervisory function of home service supervisors from different backgrounds were different.(1)The home service supervisors who were older and who had graduated from the institute or high school with longer experience in home services, and who had 3 to 6 years of supervision experience had a higher degree of empowerment perception.(2)The female and who had graduated from the institute or a junior college, and who had 3 to 6 years of supervision experience home service supervisors had a higher degree of inter-professional cooperation competency.(3)The female home service supervisors with 3 to 6 years of supervision experience had a higher degree of role perception.(4)The home service supervisors who were older and with 3 to 6 years of supervision experience had a higher degree of supervisory function.3.There was a moderate-highly positive correlation between the empowerment perception, inter-professional cooperation competency, role perception and supervisory function of home service supervisors.(1)The home service supervisors with higher degree of empowerment perception could have better inter-professional cooperation competency, role perception, and supervisory function.(2)The home service supervisors with higher degree of inter-professional cooperation competency could have better role perception, and supervisory function.(3)The home service supervisors with higher degree of role perception could have better supervisory function.4.The structural equation model adaptability of the empowerment perception, inter-professional cooperation competency, role perception and supervisory function of home service supervisors was acceptability and predictive.(1)The structural equation model adaptability of the empowerment perception, inter-professional cooperation competency, role perception and supervisory function of home service supervisors was acceptability.(2)The empowerment perception, inter-professional cooperation competency, role perception of home service supervisors, had a positive predictive relationship with the supervisory function, and the role perception had the highest predictive power.5.The empowerment perception of home service supervisors could influence supervisory function through the full mediating effect of inter-professional cooperation competency and role perception.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 高中生網路使用行為、網路霸凌經驗感知及其反應相關研究—以某技術型高中為例
title_en: High School Students' Internet Use Behavior, Cyberbullying Experience Perception and Their Responses:A Case of Technical High School
keywords: 高中生、網路使用行為、網路霸凌經驗感知、網路霸凌經驗反應、技術型高中
abstract_zh: 台灣資訊網絡發展可能導致不當網路使用行為形成一種無處不在的網路霸凌現象，以致高中生學習科目與專業知識之表現深受其影響，探討其網路使用行為、網路霸凌經驗感知及其反應之影響，實有必要。本研究旨在探討高中生網路使用行為、網路霸凌經驗感知及其反應相關之研究，研究目的如下：1.瞭解高中生網路使用行為、網路霸凌經驗感知及網路霸凌經驗反應的現況。2.探討不同背景高中生網路使用行為、網路霸凌經驗感知及網路霸凌經驗反應的差異情形。3.分析高中生網路使用行為、網路霸凌經驗感知及網路霸凌經驗反應的相關情形。4.分析高中生網路使用行為對網路霸凌經驗感知及網路霸凌經驗反應之預測力。    本研究以自編「高中生網路使用行為、網路霸凌經驗感知及其反應調查問卷」對832位高中生進行問卷調查。有效問卷回收639份，有效問卷回收率76.8%。所得資料以描述性統計、獨立樣本t檢定、變異數分析、事後比較、相關分析、逐步多元迴歸分析。本研究獲得結論如下：一、高中生中等程度使用網路，中高度使用於生活休閒，中度使用於交友聊天與教育學習。高中生很少感受到網路言語、性及關係霸凌經驗，且不太有網路霸凌經驗之不良反應。二、不同性別、年級、父母教育程度、網路使用年資、每週上網時數、上網地點高中生對「網路使用行為」有顯著差異；不同性別、年級、父母教育程度、就讀科別、網路使用年資高中生對「網路霸凌經驗感知」有顯著差異；不同性別、年級高中生對「網路霸凌經驗反應」有顯著差異。三、高中生「網路使用行為」、「網路霸凌經驗感知」與「網路霸凌經驗反應」有顯著正相關，三者間之相關性不高。四、高中生網路使用行為之「教育學習」對「網路霸凌經驗感知」及其「言語霸凌經驗感知」與「性霸凌經驗感知」具預測力；高中生網路使用行為之「教育學習」與「交友聊天」對「網路霸凌經驗反應」與「網路霸凌反擊反應」具預測力，以及其「生活休閒」對「網路霸凌心理反應」與「交友聊天」對「網路霸凌行為反應」具預測力。    根據研究結果，提出具體建議供主管教育行政機關、技術型高中推動網路霸凌防治之參考。關鍵詞：高中生、網路使用行為、網路霸凌經驗感知、網路霸凌經驗反應、技術型高中
abstract_en: The development of Taiwan's information network has prompted inappropriate Internet use behavior to form a ubiquitous phenomenon of cyberbullying. The performance of high school students' main subjects and related professional knowledge is deeply affected by it. This paper discusses their Internet use behavior, cyberbullying experience perception and The impact of its response is really necessary. The purpose of this study is to explore the research related to high school students' Internet use behavior, cyberbullying experience perception and response. situation. 2. To explore the differences in Internet usage behavior, cyberbullying experience perception and cyberbullying experience reaction among high school students from different backgrounds. 3. To analyze the related situations of high school students' Internet usage behavior, cyberbullying experience perception and cyberbullying experience reaction. 4. To analyze the predictive power of high school students' internet use behavior to cyberbullying experience perception and cyberbullying experience response.     This study conducted a questionnaire survey on 832 high school students with the self-compiled "Senior High School Students' Internet Use Behavior, Internet Bullying Experience Perception and Response Questionnaire". 639 valid questionnaires were recovered, and the recovery rate of valid questionnaires was 76.8%. The obtained data were analyzed by descriptive statistics, independent sample t test, variance analysis, post hoc comparison, correlation analysis and stepwise multiple regression analysis. The conclusions of this study are as follows:    (1) High school students use the Internet at a moderate level, at a moderate level in life and leisure, and at a moderate level in making friends, chatting, and education. High school students seldom experience verbal, sexual, and relationship bullying online, and are less likely to experience adverse reactions to cyberbullying.    (2) There are significant differences in "Internet usage behavior" among high school students by gender, grade, educational level of parents, years of Internet use, number of hours per week, and location where they surf the Internet; There are significant differences in the “perception of cyberbullying experience” among senior high school students who use the Internet; there are significant differences in “reaction to cyberbullying experience” among high school students of different genders and grades.    (3) High school students' "Internet use behavior", "cyberbullying experience perception" and "cyberbullying experience reaction" are significantly positively correlated, and the correlation between the three is not high.    (4) "Educational learning" of high school students' Internet use behavior has predictive power on "Internet bullying experience perception" and its "verbal bullying experience perception" and "sexual bullying experience perception"; Education and learning and "friend chat" are predictive of "cyberbullying experience response" and "cyberbullying counterattack response", as well as their "life leisure" vs. "Roadbullying Behavior Response" is predictive.    　    According to the research results, specific recommendations are put forward for the reference of competent educational administrative agencies and technical high schools to promote the prevention and control of cyberbullying.Keywords：high school students, internet use behavior, perception of cyberbullying  experience, response to cyberbullying experience, technical high school

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 擴增實境影片製作增進大學生英語口說能力與在地文化學習
title_en: Using Students’ AR Video-making to Enhance College Students’ English-speaking Performance and Local Cultural Learning
keywords: 擴增實境影片製作、大學生、英語口說表現、在地文化學習、益處和挑戰
abstract_zh: 英語口說及文化學習身為在21世紀生存不可獲缺的兩個技能被許多學者推廣須納入現今的語言教育之中，然而，許多老師們仍然以教師及考試導向的教學方式教導英文知識，導致有許多學生缺乏足夠的英語練習及文化知識。本研究目的如下：1、結合擴增實境影片製作在英語口說能力上的設計方案。2、探討擴增實境影片英語教學法對大學生在「英語口說能力表現」產生的差異。3、探討擴增實境影片英語教學法對大學生在「在地文化學習的益處」產生的效果。4、探討擴增實境影片英語教學法對大學生在「在地文化學習的益處挑戰」產生的效果。為達上述研究目的，本研究邀請36位來自台灣中部一所大學學生製作擴增實境文化影片。在這為期18週的課程中，大學生們必須先參加全民英檢口說能力測驗當作前測，以了解他們的英文程度。此外，他們需選擇任一當地旅遊景點、了解並搜集其文化、歷史、建築、及美食之相關資料，並將這些資料與多媒體素材結合，製作出實境擴增的文化影片。學生們於期中和期末時需撰寫反思學習單，以此表達他們在此課程的學習收穫，以及對課程的感受，並於期末再參與一次全民英檢口說能力測驗當作後測，以了解其英語口說進步幅度。蒐集的資料包含大學生在全民英檢口說測驗前測與後測成績，以及反思學習單的內容，並使用成對樣本 t 檢定及內容分析法分析。獲得以下的研究結果：1.擴增實境文化影片英語教學法可增進大學生英語口說能力表現。2.擴增實境文化影片英語教學法可增進大學生在地文化學習。3.擴增實境文化影片英語教學法對大學生在地文化學習有顯著的益處和挑戰。根據研究結果，提出具體建議供英語文教學者，進行英語教學之參考。
abstract_en: English speaking and cultural learning as two of vital skills for surviving in 21st century have been advocated in language education. However, most teachers still use teacher-centered and exam-oriented teaching approaches to teach linguistic knowledge, which leads to insufficient speaking practice and cultural learning. The objectives of this study are as follows: 1. To combine the design of AR cultural videos production in English oral skills. 2. To explore the difference on university students’ English-speaking performances when making AR cultural videos. 3. To explore the effects of AR cultural videos on university students’ local cultural learning. 4. To explore the effects of AR cultural videos on university students’ benefits and challenges of local cultural learning.This study, thus, in order to bridge this gap, engaged thirty-six university students in central Taiwan in making AR cultural videos for 18 weeks. Throughout this 18-week course, the students would first be asked to complete a GEPT speaking pre-test, and then they had to collaboratively choose a local tourist attraction, learn and collect its culture history, architecture, and food information and combine this information with multimedia sources to produce AR videos so as to introduce the local cultures. In the final week, the students were asked to take GEPT speaking post-test. The students were also asked to write mid-term and final reflective essays to express what they learnt and how they felt about the course. The collected data included the students’ scores from the pre-test and post-test of GEPT oral test and reflective essays. The data would be qualitatively and quantitatively analyzed respectively via paired sample t test and content analysis. The research results found out:1.English teaching method of augmented reality cultural video making could improve college students' English oral performance.2.English teaching method of augmented reality cultural video making could enhance college students' local cultural learning.3.English teaching method of augmented reality cultural video making had significant benefits and challenges for college students' local cultural learning.According to the research results, specific suggestions were provided for English language teachers to conduct English teaching as references.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 運用心智圖提 升創意思考能力對工作成就影響之研究 ­­ 以A科技公司員工為例
title_en: A Research on the Effect of Using Mind Map to Improve Creative Thinking Ability on WorkAchievement ­­ Taking a Technology Company as an Example.
keywords: 心智圖、創意思考能力、工作成就
abstract_zh: 本研究主要在分析創意思考能力對工作成就的影響，以某公司員工心智圖培訓為研究對象，以準實驗設計來驗證變數間的關聯性。    研究中，區分成控制組與實驗組進行本實驗，實驗前這兩組進行獨立樣本t檢定，得知這兩組未達顯著水準，表示這兩組是沒有顯著差異。實驗組員工進行一個月的心智圖培訓課程，再工作一週後，進行後測一，針對這兩組進行問卷調查，再持續進行工作一個月後，進行後測二，實證得知心智圖的教學成效及學習成效都具干擾效果，能內化心智圖受訓的成果，將受訓所學的心智圖，有效運用到工作上，所以才導致教學成效及學習成效都具干擾效果，證明培訓是需時間內化才有成效。並以迴歸模式分析創意思考能力對工作成就的影響性，得知創意思考能力的靈活性及獨創性顯著正向影響工作成就的自我工作評價；而創意思考能力的流暢性及精緻性顯著正向影響工作成就的他人工作評價。本研究並進行質性訪談，針對管理當局與員工，針對成果與成效的見解與看法。    本研究證實，員工接受心智圖的培訓及創意思考能力，是增強工作成就的前置變數。員工對心智圖的吸收與內化，是需要一段時間的醞釀，隨著時間的增長，才有培訓成效，對創意思考能力及工作成就都有顯著正向影響性。尤其員工對心智圖的教學成效及學習成效較高者，會有更高的工作成就，也就是心智圖對工作成就有正增強的效果，有助於創意思考能力及工作成就。最後根據研究之結果提出建議，供培訓單位參考。
abstract_en: This research analyses the impact of creative thinking on work achievement by employees’ mental mind map training of a certain company as the research object and adopts quasi-experimental design to verify the correlation between variables.    In the study on the experiment includes a control and an experimental group both were subjected to an independent sample test before this experiment to be found no reaching statistically significant level. As the two groups were not significantly different since first experiment has been done after one week later for conducting mind map training course. The questionnaire surveys were conducted for groups and the empirical results showed that both the teaching and learning effectiveness of the mind map did not interfere with it. This is to the short time and the employees who attend the experiment cannot effectively use the mind map learned by the training on work that they fail to moderate the effect. Moreover, a second experiment was conducted after to work again for another one month and the evidence reveals that they both succeed the moderating effect. It could possible that the experimented staffs can internalize the results of the mind map training and use it on the organization effectively. It analyzed the influence of creative thinking on work achievement by regression model and found that the flexibility and originality of creative thinking ability significantly positively affect the self-work evaluation of work achievement. While the fluency and refinement of creative thinking ability are significantly positive correction with other persons’ work evaluation of achievement. This study also interviews the managers’ or employees' views on the results.    This research confirms that employees’ mental mapping training and creative thinking skills are pre-variables for enhancing work achievement. The mind map absorption and internalization of employees require a period of incubation and it has a significant positive impact on creative thinking ability and work achievement gradually.  In particular, employees who have higher teaching and learning effectiveness of the mind map will have higher work achievements that it is has a positive effect on it. Therefore, employees have to learn the mind map well with absorb and internalize it into their own thinking mode for the purpose of this research.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 雲林縣國民中小學校務評鑑後設評鑑之研究
title_en: A Study on Meta-evaluation of Elementary and Junior High School Evaluation in Yunlin County
keywords: 雲林縣、國民中小學、校務評鑑、後設評鑑
abstract_zh: 校務評鑑品質攸關教育品質，然雲林縣國民中小學校務評鑑迄今尚無後設評鑑檢討其評鑑品質，故亟待進行後設評鑑探討之。本研究旨在探討雲林縣國民中小學校務評鑑後設評鑑指標認同度與差異、相關及影響關係模式，具體目的如下：1.建構雲林縣國民中小學校務評鑑的後設評鑑之研究架構。2.探討雲林縣國民中小學教育人員對校務評鑑後設評鑑指標認同度及差異。3.分析雲林縣國民中小學校務評鑑後設評鑑指標與構面認同度的相關情形。4.分析雲林縣國民中小學校務評鑑後設評鑑指標認同度之影響關係模式。本研究以自編之「雲林縣國民中小學校務評鑑後設評鑑調查問卷」對四類教育人員（國民中小學校長、主任、組長、教師），進行資料搜集，有效問卷回收326份，有效問卷回收率74%。所得資料以描述性統計、獨立樣本t檢定、單因子變異數分析、積差相關分析及結構方程模式分析，進行統計分析。本研究獲致結論如下：一、雲林縣國民中小學校務評鑑後設評鑑之研究架構及研究方法論有其貢獻。二、雲林縣國民中小學教育人員中高度認同校務評鑑後設評鑑指標，女性教育人員對校務評鑑後設評鑑指標「評鑑過程」、「評鑑結果」認同度高於男性；校長對「評鑑規劃」、「評鑑設計」、「評鑑過程」、「評鑑結果」及「運用與改善」高於主任、組長、教師；13-24班受試者對「評鑑設計」、「評鑑結果」、「運用與改善」高於12班以下者。三、雲林縣國民中小學校務評鑑後設評鑑指標與各構面認同度間具有高度正相關。四、雲林縣國民中小學校務評鑑後設評鑑指標認同度具有直接及中介效果網絡狀影響關係。本研究根據研究結果提出具體建議，供雲林縣主管教育行政機關、國民中小學校推動與實施校務評鑑之參考。
abstract_en: The quality of school evaluation was closely related to the quality of education. However, there was no meta- evaluation to review the elementary and junior high school evaluation quality of Yunlin county evaluation. The purpose of this study was to explore the meta- evaluation and difference, correlation and influence relationship model of the evaluation indicators in the elementary and junior high school evaluation in Yunlin county. The specific purposes was as follows:1. Construct the research framework of the meta- evaluation of elementary and junior high school evaluation in Yunlin county. 2. Explore the education personnel of elementary and junior high schools in Yunlin county’s thought about the recognition and differences of the evaluation indicators. 3. Analyze the relationship between the the meta-assessment’s evaluation indicators and the dimension identity of the elementary and junior high school evaluation in Yunlin county. 4. Analyze the influence relationship model of the metric recognition of the meta-assessment of elementary and junior high school in Yunlin county.In this study, the self-edited "Evaluation questionnaire on elementary and junior high schools in Yunlin county" was used to collect data about four types of educators (principals, directors, team leaders, and teachers of elementary and junior high schools), and 326 valid questionnaires were collected. The effective questionnaire recovery rate was 74%. The obtained data were analyzed by descriptive statistics, independent sample t test, one-way analysis of variance,product-moment correlation analysis and structural equation model analysis. The conclusions of this study are as follows.1.The research framework and research methodology of the meta-assessment of elementary and junior high school evaluation in Yunlin county have contributed to the evaluation.2.Most of the education personnel of elementary and junior high schools in Yunlin county highly agree that the evaluation indicators of the meta-assessment. Female educators have a higher recognition of the evaluation indicators on “evaluation process” and “evaluation results” than male educators.  The principals are more interested in "assessment planning", "assessment design", "assessment process", "assessment results" and "application and improvement" than directors, group leaders, and teachers. Subjects in schools with 13-24 classes have higher degree on "Assessment design", "assessment result", "application and improvement" than subjects in schools with class 12 or below.3.There is a high positive correlation between the evaluation indicators of the meta-assessment and the identity of each dimension in elementary and junior high schools in Yunlin county.4.The degree of recognition of the evaluation indicators of the meta-assessment in elementary and junior high school evaluation in Yunlin county has a direct and intermediary effect network-like influence relationship.Based on the research results, this study gives specific suggestions for Yunlin county's competent education administrative agencies and elementary and junior high schools to promote and implement school evaluation.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 國小校長生涯調適力之敘說研究
title_en: A Narrative Inquiry on the Career Adaptability of Elementary School Principals
keywords: 生涯調適力、生涯發展、生涯轉換、生涯成功
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在探究國小校長生涯調適力的歷程與具體改變。為達成研究目的，本研究透過四位研究參與者每位一至二次訪談，每次一至二小時之深度質性訪談，以敘說研究中「整體-內容」及「類別-內容」進行研究分析。首先探討校長生涯調適力的概念；接著探究校長生涯調適力所關注的「人－境」之間互動；最後，進而探究影響校長在工作世界中，其生涯調適力對生涯成功影響的重要因素。研究對象以國民小學校長為主，採取「立意取樣」方式，邀請雲林縣內國民小學校長參與接受訪談；所採用的研究方法為「文獻分析法」、「質性訪談法」、「參與觀察法」、及「文件分析法」。本研究先進行相關文獻分析，再以文獻分析方法進行比較探討，並發展「訪談大綱初稿」；其次採用「質性研究」方法與「敘說研究」策略，從自然情境中紀錄個案或事件脈絡，紀錄方式包括錄音錄影、筆記記錄、參與觀察、訪談和分析文件資料，然後運用資料加以分類歸納。透過文件分析等方法，研究發現「校長生涯調適力」之重要影響因素為：一、生涯調適與生涯關注發展密切相關，生涯規劃預備能促進慎思決策力；二、生涯控制能力影響生涯轉換的準備，校長應強化自我生涯發展的控制層面；三、生涯好奇的探索歷程影響價值觀建立，校長應適切引導生涯規劃邁向改變；四、關注環境互動是生涯決定與探索的主要途徑，生涯決定的信心歷程提升自我實現需求；五、生涯合作與生涯成功能相輔相成，生涯調適對生涯合作具有積極影響力。最後根據研究結果，提出相關建議提供國民小學學校校長、校長培育機構、及未來後續研究的參考建議，並據以提供校長生涯調適之規劃生涯發展參考。
abstract_en: This study aims to explore the course and specific changes of elementary school principals’ career adaptability. To achieve the objectives, the research was conducted and analyzed by adopting the analytical models--- the “holistic-content” and “categorical-content” of the narrative inquiry, through one to two in-depth qualitative interviews for 1-2 hours every time with each of the four research participants. First, the concept of principals’ career adaptability is discussed. Then, the interaction between “human and environment,” which is the focus of the principals’ career adaptability is explored. Finally, the important factors that affect the impact of the principals’ career adaptability on career success in the world of work are examined. The research subjects are mainly the elementary school principals, and the approach of purposive sampling is taken. The principals in the elementary schools in Yunlin County are invited to participate in the interviews, and the research methods used were “Literature Analysis Method,” “Qualitative Interview Method,” “Participant Observation Method” and “Documentary Research Method.”In this study, the relevant literature analysis is conducted first. Then, a comparative discussion is carried out with the literature analysis method, and “the first draft of the interview outline” is developed. Next, the "qualitative research" method and the "narrative research" strategy were taken to record the cases or event contexts from the natural situation. The recording modes include audio and video recordings, note recordings, participation observations, interviews and analyses of documents, and afterwards, the data is used for classification and induction.Through the documentary research and other methods, it is found that the important influencing factors of the “principals’ career adaptability” are as follows: 1. Career adjustment is closely related to the development of career concern, and the preparation for career planning can advance the deliberate decision-making skills. 2. Career control abilities affect the preparation for career transition, so principals should strengthen the control level of self-career development. 3. The exploration course of career curiosity influences the establishment of values, and principals should appropriately guide their career planning towards changes. 4. Paying attention to the environmental interaction is the main way to make career decisions and exploration, and the confidence mechanisms of career decisions enhances the needs for self-realization. 5. Career cooperation and career success can complement each other, and career adjustment has a positive effect on career cooperation. Finally, based on the research results, relevant advice is put forward to offer suggestions to elementary school principals, principal training institutions, and future follow-up studies, and it is provided as references for the planning of career development for principals’ career adjustment.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 主廚專業角色、知識管理及數位能力發展模式之研究
title_en: A Study on the Modeling of Professional Role, Knowledge Management and Digital Capability Development of Chefs
keywords: 主廚、專業角色、知識管理、數位能力發展
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在探討主廚在專業角色、知識管理及數位能力發展，問卷調查對象以臺灣中部(台中與南投)地區的星級飯店主廚201位。問卷調查結果以項目分析、探索式因素分析、描述性統計分析、單因子變異數分析、驗證性因素分析及線性結構方程模式，進行資料之分析，研究結果如下：一、主廚在專業角色的「廚房管理」知覺比較高；「供膳型式」最低，主廚在知識管理「傳統技轉」知覺比較高；「數位原理分析」最低，主廚在數位能力發展的「自主衛生管理」知覺比較高；「成本控制E化」最低。二、主廚在專業角色的學習過程沒有性別、年齡的區分，不同教育程度的「供膳型式」、「廚房管理」為高中大於大學，不同工作資歷的「廚房管理」為5年以上~10年(含)與15年以上大於1年~5年(含)。主廚在知識管理的學習過程沒有性別、年齡及工作資歷的區分，不同教育程度的「傳統技轉」為高中大於大學。主廚在數位能力發展的學習過程是沒有性別、年齡、教育程度、工作資歷上的區分。三、本研究建構的主廚專業角色、知識理、數位能力發展結構模式，適配度良好；模式具備檼定性與有效性，模式適用於臺灣各地區的主廚樣本資料。    本研究根據問卷調查所發現的問題，提出對主廚、餐飲業界、教育輔導和後續研究的改進建議。關鍵字：主廚、專業角色、知識管理、數位能力發展
abstract_en: This study aims to explore the professional roles, knowledge management and digital competence development of chefs. The respondents of the questionnaire were 201 chefs of star-rated restaurants in central Taiwan (Taichung and Nantou). The questionnaire survey results were analyzed by item analysis, exploratory factor analysis, descriptive statistical analysis, one-way analysis of variance, confirmatory factor analysis and linear structural equation model. The research results are as follows：1.The perception of "kitchen management" in professional roles of chefs is relatively high; "The lowest, chefs have a relatively high awareness of "autonomous hygiene management" in digital competence development; "cost control E-ization" is the lowest. 2. There is no gender or age distinction between chefs in the learning process of their professional roles. "Meal feeding style" and "kitchen management" with different education levels are higher than those of high school, and "kitchen management" with different work qualifications is more than 5 years. ~10 years (inclusive) and more than 15 years and more than 1 year to 5 years (inclusive). There is no distinction of gender, age and work qualifications between chefs in the learning process of knowledge management. The "traditional skills transfer" of different educational levels is that highschool is greater than university. The learning process of chefs in digital competence development is not differentiated by gender, age, education level, and work qualifications. 3. The structural model of chefs professional role, knowledge management, and digital competence development constructed in this study has a good degree of adaptation; the model is qualitative and effective, and the model can be applied to chefs sample data in various regions of Taiwan.    Based on the problems found in the questionnaire, this study proposes improvement suggestions for chefs, the catering industry, educational counseling and follow-up research.Keywords：chefs, professional role, knowledge management, digital competence development

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 以社會認知生涯理論建構升讀高職學生生涯選擇模式之研究
title_en: A Study on Constructing of Career Choice Model for Students Entering Vocational High School Based on Social Cognitive Career Theory
keywords: 社會認知生涯理論、生涯自我效能、社會支持、結果預期、生涯目標決定
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在以社會認知生涯理論為基礎，探討影響升讀高職學生的生涯選擇模式，使用後中資料庫107學年度釋出之高一（專一）網路問卷調查資料進行分析，研究結果發現：（一）男性就讀高職學生佔多數，又以餐旅群（佔16.2%）人數最多，曾參加技藝學程者僅佔21.7%，對於所就讀群科全無探索經驗者則是達38.2%。因為對群科學習內容很感興趣而選讀技職的達69.1%。（二）國中時期選修過技藝學程和群科探索經驗的受試者，在自我效能、興趣構面有較高得分；具有群科探索經驗者，在生涯目標決定也更加明確。（三）建構模型經適配度考驗結果配適程度良好，且具有良好之內在品質。（四）修正之升讀高職學生生涯選擇模型，各變項間之標準化迴歸權重估計值：學習經驗對自我效能（.323）、社會支持對自我效能（.320）、自我效能對結果預期（.375）、自我效能對興趣（.265）、結果預期對興趣（.417）、興趣對目標決定（.676）。此外，針對研究結果，提出建議包括：國中階段應提供充足的職業探索與技藝教育學習機會、後中資料庫問卷追踪之題項在職涯選擇上增列題組、學校教育方面要更加落實生涯輔導等。
abstract_en: Based on the social cognitive career theory, this research aims to explore the career choice model that affects the students who entering vocational high schools. The results showed that: (1) The majority of students were male, and the largest number of students were in the food and travel group (16.2%). Only 21.7% had participated in technical courses, and 38.2% had no experience in exploring the group subjects they were studying. 69.1% of them are interested in the learning content of group subjects. (2) Students who have studied skills and experience in group exploration have higher scores in the dimensions of self-efficacy and interest; in fact, those who have experience in group exploration have a clearer career goal decision. (3) The model fits well and has good internal quality. (4) Estimated values of standardized regression weights among the variables of the career choice model for students entering vocational high schools: learning experience to self-efficacy (.323), social support to self-efficacy (.320), self-efficacy to outcome expectations (.375), self-efficacy to interest (.265), outcome expectations to interest (.417), and interest to career goal determination (.676). In addition, in response to the research results, some suggestions are put forward, including: providing sufficient opportunities for career exploration and technical education at the middle school stage, adding question groups to career selection in the questionnaire items tracked by the TUSED, and implementing more career guidance in school education.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 馬來西亞華文獨中統一課程與國際文憑課程融合可行性評估
title_en: A Feasibility Study of Integrating the International Baccalaureate Curriculum into the Unified Curriculum of the Malaysia Independent Chinese Secondary Schools
keywords: 華文獨中統一課程、國際文憑課程、課程融合
abstract_zh: 本研究探討在既有的馬來西亞華文獨中統一課程中實施國際文憑課程的可能性。通過以下三個研究問題來探討其可行性方案：1. 了解及歸納適合獨中實施的國際文憑課程。2. 了解國際文憑課程在類似地區（如臺灣）的成效。3. 評估獨中實施國際文憑課程之可能衝擊與因應策略。本研究從文獻分析法、文件分析法、及半結構式訪談法來分析及歸納適合獨中統一課程實施的國際文憑課程。本研究結果如下：一、國際文憑課程可以契合獨中學制；二、歐美大學普遍接受國際文憑畢業證書；三、國際文憑課程目標與獨中統一課程目標一致性高；四、國際文憑--大學預科項目適合獨中的課程架構；五、臺灣已開辦國際文憑課程之學校有15所，其中公立學校3所，私立學校12所，其中以「大學預科項目」最為普遍，總計有10所開辦；六、台灣公私立學校開辦國際文憑課程多為提高學校聲譽、形象及行銷為考量點；七、台灣開辦國際文憑課程可以促進雙語教育，呼應目前的國家雙語教育政策；八、實施國際文憑課程的負面衝擊是減少進入此一課程學生使用華語母語的機會，不利於華語聽、說、讀、寫的學習；九、獨中實施國際文憑的生源影響為正向的影響，可以吸引其他族群學生就讀；十、配合國際文憑課程的實施，學校的行政系統勢必改組，其中可能衍生的阻力或困境有待董事會提早規劃因應；十一、國際文憑課程各科的內部評估機制嚴謹可為獨中借鏡學習；十二、獨中開辦國際文憑課程所需師資培訓，國際文憑組織可以提供系列的培訓活動；十三、開辦國際文憑可以讓獨中接軌國際化，讓學校師生更了解國際社會；十四、 獨中國際文憑畢業生未來就讀歐美大學的進路質量皆可提升。最後，根據研究發現，對獨中董事會，獨中行政體系，及未來研究方向提出建議。
abstract_en: This research explores the feasibility of implementing the International Baccalaureate (IB) curriculum in the existing unified curriculum of Malaysian Independent Chinese Secondary Schools (MICSS). Exploring the feasibility of this research, three main research questions will be addressed: 1. Understand and summarize the most suitable IB curriculum for implementation in  MICSS. 2. To gauge the effectiveness of the IB curriculum in a similar region (e.g. Taiwan). 3. To assess the possible impacts and coping strategies of the IB curriculum implementation in MICSS. This study will analyze and summarize the IB curriculum suitable for the implementation of the Unified Curriculum of independent secondary schools from the literature analysis method, document analysis and semi-structured interviews.The results of this study are as follows: 1. The IB curriculum can fit into the MICSS Unified Curriculum. 2. The IB diploma certificate is generally accepted by European and American universities. 3. The IB curriculum objectives are highly consistent with the Unified Curriculum objectives. 4. The IB Diploma Programme is suitable for the MICSS curriculum structure. 5. 15 schools in Taiwan have offered the IB programme, including 3 public schools and 12 private schools, of which the IB Diploma Programme is the most common, with a total of 10 schools offering this programme. 6. IB programme are now being used by public and private schools in Taiwan to improve their reputation, image and marketing strategies. 7. IB programme in Taiwan can promote bilingual education, which is also echoing the current national bilingual education policy. 8. The implementation of the IB Diploma Programme is believed to contribute to students reducing the use of their native Chinese language, which is not conducive to learning Chinese listening, speaking, reading, and writing. 9. The implementation of the IB programme can also enhance enrollment from other ethnic groups in MICSS, bringing greater understanding amongst the people. 10. For implementation of the IB programme, the school's board of directors’ approval is needed to reorganize the administrative system to ensure that issues arising can be mitigated. 11.  The rigorous internal assessment mechanism of the IB Diploma Programme can be used as a reference for learning by MICSS. 12. The IB Organization can provide a series of training activities for teachers from MICSS when implementing the IB Diploma Programme. 13. Implementing IB Diploma Programme in MICSS is in line with globalization, and enable school teachers and students to better understand the international community. 14. IB graduates will be equipped with the necessary qualifications when attending European and American universities for a brighter future. Finally, based on the research findings, suggestions are made for the MICSS board of directors, the MICSS administrative system, and future research directions.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 大學生運動行為相關影響因素與模型驗證之研究
title_en: A Study of Exercise Behaviors and Relating Factors and Model Validation of College Students
keywords: 運動意願、健康信念、自我效能、運動行為
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在探討大學生運動行為的影響因素，並以健康信念模式及自我效能等理論進行研究，研究對象為國立科技大學學生，採問卷調查法方式進行資料蒐集，研究工具包括運動意願量表、健康信念因素實際感受量表、自我效能量表、運動行為量表，各量表採用內部一致性信度檢測，Cronbach α 值均達0.7 以上，叢集取樣方式發放530份問卷，有效問卷共402份，分別為工程學院、管理學院、設計學院、人文與科學學院，共計402人。其中男性263人、女性139人。資料處理採平均數、標準差、t檢定、單因子變異數分析、階層迴歸及皮爾森積差相關等方法，研究結果發現如下:壹、研究對象運動量偏低，無運動222人，高達55.2%，BMI平均數為22.18。貳、不同性別在知覺憂鬱情緒威脅、知覺運動障礙方面有顯著差異，女性顯著高於男性；在自我效能、運動行為方面，男性顯著高於女性。課業壓力愈輕鬆，知覺運動線索能力愈佳，達顯著差異。上網時間愈短，知覺運動利益愈佳、自我效能愈好，達顯著差異。參、運動意願與罹病可能性、運動線索、運動利益、自我效能具有顯著正相關，與運動障礙具有顯著負相關。肆、本研究建構的健康信念模式應用於健康行為模式，適配度良好；複核效化分析結果，模式具備穩定性與有效性。本研究建議學校教育應強化學生的運動意願和運動利益，增加多元化的運動社團，為大學學生擬定健康促進之生活目標，並開設與運動相關的健康促進課程，促進大學生的運動行為，減少運動障礙，增加運動線索，活絡校園的運動氣氛，達成｢生活體適能、體適能生活｣目標。
abstract_en: This study aims to explore the influencing factors of college students' sport behavior, and conduct research based on theories such as health belief model and self-efficacy. The research object is the students of the National University of Science and Technology. Health Belief Factor Actual Feeling Scale, Self-efficacy Scale, Motor Behavior Scale, each scale was tested with internal consistency reliability, Cronbach α value was above 0.7, 530 questionnaires were distributed by cluster sampling, and a total of 402 valid questionnaires, respectively, the College of Engineering, the College of Management, the College of Design, and the College of Humanities and Sciences, with a total of 402 people. Among them, 263 were male and 139 were female. The data processing adopts the methods of mean, standard deviation, t-test, one-way anova, regression and Pearson correlation. The research results are as follows:1. The amount of exercise of the research subjects was low, 222 students did not exercise, up to 55.2%, and the average BMI was 22.18.2. Different genders have significant differences in perceived depressive emotional threat and perceived motor impairment, and women are significantly higher than men； in terms of self-efficacy and motor behavior, men are significantly higher than women. The easier the academic pressure, the better the ability of perceptual motor cues, and the difference was significant. The shorter the time spent on the Internet, the better the perceived motor benefits and the better the self-efficacy, with a significant difference.Participation and exercise willingness were significantly positively correlated with the possibility of disease, exercise cues, exercise benefits, and self-efficacy, and significantly negatively correlated with movement disorders.4. The health belief model constructed in this study is applied to the health behavior model, and the degree of adaptation is good; after reviewing the results of the validation analysis, the model is qualitative and effective.This study suggests that school education should strengthen students' willingness to exercise and exercise interests, increase diversified sports clubs, formulate health promotion life goals for college students, and set up sports-related health promotion courses to promote college students' exercise behavior and reduce exercise. Obstacles, increase exercise clues, activate the sports atmosphere of the campus, and achieve the goal of "life fitness, physical fitness life".

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 中國大陸高等職業院校教師前攝行爲之研究
title_en: A Study on the Proactive Behavior of Higher Vocational Colleges in Mainland China
keywords: 中國大陸、高等職業院校、前攝行爲、組織支持感、教學績效
abstract_zh: 基於以往中國大陸高等職業教育的研究，聚焦物流群科一綫教師，本研究目的在於瞭解中國高等職業院校教師的前攝行爲影響機制。本研究以運用組織行爲學的理論主張為基礎，建構包括前攝人格、工作活力、工作專注、目標導向、組織文化和組織地位等六個前因變項，組織支持為中介變項，教學績效為結果變項，依序編制問卷，採用分層二階段抽樣技術蒐集373 份現任高職院校教師為有效樣本，運用項目分析、探索式因素分析、驗證式因素分析、描述性統計分析、單因子變異數分析、多因子變異數分析、階層回歸分析和拔靴中介效果分析。    研究發現：一、男教師的謀略行爲表現顯著好於女教師，省級雙高計劃院校的教師常規績效高於於國家級和普通院校，46 嵗以上教師的工作專注度顯著高於40 嵗以下的80 後、90 後青年教師，本科學歷教師的工作活力、目標導向均顯著高於碩士學歷教師；二、除前攝人格外，模式中工作活力、工作專注、目標導向、組織文化、組織地位皆對教師前攝行爲有顯著影響，其中工作活力具負相關；三、教師前攝行爲、組織支持感和教學績效三者存在顯著相關關係，組織支持感在前攝行爲與教學績效間起部分中介遮掩效果。    上述的研究發現，可供中央或地方教育政策決策及執行單位參考；另外，本模式未來亦可擴大運用至職業教育其他群科對象或政策，具理論和實務的應用性。
abstract_en: Based on the previous studies of higher vocational education in Mainland China generally focused on the teachers of logistics, this study purports to understand the influence mechanism of proactive behavior on teachers in China higher vocational colleges.
