According to the theory of organizational behavior, the study constructs six antecedent variables, including proactive personality, work vigor, work absorption, goal orientation, organizational culture and organizational status. One mediator variable is organizational support perceived, and one outcome variable is teaching performance. Questionnaires are developed in order to collect 373 valid samples with stratified two-stage sampling and anlysed by using item analysis, exploratory factor analysis, confirmatory factor analysis, descriptive statistical analysis, one-way ANOVA, multifactor ANOVA, hierarchical regression analysis, and bootstrapping mediator effect analysis.    The study finally led to the following results: First, the strategic scanning behavior of male teachers is significantly better than that of female teachers, the regular performance of teachers in institutions of higher education at the provincial level is higher than that in national and ordinary institutions, the work absorption of teachers aged 46 and above is significantly higher than that of young teachers aged 40 and below, and the work vigor and goal orientation of teachers with bachelor's degree are significantly higher than those of teachers with master's degree; Second, besides proactive personality, work vigor, work absorption, goal orientation, organizational culture and organizational status have significant effects on teachers' proactive behavior; Third, teachers' proactive behavior, perceived organizational support and teaching performance are significantly correlated, and perceived organizational support partially mediates the relationship between proactive behavior and teaching performance.    In addition, this model can be further employed to other groups of subjects for policy decisions in vocational education in the future in terms of theoretical interpretation and practical application.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 國小師鐸獎教師專業特質分析研究
title_en: An Analytical Study on the Professional Characteristics of Excellent Award Teachers
keywords: 國小教師、師鐸獎、專業特質
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在探討國小師鐸獎教師具備的專業特質，在教學上、對學生的關懷、專業責任展現、社群關係營造、專業成長等方面的表現。為了達到研究目的，本研究採取質性研究法，以三位國小師鐸獎獲獎教師為研究對象，透過半結構式深度訪談法進行資料蒐集。依據訪談獲得的資料分析與歸納結果，主要研究結論如下：一、在「教學」上專業特質表現有：課程與教學設計強調生活經驗結合，非常重視學習動機的引發；注重體驗學習，讓學生從做中學；瞭解學生學習差異，善用不同的教學策略；提供學生自我表現機會，讓學生都能獲得成功經驗。二、在「對學生關懷表現」上專業特質表現：注重生活敎育，強調正確的生活態度與習慣的養成；注重品格教育；能注意到孩子特殊差異，主動給於個別化關懷；主動的親師溝通，增進親師間的教育共識。三、在「專業責任展現」上專業特質表現：樂於承擔學校的行政工作；充滿教育熱忱；具備教育使命感；付出課餘時間，陪伴成就學生。四、在「社群關係經營」上專業特質表現：與同儕相互支援，共同解決問題；展現協作能力；善用家長力量，阻力變助力；強調團隊力量，感謝團隊付出。五、在「專業成長」上專業特質表現：持續不斷學習，隨時隨地都在增加自己的專業知識；加入輔導團充實自己；學習沒有限制範圍主題。
abstract_en: The purpose of this study is to explore the professional characteristics of excellent award teachers performance in teaching, caring for students, showing professional responsibility, crowd relations management, and professional growth. In order to achieve the research purpose, this research adopts the qualitative research method, and had interviewed personnel of three elementary school teachers as the research objects, and collects the data through the semi-structured in-depth interview method. According to the data analysis and summary results obtained from the interviews, the main research conclusions are as follows:a. In the "teaching" : Curriculum and instructional design emphasizes the combination of life experience and attaches great importance to the initiation of learning motivation; focuses on experiential learning, allowing students to learn by doing; understands students' learning differences and makes good use of different teaching strategies; provides students with opportunities for self-expression, so that students can achieve success experience.b. In "Caring for Students": Pay attention to life education, emphasize the development of correct life attitudes and habits; pay attention to character education; be able to pay attention to the special differences of children, and take the initiative to give individualized care; active parent-teacher communication to enhance the educational consensus between parents and teachers.c. In ",Professional Responsibility Demonstrated": Willing to undertake the administrative work of the school; showing enthusiasm for education; having a sense of educational mission; devoting spare time to accompany and achieve students.d. In " Interpersonal relationship maintain": Support each other with peers to solve problems together; show collaboration ability; make good use of parental power, resistance becomes help; emphasize team strength and thank the team for their efforts.e. In ",professional growth ": Continuous learning, increasing your professional knowledge anytime, anywhere; Join professional societies to enrich yourself; Learning is not limited by subject.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 候用校長生涯韌性、敬業貢獻與職場幸福感之研究
title_en: A Study of Career Resilience,Work Engagement and Workplace Well-being for the Pre-service Principals
keywords: 校長專業發展、韌性、敬業貢獻度、幸福感
abstract_zh: 本研究目的為：一、探討候用校長生涯韌性、敬業貢獻與職場幸福感之現況。二、探討不同背景變項候用校長在生涯韌性、敬業貢獻與職場幸福感之差異。三、驗證候用校長生涯韌性、敬業貢獻與職場幸福感之關係。四、驗證候用校長生涯韌性與敬業貢獻能有效預測職場幸福感。為達上述研究目的，以問卷調查法及半結構訪談法為研究方法，以在臺灣各縣市教育局（處）行政實習之候用校長為研究對象。問卷調查共發出問卷240份，回收有效問卷232份；並輔以半結構訪談的方式，抽取9位在各縣市教育局（處）行政實習超過二年的國中小候用校長參與研究。本研究結論如下：一、候用校長「生涯韌性」、「敬業貢獻」與「職場幸福感」的現況均為「中上」程度。二、不同性別、年齡、行政實習年資之候用校長，在生涯韌性構面並無顯著差異；不同最高學歷之候用校長在生涯韌性構面達顯著差異。三、不同性別、年齡、行政實習年資之候用校長，在敬業貢獻構面並無顯著差異；不同最高學歷之候用校長在敬業貢獻構面達顯著差異。四、不同性別、年齡、行政實習年資之候用校長，在職場幸福感構面並無顯著差異；不同最高學歷之候用校長在職場幸福感等構面達顯著差異。五、生涯韌性對敬業貢獻整體構面達顯著水準，並呈現中度相關情形。六、生涯韌性對職場幸福感整體構面達顯著水準，並呈現低度相關情形。七、敬業貢獻整體構面對職場幸福感整體構面呈現高度相關情形八、候用校長生涯韌性對職場幸福感的影響為正向關係，即候用校長的生涯韌性愈高，則其職場幸福感愈高。九、候用校長敬業貢獻對職場幸福感整體構面的影響為正向關係，即候用校長的敬業貢獻愈高，則其職場幸福感整體構面愈高。十、候用校長生涯韌性、敬業貢獻與職場幸福感整體結構適配度良好。
abstract_en: The questionnaire survey method and the semi-structured interview method were used as the research methods, and the pre-service principals who were in the administrative practice of the education bureaus (divisions) of various counties and cities in Taiwan were used as the research objects. A total of 240 questionnaires were sent out, and 232 valid questionnaires were recovered; supplemented by semi-structured interviews, 9 pre-service principals who had been in the administrative practice of the county and city education bureaus (divisions) for more than two years were selected to participate in the research. The conclusions of this study are as follows:1. The current status of the pre-service principals career resilience, work engagement and workplace well-being are all at the moderate to upper level.2. There is no significant difference in the aspect of dedication and contribution in terms of career resilience when using pre-service principals for different genders, ages, and administrative internship years; however, there are significant differences in the aspect of dedication and contributions for principals who are candidates for different highest academic degrees.3. There is no significant difference in the aspect of dedication and contribution in terms of work engagement when using pre-service principals for different genders, ages, and administrative internship years; however, there are significant differences in the aspect of dedication and contributions for principals who are candidates for different highest academic degrees.4. There is no significant difference in the aspect of dedication and contribution in terms of workplace well-being when using pre-service principals for different genders, ages, and administrative internship years; however, there are significant differences in the aspect of dedication and contributions for principals who are candidates for different highest academic degrees.5.The overall dimension of career resilience to work engagement has reached a significant level, with a moderate correlation.6. For the Career resilience has a significant effect on the overall and various aspects of workplace happiness as it shows a low degree of correlation.7. The overall dimension of work engagement is highly correlated with the overall dimension of workplace well-being.8. The impact of career resilience of prospective principals on workplace well-being is a positive relationship that is the higher the career resilience of prospective principals and the higher of their workplace well-being.9. The impact of prospective pre-service principals work engagement on the overall dimension of workplace well-being is a positive relationship, That is the higher the prospective pre-service principals work engagement and the higher the overall dimension of workplace well-being.10. For the pre-service principals have a good degree of fit in the overall structure of career resilience, work engagement and workplace well-being.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 點讀筆結合閱讀理解策略對提升國小學習障礙學生閱讀學習成效之研究
title_en: The Reading Pen Combined with Reading Comprehension Strategy on the Effects of Reading Learning for Elementary School Students with Learning Disabilities
keywords: 點讀筆、閱讀理解策略、學習障礙、閱讀學習成效
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在探討點讀筆結合閱讀理解策略的教學對提升國小學習障礙學生閱讀學習能力的成效。研究方法採用單一受試研究法之A-B-A'撤回實驗設計，以雲林縣某國小兩名三年級學習障礙學生為研究對象，進行為期十週，共二十節的教學實驗課程。自變項是點讀筆結合閱讀理解策略教學，依變項是研究對象在研究者自編的閱讀學習成效測驗中「聽音選字」、「看字讀音」、「閱讀理解」三項分測驗之結果，透過視覺分析、C統計進行資料處理與分析，以了解研究對象在閱讀學習的成效。    研究主要結果如下：一、點讀筆結合閱讀理解策略對學習障礙學生在「聽音選字」測驗具有立即與保留成效。二、點讀筆結合閱讀理解策略對學習障礙學生在「看字讀音」測驗具有立即與保留成效。三、點讀筆結合閱讀理解策略對學習障礙學生在「閱讀理解」測驗具有立即與保留成效。    最後，根據研究結果提出教學及未來研究的建議。關鍵詞：點讀筆、閱讀理解策略、學習障礙、閱讀學習成效
abstract_en: The purpose of this study was to explore the effects of the reading pen combined with reading comprehension strategy on improving the reading learning for elementary school students with learning disabilities. The study was conducted by using an A-B-A’ withdrawal design of the single subject. Two third-grader with learning disabilities in a elementary school in Yunlin County as the research object and taught for ten weeks, a total of twenty sessions of experimental teaching. The independent variable was the reading pen combined with reading comprehension strategy and the dependent variable was the reading learning results in the “ listen to choose", “ read to pronounce", and “ reading comprehension" compiled by the researcher. Data were processed and analyzed by visual analysis and C statistics to understand the effectiveness of research in reading learning.    The results of this study were as follows:1.The reading pen combined with reading comprehension strategy had immediate and maintaining effects on the performance of “ listen to choose" test for the student’s with learning disabilities.2.The reading pen combined with reading comprehension strategy had immediate and maintaining effects on the performance of “ read to pronounce" test for the student’s with learning disabilities.3.The reading pen combined with reading comprehension strategy had immediate and maintaining effects on the performance of “ reading comprehension" test for the student’s with learning disabilities.Finally, suggestions for teaching and future studies, based on the results of this study were discussed.Keywords: reading pen, reading comprehension strategy, learning disabilities,          the effects of reading learning

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 國中生英語科學習成就對學科能力影響之實證研究
title_en: A Research the influence of English learning achievement on subject ability of middle school students.
keywords: 英語學習成就、英語記憶、英語理解、英語應用
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在探討國中生英語科三構面（記憶、理解、應用）之間分別表現和相關性並且進一步分析英語科學習成就與國文、數學、理化學習成就之間的關聯性。本研究採用雲林縣某國中，一百零八學年度下學期第二次英語成績及國文、數學、理化成績進行分析及探討。為達成上述目的，本研究係採統計考驗法，以一百一十八人國中八年級生為研究對象，考卷採用學校老師所命題之考卷，研究者將這些研究對象的英語科學習成就進一步分析後並與國文、數學、理化學習成就進行探討。    研究者透過學生學習成就運用統計考驗法，獲得以下結論：一、英語科的學習成就中包含了記憶、理解、應用等三個構面，這三構面達顯著相關，這表示當這三個構面之間互相影響著。二、英語科學習成就能力會影響其他學科學習成就的表現。三、英語三構面記憶、理解、應用與其他學科學習成就達顯著相關，表示當學生英語科三構面能力增加時能牽動其他學科成績。
abstract_en: The purpose of this study is to explore the performance and correlation between the three dimensions of English subjects (memory, comprehension, and application) of middle school students, and to further analyze the correlation between English learning achievement and Mandarin, mathematics, physics and chemistry learning achievement. In this study, the results of English, Mandarin, mathematics, physics and chemistry in the second semester of the second semester of the 108 academic year of a middle school in Yunlin County were used to analyze and discuss. In order to achieve the above purpose, this research adopts the statistical test method, taking 118 middle school eighth-grade students as the research object, and the test paper adopts the test paper proposed by the school teacher. The researcher further analyzes the English subject learning achievement of these research objects. Afterwards, it discusses with the achievement of Mandarin, mathematics, physics and chemistry.    Using statistical tests based on student achievement, the researchers obtained the following conclusions:1. The learning achievement of English subject includes three aspects: memory, comprehension, and application. These three aspects are significantly correlated, which means that when these three aspects influence each other.2. The English subject learning achievement ability will affect the performance of other subjects' learning achievement.3. The memory, comprehension, and application of the three aspects of English are significantly related to the learning achievements of other subjects, which means that when the students' ability of the three aspects of English subjects increases, it can affect the performance of other subjects.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 設計斜槓工作者雙重職涯歷程之研究
title_en: A Study of Atypical Employer’s Motivation-base on Slash Designer’s Case
keywords: 雙重職涯、斜槓者、職業生涯
abstract_zh: 此研究共分成五章，第一章為緒論，第二章是文獻探討，研究設計主要透過此章獲得啟發，並從中確立本研究議題之研究目的與問題，至於第三章為研究方法與設計，而第四章質性訪談結果分析與討論，最後一章為第六章結論與研究限制。本研究旨在探討設計斜槓工作者多重職涯歷程之研究。據此，研究目的為：（一）探討自由設計工作者，斜槓職業的發展與現況；（二）探討自由設計工作者，斜槓職涯發展形成及困境；（三）探究自由設計工作者，斜槓職涯發展的未來規劃。爾後，透過整體訪談分析所獲結果，將提供未來有意選擇斜槓職涯工作者參考。至於，研究採取質性研究取向，以深度訪談法為主，作為蒐集研究資料之方法：並以立意選取5位斜槓設計領域工作者作為本研究參與研究者。最後，以主題分析法將訪談文本進行歸納分析出意義主題，提出研究結果。對此，本研究結論如下：（一）自由設計工作者普遍初投入斜槓職涯，多數因親友的鼓勵及支持而選擇投入，且擁有時間管理才更有助於斜槓也更能符合期待，且主專業及經驗皆有利斜槓職業發揮專業加乘效果；（二）斜槓職業普遍多數因獲得同儕、朋友支持肯定而選擇投入，普遍認為累積職涯資本是重要的，而整體斜槓職涯發展可分為四個重要階段；（三）多數斜槓工作者願意持續投入下去，認為必須保持願意學習累積實務的心態。
abstract_en: The research has divided into five chapter. The first chapter is introduction, followed by literature review. Third chapter is the chapter I am inspired the most, it is about my research method and design. Chapter four contains collected interview data and research analysis. The last chapter is research results and research limitations.The research purpose is to analysis the slash Designer’s career development. Such as: (1) to discuss the Slash Designer’s career development and present condition. (2) discuss what determined the Slash designer's career path and difficulties encountered (3) what are the Slash Designer’s future plans are. By analysing the interview, valuable career experience and knowledge will be helpful for future Slash designers.The research data is aquired via qualitative interviews. The interviewee were 5 Slash Designer who works in the designer field. At last, the research result was base on the interview data and the raw data collected. In conclusion, the results are: (1) Most Slash designers are able to work in the field are due to their family and friend's encouragement and affirmation. Time management is valuable skill as it is needed to meet the deadline of the business partners. Skill and experience are also essential to the profession. (2) most Slash Designer thinks accumulating experience and skills throughout the career is essential for the career development, and this career development can divide in to four stages; (3) Slash Designer agrees keeping an open mind for new things is the key to help them keep working as a slash designer.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 某技術型高中餐飲科學生媒體傳播效應與身體意象之相關研究
title_en: A Study of the Relationship between Media Communication Effect and Body Image of Catering Students in a Technical High School
keywords: 餐飲科、媒體傳播效應、身體意象
abstract_zh: 因應全球科技與產業及結構的快速變遷，台灣資訊網絡的發展已促使媒體傳播形成一種無處不在的潛在現象及不對等價值觀傳遞無形中導致接收者潛意識自我身體意象塑造，而餐飲科學生因主要學習科目與相關專業知識其表現深受其影響，因之如能探討餐飲科學生媒體傳播效應及身體意象之影響，乃為課程設計與教學重要議題。本研究旨在探討餐飲科學生在媒體傳播效應與身體意象之相關研究，研究目的如下：一、瞭解餐飲科學生對於媒體傳播效應之現況與差異。二、暸解餐飲科學生對於身體意象的現況與差異。三、分析餐飲科學生媒體傳播效應與身體意象之相關情形。四、分析餐飲科學生媒體傳播效應對身體意象之預測力。為達上述目的，本研究以雲林縣某技術型高中餐飲科592位學生為研究對象，進行問卷調查研究，採用「媒體傳播效應量表」以及「多向度身體自我關係問卷」搜集資料，探討其個人背景對媒體傳播效應接收與個人對身體意象感受之認同度與差異，以期透過了解餐飲科學生個人背景、媒體傳播效應及其身體意象之關係，從中探討並彙整此三者之間的關聯。所得資料以描述性統計、獨立樣本t檢定、單因子異數分析、皮爾森積差相關分析、逐步多元迴歸分析。本研究獲得結論如下：一、餐飲科學生對媒體傳播效應看法呈現「中低程度」與「不佳」間認同度；餐飲科學生對身體意象現況看法呈現「中低度」間認同度。二、除性別及體型滿意度對媒體傳播效應未顯著外，其他不同背景餐飲科學生對媒體傳播效應與身體意象看法有顯著差異。三、餐飲科學生除媒體傳播效應各構面與身體意象「身體各部位滿意度」構面無顯著相湍外，其餘整體與各構面間之相關性大部分獲得支持，且相關程度為「低度相關」與「高度相關」之間正相關。四、餐飲科學生媒體傳播效應對身體意象的預測力除「身體各部位滿意度」無顯著性外，「認同度」、「批評懷疑」、「社會壓力」及「比較」對「外表評價」及「外表取向」具有預測力。據以上結論，提出具體建議供技術型高中及主管教育行政機關推動教育之政策參考。
abstract_en: In response to the rapid changes of technology, industry and structure in global, the development of Taiwan's information network has promoted media communication to form a ubiquitous potential phenomenon and the transmission of asymmetric values, which invisibly leads to the shaping of the receiver's subconscious self-body image. The performance of catering students is deeply influenced by the main subjects of study and related professional knowledge. Therefore, if they can explore the influence of media communication and body image of catering students, it is an important topic for curriculum design and teaching. This research aims to explore the relevant research on media broadcasting effects and body image of catering students. The purpose of the research is as follows: 1. To understand the current status and differences of catering students' media broadcasting effects. 2. Understand the current status and differences of body image of catering students. 3. Analyze the relationship between media broadcasting effects and body image of catering students. 4. Analyze the predictive power of catering students' media broadcasting effect on body image.Accordingly, there were 592 students from the Food and Beverage Department of a vocational school in Yunlin County as the object, conducted a questionnaire survey, using the "Media broadcasting effect Scale" from Cheng-Sung Wang & Chien-Hsin Wang (2010), and Wang and Wang (2004). The Dimensional Body-Self-Relationship Questionnaire collects data to explore the influence of their personal background on the reception of media broadcasting effects and personal perceptions of body image, in order to explore and summarize the relationship between the personal background of catering students, media broadcasting effects and their body image The influence and connection between these three. The data obtained are based on descriptive statistics, independent sample t test, single factor outlier analysis, Pearson product difference correlation analysis, and stepwise multiple regression analysis.The findings of the study are follows:1.The perception of media communication effects of students in food and beverage department show a "medium-low" and "poor" identity; catering students' perceptions of body image status show a "medium-low" identity.2. Besides gender and body type satisfaction, which have no significant effect on media communication, other students in food and beverage department with different backgrounds have significant differences in their views on media communication effects and body image.3. Besides the media communication effect, which has no significant correlation with the body image "satisfaction of various parts of the body", most of the correlations between the rest of the students as a whole and each dimension are supported, and the correlation degree is "low" There is a positive correlation between "highly correlated" and "highly correlated".4. In addition to the "satisfaction of various body parts", the predictive power of media communication effect on body image of food and beverage students has no significant effect, but "approval", "criticism and suspicion", "social pressure" and "comparison" have no significant effect on "appearance evaluation" And "appearance orientation" is predictive.Accordingly, the above conclusions provide specific suggestions for the policy reference of technical high schools and the competent educational administrative agencies to promote education.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 高中童軍團繩結技能數位化教學成效之研究
title_en: A Study on the Effectiveness of E-learning Applied on High School Scout Group Knotting Skill
keywords: 繩結、數位學習、學習成效
abstract_zh: 本研究主要探討以數位化融入高中童軍團繩結技能教學，是否能提升童軍團員的學習成效。本研究以準實驗設計以雲林縣某高中童軍團為研究對象，共48名童軍團成員進行研究。分為兩組受試對象，並各自接受傳統講述教學及多媒體融入繩結教學。共進行4次實驗課程、羅馬砲實作、繩結知識筆試及問卷調查，以蒐集本次研究資料，並以統計方式分析。研究結果顯示：一、高中童軍團團員童軍繩結知識、童軍繩結認知、童軍繩結情意與童軍繩結技能皆具有中偏高程度。二、不同個人背景變項的高中童軍團團員在童軍繩結知識、童軍繩結認知、童軍繩結情意與童軍繩結技能整體及各層面具有差異。三、研究對象「童軍繩結技能」與「童軍繩結知識、認知、情意」間有高度正相關。四、研究對象「童軍繩結技能」與「童軍繩結知識、認知、情意」間有高度解釋力。五、在排除前測影響後多媒體教學活動介入對，「童軍繩結知識」是能夠被提升的，然而在「童軍繩結認知、情意、技能」部分是沒有被提升的。期望本研究結果能做為後續發展高中童軍團繩結技能數位學習課程之參考，進而將使得繩結技能可以更加便利地使學習者取得並學習之目的。
abstract_en: This study was conducted to investigate whether the integration of digitalization into the knotting skills teaching in senior high school scout groups could enhance the learning effectiveness of the members. A total of 48 members from a high school scout group in Yunlin County were used as the target group for this study. The subjects were divided into two groups, and each group received both traditional narrative instruction and multimedia-integrated knot teaching. A total of four experimental sessions, a Roman catapult practice, a written test on knotting knowledge, and a questionnaire survey were conducted to collect data for this study and analyzed statistically.The results of the study showed that:1. The senior high school scouts have a medium to high level of knotting knowledge, knotting cognition, knotting affection and knotting skills.2. The variables of scouting knowledge, knotting cognition, scouting affection, and scouting skills vary across senior high school scout groups with different personal backgrounds in terms of overall and individual aspects.3. There is a high positive correlation between the "scout knotting skills" and "scout knotting knowledge, cognition, and affection".4. There is a high degree of explanatory power between "scout knotting skills" and "scout knotting knowledge, cognition, and affection" of the study subjects.5. After excluding the effect of the pre-test, the multimedia teaching activity intervention was able to improve " scouting knowledge about knotting". However, the "scout knotting cognition, affection, and skills" were not improved.It is hoped that the results of this study can be used as a reference for the subsequent development of a digital learning curriculum for senior high school scout groups on knotting skills. And I hope the learners can access the online materials and gain knotting skills more easily.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 應用3D繪圖APP融入國小視覺藝術課程提升空間能力與創造思考能力之研究
title_en: Research on the Application of 3D Drawing APP into Elementary School Visual Art Curriculum to Improve Spatial Ability and Creative Thinking Ability
keywords: 資訊科技融入教學、視覺藝術、空間能力、創造思考能力
abstract_zh: 近年來隨著行動裝置與數位網路科技的迅速發展，讓數位化教育成為現代教育的主流趨勢。然而，有關視覺藝術課程融入3D繪圖APP的探討極為稀少。3D繪圖是視覺藝術課程的基礎，對於學生也有著重要的影響。因此，本研究旨在探討應用3D繪圖APP融入視覺藝術課程對高年級學生於在空間能力與創造思考能力之研究以及課程滿意度之影響。研究為國小高年級的視覺藝術課程，重新進行課程規劃的設計與擬定，主要針對課程內容結合3D繪圖APP，使新增之擬定課程融入既有課堂，並進行研究與分析。本研究採準實驗研究設計法，研究對象為雲林某市立國小五年級二個班級，共計50位國小五年級學生，進行六週的實驗教學。實驗組採3D繪圖APP融入視覺藝術課程教學；對照組採傳統的視覺藝術課程教學。教學內容為應用3D繪圖APP，融入視覺藝術教學，結合創造思考教學活動，與研究者自行設計之存錢筒設計課程為主題，進行教學。其3D繪圖APP的特色，即是簡單且容易學習，可讓學生在繪圖過程中，盡情發揮無限創造力。研究結果：一、視覺藝術課程應用不同教學策略於五年級學生空間能力之提升，實驗組高於對照組，且有顯著性成效。二、視覺藝術課程應用不同教學策略於五年級學生創造思考能力之提升，實驗組高於對照組，且有顯著性成效。三、視覺藝術課程應用不同教學策略於五年級學生，探討不同教學策略的課程滿意度，兩組皆有顯著成果，進一步分析課程滿意度，兩組學生問卷總分的平均差異不明顯，表示實驗組與對照組學生的課程滿意度並無顯著差異。四、視覺藝術課程應用不同教學策略於五年級學生，探討不同教學策略的作品評分，實驗組高於對照組學生，且有顯著性成效。
abstract_en: In recent years, with the rapid development of mobile devices and digital network technology, digital education has become the mainstream trend of modern education. 3D drawing is the foundation of visual art courses and has an important influence on students. Therefore, this research aims to explore the influence of applying 3D drawing APP into visual art curriculum on the research of spatial ability and creative thinking ability and course satisfaction of middle-grade students. The research is a visual arts curriculum for middle grades in elementary schools. This study adopts the quasi-experimental research design method. The research object is two classes of the fourth grade in a municipal elementary school in Yunlin, with a total of 50 fourth-grade students in the elementary school for six weeks of experimental teaching.Research results: 1. The use of different teaching strategies in visual arts courses to improve the spatial ability of fifth-grade students is higher in the experimental group than in the control groups. 2. The experimental group’s creative thinking ability is higher than the control group. 3. Both groups had significant results. Further analysis of course satisfaction showed that the average difference in the total scores of the two groups of students was not obvious, indicating an experiment. There was no significant difference in course satisfaction between the group and the control group. 4. The visual arts course applied different teaching strategies to fifth grade students to explore the scores of works of different teaching strategies. The experimental group was higher than the control group students, and there were significant results.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 印尼高中畢業生於觀光產業的勞動市場表現研究
title_en: An Exploration of High School Graduates’ Labor Market Performance in Indonesian Hospitality Industries
keywords: 餐旅業、生產率、個人工作績效、高級職業學校、高級中學
abstract_zh: 旅遊業是印尼經濟成長的重要產業之一，而旅館業的僱員大多是來自兩種中學制度的中學畢業生，亦即高級職業學校（Vocational High School, VHS）和高級中學（Academic High School,AHS）。本研究旨在探討，在印尼餐旅業工作的中學畢業生之工作績效。本研究以星級飯店和非星級飯店的員工做為問卷調查對象，並從中回收420份問卷作為數據資料，並透過三方面來評估員工的生產率：基本工資、分紅獎金和總薪資，個人工作績效的數據則是透過修改後的個人工作績效問卷（IWPQ）取得，並使用描述性和多元迴歸來進行統計分析。初步的分析階段用來確認學校因素對員工生產率和個人工作績效是否產生影響，而進一步的分析則旨在找到高級職業學校畢業和高級中學畢業的員工所收到的薪水差異模式，工作經歷、工作經歷２、培訓經驗、性別和公司型態用來作為控制學校因素對員工績效影響的變數，在得出結論之前，並對經理級別的四位飯店人員進行訪談，以補充研究結果。研究結果顯示，在學校因素的四個變數中，只有「學校課程」被證明會影響員工的生產率（基本工資、分紅獎金和總薪資），由於產生顯著的負面結果，因此意味著高級職業學校畢業的員工生產率低於高級中學畢業的員工生產率，其他三個變量，即「學校類型」、「學校營運」和「學校營運成本」，並不會影響員工的生產率，學校因素則不影響個人工作績效；在兩階段分析的結果中發現，基本工資、分紅獎金和總薪資模式在工作滿兩年之後存在顯著差異，然分紅獎金在工作僅兩年期間並沒有顯著差異。
abstract_en: The tourism sector is one of the crucial sectors for economic growth in Indonesia. The majority of employees in the hotel industry are high school graduates who come from two school tracks at the secondary level, i.e. Vocational High School (VHS) and Academic High School (AHS). This study aims to explore the performance of high school graduates working in the Indonesian hospitality industry.Data were collected through  420 survey questionnaires obtained from the participation of employees who work in star and non-star hotels. Employee productivity is measured from three aspects, i.e. basic salary, bonuses, and total salary. IWPQ modified by the researcher is used to obtain individual work performance data. Statistical analysis used descriptive and multiple regression. The initial stage is carried out to determine the effect of school factors on employee productivity and individual work performance. Meanwhile, the further analysis aims to find a pattern of discrepancy salary received by VHS and AHS graduates. Job experience, job experience2, training experience, gender, and firm type variables were used to control the effect of school factors on employee performance. Before making any conclusions, interviews with four hoteliers at the manager level were conducted to complement the study results.The findings of this study indicate that of the four variables in the school factor, only the school program variable is proven to affect employee productivity (basic salary, bonuses, and total salary). Three other variables, i.e. school type, school operation, and school operational cost, do not affect employee productivity. With the result of a significant negative effect, it means the productivity of employees of VHS graduates is lower than employees of AHS graduates. Regarding individual work performance, the school factor does not affect it. In the results of the 2-stage analysis, the discrepancy in basic salary, bonuses, and total salary patterns was found significant in the two years of service and afterwards. Concerning bonuses, there was no significant difference after the two years of service.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 數位學習課程運用網路教學策略對於學習行為、群組互動與學習滿意度關係之研究
title_en: A Study of the Relationships among Teaching Strategy on Learning Behavior,Group Interaction ,and the Satisfactions of Learning for E-Learning Curriculum in the Web-Learning System
keywords: 數位學習、學習行為、群組互動、學習滿意度
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在探討數位教學課程運用網路教學策略對於學習行為、群組互動與學習滿意度關係之研究，透過國立雲林科技大學《網路學園》系統平台網路教學模式的針對修習的人數進行背景調查與分析學習滿意度差異情形。本研究以修習國立雲林科技大學技職所莊貴枝教授所授課之「比較技職教育研究」數位學習認證課程131名研究生為研究對象，上課方式為數位教學平台《網路學園》來進行授課，教學方式以5次面授、8次同步遠距、5次非同步遠距為混合式教學，共十八週，授課完畢後，讓學生利用《網路學園》線上討論並以分組方式在即時平台上進行分享、討論課程內容、小組報告製作與組別報告，研究工具為莊貴枝教授編製之「比較技職教育研究數位課程教學策略與方法之滿意度調查問卷」。    分別以敘述性統計、獨立樣本t檢定、單因子變異數分析、積差與典型相關及結構方程模式SEM等方法分析資料，並且進行各項假設之探討與驗證。最後獲致結論如下： 一、數位教學課程運用網路教學策略對於學習行為、群組互動與學習滿意度有正向之影響。 二、學生年齡背景變項對學習行為、群組互動與學習滿意度皆具不同影響。 三、數位教學課程運用網路教學策略影響學習行為、群組互動與學習滿意度有顯著的影響。 四、數位教學課程運用網路教學策略對於學習行為會透過群組互動而間接正向顯著影響學習滿意度，群組互動具有中介效果。   本研究提出相關實證的數據與建議，俾供未來教學與研究之參考。
abstract_en: This study had been to explore the relationships of learning behavior, group interaction and learning satisfactions in the web-learning systems by using e-learning curriculum.  Through the network teaching model on the system platform of Network Academy in National Yunlin University of Science & Technology, we went on the background investigation and analyzed the differences on learning satisfactions according to the number of learners.  The object was 131 graduate students who had studied "Comparative Vocational and Technological Education" e-learning certification courses taught by Kuei-Chih Chuang Professor from Graduate School of Technological and Vocational Education National Yunlin University of Science & Technology.  The students attended class through e-learning teaching platform on Network Academy.  The teaching way was 5 times face-to-face, 8 times distance synchronization, and 5 times distance asynchronous as mixed type teaching for 18 weeks. After teaching, students went on on-line discussion through Network Academy, shared in real-time platform by grouping , discussed course content, made group report and made constituency report.  The research tool was the satisfaction questionnaire of Comparative Technological and Vocational Education e-learning curriculum on teaching strategy and methods edited by Kuei-Chih, Chuang Professor.The data was analyzed by the methods like descriptive analysis, independent sample mean t test, One-Way ANOVA, product-moment correlation analysis, SEM and so on. In addition, the discussion and verification with the hypotheses were carried out.The conclusions of this study were following：1.The influence of teaching strategy on learning behavior, group interaction and learning satisfactions in the e-learning curriculum was positive.2.The variables about students from different backgrounds to learning bechavior, group interaction and learning satisfactions had different influences.3.The influence of the e-learning curriculum by using teaching strategy in the web-learning system on learning behavior, group interaction and learning satisfactions was a obvious positive relationship.4.The e-learning curriculum using the web-teaching strategies had a indirect positive obvious influence on learning satisfactions through group interaction. Group interaction had intermediary effect.According to the results of the research, this study provides relative concrete data and suggestions as the references for the future teaching and research.

department: 技術及職業教育研究所
title: 幼兒教師親師溝通與班級經營效能關係之研究
title_en: A Study on the Relationship between Preschool Teachers' Parent-teacher Communication and Classroom Management Efficacy
keywords: 幼兒教師、親師溝通、班級經營效能
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在探討幼兒教師親師溝通與班級經營效能關係之現況與相關情形。    本研究採問卷調查法，以「幼兒教師親師溝通量表」和「幼兒教師班級經營效能量表」這兩種量表作為研究工具，並以雲林縣幼兒教師為研究樣本。所得資料以SPSS25 for Windows 統計軟體執行分析，採描述統計方法、獨立樣本t檢定、單因子變異數分析、皮爾森積差相關和逐步迴歸分析等方法，進行研究資料分析。    根據分析結果，本研究所獲得結論如下：壹、幼兒教師親師溝通之「溝通理念與方式」、「溝通內容」和「溝通管道」無顯著相關性。貳、幼兒教師親師溝通在不同的年齡、婚姻、教育程度和教學年資無顯著差異。參、幼兒教師班級經營效能之「親師生互動」、「環境規劃與佈置」與「班級常規」無顯著相關性。肆、幼兒教師班級經營效能在不同的年齡、婚姻、教育程度和教學年資則無顯著差異。伍、幼兒教師親師溝通各層面與班級經營效能各層面呈現正相關性。陸、幼兒教師親師溝通對班級經營效能具有顯著預測力。    最後，根據研究結論提出相關建議，以作為日後教育行政單位、幼兒教師及後續研究者參考。
abstract_en: This research aims to explore the current situation and related situations of the relationship between preschool teachers' parent-teacher communication and classroom management effectiveness.    This study adopts the questionnaire survey method, using two scales, the " Preschool Teachers’ Parent-Teacher Communication Scale" and the " Preschool Teacher’s Classroom Management Efficiency Scale" as the research tools, and the Yunlin County preschool teachers as the research sample.The data obtained is analyzed by SPSS25 for Windows statistical software, and the research data are analyzed by descriptive statistical methods, independent sample t test, single factor variance analysis, Pearson product difference correlation and stepwise regression analysis.    According to the analysis results, the research conclusions are as follows:1.There is no significant correlation between the "communication concept and method","communication content" and "communication channel" of the preschool  teacher's parent-teacher communication.2.There is no significant difference in communication between preschool teachers and parents in different ages, marriages, education levels and teaching years.3.There is no significant correlation between "pro-teacher-student interaction","environmental planning and layout" and "class routine" in the management  effectiveness of the preschool teacher's class.4.There is no significant difference in classroom management efficiency of preschool teachers in different ages, marriages, education levels and teaching years.5.There is a positive correlation between all levels of communication between parents and teachers of preschool teachers and all levels of classroom management  effectiveness.6.The communication between preschool teachers and teachers has significant predictive power for classroom management effectiveness.    Finally, based on the research conclusions, relevant suggestions are put forward for future reference for educational administrative units, preschool teachers and follow-up researchers.
